papers.title: Singular Weak-Field Thermodynamics of 2D Superconductors
papers.abstract: In a bulk 3D type-II superconductor, the lower critical field at which an isolated vortex becomes thermodynamically favorable is a size-independent material property. We show that the situation is different in 2D superconductors: the larger the superconductor, the weaker the field needed to create its first vortex. The lower critical field in 2D is always size-dependent. For a disk of area $\mathcal A$, the lower critical field $B_v(\mathcal A)$ scales as $\mathcal A^{-1}\ln(\mathcal A/\mathcal A_0)$ in the weak-screening regime and as $\mathcal A^{-1/2}$ in the strong-screening regime. We derive these results from an analytically tractable microscopic model that admits many-body wavefunctions for both the uniform and singly quantized vortex states in a magnetic field, and incorporate screening by coupling their long-distance 2D supercurrents to 3D Maxwell equations. These results motivate organizing the weak-field ground-state of a 2D superconductor in the $(1/\mathcal A,B)$ plane. The origin represents the zero-field thermodynamic limit and it is singular. Approaching the origin along the $B$ axis leads to an increasingly dilute vortex lattice, whereas approaching along the $1/\mathcal A$ axis yields the uniform vortex-free state. Our theory shows that every trajectory carrying fixed finite flux ultimately approaches the vortex-free state in the thermodynamic limit and provides a firm microscopic foundation for the weak-field thermodynamics of 2D superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically tractable microscopic model”“derive these results”“provides a firm microscopic foundation”，属于解析理论推导。；研究对象：二维超导体的弱场热力学性质，特别是下临界场（第一个涡旋出现的磁场）对体系尺寸的依赖关系，以及涡旋态与均匀态的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维超导体的下临界场总是依赖于体系尺寸：面积越大，产生第一个涡旋所需的磁场越弱。在弱屏蔽区，下临界场按 $\mathcal A^{-1}\ln(\mathcal A/\mathcal A_0)$ 标度；在强屏蔽区，按 $\mathcal A^{-1/2}$ 标度。热力学极限（面积趋于无穷、磁场趋于零）在参数平面 $(1/\mathcal A, B)$ 中是一个奇异点，沿不同路径趋近该点会得到不同的基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维超导体的下临界场总是依赖于体系尺寸：面积越大，产生第一个涡旋所需的磁场越弱。在弱屏蔽区，下临界场按 $\mathcal A^{-1}\ln(\mathcal A/\mathcal A_0)$ 标度；在强屏蔽区，按 $\mathcal A^{-1/2}$ 标度。热力学极限（面积趋于无穷、磁场趋于零）在参数平面 $(1/\mathcal A, B)$ 中是一个奇异点，沿不同路径趋近该点会得到不同的基态。；创新点：首次系统揭示了二维超导体下临界场的尺寸依赖性，并建立了弱场热力学极限的奇异结构——即热力学极限与零场极限的顺序不可交换，沿不同路径趋近会得到涡旋晶格态或均匀无涡旋态。摘要未突出说明与具体材料体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个可解析求解的微观模型，该模型能给出磁场中均匀态和单量子涡旋态的多体波函数；通过将二维超导体的长距离超流与三维麦克斯韦方程耦合来纳入屏蔽效应，从而解析推导出下临界场的尺寸标度律。

papers.title: Understanding the superconducting proximity effect in semiconductors through quantum oscillations
papers.abstract: Superconductor-semiconductor hybrids host emergent states of matter and offer a platform for new qubits, but the superconducting metal shunts electrical transport, which rules out conventional semiconductor characterization and leaves the hybrid parameters to speculation. Here we determine density, mass, $g$-factor, mobility and subband occupation beneath the superconductor, from Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations of a buried InAs quantum well under Al, Sn, V, Nb, Ta and Re films, with a Dingle analysis that accounts for the shunt. Every metal adds an interface subband whose occupation falls into one of two classes, whereas the mass and $g$-factor of the buried well are unchanged to within 10\%. Within the uncertainty set by the transport mobility, no film shortens the quantum lifetime of the buried well, and Al and Sn lengthen it. Quantum lifetimes bound the hybridization of the interface subband to 2-4~meV. These measurements supply the normal-state parameters that tunnelling spectroscopy renormalizes but cannot measure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验测量（Shubnikov-de Haas振荡、Dingle分析），并涉及多种金属薄膜的制备与表征。；研究对象：超导体-半导体混合体系，具体为被Al、Sn、V、Nb、Ta、Re薄膜覆盖的埋藏InAs量子阱。研究聚焦于超导邻近效应下半导体层的正常态电子参数（密度、有效质量、g因子、迁移率、子带占据）及界面子带的杂化强度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过量子振荡测量，成功确定了超导金属下方InAs量子阱的密度、质量、g因子、迁移率和子带占据；所有金属均引入一个界面子带，其占据分为两类，而埋藏阱的质量和g因子变化不超过10%。量子寿命的测量表明Al和Sn可延长量子寿命，且界面子带杂化能量被限制在2–4 meV。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过量子振荡测量，成功确定了超导金属下方InAs量子阱的密度、质量、g因子、迁移率和子带占据；所有金属均引入一个界面子带，其占据分为两类，而埋藏阱的质量和g因子变化不超过10%。量子寿命的测量表明Al和Sn可延长量子寿命，且界面子带杂化能量被限制在2–4 meV。；创新点：首次通过量子振荡直接表征超导金属覆盖下半导体层的正常态参数，克服了超导金属分流对传统半导体表征的阻碍，并提供了隧穿谱学无法直接测量的正常态基准参数。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用Shubnikov-de Haas（SdH）振荡测量，结合考虑超导金属分流效应的Dingle分析，对埋藏InAs量子阱在Al、Sn、V、Nb、Ta、Re薄膜覆盖下的输运数据进行提取。通过振荡频率和Dingle衰减分别确定载流子密度、有效质量、g因子、迁移率、子带占据和量子寿命。

papers.title: No source-free exchange-correlation magnetic fields in non-collinear spin DFT
papers.abstract: We show that the Maxwellian equation $\nabla\cdot\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{xc}}=0$, where $\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{xc}}$ is the exchange-correlation (xc) magnetic field, is not an exact condition of non-collinear spin density functional theory: it violates global spin-rotation symmetry, the operation which turns the electron spins. How much does this matter in practice? To find out we impose the condition anyway, in the best way we can: we modify any parent xc functional so that the Kohn-Sham procedure yields a divergence-free $\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{xc}}$ that is a functional derivative, stays exact for the homogeneous gas, and exerts the local torques a locally collinear functional cannot. Any non-physical result from the calculation must be due to the spurious condition, not the implementation. On Mn$_2$ with LSDA as parent, the source-free (SoF) construction and locally collinear (LoC) LSDA both give too short a bond and too large a bond energy, but differ on the magnetic exchange coupling and on the state itself: SoF finds the experimentally observed $^1Σ^+_g$ antiferromagnet, with a coupling of the right sign and roughly the right size, while LoC finds a high-spin $^{11}Π_u$ ferromagnet and the wrong sign. Despite this seeming success, breaking the symmetry has serious consequences: a rigid spin rotation of the magnetization changes $E_{\mathrm{xc}}$ by about 1 eV (it should not change at all), and the magnetization induced by a weak uniform field points perpendicular to the field (it should be antiparallel to it).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：non-collinear spin density functional theory、Kohn-Sham procedure、functional derivative。；研究对象：非共线自旋密度泛函理论（non-collinear spin DFT）中的交换关联磁场（exchange-correlation magnetic field, B_xc），并以Mn₂分子作为具体测试体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无源条件 ∇·B_xc = 0 并非非共线自旋DFT的精确条件，强行施加会破坏全局自旋旋转对称性，导致严重非物理后果（如刚性自旋旋转改变交换关联能约1 eV，弱均匀场诱导的磁化方向垂直于外场而非反平行）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无源条件 ∇·B_xc = 0 并非非共线自旋DFT的精确条件，强行施加会破坏全局自旋旋转对称性，导致严重非物理后果（如刚性自旋旋转改变交换关联能约1 eV，弱均匀场诱导的磁化方向垂直于外场而非反平行）。；创新点：提出了一种“最小破坏”地施加无源条件的具体构造方案（SoF），使得任何非物理结果可明确归因于无源条件本身而非实现细节；并首次系统展示了该条件在Mn₂上虽能偶然给出正确的磁耦合符号和大小，却同时带来严重的对称性破坏后果。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值计算：从对称性论证出发证明无源条件违反自旋旋转对称性；构造“源自由”（source-free, SoF）泛函——对任意母泛函（此处以LSDA为母）施加无源约束，同时保持其为泛函导数、对均匀电子气精确、并能产生局域力矩；在Mn₂上对比SoF-LSDA与局域共线（locally collinear, LoC）LSDA的结果。

papers.title: First-principles optical response of shock-compressed LiF: Quasiparticle, excitonic, and ionic-temperature effects
papers.abstract: We investigate the refractive index $n$ of LiF using DFT+G$_0$W$_0$+BSE, with ionic-temperature effects included through QMD. We calculate photon-energy dispersions $n(ω)$ and $k(ω)$ at ambient pressure and $n(ρ,T)$ at 532 and 1550 nm under shock compression, where $ρ$ and $T$ vary together. Quasiparticle band structures at ambient and compressed conditions and the ambient-pressure orbital-projected density of states connect the optical response to the electronic structure. At ambient pressure, G$_0$W$_0$ yields a quasiparticle gap of 14.25 eV, close to the experimental 14.2 eV, while BSE reproduces the main excitonic feature at 12.5 eV, close to the observed 12.6 eV. Quasiparticle and excitonic effects are thus essential for accurate optical dispersion; the hybrid HSE functional does not reproduce the optical spectra. Along the principal Hugoniot up to 140 GPa, $n(ρ)$ agrees closely with shock data at 1550 nm and acceptably at 532 nm, and agrees better overall than earlier first-principles calculations. Above approximately 110-120 GPa, QMD produces a downturn relative to cold $n(ρ)$ curves, suggesting that ionic dynamics may contribute to deviations from the linear $n$-$ρ$ Gladstone-Dale relation. QMD-sampling and finite-k-grid uncertainties are estimated, and transition-peak broadening is assessed using a recently proposed criterion. The gap increases under pressure, with a transition to a $Γ\to\mathrm L$ indirect gap near 50 GPa. An exploratory calculation at approximately 1400 GPa finds a gap of about 24 eV, disfavoring gap-closure metallization. Structural and elastic benchmarks of the underlying models are also provided.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：First-principles、DFT+G₀W₀+BSE、QMD（量子分子动力学）。；研究对象：冲击压缩下LiF（氟化锂）的光学响应，具体包括折射率n(ω)、消光系数k(ω)随光子能量的色散关系，以及沿主Hugoniot（冲击绝热线）在532 nm和1550 nm波长下折射率n(ρ,T)随密度和温度的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准粒子（G₀W₀）和激子（BSE）效应对于准确描述LiF的光学色散必不可少；沿主Hugoniot至140 GPa，计算折射率与冲击实验数据吻合良好，且高于约110–120 GPa时离子动力学导致n(ρ)相对冷曲线出现下弯，偏离线性Gladstone-Dale关系。压力下带隙增大，约50 GPa处转变为Γ→L间接带隙，约1400 GPa时带隙仍约24 eV，不支持冲击下带隙闭合金属化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准粒子（G₀W₀）和激子（BSE）效应对于准确描述LiF的光学色散必不可少；沿主Hugoniot至140 GPa，计算折射率与冲击实验数据吻合良好，且高于约110–120 GPa时离子动力学导致n(ρ)相对冷曲线出现下弯，偏离线性Gladstone-Dale关系。压力下带隙增大，约50 GPa处转变为Γ→L间接带隙，约1400 GPa时带隙仍约24 eV，不支持冲击下带隙闭合金属化。；创新点：首次在G₀W₀+BSE框架下系统研究冲击压缩LiF的光学响应，并定量评估了离子温度效应、QMD采样不确定性和有限k网格误差；发现HSE杂化泛函无法复现光学谱，而G₀W₀+BSE可同时准确复现环境压力下的激子峰（12.5 eV vs 实验12.6 eV）和准粒子带隙（14.25 eV vs 实验14.2 eV）。摘要未突出说明与以往第一性原理计算相比的具体改进机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用DFT+G₀W₀+BSE（含激子效应的第一性原理方法）计算光学响应，离子温度效应通过QMD（量子分子动力学）模拟纳入；同时计算了准粒子能带结构、轨道投影态密度，并给出结构及弹性基准测试。摘要未明确说明具体使用的DFT交换关联泛函（如PBE）及QMD的具体实现细节。

papers.title: A relational fabrication-to-modeling database for memristor devices
papers.abstract: Resistive random access memory (RRAM) devices, also known as memristors, are highly dependent on fabrication, location on the wafer, and measurement protocols. However, openly available large-scale memristor datasets remain scarce, particularly those that combine experimental metadata with electrical measurements and preserve explicit links across the experimental workflow. Here, we present a comprehensive relational database of automated electrical characterization data from oxide-based memristors. The database links 6,190 memristor devices across TiN/HfOx/TiN, Pt/TiOx/AlOy/Pt, and Pt/TiOx/Pt stacks to 161,006 validated experiments and over 169 million electrical point records. It integrates fabrication, wafer mapping, electrical characterization, and modeling to describe electroforming, current-voltage non-linearity, memory windows (R_off/R_on), switching dynamics, and short-term volatility. Released as a normalized and indexed SQLite database with schema documentation, graphical user interfaces, and examples of empirical modeling, this resource supports provenance-aware querying, statistical analysis, and data-driven applications for the development of future memristor technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验数据采集 + 数据库构建 + 经验建模）。判断依据：摘要提及“automated electrical characterization data”（自动化电学表征数据）、“relational database”（关系数据库）以及“examples of empirical modeling”（经验建模示例）。；研究对象：氧化物基忆阻器（RRAM），具体材料体系包括 TiN/HfOx/TiN、Pt/TiOx/AlOy/Pt 和 Pt/TiOx/Pt 三种堆叠结构。涉及的物理现象包括电致形成（electroforming）、电流-电压非线性、存储窗口（R_off/R_on）、开关动力学以及短时挥发性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作构建了一个包含 6,190 个忆阻器器件、161,006 个已验证实验和超过 1.69 亿个电学点记录的大型关系数据库，将制造工艺、晶圆位置、电学表征与建模数据显式关联，为忆阻器性能的溯源查询和统计分析提供了开放资源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作构建了一个包含 6,190 个忆阻器器件、161,006 个已验证实验和超过 1.69 亿个电学点记录的大型关系数据库，将制造工艺、晶圆位置、电学表征与建模数据显式关联，为忆阻器性能的溯源查询和统计分析提供了开放资源。；创新点：该工作填补了公开大规模忆阻器数据集的空白，特别是将实验元数据（制造与晶圆位置信息）与电学测量数据以关系数据库形式显式关联，支持溯源感知查询（provenance-aware querying），这是以往数据集所缺乏的。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 自动化电学表征（automated electrical characterization）获取器件数据；数据库采用规范化且带索引的 SQLite 格式，并配有模式文档、图形用户界面（GUI）以及经验建模示例。摘要未明确说明具体电学测量技术细节（如脉冲或直流扫描方式）。

papers.title: Accelerating dynamic simulations of photoexcited materials and their evolution by electron-informed machine learning
papers.abstract: Nonadiabatic coupled electron-nuclear dynamics upon electronic excitation underpin the microscopic mechanism and rational modulation of diverse photoinduced functional phenomena in materials, yet their direct first-principles simulations remain computationally demanding. Here we develop a framework for nonadiabatic excited-state machine-learning molecular dynamics (EMLMD) simulations, where the nonequilibrium electronic information upon photoexcitation such as electron temperature is rigorously calibrated from high-precision real-time time-dependent density functional theory (rt-TDDFT) benchmark simulations, enabling accurate reconstruction of excited-state potential energy surfaces (PES). This framework natively incorporates the excited-state electron-phonon couplings and intrinsically captures photoinduced phonon anharmonicity, both of which are missing in standard machine learning molecular dynamics, thus delivering first-principles-level accuracy for excited-state atomic evolutions. Large-scale EMLMD simulations resolve time- and momentum-resolved phonon dynamics in photoexcited materials, directly uncovering the competition between photogenerated coherent phonons and thermal phonons during photoinduced phase transition of bismuth. It also simultaneously resolves elusive atomic-scale microscopic dynamics and global structural rearrangement for selenium photoamorphization. Balancing high accuracy and efficiency, EMLMD offers a versatile paradigm to tackle key challenges in the study of complex excited-state molecular dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“machine learning molecular dynamics (EMLMD) simulations”、“real-time time-dependent density functional theory (rt-TDDFT) benchmark simulations”等第一性原理计算方法。；研究对象：光激发材料（photoexcited materials）中的非绝热耦合电子-核动力学，具体包括铋（bismuth）的光致相变和硒（selenium）的光致非晶化过程中的声子动力学与结构演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作发展的EMLMD框架能够以第一性原理精度重现光激发态原子演化，并首次在大尺度模拟中同时分辨出光致相变中相干声子与热声子的竞争，以及硒光致非晶化中原子尺度微观动力学与全局结构重排。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作发展的EMLMD框架能够以第一性原理精度重现光激发态原子演化，并首次在大尺度模拟中同时分辨出光致相变中相干声子与热声子的竞争，以及硒光致非晶化中原子尺度微观动力学与全局结构重排。；创新点：该框架首次在机器学习分子动力学中内禀地纳入激发态电子-声子耦合和光致声子非谐性（这两者在标准MLMD中缺失），实现了对光激发态原子演化的大规模、第一性原理精度模拟，并同时解析了时间分辨和动量分辨的声子动力学。
papers.method_zh: 基于机器学习分子动力学（MLMD）框架，结合高精度实时含时密度泛函理论（rt-TDDFD）基准模拟来标定光激发后的非平衡电子信息（如电子温度），从而重构激发态势能面（PES）。该框架天然包含激发态电子-声子耦合和光致声子非谐性。

papers.title: Superconducting diode effect from field-induced $s+if$ pairing in Ising superconductors
papers.abstract: The in-plane critical field of Ising superconductors exceeds the Pauli limit by an order of magnitude because the Ising spin-orbit coupling locks the electron spins out of the basal plane. The same locking converts an in-plane Zeeman field into a source of equal-spin triplet Cooper pairs, so that the field-driven condensate acquires an $s+if$ character. We show that this conversion channel also generates Lifshitz invariants, the odd-in-momentum terms of the Ginzburg-Landau expansion responsible for the superconducting diode effect. When the basal mirror symmetry of the monolayer is lifted by a substrate or a gate, the field-induced triplets couple linearly to the Cooper-pair momentum, and an intrinsic diode response develops whose strength is set by the ratio of the Zeeman and spin-orbit energies rather than by the small ratio of the spin-orbit and Fermi energies familiar from parity-mixing mechanisms. We construct the symmetry-constrained two-component Ginzburg-Landau theory of the coupled singlet and triplet order parameters and derive all of its coefficients from the microscopic model of an Ising superconductor; the complete functional, including all gradient and quartic terms, is generated by a single pair-breaking function of temperature, field, and Cooper-pair momentum. An attractive triplet channel reshapes the diode response: at weak fields it suppresses the efficiency through destructive interference between the direct and the collective-mode conversion paths, while at strong fields it extends the diode regime well beyond the singlet-only critical field, with the maximal efficiency reached along the triplet-enhanced phase boundary. The diode effect thereby serves as a transport probe of a hidden triplet pairing channel and of the field-induced $s+if$ state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Ginzburg-Landau理论”“微观模型”“推导系数”等理论推导关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：Ising超导体中的超导二极管效应，具体为面内磁场诱导的s+if配对态及其输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Ising超导体中，面内塞曼场通过等自旋三重态通道产生Lifshitz不变量，从而在无外磁场梯度下产生本征超导二极管效应；该效应强度由塞曼能与自旋轨道能的比值决定，而非传统的自旋轨道能与费米能的小比值。此外，吸引性三重态通道可重塑二极管响应，并在强场下将二极管工作区间扩展至纯单重态临界场以上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Ising超导体中，面内塞曼场通过等自旋三重态通道产生Lifshitz不变量，从而在无外磁场梯度下产生本征超导二极管效应；该效应强度由塞曼能与自旋轨道能的比值决定，而非传统的自旋轨道能与费米能的小比值。此外，吸引性三重态通道可重塑二极管响应，并在强场下将二极管工作区间扩展至纯单重态临界场以上。；创新点：首次指出Ising超导体中面内磁场诱导的等自旋三重态转换通道可直接产生Lifshitz不变量，从而无需宇称混合机制即可实现本征超导二极管效应；并揭示该效应可作为探测隐藏三重态配对通道及场致s+if态的输运探针。
papers.method_zh: 对称性约束的两分量Ginzburg-Landau理论，耦合单重态与三重态序参量；从Ising超导体的微观模型出发推导所有系数（包括梯度项和四次项），整个泛函由单一的温度、磁场和库珀对动量的对破缺函数生成。

papers.title: Polar nanoregions and reentrant-like ferroelectric behavior in SrTiO$_3$
papers.abstract: Recent real-space imaging in quantum paraelectric SrTiO$_3$ [Nature 656, 54 (2026)] reveals that local polar textures do not continuously grow upon cooling, but reach a maximum intensity at intermediate temperatures around 60-65~K and weaken again toward the quantum paraelectric ground state. Such a reentrant-like weakening of local polar textures challenges the conventional paradigm in which ordering tendencies generally strengthen as thermal fluctuations are suppressed. Here we employ a self-consistent phase-field theory showing that this anomalous behavior naturally arises from the interplay between intrinsic polar and antiferrodistortiv (AFD) fluctuations. We demonstrate that flexoelectric-like coupling strongly hybridizes the polar and AFD modes. As the uncoupled polar and AFD modes cross near 52~K, their hybridization is maximized, driving the lower hybridized branch to develop a minimum on a finite-wave-vector shell. This finite-$q$ softening triggers a Brazovskii-type instability, strongly enhancing polarization correlations and producing nanoscale polar textures. Away from the crossing temperature, the two modes become increasingly detuned, weakening their hybridization and the associated finite-$q$ softening. These results reaveal the origin of the formation of polar nanoregions in SrTiO$_3$, naturally explaining the unexpected confinement to an intermediate-temperature window and providing a mechanism beyond the quantum-fluctuation-based interpretation suggested by experiment. Furthermore, we predict an unconventional reentrant-like sequence in weakly strained SrTiO$_3$, evolving from ferroelectric to paraelectric, polar-nanoregion, and eventually paraelectric regimes upon heating from zero temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“self-consistent phase-field theory”（自洽相场理论）进行建模与预测，属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：量子顺电体 SrTiO₃（钛酸锶）中的极性纳米区域（polar nanoregions）及其再入型（reentrant-like）铁电行为，重点关注极性模式与反铁畸变（antiferrodistortive, AFD）模式之间的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SrTiO₃ 中极性纳米区域的形成源于极性模式与 AFD 模式的杂化：当两者在约 52 K 交叉时，杂化最强，导致有限波矢壳层上的软化（Brazovskii 型不稳定性），从而增强极化关联并形成纳米极性纹理；偏离交叉温度后杂化减弱，极性纹理随之削弱。该机制自然解释了极性纹理仅存在于中间温度窗口（约 60–65 K）的异常现象，并预测弱应变 SrTiO₃ 在升温过程中呈现“铁电→顺电→极性纳米区域→顺电”的非常规再入型序列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SrTiO₃ 中极性纳米区域的形成源于极性模式与 AFD 模式的杂化：当两者在约 52 K 交叉时，杂化最强，导致有限波矢壳层上的软化（Brazovskii 型不稳定性），从而增强极化关联并形成纳米极性纹理；偏离交叉温度后杂化减弱，极性纹理随之削弱。该机制自然解释了极性纹理仅存在于中间温度窗口（约 60–65 K）的异常现象，并预测弱应变 SrTiO₃ 在升温过程中呈现“铁电→顺电→极性纳米区域→顺电”的非常规再入型序列。；创新点：提出了超越实验所建议的“量子涨落”解释的新机制——即极性/AFD 模式杂化驱动的有限波矢软化，首次从理论上解释了极性纳米区域为何被限制在中间温度窗口，并预言了弱应变 SrTiO₃ 中全新的再入型相序列。
papers.method_zh: 自洽相场理论（self-consistent phase-field theory），包含极性模式与 AFD 模式的耦合，以及类挠曲电（flexoelectric-like）耦合项的引入，用于分析模式杂化、有限波矢软化及 Brazovskii 型不稳定性。

papers.title: Cell size and confinement drive asymmetric cell division through a cortical instability
papers.abstract: Asymmetric cell division -- in which a mother cell divides into two daughter cells of unequal size -- is a fundamental problem in biology. It is believed that the asymmetry originates from the prior polarization of the mother cell. Here we show that division asymmetry can occur spontaneously even in unpolarized mother cells. Specifically, curvature-dependent active stresses in the cell cortex can lead to this symmetry breaking without any molecular polarity cue if the mother cell is confined within a restricted space. Either reducing the cell size or tightening mechanical confinement triggers the same spontaneous symmetry-breaking instability, in which the contractile ring slips off the equator to yield daughters of unequal volume. In the presence of a polarity cue, this instability cooperates with the cue to program the division asymmetry. The model prediction is compared with the imaging data of C. elegans embryogenesis, in which successive cell divisions in a confined eggshell lead to smaller and smaller cell sizes. The measured division asymmetry indeed increases as the cells shrink, and is further amplified when the embryo is mechanically compressed, both in agreement with the model prediction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/建模文章（结合实验数据对比）。判断依据：摘要中出现“active stresses”“model prediction”“instability”等理论建模关键词，并与“imaging data”对比。；研究对象：不对称细胞分裂的物理机制，具体为细胞皮层（cell cortex）中曲率依赖的活性应力导致的对称性破缺，以及细胞尺寸和机械约束（confinement）对分裂不对称性的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使母细胞未预先极化，在受限空间内，皮层中曲率依赖的活性应力也能自发触发分裂不对称性——收缩环偏离赤道，产生体积不等的子细胞。减小细胞尺寸或增强机械约束均可诱发该不稳定性，且该机制与极性线索协同调控分裂不对称程度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使母细胞未预先极化，在受限空间内，皮层中曲率依赖的活性应力也能自发触发分裂不对称性——收缩环偏离赤道，产生体积不等的子细胞。减小细胞尺寸或增强机械约束均可诱发该不稳定性，且该机制与极性线索协同调控分裂不对称程度。；创新点：首次提出分裂不对称性可完全由几何/力学因素（细胞尺寸与约束）自发产生，无需分子极性线索；并揭示该力学不稳定性与极性线索的协同作用。摘要未突出说明与既有极化主导模型的系统性差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：基于活性应力与皮层曲率耦合的连续介质不稳定性分析；模型预测与秀丽隐杆线虫胚胎发育的活体成像数据（连续分裂中细胞尺寸递减、机械压缩实验）进行定量对比。

papers.title: Simulating Continuous-Rotation 3D Electron Diffraction: A Multislice and Bloch Wave Framework
papers.abstract: To improve the agreement between measured and calculated intensities of three-dimensional electron diffraction (3D ED) experiments, a simulation pipeline is needed to assess and quantify the influence of various structural and experimental parameters. We present a computational pipeline, built upon the abTEM Python package, to simulate continuous-rotation 3D electron diffraction data based on either the Bloch wave or the multislice formalism. Multislice calculations in arbitrary orientations are achieved through large supercells and windowing. We investigate the convergence of key simulation parameters and test their consistency, establishing suitable parameters for accurate and efficient simulations. The pipeline's applicability and robustness are demonstrated through case studies on cubic silicon as well as stretched and sheared variants, analyzing the influence of electron kinetic energy, sample thickness, orientation, and symmetry on simulated diffraction intensities. Finally, we investigate a representative selection of seven compounds, including cubic $\mathrm{SrTiO_3}$, monoclinic $α$-glycine $\mathrm{C_2H_5NO_2}$, and triclinic kyanite $\mathrm{Al_2SiO_5}$ to validate the method. This framework for the simulation of 3D electron diffraction data establishes an approach to investigate the dependence of diffracted intensities on experimentally relevant parameters which are difficult to systematically investigate in experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法学文章。关键词：simulation pipeline、computational pipeline、Bloch wave、multislice formalism。；研究对象：三维电子衍射（3D ED）实验的模拟方法，具体应用于立方硅（cubic silicon）及其拉伸/剪切变体、立方SrTiO₃、单斜α-甘氨酸（C₂H₅NO₂）和三斜蓝晶石（Al₂SiO₅）等七种化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了一套基于abTEM Python包的连续旋转3D电子衍射模拟流程，能够系统评估电子动能、样品厚度、取向和对称性等参数对衍射强度的影响，并验证了该方法在多种晶体结构（从立方到三斜）上的适用性和稳健性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了一套基于abTEM Python包的连续旋转3D电子衍射模拟流程，能够系统评估电子动能、样品厚度、取向和对称性等参数对衍射强度的影响，并验证了该方法在多种晶体结构（从立方到三斜）上的适用性和稳健性。；创新点：提供了一个统一的、可系统扫描实验相关参数（如厚度、取向、对称性）的3D ED模拟框架，这些参数在实验中难以系统调控——摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于Bloch波或multislice形式主义，在abTEM Python包中实现连续旋转3D ED模拟；multislice计算通过大超胞和加窗（windowing）技术实现任意取向；通过收敛性测试确定关键模拟参数。

papers.title: Antiresonances of Wannier-Stark ladders in Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattices
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that Wannier-Stark ladders (WSLs) in one-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chains manifest as antiresonance signatures in the electron transmission. We study the quantum transport in the SSH chain in the presence of a periodic potential profile plus a uniform electric field. By employing the global matrix method with non-trivial matching conditions, we find that these WSL antiresonances correspond to states that are exponentially localized at the potential's incident boundary. These findings provide a robust, unified framework for identifying WSLs across diverse scales, ranging from electronic transport in trans-polyacetylene to classical-wave analogs in phononic crystals and surface water waves.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“global matrix method”（全局矩阵方法）以及“electron transmission”（电子输运）计算，属于理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：一维Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链中的Wannier-Stark梯子（WSLs），具体体系为存在周期势剖面与均匀电场叠加的SSH链，并涉及电子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SSH链中的Wannier-Stark梯子在电子透射谱中表现为反共振（antiresonance）特征，且这些反共振态对应于在势垒入射边界处指数局域化的态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SSH链中的Wannier-Stark梯子在电子透射谱中表现为反共振（antiresonance）特征，且这些反共振态对应于在势垒入射边界处指数局域化的态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但指出该工作为在不同尺度（从trans-polyacetylene的电子输运到声子晶体和表面水波的经典波类比）中识别WSLs提供了一个统一且稳健的框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用全局矩阵方法（global matrix method），并引入非平凡匹配条件（non-trivial matching conditions）来研究量子输运。

papers.title: Pole-Zero Geometry, Model Reduction, and Identifiability in Sensory Adaptation
papers.abstract: Sensory adaptation provides a concrete setting in which low-order system identification can fail qualitatively. We show that one fixed higher-order adaptive system composed entirely of real first-order relaxation modes can be reduced to opposite sides of the second-order pole boundary: low-frequency moment matching gives $ρ_{\rm moment}=4.50$, whereas finite-window fitting gives $ρ_{\rm window}=3.31$, and the inferred pole class changes further with sampling protocol. Thus the real-versus-complex classification of a reduced model is not itself reduction invariant. We then use the general two-state spectrum to connect stochastic identifiability to adaptation: for nontrivial coupling and one-state observation, cross diffusion drops out of the scalar spectrum when the hidden state has no self-relaxation. In the adaptive model, this condition is precisely the integral-memory limit that produces exact adaptation, while leaky memory restores spectral sensitivity. For the exact-adaptation model, the Gaussian path-space irreversibility nevertheless depends on the hidden cross-diffusion channel. Hence $\{H,S_x\}$ does not determine the irreversibility rate. Independently, for a specified all-even reduced two-state drift with $ρ<4$, the drift-only lower bound is $σ\ge τ_x^{-1}(4/ρ-1)$. Published \textit{E.~coli} and \textit{C.~elegans} responses provide biological examples of these limits. The distinction established here between transfer-function invariants, reduction-dependent properties, and hidden-state quantities provides a concrete framework for evaluating the limitations of low-dimensional models of adaptive biological dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“系统辨识”“模型降阶”“随机可辨识性”“高斯路径空间不可逆性”等理论分析内容，未提及实验手段或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：感官适应（sensory adaptation）过程中的低阶动力学模型，具体以大肠杆菌（*E. coli*）和秀丽隐杆线虫（*C. elegans*）的生物学响应为实例，研究高阶自适应系统降阶为二阶模型时的极零点几何、可辨识性及不可逆性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 一个由纯实数一阶弛豫模式构成的高阶自适应系统，在降阶为二阶模型时，其极点类型（实数或复数）依赖于降阶方法（低频矩匹配给出ρ=4.50，有限窗口拟合给出ρ=3.31），因此“实极点vs复极点”的分类并非降阶不变量；此外，在精确适应极限下，标量谱无法反映隐藏交叉扩散通道，但路径空间不可逆性仍依赖该通道，说明谱信息不足以确定不可逆率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：一个由纯实数一阶弛豫模式构成的高阶自适应系统，在降阶为二阶模型时，其极点类型（实数或复数）依赖于降阶方法（低频矩匹配给出ρ=4.50，有限窗口拟合给出ρ=3.31），因此“实极点vs复极点”的分类并非降阶不变量；此外，在精确适应极限下，标量谱无法反映隐藏交叉扩散通道，但路径空间不可逆性仍依赖该通道，说明谱信息不足以确定不可逆率。；创新点：首次明确指出“实极点vs复极点”的降阶模型分类不具降阶不变性，并系统区分了传递函数不变量、降阶依赖性质与隐藏态量三类量，为评估低维自适应生物动力学模型的局限性提供了具体框架。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：低阶系统辨识（低频矩匹配与有限窗口拟合）、二阶极点边界分析、两态谱理论、随机可辨识性分析、高斯路径空间不可逆性计算，以及漂移-扩散下界推导（σ ≥ τ_x⁻¹(4/ρ−1)）。生物学实例来自已发表的*E. coli*和*C. elegans*响应数据。

papers.title: Inversion-symmetric topological insulators in cut-and-project binary chains
papers.abstract: We investigate the electronic properties of binary tight-binding chains generated by the cut-and-project method for rational slopes $α=p/q$, leading to periodic and inversion symmetric chains with $n=p+q$ sites. The binary structure is encoded in two hopping amplitudes $t_a$ and $t_b$. For fixed $t_a \neq t_b$, the support of the energy spectrum as a function of $p/n$ gives rise to a "Cut-and-Project butterfly". We concentrate on insulators with $M$ filled bands among a total of $n$ bands and vary $t_a/t_b$. Inversion symmetry constrains the electric polarization $P$ to $0$ or $P_q/2$ modulo a polarization quantum $P_q = \gcd(M,n)/n$. A topological transition, between two insulators that differ by their quantized polarization, occurs if and only if $n/\gcd(M,n)$ is odd. When $n/\gcd(M,n)$ is even, the two insulating regimes have a vanishing polarization and no topological transition occurs, despite the gap closing at $t_a=t_b$. When $n$ is even and $M$ odd, we find an adiabatic path between $t_a>t_b$ and $t_a<t_b$ that maintains inversion symmetry and a gap.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及紧束缚模型、对称性分析、极化量子化等理论概念，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：由cut-and-project方法生成的有理斜率α=p/q的二元紧束缚链，具有反演对称性，包含n=p+q个格点，两种跳跃振幅ta和tb。研究其电子性质、能谱结构（“Cut-and-Project butterfly”）及拓扑绝缘体相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反演对称性将电极化P约束为0或P_q/2（模极化量子P_q）。拓扑相变（极化量子化值改变）仅在n/gcd(M,n)为奇数时发生；为偶数时两绝缘相极化均为零，无拓扑相变，尽管ta=tb处能隙闭合。当n为偶数且M为奇数时，存在保持反演对称性和能隙的绝热路径连接ta>tb与ta<tb两个区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反演对称性将电极化P约束为0或P_q/2（模极化量子P_q）。拓扑相变（极化量子化值改变）仅在n/gcd(M,n)为奇数时发生；为偶数时两绝缘相极化均为零，无拓扑相变，尽管ta=tb处能隙闭合。当n为偶数且M为奇数时，存在保持反演对称性和能隙的绝热路径连接ta>tb与ta<tb两个区域。；创新点：揭示了反演对称二元链中拓扑相变的存在条件与n/gcd(M,n)奇偶性的严格对应关系，并发现当n/gcd(M,n)为偶数时能隙闭合但不伴随拓扑相变的反常行为；此外，在n为偶数、M为奇数时构造了保持对称性和能隙的绝热路径，表明两个看似不同的绝缘态在拓扑上等价。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于cut-and-project方法构造周期二元链，利用紧束缚模型计算能谱；通过反演对称性约束分析电极化P的量子化取值；结合能隙闭合条件与n/gcd(M,n)的奇偶性判定拓扑相变；构造绝热路径验证特定情况下的拓扑等价性。

papers.title: Thickness-Dependent Orbital-to-Spin Torque Signatures in Cr/Gd/Co Thin Films
papers.abstract: We studied orbital-torque generation in Cr(10nm)/Gd($t_{\mathrm{Gd}}$)/Co(3nm)/TaO$_x$ and the inverted stack Co(3nm)/Gd($t_{\mathrm{Gd}}$)/Cr(10nm) with $t_{\mathrm{Gd}}$ from 0 to $5\,\mathrm{nm}$ by combining electrical harmonic Hall measurements with magnetometry. A detailed understanding of the magnetometric data is obtained by cross-sectional chemical composition mapping. The data show temperature-dependent magnetic compensation points, while elemental analysis provides evidence of pronounced intermixing, in particular of Gd and Co layers. From the harmonic Hall dataset we extract the damping-like (DL) and field-like (FL) torque efficiencies normalized to the applied electric field, $ξ_{\mathrm{DL}}^{E}$ and $ξ_{\mathrm{FL}}^{E}$, and interpret their dependence on the Gd interlayer thickness using two different descriptions: (i) a naive-layer model and (ii) an alloy model that accounts for interfacial mixing. Notably, upon reversing the stack order, the FL contribution changes sign, whereas the DL contribution does not change sign within the harmonic Hall measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要提及“electrical harmonic Hall measurements”“magnetometry”“cross-sectional chemical composition mapping”等实验手段。；研究对象：Cr/Gd/Co 薄膜异质结及其反置结构 Co/Gd/Cr，具体研究 Gd 插层厚度（0–5 nm）对轨道转矩（orbital torque）产生与自旋-轨道转矩符号的影响，涉及磁性补偿点、界面混合及阻尼类（DL）和场类（FL）转矩效率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Cr/Gd/Co 及反置 Co/Gd/Cr 薄膜中，Gd 层厚度调控轨道转矩效率；反置堆叠顺序后，场类（FL）转矩贡献改变符号，而阻尼类（DL）转矩在谐波霍尔测量中符号不变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Cr/Gd/Co 及反置 Co/Gd/Cr 薄膜中，Gd 层厚度调控轨道转矩效率；反置堆叠顺序后，场类（FL）转矩贡献改变符号，而阻尼类（DL）转矩在谐波霍尔测量中符号不变。；创新点：通过系统改变 Gd 层厚度并对比正反堆叠结构，揭示了轨道转矩的厚度依赖及堆叠顺序对 FL 转矩符号的影响，并引入合金模型定量解释界面混合效应。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 电学谐波霍尔测量（harmonic Hall measurements）提取 DL 和 FL 转矩效率（ξ_DL^E 和 ξ_FL^E）；磁强计（magnetometry）测量磁化行为；截面化学组分映射（cross-sectional chemical composition mapping）分析元素分布与界面混合；采用“naive-layer model”和考虑界面混合的“alloy model”两种模型解释 Gd 层厚度依赖。

papers.title: Self-Healing Diffusion Monte Carlo applied to a simple fermionic model: A critical assessment of the method
papers.abstract: We investigate the Self-Healing Diffusion Monte Carlo (SHDMC) method using a one-dimensional model with periodic boundary conditions. An inversion symmetry is introduced to mimic the antisymmetry property of fermionic wavefunctions, with the bosonic and fermionic sectors being modeled by the even and odd eigenstates, respectively. As in realistic fermionic systems, the nodal structure is only partially constrained by symmetry, making this model a non-trivial testbed for nodal optimization algorithms such as SHDMC. We show that the nodal evolution under SHDMC iterations can be cast into a dynamical system exhibiting both attractive and repulsive fixed points. In the standard formulation of SHDMC applied to this model, the fixed-node energy is found to increase upon iteration, and the node converges to a wrong value, indicating that SHDMC does not always converge to the correct solution. We further show that this problem is partially cured by modifying the nodal update criterion to give more importance to the nodal region. Achieving convergence in the general case very likely requires the use of a localized basis set, as is the case for this model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Self-Healing Diffusion Monte Carlo (SHDMC) 方法、模型计算、迭代动力学分析。；研究对象：一维周期边界条件下的简单费米子模型。该模型通过引入反演对称性来模拟费米子波函数的反对称性质，其中偶宇称和奇宇称本征态分别对应玻色子和费米子扇区。该模型的节面结构仅部分受对称性约束，因此可作为检验节面优化算法的非平凡测试平台。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在标准SHDMC公式下，该模型的固定节面能量随迭代次数增加而升高，节面收敛到错误值，表明SHDMC并不总是收敛到正确解。通过修改节面更新准则（给予节面区域更大权重）可部分修复该问题，但一般情况下的收敛很可能需要采用局域基组。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在标准SHDMC公式下，该模型的固定节面能量随迭代次数增加而升高，节面收敛到错误值，表明SHDMC并不总是收敛到正确解。通过修改节面更新准则（给予节面区域更大权重）可部分修复该问题，但一般情况下的收敛很可能需要采用局域基组。；创新点：首次将SHDMC的节面演化形式化为具有吸引/排斥不动点的动力学系统，并系统揭示了标准SHDMC在该类部分对称性约束模型中可能失败的具体机制；同时提出了改进节面更新准则的补救方案。摘要未明确说明与以往SHDMC测试工作的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用Self-Healing Diffusion Monte Carlo (SHDMC) 方法，这是一种量子蒙特卡洛节面优化算法。作者将SHDMC迭代下的节面演化映射为一个具有吸引和排斥不动点的动力学系统，并分析了不同节面更新准则对收敛行为的影响。

papers.title: An exact and fast solution of the inverse Regularized Optimal Transport problem
papers.abstract: Optimal transport describes the most efficient way to move mass between two distributions, given a cost matrix for moving mass between each pair of locations. Entropic optimal transport, solved via the Sinkhorn algorithm, is a widely used regularized version of this problem. Its inverse problem asks the opposite question: given an observed transport plan, what cost matrix produced it? This is difficult because the cost is identifiable only up to an additive gauge freedom. Here we show that this freedom can be fixed exactly by a single double-centering operation applied to the observed plan, yielding the true cost matrix in closed form, with no iterative optimization required. When a modest number of true cost entries are known, the same approach lets us jointly estimate the temperature parameter controlling the entropic regularization, together with a diagnostic for the reliability of this estimate. We further show that the method is not specific to the entropic optimal transport, but extends to a broader class of transport models defined by an invertible relation between cost and plan.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于数学推导与算法设计（“closed form”“no iterative optimization required”），属于理论框架构建与计算方法提出。；研究对象：最优传输（Optimal Transport）及其正则化版本——熵正则化最优传输（Entropic Optimal Transport）的**逆问题**，即从给定的传输计划（transport plan）反推生成它的代价矩阵（cost matrix）。属于数学物理与计算凝聚态交叉领域，不涉及具体材料或物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过一次简单的双中心化（double-centering）操作，即可精确固定代价矩阵的规范自由度（gauge freedom），以闭式解直接还原真实代价矩阵，无需迭代优化；当已知少量真实代价条目时，还可联合估计熵正则化温度参数并给出可靠性诊断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过一次简单的双中心化（double-centering）操作，即可精确固定代价矩阵的规范自由度（gauge freedom），以闭式解直接还原真实代价矩阵，无需迭代优化；当已知少量真实代价条目时，还可联合估计熵正则化温度参数并给出可靠性诊断。；创新点：首次证明逆正则化最优传输问题可通过单次双中心化操作获得精确闭式解，完全避免迭代优化；同时提出温度参数与可靠性诊断的联合估计方案，并展示方法对更广传输模型类的普适性。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与算法设计：利用双中心化操作解析求解逆问题；对温度参数估计采用“已知少量代价条目”的联合估计策略；并证明该方法可推广至更广泛的、代价与计划满足可逆关系的传输模型类别。摘要未提及具体数值模拟或实验手段。

papers.title: Intruder dynamics in granular media under localized surface loading
papers.abstract: We experimentally investigate the dynamics of a spherical intruder driven horizontally at a constant force in a granular medium subjected to a localized surface overload. While intruder motion beneath a free surface exhibits constant acceleration in the quasistatic regime, the presence of a surface load induces a pronounced transient deceleration when the intruder passes below the loaded region. The magnitude of this deceleration increases with the applied overload and saturates at large overloads, while it decreases with intruder depth. Introducing a characteristic timescale and an overload-based Froude number, we show that the deceleration dynamics collapse onto master curves. We further develop a model incorporating stress transmission from the surface, which partially captures the intruder deceleration. In this approach, this deceleration is shown to depend on two parameters: the overload and the area on which this overload is applied. These results provide a framework to quantify how localized surface stresses influence subsurface intruder dynamics, with implications for locomotion, root growth, and underground transport in granular media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“experimentally investigate”，属于实验研究。；研究对象：颗粒介质中的球形侵入体（intruder）在局部表面过载（localized surface overload）条件下的水平恒力驱动动力学。具体物理现象为侵入体在自由表面下方运动时，经过表面加载区域所经历的瞬态减速行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 表面局部过载会在侵入体经过加载区域下方时诱发显著的瞬态减速，该减速幅度随过载增大而增大并在大过载下饱和，随侵入体深度增大而减小；引入特征时间尺度和基于过载的Froude数后，减速动力学可塌缩到主曲线上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：表面局部过载会在侵入体经过加载区域下方时诱发显著的瞬态减速，该减速幅度随过载增大而增大并在大过载下饱和，随侵入体深度增大而减小；引入特征时间尺度和基于过载的Froude数后，减速动力学可塌缩到主曲线上。；创新点：首次系统量化了局部表面应力对颗粒介质中地下侵入体动力学的影响，提出了基于过载和过载作用面积两个参数的减速描述框架，并建立了表面应力传递模型。该框架对颗粒介质中的 locomotion（运动）、根系生长和地下输运具有潜在应用意义。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异点。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：恒力水平驱动球形侵入体穿过颗粒介质，施加可控的局部表面过载，测量侵入体运动轨迹与速度变化；通过改变过载大小和侵入体深度系统研究减速行为；引入特征时间尺度和过载Froude数进行数据塌缩分析；并建立包含表面应力传递的理论模型进行部分验证。

papers.title: Tunneling characteristics of twisted double bilayer graphene heterostructures
papers.abstract: Electron tunneling between sheets of bilayer Bernal graphene twisted at different small angles was studied experimentally and theoretically. The current-voltage characteristics exhibit resonant peaks, steps, and regions of negative differential resistance, the origin of which is explained by the intersections of energy- and momentum-shifted electron dispersions of adjacent layers. A theoretical analysis of tunneling transport demonstrated that the key to understanding this phenomenon lies in the competition between two contributions: between like (conductivity-conductivity or valence-valence) and unlike (conductivity-valence) bands of parallel bilayer graphene sheets. A systematic evolution of the tunneling current patterns with increase of the twist angle is investigated. Polarization of electron wave function across graphene sublayers caused by displacement field within bilayer graphene is shown to strongly affect the tunneling probability, thus enhancing negative differential resistance due to Van Hove singularities at the band edges.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“studied experimentally and theoretically”，包含实验测量与理论分析。；研究对象：扭转双层Bernal石墨烯异质结构（twisted double bilayer graphene heterostructures），即两层Bernal堆垛双层石墨烯以不同小角度扭转堆叠形成的体系，研究其层间电子隧穿特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 隧穿电流-电压特性呈现共振峰、台阶和负微分电阻区域，其起源可归因于相邻层间能量与动量平移的电子色散的交点；层间隧穿由同类能带（导带-导带或价带-价带）与异类能带（导带-价带）贡献之间的竞争决定，且层内位移场引起的波函数极化会显著增强由范霍夫奇点导致的负微分电阻。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：隧穿电流-电压特性呈现共振峰、台阶和负微分电阻区域，其起源可归因于相邻层间能量与动量平移的电子色散的交点；层间隧穿由同类能带（导带-导带或价带-价带）与异类能带（导带-价带）贡献之间的竞争决定，且层内位移场引起的波函数极化会显著增强由范霍夫奇点导致的负微分电阻。；创新点：系统揭示了扭转角增大时隧穿电流模式的演化规律，并首次明确指出双层石墨烯内位移场导致的波函数极化对隧穿概率的强烈调控作用，可增强带边范霍夫奇点引起的负微分电阻。（摘要未突出说明与先前工作的具体差异）
papers.method_zh: 实验上测量隧穿电流-电压特性曲线；理论上对隧穿输运进行分析，考虑能量与动量守恒的色散交点，并计算不同扭转角下的隧穿电流模式，同时分析位移场对子层波函数极化的影响。

papers.title: Multiple chiral Majorana states in proximitized magnetic topological insulator heterostructures
papers.abstract: Achieving robust topological superconductivity with multiple Majorana channels is a key step for scalable topological quantum computing. To this end, we investigate magnetically doped three-dimensional topological insulator heterostructures proximitized by an s-wave superconductor within a fully three-dimensional extended Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang framework that explicitly accounts for vertical confinement. We show that magnetic exchange coupling, orbital mixing, and bulk band inversion cooperate to generate effective equal-spin p-wave pairing channels supporting multiple chiral Majorana modes. The number of Majorana channels is determined by the confined modes in the vertical direction and the high-Chern-number phases of the normal state, which allows us to derive an analytical criterion for the emergence of the multiple-Majorana topological superconducting phases. The chiral Majorana modes remain robust against strong disorder and moderate symmetry-breaking perturbations. We also demonstrate that a superconducting phase difference defining a vertical Josephson junction acts as a tunable parameter that controls the hybridization, minigap, and effective multiplicity of the low energy Majorana channels. Our results establish magnetic three-dimensional topological- insulator heterostructures as a promising platform for engineering multiple chiral Majorana modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“investigate”“framework”“show”“derive an analytical criterion”等理论推导与建模关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：磁性掺杂三维拓扑绝缘体异质结，与s波超导体邻近耦合（proximitized）形成的体系，具体研究其拓扑超导态及手性马约拉纳模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁交换耦合、轨道杂化与体带反转协同作用，可在该异质结中产生有效的等自旋p波配对通道，从而支持多个手性马约拉纳模；马约拉纳通道数目由垂直方向的受限模式数及正常态的高陈数相决定，并给出了多马约拉纳拓扑超导相出现的解析判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁交换耦合、轨道杂化与体带反转协同作用，可在该异质结中产生有效的等自旋p波配对通道，从而支持多个手性马约拉纳模；马约拉纳通道数目由垂直方向的受限模式数及正常态的高陈数相决定，并给出了多马约拉纳拓扑超导相出现的解析判据。；创新点：首次在三维磁性拓扑绝缘体异质结中系统阐明多个手性马约拉纳通道的产生机制，并建立通道数目与垂直受限模式及高陈数相的定量联系；提出垂直约瑟夫森结的相位差可作为调控马约拉纳通道杂化、微隙及有效多重性的可调参数。
papers.method_zh: 采用全三维扩展的Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang（BHZ）框架，显式考虑垂直方向的量子受限效应，对磁性掺杂三维拓扑绝缘体异质结进行理论建模与分析；通过解析判据推导和数值计算研究马约拉纳模式的稳定性及约瑟夫森结调控。

papers.title: Interferometry reveals spin-singlet fractional quantum Hall edges in graphene
papers.abstract: The edge modes of spin-singlet fractional quantum Hall (FQH) phases are manifestations of multicomponent topological order and SU(2) spin symmetry. An archetype is the spin-unpolarized state at $ν$=2/3, whose edge is expected to host spatially coexisting yet counter-propagating charge and neutral spin modes. Despite efforts, its edge properties, including spin coherence and spin-charge separation, have remained elusive owing to the difficulty of resolving spins in FQH edge transport. Here, we develop a spin-sensitive probe of graphene FQH edges by using a p-n junction to interface a target FQH state with a probe integer quantum Hall (QH) state of opposite polarity. An Aharonov-Bohm (AB) interferometer forms along the interface, when the target and probe edge channels carry the same spin. We identify the spin-unpolarized and polarized edges of the $ν$=2/3 states at lower and higher magnetic fields, respectively, through spin-dependent interference. A novel multiparticle AB interference between two electrons of opposite spin emerges from spin-charge separation and recombination on the unpolarized edge, featuring a spin swap. Our results establish edge transport as a probe of spin-singlet topological orders, with implications for parafermion platforms in graphene-superconductor hybrids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述“we develop a spin-sensitive probe”“We identify...through spin-dependent interference”，属于实验测量工作。；研究对象：石墨烯中自旋单态分数量子霍尔（FQH）态的边界模式，具体聚焦于ν=2/3自旋非极化态及其边缘的自旋-电荷分离、自旋交换等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过自旋敏感的Aharonov-Bohm（AB）干涉测量，在较低磁场下识别出ν=2/3态的自旋非极化边缘，在较高磁场下识别出自旋极化边缘；并观测到由自旋-电荷分离与复合导致的新型双电子（相反自旋）多粒子AB干涉，伴随自旋交换过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过自旋敏感的Aharonov-Bohm（AB）干涉测量，在较低磁场下识别出ν=2/3态的自旋非极化边缘，在较高磁场下识别出自旋极化边缘；并观测到由自旋-电荷分离与复合导致的新型双电子（相反自旋）多粒子AB干涉，伴随自旋交换过程。；创新点：首次实现对FQH边缘的自旋分辨探测，直接观测到自旋单态拓扑序中自旋-电荷分离及自旋交换的多粒子干涉效应，为石墨烯-超导体混合体系中parafermion平台提供了实验基础。
papers.method_zh: 利用石墨烯p-n结将目标FQH态与相反极性的整数量子霍尔（QH）探测态耦合，沿界面形成AB干涉仪；通过自旋依赖的干涉信号区分不同自旋构型的边缘通道。

papers.title: Geometry-Controlled Magnetic and Electronic Landscapes in Anisotropic van der Waals Materials
papers.abstract: Electronic structure in van der Waals materials is commonly engineered through composition, strain, electrostatic gating and heterostructure assembly. Here we introduce geometronics, a concept in which substrate geometry locally reorients an anisotropic crystal, transforming homogeneous external perturbation into programmable magnetic and electronic landscapes. We demonstrate this concept using a bilayer of the antiferromagnetic semiconductor CrSBr transferred onto an inverted pyramidal nanoindentation, where the local crystal orientation with respect to the external magnetic field drives the coexistence of antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic phases within a single continuous crystal. The resulting magnetic landscape creates a switchable excitonic potential well of up to 10--12 meV, directly visualised by spatially resolved spectroscopy. More generally, geometronics provides a universal route for deterministically programmed electronic and magnetic landscapes without modifying the material itself. It therefore establishes substrate topography as a new design principle that exploits the intrinsic anisotropy of layered van der Waals materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“transferred onto an inverted pyramidal nanoindentation”“spatially resolved spectroscopy”等实验操作与表征手段。；研究对象：各向异性范德华材料 CrSBr 双层薄膜，具体为反铁磁半导体 CrSBr 转移至倒金字塔形纳米压痕上形成的体系，涉及磁相共存与激子势阱现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过基底几何形貌局部调控各向异性晶体的取向，可在单一连续 CrSBr 晶体中实现反铁磁与铁磁相共存，并形成可切换的激子势阱（深度约 10–12 meV），从而将均匀外场转化为可编程的磁性与电子结构空间分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过基底几何形貌局部调控各向异性晶体的取向，可在单一连续 CrSBr 晶体中实现反铁磁与铁磁相共存，并形成可切换的激子势阱（深度约 10–12 meV），从而将均匀外场转化为可编程的磁性与电子结构空间分布。；创新点：提出“几何电子学”（geometronics）这一新概念，利用基底形貌而非材料改性（如组分、应变、栅压或异质结组装）来编程范德华材料中的磁性与电子结构景观，将基底拓扑确立为一种普适的设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 将 CrSBr 双层转移至倒金字塔形纳米压痕上，利用基底几何形貌改变局部晶体取向；结合空间分辨光谱（spatially resolved spectroscopy）直接可视化激子势阱及其空间分布。

papers.title: Robust thermodynamics constrain disorder and pairing in far-overdoped Tl$_2$Ba$_2$CuO$_6$
papers.abstract: The physical origin of the suppression of superconductivity with hole doping in overdoped cuprates remains unclear. We measure the electronic specific heat of microgram-scale Tl$_2$Ba$_2$CuO$_6$ crystals and find sharp superconducting anomalies persisting far into the overdoped regime, with $Δγ(T_{\rm c})/γ_n\approx0.6$ for $T_{\rm c}=14$-$25$K. A weak-coupling BCS-like framework incorporating the known Fermi surface and cation disorder quantitatively reproduces the observed anomaly and its weak doping dependence. We conclude that the observed $T_{\rm c}(p)$ cannot be driven predominantly by increasing disorder and is instead consistent with a smoothly decreasing pairing strength.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“We measure the electronic specific heat of microgram-scale Tl₂Ba₂CuO₆ crystals”，属于实验测量，并结合理论框架进行定量分析。；研究对象：过掺杂铜氧化物超导体 Tl₂Ba₂CuO₆（Tl-2201），具体研究其超导转变温度随空穴掺杂增加而受到抑制的物理机制，以及超导序参量在过掺杂区的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在过掺杂区（T_c = 14–25 K），电子比热仍表现出尖锐的超导异常，且 Δγ(T_c)/γ_n ≈ 0.6；该异常及其弱掺杂依赖可由包含已知费米面和阳离子无序的弱耦合BCS框架定量重现。因此，T_c(p) 的下降并非主要由无序增强驱动，而是与配对强度随掺杂平滑减弱一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在过掺杂区（T_c = 14–25 K），电子比热仍表现出尖锐的超导异常，且 Δγ(T_c)/γ_n ≈ 0.6；该异常及其弱掺杂依赖可由包含已知费米面和阳离子无序的弱耦合BCS框架定量重现。因此，T_c(p) 的下降并非主要由无序增强驱动，而是与配对强度随掺杂平滑减弱一致。；创新点：首次在微克级Tl-2201单晶上实现过掺杂区电子比热的精确测量，并利用热力学量（比热异常）严格约束无序与配对强度对T_c抑制的相对贡献，排除了无序主导的机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 微克级单晶的电子比热测量（高灵敏度热容实验）；理论分析采用弱耦合BCS类框架，并结合已知费米面结构及阳离子无序效应进行定量建模。

papers.title: Autonomous discovery of new structure-plausibility laws for explainable and rapid crystal diagnosis and screening
papers.abstract: Crystal generators and tool-using agents propose structures faster than density functional theory (DFT) energy and phonon calculations or experiments can assess them. Deciding which candidates merit expensive assessment is therefore the bottleneck, yet most screens test little beyond atomic overlap and give no chemical reason for failure. Here, our agents generate, test and actively refute two million candidate laws, leaving eight Plausibility Rules for Inorganic Structures (PRIS). These laws encode five mechanisms: short-range repulsion, ionic contact and packing, electrostatic balance, bond-valence conservation and crystallographic site complexity. Experimental structures satisfy our law sets at 82--99%, but satisfy Pauling's rules 2--5 together at only 6.5%. The strictest set detects 87.9% of damaged crystal structures, whereas distance cutoffs detect only 1.6--3.2%. PRIS plausibility is linearly correlated with synthesizability, so the PRIS-derived synthesis score (PSS) explainably screens 83.7% of hard-to-synthesize structures while retaining 80.7% of experimental structures. In a property-conditioned inverse-design run, PRIS and PSS can reduce the DFT validation queue by up to 67.3% and keep 99.2% of the candidates whose DFT-validated bulk moduli reach the design target. Beyond screening, PRIS explains why GNoME remains enriched in rare low-symmetry structures and reveals how wrong-element assignments in falsified crystal reports hide behind plausible coordinates. PRIS moves screening from a pass-or-fail verdict to a chemical reason for failure, showing that autonomous agents can discover, by active refutation, physicochemical laws that guide calculations and experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要强调“agents generate, test and actively refute two million candidate laws”，属于大规模自动化规则发现与筛选，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：无机晶体结构的合理性（plausibility）判定与筛选，具体针对晶体生成器、工具型智能体提出的候选结构，以及实验晶体结构数据库中的结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过主动反驳两百万条候选规则，提炼出八条无机结构合理性规则（PRIS），其满足率远高于Pauling规则，且能检测出87.9%的损坏晶体结构（距离截断仅能检测1.6–3.2%）。PRIS合理性分数与可合成性线性相关，可解释地筛选出83.7%难合成结构，同时保留80.7%实验结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过主动反驳两百万条候选规则，提炼出八条无机结构合理性规则（PRIS），其满足率远高于Pauling规则，且能检测出87.9%的损坏晶体结构（距离截断仅能检测1.6–3.2%）。PRIS合理性分数与可合成性线性相关，可解释地筛选出83.7%难合成结构，同时保留80.7%实验结构。；创新点：将晶体筛选从“通过/不通过”的二元判定提升为给出化学失败原因的机制性诊断；首次展示自主智能体可通过主动反驳发现指导计算与实验的物理化学定律；PRIS能解释GNoME中稀有低对称结构富集的原因，并揭示错误元素分配如何隐藏在看似合理的坐标中。
papers.method_zh: 自主智能体（agents）驱动的规则生成与主动反驳（active refutation）框架；对两百万条候选规则进行系统性测试与证伪；PRIS规则编码了短程排斥、离子接触与堆积、静电平衡、键价守恒和晶体学位点复杂度五种物理机制；PRIS衍生合成分数（PSS）用于性质条件反设计中的筛选；与DFT验证队列及体模量计算结果进行对比评估。

papers.title: Dynamical phase transitions for single particles in the semiclassical and weak noise limits
papers.abstract: We present a unifying description of dynamical phase transitions in the unitary evolution of an isolated quantum particle and the dissipative relaxation of a classical Brownian particle, based on a dynamical generat- ing function. In the semiclassical and weak-noise limits, Fisher zeros of this function condense in the complex- time plane and reach the corresponding physical axes, producing dynamical phase transitions through a competition between return trajectories. This establishes a direct connection between quantum and classical (finite-time) dynamical phase transitions, where the semiclassical limit plays the role of the thermodynamic limit. In particular, the established link naturally provides a classical version of the Loschmidt amplitude and shows how dynamical quantum phase transitions, typically associated with isolated many-body systems, can arise in a single-particle quantum system. The dynamical phases are distinguished by a unifying, trajectory- based order parameter, realized as a classical correlation function and a sequential quantum weak value.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“unifying description”“dynamical generating function”“semiclassical and weak-noise limits”等理论推导与概念框架，未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：孤立量子单粒子在幺正演化中的动力学相变，以及经典布朗粒子耗散弛豫中的动力学相变；重点研究单粒子量子系统中的动力学量子相变（dynamical quantum phase transitions）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在半经典与弱噪声极限下，动力学生成函数的Fisher零点在复时间平面上凝聚并到达物理时间轴，通过返回轨迹之间的竞争产生动力学相变；该机制将量子与经典（有限时间）动力学相变统一起来，并表明单粒子量子系统也能出现通常与孤立多体系统相关的动力学量子相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在半经典与弱噪声极限下，动力学生成函数的Fisher零点在复时间平面上凝聚并到达物理时间轴，通过返回轨迹之间的竞争产生动力学相变；该机制将量子与经典（有限时间）动力学相变统一起来，并表明单粒子量子系统也能出现通常与孤立多体系统相关的动力学量子相变。；创新点：建立了量子与经典动力学相变之间的直接联系，将半经典极限类比为热力学极限；首次为单粒子量子系统提供了Loschmidt振幅的经典对应版本，并展示了单粒子系统中可涌现动力学量子相变。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于动力学生成函数（dynamical generating function）的统一理论框架，结合半经典极限与弱噪声极限分析Fisher零点的复时间凝聚行为；引入基于轨迹的序参量，分别实现为经典关联函数和顺序量子弱值（sequential quantum weak value）。

papers.title: Layer-selective and magnetic-field-enhanced transport of topological kink states in rhombohedral multilayer graphene
papers.abstract: Topological valley kink states (VKSs), which are quantum valley Hall states emerging at the interfaces between adjacent domains with opposite valley Chern numbers, have attracted considerable interest in graphene-based systems. In this work, we investigate the quantum transport of VKSs in ABC-stacked rhombohedral multilayer graphene in the presence of Anderson disorder and a perpendicular magnetic field. Two prominent transport characteristics are revealed. First, in the absence of a magnetic field, the kink states exhibit strong layer polarization, with their wave functions predominantly localized and equally distributed on the outermost top and bottom layers. As a result, their transport properties are highly sensitive to the layer-selective disorder distribution. Second, under a perpendicular magnetic field, the layer-symmetric spatial distribution of VKSs is broken, leading to a significant reduction in the wave-function overlap between counter-propagating VKSs from opposite valleys. Consequently, intervalley scattering is suppressed, and the transmission of VKSs through disordered regions is substantially enhanced. Our results provide new insights into multichannel topological valley transport in rhombohedral multilayer graphene and demonstrates disorder-engineering and magnetic fields as effective approaches for manipulating the propagation of VKSs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“investigate the quantum transport”（量子输运研究），并涉及“Anderson disorder”（安德森无序）和“perpendicular magnetic field”（垂直磁场）下的输运性质计算，属于理论模拟范畴。；研究对象：ABC堆叠菱方多层石墨烯中的拓扑谷赝自旋边界态（valley kink states, VKSs），即在具有相反谷陈数畴界处出现的量子谷霍尔态，以及其在无序和磁场下的输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: VKSs在零磁场下具有强层极化特性（波函数主要分布在最外层顶/底两层），其输运对层选择性无序高度敏感；施加垂直磁场会打破VKSs的层对称空间分布，减小来自相反谷的相向传播VKSs之间的波函数重叠，从而抑制谷间散射并显著增强无序区透射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：VKSs在零磁场下具有强层极化特性（波函数主要分布在最外层顶/底两层），其输运对层选择性无序高度敏感；施加垂直磁场会打破VKSs的层对称空间分布，减小来自相反谷的相向传播VKSs之间的波函数重叠，从而抑制谷间散射并显著增强无序区透射。；创新点：揭示了菱方多层石墨烯中VKSs的层选择性输运特性，并首次提出利用垂直磁场打破层对称性来抑制谷间散射、增强无序下透射的调控机制，将无序工程和磁场作为操控VKSs传播的有效手段。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 量子输运计算（具体方法摘要未明确说明，如格林函数或散射矩阵方法未提及），结合安德森无序模型和垂直磁场下的紧束缚或连续模型描述。摘要未给出具体计算框架细节。

papers.title: Probing Nonlinear Interactions of Dipolar Interlayer Excitons in MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ Heterobilayers
papers.abstract: Interlayer excitons in transition-metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers possess intrinsic out-of-plane dipole moments, providing a platform for investigating exciton-exciton interactions at high densities. Here, we use excitation-energy-dependent photoluminescence excitation (PLE) spectroscopy to probe the nonlinear response of dipolar interlayer excitons in chemical vapor deposition-grown MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterobilayers. By tuning the excitation energy across intralayer exciton resonances at fixed excitation power, we selectively vary the population injected into the interlayer exciton states. Resonant excitation drives the system into a nonlinear regime, leading to saturation of the interlayer exciton photoluminescence and an apparent broadening of the intralayer $1s$ resonances in the PLE spectra. At the same time, the interlayer exciton emission exhibits a pronounced blueshift, reaching approximately 2.5 meV at 4 K and 1 meV at 75 K. The blueshift increases systematically with the interlayer exciton population and is consistent with a net repulsive exciton-exciton interaction, with contributions from dipole-dipole repulsion in the density regime investigated. Our results establish PLE as a sensitive approach for accessing the nonlinear, high-density regime of interlayer excitons and probing their interactions in van der Waals heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“photoluminescence excitation (PLE) spectroscopy”等实验手段，并给出具体温度（4 K、75 K）下的测量结果。；研究对象：化学气相沉积（CVD）生长的MoSe₂/WSe₂异质双层中的层间激子（interlayer excitons），具体研究其高密度下的非线性响应与激子-激子相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节激发能量选择性注入层间激子布居，系统进入非线性区：层间激子光致发光饱和、PLE谱中带内1s共振展宽，同时层间激子发射出现显著蓝移（4 K时约2.5 meV，75 K时约1 meV），蓝移随布居增加而增大，表明净排斥性激子-激子相互作用，主要来自偶极-偶极排斥。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节激发能量选择性注入层间激子布居，系统进入非线性区：层间激子光致发光饱和、PLE谱中带内1s共振展宽，同时层间激子发射出现显著蓝移（4 K时约2.5 meV，75 K时约1 meV），蓝移随布居增加而增大，表明净排斥性激子-激子相互作用，主要来自偶极-偶极排斥。；创新点：将PLE光谱学确立为一种灵敏探测层间激子非线性高密度区及其相互作用的实验手段，可直接通过激发能量调谐实现对层间激子布居的受控注入，从而定量关联蓝移与激子密度。摘要未突出说明与以往PLE研究的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 激发能量依赖的光致发光激发（PLE）光谱学；在固定激发功率下，将激发能量调谐至带内激子共振附近，以选择性改变注入层间激子态的粒子数；测量不同温度（4 K和75 K）下的PL蓝移与谱线展宽。

papers.title: Quantum antidipolar systems in two-dimensional geometries
papers.abstract: Particles with magnetic moment can be polarized, and rapidly rotated, employing a magnetic field such that the dipolar interaction among them changes sign, becoming antidipolar and thus isotropically attractive in a plane. Polar molecules can also be manipulated using microwave dressing fields to invert the sign of the dipole-dipole interaction. In this work, we study a two-dimensional system of antidipolar particles by calculating its equation of state and structural properties. The system behaves as a liquid even for scattering lengths significantly greater than the dipolar length. For large enough densities, the system transitions to a solid with one particle per lattice site via a first-order phase transition at a significantly smaller density than its dipolar counterpart. Moreover, motivated by the recent realization of a strongly axially trapped, bilayer geometry [Science 384, 546-551 (2024)], we study the properties of the bilayer liquid phase as the inter-layer distance is tuned, and provide the range of parameters where one layer can influence the properties of the other.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we study... by calculating its equation of state and structural properties”，即通过计算状态方程和结构性质来研究体系，属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：二维几何中的反偶极（antidipolar）量子粒子体系。具体包括：二维均匀液体/固体相变行为，以及强轴向束缚的双层几何结构中的液体性质（受近期实验[Science 384, 546-551 (2024)]启发）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反偶极粒子在二维中即使散射长度远大于偶极长度时仍表现为液体；在足够大密度下，体系通过一级相变转变为每格点单粒子的固体，且该相变密度显著低于对应的偶极体系。此外，在双层结构中，通过调节层间距可调控层间影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反偶极粒子在二维中即使散射长度远大于偶极长度时仍表现为液体；在足够大密度下，体系通过一级相变转变为每格点单粒子的固体，且该相变密度显著低于对应的偶极体系。此外，在双层结构中，通过调节层间距可调控层间影响。；创新点：首次系统研究二维反偶极（吸引性各向同性）粒子的液-固相图，并发现其与常规偶极（排斥性各向异性）体系在相变密度上的显著差异；同时针对近期实验实现的双层强轴向束缚几何，给出了层间影响可控的参数范围。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算：计算体系的状态方程（equation of state）和结构性质（structural properties）。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如量子蒙特卡洛、扩散蒙特卡洛、超流变分理论等），仅提及“calculating”。

papers.title: Nonmonotonic control of pattern formation by chemotaxis
papers.abstract: We investigate pattern formation in generic two-species reaction--diffusion systems with chemotaxis. We show that chemotaxis can give rise to a striking nonmonotonic dependence of pattern formation on its strength, opening the possibility of re-entrant transitions between patterned and homogeneous states controlled by chemotaxis. In certain regimes, chemotaxis also induces additional heretofore unexplored instabilities. Furthermore, varying the strength of chemotaxis can drive morphological transitions between spot and stripe patterns.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We investigate”“We show”等理论推导性表述，研究对象为“generic two-species reaction–diffusion systems”，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：具有趋化性（chemotaxis）的通用双组分反应–扩散系统中的斑图形成（pattern formation）现象，具体涉及斑图与均匀态之间的转变以及斑点（spot）与条纹（stripe）斑图之间的形态转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 趋化性强度对斑图形成具有显著的非单调控制作用，可导致由趋化性调控的斑图态与均匀态之间的重入转变（re-entrant transitions）；在特定参数区间内，趋化性还会诱发此前未被探索过的新失稳模式，并能驱动斑点与条纹斑图之间的形态转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：趋化性强度对斑图形成具有显著的非单调控制作用，可导致由趋化性调控的斑图态与均匀态之间的重入转变（re-entrant transitions）；在特定参数区间内，趋化性还会诱发此前未被探索过的新失稳模式，并能驱动斑点与条纹斑图之间的形态转变。；创新点：揭示了趋化性强度对斑图形成的非单调控制机制，提出了趋化性诱导的重入转变这一新可能性，并发现了此前未报道的新失稳模式以及趋化性驱动的斑图形态转变。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于通用双组分反应–扩散方程，引入趋化性耦合项，通过线性稳定性分析（失稳条件）研究斑图形成的临界行为及失稳类型，并分析不同趋化性强度下的斑图形态变化。

papers.title: Interfacial orbital torques excite nanoscale terahertz magnons
papers.abstract: Exchange-dominated magnons in nanometer-thick ferromagnets extend to the terahertz regime through thickness quantization of perpendicular standing spin-wave (PSSW) modes. While interfacial spin-orbit torques (SOTs) have been shown to enable the excitation of such modes, the microscopic origin of the interfacial driving torque remains unclear. In particular, the coexistence of spin and orbital currents complicates the understanding. Here, we develop and use an atomistic framework that explicitly resolves interfacial symmetries and separates spin and orbital torque contributions. Exploiting a trilayer geometry for a thin ferromagnet sandwiched between non-magnetic layers, where the symmetry-controlled polarity of the interfacial torque produces mode-selective magnon excitation as observed in the recent experiment of Salikhov et al. Nature Phys. 19, 529 (2023), we disentangle the different interfacial torque contributions. By decomposing the torque into magnetization-even (field-like) and magnetization-odd components, we identify the field-like torque as the dominant contribution responsible for the excitation. Crucially, isolating orbital and spin contributions reveals that the interfacial orbital torque provides the primary channel for the efficient excitation of exchange-dominated THz magnons in thin ferromagnets. Our results establish a microscopic basis for symmetry-engineered control of confined terahertz spin dynamics in magnetic multilayers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop and use an atomistic framework”（发展并运用原子级框架），以及“decomposing the torque”（对力矩进行分解）等理论分析手段。；研究对象：纳米厚度铁磁薄膜夹在非磁层之间的三明治异质结（trilayer geometry），具体研究其中交换主导的太赫兹自旋波（垂直驻留自旋波PSSW模式）的激发机制，以及界面自旋-轨道力矩和轨道力矩的微观来源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面轨道力矩（而非自旋力矩）是高效激发纳米厚度铁磁体中交换主导的太赫兹磁子的主要通道；其中类场（field-like）力矩分量是激发的主导贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面轨道力矩（而非自旋力矩）是高效激发纳米厚度铁磁体中交换主导的太赫兹磁子的主要通道；其中类场（field-like）力矩分量是激发的主导贡献。；创新点：首次在原子级框架中明确区分并量化界面自旋力矩与轨道力矩对太赫兹磁子激发的各自贡献，揭示了轨道力矩作为主导激发通道的微观机制，为对称性工程调控磁性多层膜中的受限太赫兹自旋动力学提供了微观理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 原子级自旋动力学框架（atomistic framework），显式解析界面对称性，将总力矩分解为自旋与轨道贡献，并按磁化偶（field-like）与磁化奇（anti-damping-like）分量进行分离，与Salikhov等人（Nature Phys. 19, 529 (2023)）的实验结果进行对照验证。

papers.title: Pressure-regulated mechanochemistry at lithium metal-sulfide electrolyte interfaces
papers.abstract: Stack pressure is commonly treated as a means of maintaining physical contact in all-solid-state lithium-metal batteries, but it can also alter the chemistry of reactive solid-solid interfaces. Here, using pressure-aware, charge-resolved machine-learning molecular dynamics validated against DFT, we determine how pressure magnitude and loading geometry regulate interphase formation at Li||Li6PS5Cl interfaces. The response is nonmonotonic: compression at 1 kbar accelerates PS4 decomposition and Li2S-like ordering, whereas 10-100 kbar compression restricts structural rearrangement and long-range crystallization. Charge-resolved dynamics further identify sulfur-centered, lithium-rich early-interphase environments associated with subsequent Li2S-like ordering. Uniaxial loading accelerates interfacial reaction relative to isostatic loading at the same nominal pressure. Pressure also changes void closure and dead-lithium spreading in a defect-location-dependent manner. These results establish applied pressure as a mechanochemical process variable coupling interphase chemistry, ion transport and defect evolution, providing a mechanistic framework for interpreting pressure effects in sulfide solid-state batteries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“machine-learning molecular dynamics validated against DFT”（机器学习分子动力学，经密度泛函理论验证），属于计算模拟研究。；研究对象：锂金属与硫化物固态电解质 Li6PS5Cl 的固-固界面，具体研究外加堆叠压力（stack pressure）的大小和加载方式如何调控界面相（interphase）的形成与演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 压力对 Li||Li6PS5Cl 界面化学的调控呈非单调性：1 kbar 压缩加速 PS4 分解和 Li2S 类有序化，而 10–100 kbar 压缩反而限制结构重排和长程结晶；单轴加载比等静压加载在相同标称压力下更能加速界面反应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：压力对 Li||Li6PS5Cl 界面化学的调控呈非单调性：1 kbar 压缩加速 PS4 分解和 Li2S 类有序化，而 10–100 kbar 压缩反而限制结构重排和长程结晶；单轴加载比等静压加载在相同标称压力下更能加速界面反应。；创新点：将外加压力确立为一种“机械化学过程变量”（mechanochemical process variable），系统揭示其耦合界面化学、离子输运和缺陷演化的机制，而非仅将压力视为维持物理接触的手段。摘要未突出说明与具体实验对比的细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用压力感知、电荷分辨的机器学习分子动力学（pressure-aware, charge-resolved machine-learning molecular dynamics），并用 DFT 进行验证；通过电荷分辨动力学分析识别界面早期相环境，同时考察缺陷（void）闭合和死锂（dead lithium）扩展行为。

papers.title: Trap Dynamics and Conductivity Changes in AlGaN/GaN Heterostructures Under Ultrasonic Loading
papers.abstract: AlGaN/GaN heterostructures are critical for high-power electronic devices but suffer from electron trapping at defects, limiting reliability. We investigate how ultrasonic vibrations affect electron transport in MOCVD-grown AlGaN/GaN heterostructures by combining temperature-dependent Hall effect and high-resolution X-ray diffraction measurements. Here we demonstrate that ultrasonic loading induces persistent acoustoconductivity and lattice parameter changes, attributed to acoustically driven rearrangement of metastable DX centers. This leads to increased carrier concentration and decreased mobility, reflecting defect state modulation by acoustic strain. These findings provide new insights into trap dynamics under dynamic deformation and suggest ultrasonic treatment as a potential approach to mitigate trapping effects, thereby enhancing the performance and reliability of GaN-based devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要提及“combining temperature-dependent Hall effect and high-resolution X-ray diffraction measurements”，即结合变温霍尔效应与高分辨X射线衍射的实验测量。；研究对象：MOCVD生长的AlGaN/GaN异质结构，具体关注超声振动加载下缺陷（DX中心）中的电子俘获动力学及其对电子输运性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超声加载在AlGaN/GaN异质结构中诱导出持久的声电导效应（persistent acoustoconductivity）和晶格参数变化，其物理机制是声学应变驱动的亚稳态DX中心重排，导致载流子浓度增加而迁移率下降。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超声加载在AlGaN/GaN异质结构中诱导出持久的声电导效应（persistent acoustoconductivity）和晶格参数变化，其物理机制是声学应变驱动的亚稳态DX中心重排，导致载流子浓度增加而迁移率下降。；创新点：首次将超声振动加载与AlGaN/GaN异质结构中的陷阱动力学联系起来，揭示了动态形变（声学应变）对DX中心亚稳态重排的调控作用，并提出超声处理可作为缓解陷阱效应、提升GaN基器件性能与可靠性的潜在手段。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：变温霍尔效应测量（temperature-dependent Hall effect）和高分辨X射线衍射（high-resolution X-ray diffraction），样品由MOCVD（金属有机化学气相沉积）生长。

papers.title: Statistical Language Competition Model with Dynamic Edge Weighting on a Random Network
papers.abstract: This paper presents a computational study of language competition dynamics on Erdős--Rényi random networks, extending the foundational Abrams--Strogatz model through two novel contributions: (i) a dynamic edge-weighting mechanism that reinforces social ties between co-minority speakers by an additive increment $Δ$, and (ii) a probabilistic agent-based framework governing language switching via a weighted majority rule. Phase boundaries separating the dominance and coexistence regimes are identified across a two-dimensional parameter space $(p, Δ)$, where $p$ denotes the network connectivity probability. We further characterise anomalous persistence zones within predicted dominance regions, attributing them to the formation of isolated minority speaker clusters. Scaling study across network sizes $N \in \{50, 100, 250, 500, 1000\}$ reveal that average cluster size decreases with $N$ and that phase boundaries diffuse with increasing stochastic noise. Finally, we discuss extensions to a tripartite bilingual model and heterogeneous prestige/volatility to more faithfully capture real sociolinguistic contact scenarios.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：computational study、agent-based framework、scaling study。；研究对象：语言竞争动力学，具体为 Erdős–Rényi 随机网络上的 Abrams–Strogatz 模型扩展，研究语言主导与共存相变及少数语言群体聚集现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维参数空间 (p, Δ) 中识别出语言主导区与共存区的相边界；在预测的主导区内发现异常持续区，归因于孤立少数语言使用者簇的形成。平均簇尺寸随网络规模 N 增大而减小，相边界随随机噪声增强而扩散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维参数空间 (p, Δ) 中识别出语言主导区与共存区的相边界；在预测的主导区内发现异常持续区，归因于孤立少数语言使用者簇的形成。平均簇尺寸随网络规模 N 增大而减小，相边界随随机噪声增强而扩散。；创新点：首次在 Abrams–Strogatz 模型中引入动态边权重（Δ 增量）以强化少数语言使用者之间的社会纽带，并系统刻画了 (p, Δ) 二维相图及异常持续区的成因。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于概率的智能体（agent-based）模拟框架，采用加权多数规则控制语言切换；引入动态边权重机制（对共少数语言者之间的社会联系施加增量 Δ）；在 N ∈ {50, 100, 250, 500, 1000} 范围内进行有限尺寸标度分析。

papers.title: Text-guided flow matching enables sample-efficient crystal structure generation
papers.abstract: Crystal generators can now propose periodic structures, but their control interfaces remain poorly matched to the mixed descriptors used in materials design. Text provides a compact way to combine composition, symmetry, prototype and property cues, yet it has not been clear whether such information can steer flow-based crystal generation. Here we introduce TFMat, a text-conditioned flow-matching framework that uses structured materials language as a semantic prior for a CrystalFlow generator. Across Perov-5, Carbon-24 and MP-20 crystal structure prediction benchmarks, TFMat improves one-candidate match rates over CrystalFlow and reaches a 92.04% MP-20 match rate with 20 candidates; in de novo generation, it improves element-count and density distribution alignment while retaining coarse property consistency in composition-selected outputs. These results position structured text as an inspectable control layer for translating human-readable materials intent into candidate crystals for downstream simulation and validation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“flow-matching framework”“CrystalFlow generator”“benchmarks”等，属于机器学习驱动的材料生成方法研究。；研究对象：晶体结构生成，具体涉及Perov-5（钙钛矿）、Carbon-24（碳同素异形体）和MP-20（Materials Project 20）三个晶体结构预测基准数据集，以及de novo（从头）晶体生成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 文本条件化的流匹配框架TFMat能够利用结构化材料语言作为语义先验，显著提升晶体结构生成的成功率：在MP-20基准上，20个候选结构时匹配率达到92.04%，优于未加文本条件的CrystalFlow；在从头生成中改善了元素计数和密度分布的对齐，同时保持成分选择输出的粗粒度性质一致性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：文本条件化的流匹配框架TFMat能够利用结构化材料语言作为语义先验，显著提升晶体结构生成的成功率：在MP-20基准上，20个候选结构时匹配率达到92.04%，优于未加文本条件的CrystalFlow；在从头生成中改善了元素计数和密度分布的对齐，同时保持成分选择输出的粗粒度性质一致性。；创新点：首次将文本条件引入基于流的晶体结构生成框架，使文本成为可检查的控制层，将人类可读的材料设计意图（成分、对称性、原型、性质提示）直接转化为候选晶体结构。摘要未突出说明与其他文本条件生成方法的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用文本条件化的流匹配（text-conditioned flow matching）生成框架，以结构化材料语言作为语义先验，嵌入CrystalFlow生成器中。评估方式为晶体结构预测基准（Perov-5、Carbon-24、MP-20）上的匹配率，以及de novo生成中的元素计数、密度分布和性质一致性指标。

papers.title: Exchange striction determines how fast antiferromagnetic insulators demagnetize
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnets combine terahertz spin dynamics with insensitivity to stray fields, and how quickly their order can be manipulated sets the speed limit on device operation. Femtosecond optical pulses demagnetize antiferromagnetic insulators on timescales that span picoseconds to nanoseconds across compounds, and no material parameter is known that accounts for the spread or predicts where a new compound will fall. In a compensated antiferromagnet, no angular momentum needs to leave the spin system, so the rate is set by energy flow from the lattice into the spins. Time-resolved second-harmonic generation experiments show that Cr2O3 demagnetizes within 2 ps once the lattice is driven above the Neel temperature, two orders of magnitude faster than the structurally similar FeBO3. First-principles calculations trace the disparity to exchange striction: short Cr-Cr contacts make the exchange coupling tenfold more sensitive to atomic displacements and widen the phase space for phonon decay into magnon pairs. Spin-lattice simulations with ab initio parameters reproduce the order of magnitude of the measured ratio. The derivative of the exchange coupling with respect to the ionic displacement thus emerges as a computable parameter that predicts how fast an insulating antiferromagnet can be demagnetized. The results advance our understanding of ultrafast control in insulating antiferromagnets, and suggest a practical pathway to screen candidate materials for thermally assisted antiferromagnetic memory before synthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算+自旋-晶格模拟）。判断依据：摘要中提及“Time-resolved second-harmonic generation experiments”“First-principles calculations”“Spin-lattice simulations with ab initio parameters”。；研究对象：反铁磁绝缘体（具体为Cr₂O₃与FeBO₃）的超快退磁动力学，以及交换伸缩（exchange striction）对退磁速率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反铁磁绝缘体的退磁速率由交换耦合对离子位移的导数（即交换伸缩强度）决定：Cr₂O₃的退磁时间（约2 ps）比结构相似的FeBO₃快两个数量级，原因是Cr-Cr短接触使交换耦合对原子位移的敏感度高出十倍，从而拓宽了声子衰变为磁子对的相空间。该导数可作为预测材料退磁速度的可计算参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反铁磁绝缘体的退磁速率由交换耦合对离子位移的导数（即交换伸缩强度）决定：Cr₂O₃的退磁时间（约2 ps）比结构相似的FeBO₃快两个数量级，原因是Cr-Cr短接触使交换耦合对原子位移的敏感度高出十倍，从而拓宽了声子衰变为磁子对的相空间。该导数可作为预测材料退磁速度的可计算参数。；创新点：首次将交换耦合对离子位移的导数确立为预测反铁磁绝缘体退磁速率的关键材料参数，并提出一种在合成前筛选热辅助反铁磁存储器候选材料的实用途径。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨二次谐波产生（TR-SHG）实验测量退磁时间；第一性原理计算（具体方法摘要未明确说明，可能为DFT类）分析交换耦合对原子位移的敏感性；基于从头算参数的自旋-晶格模拟（spin-lattice simulations）验证实验测得的速率比数量级。

papers.title: First-Principles Electronic Structure Calculation of Crystals in Laboratory Magnetic Fields
papers.abstract: External magnetic fields can qualitatively reshape the electronic structure of crystals, underpinning quantum Hall physics, Landau-level spectra and field-induced topological phases. Their first-principles treatment at laboratory-scale fields is, however, hindered by magnetic-flux quantization, which requires magnetic unit cells with areas inversely proportional to the applied field. Such cells contain a large number of chemical unit cells, rendering real-space and plane-wave calculations prohibitively expensive. Here we, for the first time, construct a magnetic Bloch basis built from linear combinations of gauge-including Gaussian-type atomic orbitals, which incorporate the magnetic-field phase factors required by magnetic translation symmetry. The framework requires far fewer basis functions than real-space or plane-wave representations of the same magnetic supercell and retains the sparsity of an atom-centred basis, together substantially reducing computational cost. We validate the framework by reproducing Landau-level spectrum of graphene from first principles. This approach provides a practical route to simulations of crystalline materials under experimentally accessible magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：“First-Principles Electronic Structure Calculation”（第一性原理电子结构计算）、“construct a magnetic Bloch basis”（构建磁布洛赫基）、“validate the framework by reproducing”（通过复现来验证框架）。；研究对象：晶体材料在外加实验室强度磁场下的电子结构，具体以石墨烯的朗道能级谱作为验证体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次构建了基于规范包含高斯型原子轨道的磁布洛赫基，使得在实验室可达到的磁场强度下对晶体进行第一性原理电子结构计算成为可行，且计算成本远低于传统的实空间或平面波方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次构建了基于规范包含高斯型原子轨道的磁布洛赫基，使得在实验室可达到的磁场强度下对晶体进行第一性原理电子结构计算成为可行，且计算成本远低于传统的实空间或平面波方法。；创新点：首次提出并实现了一种在实验室磁场强度下进行晶体第一性原理计算的实用方法，其核心创新在于利用原子中心基组的稀疏性，大幅减少了所需基函数数量，从而显著降低计算成本。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算框架，具体为：采用线性组合的规范包含高斯型原子轨道（gauge-including Gaussian-type atomic orbitals）构造满足磁平移对称性的磁布洛赫基，以克服磁通量子化导致的超大磁原胞问题。验证手段为复现石墨烯的朗道能级谱。

papers.title: Mass-conserving growth percolation in polymer gelation
papers.abstract: Polymer gelation involves the emergence of a system-spanning network from growing polymer-rich domains, yet conventional percolation models typically prescribe particle size independently of material consumption. We formulate gelation as a locally mass-conserving growth-percolation process in which Voronoi capture zones define finite material reservoirs for individual nuclei. Local depletion determines the evolving supersaturation and limiting particle size, while particle contacts generate a dynamic network whose first spanning cluster defines the gel point. Three mechanisms, namely, interface-, diffusion-, and polymer-blob-controlled growth produce distinct gelation kinetics while sharing the same accessible final state. Spatial fluctuations in nucleation further generate a distribution of gelation times. The framework separates gelation from saturation and naturally captures post-gel aging as continued growth and topological maturation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要中提出“formulate gelation as a locally mass-conserving growth-percolation process”，属于理论建模与数值模拟范畴，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：聚合物凝胶化（polymer gelation）过程，具体关注从富聚合物区域生长出跨越全系统的网络（即凝胶点）的动力学，以及成核、生长与拓扑连接之间的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 凝胶化可被描述为一种局部质量守恒的生长逾渗过程：每个核由Voronoi捕获区限定有限物质储库，局部耗尽决定过饱和度和极限粒径；三种生长机制（界面控制、扩散控制、聚合物团块控制）产生不同的凝胶化动力学，但最终可达相同的终态。空间成核涨落导致凝胶时间分布，且该框架将凝胶化与饱和分离，自然描述凝胶后老化（继续生长与拓扑成熟）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：凝胶化可被描述为一种局部质量守恒的生长逾渗过程：每个核由Voronoi捕获区限定有限物质储库，局部耗尽决定过饱和度和极限粒径；三种生长机制（界面控制、扩散控制、聚合物团块控制）产生不同的凝胶化动力学，但最终可达相同的终态。空间成核涨落导致凝胶时间分布，且该框架将凝胶化与饱和分离，自然描述凝胶后老化（继续生长与拓扑成熟）。；创新点：首次将凝胶化明确表述为局部质量守恒的生长逾渗过程，将粒子尺寸与物质消耗耦合（而非传统逾渗模型中预设粒子大小），并区分了凝胶化与饱和两个过程，同时能自然捕捉凝胶后老化现象。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟。具体框架为：将凝胶化建模为局部质量守恒的生长逾渗，使用Voronoi捕获区定义有限物质储库，通过粒子接触构建动态网络，并考察三种生长机制（界面控制、扩散控制、聚合物团块控制）下的凝胶化动力学。

papers.title: Numerical study of the grain-growth-induced non-parabolic kinetics of a solid-state reaction
papers.abstract: Non-parabolic growth of reaction layers is frequently observed in solid-state diffusion couples, but the relationship between microstructural evolution and the resulting kinetics remains incompletely understood. This effect is commonly attributed to grain growth, which can progressively reduce the contribution of fast grain-boundary diffusion, causing the effective diffusivity of a polycrystalline product layer to evolve during reaction. This work develops a moving-boundary diffusion model to describe product-layer growth while accounting for the local grain-growth history of the continuously formed product, as well as both bulk and grain-boundary diffusion. Numerical simulations show that the reaction can pass through three distinct kinetic regimes: an initial approximately parabolic regime dominated by grain-boundary diffusion, a transient sub-parabolic regime associated with strong spatial variation of the effective diffusivity, and a subsequent approximately parabolic regime dominated by bulk diffusion. The magnitude and duration of the sub-parabolic regime depend on the relative grain-boundary and bulk diffusivities and on the kinetics of grain growth. The instantaneous growth exponent therefore evolves continuously and does not represent a unique kinetic constant. Nevertheless, fitting simulated layer-thickness data over finite experimental time intervals produces well-defined apparent exponents, demonstrating how a transient process can appear to obey a single power law.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：moving-boundary diffusion model、numerical simulations。；研究对象：固态反应扩散偶中多晶产物层的生长动力学，具体关注晶粒生长对反应层非抛物线生长动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 固态反应产物层生长可经历三个不同动力学阶段：初始由晶界扩散主导的近似抛物线阶段、由有效扩散系数强空间变化引起的瞬态亚抛物线阶段、以及后续由体扩散主导的近似抛物线阶段。瞬时生长指数连续演化，并非唯一动力学常数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：固态反应产物层生长可经历三个不同动力学阶段：初始由晶界扩散主导的近似抛物线阶段、由有效扩散系数强空间变化引起的瞬态亚抛物线阶段、以及后续由体扩散主导的近似抛物线阶段。瞬时生长指数连续演化，并非唯一动力学常数。；创新点：将局部晶粒生长历史与有效扩散系数的空间-时间演化自洽耦合到移动边界模型中，系统揭示了亚抛物线瞬态动力学阶段的出现条件及其对表观生长指数的影响。摘要未突出说明与其他模型的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 建立移动边界扩散模型（moving-boundary diffusion model），同时考虑连续形成产物层的局部晶粒生长历史、体扩散和晶界扩散，通过数值模拟研究反应层生长动力学。

papers.title: Topological charges and parity selection at Floquet quasienergy degeneracies
