Contrary to gapped Dirac systems and unlike bound states in the vicinity of the upper dispersive band, the bound states derived from the flat band occur for any value of the total angular momentum. The energies of these bound states with higher angular momentum $j$ tend to decrease with $|j|$. In addition, it is found that their wave functions are localized at the potential well edge and the localization increases with $|j|$. The signatures of the impurity states in the local density of states are determined. Using the Anderson model for independent electrons in the disorder potential, the thermodynamic potential, entropy density, and heat capacity are obtained. In the regime dominated by bound states derived from the flat band, the entropy density monotonically increases with temperature and saturates, whereas the heat capacity exhibits a single maximum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“analyzed”“model”“thermodynamic potential”等理论分析关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：赝自旋-1（pseudospin-1）系统中的短程杂质（圆形势阱）诱导的束缚态与共振态，以及这些杂质态的热力学性质。体系涵盖有能隙和无能隙情形，并关注平带与色散带附近的杂质态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 由平带衍生的束缚态和共振态表现出赝自旋-1费米子多分量结构带来的独特性质：与有能隙狄拉克系统及上色散带附近的束缚态不同，平带衍生的束缚态对任意总角动量 j 均存在，且其能量随 |j| 增大而降低，波函数局域在势阱边缘且局域化程度随 |j| 增强。在平带束缚态主导的温区，熵密度随温度单调增加并趋于饱和，热容呈现单峰。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：由平带衍生的束缚态和共振态表现出赝自旋-1费米子多分量结构带来的独特性质：与有能隙狄拉克系统及上色散带附近的束缚态不同，平带衍生的束缚态对任意总角动量 j 均存在，且其能量随 |j| 增大而降低，波函数局域在势阱边缘且局域化程度随 |j| 增强。在平带束缚态主导的温区，熵密度随温度单调增加并趋于饱和，热容呈现单峰。；创新点：揭示了赝自旋-1系统中平带衍生的束缚态与赝自旋-1/2系统及色散带束缚态的定性差异（如任意角动量存在性、能量与局域化对 |j| 的依赖），并给出了相应的热力学响应特征。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用圆形势阱模型描述短程杂质，通过量子力学散射/束缚态分析（涉及总角动量分波）求解杂质态；利用Anderson模型（独立电子近似）在无序势中计算热力学势、熵密度和热容。摘要未提及具体数值方法（如精确对角化或格林函数技术）。

papers.title: Nonlinear force response of modular lattice-based metamaterials
papers.abstract: Lattice-based metamaterials provide lightweight platforms where local instabilities can govern the global mechanical response, enabling applications in energy routing, vibration isolation, and impact mitigation. Although much progress has been made in controlling deformation and buckling sequences through geometric design, the behavior of coupled nonlinear units over a large range of strain rates and their history-dependent response is less explored. Here, we investigate lattice-based mechanical metamaterials whose nonlinear buckling behavior can be harnessed through modular architectures. By combining modular units in series, we show that their interaction gives rise to emergent force responses, including transient weakening and enhanced force attenuation, that are absent in the individual modules. Furthermore, selected designs exhibit training behavior under cyclic loading, transitioning between distinct buckling states and revealing a history-dependent mechanical response. Our results demonstrate that modular, instability-driven metamaterials can be programmed and tuned not only through geometry but also through loading history, opening new avenues for designing a nonlinear stress-response in mechanical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：we investigate、show、exhibit、demonstrate，涉及实际力学测试与循环加载行为）。；研究对象：基于模块化晶格（lattice-based）的力学超材料，具体为将非线性屈曲单元串联组合而成的模块化结构，研究其力-响应行为、瞬态弱化、力衰减及历史依赖（训练）效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模块化单元串联后会产生单个模块不具备的涌现力响应（瞬态弱化和增强的力衰减）；部分设计在循环加载下表现出训练行为，可在不同屈曲态之间转变，呈现历史依赖的力学响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模块化单元串联后会产生单个模块不具备的涌现力响应（瞬态弱化和增强的力衰减）；部分设计在循环加载下表现出训练行为，可在不同屈曲态之间转变，呈现历史依赖的力学响应。；创新点：通过模块化架构的单元间相互作用实现“涌现”的非线性力响应（而非仅靠几何设计调控屈曲序列），并首次在力学超材料中展示可通过加载历史（训练）而非仅几何参数来编程和调谐非线性应力响应。
papers.method_zh: 实验力学测试：对模块化晶格超材料进行准静态/循环加载测试，测量力-位移（力-应变）响应曲线，观察屈曲序列与状态转变。摘要未提及数值模拟或理论建模。

papers.title: Chiral phonons driven by chiral cavities
papers.abstract: Lattice vibrations carrying angular momentum give rise to fundamental phenomena such as the phonon Hall effect and the Einstein-de Haas effect, offering new opportunities for manipulating angular momentum in condensed-matter systems. Generating such circularly polarized phonons requires either the use of an external magnetic field, or of polarized light pulses. The latter approach does not require the use of any magnetic response of the material, but it has limitations, in particular regarding the duration of the pulse. Consequently, any effect stemming from phonons generated by light pulses is transient. In this paper, we propose the use of a driven electromagnetic cavity as a route to generate a steady-state population of chiral phonons. We derive a general description of cavity-chiral phonon interaction, with a particular focus on modes of chiral cavities. We show that, under optimized conditions, a significant effective phonon-induced magnetic field can be generated by means of an external drive with realistic power. Our approach is specially tailored for Gamma point phonons with THz frequencies, and opens a new route for investigating chiral phonons with electromagnetic cavities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“我们提出”“我们推导”“我们展示”，属于理论建模与方案设计，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：手性声子（携带角动量的晶格振动）的产生机制，具体聚焦于手性电磁腔（chiral cavity）与布里渊区中心（Gamma点）太赫兹频率声子的耦合体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过驱动一个手性电磁腔，可以在稳态条件下产生手性声子的布居，并在优化条件下利用现实功率的外部驱动产生显著的有效声子诱导磁场。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过驱动一个手性电磁腔，可以在稳态条件下产生手性声子的布居，并在优化条件下利用现实功率的外部驱动产生显著的有效声子诱导磁场。；创新点：提出利用驱动电磁腔替代偏振光脉冲来稳态生成手性声子，克服了光脉冲方案中声子效应瞬态性的局限；且无需材料具有磁响应，适用于太赫兹频率的Gamma点声子。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：构建了腔-手性声子相互作用的一般性描述，特别针对手性腔模式进行分析，并评估了外部驱动功率与有效磁场强度之间的关系。未使用具体数值计算方法（如DFT或DMRG）。

papers.title: Multi-image Overlap Stitching and Automatic Image Construction for Coherent X-ray Imaging
papers.abstract: Direct-space and real-time coherent X-ray imaging (direct-CXI) enables visualization of magnetic-domain structures and dynamics over length scales exceeding the field of view of a single image. However, large-area measurements typically require raster scanning, producing hundreds of partially overlapping images that must be accurately aligned and combined before quantitative analysis can be performed. Here, we present Multi-image Overlap Stitching and Automatic Image Construction for coherent X-ray imaging (MOSAICX), an automated stitching workflow for large-area direct-space coherent X-ray imaging. The workflow consists of image centering, masking, trimming, binarization, hierarchical stitching, and post-processing. To demonstrate the method, we apply it to a dataset comprising 434 direct-CXI images of the antiferromagnetic topological insulator MnBi$_2$Te$_4$. The images are first combined into column reconstructions and subsequently stitched into a single large-area composite image. The resulting reconstruction reveals the complete magnetic-domain and domain-wall landscape over the scanned region while suppressing imaging artifacts and detector defects. The presented workflow provides an efficient approach for processing large direct-CXI datasets and enables visualization and analysis of magnetic-domain structures beyond the field of view of individual measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验方法/数据处理类文章。判断依据：摘要描述了一套自动化拼接工作流程（MOSAICX），并应用于实验采集的相干X射线成像数据集。；研究对象：反铁磁拓扑绝缘体 MnBi₂Te₄ 的磁畴结构与畴壁形貌，以及大尺度相干X射线成像（direct-CXI）数据的拼接与重构方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并验证了一种自动化拼接工作流 MOSAICX，可将434张部分重叠的 direct-CXI 图像拼接成单幅大面积复合图像，成功揭示扫描区域内完整的磁畴与畴壁分布，同时抑制成像伪影和探测器缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并验证了一种自动化拼接工作流 MOSAICX，可将434张部分重叠的 direct-CXI 图像拼接成单幅大面积复合图像，成功揭示扫描区域内完整的磁畴与畴壁分布，同时抑制成像伪影和探测器缺陷。；创新点：针对 direct-CXI 技术中大面积成像需要拼接数百张部分重叠图像的问题，开发了全自动化的拼接流程，并首次将其应用于反铁磁拓扑绝缘体 MnBi₂Te₄ 的大面积磁畴成像，实现了超出单幅视场范围的磁结构可视化。摘要未突出说明与其他拼接算法的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 自动化图像拼接工作流，具体步骤包括：图像居中（image centering）、掩膜（masking）、裁剪（trimming）、二值化（binarization）、分层拼接（hierarchical stitching）和后处理（post-processing）。实验数据来自 direct-CXI 相干X射线成像（非扫描透射X射线显微镜类技术）。

papers.title: Impurity-dependent quantum geometry in 2D flat band superconductors
papers.abstract: In flat band superconductors, quantum geometry, rather than kinetic energy, governs pairing and transport. However, how this geometry manifests in the response to a local, individually addressable impurity remains largely unexplored. Here, we study the Yu-Shiba-Rusinov (YSR) bound state induced by a magnetic adatom that hybridizes with every orbital of a two-dimensional flat band superconductor, and characterize its spatial profile using two quantities: the quadratic spread $Q_S$ and the localization length $ξ$. We show that $Q_S$ is not set by the quantum metric alone, as geometric corrections arising from inter-orbital interference and, more importantly, from the anisotropy of the adatom-lattice hybridization contribute on equal footing, making $Q_S$ strongly impurity dependent and tunable. On the other hand, $ξ$ emerges from the projection onto the flat band alone and is a universal property set by the overlap of compact localized states. All impurity dependence is instead isolated in the prefactor of the wavefunction whose magnitude correlates directly with $Q_S$. We, therefore, report a clean separation between universal and impurity-tunable physics from the induced YSR bound state in these systems, and confirm our results numerically via exact diagonalization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“we study”“we show”“via exact diagonalization”等表述，且未提及实验手段，属于理论建模与数值计算结合的研究。；研究对象：二维平带超导体中由磁性吸附原子（magnetic adatom）诱导的Yu-Shiba-Rusinov（YSR）束缚态，特别关注该束缚态的空间分布与量子几何（quantum geometry）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: YSR束缚态的空间展宽（$Q_S$）并非仅由量子度量（quantum metric）决定，还受到轨道间干涉和吸附原子-晶格杂化各向异性的同等重要修正，因此强烈依赖杂质并可调谐；而局域化长度（$ξ$）仅由平带投影决定，是紧凑局域态重叠给出的普适性质，所有杂质依赖性都集中在波函数前因子中，其大小与$Q_S$直接相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：YSR束缚态的空间展宽（$Q_S$）并非仅由量子度量（quantum metric）决定，还受到轨道间干涉和吸附原子-晶格杂化各向异性的同等重要修正，因此强烈依赖杂质并可调谐；而局域化长度（$ξ$）仅由平带投影决定，是紧凑局域态重叠给出的普适性质，所有杂质依赖性都集中在波函数前因子中，其大小与$Q_S$直接相关。；创新点：首次揭示了平带超导体中YSR束缚态对杂质的依赖性与量子几何的关系，并实现了普适物理（由平带投影决定的$ξ$）与杂质可调物理（由前因子和$Q_S$决定）的清晰分离。摘要未突出说明与以往YSR研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合精确对角化（exact diagonalization）数值验证。具体地，构造磁性吸附原子与二维平带超导体每个轨道杂化的模型，计算YSR束缚态的空间分布，并引入两个量：二次展宽$Q_S$和局域化长度$ξ$来表征其空间轮廓。

papers.title: Using microrheology to study dynamical heterogeneities
papers.abstract: Dynamical heterogeneities are one of the hallmarks of supercooled liquids, and their properties and relevance have been studied with theory, simulations and experiments. In this work, we propose to monitor the dynamics of tracer particles (passive microrheology) to analyze the dynamical heterogeneities in a system of hard colloids close to the glass transition density, using Langevin dynamics simulations and mode coupling theory. Different observables, typical in the study of the dynamical heterogeneities are adapted to be calculated from the trajectory of a single tracer particle. The tracer dynamics shows a transition from a regime where it is most decoupled from the bath for small tracer size to a strong coupling regime for large tracers. Both theory and simulations show that the non-Gaussian parameter of the tracer is maximal for tracer sizes at the crossover between both regimes, and is highly dependent on the bath density. The dynamic susceptibility is also studied, but this parameter shows a minor dependence on both the tracer size or the bath density. Finally, the existence of regions with different mobility is also studied with microrheology. Although the tracer trajectory indeed shows stages with increased mobility, the estimated size of the regions decreases with the bath density, contrary to the results from cluster analysis in the bulk.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要明确提到使用“Langevin dynamics simulations”和“mode coupling theory”。；研究对象：硬胶体（hard colloids）体系在接近玻璃转变密度时的动力学异质性（dynamical heterogeneities），具体通过被动微流变学（passive microrheology）中示踪粒子的运动来研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 示踪粒子的动力学从小尺寸时与浴（bath）最强解耦（decoupled）过渡到大尺寸时的强耦合（strong coupling） regime；非高斯参数（non-Gaussian parameter）在两种 regime 的交叉处对示踪粒子尺寸取最大值，且强烈依赖浴密度。动态磁化率（dynamic susceptibility）对示踪粒子尺寸和浴密度依赖较弱。微流变学估计的高迁移区域尺寸随浴密度增加而减小，与体相团簇分析结果相反。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：示踪粒子的动力学从小尺寸时与浴（bath）最强解耦（decoupled）过渡到大尺寸时的强耦合（strong coupling） regime；非高斯参数（non-Gaussian parameter）在两种 regime 的交叉处对示踪粒子尺寸取最大值，且强烈依赖浴密度。动态磁化率（dynamic susceptibility）对示踪粒子尺寸和浴密度依赖较弱。微流变学估计的高迁移区域尺寸随浴密度增加而减小，与体相团簇分析结果相反。；创新点：提出利用被动微流变学中单个示踪粒子的轨迹来监测和分析接近玻璃转变的硬胶体系统中的动力学异质性，将原本用于体相系综的观测量适配到单粒子轨迹层面。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 朗之万动力学模拟（Langevin dynamics simulations）结合模式耦合理论（mode coupling theory）；将研究动力学异质性的典型观测量（如非高斯参数、动态磁化率、迁移率区域）改编为从单个示踪粒子轨迹计算。

papers.title: A Human-AI Theorem Connecting Spontaneous and Field-Induced Mechanisms of Collective Behavior in One Dimension
papers.abstract: Can an artificial intelligence (AI) generate a scientific hypothesis outside a human collaborator's active hypothesis space (AHS), and can human-AI research be organized to make such breakthroughs more likely? We document such a case while proving a theorem that connects two basic organizing mechanisms of statistical physics: collective behavior arising in zero field from competing interactions and that induced or controlled by an external field. A zero-field $O(n)$-vector open chain with arbitrary inhomogeneous nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor interaction functions $U_i(S_i\cdot{S}_{i+1})$ and $V_i(S_i\cdot{S}_{i+2})$ is microscopically, via a temperature-independent mapping at the Hamiltonian level, equivalent to a simpler $O(n)$ open chain with nearest-neighbor interaction $V_i( σ_i\cdot σ_{i+1})$ and axial single-spin potential $U_i(σ_i^z)$ for every integer $n\ge1$ and every system size $L\ge1$. The homogeneous linear specialization maps the foundational frustrated $J_1$-$J_2$ model onto the canonical $J$-$h$ field model---with $n=1,2,3$ being the Ising, XY, and Heisenberg classical spin models, respectively. An analogous theorem holds when the continuous $O(n)$ spins are replaced by the $q$-state Potts spins with the standard Potts interaction, implying a closed-form exact solution of the $J_1$-$J_2$ Potts open chain for every $q\ge2$ and every $L\ge1$. The emergence of the theorems from sustained human-AI collaboration suggests that involving AI throughout a systematic research program may incubate autonomous scientific breakthroughs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确出现“proving a theorem”“microscopically, via a temperature-independent mapping at the Hamiltonian level”“closed-form exact solution”等关键词，属于严格数学证明与解析求解。；研究对象：一维经典自旋链与Potts链的集体行为机制，具体包括：零场下由竞争相互作用（frustration）驱动的自发集体行为，与外场诱导/控制的集体行为之间的等价关系；涉及O(n)矢量自旋模型（Ising、XY、Heisenberg）及q态Potts模型，并特别关注J₁-J₂阻挫模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了一个普适定理：任意非均匀最近邻与次近邻相互作用的零场O(n)开链，在哈密顿量层面通过一个与温度无关的映射，严格等价于一个仅含最近邻相互作用和轴向单自旋势的简单O(n)开链（对任意n≥1和链长L≥1成立）。该定理将阻挫的J₁-J₂模型映射到标准的J-h外场模型，并推广至Potts自旋，从而给出J₁-J₂ Potts开链的闭式精确解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了一个普适定理：任意非均匀最近邻与次近邻相互作用的零场O(n)开链，在哈密顿量层面通过一个与温度无关的映射，严格等价于一个仅含最近邻相互作用和轴向单自旋势的简单O(n)开链（对任意n≥1和链长L≥1成立）。该定理将阻挫的J₁-J₂模型映射到标准的J-h外场模型，并推广至Potts自旋，从而给出J₁-J₂ Potts开链的闭式精确解。；创新点：首次在哈密顿量层面严格证明了零场竞争相互作用与外场诱导机制在一维系统中的微观等价性，且该等价对任意自旋维数n、任意链长L以及任意非均匀相互作用函数均成立；同时将这一等价性推广到Potts模型，获得了J₁-J₂ Potts开链的闭式精确解。此外，该定理源于人类-AI协作研究，展示了AI在人类研究者主动假设空间之外生成科学假说的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与严格数学证明：采用哈密顿量层面的微观映射（temperature-independent mapping），将零场多体相互作用系统变换为含外场（轴向势）的简化系统；对O(n)对称性模型和q态Potts模型分别建立等价定理；利用均匀线性特化将一般映射应用于J₁-J₂模型。此外，该定理的发现过程涉及人类与人工智能（AI）的持续协作研究模式。

papers.title: Engineering tunable $p$-wave magnetism in antiferromagnetic bilayers
papers.abstract: We propose a symmetry-guided route to engineer tunable $p$-wave magnetism in a bilayer system composed of two AB-stacked antiferromagnetic square lattices with their collinear moments nonparallel to each other. We show that an in-plane relative shift between the two layers selectively breaks the symmetries protecting spin degeneracy while preserving time-reversal-related constraints, thereby generating odd-parity spin splitting in a fully compensated magnetic state without spin-orbit coupling. The direction and the magnitude of the resulting $p$-wave spin-splitting, together with the associated spin responses, can be continuously tuned by the in-plane displacement, providing a potential knob for control. We further map the bilayer system onto an effective bond-modulated square lattice and investigate the corresponding Hubbard model within a mean-field framework. The calculated phase diagram reveals extended regions where $p$-wave magnetism with coplanar or chiral spin textures emerges spontaneously. Our results establish a minimal equilibrium platform for realizing and manipulating $p$-wave magnetism in two-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We propose”“We show”“We further map...and investigate...within a mean-field framework”等表述，属于理论建模与计算分析，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：由两层AB堆叠的反铁磁方格子构成的 bilayer 体系，其中两层共线磁矩互不平行；研究的是在该体系中实现可调控的 p-wave 磁性（奇宇称自旋劈裂）及其对应的 Hubbard 模型相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过层间面内相对位移，可选择性地破缺保护自旋简并的对称性，同时保持与时间反演相关的约束，从而在无自旋轨道耦合的完全补偿磁态中产生奇宇称自旋劈裂（p-wave 磁性）；该自旋劈裂的方向、大小及相关自旋响应可连续调控。平均场相图显示，在扩展参数区域内可自发涌现共面或手性自旋织构的 p-wave 磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过层间面内相对位移，可选择性地破缺保护自旋简并的对称性，同时保持与时间反演相关的约束，从而在无自旋轨道耦合的完全补偿磁态中产生奇宇称自旋劈裂（p-wave 磁性）；该自旋劈裂的方向、大小及相关自旋响应可连续调控。平均场相图显示，在扩展参数区域内可自发涌现共面或手性自旋织构的 p-wave 磁性。；创新点：提出了一个无需自旋轨道耦合即可实现 p-wave 磁性的最小平衡态平台，并通过层间位移实现连续调控，为二维体系中 p-wave 磁性的实现与操控提供了新途径。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比差异。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（symmetry-guided route）；将双层体系映射为有效键调制方格子模型；在平均场框架下求解 Hubbard 模型，计算相图。

papers.title: Entanglement from particle number fluctuations in a second-order topological insulator
papers.abstract: Higher-order topological insulators are materials with a bulk energy gap featuring gapless modes at $(d-n)$-dimensional edges, where $n > 1$. Despite this modified bulk-boundary correspondence, their nontrivial topology can nevertheless be observed through the bipartite entanglement spectrum. Inspired by works suggesting fluctuations in conserved quantities could be used to study topology in one-dimensional systems, which likewise feature zero-dimensional edge modes, we extend this treatment to a two-dimensional second-order topological insulator where corner states play an analogous role. We show that the standard bipartite entanglement entropy and particle number fluctuation lack striking signals of topological phase transitions, both in the static case and in the time evolution after a quench, obscured by an area-law term from the subsystem edges. By introducing a quadripartite construction of the subsystem, we show that it is possible to isolate the topological contributions, producing sharp transition peaks in both quantities, observable by studying subsystems much smaller than the full system. As particle number fluctuations are accessible in existing experiments, these results establish a concrete and scalable path to experimental detection of the entanglement in higher-order topological insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论推导（如纠缠熵、粒子数涨落）、数值模拟（时间演化、子系统划分），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维二阶拓扑绝缘体（2D second-order topological insulator），重点研究其角态（corner states）与拓扑相变中的纠缠特性，以及粒子数涨落作为拓扑序的探针。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 标准二分纠缠熵和粒子数涨落因受子系统边缘面积律项掩盖，无法清晰显示拓扑相变信号；通过引入四部分（quadripartite）子系统构造，可隔离拓扑贡献，在两种量中产生尖锐的相变峰，且只需观测远小于整个系统的子系统即可实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：标准二分纠缠熵和粒子数涨落因受子系统边缘面积律项掩盖，无法清晰显示拓扑相变信号；通过引入四部分（quadripartite）子系统构造，可隔离拓扑贡献，在两种量中产生尖锐的相变峰，且只需观测远小于整个系统的子系统即可实现。；创新点：将原本用于一维系统（零维边缘模）的“守恒量涨落探测拓扑”方法推广到二维二阶拓扑绝缘体（角态），并提出四部分子系统构造以提取拓扑信号，为实验上通过粒子数涨落探测高阶拓扑纠缠提供了可扩展路径。摘要未突出说明具体数值方法（如是否使用DMRG或精确对角化）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算：基于纠缠熵和守恒量（粒子数）涨落的计算，对比静态与淬火（quench）后时间演化两种情况；采用四部分子系统划分方案以消除面积律背景。

papers.title: Cryogenic Enhancement of Electron Spin Polarization from a Strained GaAs/GaAsP Superlattice Photocathode
papers.abstract: We report electron spin polarization of 95.0 +/- 0.8 (stat) +/- 2.4 (sys)% from a strained GaAs/GaAsP superlattice photocathode grown by metalorganic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) and cooled to dry-ice temperature (195 K). We achieved this polarization with 97.8% circularly polarized excitation light and a quantum efficiency of 0.7% at the peak polarization wavelength. This measurement exceeds the values of previously reported GaAs-based photocathode polarizations, which have clustered near 92% for two decades. We vary the temperature of the cathode and measure the polarization and quantum-efficiency spectra at 295 K, 273 K, 195 K, and 77 K. The polarization rises from 91.2(1)% at 295 K to its maximum at 195 K, while the spectral peak shifts from 775 nm to 739 nm (78 meV) over the full temperature range, tracking the widening band gap. The spectra probe two depolarization mechanisms: a thermalized transport channel that is suppressed on cooling, and energy-dependent hot-electron relaxation that persists and sets the low-temperature saturation. The polarization recovers after a full cooling and warmup cycle and is stable while the quantum efficiency decays, which disfavors surface energy filtering as the origin of the gain. These results indicate that modest cooling to 195 K, for which dry ice suffices, is a practical route to higher-polarization GaAs-based electron sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确报告了实验测量数据（如极化率、量子效率、温度变化测量），并涉及样品生长（MOCVD）与低温测量。；研究对象：应变异质结构 GaAs/GaAsP 超晶格光电阴极，具体研究其电子自旋极化率随温度的变化行为及退极化机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在干冰温度（195 K）下，该应变 GaAs/GaAsP 超晶格光电阴极实现了 95.0% 的电子自旋极化率，显著超过过去二十年 GaAs 基光电阴极约 92% 的极化率水平；极化率随温度降低从 295 K 的 91.2% 升至 195 K 的最大值，而光谱峰位随带隙增宽蓝移 78 meV。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在干冰温度（195 K）下，该应变 GaAs/GaAsP 超晶格光电阴极实现了 95.0% 的电子自旋极化率，显著超过过去二十年 GaAs 基光电阴极约 92% 的极化率水平；极化率随温度降低从 295 K 的 91.2% 升至 195 K 的最大值，而光谱峰位随带隙增宽蓝移 78 meV。；创新点：首次证明仅需适度冷却至 195 K（干冰即可实现）即可将 GaAs 基光电阴极的自旋极化率提升至 95%，突破了长期徘徊在 92% 的瓶颈；通过变温光谱区分了两种退极化机制（热化输运通道与能量依赖的热电子弛豫），并排除了表面能量过滤作为增益来源的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 采用金属有机化学气相沉积（MOCVD）生长应变 GaAs/GaAsP 超晶格；在 295 K、273 K、195 K 和 77 K 四个温度点测量自旋极化率与量子效率光谱；使用 97.8% 圆偏振激发光；通过完整冷却-回温循环验证极化率可恢复性。

papers.title: Polarisation-mediated underscreening from weakly bonded ion clusters
papers.abstract: We explore the hypothesis that ions form loosely connected clusters at high ionic strength in aqueous solutions, and that these clusters have relevance to the experimentally observed phenomenon usually referred to as "anomalous underscreening". Cluster formation lowers the ionic strength below its nominal value, slowing the decay of the screening length but not reversing it. Here we focus on an additional contribution, cluster polarisation. We demonstrate that this effect produces longer-ranged repulsive interactions between like-charged surfaces or particles in concentrated salt solutions. We derive an analytical bulk relation in which the entire architecture of a cluster enters through a single quantity, the charge-weighted second moment of its intramolecular charge structure factor, which quantifies the polarisation response of an arbitrary cluster topology. We also make numerical calculations using classical polymer Density Functional Theory, cDFT, for a model based on star-like clusters in which satellite ions are weakly bonded by a harmonic spring to a common central ion. The corona of satellite ions is assumed to be net neutral, since the formation of highly charged clusters would be accompanied by a significant self-energy cost. Using this model, we calculate surface interactions and screening lengths at various overall salt concentrations. We show that, under the assumption that the fraction of ions belonging to clusters increases with salt concentration, one may qualitatively arrive at "anomalous underscreening", i.e., an effective screening length that displays a minimum at an overall (monovalent) salt concentration of about 1 M. Quantitatively, we note that the predicted growth of the screening length beyond this threshold value is weaker than typically found by experimental surface force measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：analytical bulk relation、classical polymer Density Functional Theory (cDFT)、numerical calculations。；研究对象：高离子强度水溶液中由弱键合离子形成的松散团簇（loosely connected clusters），以及由此产生的“反常欠屏蔽”（anomalous underscreening）现象，具体涉及带电表面或颗粒之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 团簇极化效应会在浓盐溶液中产生同号带电表面或颗粒之间的长程排斥相互作用；在假设团簇离子占比随盐浓度增加的条件下，可定性重现“反常欠屏蔽”，即有效屏蔽长度在约1 M单价盐浓度处出现最小值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：团簇极化效应会在浓盐溶液中产生同号带电表面或颗粒之间的长程排斥相互作用；在假设团簇离子占比随盐浓度增加的条件下，可定性重现“反常欠屏蔽”，即有效屏蔽长度在约1 M单价盐浓度处出现最小值。；创新点：首次将团簇极化效应纳入欠屏蔽机制分析，提出团簇整体架构仅通过单一量（电荷加权二阶矩）进入理论描述，从而统一处理任意团簇拓扑的极化响应。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 推导了解析体相关系，用团簇内电荷结构因子的电荷加权二阶矩描述任意团簇拓扑的极化响应；并采用经典聚合物密度泛函理论（cDFT）对星形团簇模型（卫星离子通过谐振子弱键合到中心离子上）进行数值计算，计算不同盐浓度下的表面相互作用和屏蔽长度。

papers.title: Exact joint eigenvalue densities of non-Hermitian random matrices are Calogero scattering states
papers.abstract: Determining exact joint eigenvalue densities is central to random matrix theory. We solve this long-standing problem for non-Hermitian matrices with transposition symmetry (complex symmetric and complex self-dual) at arbitrary matrix size. Up to a Vandermonde factor, they are scattering-state wave functions of the Calogero model, a line of particles interacting through an inverse-square potential, with the coupling strength set by the symmetry. In contrast to many previously known joint densities, the densities cannot be written as a gas of eigenvalues with pairwise interactions. We further compute the complex level spacing distributions and two-point spectral correlation functions, which carry power-law tails, absent in a Coulomb gas. Our results shed light on the interplay among random matrices, integrability, and symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于解析求解联合本征值密度，涉及散射态波函数、Calogero模型等理论框架，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：非厄米随机矩阵，具体为具有转置对称性（复对称与复自对偶）的矩阵，任意矩阵尺寸下的本征值统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 这类非厄米随机矩阵的精确联合本征值密度（除去Vandermonde因子后）恰好是Calogero模型的散射态波函数，且该密度不能写成具有两两相互作用的特征值气体形式；其复能级间距分布与两点谱关联函数具有幂律尾巴，与Coulomb气体行为不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：这类非厄米随机矩阵的精确联合本征值密度（除去Vandermonde因子后）恰好是Calogero模型的散射态波函数，且该密度不能写成具有两两相互作用的特征值气体形式；其复能级间距分布与两点谱关联函数具有幂律尾巴，与Coulomb气体行为不同。；创新点：首次在任意矩阵尺寸下精确求解具有转置对称性的非厄米随机矩阵联合本征值密度，揭示了其与可积模型（Calogero模型）的深刻联系；同时指出这类密度无法用传统特征值气体（两两相互作用）描述，并发现了谱关联中的幂律尾巴。摘要未突出说明与以往具体工作的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论推导：利用Calogero模型（一维逆平方势相互作用粒子系统）的散射态波函数来构造联合本征值密度，并据此计算复能级间距分布和两点谱关联函数。

papers.title: Duality between the level statistics of Hermitian and non-Hermitian random matrices
papers.abstract: Random matrix theory describes complex quantum systems statistically, with symmetry as its organizing principle. We uncover an exact duality between the level statistics of Hermitian and non-Hermitian random matrices in the large-$N$ (matrix size) limit. It acts class by class: the two replica partition functions, given by fermionic nonlinear $σ$ models, are related by analytic continuation. Applied to the three Wigner--Dyson classes, the duality yields the universal bulk eigenvalue pair-correlation functions of non-Hermitian random matrices. This establishes a non-Hermitian counterpart of Dyson's threefold way, organized by transposition symmetry: generic complex, complex symmetric, and complex self-dual matrices. The dissipative spectral form factors of these classes follow in closed form as well. Applied to the seven nonstandard Altland--Zirnbauer classes, the duality yields the exact spectral densities near the origin, the non-Hermitian hard-edge statistics. Most of these statistics were previously known only numerically. Exact diagonalization confirms the analytical predictions, and physical models demonstrate their universality. We expect these results to be the tip of a deeper correspondence between Hermitian and non-Hermitian random matrix theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：exact duality、analytic continuation、partition functions、closed form、analytical predictions。；研究对象：厄米与非厄米随机矩阵的能级统计，具体涵盖Wigner–Dyson三类和Altland–Zirnbauer七类对称性下的非厄米随机矩阵系综，以及其普适本征值关联函数和硬边谱密度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大矩阵尺寸极限下，厄米与非厄米随机矩阵的能级统计之间存在逐类精确对偶，该对偶通过费米子非线性σ模型的解析延拓实现，并由此建立了非厄米随机矩阵的Dyson三类方式（按转置对称性分类），同时给出了非标准Altland–Zirnbauer七类的精确硬边谱密度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在大矩阵尺寸极限下，厄米与非厄米随机矩阵的能级统计之间存在逐类精确对偶，该对偶通过费米子非线性σ模型的解析延拓实现，并由此建立了非厄米随机矩阵的Dyson三类方式（按转置对称性分类），同时给出了非标准Altland–Zirnbauer七类的精确硬边谱密度。；创新点：首次建立了厄米与非厄米随机矩阵能级统计之间的精确对偶关系，将Dyson的三重分类推广到非厄米情形（按转置对称性组织），并给出了此前仅数值已知的非厄米硬边统计的精确解析结果。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为随机矩阵理论中的副本方法（replica method），具体使用费米子非线性σ模型（fermionic nonlinear σ model）进行解析延拓；辅以精确对角化（exact diagonalization）数值验证，并利用物理模型展示普适性。

papers.title: Nonlinear Fluctuating Hydrodynamics from Interacting Noisy Quantum Matter
papers.abstract: A universal characterization of non-equilibrium steady states in interacting quantum many-body systems remains one of the central challenges of statistical physics. Here, we address this problem for a paradigmatic model of diffusive interacting quantum matter---the boundary-driven XXZ spin chain with bulk dephasing---and derive, directly from its microscopic Lindblad dynamics, an emergent classical Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory (MFT) governing its large-scale fluctuations. Crucially, the resulting hydrodynamics carries a density-dependent diffusivity and mobility as the fingerprint of interactions. This effective description enables the exact computation of the stationary density profile, long-range correlations, and the full counting statistics of the current, in excellent agreement with tensor-network simulations. Our work demonstrates that noisy quantum many-body systems can realize the universality class of genuinely interacting diffusive matter, beyond the constant-diffusivity class of the symmetric simple exclusion process, and establishes MFT as a powerful universal framework for interacting diffusive quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“derive, directly from its microscopic Lindblad dynamics”（从微观Lindblad动力学推导），以及“enables the exact computation”（实现精确计算），属于解析理论推导结合数值验证的混合理论工作。；研究对象：边界驱动的XXZ自旋链（boundary-driven XXZ spin chain）加上体相退相干（bulk dephasing），即一个相互作用的耗散量子多体系统，研究其非平衡稳态的普适输运与涨落行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从微观Lindblad动力学出发，推导出描述该相互作用扩散量子物质大尺度涨落的经典宏观涨落理论（MFT），其有效流体动力学具有密度依赖的扩散系数和迁移率，体现了相互作用的指纹。该体系实现了超越对称简单排斥过程（SSEP）常数扩散系数类的、真正相互作用扩散物质的普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从微观Lindblad动力学出发，推导出描述该相互作用扩散量子物质大尺度涨落的经典宏观涨落理论（MFT），其有效流体动力学具有密度依赖的扩散系数和迁移率，体现了相互作用的指纹。该体系实现了超越对称简单排斥过程（SSEP）常数扩散系数类的、真正相互作用扩散物质的普适类。；创新点：首次从微观Lindblad动力学出发，为相互作用的耗散量子多体系统（XXZ链+退相干）严格推导出具有密度依赖输运系数的MFT，证明其属于相互作用扩散物质的普适类，而非SSEP的常数扩散系数类，从而将MFT确立为相互作用扩散量子系统的普适框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为宏观涨落理论（MFT），从微观Lindblad主方程出发进行流体动力学极限推导；数值验证采用张量网络模拟（tensor-network simulations）。精确计算了稳态密度分布、长程关联和电流的全计数统计（full counting statistics）。

papers.title: How Landau caterpillars turn into Hofstadter butterflies by tuning the periodic potential strength
papers.abstract: It is well-known that the spectrum of two-dimensional electrons in a perpendicular magnetic field is given by discrete flat Landau levels. By contrast, electrons in a two-dimensional tight-binding model give rise to a fractal Hofstadter butterfly spectrum. In this paper, we connect these two opposite limits by showing how a butterfly spectrum emerges from broadened Landau `caterpillars', by continuously increasing the periodic potential strength. We identify a series of topological transitions that isolate a lowest trivial band, a necessary condition for the butterfly to emerge. The resulting butterfly is topologically distinct from the Hofstadter butterfly at fluxes $φ>1$, due to anomalous behavior of diagonal hopping. Moreover, the hopping parameters of an effective tight-binding model, obtained by a Wannierization procedure at large magnetic field, are highly dependent on the flux, revealing that Wannier orbitals themselves change under the applied magnetic field. Our methods and results are relevant for artificial materials, such as moiré systems, where a full quantum of flux per lattice unit cell is experimentally accessible. On a theoretical level, having Wannierization methods for each specific flux allows more accurate many-body calculations in large magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“Wannierization procedure”“tight-binding model”“topological transitions”等理论建模与数值计算方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维电子系统在垂直磁场与周期性势场共同作用下的能谱演化，具体关注从朗道能级（Landau caterpillars）到Hofstadter蝴蝶谱的转变过程，并讨论其在moiré体系等人工材料中的适用性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过连续增大周期性势场强度，展宽的朗道能级（“朗道毛毛虫”）可演化为分形Hofstadter蝴蝶谱，且该过程中存在一系列拓扑相变，其中最低平庸带的隔离是蝴蝶谱出现的必要条件。此外，在大磁场下通过Wannier化得到的有效紧束缚模型跳跃参数强烈依赖磁通量，表明Wannier轨道本身会随磁场改变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过连续增大周期性势场强度，展宽的朗道能级（“朗道毛毛虫”）可演化为分形Hofstadter蝴蝶谱，且该过程中存在一系列拓扑相变，其中最低平庸带的隔离是蝴蝶谱出现的必要条件。此外，在大磁场下通过Wannier化得到的有效紧束缚模型跳跃参数强烈依赖磁通量，表明Wannier轨道本身会随磁场改变。；创新点：首次系统连接了朗道能级极限与Hofstadter蝴蝶极限，揭示了蝴蝶谱从朗道能级涌现的拓扑条件；发现磁通量φ>1时所得蝴蝶谱与标准Hofstadter蝴蝶谱拓扑不等价（源于对角跳跃的异常行为）；并指出Wannier轨道本身对磁通量的依赖，为强磁场下多体计算提供了新的理论工具。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算相结合：采用紧束缚模型描述二维电子系统，通过连续调节周期性势场强度研究能谱演化；使用Wannier化（Wannierization）方法在大磁场下提取有效紧束缚模型参数，并分析拓扑转变与能带结构。

papers.title: Size-Dependent Growth Rates Amplify Infinitesimal Asymmetry in Nanocrystals
papers.abstract: The kinetic Wulff construction predicts symmetric nonequilibrium shapes when crystallographically equivalent facets share a fixed growth rate. However, nanocrystals grow through finite facets whose nucleation barriers and ligand coverages depend on facet size. Here we develop a size-dependent kinetic construction and show that as a consequence infinitesimal seed asymmetries can be amplified into strongly asymmetric nanocrystal morphologies even when all symmetry-related facets obey the same microscopic growth law. Spatially heterogeneous nucleation rates and boundary limited growth generate facet growth velocities that depend on size, and deterministic shape evolution translates these local rates into global shape symmetry breaking. We illustrate the mechanism of persistent anisotropic growth on square and triangular lattices in two dimensions and on FCC seeds in three dimensions, where cuboctahedra can evolve toward rods or tetrahedra depending on which facet-area perturbations are amplified.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“kinetic Wulff construction”“size-dependent kinetic construction”“deterministic shape evolution”等理论建模与动力学演化框架，未提及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：纳米晶体的形貌演化，具体为尺寸依赖的晶面生长速率如何放大初始微小不对称性，导致对称性破缺的纳米晶形态（如二维方/三角晶格、三维FCC种子上的立方八面体向棒状或四面体演化）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当所有对称等价晶面遵循相同的微观生长定律时，由于晶面尺寸依赖的成核势垒和配体覆盖度，无限小的种子不对称性可被放大为强烈不对称的纳米晶形貌，实现全局形状对称性破缺。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当所有对称等价晶面遵循相同的微观生长定律时，由于晶面尺寸依赖的成核势垒和配体覆盖度，无限小的种子不对称性可被放大为强烈不对称的纳米晶形貌，实现全局形状对称性破缺。；创新点：突破了传统动力学Wulff构型中“对称等价晶面共享固定生长速率”的假设，首次揭示晶面尺寸本身即可作为对称性破缺的放大机制，无需任何外在不对称驱动。摘要未突出说明与实验对比或具体材料体系的定量预测。
papers.method_zh: 发展了尺寸依赖的动力学晶体生长理论（size-dependent kinetic construction），结合空间非均匀成核速率与边界受限生长，通过确定性形状演化方程将局部晶面生长速度映射为全局形貌变化。

papers.title: Bayesian Tracking of a Diffusing Target in Two and Three Dimensions
papers.abstract: We study Bayesian tracking of a diffusing target monitored by a noisy distributed sensor array. Building on an earlier mapping to KPZ growth with a moving defect (or an equivalent directed polymer pinning problem) we determine the phase structure, beyond the previously-studied one-dimensional case, for both Bayes-optimal and suboptimal inference. In $d=2$, theoretical analysis and numerical simulations both give a depinning transition between a successful tracking phase and a failure phase. Weak-coupling RG shows that Bayes-optimal tracking is always successful in $d=2$, but failure can arise from overconfident (suboptimal) inference. In $d=3$, tracking can succeed, or can fail in two distinct ways: the posterior probability distribution may delocalize (no detection), or may become sharply localized, but at the wrong position (a false detection). The two possibilities correspond to Edwards-Wilkinson or Kardar-Parisi-Zhang statistics for the log-posterior. The three phases meet at a Nishimori-like multicritical point on a Bayes-optimal line in a two-parameter phase diagram. (Model misspecification alone can drive depinning into either unpinned phase: underconfidence gives diffuse failure, while overconfidence gives localized-but-wrong failure.) We analyze the transitions between the various phases numerically and with renormalization group arguments. We show that some of these have unusual critical behavior, which the conventional $ε$ expansion fails to describe. Recent rigorous results for directed polymers indicate an alternative scenario. Many of our results, including a scaling relation for exponents at pinning transitions and results for RG flows, are relevant to other phase transitions that involve surface growth or directed polymers in 2+1D or 3+1D.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词为“theoretical analysis”、“numerical simulations”、“renormalization group (RG)”、“phase diagram”。；研究对象：扩散目标（diffusing target）的贝叶斯跟踪问题，由带噪声的分布式传感器阵列监测。该问题被映射为带有移动缺陷的KPZ生长（或等价的有向聚合物钉扎）问题，研究维度为二维（d=2）和三维（d=3）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在d=2中，贝叶斯最优跟踪总是成功，但过度自信（次优）推断可导致去钉扎转变；在d=3中，跟踪可成功或以两种不同方式失败（后验概率分布离域化——未检测，或错误位置尖锐局域化——误检测），三种相在Nishimori-like多临界点交汇。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在d=2中，贝叶斯最优跟踪总是成功，但过度自信（次优）推断可导致去钉扎转变；在d=3中，跟踪可成功或以两种不同方式失败（后验概率分布离域化——未检测，或错误位置尖锐局域化——误检测），三种相在Nishimori-like多临界点交汇。；创新点：将此前仅在一维研究的贝叶斯跟踪映射推广到二维和三维，确定了更高维度的相结构；揭示了模型误设（欠自信/过度自信）可分别驱动两种不同的去钉扎失败模式；发现某些相变具有非常规临界行为，传统ε展开无法描述，并给出了钉扎转变处指数的标度关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值模拟；使用弱耦合重整化群（weak-coupling RG）分析d=2情形；在d=3中通过RG论证和数值方法分析相变；讨论了传统ε展开的失效，并引用有向聚合物的严格结果作为替代方案。

papers.title: Subgap Bound States from Dynamical Impurities
papers.abstract: We find that a single non-magnetic dynamical impurity (e.g., a low-frequency localized "vibron" mode) induces a subgap bound state in an s-wave superconductor. A closed-form solution for the bound state energy is found as a function of the vibron frequency in the elastic scattering limit, with the salient features of the bound state energies unaffected by inelastic scattering processes in the sub-THz regime. In addition to subgap features in the low-frequency local density of states, such impurities result in real space regions of reduced spectroscopic weight outside the gap peak.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We find that”“A closed-form solution is found”等理论推导表述，且讨论弹性散射与非弹性散射过程，属于解析理论分析。；研究对象：s波超导体中单个非磁性动力学杂质（低频局域“振动子”模式）诱导的亚隙束缚态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个非磁性动力学杂质可在s波超导体中诱导出亚隙束缚态；在弹性散射极限下，束缚态能量与振动子频率之间存在闭式解，且亚隙束缚态能量在亚THz频段不受非弹性散射过程的显著影响。此外，这类杂质会在实空间中导致隙峰之外的谱权重降低区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个非磁性动力学杂质可在s波超导体中诱导出亚隙束缚态；在弹性散射极限下，束缚态能量与振动子频率之间存在闭式解，且亚隙束缚态能量在亚THz频段不受非弹性散射过程的显著影响。此外，这类杂质会在实空间中导致隙峰之外的谱权重降低区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断：首次指出非磁性动力学杂质（而非静态杂质）即可产生亚隙束缚态，并给出解析闭式解，同时揭示了实空间谱权重降低这一新的可观测特征。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论求解：在弹性散射极限下推导束缚态能量的闭式解，并分析非弹性散射过程对束缚态能量的影响；计算低频局域态密度及实空间谱权重分布。

papers.title: Magnetic frustration and non-collinear textures in layered Gd magnets
papers.abstract: Using scale-bridging simulations based on electronic structure theory and atomistic spin dynamics, we investigate the magnetic properties of skyrmionic GdRu$_2$Si$_2$ and GdRu$_2$Ge$_2$ layered rare-earth magnets and similar Gd-based compounds (GdAu$_2$Si$_2$, GdAu$_2$Ge$_2$, GdAg$_2$Si$_2$ and GdAg$_2$Ge$_2$). By studying the trends across this structural family, we confirm the importance of magnetic frustration and dipolar interactions for the stability of non-collinear and skyrmion phases. Furthermore, our calculations predict promising opportunities for chemical tuning of these magnets in terms of the balance between various exchange interactions and the character of the magnetic anisotropy. These changes lead to the formation of new types of skyrmions that are stable in a wide range of applied external magnetic field. In particular, we propose partial alkali-metal substitution of Gd in GdRu$_2$Si$_2$ leading to GdKRu$_4$Si$_4$, GdRbRu$_4$Si$_4$, GdCsRu$_4$Si$_4$ as well as GdYRu$_4$Si$_4$ compounds, and suggest that it is likely to result in an ordered layered structure, similarly to previously reported iron pnictides like CaKFe$_4$As$_4$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“scale-bridging simulations based on electronic structure theory and atomistic spin dynamics”，即基于电子结构理论和原子自旋动力学的模拟。；研究对象：层状稀土磁体GdRu₂Si₂和GdRu₂Ge₂及其类似化合物（GdAu₂Si₂、GdAu₂Ge₂、GdAg₂Si₂、GdAg₂Ge₂），以及通过化学替代预测的新化合物（GdKRu₄Si₄、GdRbRu₄Si₄、GdCsRu₄Si₄、GdYRu₄Si₄）。物理现象为磁阻挫、非共线磁结构及斯格明子（skyrmion）相的稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁阻挫和偶极相互作用对非共线磁结构和斯格明子相的稳定至关重要；通过化学调控交换相互作用的平衡和磁各向异性特征，可形成在宽外磁场范围内稳定的新型斯格明子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁阻挫和偶极相互作用对非共线磁结构和斯格明子相的稳定至关重要；通过化学调控交换相互作用的平衡和磁各向异性特征，可形成在宽外磁场范围内稳定的新型斯格明子。；创新点：预测了通过部分碱金属替代Gd（形成GdKRu₄Si₄、GdRbRu₄Si₄、GdCsRu₄Si₄）以及GdYRu₄Si₄等新化合物，并指出这些化合物可能形成有序层状结构（类似铁基超导体CaKFe₄As₄），为化学调控斯格明子磁性材料提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用跨尺度模拟方法，结合电子结构理论（第一性原理计算）与原子自旋动力学模拟，系统比较该结构家族中不同化合物的磁性趋势。

papers.title: Higher-Winding Fractionalization
papers.abstract: Higher-winding skyrmion textures can generate emergent magnetic fields with multiple flux quanta per unit cell. This opens an intriguing route toward fractionalization, allowing fractionalized quantum anomalous Hall states to arise even at integer filling of the microscopic unit cell. We show that, in this setting, increasing lattice-scale inhomogeneity of the emergent magnetic field drives a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) transition between a fractionalized liquid and a crystalline dielectric state. This transition carries a topological signature: under flux insertion, the many-body polarization defines a quantized winding number that is nonzero in the fractionalized phase and vanishes in the dielectric crystal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论概念（emergent magnetic fields、fractionalization、BKT transition、topological signature、quantized winding number），未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：具有更高绕数（higher-winding）的斯格明子（skyrmion）晶格体系，具体研究其产生的涌现磁场（emergent magnetic field）对量子霍尔态分数化（fractionalization）的影响，以及该体系中的量子相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在更高绕数斯格明子晶格中，涌现磁场的晶格尺度不均匀性增强会驱动一个Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless（BKT）相变，从分数化液体转变为晶体介电态；该相变具有拓扑特征——在磁通插入下，多体极化定义了一个量子化的绕数，在分数化相中非零，在介电晶体中为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在更高绕数斯格明子晶格中，涌现磁场的晶格尺度不均匀性增强会驱动一个Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless（BKT）相变，从分数化液体转变为晶体介电态；该相变具有拓扑特征——在磁通插入下，多体极化定义了一个量子化的绕数，在分数化相中非零，在介电晶体中为零。；创新点：首次指出更高绕数斯格明子纹理可在微观原胞整数填充下产生分数化量子反常霍尔态，并揭示涌现磁场的晶格尺度不均匀性可作为调控分数化与介电晶体之间BKT相变的驱动参数，且该相变具有可量化的拓扑绕数标志。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或计算方法（如是否使用场论、有效模型、数值对角化等），仅提及了BKT相变理论、磁通插入（flux insertion）和多体极化（many-body polarization）等概念性工具。

papers.title: Temporal Signature of Bosonic Stimulation Induced by Dark Exciton in a Two-photon Pumped Polariton Condensate
papers.abstract: Strongly-coupled light-matter exciton-polaritons constitute an on-chip solid-state platform where the macroscopic quantum phenomenon of condensation is not only achievable at elevated temperatures, but can also be optically controlled, including through their interaction with inaccessible "dark" states. A recent study has shown that polariton condensation can be established under nonlinear two-photon pumping, paving the way towards dark state-condensate coherent control and highly-efficient terahertz (THz) lasing. In this letter, we show for the first time a temporal signature of dark exciton induced bosonic stimulation by investigating one- and two-photon pumped condensation with time-resolved photoluminescence spectroscopy. Our results show a clear difference in the detuning dependence of the buildup and relaxation rates of the condensate-induced blueshifts under one- and two-photon pumping. This difference is associated with the stronger exciton-fraction dependence expected for one-photon pumped condensation, where polariton-polariton stimulation dominates, compared with two-photon pumped condensation, where a 2p-exciton-to-lower-polariton THz transition can provide another stimulation channel, together with various spin-flip, electron-hole exchange and phonon-based mechanisms. These observations indicate the presence of a new dark state originated stimulation channel that could facilitate highly-efficient THz lasing in semiconductor microcavities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“time-resolved photoluminescence spectroscopy”（时间分辨光致发光谱）作为研究手段，并报告了实验观测结果。；研究对象：半导体微腔中的激子-极化激元凝聚体（exciton-polariton condensate），具体研究在单光子泵浦与双光子泵浦两种条件下，暗激子（dark exciton）诱导的玻色子受激放大（bosonic stimulation）的时间特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在时间分辨光致发光谱中观测到暗激子诱导的玻色子受激放大的时间特征：单光子与双光子泵浦下，凝聚体诱导蓝移的建立速率和弛豫速率对失谐（detuning）的依赖存在明显差异，表明双光子泵浦中存在由暗态（2p激子到下极化激元的太赫兹跃迁）提供的新受激通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在时间分辨光致发光谱中观测到暗激子诱导的玻色子受激放大的时间特征：单光子与双光子泵浦下，凝聚体诱导蓝移的建立速率和弛豫速率对失谐（detuning）的依赖存在明显差异，表明双光子泵浦中存在由暗态（2p激子到下极化激元的太赫兹跃迁）提供的新受激通道。；创新点：首次在时间域上揭示暗激子参与的玻色子受激放大通道的存在，该通道可能为实现半导体微腔中高效太赫兹激射提供新途径。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨光致发光谱（time-resolved photoluminescence spectroscopy），对比单光子泵浦与双光子泵浦下的凝聚体动力学，分析蓝移的建立与弛豫速率随失谐的变化。

papers.title: Green-function Zeros Encode Competing Mott and Charge-ordering Scales
papers.abstract: While correlated insulators are devoid of low-energy quasiparticle poles, their Green functions retain clean momentum structure through zeros. However, precisely what zeros imply is not clear. By studying the extended Hubbard model both analytically and numerically, we establish a new paradigm for strongly correlated matter: the dispersion of Green function zeros is determined by both microscopic spin-spin correlations and defect kinematics. In fact, we find that the dispersion changes discontinuously across the transition between the Mott and the checkerboard charge-density wave phases as is expected for a first-order transition. This physics is robust to the inclusion of further neighbor hopping which simply fine tunes the spin-correlation or charge-defect kinematics. We conclude that it is the {\it dispersion} of the Green-function zeros that encode the physics of ordering resultant from the strong correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“analytically and numerically”（解析和数值）研究扩展Hubbard模型，属于理论框架与数值模拟结合，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：强关联电子体系中的关联绝缘体，具体为扩展Hubbard模型（extended Hubbard model）及其中的Mott绝缘体相与棋盘型电荷密度波（checkerboard charge-density wave）相。核心物理现象是格林函数零点的色散行为及其与竞争序的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 格林函数零点的色散由微观自旋-自旋关联和缺陷（电荷缺陷）运动学共同决定；在Mott相与棋盘型电荷密度波相之间的一级相变处，零点色散发生不连续跳变，因此零点色散编码了强关联导致的序的物理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：格林函数零点的色散由微观自旋-自旋关联和缺陷（电荷缺陷）运动学共同决定；在Mott相与棋盘型电荷密度波相之间的一级相变处，零点色散发生不连续跳变，因此零点色散编码了强关联导致的序的物理。；创新点：提出了一个新的范式：格林函数零点的色散（而非仅仅零点的存在或位置）是理解强关联物质中竞争序的关键，并揭示了零点色散对自旋关联和缺陷运动学的双重依赖，以及其在一级相变中的不连续行为。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析（analytically）与数值计算（numerically）相结合，具体针对扩展Hubbard模型。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如DMRG、QMC等），也未给出解析技术的细节。

papers.title: Fermi-Level Metal-d Character of Group-6 Bis-Hexahapto Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Superconductivity in graphite intercalation compounds requires occupancy of a carbon-derived interlayer band filled by charge from an electropositive intercalant. Bis-hexahapto (eta6-eta6) coordination binds transition metals covalently to two graphene sheets with little charge transfer -- the mechanism that defines this chemistry removes the donation on which intercalated-graphite superconductivity rests. We ask, for group-6 Cr, Mo and W in bilayer graphene, whether Fermi-level states retain the interstitial, carbon-p character of ionic references, with bulk CaC6 and same-cell C12Ca/C12Li controls. Electron-phonon coupling is not computed. At one metal per gallery (C12M), the ionic controls retain 68 and 45 per cent, respectively, of gallery spectral weight in atom-masked interstitial regions at EF; the group-6 systems retain 15, 22 and 23 per cent. The contrast is compositional: group-6 galleries carry more absolute interstitial weight than C12Li, but projected density of states within +/-0.15 eV of EF is carbon p dominated in the ionic references and metal d dominated (~73 per cent) in all three group-6 bilayers. Every system studied is metallic; they differ in what carries the Fermi surface. Geometrically, eta6-eta6 coordination requires AA stacking and reverses the intrinsic Bernal preference by 400-600 meV wherever metal is present. Ordered phases are metastable against bulk metal (+2.9-5.0 eV per atom) but bound against isolated atoms (-1.6-4.1 eV); instability ordering (Cr least, W most) matches Cr > Mo > W reactivity. C12Cr is metallic; tungsten alone carries 0.65 muB. Bis-hexahapto intercalation delivers strong interlayer bonding and a definite AA registry, but not the interlayer-band character associated with superconducting graphite intercalation compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Electron-phonon coupling is not computed”，并详细描述了投影态密度、几何能量比较等计算分析内容，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：双层石墨烯中第6族过渡金属（Cr、Mo、W）的双六配位（bis-hexahapto，η6-η6）插层体系，具体为C12M（每层间一个金属原子）结构，并与离子型插层石墨化合物（CaC6、C12Ca、C12Li）进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 第6族金属的双六配位插层虽然能形成强层间键合并稳定AA堆垛，但其费米面附近的电子态以金属d轨道为主（约73%），而非超导石墨插层化合物所需的碳p型层间带特征，因此这类体系不具备石墨插层超导所需的电子结构条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：第6族金属的双六配位插层虽然能形成强层间键合并稳定AA堆垛，但其费米面附近的电子态以金属d轨道为主（约73%），而非超导石墨插层化合物所需的碳p型层间带特征，因此这类体系不具备石墨插层超导所需的电子结构条件。；创新点：首次系统研究了双六配位共价键合插层（而非离子电荷转移插层）对双层石墨烯费米面电子结构的影响，明确指出这种配位化学机制会消除层间碳p带占据，从而破坏超导所需的电子条件。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，包括：投影态密度（PDOS）分析（±0.15 eV费米能级窗口）、原子掩蔽（atom-masked）层间谱权重分析、AA/AB堆垛能量比较（400–600 meV）、有序相相对于体相金属和孤立原子的稳定性计算（+2.9–5.0 eV/atom和-1.6–4.1 eV/atom）、磁矩计算（W为0.65 μB）。

papers.title: AutoXRD: Autonomous LLM Agents and Comprehensive Evaluation for Powder Diffraction Analysis
papers.abstract: Powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) is central to materials characterization, yet reliable end-to-end automation remains challenging. An XRD agent must interpret diffraction evidence, operate refinement software, manage coupled parameters in a defensible order, and distinguish numerical improvement from physical validity. In this paper, we propose AutoXRD, an autonomous large language model (LLM) agent framework that organizes powder-XRD analysis as stepwise refinement, grounds actions in observed evidence, and applies deterministic crystallographic and physical checks before accepting results. We further introduce XRDBench with two complementary tracks. XRDBench-QA contains 100 bounded diagnostic tasks that isolate scientific reasoning and decision-making, whereas XRDBench-E2E contains 34 executable workflows that test whether agents can compose these capabilities into complete analyses requiring file inspection, crystallographic-software execution, iterative refinement, evidence preservation, and reporting. We evaluate ten recent LLMs across 1,340 model--task runs. Models average only 57.8 out of 100, falling from 61.9 on XRDBench-QA to 53.7 on XRDBench-E2E. They perform best on refinement-history assessment and result acceptance, but remain substantially weaker on refinement-action selection, phase quantification, indexing, and Rietveld refinement. GPT-5.6 Sol achieves the highest overall score of 81.1, GPT-5.6 Terra the highest XRDBench-E2E point estimate of 81.0, and GPT-5.6 Luna the best score--cost trade-off. Ablations show that all six AutoXRD components consistently improve performance, supporting the framework design. Finally, execution-trace analysis reveals recurring failures in coupled-parameter control, quantitative reasoning, evidence preservation, and workflow termination, motivating stronger scientific constraints, uncertainty-aware decisions, and more efficient planning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算/方法学文章）。判断依据关键词：LLM agent framework、deterministic crystallographic and physical checks、benchmark evaluation、ablation analysis。；研究对象：粉末X射线衍射（powder XRD）数据分析的自动化流程，具体涉及物相鉴定、Rietveld精修、定量分析等晶体学任务，以及用于评测的XRDBench基准（含QA与E2E两个轨道）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 现有大语言模型在粉末XRD端到端自动分析上平均得分仅57.8/100（QA轨道61.9，E2E轨道53.7），在精修历史评估和结果接受方面表现较好，但在精修动作选择、物相定量、指标化及Rietveld精修上明显薄弱；最佳模型GPT-5.6 Sol总分81.1，GPT-5.6 Terra在E2E上最高（81.0），GPT-5.6 Luna性价比最优。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：现有大语言模型在粉末XRD端到端自动分析上平均得分仅57.8/100（QA轨道61.9，E2E轨道53.7），在精修历史评估和结果接受方面表现较好，但在精修动作选择、物相定量、指标化及Rietveld精修上明显薄弱；最佳模型GPT-5.6 Sol总分81.1，GPT-5.6 Terra在E2E上最高（81.0），GPT-5.6 Luna性价比最优。；创新点：提出首个面向粉末XRD分析的自主LLM智能体框架（AutoXRD），并配套双轨评测基准XRDBench，将科学推理能力与完整工作流执行能力分开评测；通过消融实验验证框架六个组件的各自贡献，并通过执行轨迹分析揭示耦合参数控制、定量推理、证据保留和工作流终止等系统性失败模式。
papers.method_zh: 构建AutoXRD框架，将XRD分析组织为逐步精修流程，以观测证据为行动依据，并在接受结果前施加确定性晶体学与物理约束检查；同时构建XRDBench基准（100个有界诊断任务QA + 34个可执行端到端工作流E2E），对10个近期LLM进行1,340次模型-任务运行评测，并开展消融实验与执行轨迹分析。

papers.title: Observable- and state-selective prethermalization and bounds on prethermal lifetimes
papers.abstract: Prethermalization describes long-lived intermediate regimes that precede equilibrium and can dominate experimentally accessible dynamics. Here, we show that a separation of spectral energy scales, despite giving rise to a hierarchy of dynamical timescales, does not by itself guarantee the appearance of a prethermal plateau. Under the same Hamiltonian, some observables may exhibit prethermal behavior, while others relax directly toward equilibrium. We uncover the mechanism governing this selectivity, showing that the emergence of a prethermal plateau depends not only on the Hamiltonian, but also on the observable and the initial state. Our results apply broadly to systems close to a fully permutation-symmetric limit and are illustrated with a long-range interacting spin model. We further prove that the Loschmidt echo provides a lower bound on the prethermal lifetime of any bounded observable whenever the prethermal and exact dynamics are unitary.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, prove, uncover the mechanism，属于解析论证与理论分析。；研究对象：预热化（prethermalization）现象，具体研究在具有分离的谱能量标度、且接近完全置换对称极限的量子多体系统中，预热化平台的出现条件与寿命下界。以长程相互作用自旋模型为例进行说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 谱能量标度的分离（即存在动力学时间尺度层级）本身并不足以保证出现预热化平台；在同一个哈密顿量下，某些可观测量会表现出预热化行为，而另一些则直接弛豫到平衡态。预热化平台的出现不仅取决于哈密顿量，还取决于所选择的可观测量和初始态。此外，证明了Loschmidt回声为任何有界可观测量的预热化寿命提供了一个下界（在预热化动力学与精确动力学均为幺正演化的条件下）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：谱能量标度的分离（即存在动力学时间尺度层级）本身并不足以保证出现预热化平台；在同一个哈密顿量下，某些可观测量会表现出预热化行为，而另一些则直接弛豫到平衡态。预热化平台的出现不仅取决于哈密顿量，还取决于所选择的可观测量和初始态。此外，证明了Loschmidt回声为任何有界可观测量的预热化寿命提供了一个下界（在预热化动力学与精确动力学均为幺正演化的条件下）。；创新点：揭示了预热化现象的可观测量选择性与初态依赖性，打破了“能标分离必然导致预热化平台”的直觉认知；并首次给出Loschmidt回声与任意有界可观测量预热化寿命之间的严格下界关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于接近完全置换对称极限的体系展开论证；结合长程相互作用自旋模型进行具体说明；利用Loschmidt回声的数学性质证明预热化寿命的下界。

papers.title: Depth-1 expanders on the unitary group and applications
papers.abstract: We construct a constant-degree and constant-gap quantum expander on $n$ qubits where each unitary can be implemented by a depth-$1$ and 1D circuit of Pauli or CNOT gates. We provide two applications of this expander. First, we use it to construct a family of frustration-free 1D Hamiltonians whose ground states obey the entanglement-gap relation $S = Θ(Δ^{-1/2})$; this is believed to be optimal, but achieving it had been open. Second, we use it to provide a streaming protocol that tests for closeness to a class of 1D volume-law entangled states. Moreover, we extend our quantum expander to a constant-degree and constant-gap expander on the unitary group where each unitary is a single $T$ gate, a single $T^{\dagger}$ gate, or a depth-$1$ Clifford circuit. This implies that a random sequence of unitaries from the expander yields a gapped walk on a dense subgroup of the unitary group. This improves upon previous work by Bourgain and Gamburd which did not control the dependence of the gap on the dimension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct、quantum expander、Hamiltonians、streaming protocol、proof/construction（摘要中为数学构造与理论分析，无实验手段）。；研究对象：量子信息与量子多体物理交叉领域：n量子比特上的量子扩展器（quantum expander），以及由其构造的1D无阻挫哈密顿量基态纠缠性质、1D体积极律纠缠态的流式测试协议，以及酉群上的扩展器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了常数度、常数能隙的量子扩展器，每个酉算符可由深度为1的1D Pauli或CNOT电路实现；由此得到满足纠缠-能隙关系 S = Θ(Δ^{-1/2}) 的无阻挫1D哈密顿量族（该关系被认为最优但此前未实现），并给出测试1D体积极律纠缠态的流式协议。此外，将扩展器推广到酉群上，每个酉为单个T门、单个T†门或深度1的Clifford电路，从而在酉群的稠密子群上产生有能隙的随机游走。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了常数度、常数能隙的量子扩展器，每个酉算符可由深度为1的1D Pauli或CNOT电路实现；由此得到满足纠缠-能隙关系 S = Θ(Δ^{-1/2}) 的无阻挫1D哈密顿量族（该关系被认为最优但此前未实现），并给出测试1D体积极律纠缠态的流式协议。此外，将扩展器推广到酉群上，每个酉为单个T门、单个T†门或深度1的Clifford电路，从而在酉群的稠密子群上产生有能隙的随机游走。；创新点：首次实现深度1（1D电路）的常数度、常数能隙量子扩展器，并据此达到最优纠缠-能隙标度 S = Θ(Δ^{-1/2})（此前为开放问题）；同时将扩展器推广到仅含T门/T†门/深度1 Clifford电路的酉群扩展器，改进了Bourgain-Gamburd此前未控制能隙对维度依赖的不足。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与数学证明：显式构造常数度、常数能隙的量子扩展器（基于Pauli/CNOT深度1电路），利用其性质构造哈密顿量并分析基态纠缠-能隙标度；采用流式（streaming）协议设计用于纠缠态测试；推广至酉群时使用T门与Clifford电路的组合，并分析随机游走的能隙（改进Bourgain-Gamburd方法，控制能隙对维度的依赖）。

papers.title: Concentration of additive functionals of Stratonovich-type
papers.abstract: Additive functionals $\overline{J}_t=\frac{1}{t}\int_0^tU(X_s)\circ dX_s$ of Stratonovich-type recently attracted much attention in the context of inference of thermodynamic properties of complex systems from observations $U$ of individual fluctuating paths $(X_s)_{0\le s\le t}$, whereby $X_0$ is initiated from some general measure. Concentration results on $\overline{J}_t$, albeit desirable, are virtually nonexistent. They turn out to be significantly more challenging to prove than for classical Lebesgue-type functionals $\overlineρ_t=\frac{1}{t}\int_0^t V(X_s)ds$ because the tilt deforms the full second-order structure of the Feynman-Kac generator instead of contributing an additive potential. This renders the generator generally non-self-adjoint even under detailed balance. We overcome this by working with a symmetrized Dirichlet form with a new effective potential that now couples the observable to the non-equilibrium character of the dynamics. We prove concentration inequalities for $\overline{J}_t$ for any bounded, sufficiently smooth vector-valued function $U$ of a general geometrically ergodic diffusion process $X_s$, including explicit sub-gamma and Bernstein-type inequalities, and we obtain explicit upper bounds on ${\rm Var}(\overline{J}_t)$. Strikingly, under detailed balance the concentration of $\overline{J}_t$ is distinctively sub-Gaussian at all times and all deviations, with a variance proxy fixed by the noise alone and independent of the spectral gap, which has no analog for $\overlineρ_t$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于数学证明（concentration inequalities、显式不等式推导），属于随机过程与统计物理的理论分析。；研究对象：Stratonovich型加性泛函 \(\overline{J}_t=\frac{1}{t}\int_0^tU(X_s)\circ dX_s\) 的浓度性质，该泛函用于从单个涨落路径观测中推断复杂体系的热力学性质，研究对象为一般几何遍历扩散过程 \(X_s\)。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于任意有界、充分光滑的向量值函数 \(U\)，\(\overline{J}_t\) 满足显式的亚伽马型与Bernstein型浓度不等式，且其方差有显式上界；在细致平衡条件下，\(\overline{J}_t\) 的浓度在所有时间和所有偏差下均为亚高斯型，其方差代理仅由噪声决定、与谱隙无关——这一性质对经典Lebesgue型泛函 \(\overline{\rho}_t\) 不存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于任意有界、充分光滑的向量值函数 \(U\)，\(\overline{J}_t\) 满足显式的亚伽马型与Bernstein型浓度不等式，且其方差有显式上界；在细致平衡条件下，\(\overline{J}_t\) 的浓度在所有时间和所有偏差下均为亚高斯型，其方差代理仅由噪声决定、与谱隙无关——这一性质对经典Lebesgue型泛函 \(\overline{\rho}_t\) 不存在。；创新点：首次给出Stratonovich型加性泛函的浓度不等式（此前该类结果几乎不存在）；发现细致平衡下 \(\overline{J}_t\) 具有与谱隙无关的亚高斯浓度，这一特性在经典Lebesgue型泛函中没有对应物。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：对称化Dirichlet形式方法。关键技巧是引入一个新的有效势，将观测函数与非平衡动力学特征耦合，从而克服Feynman-Kac生成元因倾斜变形而失去自伴性（即使在细致平衡下）的困难。

papers.title: Odd-viscosity-induced instability in shear flows
papers.abstract: Odd viscosity is a nondissipative component of the viscosity tensor that arises in fluids with broken time-reversal symmetry. Despite conserving energy, we show that odd viscosity can qualitatively alter hydrodynamic stability by generating exponentially growing modes that are absent in conventional fluids. For plane Poiseuille flow, we derive the odd-viscous generalization of the Orr--Sommerfeld--Squire equations and find a new instability that first emerges for spanwise perturbations and extends to oblique modes through the amplification of odd-viscous forces in critical layers. The instability originates from the non-normal dynamics of shear flows: conventional fluids support transiently growing disturbances through the lift-up mechanism, while odd viscosity provides a feedback between wall-normal velocity and vorticity that converts this transient growth into a self-sustaining exponentially growing mode. More generally, we show that an energy-conserving perturbation can destabilize a non-normal dynamical system only when the unperturbed system supports transient growth. Our results establish a direct connection between transient growth, non-normality, and instability induced by nondissipative forces, with implications extending beyond odd-viscous hydrodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及推导方程（derive the odd-viscous generalization）、理论分析（show, prove）以及一般性动力学论证，未提及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：具有奇黏度（odd viscosity）的流体，具体研究平面泊肃叶流（plane Poiseuille flow）中的水动力学稳定性问题，属于非耗散黏性流体力学范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 奇黏度虽不耗散能量，却能通过将剪切流中非正常动力学（non-normal dynamics）的瞬态增长转化为自持的指数增长模式，从而在传统流体中不存在的条件下引发新的不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：奇黏度虽不耗散能量，却能通过将剪切流中非正常动力学（non-normal dynamics）的瞬态增长转化为自持的指数增长模式，从而在传统流体中不存在的条件下引发新的不稳定性。；创新点：首次证明能量守恒的扰动（奇黏度）可以仅通过非正常系统的瞬态增长机制诱导出指数不稳定性，建立了瞬态增长、非正常性与非耗散力致不稳定性之间的直接联系，并将该结论推广到超出奇黏滞流体的一般动力学系统。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：对平面泊肃叶流推导了奇黏滞推广的 Orr–Sommerfeld–Squire 方程，并分析了扰动的线性稳定性；同时采用一般非正常动力系统（non-normal dynamical system）的抽象理论框架进行普适性论证。

papers.title: Quasi-normal-mode signatures of periodicity and hyperuniformity
papers.abstract: Hyperuniform materials occupy an intermediate regime between periodic order and conventional disorder, characterized by a suppression of long-wavelength density fluctuations, commonly quantified by the structure factor. This characterization, however, relies on the statistical properties of an extended configuration or supercell representation and does not directly describe the resonant response of a finite structure, as typically encountered in scattering experiments. Here, we introduce the quasi-normal-mode spectrum as a complementary framework for characterizing the wave properties of finite stealthy hyperuniform materials. We analyze the complex eigenfrequencies of both periodic and stealthy hyperuniform structures over a range of the stealthiness parameter ($χ$), and investigate how the spatial organization of scatterers is encoded in both frequency and spatial profiles of their quasi-normal modes. We find systematic changes in the quasi-normal modes spectrum as the degree of hyperuniformity is varied, revealing signatures that are not captured solely by the structure factor. In particular, the evolution of the resonant states provides a direct connection between structural correlations and the scattering response of finite systems. Our results establish quasi-normal modes as a real-space and open-system characterization of hyperuniformity and provide a unified framework for comparing discrete heterogeneous materials from the perspective of their scattering and resonant dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“分析复本征频率”“结构因子”“准正态模式谱”等理论计算关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：有限尺寸的隐身超均匀（stealthy hyperuniform）材料，以及周期性结构，重点研究其准正态模式（quasi-normal modes）所反映的共振响应与波动力学特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着超均匀性程度（隐身参数χ）变化，准正态模式谱出现系统性改变，揭示了仅靠结构因子无法捕捉的共振特征；共振态的演化直接建立了结构关联与有限体系散射响应之间的联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着超均匀性程度（隐身参数χ）变化，准正态模式谱出现系统性改变，揭示了仅靠结构因子无法捕捉的共振特征；共振态的演化直接建立了结构关联与有限体系散射响应之间的联系。；创新点：将准正态模式谱引入作为超均匀性的实空间、开放体系表征工具，提供了一种统一框架，从散射与共振动力学角度比较不同离散异质材料；该框架能捕捉结构因子遗漏的共振信息。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算：通过求解有限结构的复本征频率（准正态模式谱），分析周期性和隐身超均匀结构中散射体空间组织对频率及空间模式分布的影响，并扫描隐身参数χ。

papers.title: A nonabelian anyon violates Haag duality
papers.abstract: We show that a superselction sector describing a single nonabelian anyon violates Haag duality, which is equivalent to the fundamental quantum-information theoretic principle of uniqueness of purifications. We provide a simple physics argument as well as a rigorous proof using sector theory, and instantiate our result concretely in Levin-Wen models. We also show that the associated ground state does not allow for quantum steering despite being a pure state. Finally, we show that this ground state violates approximate Haag duality, disproving the conjecture that all gapped ground states satisfy this condition. Our result implies that there are gapped phases of matter where Haag duality fails at every point in the phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“rigorous proof”“sector theory”“Levin-Wen models”等理论物理与数学物理关键词，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：非阿贝尔任意子的超选择扇区，以及与之关联的量子基态（具体在Levin-Wen模型中实现）。研究聚焦于量子场论/拓扑序中的Haag对偶性、纯化唯一性、量子转向等量子信息与代数量子场论交叉的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个非阿贝尔任意子的超选择扇区违反Haag对偶性（等价于违反纯化唯一性）；该任意子对应的基态虽为纯态但不允许量子转向，且该基态违反近似Haag对偶性，从而否证了“所有能隙基态满足近似Haag对偶性”的猜想。这意味着存在能隙物相，其中Haag对偶性在相中每一点都失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个非阿贝尔任意子的超选择扇区违反Haag对偶性（等价于违反纯化唯一性）；该任意子对应的基态虽为纯态但不允许量子转向，且该基态违反近似Haag对偶性，从而否证了“所有能隙基态满足近似Haag对偶性”的猜想。这意味着存在能隙物相，其中Haag对偶性在相中每一点都失效。；创新点：首次证明非阿贝尔任意子违反Haag对偶性，并将该违反与纯化唯一性这一量子信息基本原理直接联系；同时否证了关于能隙基态满足近似Haag对偶性的猜想，揭示了拓扑序中Haag对偶性系统性失效的新现象。
papers.method_zh: 采用代数量子场论中的扇区理论（sector theory）进行严格证明，并辅以物理直观论证；具体实例化于Levin-Wen格子模型（拓扑序的晶格模型）中。

papers.title: Exceptional Points in Photonics: From Non-Hermitian Physics to Applications
papers.abstract: Open photonic systems provide a versatile platform for non-Hermitian physics, enabling control over complex spectra, transport, and light-matter interactions. Exceptional points (EPs), at which eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce and the governing operator becomes defective, play a central role because they combine branch-point spectral topology, nonanalytic perturbative response, and controllable eigenstate conversion. This Review provides a unified framework for EP photonics by systematically distinguishing exceptional degeneracies according to the underlying operator, spectral variable, boundary conditions, and experimentally accessible observables. We discuss Hamiltonian EPs, absorbing EPs associated with scattering zeros, real-frequency scattering-matrix and Jones-matrix EPs, Bloch and Floquet EPs, and Liouvillian EPs in open quantum systems. We review their spectral topology, static and dynamical encircling, higher-order exceptional structures, and coexistence with bound states in the continuum, together with applications in sensing, lasing, coherent absorption, directional scattering, polarization and wavefront control, nonlinear optics, optical storage, nonreciprocal photonics, and quantum photonics. We also critically assess the current limitations, practical challenges, and future perspectives of EP-based photonic technologies, with particular attention to robustness, noise, scalability, and experimentally measurable performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。判断依据：摘要明确为“This Review”，系统分类讨论非厄米光子学中的奇异点（EPs），属于理论框架综述，未涉及具体实验或计算数据。；研究对象：开放光子体系中的非厄米物理，具体聚焦于**奇异点（Exceptional Points, EPs）**——即本征值和本征矢量同时合并、系统算符变为亏损（defective）的特殊简并点。涵盖多种EP类型：哈密顿量EP、与散射零点相关的吸收EP、实频率散射矩阵/琼斯矩阵EP、Bloch/Floquet EP、开放量子系统中的Liouvillian EP，以及它们与连续谱中束缚态（BIC）的共存。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该综述为EP光子学提供了统一框架，系统区分了不同EP的底层算符、谱变量、边界条件和可观测物理量，并总结了EP在传感、激光、相干吸收、定向散射、偏振/波前调控、非线性光学、光存储、非互易光子学和量子光子学中的应用，同时批判性评估了其鲁棒性、噪声、可扩展性等实际挑战。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该综述为EP光子学提供了统一框架，系统区分了不同EP的底层算符、谱变量、边界条件和可观测物理量，并总结了EP在传感、激光、相干吸收、定向散射、偏振/波前调控、非线性光学、光存储、非互易光子学和量子光子学中的应用，同时批判性评估了其鲁棒性、噪声、可扩展性等实际挑战。；创新点：摘要未突出说明单一创新点，但明确提出了一个**统一的分类框架**，即按照底层算符、谱变量、边界条件和可观测物理量来系统区分各类EP，这相对于以往分散的EP研究是一种系统性整合。此外，对EP技术实际限制（鲁棒性、噪声、可扩展性、可测量性能）的批判性评估也是其特色。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架与分类学方法：基于非厄米算符理论（Hamiltonian、散射矩阵、Jones矩阵、Liouvillian），结合谱拓扑分析（branch-point拓扑、静态/动态环绕）、高阶奇异结构（higher-order exceptional structures）以及BIC共存理论。摘要未提及具体数值计算方法（如有限元、传输矩阵等）。

papers.title: Chemotaxis-induced linear instabilities and pattern formation in a reaction-diffusion model
papers.abstract: We study linear instabilities and pattern formation in a spatially extended Selkov model for glycolysis with diffusion and chemotactic interactions between two species. Linear stability analysis reveals two distinct bifurcations: a zero-wavevector, finite-frequency Hopf bifurcation leading to spatially homogeneous oscillations, and a finite-wavevector Turing instability with a saddle-node bifurcation leading to stationary inhomogeneous patterns. The selected wavevector, $k_c$, depends sensitively on the nature and strength of chemotaxis and varies nonmonotonically with the chemotaxis parameters, allowing re-entrant transitions between homogeneous and patterned states. For sufficiently strong chemotaxis, when the two species mutually attract or mutually repel each other, an unusual instability emerges in which the preferred wavevector diverges as a finite threshold in chemotactic strength is approached. We complement the linear analysis with extensive direct numerical simulations (DNS) of the nonlinear partial differential equations in two dimensions. The DNS confirm the predicted instabilities and their nonmonotonic and re-entrant character, and also reveal spatially uniform oscillatory states for suitable parameters. The stationary patterns include spots and, unexpectedly, stable stripes. We further uncover transitions between spot and stripe morphologies controlled by chemotactic strength and diffusivity ratios. The stability of the striped states is consistent with linear amplitude equations, whereas the spot-stripe transition is attributed to nonlinear effects beyond linear stability. Our results demonstrate that chemotaxis can act as a nonmonotonic control parameter for instability selection, wavelength selection, re-entrant pattern formation, and nonlinear pattern morphology in reaction-diffusion systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：线性稳定性分析、直接数值模拟（DNS）、非线性偏微分方程求解。；研究对象：空间扩展的Selkov糖酵解反应-扩散模型，包含两种物种间的扩散与趋化相互作用，研究趋化诱导的线性不稳定性和斑图形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 趋化作用可作为反应-扩散系统中不稳定性选择、波长选择、重入斑图形成及非线性斑图形态的非单调控制参数；强趋化下可出现波矢发散的非寻常不稳定性，并发现稳定的条纹斑图及斑点-条纹转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：趋化作用可作为反应-扩散系统中不稳定性选择、波长选择、重入斑图形成及非线性斑图形态的非单调控制参数；强趋化下可出现波矢发散的非寻常不稳定性，并发现稳定的条纹斑图及斑点-条纹转变。；创新点：揭示了趋化强度作为非单调控制参数导致的重入性斑图转变，以及强趋化下波矢发散的新型不稳定性；首次在Selkov模型中报道稳定的条纹斑图及斑点-条纹形态转变，并将条纹稳定性归因于线性振幅方程、斑点-条纹转变归因于非线性效应。摘要未突出说明与已有趋化-反应扩散研究的系统性对比。
papers.method_zh: 线性稳定性分析（Hopf分岔与Turing不稳定性分析）、线性振幅方程、二维非线性偏微分方程的直接数值模拟（DNS）。

papers.title: Helium-Gas-Cooled Cryogenic Current Comparator Integrated with a Quantum Resistance Standard
papers.abstract: We report a cryogen-free cryogenic current comparator (CCC) system for precision resistance measurements. A helium-gas chamber was developed and installed on the 4 K stage of a cryogen-free dilution refrigerator equipped with a pulse-tube cryocooler. The CCC probe was housed in this chamber and was cooled through helium gas serving as a heat exchange medium. The metrological performance of this helium-gas-cooled CCC was evaluated through precision resistance-ratio measurements and found to be comparable to that obtained under liquid-helium cooling. A quantum Hall resistance (QHR) device was also integrated into the same refrigerator, enabling QHR/100~$Ω$ resistance-ratio measurements. The type-A uncertainty reached the 1~n$Ω$/$Ω$ level within an averaging time of 100~s, and the resulting resistance-ratio measurements agreed well with conventional liquid-helium-based measurements at the level of a few n$Ω$/$Ω$. The system provides this level of measurement performance while consuming less than 1~L of helium gas per thermal cycle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了一套实际搭建的低温系统（helium-gas chamber、CCC probe）并进行了测量（precision resistance-ratio measurements），属于实验技术开发与验证。；研究对象：研究对象是低温电流比较仪（CCC）系统，具体为一种采用氦气冷却（而非液氦浸泡）的CCC，并与量子霍尔电阻（QHR）标准集成在同一无液氦稀释制冷机中，用于精密电阻比例测量（QHR/100 Ω）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氦气冷却的CCC在计量性能上与液氦冷却相当，在100秒平均时间内达到1 nΩ/Ω量级的A类不确定度，且与常规液氦测量结果在几个nΩ/Ω水平一致；每次热循环消耗的氦气少于1升。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氦气冷却的CCC在计量性能上与液氦冷却相当，在100秒平均时间内达到1 nΩ/Ω量级的A类不确定度，且与常规液氦测量结果在几个nΩ/Ω水平一致；每次热循环消耗的氦气少于1升。；创新点：实现了无液氦（cryogen-free）条件下CCC的氦气冷却运行，避免了液氦浸泡需求，同时保持计量级精度，并首次将QHR与氦气冷却CCC集成于同一无液氦制冷机中，显著降低了氦气消耗（每次循环<1 L）。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：在无液氦稀释制冷机（脉冲管制冷机）的4 K级上安装氦气室，以氦气作为换热介质冷却CCC探针；通过精密电阻比例测量评估计量性能；将QHR器件集成于同一制冷机，进行QHR/100 Ω比例测量，并与传统液氦冷却测量结果对比。

papers.title: Tangent fermions can restore vacuum stability of discrete-time Dirac models
papers.abstract: The Dirac quantum walk (a 1+1 dimensional space-time discretization of the Dirac equation) has a $2μ$ mass gap both at the center and at the corner of the quasi-energy-momentum Brillouin zone. Gupta and Short recently noted [Quantum 9, 1845 (2025)] that the Dirac vacuum can create a particle-hole pair at the zone corner with the release of an energy $2μ$ to the environment. They removed this vacuum instability at the expense of fermion doubling, the appearance of a second low-energy Dirac cone. Here we show that an alternative discretization scheme, with a tangent rather than a sine dispersion relation, offers stability while retaining a single Dirac cone. The key step is the Cayley transformation from the unit circle of Floquet eigenvalues $e^{-i\varepsilon}$ to the real line of unbounded energies $E=2\tan(\varepsilon/2)$. We compute the Schwinger effect (particle-hole pair creation in a uniform electric field) for tangent fermions and show that the pair-production rate agrees with the continuum result for a single Dirac cone. The zone corner is exactly decoupled if the scalar potential is coupled through the Hermitian generator of the quantum map. If it is coupled as a split operator, in order to preserve exact gauge invariance on the lattice, the corner does contribute - with a weight that vanishes quadratically with the lattice constants, in contrast to the Dirac quantum walk where the zone-corner instability survives the continuum limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论推导（Cayley变换）、数值计算（Schwinger效应、粒子对产生率），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：离散时间Dirac模型（1+1维Dirac方程的时空离散化），具体为Dirac量子行走及其替代离散化方案——切线色散（tangent dispersion）费米子体系，关注真空稳定性与粒子-空穴对产生（Schwinger效应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用切线色散关系的离散化方案（通过Cayley变换实现）能在保持单一Dirac锥的同时恢复真空稳定性，消除Dirac量子行走在布里渊区角落的真空不稳定性；其Schwinger效应粒子对产生率与连续统单Dirac锥结果一致，且角落贡献随晶格常数二次方消失（若以分裂算符耦合标量势），而Dirac量子行走的角落不稳定性在连续极限下仍存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用切线色散关系的离散化方案（通过Cayley变换实现）能在保持单一Dirac锥的同时恢复真空稳定性，消除Dirac量子行走在布里渊区角落的真空不稳定性；其Schwinger效应粒子对产生率与连续统单Dirac锥结果一致，且角落贡献随晶格常数二次方消失（若以分裂算符耦合标量势），而Dirac量子行走的角落不稳定性在连续极限下仍存在。；创新点：提出一种新的离散化方案（切线色散）替代Dirac量子行走，在不引入费米子加倍（即保持单一Dirac锥）的前提下解决真空不稳定性问题，并证明其连续极限行为优于Dirac量子行走（角落贡献二次方消失而非持续存在）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析计算：利用Cayley变换将Floquet本征值单位圆（e^{-iε}）映射到无界能量实线（E=2tan(ε/2)），构建切线色散离散化方案；计算均匀电场下的Schwinger效应（粒子-空穴对产生率），并对比两种标量势耦合方式（Hermitian生成元耦合与分裂算符耦合）下的角落贡献权重。

papers.title: Topological charge switching in trapped polariton condensates
papers.abstract: Topological charges in photonic systems provide a robust degree of freedom with direct applications in optical information processing. Bound states in the continuum (BICs) in photonic crystal slabs inherently carry such quantized topological charges, yet they are topologically protected, making active reconfiguration fundamentally challenging. Here, we demonstrate topological charge switching in trapped BIC polariton condensates in a photonic crystal, where spatial modulation of the photonic crystals supports multiple confined states, each carrying a distinct charge. Trapped condensates within the Dirac bandgap are expelled into the leaky band via polariton blueshift, enabling single-mode selection by solely tuning the excitation power. This work offers a platform for optically controlling topological charges by harnessing polariton nonlinearity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we demonstrate”“trapped condensates are expelled”等实验性描述，以及“solely tuning the excitation power”表明实际测量操作。；研究对象：光子晶体平板中的束缚态连续谱（BIC）激子极化激元凝聚体，具体为被限制在光子晶体空间调制势阱中的极化激元凝聚体，以及其携带的拓扑电荷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过仅调节激发功率，利用极化激元蓝移将狄拉克带隙内的束缚凝聚体推入漏泄带，实现了束缚BIC极化激元凝聚体中拓扑电荷的切换，并完成单模选择。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过仅调节激发功率，利用极化激元蓝移将狄拉克带隙内的束缚凝聚体推入漏泄带，实现了束缚BIC极化激元凝聚体中拓扑电荷的切换，并完成单模选择。；创新点：首次在束缚BIC极化激元凝聚体中实现拓扑电荷的主动切换，打破了BIC拓扑电荷的拓扑保护限制，利用极化激元非线性（蓝移）实现了纯光学调控的拓扑电荷开关，为光学信息处理提供了可重构的拓扑自由度平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用空间调制的光子晶体结构以支持多个携带不同拓扑电荷的束缚态；利用非共振光学激发产生极化激元凝聚体，通过改变激发功率调控极化激元蓝移，从而驱动凝聚体从狄拉克带隙进入漏泄带，实现模式与拓扑电荷的切换。

papers.title: Information geometry of non-equilibrium quantum states: Mixed metric structures on an extended information manifold
papers.abstract: We discuss an information-geometric framework for characterizing quantum states in non-equilibrium dynamics. Using the transverse-field Ising chain model as a laboratory, we investigate the quantum Fisher information metric with particular emphasis on the mixed metric component $g_{ht}$ and related geometric observables, where $h$ is a controllable post-quench Hamiltonian parameter and $t$ is real time. The framework treats $h$ and $t$ as coordinates of an extended information manifold $(h,t)$. The geometric observables characterize the speed of evolution on the manifold and the alignment between the temporal and parameter-deformation directions. Correlations between these geometric quantities and two widely used measures of non-equilibrium dynamics, the entanglement entropy and the Loschmidt echo, are analyzed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“framework”“model”“investigate”等理论建模词汇，并以横场伊辛链模型为“laboratory”进行数值/解析研究，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：非平衡量子态的信息几何性质，具体以横场伊辛链（transverse-field Ising chain）模型为研究对象，关注其淬火后非平衡动力学过程中的量子几何结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将后淬火哈密顿参数h和实时t作为扩展信息流形(h,t)的坐标，建立了非平衡量子态的混合度规分量g_ht及相关几何可观测量，并发现这些几何量与纠缠熵和Loschmidt回声之间存在关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将后淬火哈密顿参数h和实时t作为扩展信息流形(h,t)的坐标，建立了非平衡量子态的混合度规分量g_ht及相关几何可观测量，并发现这些几何量与纠缠熵和Loschmidt回声之间存在关联。；创新点：将信息几何方法从平衡态推广到非平衡动力学，通过引入“混合度规分量”g_ht将参数方向与时间方向统一到同一信息流形上，并建立了几何可观测量与常用非平衡度量（纠缠熵、Loschmidt回声）之间的关联。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 信息几何框架：利用量子Fisher信息度规，重点分析混合度规分量g_ht；以横场伊辛链模型为具体计算平台，研究h和t构成的扩展信息流形上的几何量，并与纠缠熵和Loschmidt回声进行相关性分析。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如精确对角化、张量网络等）。

papers.title: Thermal screening and critical scaling of quantum energy teleportation in a harmonic chain
papers.abstract: We develop a finite-temperature Gaussian-state formulation of quantum energy teleportation in the one-dimensional harmonic chain. For Gibbs states, the optimized measurement-feedback protocol reduces to thermal two-point functions. In the single-site protocol, the extracted energy is governed by a single correlator, which makes the thermodynamic and near-critical limits analytically tractable. At fixed finite temperature, the extracted energy is exponentially screened with distance and is controlled by a thermal correlation length for both critical and non-critical $α$. In the zero-temperature critical limit taken after the thermodynamic limit, we derive the exact asymptotic law $E_{\mathrm{ext}}\sim d^{-4}$. Numerical results confirm both regimes and resolve the crossover responsible for the apparent drift of the effective decay exponent at intermediate distances. We also analyze squeezed Gaussian measurements and show that they modify the extraction prefactor: $p-$squeezing enhances the extracted energy, whereas $q-$squeezing suppresses it, without changing the large-distance scaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：finite-temperature Gaussian-state formulation、analytically tractable、derive exact asymptotic law。；研究对象：一维谐振子链（harmonic chain）中的量子能量隐形传态（quantum energy teleportation），具体关注热平衡（Gibbs态）及近临界极限下的能量提取行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在固定有限温度下，提取能量随距离呈指数衰减，由热关联长度控制（对临界和非临界参数α均成立）；在热力学极限后取零温临界极限时，提取能量满足精确渐近律 E_ext ~ d^(-4)。此外，压缩高斯测量可改变提取能量的前因子（p-压缩增强、q-压缩抑制），但不改变大距离标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在固定有限温度下，提取能量随距离呈指数衰减，由热关联长度控制（对临界和非临界参数α均成立）；在热力学极限后取零温临界极限时，提取能量满足精确渐近律 E_ext ~ d^(-4)。此外，压缩高斯测量可改变提取能量的前因子（p-压缩增强、q-压缩抑制），但不改变大距离标度行为。；创新点：首次在有限温度下对一维谐振子链的量子能量隐形传态给出解析可处理的高斯态描述，精确推导出零温临界极限下的 d^(-4) 渐近律，并揭示了中间距离处有效衰减指数表观漂移的交叉机制；同时系统分析了压缩高斯测量对提取能量的调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为有限温度高斯态形式化（finite-temperature Gaussian-state formulation），将优化测量-反馈协议约化为热两点关联函数；对单点协议解析求解热力学极限与近临界极限，并用数值计算验证标度行为及交叉区域。

papers.title: Synchronization Pathways and Resilience in Power Grids
papers.abstract: Ensuring a sustainable energy supply requires maintaining power-grid stability. Rotor dynamics are governed by the swing equation, which takes the form of a second-order Kuramoto model with a correlation between power and total coupling strength. Yet the microscopic mechanisms that nucleate and propagate synchronized clusters remain poorly understood. Using a minimal model motivated by empirical grid data and the \Adhoc potential method, we reveal two distinct seed cluster types and propagation pathways: a population-driven seed cluster at the center of the power distribution propagating to its tails by rotor accretion, and, for a symmetric distribution, coupling-driven seed clusters at its tails propagating inward to the center by cluster merger.
