These differences generate distinct order-parameter patterns, while inertia controls whether the seed clusters persist with distinct angular velocities. The same propagation pathways also govern recovery following external disturbances. We further confirm that the same selection--persistence rule holds in data-derived annealed representations of European power grids. Therefore, our results can inform strategies for sustaining stable power-grid operation. More generally, our pathway-based framework reframes synchronization by emphasizing the dynamics of cluster formation and recovery rather than relying solely on static criteria.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“最小模型”“Adhoc potential method”“数据推导的退火表示”等理论建模与数据分析方法，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：电力网络的同步动力学，具体为电网中转子动力学（由摆动方程描述）所支配的同步团簇成核与传播机制，以及外部扰动后的恢复过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了两种不同的种子团簇类型及其传播路径：由功率分布中心的人口驱动种子团簇通过转子增积向尾部传播，以及（对对称分布）由耦合驱动的尾部种子团簇通过团簇合并向中心传播；惯性决定种子团簇是否以不同角速度持续存在，且相同路径也支配扰动后的恢复。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了两种不同的种子团簇类型及其传播路径：由功率分布中心的人口驱动种子团簇通过转子增积向尾部传播，以及（对对称分布）由耦合驱动的尾部种子团簇通过团簇合并向中心传播；惯性决定种子团簇是否以不同角速度持续存在，且相同路径也支配扰动后的恢复。；创新点：提出了基于路径的同步框架，强调团簇形成与恢复的动力学过程，而非仅依赖静态判据；并首次区分了人口驱动与耦合驱动两种种子团簇类型及其不同的传播路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用受经验电网数据启发的极小模型，结合Adhoc势方法（Adhoc potential method）分析同步团簇的成核与传播；并在欧洲电网的数据推导退火表示（annealed representations）中验证了“选择—持续”规则。

papers.title: Spatio-temporal coherent molding and retrieval of pulsed signals in optical waveguides
papers.abstract: Optical waveguides are key elements for high fidelity, long distance optical communications. Coupled waveguide arrays allow for higher information density, steerting the propagation direction, and for encoding information. However, due to the mixing of relative phases for short pulses containing multiple waveguide-mode frequencies, a process for retrieving an encoded input state once these signals undergo coherent propagation remains elusive. A concept is presented to extract with high fidelity the phase-encrypted input signal from spatio-temporal propagated states. As a realization, an array of coupled waveguides is suggested with the retrieval mechanism being realized by local phase shifts that comply with the identified retrieval concept. Three dimensional full-wave electromagnetic simulations for broadband optical signals in coupled dielectric waveguides confirm the validity of the scheme and the high fidelity of information retrieval pointing to potential applications, for instance in ultrafast coherent coding and decoding of information imprinted on pulse sequences.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要提出“概念”（concept）和“检索机制”（retrieval mechanism），并通过“三维全波电磁模拟”（three-dimensional full-wave electromagnetic simulations）验证，未提及实验实现。；研究对象：耦合波导阵列（coupled waveguide arrays）中宽带光脉冲的时空相干传播与相位编码信息检索。具体物理现象为短脉冲（含多个波导模式频率）在耦合波导中传播时相对相位混合后的信息提取问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种能从时空传播态中高保真提取相位加密输入信号的方案，并通过三维全波电磁模拟证实了该方案的有效性和信息检索的高保真度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种能从时空传播态中高保真提取相位加密输入信号的方案，并通过三维全波电磁模拟证实了该方案的有效性和信息检索的高保真度。；创新点：首次提出针对短脉冲（多频率分量）在耦合波导中相干传播后相位混合问题的输入态检索方案，实现了相位加密信号的时空相干“塑形”与高保真提取，潜在应用于超快相干编码/解码。摘要未突出说明与已有方案的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论概念分析与三维全波电磁模拟（three-dimensional full-wave electromagnetic simulations）。具体为在耦合介质波导阵列中，通过施加满足检索概念的局域相位移动（local phase shifts）来实现信号提取。

papers.title: Superconducting Flux Memory for Cryogenic Applications
papers.abstract: We report the development of flux memory for use with superconducting circuits. This technology stores persistent currents in superconducting loops on-chip to be used to provide flux biasing for superconducting circuits, like qubits. We developed three types of flux memory and draw comparisons among them for circuit design. We demonstrate the utility of flux memory by using an in-situ flux detector and characterize each approach and further demonstrate that once flux is set in a memory cell, benchtop DC control sources can be powered off, leaving the on-chip flux bias in place. We propose that flux memory can be arranged in a two-dimensional configuration to multiplex control signals and reduce how line counts scale (N^2 devices -> 2N control lines), and our experimental results pave the path to the proposed scalability. We demonstrate the use of flux memory to flux bias a transmon qubit and show the tunability of the qubit state to a target frequency which remained stable on-chip for 20 hours.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We report the development”“We developed”“We demonstrate”“experimental results”等表述，明确为实验工作。；研究对象：超导电路中的片上通量存储器（flux memory），用于为超导量子比特等电路提供磁通偏置。具体体系为超导环路中存储的持续电流，以及与之集成的transmon量子比特。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了三种类型的超导通量存储器，并证明在通量设定后，可关闭台式直流控制源，片上磁通偏置仍保持稳定；进一步展示了通量存储器对transmon量子比特的磁通偏置能力，量子比特状态在片上稳定达20小时。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了三种类型的超导通量存储器，并证明在通量设定后，可关闭台式直流控制源，片上磁通偏置仍保持稳定；进一步展示了通量存储器对transmon量子比特的磁通偏置能力，量子比特状态在片上稳定达20小时。；创新点：提出通量存储器可按二维阵列排布，将控制线数量从N²个器件缩减为2N条控制线，实现控制信号的多路复用，为大规模超导电路的可扩展控制提供了实验路径。摘要未突出说明与已有通量存储方案相比的其他具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：在超导芯片上制备通量存储器（三种类型对比），使用原位通量探测器（in-situ flux detector）表征各方案的性能；通过关闭直流控制源验证非易失性；将通量存储器与transmon量子比特集成，测量其频率可调性及长期稳定性。摘要未明确提及具体材料体系（如铝、铌等）或制备工艺细节。

papers.title: Efficiently classifying shocks in complex systems requires dormant reporters
papers.abstract: Many natural and engineered systems are large complex networks of interacting components, and external perturbations drive them along different dynamical paths. Identifying which perturbation occurred matters for diagnosis, control, and prediction. Yet often times only a few components can be jointly monitored. Which components should be monitored? Experimental practice usually favors placing reporters at the most sensitive sites, where perturbations produce the largest effects. Using a simple dynamical model for complex systems with heterogeneous connectivity, we ask how sparse reporter panels should be chosen to classify shocks from partial trajectories when repeated trials only approximately reproduce an ideal initial condition. Once that reproduction is imperfect, sensitivity ranked panels fall far short of optimal, and the shortfall grows with the noise. We find that the best panels mix two kinds of reporters. A promiscuous reporter responds to most shocks, so it separates them mainly by degree, and degree fluctuates from trial to trial. A dormant reporter responds to only a few shocks but strongly, and its answers do not scatter as much between trials. As noise grows, the cost of losing a dormant reporter rises to meet the cost of losing a promiscuous one. Panels of either kind alone classify worse than the mixture, and no property of the members collected individually explains the ordering. Most of all, we find that only a minuscule number of reporters are needed on a panel to accurately identify which shock hit the system. We implement an efficient algorithm to assemble such a panel. Together these results provide a low cost practical design principle for monitoring large complex dynamical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“使用简单动力学模型”“实现高效算法”，属于建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：大型复杂网络（复杂系统）中的外部扰动（冲击）分类问题，具体关注在仅能监测少量节点（报告器）时，如何选择监测节点以从部分轨迹中识别冲击类型。属于复杂系统动力学与网络科学范畴，非传统凝聚态材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当初始条件在重复试验中无法精确复现（存在噪声）时，按灵敏度排序的报告器面板远非最优，且性能差距随噪声增大而扩大；最优面板需混合“广谱型”与“休眠型”两类报告器，且仅需极少量报告器即可准确分类冲击。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当初始条件在重复试验中无法精确复现（存在噪声）时，按灵敏度排序的报告器面板远非最优，且性能差距随噪声增大而扩大；最优面板需混合“广谱型”与“休眠型”两类报告器，且仅需极少量报告器即可准确分类冲击。；创新点：揭示了在噪声存在下，传统“最灵敏优先”的监测节点选择策略失效，并提出“休眠报告器”（对少数冲击强响应、试验间波动小）与“广谱报告器”混合的最优面板设计原则；同时发现所需报告器数量极小，并给出高效组装算法。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体算法名称，但提及“简单动力学模型”“异质连接性”“稀疏报告器面板”“高效算法”。未给出如DFT、DMRG等具体凝聚态计算方法，属于一般性动力学建模与数值优化。

papers.title: Separating perception from reasoning in vision-language models: a model-free render ceiling for crystal structures
papers.abstract: Multimodal evaluations cannot say whether a vision-language model misread an image or misreasoned about it, because every existing method for separating the two places a second model in the loop. We introduce the render ceiling, a model-free reference for benchmarks built by rendering known objects: inverting the frozen cameras and re-solving cross-view correspondence recovers exactly the answer the images support. We prove the ceiling fails only through an enumerable set of projection coincidences and certify that set empty on 2,160 rendered crystal structures, so every point of a model's deficit belongs to the model. Across fourteen vision-language models, supplying exact geometry as text lifts every model yet closes under half the gap for thirteen, while a supervised vision model with no language component reads the same images at 0.8952, above every vision-language model. The instrument exposes extraction-stage fabrication that downstream accuracy would misattribute to reasoning, yields camera-placement rules for benchmark builders, and transfers to any benchmark with an invertible forward rendering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（涉及模型评估、基准测试构建与理论证明，属于计算/理论分析，非传统凝聚态实验）。判断依据关键词：model-free reference、prove、certify、rendered crystal structures。；研究对象：视觉-语言模型（VLMs）对晶体结构图像的感知与推理能力，以及图像渲染基准测试的可靠性。物理体系为2,160个渲染的晶体结构图像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“渲染天花板”（render ceiling）作为无模型参考基准，可严格区分模型对晶体结构图像的“感知错误”与“推理错误”。实验表明，即使提供精确几何文本，十三个视觉-语言模型仍有一半以上的性能缺口无法闭合，而一个无语言组件的监督视觉模型（准确率0.8952）超过所有视觉-语言模型，说明多数缺陷源于感知阶段而非推理阶段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“渲染天花板”（render ceiling）作为无模型参考基准，可严格区分模型对晶体结构图像的“感知错误”与“推理错误”。实验表明，即使提供精确几何文本，十三个视觉-语言模型仍有一半以上的性能缺口无法闭合，而一个无语言组件的监督视觉模型（准确率0.8952）超过所有视觉-语言模型，说明多数缺陷源于感知阶段而非推理阶段。；创新点：首次提出无需第二模型介入的“渲染天花板”方法，严格分离感知与推理误差；证明该天花板在晶体结构渲染上可认证为空集，从而将模型性能缺口完全归因于模型自身。该方法可迁移至任何具有可逆前向渲染的基准测试，并为基准构建者提供相机放置规则。摘要未突出说明与传统凝聚态物理实验或计算方法（如DFT、ARPES等）的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 1）理论证明：通过反转固定相机并重新求解跨视角对应关系，恢复图像所支持的精确答案；证明天花板仅在可枚举的投影巧合集合下失效，并在2,160个渲染晶体结构上验证该集合为空。2）基准测试：对十四个视觉-语言模型进行系统评估，对比“仅图像”与“图像+精确几何文本”两种输入条件下的表现。3）对照实验：使用无语言组件的监督视觉模型（准确率0.8952）作为感知能力基线。

papers.title: Mudskippers use tail thrusting to help crutching to move on mud of various wetness
papers.abstract: At the water-land interface, amphibious fishes encounter wet flowable substrates made of granular solid-water mixtures, which can stay solid or flow like a fluid. As these substrates become wetter or drier, their yield strength (at which solid-fluid transition occurs) and cohesion (how sticky they are) both change, challenging locomotion. Despite substantial understanding of tetrapod locomotion on flowable substrates (mostly dry sand), we know little about how amphibious fishes cope with wet flowable substrates of various wetness. Here, we studied mudskippers on clay mud of controlled, variable wetness over the range where solid-fluid transition occurs. As mud became wetter, its strength decreased by 100-fold, leading the animal to sink deeper, with larger areas of body and fins contacting mud. By contrast, mud stuck most easily at intermediate wetness. The increased sinkage and contact and stickiness change caused more mud to stick to and pull against the animal on wetter mud. We also tested dry mud, which stuck to animal fins as its mucus dried. Despite these challenges, the mudskipper predominately used a conserved crutching gait on all except the wettest mud tested, with a modest performance reduction. When normal crutching became less effective, the animal assisted it with tail thrusting, by bending and straightening it to push downward and backward to generate additional thrust and lift, or even thrusting the tail to jump. These observations suggest that mudskipper's crutching motor program is well adapted to its native muddy substrates but inflexible, with most novelty in tail use.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了“we studied mudskippers on clay mud of controlled, variable wetness”，涉及对动物行为的直接观测和基质力学性质的测量。；研究对象：弹涂鱼（mudskipper）在湿度可变的湿黏土泥浆（clay mud）上的运动行为，具体关注其“拐杖式”步态（crutching gait）与尾部推进（tail thrusting）的协同机制，以及泥浆湿度对基质屈服强度、黏附性和动物沉陷深度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弹涂鱼在除最湿泥浆外的所有湿度条件下均保持保守的拐杖式步态，仅性能略有下降；当常规步态效率降低时，鱼通过弯曲和伸直尾部向下后方推进产生额外推力和升力，甚至用尾部跳跃，表明其拐杖式运动程序对原生泥质基质适应良好但缺乏灵活性，新颖性主要体现在尾部使用上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弹涂鱼在除最湿泥浆外的所有湿度条件下均保持保守的拐杖式步态，仅性能略有下降；当常规步态效率降低时，鱼通过弯曲和伸直尾部向下后方推进产生额外推力和升力，甚至用尾部跳跃，表明其拐杖式运动程序对原生泥质基质适应良好但缺乏灵活性，新颖性主要体现在尾部使用上。；创新点：首次系统研究两栖鱼类在湿度可变的湿颗粒状基质（而非干沙）上的运动应对策略，揭示了尾部推进作为辅助机制在步态失效时的补偿作用，并指出该运动程序对基质变化的适应性局限。摘要未突出说明与已有干沙基质上四足动物运动研究的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验控制黏土泥浆的湿度（覆盖固-液转变区间），测量泥浆的屈服强度（随湿度增加下降100倍）和黏附性（中间湿度最易黏附），同时观测动物沉陷深度、身体与鳍的接触面积、泥浆黏附量，并记录运动步态和尾部动作。

papers.title: Importance and methods to control, vary, and characterize mud strength for studying locomotion
papers.abstract: Animals and robots encounter mud at the water-land interface. Like sand, mud can stay solid or flow like a fluid. Unlike sand, the yield strength of mud at which solid-fluid transitions occur depends on not only the amount of solid relative to fluid (water in mud, air in dry sand), but also how much coarse grains and fine clay are within the solid. Despite understanding of locomotion on/within dry sand dominated by coarse grains with repulsive normal forces and friction, little is known for mud dominated by fine clay with strong cohesion. Here, we developed methods to prepare uniform mud of controlled, variable yield strength and characterize and track its drift from water evaporation. Compared to other flowable substrates, mud strength measured by upward force during penetration is weaker and can vary more, and mud sticks more during extraction to pull downward, making it more challenging for locomotion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“developed methods to prepare”“characterize and track”等实验操作关键词。；研究对象：水-陆交界处泥浆（mud）的力学性质，特别是其屈服强度（yield strength）及其对动物和机器人运动（locomotion）的影响。研究对象为细黏土（fine clay）主导的泥浆体系，与粗颗粒干沙形成对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 泥浆的屈服强度不仅取决于固/液比例，还受粗颗粒与细黏土含量影响；与干沙相比，泥浆在穿透时测得的强度更弱且变化更大，且在拔出时因黏附产生向下拉力，使运动更加困难。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：泥浆的屈服强度不仅取决于固/液比例，还受粗颗粒与细黏土含量影响；与干沙相比，泥浆在穿透时测得的强度更弱且变化更大，且在拔出时因黏附产生向下拉力，使运动更加困难。；创新点：首次系统研究了细黏土主导、具有强内聚力的泥浆作为运动介质的力学特性，并开发了可控屈服强度的泥浆制备与表征方法，填补了与干沙运动研究相比对泥浆运动认知的空白。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体仪器或表征手段，但提及了：制备均匀泥浆的方法、控制并改变屈服强度的方法、通过向上力（upward force）测量穿透强度、以及追踪水分蒸发引起的漂移（drift）的方法。具体设备名称摘要未给出。

papers.title: Strong suppression of the photonic density of states in three-dimensional disordered silicon networks
papers.abstract: Photonic bandgaps can open not only in crystalline dielectric materials but also in amorphous structures. Self-uniform amorphous gyroid networks have been proposed as promising disordered photonic architectures. Motivated by numerical studies, we combine direct laser-writing lithography with advanced materials processing to fabricate these structures from high-refractive-index silicon. Spectroscopic measurements at mid-infrared wavelengths reveal pronounced transmission minima. To investigate the formation of photonic band gaps in amorphous structures, we develop polarization-resolved transmission spectroscopy that separates ballistic and multiply scattered contributions, enabling direct identification of the underlying transport regimes. We observe a strong suppression of diffuse transmission, providing direct experimental evidence for a breakdown of conventional diffuse transport associated with a strongly reduced photonic density of states. Together with large-scale numerical simulations, our results establish the presence of a deep photonic pseudogap in an amorphous three-dimensional dielectric material and open new opportunities for observing disorder-induced localization phenomena, including Anderson localization of light.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“direct laser-writing lithography”“Spectroscopic measurements”“polarization-resolved transmission spectroscopy”等实验手段，同时包含“large-scale numerical simulations”。；研究对象：三维无序硅网络（self-uniform amorphous gyroid networks），具体为高折射率硅制成的无序光子结构，研究其光子态密度及光子赝隙（photonic pseudogap）的形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维无序硅网络中观察到漫散射传输的强烈抑制，直接实验证明了与光子态密度强烈降低相关的常规扩散输运的失效，确立了非晶三维介电材料中存在深光子赝隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维无序硅网络中观察到漫散射传输的强烈抑制，直接实验证明了与光子态密度强烈降低相关的常规扩散输运的失效，确立了非晶三维介电材料中存在深光子赝隙。；创新点：首次通过实验直接证明三维无序介电材料中存在深光子赝隙，并利用偏振分辨光谱将弹道与漫散射贡献分离，为观测光子的安德森局域化等无序诱导局域现象开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用双光子直接激光写入光刻结合先进材料处理工艺制备高折射率硅无序陀螺网络；利用中红外波段的偏振分辨透射光谱，将弹道与多次散射贡献分离，以识别输运机制。数值上采用大规模模拟（摘要未明确说明具体方法，如FDTD或TMM）。

papers.title: Mixture of Polyconvex Neural Potentials for Parametric Hyperelasticity: Towards Foundation Material Models
papers.abstract: Hyperelastic constitutive models enable modeling large deformations in elastic solids. In common practice, a strain energy density function is prescribed in advance and model-specific parameters are calibrated from experiments. However, many applications require constitutive models for a family of related materials whose mechanical behavior varies with composition. A fixed constitutive model-form may not capture the full range of behavior across the family, while fitting separate forms does not provide a direct way to predict the response of new compositions. Recent work has developed data-driven constitutive models that learn flexible strain energy functions while incorporating key physical constraints. In this work, we propose using mixtures of convex neural potentials based on input convex neural networks as a modular and data efficient approach to modeling material families. Each potential is convex and monotonic with respect to polyconvex strain invariants, while a conditioning network maps material descriptors to mixture weights. We compare the approach with a monolithic partially input-convex neural network using experimental data from PolyJet 3D-printed materials and a synthetic Gent-type benchmark. Across both benchmarks, the mixture architecture generalized better to material descriptors not seen during training. In the PolyJet experimental benchmark, we showed that the mixture architecture is less sensitive to model hyperparameters, while in the Gent-type benchmark it generalized more reliably with sparse data in the material-descriptor space. These results suggest that representing a material family through a small set of shared convex neural potentials provides a useful structural prior for learning descriptor-dependent constitutive behavior from limited data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“data-driven constitutive models”“input convex neural networks”“synthetic benchmark”等，核心为机器学习模型构建与数值验证，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：超弹性材料家族（material families），具体包括PolyJet 3D打印材料（实验数据）和合成Gent型超弹性材料。物理现象为有限变形下的弹性响应，重点研究材料力学行为随材料描述符（composition/descriptor）的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出用多个凸神经势的混合（mixture of convex neural potentials）来建模材料家族，相比单一的部分输入凸神经网络（monolithic partially input-convex NN），该混合架构在训练中未见过的材料描述符上具有更好的泛化能力，且对超参数更不敏感、在稀疏数据下更可靠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出用多个凸神经势的混合（mixture of convex neural potentials）来建模材料家族，相比单一的部分输入凸神经网络（monolithic partially input-convex NN），该混合架构在训练中未见过的材料描述符上具有更好的泛化能力，且对超参数更不敏感、在稀疏数据下更可靠。；创新点：将“多个共享凸神经势的混合”作为材料家族的结构先验（structural prior），以模块化、数据高效的方式学习依赖描述符的本构行为，从而在有限数据下实现对未见成分的预测。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于输入凸神经网络（ICNN）构建多个凸势函数，每个势对多凸应变不变量（polyconvex strain invariants）满足凸性和单调性；另设一个条件网络（conditioning network）将材料描述符映射为混合权重。在PolyJet实验数据和合成Gent型基准上，与单一PICNN模型进行对比评估。

papers.title: Ghost-free higher-gradient Newtonian gravity from the Second Law of Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: Higher-gradient modifications of Newtonian gravity remove the point-mass singularity, but their Lagrangian dynamics is haunted by the Ostrogradsky instability. We show that the same field equations follow from the Second Law of thermodynamics applied to a self-gravitating fluid with a weakly nonlocal state space, and that on this route the instability is absent by construction: the potential obeys a first-order relaxation equation that is a gradient flow, whose Lyapunov function is the entropy density, and whose relaxation spectrum is negative definite at every wavenumber precisely when the entropy is concave. The derivation also yields the pressure tensor and the energy current, an exact identity that reproduces Newton's force law without further input, and a dissipation-free cross-coupling to the bulk viscous pressure that no variational principle can produce. Regularity constrains the Yukawa-type corrections by an amplitude sum rule, $\sum_iα_i=-1$, so that laboratory tests of the inverse-square law bound the largest internal length below $4\times10^{-5}$~m, and identify the complex-root regime as a classically consistent Lee--Wick-like sector.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Second Law of Thermodynamics、field equations、gradient flow、variational principle。；研究对象：高阶梯度修正的牛顿引力（higher-gradient Newtonian gravity），具体为自引力流体（self-gravitating fluid）在弱非局域态空间（weakly nonlocal state space）中的引力势动力学，以及点质量奇点（point-mass singularity）的消除与Ostrogradsky不稳定性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从热力学第二定律出发可导出与高阶梯度牛顿引力相同的场方程，且该路径上Ostrogradsky不稳定性天然不存在：引力势满足一阶弛豫方程（梯度流），其李雅普诺夫函数为熵密度，当熵为凹函数时弛豫谱在所有波数上负定。此外，正则性要求Yukawa型修正满足振幅求和规则∑ᵢαᵢ=−1，从而实验室平方反比律检验将最大内部长度限制在4×10⁻⁵ m以下。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从热力学第二定律出发可导出与高阶梯度牛顿引力相同的场方程，且该路径上Ostrogradsky不稳定性天然不存在：引力势满足一阶弛豫方程（梯度流），其李雅普诺夫函数为熵密度，当熵为凹函数时弛豫谱在所有波数上负定。此外，正则性要求Yukawa型修正满足振幅求和规则∑ᵢαᵢ=−1，从而实验室平方反比律检验将最大内部长度限制在4×10⁻⁵ m以下。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但可看出：首次从热力学第二定律而非变分原理出发构造高阶梯度引力理论，从而绕开Ostrogradsky不稳定性；并给出了变分原理无法产生的无耗散体粘滞交叉耦合项）。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：将热力学第二定律应用于具有弱非局域态空间的自引力流体，推导出引力势的一阶弛豫方程（梯度流形式），并利用李雅普诺夫函数（熵密度）分析稳定性；同时推导出压力张量、能量流以及无耗散的体粘滞压力交叉耦合项；通过振幅求和规则约束Yukawa型修正参数。

papers.title: Smoothed truncated Coulomb potential for periodic Gaussian-basis Hartree--Fock exchange
papers.abstract: Truncated Coulomb (TC) potentials reduce finite-size errors and accelerate thermodynamic-limit convergence in periodic Hartree--Fock (HF) calculations, but their use with Gaussian basis sets is complicated by the evaluation of electron repulsion integrals (ERIs), particularly for nonspherical truncation domains and all-electron calculations. We introduce the smoothed truncated Coulomb (sTC) potential as a systematically improvable approximation to a parent TC potential. A real-space Gaussian convolution smooths the sharp truncation boundary, and a single dimensionless parameter, $η$, controls the width of the smoothing window, which can be tightened to systematically approach the TC reference. The smoothing by sTC enables a dual-space algorithm for evaluating periodic Gaussian-basis ERIs that requires neither a large plane-wave basis nor new molecular integral kernels and is applicable to both pseudopotential and all-electron calculations, including the important Wigner--Seitz-cell truncation boundaries. Benchmarks spanning insulating, semiconducting, layered, metallic, and molecular-crystal systems show that sTC-based HF closely reproduces TC results in pseudopotential calculations and extends TC-quality calculations to all-electron settings. Across these systems, sTC substantially improves thermodynamic-limit convergence relative to the probe-charge Ewald method while remaining practical for all-electron calculations in which direct TC-based calculations are computationally challenging.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“periodic Hartree–Fock calculations”“Gaussian basis sets”“electron repulsion integrals”等计算方法与理论推导关键词。；研究对象：周期性体系中的Hartree–Fock交换相互作用，具体涵盖绝缘体、半导体、层状材料、金属和分子晶体等多种凝聚态体系，重点研究截断库仑势在周期性高斯基组计算中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种平滑截断库仑（sTC）势，作为传统截断库仑（TC）势的系统可改进近似，能够在保持TC势热力学极限收敛优势的同时，扩展到全电子计算领域，并显著改善相对于探针电荷Ewald方法的热力学极限收敛速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种平滑截断库仑（sTC）势，作为传统截断库仑（TC）势的系统可改进近似，能够在保持TC势热力学极限收敛优势的同时，扩展到全电子计算领域，并显著改善相对于探针电荷Ewald方法的热力学极限收敛速度。；创新点：首次将平滑化处理引入截断库仑势，使得非球形截断域（特别是Wigner–Seitz胞截断边界）下的周期性高斯基组ERIs计算变得可行，并首次将TC质量的Hartree–Fock计算推广到全电子体系，而此前TC方法在全电子计算中面临计算困难。
papers.method_zh: 采用实空间高斯卷积对截断边界进行平滑处理，引入单一无量纲参数η控制平滑窗口宽度；开发了双空间算法用于周期性高斯基组电子排斥积分（ERIs）的评估，无需大平面波基组或新的分子积分内核，适用于赝势和全电子计算。

papers.title: Higher anomalies, compressing SPTs and cohomology operations
papers.abstract: We explicitly compute and tabulate the suspension map for cohomology operations, applying it to the dimensional reduction of anomalies and higher group structures of generalised symmetries in quantum field theories and lattice systems. In a quantum system with a discrete $p$-form symmetry, we can restrict the symmetry defects to a codimension-$q$ subspace of spacetime, or equivalently confine the gauge field to a slab whose thickness approaches zero. This results in a $(p-q)$-form symmetry on the subspace. We determine the fate of two important properties of symmetries under this process. First, we compute the anomaly of the reduced symmetry, or the higher anomaly of the original symmetry, which acts as an obstruction to higher gauging and onsiteability. Second, for two symmetries forming a higher-group structure, encoded as a Postnikov class, we compute the reduced higher-group structure, which may or may not be trivial. Both cases are captured by the $q$-fold iteration of the cohomology suspension $Ω$, also known as the loop functor or transgression, in the cohomology of Eilenberg--MacLane spaces. Classical results state that $Ω$ is an isomorphism in a stable range and annihilates mixed anomalies. To calculate $Ω$ over a base ring which is not a field, we make use of small models for the chain DGAs of Eilenberg--MacLane spaces, pioneered by Cartan and Moore, whose results we review and extend. The critical added step is the improvement of a mod $p$ chain contraction to the $p$-local integers, obtained via a $p$-adic series. We automate the computations in a software package \texttt{emcm}, and provide extensive tables of the results. Finally, to make contact with explicit cochain formulations of cohomology operations, we demonstrate how to calculate cup products and certain cup-$i$ products in this framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：cohomology operations、dimensional reduction、quantum field theories and lattice systems、theoretical framework。；研究对象：量子场论和格点系统中广义对称性的高异常（higher anomalies）与高群结构（higher-group structures），特别是离散 p-形式对称性在维度约化（dimensional reduction）下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过显式计算并列表化上同调中的 suspension map（Ω，即 loop functor / transgression），确定了对称性缺陷限制到余维数为 q 的子空间后，约化对称性的异常（即原对称性的高异常）以及约化后的高群结构（Postnikov 类）如何变化；两者均由 Ω 的 q 次迭代捕获。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过显式计算并列表化上同调中的 suspension map（Ω，即 loop functor / transgression），确定了对称性缺陷限制到余维数为 q 的子空间后，约化对称性的异常（即原对称性的高异常）以及约化后的高群结构（Postnikov 类）如何变化；两者均由 Ω 的 q 次迭代捕获。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用 Eilenberg--MacLane 空间链 DGAs 的小模型（Cartan 和 Moore 开创），将 mod p 链收缩改进为 p-局部整数上的收缩（通过 p-adic 级数实现），并自动化计算于软件包 \texttt{emcm} 中，提供大量结果表格；同时演示了在该框架下计算 cup 积和某些 cup-i 积的方法。

papers.title: Exploring thermal order in conformal theories with multiple scalars coupled to an $O(N)$ vector field
papers.abstract: We study thermal order in conformal field theories (CFTs) in $d=4-ε$ and $d=3$ dimensions where several scalars are coupled to an $O(N)$ vector field. In $(4-ε)$ dimensions, we consider models coupling a cubic model of $M$ scalars with $\mathbb{Z}_2^M\rtimes S_M$ symmetry (corresponding to sign flips and permutations of the scalars) to an $O(N)$ vector model. For any $M$, we find a window of $N$ in which two Wilson-Fisher-like fixed points exist. We show that the $\mathbb{Z}_2^M\rtimes S_M$ symmetry is spontaneously broken at arbitrary nonzero temperatures for $M=2$ and sufficiently large $N$ within this window, but it remains unbroken for $M>2$. Using the functional renormalisation group to continue these fixed points towards three dimensions, we find that they collide and move into the complex plane well before reaching $d=3$, suggesting that their continuation to $d=3$ does not yield unitary CFTs. We then work directly in three dimensions at large but finite $N$, with $M\ll N$, initially without assuming any permutation symmetry among the $M$ scalars. By studying the RG flow, we show that these models possess a conformal manifold up to the leading nontrivial order in the $1/N$ expansion of the beta functions (which is $\mathcal{O}(1/N)$). At each point on this manifold, the scalars split into two classes that are distinguished by how they couple to the $O(N)$ vector field. We then restrict to a subspace of the conformal manifold where there is an additional symmetry under permutations of the scalars within each class. We prove that in a domain of this subspace, all $M$ scalars acquire thermal expectation values such that the symmetry under sign flips of the scalars is spontaneously broken at all nonzero temperatures. This provides a novel class of large $N$ CFTs that exhibit a rich pattern of persistent symmetry breaking at nonzero temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：conformal field theories、functional renormalisation group、RG flow、1/N expansion、fixed points。；研究对象：共形场论（CFT）中的热序（thermal order）现象，具体为多个标量场与一个O(N)矢量场耦合的模型，在d=4-ε和d=3维度下的热力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在d=4-ε中，对任意M存在一个N的窗口，其中存在两个Wilson-Fisher型不动点；M=2且N足够大时，Z₂^M⋊S_M对称性在任意非零温度下自发破缺，而M>2时保持不破缺。在d=3大N极限下，这些模型存在共形流形，且在该流形的某个子空间中，所有M个标量在任意非零温度下获得热期望值，导致标量符号翻转对称性在所有非零温度下自发破缺。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在d=4-ε中，对任意M存在一个N的窗口，其中存在两个Wilson-Fisher型不动点；M=2且N足够大时，Z₂^M⋊S_M对称性在任意非零温度下自发破缺，而M>2时保持不破缺。在d=3大N极限下，这些模型存在共形流形，且在该流形的某个子空间中，所有M个标量在任意非零温度下获得热期望值，导致标量符号翻转对称性在所有非零温度下自发破缺。；创新点：发现了一类新的大N共形场论，在非零温度下展现出丰富的持续对称性破缺模式（persistent symmetry breaking），且该破缺模式依赖于标量场数量M的奇偶性（M=2 vs M>2），并揭示了d=4-ε中的不动点在延拓至d=3前即碰撞并进入复平面，暗示其三维延拓不产生幺正CFT。
papers.method_zh: 采用ε展开（d=4-ε）分析不动点结构；使用泛函重整化群（functional renormalisation group）将不动点延拓至三维；在d=3直接采用大N但有限N（M≪N）的1/N展开，通过β函数的RG流分析共形流形结构。

papers.title: Guiding center quantization of a quantum Hall analog of Hawking radiation
papers.abstract: We revisit the quantum Hall analog of Hawking radiation in which a Fermi sea of electrons occupying half of a plane, subjected to a quadrupolar electric potential, gives rise to analog Hawking radiation of chiral edge modes. We show that the phenomenon is accurately captured by quantization of the classical guiding center theory, where the gyroscopic motion of the electrons is coarse grained and only the drift motion is resolved. The quantum dynamics takes place on a non-commutative plane, which requires an electron localized in the half-plane to be supported everywhere along the edge direction. This kinematical constraint on the quantum state leads directly to the radiation, which propagates in both directions away from the origin along the edge. The radiation is thermal with respect to laboratory time, which is equal (up to a constant factor) to the boost angle in the analog Minkowski spacetime in which the chiral edge modes propagate, so in fact it corresponds to analog Unruh radiation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“quantization”（量子化）、“theory”（理论）、“quantum dynamics”（量子动力学）等理论推导关键词，未提及任何实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：量子霍尔效应中的“霍金辐射”类比现象。具体体系为：占据半平面的二维电子费米海，在四极电势（quadrupolar electric potential）作用下，手性边缘模式产生的类比霍金辐射。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该类比霍金辐射现象可以被经典引导中心理论的量子化精确描述。辐射源于量子态在非对易平面上的运动学约束（电子在半平面局域化必然沿边缘方向延展），辐射沿边缘从原点向两侧传播，且相对于实验室时间是热谱，本质上对应类比闵可夫斯基时空中的“Unruh辐射”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该类比霍金辐射现象可以被经典引导中心理论的量子化精确描述。辐射源于量子态在非对易平面上的运动学约束（电子在半平面局域化必然沿边缘方向延展），辐射沿边缘从原点向两侧传播，且相对于实验室时间是热谱，本质上对应类比闵可夫斯基时空中的“Unruh辐射”。；创新点：首次指出该量子霍尔霍金辐射类比实际上应被理解为“类比Unruh辐射”（而非严格意义上的霍金辐射），并揭示了其与引导中心量子化及非对易平面运动学约束的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为引导中心（guiding center）理论的量子化。该方法对电子回旋运动进行粗粒化（coarse grained），仅保留漂移运动，量子动力学发生在非对易平面上。

papers.title: Regulating Free-scalar and Yang--Lee 5d CFTs on the Fuzzy Four Sphere
papers.abstract: Non-commutative sphere regularization of CFT has become a powerful tool for computing conformal data of 3d CFTs and was recently extended to 4d CFTs. In this work we further construct 5d free-scalar CFT and Yang-Lee CFT on a fuzzy 4-sphere. We observe a continuous phase transition and conformal towers in these examples. We obtain the first three scalar primaries of the 5d free-scalar CFT, furthermore, we compute the 5d Yang-Lee $Δ_φ,Δ_{φ^3}$ with $N_e=10$ fermions using exact diagonalization (ED) and $N_e=20$ fermions using density matrix renormalization group (DMRG), obtaining relatively good agreement with both $ε$-expansion and the Gliozzi truncated bootstrap result.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用 exact diagonalization (ED) 和 density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) 等数值计算方法，并结合 ε-expansion 与 Gliozzi truncated bootstrap 结果进行对比。；研究对象：5维自由标量 CFT 和 Yang-Lee CFT，在模糊四球面（fuzzy 4-sphere）上的非对易正则化实现。属于高维（5d）共形场论的非微扰研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在模糊四球面上成功构造了 5d 自由标量 CFT 和 Yang-Lee CFT，观察到连续相变和共形塔结构；计算得到的 5d Yang-Lee 标度维度 Δ_φ 和 Δ_{φ^3} 与 ε-展开及 Gliozzi 截断 bootstrap 结果吻合较好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在模糊四球面上成功构造了 5d 自由标量 CFT 和 Yang-Lee CFT，观察到连续相变和共形塔结构；计算得到的 5d Yang-Lee 标度维度 Δ_φ 和 Δ_{φ^3} 与 ε-展开及 Gliozzi 截断 bootstrap 结果吻合较好。；创新点：将模糊球面正则化方法从 3d CFT 和 4d CFT 进一步推广到 5d CFT，首次在模糊四球面上实现 5d 自由标量和 Yang-Lee CFT 的数值研究，并验证了其与解析方法（ε-展开、bootstrap）的一致性。
papers.method_zh: 非对易球面正则化方法（fuzzy sphere regularization）扩展到 4 维球面（即模糊四球面）；对自由标量 CFT 提取前三个标量初级算符；对 Yang-Lee CFT 分别使用精确对角化（ED，N_e=10 费米子）和密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG，N_e=20 费米子）计算标度维度。

papers.title: Quantum Complexity Dynamics for Disjoint Subsystems
papers.abstract: Quantum complexity has emerged as a natural probe of chaos, thermalization, and the black hole interior on timescales long after local observables have equilibrated. However, its time evolution has been studied almost exclusively in subsystems confined to a single connected region. We show, using complementary tools from holography and random quantum circuits, that noncontiguous subsystems composed of multiple disjoint regions give rise to qualitatively new physics compared to the contiguous case. First, at finite temperature, a subsystem occupying less than half of the total system can carry high complexity at late times, even as the complexity of its larger complement remains low. This inversion of the usual hierarchy is intrinsically thermal: it vanishes in the infinite-temperature limit, which is the regime modeled by random quantum circuits. Second, if a subsystem's complexity equilibrates at an early time, then fragmenting it into $m$ disjoint components can further reduce this timescale by a factor of $m$, a phenomenon we exhibit in both holography and random quantum circuits. These results not only sharpen the correspondence between geometric and computational notions of complexity, but also motivate the search for novel complexity phenomena in quantum dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“holography”（全息对偶）和“random quantum circuits”（随机量子电路）作为理论工具，属于理论物理研究。；研究对象：量子复杂度（quantum complexity）在由多个互不相连（disjoint）子区域组成的非连续子系统中的时间演化行为，涉及量子混沌、热化以及黑洞物理中的复杂度动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非连续子系统（由多个分离区域组成）的量子复杂度展现出与连续子系统定性不同的新物理：1）在有限温度下，占据总系统不到一半的子系统可在晚时间保持高复杂度，而其更大的补集复杂度反而较低，这种层级反转在无限温度极限下消失；2）若子系统复杂度在早期达到平衡，将其分割为 m 个不相连部分可将平衡时间进一步缩短约 m 倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非连续子系统（由多个分离区域组成）的量子复杂度展现出与连续子系统定性不同的新物理：1）在有限温度下，占据总系统不到一半的子系统可在晚时间保持高复杂度，而其更大的补集复杂度反而较低，这种层级反转在无限温度极限下消失；2）若子系统复杂度在早期达到平衡，将其分割为 m 个不相连部分可将平衡时间进一步缩短约 m 倍。；创新点：首次系统研究非连续（多区域分离）子系统的量子复杂度动力学，发现与连续子系统情形定性不同的新现象（复杂度层级反转和分割加速平衡），并展示了全息几何与计算复杂度概念之间更精细的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用全息对偶（holography）与随机量子电路（random quantum circuits）两种互补的理论框架，分别从几何与计算两个角度分析量子复杂度动力学。

papers.title: Classification of Rational $c=1$ Vertex Operator Algebras and Vertex Operator Superalgebras
papers.abstract: For mathematicians: In this first in a series of two papers, we give a mathematically rigorous classification of (sufficiently nice) $c=1$ vertex operator algebras (VOAs) and vertex operator superalgebras (VOSAs). We confirm the lore that any such VO(S)A is either a lattice VO(S)A $V_L$ associated to a rank-1 integral lattice $L$, or can be obtained as an orbifold thereof, i.e. a $G$-invariant subalgebra $V_L^G$ for some finite group $G$ of automorphisms. All such $G$ are known, allowing for an explicit enumeration of nice $c=1$ VO(S)As. A key ingredient in our approach is to establish a general criterion for nice VOAs, requiring knowledge only of the vacuum character, for testing when the simple modules with integer conformal dimension span a symmetric fusion subcategory which is braided tensor equivalent to $Rep(G)$. In our companion paper, we calculate the ribbon auto-equivalences of the representation categories of the nice $c=1$ VOAs, and leverage this to obtain the classification of nice bosonic and fermionic $c=1$ full conformal field theories. For physicists: We rigorously classify the chiral algebras that can arise in the holomorphic sector of a bosonic or fermionic rational $c=1$ conformal field theory (CFT) whose non-identity primaries all have positive conformal dimension. Thinking of chiral algebras as gapless boundary conditions of 3D topological quantum field theories (TQFTs), our result says that any such chiral algebra is either a holomorphic boundary of $U(1)_k$ Chern-Simons theory, or can be obtained by passing to the $G$-invariant states thereof for some finite group $G$ of symmetries. We explicitly enumerate these chiral algebras and also discuss their non-invertible symmetries. In a companion paper, we build on these results using techniques from the study of 3D TQFTs to classify full bosonic and fermionic rational $c=1$ CFTs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确为“mathematically rigorous classification”（数学严格分类），面向数学家与物理学家，属于数学物理/场论理论工作。；研究对象：中心电荷 c=1 的有理顶点算子代数（VOA）与顶点算子超代数（VOSA），即玻色子与费米子有理 c=1 共形场论（CFT）手征代数（chiral algebra）的完整分类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 任何“足够好”（nice）的 c=1 VOA/VOSA 要么是秩 1 整格 L 对应的格 VOA/VOSA V_L，要么是其有限自同构群 G 的 orbifold（G-不变子代数 V_L^G）。所有可能的 G 已知，因此可显式枚举所有 nice c=1 VOA/VOSA。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：任何“足够好”（nice）的 c=1 VOA/VOSA 要么是秩 1 整格 L 对应的格 VOA/VOSA V_L，要么是其有限自同构群 G 的 orbifold（G-不变子代数 V_L^G）。所有可能的 G 已知，因此可显式枚举所有 nice c=1 VOA/VOSA。；创新点：首次给出 c=1 VOA/VOSA 的数学严格完整分类，确认了此前仅作为“lore”（经验认知）的格/orbifold 结构；并引入仅依赖真空特征标的通用判据，为后续（companion paper）利用 3D TQFT 技术分类完整 c=1 CFT 奠定基础。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：顶点算子代数与张量范畴理论。关键步骤是建立仅需真空特征标（vacuum character）的一般判据，用于判定整数共形维数的单模是否张成对称融合子范畴，且该子范畴与 Rep(G) 辫子张量等价。

papers.title: Generative artificial intelligence for reliable mechanistic reasoning for corrosion
papers.abstract: Corrosion accounts for approximately 4% of global GDP, and reliable prediction is essential for timely mitigation. Machine learning effectively predicts corrosion rates from composition, microstructure, and environmental variables, but cannot explain the underlying mechanisms. A reliable approach in safety-critical materials engineering requires not only accurate retrieval but also mechanistically defensible reasoning, a capability that existing factuality metrics cannot assess. This work presents a domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation framework for corrosion knowledge synthesis, demonstrated on magnesium alloy corrosion. Three open-weight language models (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Mistral-7B) are fine-tuned on 3,309 expert-verified question-answer pairs from 840 peer-reviewed papers and integrated with a hybrid dense-lexical retrieval pipeline. Retrieval augmentation produces Token F1 gains of 143-194%, with system faithfulness of 0.964 and context recall of 0.988. Blind external validation on newly published literature and in-house electrochemical data confirms trend-level generalisation. Reason Map, a proposition-graph framework, is further introduced; it independently constructs directed evidence graphs from generated answers and retrieved literature, enabling systematic detection of causal direction inversions and unsupported inferential leaps that flat factuality metrics cannot expose. The modular architecture can be applied across domains, offering a generalizable blueprint for trustworthy AI-assisted knowledge synthesis to circumvent corrosion, which can also be applied to other engineering domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+理论）。判断依据：摘要中提及“fine-tuned”（微调）、“retrieval-augmented generation framework”（检索增强生成框架）、“proposition-graph framework”（命题图框架）等，属于AI模型构建与算法框架设计，而非传统实验或第一性原理计算。；研究对象：腐蚀科学与材料工程领域，具体以**镁合金腐蚀**为演示对象。研究体系为腐蚀知识图谱与AI推理系统，而非特定物理相或量子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作构建了一个领域自适应的检索增强生成（RAG）框架，在镁合金腐蚀知识合成中实现了高保真度（0.964）和高上下文召回率（0.988），并引入“Reason Map”命题图框架，能够系统检测因果方向倒置和缺乏支持的推理跳跃，弥补了传统事实性指标无法评估机理推理可靠性的缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作构建了一个领域自适应的检索增强生成（RAG）框架，在镁合金腐蚀知识合成中实现了高保真度（0.964）和高上下文召回率（0.988），并引入“Reason Map”命题图框架，能够系统检测因果方向倒置和缺乏支持的推理跳跃，弥补了传统事实性指标无法评估机理推理可靠性的缺陷。；创新点：主要创新在于将“机理可辩护性”（mechanistically defensible reasoning）引入AI辅助知识合成，并通过命题图（Reason Map）实现因果方向一致性的显式验证，超越了传统仅关注事实准确性的评估方式。此外，该模块化架构具有跨领域通用性，可推广至其他工程领域。

papers.title: Modernization and Statistical Validation of a Multilayer TRIM.SP Code for Low-Energy Muon and Ion Implantation
papers.abstract: We describe the staged modernization of a local multilayer TRIM.SP implementation, denoted TRIM.SP-NL. The work included behavior-preserving refactoring, correction of localized bookkeeping and initialization defects, support for more than five elements per layer, reproducible build modes, and a runtime-selectable random-number-generator (RNG) interface. The RANLUX RNG remains the default reference backend, while PCG32 and xoshiro256** provide faster alternatives without changing the input-deck format. The code validation combined exact regression testing with statistical comparisons over 13 representative target multilayer configurations, comprising 143 energy-configuration points per backend and 429 simulations in total. Across the test suite, PCG32 and xoshiro256** reduced runtime by factors of 1.98 and 2.01, respectively. The implanted, backscattered, and transmitted fractions, as well as the mean implantation depths, range straggling, and representative depth profiles showed no systematic RNG dependence. Together with a Node.js-based graphical interface for setup, scans, and result collection, the Fortran engine forms the open-source TRIM.SP-NL Workbench.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/软件工程类文章。关键词：TRIM.SP代码现代化、回归测试、统计验证、Fortran引擎。；研究对象：低能缪子与离子在多层材料中的注入与输运过程，具体为多层靶材中的离子注入深度分布、背散射与透射行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 现代化后的TRIM.SP-NL代码在保持物理结果一致性的前提下，通过更换随机数生成器（PCG32和xoshiro256**）将计算速度提升约2倍，且注入、背散射、透射分数及深度分布等关键物理量不依赖于随机数生成器的选择。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：现代化后的TRIM.SP-NL代码在保持物理结果一致性的前提下，通过更换随机数生成器（PCG32和xoshiro256**）将计算速度提升约2倍，且注入、背散射、透射分数及深度分布等关键物理量不依赖于随机数生成器的选择。；创新点：实现了支持五元素以上多层靶的TRIM.SP代码现代化，提供可复现构建模式和运行时可选随机数生成器接口，并配套Node.js图形界面，形成开源TRIM.SP-NL Workbench工具链。摘要未突出说明物理模型本身的创新。
papers.method_zh: 对多层TRIM.SP实现进行行为保持的重构与缺陷修复，采用精确回归测试与统计比较相结合的方式，在13种多层靶构型、143个能量-构型点、共429次模拟中对三种随机数生成器（RANLUX、PCG32、xoshiro256**）进行系统验证。

papers.title: Strain-Tunable Spin Relaxation in Germanium from First Principles
papers.abstract: Germanium is a leading platform for semiconductor spin qubits and spintronics. Yet its electron and hole spin dynamics remain understood primarily through phenomenological models. Here, we predict electronic transport and spin relaxation in bulk Ge entirely from first principles, combining hybrid-functional band structures with fully relativistic electron-phonon ($e$-ph) interactions. Without empirical parameters, we predict carrier mobilities, velocity-field curves, and electron and hole spin relaxation times in close agreement with experiments over 100$-$400 K. By resolving spin-flip scattering by valley and phonon mode, we identify the microscopic mechanisms governing spin relaxation and show that spin and momentum relaxation, although both mediated by $e$-ph scattering, are controlled by distinct processes. We further show that compressive biaxial strain enhances the hole spin lifetime by up to two orders of magnitude at 5% strain, through strain-induced valence-band splitting and suppressed spin mixing. This mechanism is directly relevant to Ge-on-Si devices, where strain provides a practical route to engineering long-lived hole spins for quantum technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“from first principles”（第一性原理）、“hybrid-functional band structures”（杂化泛函能带结构）、“fully relativistic electron-phonon interactions”（全相对论电子-声子相互作用），属于第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：体相锗（bulk Ge）中的电子与空穴输运性质及自旋弛豫动力学，具体包括载流子迁移率、速度-电场曲线、电子与空穴自旋弛豫时间，以及双轴压应变对空穴自旋寿命的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在不依赖任何经验参数的情况下，第一性原理计算可定量重现锗在100–400 K范围内的迁移率和自旋弛豫时间；自旋弛豫与动量弛豫虽均由电子-声子散射介导，但受不同微观过程控制。此外，5%双轴压应变通过价带劈裂和自旋混合抑制，可将空穴自旋寿命提升约两个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在不依赖任何经验参数的情况下，第一性原理计算可定量重现锗在100–400 K范围内的迁移率和自旋弛豫时间；自旋弛豫与动量弛豫虽均由电子-声子散射介导，但受不同微观过程控制。此外，5%双轴压应变通过价带劈裂和自旋混合抑制，可将空穴自旋寿命提升约两个数量级。；创新点：首次完全从第一性原理（无经验参数）统一预测锗的迁移率、速度-电场曲线及电子/空穴自旋弛豫时间，并揭示自旋弛豫与动量弛豫由不同散射过程主导；同时提出应变工程（压缩双轴应变）作为提升Ge空穴自旋寿命的实用途径，直接关联Ge-on-Si器件应用。
papers.method_zh: 采用杂化泛函（hybrid-functional）计算能带结构，结合全相对论电子-声子相互作用（fully relativistic e-ph interactions）进行第一性原理输运和自旋弛豫计算。通过按能谷（valley）和声子模式（phonon mode）分解自旋翻转散射，识别微观弛豫机制。

papers.title: Microwave-Induced Optomagnetism in High-Temperature Superconductors
papers.abstract: We report the first experimental observation of a steady-state, microwave-driven inverse Faraday effect in a high-temperature superconductor. Circularly polarized microwave radiation generates a helicity-dependent response in an epitaxial $\mathrm{YBa_2Cu_3O_{7-δ}}$ film, detected using homodyne Hall transport. The optomagnetic response emerges exclusively below $T_c$, vanishes in the normal state, and exhibits no power-dependent counterpart under linearly polarized excitation. The effective optomagnetic conversion reaches $1.75\,\mathrm{T}/(\mathrm{W\,cm^{-2}})$, surpassing optical benchmarks by several orders of magnitude. At higher microwave powers, the signal collapses when the self-generated field exceeds $B_{c1}$, marking the onset of a vortex phase-slip regime, and subsequently re-emerges at mode-locked vortex-washboard harmonics. These results establish steady-state microwave optomagnetism as a route to contactless, non-inductive magnetic control and nonequilibrium vortex spectroscopy in superconducting quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first experimental observation”，并描述了具体的实验测量手段（homodyne Hall transport）。；研究对象：高温超导体外延薄膜 YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ（YBCO），具体研究圆偏振微波辐照下产生的稳态逆法拉第效应（微波致光磁效应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高温超导 YBCO 薄膜中首次实验观测到微波驱动的稳态逆法拉第效应：圆偏振微波在超导态下产生与手性相关的光磁响应，有效光磁转换效率高达 1.75 T/(W·cm⁻²)，远超光学波段基准；当自生磁场超过下临界场 B_c1 时信号塌缩，并在涡旋洗板谐波频率处重新出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高温超导 YBCO 薄膜中首次实验观测到微波驱动的稳态逆法拉第效应：圆偏振微波在超导态下产生与手性相关的光磁响应，有效光磁转换效率高达 1.75 T/(W·cm⁻²)，远超光学波段基准；当自生磁场超过下临界场 B_c1 时信号塌缩，并在涡旋洗板谐波频率处重新出现。；创新点：首次在高温超导体中实现稳态（非瞬态）微波驱动的逆法拉第效应，其转换效率比光学波段高数个数量级；并揭示了该效应与涡旋相滑移动力学及涡旋洗板模式的耦合，为无接触、非感应式磁调控和非平衡涡旋谱学提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用同相（homodyne）霍尔输运测量，对高质量外延 YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ 薄膜施加圆偏振微波辐射，测量与微波手性相关的霍尔响应；通过对比线偏振激发、改变温度跨越 T_c 以及改变微波功率来表征光磁信号。

papers.title: Static-Field Shielding of Bosonic Molecules: Evaporation to Degeneracy and Self-Bound Droplets
papers.abstract: The strong, tunable dipolar interactions of ultracold molecules make them a powerful platform for quantum many-body physics, but reaching degeneracy by evaporative cooling requires suppressing inelastic collisions. Microwave collisional shielding has enabled the preparation of degenerate Fermi gases and Bose-Einstein condensates of polar molecules, whereas static electric field shielding has been limited to fermionic species, which are less prone to inelastic loss. We demonstrate static-field Förster shielding of bosonic $^{23}$Na$^{87}$Rb molecules, suppressing two-body loss by up to four orders of magnitude. Within a bound-state-free electric-field window, three-body loss is also strongly suppressed, enabling efficient evaporation. Evaporating with an efficiency of 2.09(9), we increase the phase-space density of the gas by two orders of magnitude, reaching degeneracy with 7200(1000) molecules. We observe self-bound droplets at the end of evaporation over a wide range of field strengths, emerging from either degenerate or non-degenerate parent gases. We perform Path Integral Monte Carlo simulations, which suggest that the observed droplets are filamentary in nature, and find good agreement with the experimentally observed droplet formation temperatures. Our results establish Förster shielding as a single-field route to prepare degenerate gases and self-bound droplets of bosonic polar molecules.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含数值模拟辅助）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述实验演示（“demonstrate”）、观测（“observe”）及效率测量（“efficiency of 2.09(9)”），同时包含Path Integral Monte Carlo模拟作为理论支撑。；研究对象：超冷玻色性极性分子²³Na⁸⁷Rb气体，具体研究其蒸发冷却至量子简并以及自束缚液滴的形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过静电场Förster屏蔽，将玻色性²³Na⁸⁷Rb分子的双体损失抑制四个数量级，并在无束缚态电场窗口内实现高效蒸发，使相空间密度提升两个数量级，最终达到量子简并（7200(1000)个分子），同时观测到自束缚液滴的形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过静电场Förster屏蔽，将玻色性²³Na⁸⁷Rb分子的双体损失抑制四个数量级，并在无束缚态电场窗口内实现高效蒸发，使相空间密度提升两个数量级，最终达到量子简并（7200(1000)个分子），同时观测到自束缚液滴的形成。；创新点：首次将静电场屏蔽（而非微波屏蔽）成功应用于玻色性极性分子的蒸发冷却至简并，并证明Förster屏蔽可作为单一电场路径同时制备简并气体和自束缚液滴。摘要未突出说明与已有微波屏蔽方案的系统性对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用静电场Förster屏蔽技术进行蒸发冷却，测量双体和三体损失率、相空间密度及液滴形成温度；理论上采用Path Integral Monte Carlo（PIMC）模拟，与实验观测的液滴形成温度进行对比。

papers.title: Overcoming critical slowing down in frustrated spin systems by learned multiscale sampling
papers.abstract: Cluster algorithms, such as the Swendsen--Wang and Wolff methods, are among the most successful MCMC methods for mitigating critical slowing down in statistical systems. These constructive cluster algorithms, however, fail in the presence of even extremely weak frustration. Here, we sidestep this fundamental limitation by learning rather than constructing the relevant clusters. Specifically, we use the wavelet conditional renormalization group (WCRG) sampling method to learn the probability distribution of collective fluctuations of a frustrated two-dimensional soft-spin model. Configurations are then generated recursively from coarse to fine scales by sampling conditional wavelet distributions. The WCRG method reproduces the main statistical properties of the system across different phases, including the local-field distribution and the structure factor. At an Ising-like critical point, the conditional dynamics remains decorrelated within $\mathcal{O}(1)$ sweeps at each scale, yielding an overall sampling complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\log_2 L)$, thus making WCRG much more efficient than standard local MCMC methods. These results show that learned multiscale sampling can overcome critical slowing down in frustrated systems for which conventional cluster algorithms fail. By assessing the sampling accuracy of different observables, we also clarify the main tradeoff of the WCRG method: the accuracy of the fast sampling scheme depends on the expressiveness of the energy-based model used to estimate the wavelet conditional distributions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“MCMC方法”“采样方法”“能量模型”等计算与理论模拟关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维软自旋（soft-spin）阻挫自旋系统，重点关注其临界点附近的集体涨落行为与临界慢化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过学习的多尺度采样方法（WCRG）可在阻挫自旋系统中克服临界慢化，在Ising类临界点处每尺度条件动力学在O(1)次扫描内去相关，整体采样复杂度为O(log₂L)，远优于标准局域MCMC方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过学习的多尺度采样方法（WCRG）可在阻挫自旋系统中克服临界慢化，在Ising类临界点处每尺度条件动力学在O(1)次扫描内去相关，整体采样复杂度为O(log₂L)，远优于标准局域MCMC方法。；创新点：传统构造性簇算法（如Swendsen–Wang和Wolff）在极弱阻挫下即失效，本文通过“学习”而非“构造”相关簇来规避这一根本限制，首次展示了学习型多尺度采样可在传统簇算法失效的阻挫体系中克服临界慢化。摘要同时指出该方法的权衡：快速采样的精度取决于用于估计小波条件分布的能量基模型的表达能力。
papers.method_zh: 采用小波条件重正化群（WCRG）采样方法：利用能量基模型学习集体涨落的概率分布，从粗到细尺度递归采样条件小波分布。具体涉及学习阻挫二维软自旋模型的局域场分布与结构因子，并与Swendsen–Wang和Wolff等传统簇算法进行对比。

papers.title: Device characterization of Si$/$SiGe double quantum dots using exchange oscillations in Earth's magnetic field
papers.abstract: Exchange-based semiconductor qubits encompass a broad family of encodings constructed from singlet- and triplet-like spin states, several of which are compatible with operation at zero applied magnetic field. Their reliable operation requires characterization of environmental noise, residual idle interactions, and exchange-dependent decay, but this characterization often relies on multi-axis control calibration or deliberately engineered magnetic-field gradients. A simpler zero-applied-field diagnostic is particularly valuable for hybrid semiconductor-superconductor systems, in which magnetic fields can degrade superconducting components. Here, we use the intrinsic magnetic-field gradient produced by residual nuclear spins in isotopically enriched Si/SiGe to implement exchange oscillations between two quantum dots as a characterization tool without a micromagnet, dynamic nuclear polarization, or prior multi-axis calibration. Using Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill exchange sequences, we extend the singlet coherence from $T_2^*=1.17\pm0.02~μ$s to $T_2^{\mathrm{CPMG}}=74.8\pm1.8~μ$s with $N=70$ refocusing pulses. The oscillation phase resolves residual exchange in the tens-of-kilohertz regime and enables it to be mapped across the $(1,1)$ charge cell. These results establish intrinsic-gradient exchange oscillations as a simple, more relevant zero-field diagnostic for exchange-only and related semiconductor qubit encodings that is amenable to rapid, high-throughput device characterization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的器件测量（交换振荡、相干时间测量）和脉冲序列（CPMG），属于实验研究。；研究对象：Si/SiGe 双量子点体系，具体为基于单重态-三重态自旋编码的交换型半导体量子比特，在零外加磁场下利用残余核自旋产生的内禀磁场梯度实现交换振荡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用同位素富集 Si/SiGe 中残余核自旋产生的内禀磁场梯度，无需微磁体或动态核极化即可实现双量子点间的交换振荡，并以此作为器件表征工具。通过 CPMG 交换序列将单重态相干时间从 T2* = 1.17 ± 0.02 μs 延长至 T2^CPMG = 74.8 ± 1.8 μs（N=70 重聚焦脉冲），振荡相位可分辨数十 kHz 量级的残余交换耦合，并能在 (1,1) 电荷胞内进行映射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用同位素富集 Si/SiGe 中残余核自旋产生的内禀磁场梯度，无需微磁体或动态核极化即可实现双量子点间的交换振荡，并以此作为器件表征工具。通过 CPMG 交换序列将单重态相干时间从 T2* = 1.17 ± 0.02 μs 延长至 T2^CPMG = 74.8 ± 1.8 μs（N=70 重聚焦脉冲），振荡相位可分辨数十 kHz 量级的残余交换耦合，并能在 (1,1) 电荷胞内进行映射。；创新点：提出并验证了一种零外加磁场下的简单诊断方法：利用内禀核自旋梯度（而非人为工程磁场梯度）实现交换振荡，用于交换型量子比特的器件表征。该方法无需微磁体、动态核极化或多轴校准，特别适用于混合半导体-超导体系（磁场会损伤超导元件），且适合快速、高通量的器件筛选。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用 Si/SiGe 双量子点器件，在零外加磁场下进行交换振荡测量；使用 Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill（CPMG）交换脉冲序列延长相干时间；通过振荡相位提取残余交换耦合强度并绘制其在电荷稳定性图中的分布。未使用微磁体、动态核极化或预先的多轴校准。

papers.title: Orbital and Spin Edelstein Effects in KTaO$_3$(110) Two-Dimensional Electron Gases
papers.abstract: The orbital Edelstein effect converts an electric field into a non-equilibrium orbital polarization, opening new opportunities for orbitronics. Although signatures of the orbital Edelstein effect have been reported, its microscopic mechanisms and quantitative validation remain underexplored. Here, by directly linking the atomic structure of KTaO$_3$(110) two-dimensional electron gases to both their calculated and measured electronic band dispersions, we predict and provide experimental evidence for an orbital Edelstein effect that largely counterbalances its spin counterpart. Scanning transmission electron microscopy and electron energy-loss spectroscopy resolve the interfacial atomic configuration, which is used as input for density-functional calculations. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy then confirms the resulting band structure, which is fitted by a tight-binding model enabling computation of the spin and orbital Edelstein responses. Harmonic magnetotransport indicates that a $\sim$20 \% contribution from the orbital Edelstein response is necessary to describe the magnitude and anisotropy of the effect. Our results establish KTaO$_3$(110) as a model platform for orbitronics and demonstrate a pathway to generate and harness orbital polarization in quantum oxide systems while also offering new insights into pairing mechanisms in their superconducting state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“scanning transmission electron microscopy”“angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy”“harmonic magnetotransport”等实验手段，以及“density-functional calculations”“tight-binding model”等理论计算方法。；研究对象：KTaO₃(110) 二维电子气（2DEG）中的轨道Edelstein效应与自旋Edelstein效应，以及二者之间的竞争关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在KTaO₃(110)二维电子气中，轨道Edelstein效应显著存在，且其大小足以在很大程度上抵消自旋Edelstein效应；谐波磁输运表明约20%的响应来自轨道Edelstein贡献，才能解释效应的幅度和各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在KTaO₃(110)二维电子气中，轨道Edelstein效应显著存在，且其大小足以在很大程度上抵消自旋Edelstein效应；谐波磁输运表明约20%的响应来自轨道Edelstein贡献，才能解释效应的幅度和各向异性。；创新点：首次将KTaO₃(110)二维电子气的原子结构直接与计算和实测能带联系起来，定量预测并实验证实了轨道Edelstein效应对自旋Edelstein效应的显著抵消作用，将KTaO₃(110)确立为轨道电子学（orbitronics）模型平台，并为超导配对机制提供新视角。
papers.method_zh: 扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）和电子能量损失谱（EELS）确定界面原子构型；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算电子结构；角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）验证能带；紧束缚模型拟合能带并计算自旋/轨道Edelstein响应；谐波磁输运测量验证响应大小与各向异性。

papers.title: A MOF-reinforced self-foaming sponge for mechanically robust triboelectric membranes with improved resistance to humidity
papers.abstract: Porous triboelectric materials offer significant potential for enhancing the performance of triboelectric nanogenerators, yet their practical application is limited by structural instability and humidity-induced performance degradation. In this work, a bio-derived, sustainable polyamide containing disulfide linkages was developed to enable spontaneous formation of a porous dielectric without external templating. Hydrophilic MOF fillers comprising HKUST-1 crystals are incorporated within the porous matrix to reinforce the membrane structure and regulate moisture effects. Mechanical characterization demonstrates that HKUST-1 suppresses pore collapse and improves structural robustness under repeated deformation, while analysis of stress-strain behaviour reveals the critical role of pore stability in achieving stable triboelectric output. In addition, HKUST-1 mitigates humidity-induced charge dissipation by confining water molecules within its framework, giving enhanced triboelectric output stability and reduced performance degradation under increasing relative humidity compared to the neat porous system. This work demonstrates a strategy that integrates self-foamed porous structures, sustainable polymer design, and functional filler reinforcement to engineer mechanically robust and environmentally stable triboelectric systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Mechanical characterization demonstrates...”“analysis of stress-strain behaviour...”，涉及材料制备、力学测试与性能表征。；研究对象：一种含二硫键的生物基可持续聚酰胺自发泡多孔介电材料，其中掺入亲水性MOF填料HKUST-1晶体，构成复合摩擦电膜，用于摩擦纳米发电机（TENG）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: HKUST-1填料可抑制多孔结构在反复形变下的孔洞塌陷，增强膜的力学稳定性；同时通过将水分子限制在MOF框架内，缓解湿度引起的电荷耗散，从而在较高相对湿度下显著提升摩擦电输出稳定性并降低性能衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：HKUST-1填料可抑制多孔结构在反复形变下的孔洞塌陷，增强膜的力学稳定性；同时通过将水分子限制在MOF框架内，缓解湿度引起的电荷耗散，从而在较高相对湿度下显著提升摩擦电输出稳定性并降低性能衰减。；创新点：将自发泡多孔结构、可持续聚合物设计与功能性MOF填料增强相结合，同时解决多孔摩擦电材料的结构不稳定性和湿度敏感性两大瓶颈，实现力学稳健且环境稳定的摩擦电体系。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体表征仪器或测试细节，但涉及：自发泡多孔聚合物合成（含二硫键聚酰胺）、MOF（HKUST-1）复合掺杂、力学性能测试（应力-应变分析、重复形变测试）、摩擦电输出性能测试（不同相对湿度条件下）。

papers.title: Intercoupling of Segregation and Rheology in Spatially Developing Granular Chute Flows
papers.abstract: We investigate the flow and segregation of binary granular mixtures with density differences down a long chute using a continuum framework that couples a particle-force-based segregation model with an inertial-number-based local rheology. The steady-state momentum and convection-diffusion-segregation equations are solved simultaneously, explicitly accounting for the two-way coupling between segregation and flow. Predicted concentration and velocity fields at different streamwise locations are validated against representative DEM simulations. The validated model is then used to examine the influence of density ratio, mixture composition, and chute inclination on segregation over a wide range of conditions. The chute length required to achieve fully developed segregation is quantified and compared with the development length for monodisperse granular flow. At low density ratios and/or low inclinations, segregation develops over much longer distances than the velocity field. In contrast, at higher inclinations and larger density contrasts, the two length scales become comparable, demonstrating that neglecting flow development can significantly underestimate segregation evolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“continuum framework”（连续介质框架）、“solved simultaneously”（联立求解方程）以及“validated against representative DEM simulations”（与DEM模拟对比验证），属于基于连续介质模型的理论计算研究。；研究对象：具有密度差异的二元颗粒混合物在长溜槽（chute）中的流动与分离（segregation）现象，具体关注颗粒密度比、混合物组分和溜槽倾角对分离过程的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低密度比和/或低倾角条件下，分离（segregation）的发展长度远大于速度场的发展长度；而在高倾角和大密度差条件下，两者长度尺度相当，表明忽略流动发展会显著低估分离演化的进程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低密度比和/或低倾角条件下，分离（segregation）的发展长度远大于速度场的发展长度；而在高倾角和大密度差条件下，两者长度尺度相当，表明忽略流动发展会显著低估分离演化的进程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用耦合的连续介质框架：将基于颗粒力的分离模型（particle-force-based segregation model）与基于惯性数的局部流变学（inertial-number-based local rheology）相结合。稳态动量方程与对流-扩散-分离方程（convection-diffusion-segregation equations）联立求解，显式考虑分离与流动之间的双向耦合。模型预测与代表性DEM（离散元）模拟结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: Particle-Mediated Tuning of Defect Stability in Lamellar Block Copolymer Systems
papers.abstract: We study how colloidal inclusions modify the formation energy of dislocation pairs in lamellar block copolymer systems. Using a hybrid particle/Ginzburg--Landau model, we calculate defect formation energies by comparing defect-free and defect-containing states with and without embedded colloids. Finite-size scaling is used to obtain formation energies in the thermodynamic limit. The effect of colloid insertion depends strongly on particle sizes and surface patterning. Homogeneous particles increasingly stabilize dislocation pairs with increasing particle sizes. Particles larger than one lamellar domain preferentially occupy the dislocation cores, where they replace strained polymer rather than deforming defect-free lamellae. The magnitude of this stabilization depends on surface affinity. Balanced Janus particles instead increase the formation energy, because their competing surface preferences cannot be satisfied simultaneously near the curved core. Varying the patch ratio interpolates between these limits. Surface patterning has little effect for particles smaller than one lamellar domain but changes the formation energy by several tens of $k_BT$ for larger particles. These results provide quantitative guidelines for controlling topological defect stability in lamellar block copolymer systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用“hybrid particle/Ginzburg--Landau model”进行模拟计算，并采用“finite-size scaling”分析，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：层状嵌段共聚物（lamellar block copolymer）体系中的位错对（dislocation pairs）稳定性，以及胶体颗粒（colloidal inclusions）对其形成能的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 胶体颗粒对位错对稳定性的影响强烈依赖于颗粒尺寸和表面图案：均质颗粒随尺寸增大越来越稳定位错对（大颗粒优先占据位错核心），而平衡型Janus颗粒则增大位错形成能（不利于位错稳定）；表面图案对大于一个层状畴的颗粒影响显著（改变形成能达数十k_BT），对小颗粒几乎无影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：胶体颗粒对位错对稳定性的影响强烈依赖于颗粒尺寸和表面图案：均质颗粒随尺寸增大越来越稳定位错对（大颗粒优先占据位错核心），而平衡型Janus颗粒则增大位错形成能（不利于位错稳定）；表面图案对大于一个层状畴的颗粒影响显著（改变形成能达数十k_BT），对小颗粒几乎无影响。；创新点：定量揭示了胶体颗粒尺寸和表面图案（包括Janus颗粒的补丁比例）对层状嵌段共聚物中拓扑缺陷（位错对）形成能的系统性调控规律，为通过颗粒设计控制缺陷稳定性提供了定量指导。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合粒子/Ginzburg–Landau模型（hybrid particle/Ginzburg–Landau model），通过比较含/不含缺陷及含/不含胶体颗粒的状态来计算缺陷形成能，并利用有限尺寸标度（finite-size scaling）外推热力学极限下的形成能。

papers.title: Interfacial Spin-to-Charge Conversion in Sputtered MoTe2 Heterostructures Probed by Spin Pumping and Spin-Torque Ferromagnetic Resonance
papers.abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) and their Weyl semimetal phases, such as MoTe$_2$, have attracted significant attention for spin-orbit torque applications due to their efficient charge-to-spin conversion. However, whether this conversion originates predominantly from the bulk or the interface remains unclear. Here, we investigate spin-charge interconversion in MoTe$_2$ using spin-pumping and spin-torque ferromagnetic resonance (SP-FMR and ST-FMR). Thickness-dependent measurements reveal large spin-to-charge conversion and spin-torque efficiencies that are essentially independent of MoTe$_2$ thickness, indicating that the conversion is predominantly governed by the Rashba-Edelstein effect at the Py/MoTe$_2$ interface rather than by bulk spin transport. This behavior contrasts with the characteristic thickness dependence observed in Pt heterostructures and is further supported by bidirectional SP-FMR and interface-separation measurements. Our results highlight the dominant role of the Py/MoTe$_2$ interface in enabling efficient spin-charge conversion and spin-orbit torques in TMD-based spintronic devices. These findings highlight the potential of sputtered MoTe$_2$/Py heterostructures for low-power spintronic applications, including magnetic memory and logic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“spin-pumping and spin-torque ferromagnetic resonance (SP-FMR and ST-FMR)”以及“thickness-dependent measurements”等实验手段。；研究对象：溅射生长的MoTe₂（过渡金属二硫族化物，可能具有Weyl半金属相）与坡莫合金（Py）构成的异质结，具体研究其界面自旋-电荷转换和自旋轨道矩效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MoTe₂中的自旋-电荷转换和自旋力矩效率基本不依赖于MoTe₂厚度，表明该转换主要由Py/MoTe₂界面处的Rashba-Edelstein效应主导，而非体态自旋输运机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MoTe₂中的自旋-电荷转换和自旋力矩效率基本不依赖于MoTe₂厚度，表明该转换主要由Py/MoTe₂界面处的Rashba-Edelstein效应主导，而非体态自旋输运机制。；创新点：通过厚度依赖实验明确区分了界面与体态对自旋-电荷转换的贡献，揭示了TMD基异质结中界面Rashba-Edelstein效应的主导地位，与Pt异质结的典型体态厚度依赖行为形成对比。
papers.method_zh: 自旋泵浦-铁磁共振（SP-FMR）和自旋力矩-铁磁共振（ST-FMR）技术，结合厚度依赖测量、双向SP-FMR以及界面分离测量。

papers.title: Compensation in continuous symmetric trilayered planar ferrimagnet
papers.abstract: The trilayered (A-B-A type) anisotropic (single site) XY magnetic model is considered with the intra-plane ferromagnetic and the inter-plane antiferromagnetic interactions. The equilibrium properties of such trilayered anisotropic XY system has been studied by Monte Carlo simulation with Metropolis single spin (randomly chosen) update algorithm. In a given range of interaction parameters, the system has been found to exhibit the high temperature {\it critical} (vanishing sublattice magnetisations and total magnetisation) and low temperature {\it compensation} (vanishing total magnetisation even for non-vanishing sublattice magnetisations) behaviours. The compensation temperature and the critical temperature both are found to increase with the increase of single site anisotropy. The comprehensive phase diagram is drawn. The finite size study reveals the growth of correlations near the critical temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Monte Carlo simulation with Metropolis single spin update algorithm”进行数值模拟研究。；研究对象：连续对称的三层（A-B-A型）平面铁磁体（trilayered planar ferrimagnet），具体为具有面内铁磁、层间反铁磁耦合的各向异性（单离子）XY模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在该三层各向异性XY模型中，在特定相互作用参数范围内，系统同时表现出高温临界行为（子格磁化与总磁化均消失）和低温补偿行为（子格磁化非零但总磁化消失）。补偿温度与临界温度均随单离子各向异性增强而升高。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在该三层各向异性XY模型中，在特定相互作用参数范围内，系统同时表现出高温临界行为（子格磁化与总磁化均消失）和低温补偿行为（子格磁化非零但总磁化消失）。补偿温度与临界温度均随单离子各向异性增强而升高。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: Metropolis单自旋随机更新算法的蒙特卡洛模拟，用于研究平衡态性质；并进行了有限尺寸分析以考察临界温度附近的关联增长。

papers.title: Stoner contributions to the magnon equation of motion
papers.abstract: From linear response theory, we derive the equation of motion for Landau-damped magnon quasi-particles in absence of spin-orbit coupling. The derivation is based on a minimal set of assumptions, namely that the transverse magnetic susceptibility is diagonalized by one collective eigenmode per magnetic atom in the unit cell, and that the spectrum of each collective eigenmode is dominated by a single magnon resonance. The resulting equation of motion leads to a natural definition of the exchange interaction as the restoring force acting on the collective mode magnetization near equilibrium. In addition to magnetic exchange, the magnon equation of motion also contains a damping term and a dispersive quasi-particle mass, both originating from the electron-magnon coupling. The effect of these terms is illustrated for a prototypical itinerant ferromagnet, where they redshift the magnon dispersion and reduce the magnon lifetime as the magnon enters the Stoner continuum. By further assuming wave vector independence of the collective magnon subspace, the magnon equation of motion becomes atomistic with well defined magnetic sites. For real materials, one can approximate the magnon coupling constants using an arbitrary level of band theory for the dynamic transverse magnetic susceptibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“From linear response theory, we derive...”（从线性响应理论出发推导），属于第一性原理或解析理论推导。；研究对象：无自旋轨道耦合的巡游铁磁体中的Landau阻尼磁振子准粒子，特别是其进入Stoner连续谱后的行为。具体材料为“prototypical itinerant ferromagnet”（典型巡游铁磁体），但摘要未指明具体化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从线性响应理论出发，推导出包含交换恢复力、阻尼项和色散准粒子质量项的磁振子运动方程。该方程能自然解释磁振子进入Stoner连续谱时发生的色散红移和寿命缩短现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从线性响应理论出发，推导出包含交换恢复力、阻尼项和色散准粒子质量项的磁振子运动方程。该方程能自然解释磁振子进入Stoner连续谱时发生的色散红移和寿命缩短现象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其新意在于：仅基于最小假设（每个磁性原子一个集体模、单共振主导）推导出包含Landau阻尼和色散质量的磁振子运动方程，并给出了交换相互作用的自然定义（作为恢复力），同时建立了从第一性原理能带理论计算磁振子耦合常数的桥梁。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导框架：基于线性响应理论（linear response theory），假设横向磁化率可由每个磁性原子一个集体本征模对角化，且每个模谱由单一磁振子共振主导。进一步假设集体磁振子子空间波矢无关，使方程变为原子尺度形式。耦合常数可通过任意精度的能带理论计算动态横向磁化率来近似。

papers.title: Breakdown of Charge-Conjugation Symmetry of Disclinations in 2D Crystals
papers.abstract: Disclinations are elementary topological defects in two-dimensional (2D) crystalline membranes, yet their elastic properties remain largely unexplored. Using atomistic simulations, we address the energetics, morphology, and interactions of disclinations in free-standing graphene, a prototypical 2D crystal. We find that while disclinations with positive topological charges follow an expected behavior, negative disclinations exhibit sublinear energy scaling with charge as well as equilibrium shape that deviates sharply from the conventional saddle ansatz. This breakdown of charge-conjugation symmetry leads to qualitatively distinct interactions: positive disclinations repel, whereas negative disclinations display a robust long-range attraction. These trends are shown to be further amplified by self-adhesion in folded membranes. Our results uncover a fundamentally different energetic landscape for negative curvature defects and provide a basis for understanding the stability, self-folding behavior, and defect-driven morphology of graphene and other 2D membranes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Using atomistic simulations”（原子级模拟）。；研究对象：二维晶体中的向错（disclinations），以自由悬浮石墨烯为原型体系，研究其能量学、形貌与相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 正拓扑荷向错行为符合预期，但负向错表现出亚线性的能量-电荷标度关系，且平衡形状偏离传统鞍面解，导致电荷共轭对称性破缺：正向错相互排斥，负向错则呈现稳健的长程吸引。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：正拓扑荷向错行为符合预期，但负向错表现出亚线性的能量-电荷标度关系，且平衡形状偏离传统鞍面解，导致电荷共轭对称性破缺：正向错相互排斥，负向错则呈现稳健的长程吸引。；创新点：首次系统揭示负曲率向错（负拓扑荷）在二维晶体中具有与正向错截然不同的能量景观与相互作用规律，并指出自粘附（self-adhesion）效应会进一步增强这些行为，为理解石墨烯等二维膜的自折叠与缺陷驱动形貌提供了新基础。
papers.method_zh: 原子级模拟（atomistic simulations），具体方法细节（如势函数类型、模拟温度等）摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Anomalous temperature dependence in phase transitions via ballistic coalescence
papers.abstract: We study kinetics of phase transitions within a single component Lennard-Jones model. For low enough particle densities disconnected clusters form that can move ballistically in an inviscid vapor background. The clusters undergo sticky collisions, thereby forming larger aggregates, which can be of fractal nature at ultra cold temperatures. As the temperature is varied, the exponent of the algebraic growth of average cluster mass changes, exhibiting pronounced nonmonotonic character. We capture this anomalous behavior, in two and three space dimensions, within a ballistic aggregation theory. We show that the scope of the theory is much broader than the typically considered case where cluster motions are uncorrelated. An analysis of the theory shows that ballistic aggregation can even occur exponentially fast. This is in sharp contrast with the conventional algebraic picture, regarding passive matter phase transitions. We discuss scenario where such explosive growth can be realized. In addition, our results are widely relevant in understanding structure and growth in aerosols, cosmic dust and other aggregation processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Lennard-Jones模型、kinetics of phase transitions、ballistic aggregation theory。；研究对象：单组分Lennard-Jones模型中的相变动力学，具体为低密度下孤立团簇在无黏性蒸气背景中的弹道运动、黏性碰撞及聚集生长过程，涉及二维和三维空间。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平均团簇质量的代数增长指数随温度变化呈现显著的非单调行为（异常温度依赖性）；在弹道聚集理论框架下，聚集过程甚至可能以指数级速度发生，与被动物质相变中传统的代数增长图像形成鲜明对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平均团簇质量的代数增长指数随温度变化呈现显著的非单调行为（异常温度依赖性）；在弹道聚集理论框架下，聚集过程甚至可能以指数级速度发生，与被动物质相变中传统的代数增长图像形成鲜明对比。；创新点：将弹道聚集理论的适用范围从通常假设的团簇运动无关联情形扩展到更一般的情形，并首次指出弹道聚集可以指数级快速发生（“爆炸性增长”），突破了被动物质相变中代数增长的常规图像。摘要未明确说明具体实验或数值模拟细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于Lennard-Jones模型的动力学模拟（研究团簇形成与碰撞聚集），并结合弹道聚集理论（ballistic aggregation theory）进行解析分析，覆盖二维和三维空间维度。

papers.title: Signatures of inter-sideband coherence in the resonance fluorescence spectrum of an acoustically-modulated quantum dot
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the inter-sideband phase coherence within the resonance fluorescence spectrum of an acoustically modulated quantum dot using a filtered-field formalism for a Mach-Zehnder configuration. We demonstrate that geometric slant of the interferograms provides an indicator of phase coherence that is resilient to environmental white noise. Specifically, noise-induced spectral diffusion reduces the global fringe intensity, while leaving the characteristic inclination strictly invariant. Our findings establish a framework for verifying single-photon coherence between spectral sidebands, essential for frequency-bin encoding and scalable quantum networking in realistic, noisy solid-state architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“theoretically investigate”，并采用“filtered-field formalism”进行理论建模。；研究对象：声学调制的量子点（acoustically-modulated quantum dot）在共振荧光谱中的**带间相位相干性**，以及马赫-曾德尔干涉构型下的干涉图样。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 干涉图的几何倾斜（geometric slant）可作为带间相位相干性的稳健指标：环境白噪声引起的谱扩散只会降低整体条纹强度，而不会改变特征倾斜角，从而为在噪声固态体系中验证单光子带间相干性提供了可行方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：干涉图的几何倾斜（geometric slant）可作为带间相位相干性的稳健指标：环境白噪声引起的谱扩散只会降低整体条纹强度，而不会改变特征倾斜角，从而为在噪声固态体系中验证单光子带间相干性提供了可行方案。；创新点：提出利用干涉图几何倾斜而非条纹对比度作为相位相干性的判据，该判据对环境白噪声具有内在鲁棒性，适用于实际噪声固态量子网络中的频率分箱编码验证。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为**滤波场形式（filtered-field formalism）**，针对马赫-曾德尔（Mach-Zehnder）干涉构型计算共振荧光谱，并分析噪声（白噪声导致的谱扩散）对干涉图样的影响。

papers.title: Local phase-space Berry curvature and Hall transport in textured twisted bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: Slow twist-angle and heterostrain textures in twisted bilayer graphene provide a natural route to phase-space Berry geometry. We show that a purely geometric tetrad/shift sector does not generate mixed Berry curvature once the spin connection is treated consistently. By contrast, a projected textured mini-Dirac cone in twisted bilayer graphene acquires genuine mixed phase-space curvature. We analyze a controlled local Hall-bar limit with a one-dimensional texture and mirror $M_x$. In that limit the pseudogauge gradient renormalizes only the longitudinal conductivity along the textured direction, while a dc nonlinear Hall response appears only when an additional valley-odd tilt generates a Berry-curvature dipole. Both geometric responses peak at the same local filling, $μ_{\rm loc}=\sqrt{2}\,m$, providing a gate-tunable fingerprint of their common origin. All local-cone parameters and their texture susceptibilities are extracted from a heterostrained Bistritzer-MacDonald model at $θ=1.3^\circ$. The tilt invoked in the transport estimates corresponds to heterostrain of only $0.03\%-0.2\%$, below values routinely imaged in devices. The resulting theory provides a local analytic framework for textured moiré Dirac materials and cleanly separates geometric, texture-induced, and transport-level ingredients relevant to realistic TBG.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“We show”“We analyze”“The resulting theory provides”等理论推导表述，且未提及任何实验手段或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：具有缓慢扭转角梯度和异质应变织构（texture）的双层转角石墨烯（twisted bilayer graphene, TBG），具体关注其相空间贝里几何（phase-space Berry geometry）与霍尔输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋联络被一致处理后，纯几何的tetrad/shift扇区不产生混合贝里曲率；而投影后的织构化迷你狄拉克锥（textured mini-Dirac cone）会获得真实的混合相空间曲率。在特定一维织构和镜面对称M_x限制下，赝规范梯度仅重正化沿织构方向的纵向电导率，而直流非线性霍尔响应仅在额外的谷奇倾斜（valley-odd tilt）产生贝里曲率偶极子时才出现。两类几何响应在相同的局域填充μ_loc=√2 m处达到峰值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋联络被一致处理后，纯几何的tetrad/shift扇区不产生混合贝里曲率；而投影后的织构化迷你狄拉克锥（textured mini-Dirac cone）会获得真实的混合相空间曲率。在特定一维织构和镜面对称M_x限制下，赝规范梯度仅重正化沿织构方向的纵向电导率，而直流非线性霍尔响应仅在额外的谷奇倾斜（valley-odd tilt）产生贝里曲率偶极子时才出现。两类几何响应在相同的局域填充μ_loc=√2 m处达到峰值。；创新点：建立了织构化莫尔狄拉克材料的局域解析理论框架，清晰分离了几何、织构诱导和输运层面的贡献；揭示了混合相空间曲率与贝里曲率偶极子共享同一填充依赖指纹（μ_loc=√2 m），为实验上通过栅压调控识别其共同起源提供了可检验的预言。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：采用局域相空间几何方法，结合Bistritzer-MacDonald模型（θ=1.3°）提取异质应变下的局域锥参数及其织构敏感性；输运计算基于局域霍尔棒（local Hall-bar）极限，考虑一维织构和镜面对称性约束。

papers.title: On the relaxation problem in statistical mechanics
papers.abstract: We reformulate the relaxation problem in statistical mechanics by making explicit what are the \emph{operational} objects subject to relaxation: the local time statistics of the recorded signal $Z(t)$. These local time statistics are simply the estimated histograms of observations $\{Z(t_i)\}_{i=1}^M$ performed at uniformly random times $\{t_i\}_{i=1}^M$ by a clockless observer. The subject of prediction is a belief about a future fresh out-of-sample reading of a measurement outcome whose distribution is inferred from the mathematical model believed to be true. For finite bounded systems of $N\ge 1$ degrees of freedom global irreversible relaxation of predictions can occur but special initial conditions exist. The form of the predictions depends on certain loss functions whose choice is up to the particular observer. Finally, entropy is given a learning interpretation as mutual information between the observer and the unknown past of the system under consideration and, in complete generality, its stationary value depends on the information available.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于统计力学中“弛豫问题”的概念重构，属于理论框架性讨论，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：统计力学中的不可逆弛豫问题，具体关注有限有界多体系统（N≥1个自由度）中，观测者对系统记录信号Z(t)的局部时间统计（local time statistics）的预测与弛豫行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于有限有界系统，全局不可逆弛豫可以发生，但存在特殊的初始条件使弛豫不成立；熵被赋予学习论解释，即观测者与系统未知过去之间的互信息，其稳态值依赖于观测者所拥有的信息量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于有限有界系统，全局不可逆弛豫可以发生，但存在特殊的初始条件使弛豫不成立；熵被赋予学习论解释，即观测者与系统未知过去之间的互信息，其稳态值依赖于观测者所拥有的信息量。；创新点：将弛豫问题的核心对象从传统宏观量重新定义为“局部时间统计”（即观测者记录的信号直方图），并引入“无时钟观测者”的操作性视角；同时将熵与观测者信息获取（互信息）联系起来，强调预测形式依赖于观测者选择的损失函数。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体数学工具，但涉及对弛豫问题的操作化重构（基于无时钟观测者在均匀随机时间采样得到的直方图统计）、损失函数（loss functions）的选择框架，以及互信息（mutual information）的熵解释。未提及具体模型或数值方法。

papers.title: Self-Diffusion of Water through Thermally Activated Membranes
papers.abstract: Diffusion processes involving membranes are of fundamental importance in both science and technology, since membranes serve as selective interfaces that regulate the transport of mass, charge, and information across multiple length and time scales. In this study, we employ molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to calculate the self-diffusion coefficient, tetrahedral order parameter and hydrogen-bond (HB) lifetime of SPC/E water over a wide high-temperature range in the presence of thermally activated membranes (TAMs). These membranes exhibit thermally controlled stochastic behavior that locally influences particle dynamics by probabilistically inducing elastic scattering events as particles traverse the membrane. The stochastic behavior of the membranes is governed by a sigmoidal profile, which depend on the reduced temperature of the system. The effective activation energy for diffusion is estimated for several membrane configurations. It is found that the diffusion coefficients generally decrease with an increase in the number of membranes and are in reasonable agreement with the Arrhenius approximation at high temperatures. Additionally, both the tetrahedral order parameter and the HB lifetime are only locally sensitive to the action of the membranes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“分子动力学（MD）模拟”计算扩散系数等物理量。；研究对象：水分子（SPC/E模型）在“热激活膜”（TAMs）存在下的自扩散行为，以及膜对水的四面体有序度和氢键寿命的局域影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 水的自扩散系数随膜数量增加而总体下降，且高温下符合Arrhenius近似；膜对水的四面体有序参数和氢键寿命仅产生局域影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：水的自扩散系数随膜数量增加而总体下降，且高温下符合Arrhenius近似；膜对水的四面体有序参数和氢键寿命仅产生局域影响。；创新点：引入了“热激活膜”这一具有温度控制随机散射行为的膜模型，并系统研究了其对水自扩散的阻碍效应及局域结构影响。摘要未突出说明与以往膜扩散研究的对比性创新。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟，计算了SPC/E水的自扩散系数、四面体有序参数和氢键寿命；膜的热激活随机行为由依赖于体系约化温度的sigmoid函数描述；通过Arrhenius拟合估计了不同膜构型下的有效扩散激活能。

papers.title: Inertia-Driven Information Flow and Symmetry Breaking in a Nonequilibrium Two-Bead System
papers.abstract: We investigate information-flow generation in a nonequilibrium two-bead system coupled to two heat baths.
