We show that the system acts as an information-flow generator in both overdamped and underdamped regimes, with the underdamped dynamics revealing a divergence of the scaled information flow along specific paths in the thermal asymmetry--inertia parameter space that is hidden in the overdamped limit. This information generation suggests a possible route toward information engines and demon-like mechanisms in nanomachines. A symmetry-perturbation analysis of the response landscape of information flow reveals a geometric structure reminiscent of a Ginzburg--Landau framework: the symmetric reference state can correspond to a minimum or maximum depending on the perturbation direction, while the flat overdamped landscape develops a finite curvature under inertia. Mass asymmetry shifts the resulting maxima, and Hessian eigenvalue and eigenvector analysis reveals level touching of principal modes and bimodality along a constant-diffusion path. These results establish a minimal framework for understanding how inertia and microscopic heterogeneity shape information landscapes in nonequilibrium systems, with potential extensions to more complex heterogeneous networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“对称性微扰分析”“Hessian 特征值与特征向量分析”等理论工具，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一个由两个珠子（two-bead system）组成的非平衡系统，耦合到两个不同温度的热浴，研究其信息流（information flow）的产生与对称性破缺行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该系统在过阻尼和欠阻尼两种动力学条件下均可作为信息流发生器；在欠阻尼条件下，沿热不对称性—惯性参数空间中的特定路径，标度信息流出现发散，而这一行为在过阻尼极限下被隐藏。信息流响应景观的对称性破缺结构类似于Ginzburg–Landau框架，且质量不对称会移动极大值位置。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该系统在过阻尼和欠阻尼两种动力学条件下均可作为信息流发生器；在欠阻尼条件下，沿热不对称性—惯性参数空间中的特定路径，标度信息流出现发散，而这一行为在过阻尼极限下被隐藏。信息流响应景观的对称性破缺结构类似于Ginzburg–Landau框架，且质量不对称会移动极大值位置。；创新点：揭示了惯性效应（欠阻尼动力学）在信息流产生中的关键作用——特别是标度信息流的发散行为在过阻尼极限下完全隐藏；并将信息流响应景观的几何结构与Ginzburg–Landau型对称性破缺框架建立类比，为理解非平衡系统中惯性及微观异质性如何塑造信息景观提供了最小模型。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：过阻尼与欠阻尼朗之万动力学描述；对称性微扰分析；Hessian矩阵特征值与特征向量分析（用于识别主模的能级接触与双峰性）；沿恒定扩散路径的响应景观分析。

papers.title: Role of self-coherence in single-electron phase contrast imaging
papers.abstract: The extension of coherent lattice contrast into the energy loss region in high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) is described by a pulse-like electron-sample interaction in the energy/time uncertainty limit. It generates a wave packet by electron self-interference in any coherent-inelastic scattering event with energy loss. The width of this wave packet is characterized by a self-coherence length ls(ΔE) that is predictable because an intrinsic decoherence phase around one radian is set by the expectation value for phase fluctuations. In this case the visibility of interference contrast from a crystalline sample with lattice parameter a is limited by a Rayleigh-like transfer factor P(ls, a) in the self-coherently illuminated sample area. The model is verified by energy-filtered HRTEM images of hexagonal BN and identifies energy-loss-induced phase noise as a single-electron visibility limit distinct from resolution limitations caused by ensemble-coherence or counting-statistical noise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中提出理论模型（“pulse-like electron-sample interaction”“self-coherence length”），并用实验数据（“energy-filtered HRTEM images of hexagonal BN”）进行验证，属于理论与实验结合的类型。；研究对象：高分辨透射电子显微镜（HRTEM）中单电子相位衬度成像的物理机制，具体聚焦于电子能量损失（inelastic scattering with energy loss）过程中自相干性（self-coherence）对晶格衬度（lattice contrast）的影响，并以六方氮化硼（hexagonal BN）为验证体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在能量/时间不确定极限下，单电子在相干非弹性散射中通过自干涉产生波包，其自相干长度 ls(ΔE) 可由约一弧度的内禀退相干相位预测；该自相干长度通过类瑞利传递因子 P(ls, a) 限制晶格衬度的可见度，从而将能量损失引起的相位噪声识别为一种单电子可见度极限，区别于系综相干性或计数统计噪声导致的分辨率限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在能量/时间不确定极限下，单电子在相干非弹性散射中通过自干涉产生波包，其自相干长度 ls(ΔE) 可由约一弧度的内禀退相干相位预测；该自相干长度通过类瑞利传递因子 P(ls, a) 限制晶格衬度的可见度，从而将能量损失引起的相位噪声识别为一种单电子可见度极限，区别于系综相干性或计数统计噪声导致的分辨率限制。；创新点：首次将单电子自相干性（self-coherence）作为独立的可见度限制因素引入相位衬度成像理论，并给出可预测的自相干长度表达式，区分了能量损失诱导的相位噪声与传统的系综相干性/统计噪声对分辨率的影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于能量/时间不确定关系的脉冲式电子-样品相互作用模型，引入自相干长度与退相干相位期望值；实验手段：能量过滤高分辨透射电子显微镜（energy-filtered HRTEM），对六方氮化硼（h-BN）进行成像验证。

papers.title: Supermoiré Reconstruction and Topological Mosaics in Twisted Trilayer WSe$_2$ and MoTe$_2$
papers.abstract: We investigate lattice relaxation and band structures of helical and alternating twisted trilayer WSe$_2$ and MoTe$_2$ using machine-learning force fields and large-scale ab initio calculations. Interference between the two bilayer moiré lattices generates a supermoiré lattice that, upon relaxation, reconstructs into a few dominant domain types with locally commensurate bilayer moiré lattices. Because the systems lack $C_{2z}$ symmetry, domains otherwise related by this symmetry become energetically and topologically distinct, unlike in twisted trilayer graphene. Band structure calculations show that the topmost valence bands originate from the $K$ ($K'$) valleys and carry domain-dependent valley Chern numbers. The resulting supermoiré lattice hosts a mosaic of topologically inequivalent domains, offering a platform for exploring correlated and topological physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要提及“machine-learning force fields and large-scale ab initio calculations”（机器学习力场和大规模第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：螺旋（helical）和交替（alternating）扭转三层 WSe₂ 与 MoTe₂ 中的超莫尔晶格（supermoiré lattice）重构及其电子能带结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两个双层莫尔晶格干涉形成超莫尔晶格，弛豫后重构为少数几种具有局域共度双层莫尔晶格的优势畴；由于体系缺乏 C₂z 对称性，这些畴具有不同的能量和拓扑性质，其顶价带来自 K（K′）谷并携带依赖于畴的谷陈数，从而形成拓扑不等价畴的马赛克图案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两个双层莫尔晶格干涉形成超莫尔晶格，弛豫后重构为少数几种具有局域共度双层莫尔晶格的优势畴；由于体系缺乏 C₂z 对称性，这些畴具有不同的能量和拓扑性质，其顶价带来自 K（K′）谷并携带依赖于畴的谷陈数，从而形成拓扑不等价畴的马赛克图案。；创新点：与扭转三层石墨烯不同，该体系因缺乏 C₂z 对称性，原本由该对称性关联的畴在能量和拓扑上变得不等价，从而在超莫尔晶格中形成拓扑马赛克结构，为关联与拓扑物理提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习力场（machine-learning force fields）用于晶格弛豫，结合大规模第一性原理计算（large-scale ab initio calculations）计算能带结构。

papers.title: Kinetic temperatures and inertial effects in a nonequilibrium bead-spring model
papers.abstract: We investigate a nonequilibrium steady-state model consisting of two coupled beads with arbitrary masses in contact with two thermal baths at different temperatures. Using a covariance-matrix approach together with numerical simulations of the underdamped Langevin dynamics, we characterize steady-state probability distributions, heat transport, and entropy production. We show that irreversibility measures such as entropy production and heat current are invariant under an exchange of the bead masses, whereas energy-storage observables depend explicitly on the mass arrangement in a symmetrical set up. This reveals a fundamental distinction: energy observables exhibit path dependence in singular mass limits, while transport and irreversibility remain well defined. We show that kinetic temperatures provide the natural variables governing the thermodynamics of the system: their difference controls transport and entropy production, while their sum determines the mean energy via a model specific generalized equipartition relation. In the infinite-mass limit, only constitutive relations expressed in terms of kinetic temperatures remain meaningful. Thus, energy, transport, and irreversibility are unified through kinetic temperatures as the organizing variables. We also derive an effective temperature that defines an equilibrium-like canonical distribution. Finally, we analyze the notion of ergodicity and show that the time-averaged observables converge significantly faster than the ensemble averages.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要提及“covariance-matrix approach”“numerical simulations of the underdamped Langevin dynamics”。；研究对象：一个由两个任意质量珠子组成的、分别与两个不同温度热库接触的非平衡稳态珠-弹簧模型（bead-spring model），属于经典非平衡统计物理中的介观热输运体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 动能温度（kinetic temperatures）是该非平衡体系的热力学自然变量：其差值控制热流与熵产生，其和通过广义均分关系决定平均能量；而能量观测量对质量排列敏感，输运与不可逆性则对质量交换不变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：动能温度（kinetic temperatures）是该非平衡体系的热力学自然变量：其差值控制热流与熵产生，其和通过广义均分关系决定平均能量；而能量观测量对质量排列敏感，输运与不可逆性则对质量交换不变。；创新点：揭示了能量观测量与输运/不可逆性观测量在奇异质量极限下的本质区别（能量具有路径依赖，而输运与不可逆性保持良定义），并统一以动能温度作为描述能量、输运和不可逆性的组织变量；还推导了定义类平衡正则分布的等效温度，并分析了遍历性收敛速度。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 协方差矩阵方法（covariance-matrix approach）结合欠阻尼朗之万动力学的数值模拟，用于求解稳态概率分布、热流与熵产生。

papers.title: Chiral Color Ice: Exact Local Handedness Constraints and Möbius Zero Modes in Frustrated Magnets
papers.abstract: Local constraints govern the low-energy physics of frustrated matter, but familiar ice-type rules constrain flux-like quantities and are insensitive to handedness. Here we show that handedness itself can be imposed as an exact local quantum constraint without selecting an axis in spin space. We construct positive-semidefinite, SU(2)-invariant parent Hamiltonians whose complete zero-energy space on a tetrahedron has a prescribed chirality sign, rather than selecting a particular chiral wave function. For spin-1/2 the local term is a rank-one projector onto a chiral tetrahedral singlet, while for arbitrary spin it factorizes as $B^\dagger B$ through a singlet-annihilation operator, with a completely characterized kernel given by the span of the globally rotated chiral color-ice states. For coherent states, the same zero-energy condition becomes an $S$-independent nonlinear constraint in which three spin directions determine the fourth through a Möbius transformation; compositions of these maps define constraint holonomies on extended lattices. Connecting the same local constraint in different ways produces qualitatively different collective regimes: corner-sharing lattices retain exponentially large quantum ground-state kernels, with rigorous lower bounds exceeding conventional ice benchmarks; edge-sharing lattices support subdimensional plane or line zero modes; while triangular constructions suppress nonuniform coherent deformations and contain the complete Anderson tower of tetrahedral magnetic order at exactly zero energy. Two inequivalent triangular coverings further show that harmonic zero-mode counting does not determine the size of the quantum kernel. These results establish a tractable setting in which local handedness, nonlinear constraint geometry, and quantum degeneracy can be disentangled and related directly to the connectivity of the constraint network.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“parent Hamiltonians”“zero-energy space”“spin-1/2”“coherent states”等理论构造与解析分析关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：阻挫磁体中的手性自旋冰（chiral color ice）体系，具体为四面体单元上具有精确局域手性约束的量子自旋系统，涵盖自旋1/2与任意自旋情形，以及角共享、边共享和三角格子等不同连接方式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 手性本身可以作为精确的局域量子约束被施加，无需在自旋空间选取特定轴；该约束在相干态极限下等价于一个与自旋大小无关的非线性Möbius变换约束，且不同格子连接方式导致截然不同的集体基态行为（指数大简并、亚维零模、或完整Anderson塔）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：手性本身可以作为精确的局域量子约束被施加，无需在自旋空间选取特定轴；该约束在相干态极限下等价于一个与自旋大小无关的非线性Möbius变换约束，且不同格子连接方式导致截然不同的集体基态行为（指数大简并、亚维零模、或完整Anderson塔）。；创新点：首次将“手性”本身（而非通量类量）作为精确局域量子约束引入阻挫磁体，建立了局域手性、非线性约束几何与量子简并度之间的直接联系；发现谐波零模计数不能决定量子核的大小（两个不等价三角覆盖给出不同量子核尺寸）。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造方法：构建正半定、SU(2)不变的父哈密顿量，其零能空间在四面体上具有指定手性符号；对自旋1/2为秩一投影算符，对任意自旋通过单态湮灭算符因子化为B†B形式；利用相干态分析将零能条件转化为Möbius变换约束，并研究约束holonomy与格点连接性的关系。

papers.title: Learning rules for complex-valued patterns in networks of oscillators
papers.abstract: In this article, we extend learning rules from real binary to complex-valued spins. This formulation allows for a robust and natural representation of grayscale patterns, where spins behave as multi-state neurons and can be stored in a complex-valued weight matrix. We describe a rule that performs better than standard methods, such as Hebbian learning, to encode information in a suitable form for pattern retrieval with networks of oscillators. Since in neural networks it is of interest to have local and incremental learning rules, we prove the extension of a result by Diederich and Opper with our complex-valued spin formulation. We then test the behavior of the associative memory for the system of oscillators under different circumstances for both real-valued, as well as complex-valued correlated and random patterns.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“learning rules”“formulation”“prove the extension of a result”等理论推导与算法描述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：振荡器网络中的关联记忆模型，具体为复值自旋（complex-valued spins）系统，用于表示灰度模式（grayscale patterns）的多态神经元网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种针对复值自旋的扩展学习规则，该规则在编码信息以供振荡器网络进行模式检索时，性能优于标准方法（如Hebbian学习）；并证明了Diederich–Opper结果在复值自旋表述下的推广。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种针对复值自旋的扩展学习规则，该规则在编码信息以供振荡器网络进行模式检索时，性能优于标准方法（如Hebbian学习）；并证明了Diederich–Opper结果在复值自旋表述下的推广。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可归纳为：首次将学习规则系统性地从实二值自旋推广到复值自旋，并证明其在振荡器网络中优于Hebbian学习的编码能力，同时保持了局部性与增量性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将实二值自旋的学习规则推广至复值自旋，构建复值权重矩阵；采用局部、增量的学习规则（符合神经网络要求）；通过数学证明（Diederich–Opper结果的扩展）及数值测试（对实值、复值相关及随机模式进行关联记忆行为测试）验证性能。

papers.title: Fine structure of the M-center in Si
papers.abstract: Color centers in silicon offer great possibilities for scalable quantum technologies. The M-center, proposed to originate from a carbon-hydrogen complex, offers telecommunications-band emission and a paramagnetic ground state similar to the T-center. Here, we report on photoluminescence lines in the vicinity of the M-center and investigate their properties, including their dependence on temperature, implantation fluence, implantation isotope, and annealing temperature. Three emission lines are observed that are blue-shifted by 1.1, 2.8 and 3.6 meV relative to the 761 meV zero phonon line of the M center, where the 2.8 meV line exhibits negative thermal quenching and is therefore proposed to originate from a second excited state of the M-center. The remaining blue-shifted emission lines, together with two additional red-shifted (4.7 and 6.4 meV) emission lines display normal thermal quenching, and are unaffected by an isotope shift of the implanted carbon atom ($^{12}$C versus $^{13}$C implantation) and implantation fluence. Thus, they likely arise either from other defects with similar emission energies or from a perturbed configuration of the M-center.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“photoluminescence lines”（光致发光谱线）、“implantation fluence”（注入剂量）、“annealing temperature”（退火温度）等实验测量手段。；研究对象：硅中的M色心（M-center），一种被认为源自碳-氢复合体的发光缺陷，具有电信波段发射和顺磁基态，与T-center类似。具体研究其零声子线（761 meV）附近的精细发光结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在M-center主零声子线（761 meV）附近观察到多条精细发射线，其中蓝移2.8 meV的谱线具有负热淬灭行为，被指认为M-center的第二激发态；其余蓝移（1.1、3.6 meV）和红移（4.7、6.4 meV）谱线表现出正常热淬灭，且不受碳同位素（¹²C vs ¹³C）注入和注入剂量影响，可能来自其他相似能量的缺陷或M-center的微扰构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在M-center主零声子线（761 meV）附近观察到多条精细发射线，其中蓝移2.8 meV的谱线具有负热淬灭行为，被指认为M-center的第二激发态；其余蓝移（1.1、3.6 meV）和红移（4.7、6.4 meV）谱线表现出正常热淬灭，且不受碳同位素（¹²C vs ¹³C）注入和注入剂量影响，可能来自其他相似能量的缺陷或M-center的微扰构型。；创新点：首次系统表征了M-center零声子线附近的精细发光结构，并识别出一个新的第二激发态（2.8 meV蓝移线），同时通过同位素和剂量实验排除了部分伴线来自碳相关缺陷的可能性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 光致发光（PL）光谱测量，系统研究发射线对温度、注入剂量、注入同位素（¹²C/¹³C）和退火温度的依赖关系。

papers.title: Resonance statistics, Fock-space branching, and long-range pair networks in slowly varying interacting chains
papers.abstract: In a slowly varying aperiodic potential $h_i=h\cos(2πβi^n+φ)$ with random power-law density interactions $V_{ij}/|i-j|^α$, the resonant-object ensemble changes across $α=2n$, wherever Hartree fragmentation is operative, from isolated two-level bonds to a mixture of fragmented multi-site clusters and isolated wing bonds that survive at finite density, while the pair-resonance scaling $x_{\rm pair}^{4-2n-α}\ln x_{\rm pair}\propto h^2/(Vt_0)$ is unchanged~\cite{letter}. Here we develop the microscopic resonance theory underlying these results, together with its domain of validity. We derive the exact phase-averaged resonance statistics --- the supply $N_0\propto L^{2-n}/h$, the correlated common-phase comb, and the closed-form Hartree variance --- proving that the interaction leaves the leading supply law unchanged. Exact construction of the resonant Fock-space graph at $L\le18$ shows that the order-one forward-branching scale $h_{\rm FB}\propto L^{2-n}$ carries no giant component: one-step branching and connectivity are inequivalent. We separate the fixed-pair matching law from the shell-averaged $q\ln(1/q)$ law of the bond ensemble and develop the comb into a mesoscopic shell theory; we map the fragmentation domain, with its support threshold $V_*(α)$ and the boundary-healing recursion; and we treat the marginal case $α=2$, where shell and matching marginalities compound into a double logarithm. Three long-range thresholds emerge with distinct meanings --- $α=1/2$ (the exact variance threshold of the random Fock-space energy and the square-summability boundary of the leading LIOM-dressing estimate), $α=2n$ (change of the local resonant objects), and $α=2$ (marginality of the long-range shell sum) --- none of which is, by itself, a localization transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：microscopic resonance theory、derive exact statistics、exact construction、theoretical framework。；研究对象：缓慢变化非周期势（h_i = h cos(2πβ i^n + φ)）中具有随机幂律密度相互作用（V_ij / |i−j|^α）的一维相互作用链，具体关注其共振态统计、Fock空间图结构及长程配对网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 共振对象系综在α = 2n处发生从孤立两能级键到碎片化多格点团簇与孤立翼键混合的转变，但配对共振标度律x_pair^{4−2n−α} ln x_pair ∝ h²/(V t₀)保持不变；同时证明前向分支标度h_FB ∝ L^{2−n}不伴随巨连通分量，一步分支与连通性不等价。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：共振对象系综在α = 2n处发生从孤立两能级键到碎片化多格点团簇与孤立翼键混合的转变，但配对共振标度律x_pair^{4−2n−α} ln x_pair ∝ h²/(V t₀)保持不变；同时证明前向分支标度h_FB ∝ L^{2−n}不伴随巨连通分量，一步分支与连通性不等价。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于：严格证明相互作用不改变前导供应律、揭示一步分支与连通性的不等价性、区分固定配对匹配律与壳层平均q ln(1/q)律，并厘清三个长程阈值（α = 1/2、α = 2n、α = 2）各自独立于局域化相变的不同物理含义。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导了相位平均共振统计（供应律N₀ ∝ L^{2−n}/h、公共相位梳、闭式Hartree方差），并在L ≤ 18的尺寸下精确构造共振Fock空间图；发展了壳层平均理论、碎片化域映射及边界修复递推，并处理了α = 2的边缘情形。

papers.title: Hartree Fragmentation and Long-Range Pair Networks in Aperiodic Chains
papers.abstract: For fermions in a slowly varying aperiodic potential with random interactions $V_{ij}/|i-j|^α$, the potential fixes the resonance supply $N_0 \propto L^{2-n}/h$. On crossing $α-2n$, wherever Hartree fragmentation is operative, the resonant-object ensemble reconstructs: turning-point runs fragment into clusters whose intrinsic matching law resolves no logarithmic singularity, while isolated wing bonds survive at finite density and restore a reduced logarithm. The scaling $x^{4-2n-α}_{pair} ln{x_{pair}} \propto h^2/(V t0)$ is unchanged. Random coefficient fluctuations sustain the $R^{-α}$ coupling; uniform ones cancel to $R^{-α-2}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论标度关系、解析推导（如“intrinsic matching law”“scaling”），未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：非周期（准周期）势场中的费米子体系，具体为缓慢变化非周期链上具有长程随机相互作用 \(V_{ij}/|i-j|^\alpha\) 的量子态，涉及Hartree碎裂（Hartree fragmentation）与共振对网络结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当交叉参数 \(\alpha-2n\) 时，Hartree碎裂会重构共振客体系综：转折点运行片段碎裂成团簇，其内禀匹配律消除了对数奇异性，而孤立翼键以有限密度存活并恢复约化对数；配对标度 \(x_{\rm pair}^{4-2n-\alpha}\ln x_{\rm pair} \propto h^2/(V t_0)\) 保持不变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当交叉参数 \(\alpha-2n\) 时，Hartree碎裂会重构共振客体系综：转折点运行片段碎裂成团簇，其内禀匹配律消除了对数奇异性，而孤立翼键以有限密度存活并恢复约化对数；配对标度 \(x_{\rm pair}^{4-2n-\alpha}\ln x_{\rm pair} \propto h^2/(V t_0)\) 保持不变。；创新点：揭示了Hartree碎裂机制下非周期链中长程配对网络的普适重构规律，特别是对数奇异性的消除与恢复机制，以及随机/均匀系数涨落对耦合衰减幂次的不同影响。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论分析，基于标度论证与匹配律推导，考察随机相互作用系数涨落对长程耦合 \(R^{-\alpha}\) 的影响（均匀系数则抵消为 \(R^{-\alpha-2}\)）。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法。

papers.title: Coarse-grained simulations of dsDNA polycatenanes and network formation in annular nanochannels with topoisomerase II
papers.abstract: We numerically investigate the behavior of a system of initially unlinked nicked dsDNA rings confined into an annular square nanochannel in the presence of TopoII. Channel confinement can enhance the catenation likelihood by bringing highly bent regions from different rings in close proximity, while at the same time reducing the emergence of knots. The annular channel topology simplifies the characterization of the system by removing periodic boundary conditions and can lead to the formation of circular catenanes.We characterize the equilibrium and dynamical properties of the steady-state system, including the amount of catenation and the topologies explored by the system, under different parameters of the model and for different levels of confinement. We argue that a similar setup could allow for a direct comparison between experiments and simulations under well characterized and controlled conditions, thus providing a way to select and tune computational models of TopoII, as well as provide a way to obtain dsDNA interlocked materials in a controlled fashion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“numerically investigate”（数值研究）和“simulations”（模拟）。；研究对象：双链DNA（dsDNA）多连环体（polycatenanes）体系，具体为初始未连接的带切口dsDNA环，在环形方形纳米通道（annular square nanochannel）中、存在拓扑异构酶II（TopoII）时的行为，以及由此形成的DNA网络结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通道限制通过使不同DNA环的高弯曲区域靠近，增强了连环化（catenation）概率，同时减少了打结（knots）的出现；环形通道拓扑可导致环形连环体（circular catenanes）的形成，并便于系统表征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通道限制通过使不同DNA环的高弯曲区域靠近，增强了连环化（catenation）概率，同时减少了打结（knots）的出现；环形通道拓扑可导致环形连环体（circular catenanes）的形成，并便于系统表征。；创新点：提出利用环形纳米通道的拓扑结构（消除周期性边界条件）来简化系统表征，并论证该实验设置可在受控条件下直接比较实验与模拟，从而为TopoII计算模型的选择与调优提供途径，并有望以受控方式制备dsDNA互锁材料。
papers.method_zh: 粗粒化（coarse-grained）数值模拟，模拟了dsDNA多连环体在环形纳米通道中、存在TopoII时的稳态行为。摘要未明确说明具体模拟方法（如LAMMPS、布朗动力学等），仅提及“coarse-grained simulations”。

papers.title: Universal unconventional responses controlled by ferroaxial order
papers.abstract: Ferroaxial materials are an emerging class of ferroic materials that, in contrast to ferromagnets and ferroelectrics, are fully robust against stray fields, making them ideally suited for data storage and other nonvolatile applications. However, detection of the ferroaxial state remains challenging, as ferroaxiality does not manifest directly through a measurable macroscopic electric polarization or magnetization, and probes are mostly limited to optical methods. Here, we theoretically establish that ferroaxial order universally generates unconventional components of responses to external stimuli, such as the spin Hall effect, magneto-Seebeck effect, or Faraday effect, across a broad range of linear and nonlinear transport, optical and equilibrium phenomena. These unconventional responses are always directly coupled to ferroaxial order and can distinguish ferroaxial domains, providing probes of ferroaxial order. This general connection also reveals a largely unexplored class of ferroaxial metals, in which unconventional transport provides a natural probe of ferroaxial order, as demonstrated by our first-principles calculations for representative materials. Our results reveal a fundamentally different way for ferroic order to manifest -- ferroaxiality primarily shows unconventional material responses rather than the directly measurable order parameters, broadening the possibilities of nonvolatile ferroic control and flexible device design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“theoretically establish”“first-principles calculations”等关键词。；研究对象：铁轴性（ferroaxial）材料，包括铁轴性绝缘体和铁轴性金属，以及由铁轴序控制的非常规响应（如自旋霍尔效应、磁塞贝克效应、法拉第效应等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铁轴序能够普遍地产生对外部刺激的非常规响应分量（如自旋霍尔效应、磁塞贝克效应、法拉第效应等），这些响应与铁轴序直接耦合，可用于区分铁轴畴，从而作为探测铁轴序的普适探针。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铁轴序能够普遍地产生对外部刺激的非常规响应分量（如自旋霍尔效应、磁塞贝克效应、法拉第效应等），这些响应与铁轴序直接耦合，可用于区分铁轴畴，从而作为探测铁轴序的普适探针。；创新点：首次建立了铁轴序与多种非常规线性/非线性输运、光学及平衡态响应之间的普适联系，并提出了一类此前未被充分探索的铁轴性金属，其中非常规输运可作为铁轴序的自然探针。摘要未突出说明与具体实验的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），针对代表性材料进行具体验证。摘要未明确说明具体计算软件或泛函（如VASP、DFT+U等）。

papers.title: Coexistence of polariton bound states in the continuum and 2D radiative excitons
papers.abstract: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) enable optical modes with ideally infinite radiative lifetimes despite lying within the radiation continuum. Radiation-matter interaction in periodically patterned planar waveguides embedding two-dimensional (2D) optically active excitations can be described quantum mechanically by diagonalizing a non-Hermitian operator, known as the Hopfield matrix, which can be generalized to incorporate independent photonic and excitonic losses into the polaritonic states. However, since 2D excitons undergo intrinsic wavevector-dependent radiative decay within the light cone, whether the Hopfield formalism can consistently account for this process while preserving polariton BICs has remained an open question. Here we show that a non-Hermitian Hopfield formalism incorporating excitonic radiative losses correctly captures the existence of genuine $k=0$ polariton BICs with diverging radiative lifetimes. The theory provides a unified microscopic framework for radiative excitons and polariton BICs, and an efficient predictive tool for designing photonic-crystal platforms coupled to quantum wells, transition-metal dichalcogenides, and other 2D excitonic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“quantum mechanically by diagonalizing a non-Hermitian operator”“non-Hermitian Hopfield formalism”，属于理论建模与解析推导。；研究对象：周期性图案化平面波导中嵌入二维（2D）光学活性激子（如量子阱、过渡金属二硫化物等）所构成的极化激元体系，具体物理现象为连续谱中的束缚态（BIC）与二维辐射激子的共存。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在包含激子辐射损耗的非厄米Hopfield形式下，体系可以存在真正的k=0极化激元BIC，其辐射寿命发散；该理论为辐射激子与极化激元BIC提供了统一的微观描述框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在包含激子辐射损耗的非厄米Hopfield形式下，体系可以存在真正的k=0极化激元BIC，其辐射寿命发散；该理论为辐射激子与极化激元BIC提供了统一的微观描述框架。；创新点：首次证明非厄米Hopfield形式能够自洽地同时描述二维激子的辐射衰减与极化激元BIC的存在，解决了此前该形式是否能在保留BIC的同时正确计入激子辐射损耗的开放问题，并提供了面向光子晶体平台设计的预测工具。
papers.method_zh: 非厄米Hopfield矩阵对角化方法，该矩阵被推广以同时纳入独立的光子损耗和激子损耗，并特别处理二维激子固有的波矢依赖的辐射衰减（光锥内过程）。

papers.title: Halide donors in monoclinic- and corundum-phase Ga$_2$O$_3$ and Al$_2$O$_3$
papers.abstract: We present a systematic first-principles investigation of halide impurities (F and Cl) in Ga$_2$O$_3$ and Al$_2$O$_3$, considering both monoclinic and corundum phases. Our study of the structural properties, formation energies, and charge-state transition levels establishes the relative stability of different atomic configurations and charge states. We find that F and Cl on oxygen sites act as shallow donors in Ga$_2$O$_3$ in both the monoclinic and corundum phases. However, their behavior differs substantially as the band gap increases with greater Al compositions. Fluorine is prone to $DX$-center formation with increased Al composition, leading to self-compensation at 38% Al concentration in monoclinic (Al$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$)$_2$O$_3$ and 70% Al concentration in corundum (Al$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$)$_2$O$_3$. Chlorine is more resistant to $DX$-center formation: in monoclinic (Al$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$)$_2$O$_3$, Cl$_\mathrm{O}$ on the lowest-energy oxygen site shows an onset of $DX$ behavior at 50% alloy composition, while in corundum (Al$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$)$_2$O$_3$ this onset for Cl$_\mathrm{O}$ occurs only at Al concentrations as high as 84%. We also study F and Cl interstitials, finding that they act as compensating centers but also exhibit migration barriers that are low enough for them to be removed by post-growth annealing. Surprisingly, in both monoclinic and corundum Al$_2$O$_3$, Cl$_\mathrm{O}$ exhibits a relatively shallow transition level located at $\sim$0.48 eV below the conduction-band minimum, much shallower than F$_\mathrm{O}$ and other donor candidates. These remarkable results identify Cl as an unusually promising donor candidate in (Al$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$)$_2$O$_3$ alloys and even pure Al$_2$O$_3$, although high formation energies and compensation will render observation of true $n$-type conductivity in Al$_2$O$_3$ difficult.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要中明确提及“first-principles investigation”（第一性原理研究），并系统计算了结构性质、形成能和电荷态跃迁能级。；研究对象：卤素杂质（氟F和氯Cl）在单斜相（β相）和刚玉相（α相）Ga₂O₃与Al₂O₃及其合金(AlₓGa₁₋ₓ)₂O₃中的掺杂行为，具体包括替位氧位杂质（F_O、Cl_O）和间隙杂质（F_i、Cl_i）的稳定性、电荷态及对导电性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: F和Cl在Ga₂O₃中均为浅施主，但随着Al组分增加（带隙增大），F极易形成DX中心导致自补偿；而Cl对DX中心形成具有更强的抵抗性，甚至在纯Al₂O₃中仍表现出相对较浅的施主能级（~0.48 eV），是(AlₓGa₁₋ₓ)₂O₃合金中异常有前景的施主候选者。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：F和Cl在Ga₂O₃中均为浅施主，但随着Al组分增加（带隙增大），F极易形成DX中心导致自补偿；而Cl对DX中心形成具有更强的抵抗性，甚至在纯Al₂O₃中仍表现出相对较浅的施主能级（~0.48 eV），是(AlₓGa₁₋ₓ)₂O₃合金中异常有前景的施主候选者。；创新点：首次系统对比了F和Cl在两种晶相（单斜与刚玉）的Ga₂O₃/Al₂O₃及合金中的施主行为，并揭示了Cl在宽带隙Al₂O₃中作为浅施主的独特潜力（远优于F及其他常见施主），同时指出了其高形成能和补偿效应带来的实际掺杂困难。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（基于密度泛函理论，DFT），具体包括：结构性质计算、形成能计算、电荷态跃迁能级（热力学跃迁能级）分析，以及迁移势垒（迁移能）计算。

papers.title: Active Brownian Dynamics from a Hamiltonian Model: Transitioning from Equilibrium to Activity
papers.abstract: We introduce a Hamiltonian Active Brownian Particle (HABP) model that connects equilibrium dynamics with the non-equilibrium, two-dimensional overdamped behavior of standard Active Brownian Particles (ABPs). In equilibrium, the system follows overdamped Langevin equations that strictly satisfy the fluctuation-dissipation theorem. Coupling translational and rotational degrees of freedom to separate heat baths ($T_θ > T_{\textrm{tr}}$), drives the system out of equilibrium. In free space, matching the diffusion coefficients yields quantitative agreement with the ABP model in the limit $T_θ/T_{\textrm{tr}}\to \infty$, whereas in a harmonic potential, this matching is recovered even at finite temperature ratios. Entropy production analysis demonstrates that in the ABP limit, all energy injected by the swim force dissipates into the translational bath, leaving the rotational bath as a zero-cost entropy source. These insights provide the first steps toward equilibrium-inspired descriptions of active matter, facilitating the development of new theoretical frameworks to study activity-induced fluctuations, transport, and phase behavior in living and non-living soft matter systems far from equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Hamiltonian model”“overdamped Langevin equations”“entropy production analysis”等理论建模与统计物理分析关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：活性布朗粒子（ABPs）的非平衡动力学，具体研究从平衡态到活性态的过渡，涉及平动与转动自由度耦合、热浴温度差驱动的非平衡稳态，以及自由空间和谐波势阱中的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入哈密顿活性布朗粒子（HABP）模型，在扩散系数匹配条件下，自由空间中当温度比 \(T_\theta/T_{\mathrm{tr}}\to\infty\) 时定量复现标准ABP行为；在谐波势中有限温度比下即可恢复该匹配。熵产生分析表明，ABP极限下泳力注入的能量全部耗散到平动热浴，转动热浴成为零成本熵源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入哈密顿活性布朗粒子（HABP）模型，在扩散系数匹配条件下，自由空间中当温度比 \(T_\theta/T_{\mathrm{tr}}\to\infty\) 时定量复现标准ABP行为；在谐波势中有限温度比下即可恢复该匹配。熵产生分析表明，ABP极限下泳力注入的能量全部耗散到平动热浴，转动热浴成为零成本熵源。；创新点：首次从哈密顿模型出发，建立平衡动力学与标准过阻尼ABP非平衡行为之间的严格桥梁，揭示了转动热浴在熵产生中的“零成本”角色，为活性物质的平衡化描述提供了新理论起点。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：哈密顿动力学建模，将平动与转动自由度耦合到不同温度的热浴（\(T_\theta > T_{\mathrm{tr}}\)），推导过阻尼朗之万方程；采用熵产生率分析；通过扩散系数匹配与标准ABP模型进行定量对比。

papers.title: Terahertz Control of Optical Second-Harmonic Generation in Displacive Ferroelectrics: Electronic Bloch-State Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Optical second-harmonic generation (SHG) is a powerful probe of ferroelectric order, yet its microscopic origin and dynamical control are often understood primarily from symmetry considerations rather than from the underlying electronic processes. Here, we develop a microscopic theory of terahertz-controlled optical SHG in displacive ferroelectrics, establishing a direct connection between THz-driven polar lattice distortions and the resulting electronic nonlinear optical response. Starting from a complete Bloch-band representation, we show that an inversion-breaking lattice distortion reconstructs electronic Bloch wave functions, modifies optical dipole matrix elements, and activates nonlinear optical pathways that are forbidden in the centrosymmetric structure. We derive the second-order susceptibility in terms of the distortion-induced reconstruction of electronic states and optical transition matrix elements, and demonstrate that the electronic SHG susceptibility is linear in the polar distortion, $χ^{(2)}({\bf Q})\propto{\bf Q}$, leading to an SHG intensity quadratic in the inversion-breaking order parameter. When the polar mode is coherently driven by a terahertz electric field, the resulting time-dependent lattice distortion dynamically reconstructs the electronic states and thereby modulates the optical SHG response, with $I_{2ω}(t)\propto|{\bf Q}(t)|^2$ to leading order. This framework distinguishes the THz-driven lattice dynamics from the electronic interband processes responsible for optical SHG, which is particularly important in insulating ferroelectrics where low-energy carrier dynamics are absent. Our theory thus provides a microscopic bridge between nonequilibrium polar lattice dynamics and ultrafast electronic nonlinear optics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“develop a microscopic theory”“We derive”“We show”等表述，属于理论推导与建模研究。；研究对象：位移型铁电体（displacive ferroelectrics）中，太赫兹场驱动的极性晶格畸变与光学二次谐波产生（SHG）之间的微观联系，重点研究电子布洛赫态在畸变下的重构及其非线性光学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出电子SHG极化率与极性畸变呈线性关系，χ^(2)(Q) ∝ Q，因此SHG强度与反演对称性破缺序参量的平方成正比；在太赫兹相干驱动下，SHG强度随时间满足 I₂ω(t) ∝ |Q(t)|²（至领头阶）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出电子SHG极化率与极性畸变呈线性关系，χ^(2)(Q) ∝ Q，因此SHG强度与反演对称性破缺序参量的平方成正比；在太赫兹相干驱动下，SHG强度随时间满足 I₂ω(t) ∝ |Q(t)|²（至领头阶）。；创新点：建立了非平衡极性晶格动力学与超快电子非线性光学之间的微观桥梁，明确将太赫兹驱动的晶格运动与电子带间跃迁过程在理论上分离，特别适用于缺乏低能载流子动力学的绝缘铁电体。摘要未突出说明与以往唯象对称性分析相比的具体理论突破细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于完整布洛赫带表示（complete Bloch-band representation）的微观理论推导。具体包括：分析反演对称性破缺晶格畸变对电子布洛赫波函数的重构、光学偶极矩阵元的修正，以及非线性光学跃迁路径的激活；推导二阶极化率与畸变诱导电子态重构的关系；并区分太赫兹驱动的晶格动力学与负责SHG的电子带间过程。

papers.title: Emergence and suppression of phonon vortices in two-dimensional crystals: Interplay of lattice symmetry, heavy impurities, and shear
papers.abstract: Phonon vortices are vortex-like displacement fields that appear in the vibrational modes of two- dimensional materials. Here, we demonstrate that these vortices arise as symmetry-adapted linear combinations of degenerate planar phonon modes, with the superposition coefficients uniquely de- termined by the lattice point group. This symmetry principle establishes that vortices are intrinsic standing-wave solutions in perfect crystals, requiring neither impurities nor disorder. A heavy mass impurity favors vortex modes over planar modes through stronger resonance-induced frequency soft- ening, whereas shear deformation suppresses vortex modes by breaking rotational symmetry. The competition between these two effects gives rise to a precisely predictable strain threshold. The proposed framework, grounded in symmetry and energy-minimization, provides a useful basis for understanding vibrational topological defects induced by other types of impurities or defects. This study further suggests that defect and shear engineering constitutes an effective tuning strategy for controlling vibrational modes and the associated thermal and mechanical properties of crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中强调“symmetry principle”“symmetry-adapted linear combinations”“energy-minimization”等理论框架，以及“precisely predictable strain threshold”的预测性表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维晶体中的声子涡旋（phonon vortices），具体研究晶格对称性、重质量杂质和剪切形变对声子涡旋产生与抑制的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 声子涡旋是完美晶体中由晶格点群对称性唯一确定的简并平面声子模式的对称适配线性组合，属于本征驻波解，无需杂质或无序；重杂质通过共振诱导频率软化增强涡旋模式，而剪切形变通过破缺旋转对称性抑制涡旋模式，二者竞争产生可精确预测的应变阈值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：声子涡旋是完美晶体中由晶格点群对称性唯一确定的简并平面声子模式的对称适配线性组合，属于本征驻波解，无需杂质或无序；重杂质通过共振诱导频率软化增强涡旋模式，而剪切形变通过破缺旋转对称性抑制涡旋模式，二者竞争产生可精确预测的应变阈值。；创新点：首次从晶格点群对称性出发，证明声子涡旋是完美晶体的本征解（无需杂质），并定量揭示重杂质与剪切形变对涡旋模式的竞争机制，给出可预测的应变阈值，为缺陷/应变工程调控振动模式及热-力学性质提供了统一理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于群论/点群对称性分析（对称适配线性组合），结合能量最小化原理，建立声子涡旋的存在条件与应变阈值的理论框架。摘要未提及具体数值计算方法（如DFT或分子动力学）。

papers.title: Topological and spin-orbit effects on orbital moments in ultra-thin magnetic films
papers.abstract: Topological orbital moments (TOMs) are a direct hallmark of a magnetic texture with a non-trivial spin topology. In addition to giving insight into the topology of the magnetic texture, TOMs could also be used to manipulate magnetic structures with a compensated total spin moment. Experimental evidence of TOMs has been provided via transport measurements of the Hall effect in intercalated van-der-Waals materials. However, a direct observation of TOMs is still missing. Another complication arises for the unambiguous proof of the topological origin since orbital moments can also occur due to spin-orbit coupling. Here, we use first-principles electronic structure theory to investigate the origin of orbital moments in different compensated spin structures with a non-trivial topology. We focus on ultrathin magnetic films at surfaces such as Pd/Mn bilayers on Re(0001) which represent ideal model systems for the detection of TOMs since it is possible to apply experimental techniques with local resolution of magnetic properties such as spin-polarized scanning tunneling microscopy. Due to its trivial topology we use the row-wise antiferromagnetic (RW-AFM) state in a hexagonal monolayer to analyze the spin-orbit induced contributions. The triple-Q (3Q) state is a superposition state of three RW-AFM (1Q) states and thus electronically similar, however, due to its non-trivial spin topology it exhibits TOMs. The comparison between these two spin states allows us to disentangle the topological and spin-orbit contributions to the orbital moments. We find that TOMs have an important contribution in spin-compensated systems, since the spin-orbit coupling induced orbital moments are nearly compensated. First-principles calculations for atomic-scale skyrmion lattices in Fe monolayers on different surfaces exhibit the same general trend found for the 3Q state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles electronic structure theory”（第一性原理电子结构理论）和“First-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：超薄磁性薄膜中的轨道矩（orbital moments），具体体系包括：Re(0001)表面上的Pd/Mn双层膜、六角单层膜中的行状反铁磁（RW-AFM）态与三重Q（3Q）态，以及不同表面上Fe单层膜中的原子级斯格明子晶格（skyrmion lattices）。核心物理现象为拓扑轨道矩（TOMs）与自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）诱导轨道矩的区分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋补偿体系中，拓扑轨道矩（TOMs）具有重要贡献，而自旋-轨道耦合诱导的轨道矩几乎相互抵消；通过对比拓扑平庸的RW-AFM态与拓扑非平庸的3Q态，可以分离出轨道矩中的拓扑贡献与自旋-轨道耦合贡献。Fe单层膜中原子级斯格明子晶格的计算结果与3Q态呈现相同趋势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋补偿体系中，拓扑轨道矩（TOMs）具有重要贡献，而自旋-轨道耦合诱导的轨道矩几乎相互抵消；通过对比拓扑平庸的RW-AFM态与拓扑非平庸的3Q态，可以分离出轨道矩中的拓扑贡献与自旋-轨道耦合贡献。Fe单层膜中原子级斯格明子晶格的计算结果与3Q态呈现相同趋势。；创新点：通过直接对比电子结构相似的拓扑平庸态（RW-AFM）与拓扑非平庸态（3Q）来系统分离轨道矩中的拓扑贡献与自旋-轨道耦合贡献，为实验上直接探测TOMs提供了理论判据和模型体系（如Pd/Mn/Re(0001)），并推广到原子级斯格明子晶格。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理电子结构计算（first-principles electronic structure theory），具体用于计算不同自旋结构（RW-AFM、3Q态、斯格明子晶格）中的轨道矩，并通过对比拓扑平庸与拓扑非平庸自旋态来分解轨道矩的拓扑与SOC贡献。摘要未明确说明具体计算代码或泛函（如DFT+U等）。

papers.title: Effective Hardcore Exclusion Without Exclusion: Two-Species Pair Annihilation Revisited
papers.abstract: Reaction-diffusion systems with two species that mutually annihilate through $A+B\to\emptyset$ reactions display a slow decay of the total density $ρ$ which follows an anomalous power law in low dimensions. For hardcore particles in one dimension, this decay follows $ρ\sim t^{-1/4}$ under symmetric diffusion and $ρ\sim t^{-1/3}$ under asymmetric diffusion without relative bias between the two species. The $t^{-1/3}$ behavior, in particular, has so far been observed exclusively in systems with hardcore exclusion. Here we construct a model of particles without hardcore exclusion that reproduces this same $t^{-1/3}$ scaling. In our model, both species undergo asymmetric diffusion with a rate that depends nonlinearly on the local density, a form of transport that, in the absence of the other species, is superdiffusive and falls into the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang universality class. The scaling behavior of $t^{-1/3}$ occurs when at least one of the two species undergoes asymmetric diffusion induced by microscopic processes involving pairs of particles, while asymmetric processes involving groups of three particles lead to $t^{-1/4}$ scaling associated with symmetric diffusion. This demonstrates that the pair annihilation density decay exponent is not determined exclusively by the transport properties of the isolated particle species.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。摘要中未提及实验或数值模拟细节，主要基于理论分析与模型构造，关键词如“construct a model”“scaling behavior”表明为理论/解析研究。；研究对象：双物种（A+B→∅）对湮灭反应-扩散系统，特别关注一维无硬核排斥条件下粒子密度衰减的动力学标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了一个无硬核排斥的粒子模型，通过非线性密度依赖的非对称扩散（孤立物种呈超扩散并属于KPZ普适类），成功复现了此前仅在硬核排斥系统中观察到的密度衰减指数ρ∼t^{-1/3}。该指数出现于至少一种物种经历由双粒子微观过程诱导的非对称扩散时，而三粒子过程则导致与对称扩散相关的t^{-1/4}标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了一个无硬核排斥的粒子模型，通过非线性密度依赖的非对称扩散（孤立物种呈超扩散并属于KPZ普适类），成功复现了此前仅在硬核排斥系统中观察到的密度衰减指数ρ∼t^{-1/3}。该指数出现于至少一种物种经历由双粒子微观过程诱导的非对称扩散时，而三粒子过程则导致与对称扩散相关的t^{-1/4}标度。；创新点：首次证明对湮灭密度衰减指数并非仅由孤立物种的输运性质决定——即使没有硬核排斥，只要非对称扩散由双粒子微观过程驱动，即可重现t^{-1/3}标度，打破了该指数与硬核排斥之间的必然联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与标度分析。具体为：设计无硬核排斥的粒子模型，引入依赖于局部密度的非线性非对称扩散速率；通过对比不同微观过程（双粒子 vs 三粒子诱导的非对称扩散）分析密度衰减幂律指数，并与已知的硬核排斥系统结果（t^{-1/4}与t^{-1/3}）进行对照。

papers.title: Predictive wavelength tailoring of uniform GaSb-based quantum dots for emission at 1.55 um
papers.abstract: A detailed study of emission wavelength tailoring of GaSb-based QDs formed by InGaSb-filling of droplet-etched nanoholes in AlGaSb is presented. The study shows that the emission wavelength can be modified from 1.48 um to the center of the telecom C-band at 1.55 mm by independently varying the QD composition and size. More specifically, the optical transition energy shifts linearly as a function of In-content of the QD material at a rate of -4.4 meV/In-percentage, and with the number of monolayers (ML) of material used for filling the nanoholes, at -2.0 meV/ML. These experimentally observed energy shifts are well predicted by simulations yielding rates of -4.3 meV/In-percentage and -2.1 meV/ML, respectively. For the simulation, a uniform In composition, low intermixing, and microscopically measured QD geometry is considered. Additionally, excellent ensemble QD uniformity, with unprecedented inhomogeneous broadening well-below 7 meV across all samples is demonstrated. Finally, photoluminescence of single-QDs reveals narrow excitonic emission lines of 13.8+/-6.7 ueV and low fine-structure splitting values reaching <10 ueV. These results identify GaSb-based LDE QDs as a tunable telecom platform for scaling quantum-photonic applications over long-haul optical fiber networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含模拟对比）。判断依据：摘要描述“detailed study”“experimentally observed”“photoluminescence”等实验手段，同时提及“simulations”作为辅助验证。；研究对象：GaSb基量子点体系，具体为通过InGaSb填充液滴刻蚀纳米孔（droplet-etched nanoholes）在AlGaSb势垒中形成的量子点，目标调控其发光波长至1.55 μm电信C波段。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过独立调控量子点的In组分和尺寸（填充单层数），可将发射波长从1.48 μm调至1.55 μm，且实验测得的跃迁能量随In含量和单层数的线性变化率（-4.4 meV/In%、-2.0 meV/ML）与模拟预测（-4.3 meV/In%、-2.1 meV/ML）高度吻合。同时实现了极低的非均匀展宽（<7 meV）和单量子点窄激子发射线（13.8±6.7 μeV）及低精细结构劈裂（<10 μeV）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过独立调控量子点的In组分和尺寸（填充单层数），可将发射波长从1.48 μm调至1.55 μm，且实验测得的跃迁能量随In含量和单层数的线性变化率（-4.4 meV/In%、-2.0 meV/ML）与模拟预测（-4.3 meV/In%、-2.1 meV/ML）高度吻合。同时实现了极低的非均匀展宽（<7 meV）和单量子点窄激子发射线（13.8±6.7 μeV）及低精细结构劈裂（<10 μeV）。；创新点：首次系统展示GaSb基液滴刻蚀（LDE）量子点可通过独立调节组分和尺寸实现发射波长精确覆盖电信C波段（1.55 μm），并兼具极低非均匀展宽（<7 meV）和单量子点优异光学质量（窄线宽、低精细结构劈裂），为长距离光纤网络中的可调谐量子光子平台提供了新方案。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长液滴刻蚀纳米孔并填充InGaSb形成量子点；光致发光（PL）谱测量发射波长与能量位移；单量子点PL谱测量激子线宽和精细结构劈裂；基于均匀In组分、低互混和显微实测量子点几何结构的数值模拟计算光学跃迁能量。

papers.title: Time-delayed feedback turns Arrhenius escape logarithmic
papers.abstract: Thermal escape is governed by the Arrhenius law, where the mean escape time scales exponentially with the barrier height. We show that the non-Markovianity induced by time-delayed feedback in the confining force removes this exponential scaling. Beyond a threshold set by the curvature of the minimum, the delay destabilizes the well, and the thermal noise seeds an instability that is subsequently amplified deterministically to the boundary leading to \textit{slingshot} escape trajectories. The escape time becomes logarithmic in the barrier, its fluctuations follow a Gumbel law, and an optimal delay enables escape faster than free diffusion. Our results propose time delay as a tunable and experimentally feasible control parameter for accelerating activated processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论推导（“We show that...”）、标度行为分析（“escape time becomes logarithmic”）以及统计分布（“Gumbel law”），未提及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：热激活逃逸过程（Arrhenius escape）在含时延反馈的非马尔可夫动力学中的行为，具体为势阱中粒子在热噪声和时延反馈共同作用下的逃逸问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时延反馈引入的非马尔可夫性可消除逃逸时间的指数标度（Arrhenius定律），使逃逸时间随势垒高度呈对数标度；在最优时延下，逃逸甚至比自由扩散更快。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时延反馈引入的非马尔可夫性可消除逃逸时间的指数标度（Arrhenius定律），使逃逸时间随势垒高度呈对数标度；在最优时延下，逃逸甚至比自由扩散更快。；创新点：首次提出将时延反馈作为可调控制参数来加速激活过程，揭示了非马尔可夫性导致的“弹弓”（slingshot）逃逸轨迹这一新机制，并证明逃逸时间从指数标度转变为对数标度。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于朗之万方程（Langevin dynamics）描述含时延反馈的逃逸动力学，通过线性稳定性分析确定时延失稳阈值，结合噪声种子放大机制推导逃逸时间标度，并利用极值统计（Gumbel分布）刻画逃逸时间涨落。

papers.title: Layer Axial Phonons and Dipolar Thermal Response in Centrosymmetric Thin Films
papers.abstract: In nonmagnetic centrosymmetric materials, $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetry enforces vanishing total phonon angular momentum (phonon AM) at every wave vector, making them appear unsuitable as hosts of axial phonons. Here, using first-principles calculations for BaAgAs and representative van der Waal's layered materials, we show that centrosymmetric slabs can still host large hidden layer-resolved phonon AM with both chiral and cycloidal modes. This hidden phonon AM texture produces layer resolved phonon thermal Edelstein-like responses and a real-space phonon AM dipole response, both tunable by strain. Our results establish centrosymmetric layered materials as an exciting platform for hidden axial phonon and multipolar phonon thermal response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“using first-principles calculations”。；研究对象：中心对称薄膜材料中的层分辨声子角动量（layer-resolved phonon AM）及其热响应，具体材料包括BaAgAs和代表性范德华层状材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非磁性中心对称材料中，尽管体相受PT对称性约束总声子角动量为零，但中心对称薄膜仍可承载巨大的隐藏层分辨声子角动量，包含手性和摆线（cycloidal）两种模式，并产生层分辨的声子热Edelstein类响应及实空间声子角动量偶极响应，且均可由应变调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非磁性中心对称材料中，尽管体相受PT对称性约束总声子角动量为零，但中心对称薄膜仍可承载巨大的隐藏层分辨声子角动量，包含手性和摆线（cycloidal）两种模式，并产生层分辨的声子热Edelstein类响应及实空间声子角动量偶极响应，且均可由应变调控。；创新点：突破了中心对称材料因PT对称性导致总声子角动量为零、因而被认为不适合承载轴向声子的传统认知，揭示了隐藏的层分辨声子角动量及其多极热响应，并建立了应变调控手段。摘要未突出说明与已有非中心对称体系研究的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体针对BaAgAs和范德华层状材料进行声子能带与角动量性质计算。

papers.title: Quadratic pair-breaking absorption edge from Anderson localization in a superconducting wire
papers.abstract: We show that Anderson localization fundamentally reshapes dissipative superconducting electrodynamics, replacing the linear Mattis--Bardeen pair-breaking onset with a parametrically weaker quadratic Mott edge while leaving the quasiparticle spectrum unchanged. We derive this behavior for a weakly disordered single-channel wire with a spatially uniform $s$-wave pair potential using a Nambu-space extension of the Berezinskii diagram technique that resums elastic impurity scattering to all orders. Conservation of the Bogoliubov branch collapses the Nambu diagram hierarchy onto an exactly solvable localization problem. The localization length remains equal to its normal-state value, whereas the localization time diverges at the gap edge. The new absorption edge results from the product of the superconducting pair-creation coherence factor and the Mott-suppressed current matrix elements between localized orbitals, which generates the characteristic double logarithm. Localization also reduces the Hebel--Slichter coherence peak. The resulting theory provides an all-orders benchmark for microwave and spin-relaxation experiments on localized superconducting nanowires.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show”“We derive”“diagram technique”“exactly solvable”等理论推导关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：弱无序单通道超导纳米线（s-wave，空间均匀配对势），具体研究安德森局域化对耗散性超导电动力学的影响，尤其是对配对破缺吸收边和准粒子谱的修正。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 安德森局域化将超导配对破缺吸收边从线性Mattis–Bardeen行为改写为参数上更弱的二次Mott型吸收边（特征为双对数行为），同时准粒子谱保持不变；局域化还抑制了Hebel–Slichter相干峰。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：安德森局域化将超导配对破缺吸收边从线性Mattis–Bardeen行为改写为参数上更弱的二次Mott型吸收边（特征为双对数行为），同时准粒子谱保持不变；局域化还抑制了Hebel–Slichter相干峰。；创新点：首次证明安德森局域化从根本上重塑超导配对破缺吸收边（线性→二次Mott边），并给出全阶基准理论；发现局域化长度保持正常态值而局域化时间在能隙边缘发散，这一非平凡组合源于配对相干因子与局域轨道间Mott抑制电流矩阵元的乘积。摘要未突出说明与具体实验材料的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: Nambu空间的Berezinskii图技术扩展，对弹性杂质散射进行全阶重求和；利用Bogoliubov支守恒将Nambu图层级约化为可精确求解的局域化问题。

papers.title: Freezing of a deformable water-saturated porous medium. Part I: THM formulation, OpenGeoSys-6 implementation and benchmarking
papers.abstract: In this contribution, Part I, we present a coupled thermo-hydro-mechanical formulation for modeling and analyzing water-to-ice phase change in a deformable fully-saturated porous medium. It is implemented in the multi-physics computational platform OpenGeoSys-6. We compute a series of carefully designed benchmark problems which critically examine the corresponding formulation components and the overall implementation. Several ingredients that have a qualitative and quantitative impact on the numerical results are identified, particularly dissected and commented on. Simulations also account for soil deformation induced by freezing (as a result of 9% volumetric expansion caused by water-to-ice phase transition). The forthcoming Part II will complete the code verification and validation campaign by considering a real full-scale three-dimensional case study of shallow subsurface ice storage. More specifically, we simulate the ice growth process in a fully saturated soil specimen surrounding a group of borehole heat exchangers (BHEs) that contain subzero temperature coolant fluid. A snapshot of the numerical results of this task is already depicted here in Part I as a teaser.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数值模拟文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“implemented in the multi-physics computational platform OpenGeoSys-6”，并强调“benchmark problems”和“simulations”。；研究对象：可变形、完全饱和的多孔介质中水到冰的相变过程（冻土冻结），具体涉及土壤冻结引起的变形（水-冰相变导致9%体积膨胀），以及浅层地下冰储存系统中 borehole heat exchangers（BHEs）周围的冰生长过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未给出明确的单一物理结论，主要贡献在于提出并实现了一个耦合的热-水-力学（THM）数值框架，并通过系列基准算例识别出若干对数值结果有定性和定量影响的关键因素（具体因素摘要未展开说明）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未给出明确的单一物理结论，主要贡献在于提出并实现了一个耦合的热-水-力学（THM）数值框架，并通过系列基准算例识别出若干对数值结果有定性和定量影响的关键因素（具体因素摘要未展开说明）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的独特创新点，但可看出其贡献在于：在OpenGeoSys-6中完整实现THM耦合的冻土相变模型，并通过系统基准测试对关键影响因素进行剖析；同时预告了Part II将进行全尺寸三维实际案例验证。
papers.method_zh: 基于OpenGeoSys-6多物理场计算平台，实现耦合的热-水-力学（THM）有限元数值模型，用于模拟饱和多孔介质中水-冰相变及伴随的土壤变形。通过设计一系列基准算例（benchmark problems）对公式组件和整体实现进行检验。

papers.title: Machine learning reveals common features of unconventional superconductors with high transition temperatures
papers.abstract: Superconductors with high critical temperatures that emerges beyond the phonon-mediated regime are usually considered unconventional in nature, yet unlike conventional superconductors, no broadly applicable predictive theory currently guides their discovery. Here, we use interpretable machine learning to uncover a common materials-space signature of high-$T_{\mathrm{c}}$ unconventional superconductors and develop a data-driven strategy for materials discovery. We construct a unified feature representation for each material by integrating compositional statistics, structural information, and latent representations from trained property-prediction models, followed by structure-aware filtering of an experimentally established superconducting dataset. Without using transition-temperature information, unsupervised analysis shows that cuprate and iron-based superconductors occupy a common region of materials space, characterized primarily by large electronegativity deviation and intermediate mean valence-electron number. A supervised $T_{\text{c}}$ model independently identifies the same descriptors as dominant features, providing complementary evidence for their relevance. Using this empirical materials-space prior together with the $T_{\text{c}}$ model, we prioritize candidate materials, recover recently discovered nickelate superconductors, and identify chemically distinct candidates for future investigation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据驱动文章。判断依据关键词：machine learning、unsupervised analysis、supervised model、data-driven strategy。；研究对象：非常规超导体（包括铜氧化物、铁基超导体、镍基超导体等），重点关注其高临界温度（\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)）的共同材料空间特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过可解释机器学习，发现高\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)非常规超导体在材料空间中具有共同特征，主要由大的电负性偏差和中等平均价电子数主导；该特征可用于优先筛选候选材料，并成功识别出近期发现的镍基超导体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过可解释机器学习，发现高\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)非常规超导体在材料空间中具有共同特征，主要由大的电负性偏差和中等平均价电子数主导；该特征可用于优先筛选候选材料，并成功识别出近期发现的镍基超导体。；创新点：在不使用\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)信息的情况下，通过无监督学习独立发现铜基和铁基超导体共享同一材料空间区域，并利用该经验先验结合\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)模型实现数据驱动的材料发现策略，而非依赖传统理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用可解释机器学习方法，构建统一特征表示（整合组分统计、结构信息以及预训练性质预测模型的潜在表示），对实验超导数据集进行结构感知过滤；使用无监督分析（聚类）和有监督\(T_{\mathrm{c}}\)预测模型（特征重要性分析）交叉验证。

papers.title: A closed-form theory of charge-regulated electrostatic interactions between anisotropically charged spheres
papers.abstract: Proteins and many other colloids carry ionizable surface groups that are both spatially inhomogeneous (patchy) and pH-responsive (charge-regulating). In the description of the electrostatic interactions between such particles, these two aspects are often treated separately, especially from a theoretical perspective. We present a unified, closed-form theory that unites charge regulation and patchiness within the linearized Poisson--Boltzmann approximation. For spherical particles with anisotropic distributions of titratable sites, we derive both the leading-order mean-field interaction energy as well as the Kirkwood--Shumaker fluctuation interaction. The theory exposes a qualitatively new effect between two electroneutral anisotropic particles: proximity-induced charge regulation generates a net monopole, and splits orientational branches that are degenerate in any linear fixed-charge model. The accompanying correction to the interaction energy has no fixed sign---it softens like-charge repulsion but can deepen or create attraction away from the isoelectric point. We benchmark three ingredients of the theory against published results; no existing simulation probes their combination, which would capture the central prediction of the theory. Lastly, we apply the theory to two proteins---lysozyme and $α$-chymotrypsinogen A---and show that it not only reproduces the measured second virial coefficients reasonably well but also predicts how charge regulation expands the range of pH and screening strength where the protein--protein interaction is attractive.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“closed-form theory”“linearized Poisson–Boltzmann approximation”“derive”，属于解析理论推导，无实验或数值模拟数据。；研究对象：带各向异性电荷分布（patchy）且具有pH响应性（charge-regulating）的球形胶体粒子（如蛋白质）之间的静电相互作用，具体应用对象为溶菌酶（lysozyme）和α-胰凝乳蛋白酶原A（α-chymotrypsinogen A）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该理论揭示了一个全新的物理效应：两个电中性但各向异性带电的粒子在近距离时，由邻近诱导的电荷调节会产生净单极矩，并分裂在固定电荷线性模型中简并的取向分支。该相互作用能修正项的符号不固定——它软化同号电荷排斥，但在等电点附近可加深或产生吸引。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该理论揭示了一个全新的物理效应：两个电中性但各向异性带电的粒子在近距离时，由邻近诱导的电荷调节会产生净单极矩，并分裂在固定电荷线性模型中简并的取向分支。该相互作用能修正项的符号不固定——它软化同号电荷排斥，但在等电点附近可加深或产生吸引。；创新点：首次将电荷调节（charge regulation）与电荷斑块各向异性（patchiness）统一在一个闭式解析理论框架中，而非像以往那样分别处理。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 在线性化Poisson–Boltzmann近似下，对具有各向异性可滴定位点分布的球形粒子，解析推导了领头阶平均场相互作用能以及Kirkwood–Shumaker涨落相互作用能。理论结果与已发表的三个独立基准进行了对比验证，并应用于实际蛋白质体系计算第二维里系数。

papers.title: Heterogeneous ferroelectricity and conductivity of oxidized BaTiO$_3$ crystals: the role of nanoscale phase segregation in the surface region
papers.abstract: We investigate the effect of thermal oxidation on BaTiO$_3$ single crystals. Our results reveal that, even at moderate temperatures of up to 1000 °C, complex segregation mechanisms occur involving the movement of Ba-rich compounds to the upper surface, where they form inhomogeneously distributed BaO nanocrystals. As a result, deeper regions of the surface layer become depleted in Ba and become TiO$_2$-rich. A sandwich-like structure evolves in the surface layer, exhibiting a measurable electromotive force and self-polarization. This, in turn, screens the polarization and diminishes the global ferroelectric response. The conductivity is also strongly influenced by the irreversible segregation effects in the surface region. An as-received crystal can be transformed into a metallic state, while oxidation induces semiconducting properties and prevents a return to the metallic state upon subsequent reduction. Nanoscale analysis demonstrates that the conductivity is channeled to filaments forming along dislocations, whose local chemical composition changes upon reduction and oxidation even at moderate temperatures due to preferential Ba and O pipe diffusion thus determining the electric behavior of the whole sample.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要描述了对BaTiO₃单晶的热氧化实验、结构表征（纳米尺度分析）及电学性质测量。；研究对象：氧化处理的BaTiO₃单晶，重点研究表面区域纳米尺度相分离对铁电性和导电性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使在1000°C的温和温度下，热氧化也会引发Ba富集化合物向表面迁移并形成BaO纳米晶，导致表面层形成Ba贫化/TiO₂-rich的三明治结构，产生自极化和电动势，同时屏蔽极化并削弱宏观铁电响应；氧化还使晶体从金属态转变为半导体态，且不可逆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使在1000°C的温和温度下，热氧化也会引发Ba富集化合物向表面迁移并形成BaO纳米晶，导致表面层形成Ba贫化/TiO₂-rich的三明治结构，产生自极化和电动势，同时屏蔽极化并削弱宏观铁电响应；氧化还使晶体从金属态转变为半导体态，且不可逆。；创新点：揭示了即使在中等温度下，BaTiO₃表面区域也会发生不可逆的纳米尺度相分离，并首次指出导电性沿位错形成的丝状通道传输，其局部化学组成因Ba和O的管道扩散而改变，从而决定整个样品的电学行为。
papers.method_zh: 热氧化处理（最高1000°C）、纳米尺度成分/结构分析（用于表征表面相分离和位错处的化学组成变化）、电学输运测量（电导率、电动势、自极化）、还原/氧化循环实验。

papers.title: Temperature Dependence of the Refractive Index for AlAsGaSb
papers.abstract: Accurate design and optimization of photonic multilayer structures like distributed Bragg reflectors (DBRs) require precise knowledge of material optical constants, particularly the temperature dependence of the refractive index. While these parameters are well established for widely used semiconductors, for emerging materials such as antimonides they are often limited to room-temperature data, especially for new spectral ranges of interest. Antimonide compounds, in particular GaSb-based alloys, are promising for quantum photonics applications. In this work, we investigated DBRs lattice-matched to GaSb and designed for operation in the third telecommunication window. Reflectivity spectra were measured in the temperature range from 11.5 K to 300 K, and then fitted using the transfer matrix method (TMM), combined with a dedicated recursive numerical fitting algorithm. Initial parameters included layer thicknesses determined by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and literature values of refractive indices at room temperature. This approach enabled extraction of the temperature-dependent refractive indices of two AlGaAsSb alloys suitable for forming DBR mirrors for 1.5 um wavelengths. The obtained results provide essential input for reliable DBR design, ensuring proper stopband positioning and high reflectivity under cryogenic operating conditions required for efficient quantum emitter performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要中描述了反射谱测量（Reflectivity spectra were measured）、扫描电子显微镜表征（SEM）以及传输矩阵法拟合实验数据。；研究对象：AlGaAsSb合金材料（具体为两种AlGaAsSb合金），用于与GaSb衬底晶格匹配、工作在1.5 μm（第三电信窗口）的分布式布拉格反射镜（DBR）结构。研究聚焦于该材料折射率的温度依赖性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在11.5 K至300 K温度范围内，通过拟合DBR反射谱提取了两种AlGaAsSb合金的温度依赖折射率，为低温下1.5 μm波长DBR的可靠设计提供了关键光学常数数据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在11.5 K至300 K温度范围内，通过拟合DBR反射谱提取了两种AlGaAsSb合金的温度依赖折射率，为低温下1.5 μm波长DBR的可靠设计提供了关键光学常数数据。；创新点：针对锑化物（antimonide）材料体系，首次（或补充性地）提供了低温范围内（11.5 K–300 K）的温度依赖折射率数据，填补了该材料在第三电信窗口波段低温光学常数数据的空白，为低温量子光子学应用中的DBR设计提供了必要输入。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了DBR样品在11.5 K–300 K温度范围内的反射光谱；利用传输矩阵法（TMM）结合递归数值拟合算法对反射谱进行拟合；初始参数采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）测定的层厚和室温折射率文献值。

papers.title: Mass-gap functional determinant approach for mobile Fermi polarons
papers.abstract: We extend the functional determinant approach (FDA), previously restricted to static impurities, to the case of finite-mass impurities by using the mass-gap description of Fermi polarons [Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 193401 (2025)]. The quadratic structure of the mass-gap model enables the exact evaluation of many-body spectra and Ramsey dynamics for mobile impurities. We show that this mass-gap FDA smoothly interpolates between the Fermi-edge singularity for infinitely heavy impurities and the emergence of quasiparticle weight for finite impurity mass. Our results demonstrate that the mass-gap FDA provides a transparent and computationally efficient framework to describe the quantum dynamics of mobile impurities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“extend the functional determinant approach”“exact evaluation”“provide a framework”，属于理论推导与计算方法研究，无实验数据或数值模拟细节描述。；研究对象：费米极化子（Fermi polarons）体系，具体为有限质量杂质（mobile impurities）在费米海中的量子多体动力学，包括多体能谱和Ramsey干涉动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该质量间隙泛函行列式方法（mass-gap FDA）能够平滑地连接两个极限：无限重杂质时的费米边奇异（Fermi-edge singularity）与有限杂质质量时准粒子权重的出现，从而统一描述移动杂质的量子动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该质量间隙泛函行列式方法（mass-gap FDA）能够平滑地连接两个极限：无限重杂质时的费米边奇异（Fermi-edge singularity）与有限杂质质量时准粒子权重的出现，从而统一描述移动杂质的量子动力学。；创新点：将原本仅适用于静态杂质的FDA推广到有限质量杂质情形，并利用质量间隙模型的二次型结构实现精确求解，提供了一个透明且计算高效的框架来描述移动杂质的量子动力学。
papers.method_zh: 泛函行列式方法（FDA）的扩展，结合质量间隙（mass-gap）描述（参考文献Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 193401 (2025)）。利用该模型的二次型结构，对移动杂质的多体能谱和Ramsey动力学进行精确求解。

papers.title: Exact fluctuation relations in voltage- and temperature-biased Laughlin-edge constrictions
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive analysis of non-equilibrium fluctuation-dissipation relations connect- ing experimentally accessible chiral-current auto- and cross-correlations to the tunneling-current noise and conductance in Laughlin edge states coupled through a quantum point contact (QPC). We examine their validity for two chiral Laughlin edges held at different temperatures and voltages and show that the relations remain exact for arbitrary tunneling strength, voltage bias, and edge- state temperatures. We further generalize them to spatially extended QPCs and to tunneling am- plitudes with an explicit voltage dependence, and discuss the conditions and limitations associated with these generalizations. Our results establish that the local tunneling-current noise generated at the QPC can be reliably reconstructed from experimentally accessible auto- and cross-correlations measured downstream, providing a robust route to characterize non-equilibrium transport in chiral edge states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“comprehensive analysis”“relations remain exact”“generalize them”等理论推导与推广表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：Laughlin边缘态通过量子点接触（QPC）耦合构成的体系，具体研究在电压偏置和温度偏置下的手征边缘态输运现象，以及非平衡涨落-耗散关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Laughlin边缘态QPC体系中，连接手征电流自关联/互关联与隧穿电流噪声及电导的非平衡涨落-耗散关系，对任意隧穿强度、电压偏置和边缘态温度均严格成立；该关系可推广至空间扩展QPC及具有显式电压依赖的隧穿振幅，并可由下游测量的关联函数可靠重构QPC处的局域隧穿电流噪声。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Laughlin边缘态QPC体系中，连接手征电流自关联/互关联与隧穿电流噪声及电导的非平衡涨落-耗散关系，对任意隧穿强度、电压偏置和边缘态温度均严格成立；该关系可推广至空间扩展QPC及具有显式电压依赖的隧穿振幅，并可由下游测量的关联函数可靠重构QPC处的局域隧穿电流噪声。；创新点：首次系统证明该类涨落-耗散关系在任意隧穿强度、电压偏置和温度偏置下均精确成立，并推广至更一般的QPC几何和隧穿振幅形式，为从实验可测的下游关联函数重构局域隧穿噪声提供了理论依据。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于Laughlin边缘态的手征输运理论，推导非平衡涨落-耗散关系，并考察其在有限温度差和电压差下的有效性，进一步推广至空间扩展QPC和电压依赖隧穿振幅情形。

papers.title: Moiré-induced lattice reconstruction at buried atomic interfaces
papers.abstract: Atomic reconstruction at twisted two-dimensional interfaces governs many of their emergent optical, electronic, and mechanical properties, including sliding ferroelectricity. Despite recent progress in understanding lattice reconstruction in suspended twisted bilayers, structural changes at van der Waals heterointerfaces between multilayer crystals remain largely unexplored. Here we use multi-slice electron ptychography to non-invasively recover the three-dimensional atomic structure at marginally twisted rhombohedral interfaces between thick transition-metal dichalcogenide crystals. With a position precision of ~3 pm and a depth resolution ~1 nm, we resolve the twist-induced lattice reconstruction field per layer, and the resulting dislocation network at the buried interface. Despite the bulk nature, we observe markedly strong in-plane interfacial reconstruction due to suppression of the out-of-plane bending by outer layers, exceeding predictions from our three-dimensional modelling. Furthermore, we extract the strain tensor evolution during the decay of the reconstruction into the bulk, providing a structural foundation for understanding multi-layer moiré systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用多切片电子叠层衍射（multi-slice electron ptychography）进行实验测量，并辅以三维建模对比。；研究对象：厚过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）晶体之间、具有微小扭转角的菱面体堆垛范德华异质界面，具体关注埋藏原子界面处的晶格重构、位错网络及应变场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在厚层块体TMD的埋藏扭转界面处，由于外层抑制了面外弯曲，面内界面重构异常强烈，其幅度超过三维建模的预测；同时提取了重构向块体内部衰减过程中的应变张量演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在厚层块体TMD的埋藏扭转界面处，由于外层抑制了面外弯曲，面内界面重构异常强烈，其幅度超过三维建模的预测；同时提取了重构向块体内部衰减过程中的应变张量演化。；创新点：首次在多层晶体之间的埋藏范德华异质界面（而非悬浮双层体系）中，以非侵入方式三维解析原子重构场，并揭示块体约束（抑制面外弯曲）导致重构增强这一超出现有模型预期的现象。
papers.method_zh: 多切片电子叠层衍射（multi-slice electron ptychography），实现约3 pm的位置精度和约1 nm的深度分辨率，逐层解析扭转诱导的晶格重构场及界面位错网络；辅以三维建模进行对比分析。

papers.title: Chemically Resolved Topological Coordinates Link Structural Dynamics and Configurational Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: Atomic coordinates specify a structure, but they do not reveal how chemical connectivity across several length scales relates to atomic motion and configurational energy ordering. We formulate chemically directed persistent homology at four resolutions---complete networks, individual sites, spatial fields, and substitutional arrangements---while retaining the chemical identity and length scale of each connectivity feature. In \textit{ab initio} molecular dynamics (AIMD) trajectories of $δ$- and $γ$-CsPbI$_3$ at five temperatures spanning 500--700 K, the corner-sharing $γ$ network has a lower Pb--I restoring stiffness and permits larger iodide excursions, yet iodide positional correlations decay 2.27 times more slowly and Pb-network topology retains memory 1.63 times longer than in the edge-sharing $δ$ phase. Local softness and loss of network memory are therefore distinct. At individual sites, rare $γ$-phase Pb environments with a $δ$-like Cs-cage connectivity precede 0.17 $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$ greater Pb displacement over the subsequent 0.5 ps. The same Pb-network coordinate resolves disruption of corner-sharing connectivity across a 2560-atom $δ|γ$ boundary. In substituted CsPbI$_3$, compact dopant arrangements undergo greater cooperative host relaxation and lie lower in density-functional-theory (DFT) energy than dispersed arrangements of the same composition. SchNet and Allegro model families with comparable energy errors encode opposite ordering along this coordinate, and 61 of 247 supplied models with errors below 1 meV atom$^{-1}$ on separate test structures reverse the DFT relation. Because relative configurational energies set Boltzmann populations, chemical network topology links structure to physical response and tests whether learned energy models preserve DFT configurational ordering even when their average errors are small.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) trajectories”“density-functional-theory (DFT) energy”“SchNet and Allegro model families”等关键词，属于第一性原理分子动力学模拟与机器学习势函数评估。；研究对象：CsPbI₃ 钙钛矿的 δ 相（edge-sharing）与 γ 相（corner-sharing）结构，以及取代掺杂（substituted CsPbI₃）体系；关注其结构动力学、构型热力学与化学连接拓扑之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 化学连接拓扑（以化学定向持久同调描述）能够区分局部软度与网络记忆丧失：γ 相虽具有更低的 Pb–I 恢复刚度且允许更大的碘离子位移，但其碘离子位置关联衰减慢 2.27 倍、Pb 网络拓扑记忆保持时间长 1.63 倍；此外，机器学习势函数（SchNet 与 Allegro）即使平均能量误差很小，也可能在构型能量排序上反转 DFT 结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：化学连接拓扑（以化学定向持久同调描述）能够区分局部软度与网络记忆丧失：γ 相虽具有更低的 Pb–I 恢复刚度且允许更大的碘离子位移，但其碘离子位置关联衰减慢 2.27 倍、Pb 网络拓扑记忆保持时间长 1.63 倍；此外，机器学习势函数（SchNet 与 Allegro）即使平均能量误差很小，也可能在构型能量排序上反转 DFT 结果。；创新点：将持久同调推广为“化学定向”形式，在保留化学身份与长度尺度的同时，将拓扑坐标直接关联到原子运动、局域软度、相界结构以及取代构型的能量排序；并首次系统检验了低误差机器学习势函数在构型能量排序上的可靠性。
papers.method_zh: 化学定向持久同调（chemically directed persistent homology）在四种分辨率（完整网络、单个位点、空间场、取代排列）下分析 AIMD 轨迹；DFT 能量计算用于评估取代构型稳定性；使用 SchNet 与 Allegro 两类机器学习势函数模型（共 247 个，误差低于 1 meV/atom）检验其是否保持 DFT 的构型能量排序。

papers.title: Dynamics of a nanoscale ferromagnetic vortex
papers.abstract: We propose a ferromagnetic vortex stabilized by the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (iDMI) and investigate its properties through theoretical analysis and micromagnetic simulations. Our results demonstrate that this vortex can remain stable even in nanoscale ferromagnetic disks with radii below $5\,\text{nm}$---far smaller than those of conventional nanodot vortices having about $1\,μ\text{m}$ radius. We analytically solve the nonlinear equation of motion describing the anharmonic vortex oscillation, and identify the critical frequency that determines the stability of the driven oscillation of the vortex. This nanoscale vortex exhibits conventional properties of microscale vortices, including gyrotropic oscillation and resonance frequency shift under an out-of-plane magnetic field. It also exhibits unconventional behaviors, such as a strongly anharmonic potential, nonlinear oscillations, and a Duffing-oscillator-like response under the external AC bias.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含微磁模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“theoretical analysis and micromagnetic simulations”。；研究对象：由界面Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用（iDMI）稳定的纳米尺度铁磁涡旋（ferromagnetic vortex），具体为半径小于5 nm的铁磁纳米盘中的涡旋态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该iDMI稳定的铁磁涡旋可在半径低于5 nm的纳米盘中保持稳定，远小于传统纳米点涡旋（约1 μm半径）；其驱动振荡存在一个决定稳定性的临界频率，且表现出强非谐势、非线性振荡及类似Duffing振子的响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该iDMI稳定的铁磁涡旋可在半径低于5 nm的纳米盘中保持稳定，远小于传统纳米点涡旋（约1 μm半径）；其驱动振荡存在一个决定稳定性的临界频率，且表现出强非谐势、非线性振荡及类似Duffing振子的响应。；创新点：首次提出利用iDMI在亚5 nm尺度稳定铁磁涡旋，突破了传统纳米点涡旋的尺寸下限（约1 μm），并揭示了该尺度下强非谐势导致的非线性动力学行为（如Duffing振子响应）。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析（求解描述非谐涡旋振荡的非线性运动方程）与微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations）相结合。

papers.title: Dark exciton signatures in the infrared transient absorption of MoS$_2$ monolayer
papers.abstract: Dark excitons play a central role in the nonequilibrium dynamics of two-dimensional semiconductors, but remain difficult to characterize. In this work we show that transient-absorption experiments, with probe pulses tuned in the exciton-exciton transitions energy range (exc-tr-abs), can be used to detect excitations from any populated dark excitonic state, including symmetry-forbidden, spin-forbidden, and finite momentum ones. We develop a fully ab initio scheme, on top of $GW$+BSE, for computing exc-tr-abs spectra from arbitrary populated exciton distributions. The different classes of dark excitons are included on an equal footing, by evaluating exciton-exciton dipole matrix elements in a locally smooth gauge, which accounts for both intra-band and inter-band contributions. As a test case, we consider monolayer MoS$_2$, for which experimental data are available. The exc-tr-abs signal emerges from a sum of contributions from four different valleys in the exciton dispersion, namely $Γ$, $K$, $M$, and $Q$ valleys. The interpretation of the final signal is substantially different from the one based on transitions at $\mathbf{q}=Γ$ alone. The exciton-exciton dipoles show similar intensity among these valleys, while their relative weight is mostly dictated by the initial excitonic population. State- and spin-resolved analyses show that the main peaks can be described as $1s \rightarrow 2p$ and $1s \rightarrow 3p$ transitions from A and B excitons, but with a superposition of transitions from both spin-flip and spin-conserving excitons across the valleys, and with contributions averaged over different momenta within the individual valleys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：fully ab initio scheme、GW+BSE、计算exc-tr-abs光谱。；研究对象：单层MoS₂（monolayer MoS₂）中的暗激子（dark excitons），具体包括对称禁戒、自旋禁戒和有限动量暗激子，以及它们在红外瞬态吸收（exc-tr-abs）光谱中的特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 瞬态吸收实验（探针调谐在激子-激子跃迁能量范围）可以探测任意布居的暗激子态，包括对称禁戒、自旋禁戒和有限动量暗激子。在单层MoS₂中，exc-tr-abs信号来自激子色散中Γ、K、M、Q四个不同谷的贡献之和，其解释与仅考虑q=Γ跃迁的图景有本质不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：瞬态吸收实验（探针调谐在激子-激子跃迁能量范围）可以探测任意布居的暗激子态，包括对称禁戒、自旋禁戒和有限动量暗激子。在单层MoS₂中，exc-tr-abs信号来自激子色散中Γ、K、M、Q四个不同谷的贡献之和，其解释与仅考虑q=Γ跃迁的图景有本质不同。；创新点：首次建立了从任意布居激子分布出发、全从头算的exc-tr-abs光谱计算框架，将对称禁戒、自旋禁戒和有限动量暗激子统一处理；揭示了单层MoS₂中exc-tr-abs信号的多谷（Γ、K、M、Q）贡献机制，纠正了仅基于q=Γ跃迁的传统解释。
papers.method_zh: 在GW+BSE（多体微扰论）基础上发展的全从头算（fully ab initio）方案，用于计算任意激子布居分布下的exc-tr-abs光谱。通过局域光滑规范（locally smooth gauge）计算激子-激子偶极矩阵元，同时包含带内和带间贡献，将不同类别的暗激子平等地纳入处理。

papers.title: Polymer Membrane Tensegrity: Inverse Design of Polymer Films Morphing into Freeform 3D Surfaces with Digital Photopatterning Technique
papers.abstract: In Metamorphosis of Plants (1790), Goethe traced diverse plant organs to transformations of a common leaf-like structure -- a principle modern mechanics attributes to two material ingredients: non-uniform in-plane strain from differential growth or shrinkage, and spatially patterned stiffness. Here we translate this principle into a synthetic fabrication framework called Polymer Membrane Tensegrity (PMT). A flat elastomeric film swollen with a second monomer is selectively UV-cured through a liquid-crystal display (LCD) photomask in a single-side digital photopatterning step, producing rigid rods embedded in a soft, shrinkable membrane. After the unreacted monomer is extracted with a solvent and the film is dried, the membrane shrinks far more than the rods, generating a ~50% in-plane strain differential and a ~2,000-fold modulus contrast -- conditions under which the contracting membrane is held in tension by mutually unconnected rods, a tensegrity-inspired arrangement within a single film. An origami-based inverse design algorithm computes the rod layout that morphs the film into a prescribed 3D surface. We demonstrate PMT on a dome, a hyperbolic surface, and a gyroid unit cell -- positively and negatively curved targets -- reproducing all three with mean deviations of 1.0-2.1% of the target size; perimeter curve optimization halves the mean deviation of the gyroid. Because patterning occurs on one side only, PMT eliminates the front-to-back alignment demanded by bilayer methods, offering a scalable route from flat polymer films to freeform 3D surfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含计算设计辅助）。判断依据：摘要描述实际制备流程（UV固化、溶剂提取、干燥）、实验表征（形貌偏差测量），并包含“origami-based inverse design algorithm”计算设计环节，属于实验与计算结合。；研究对象：聚合物薄膜体系——由刚性棒状结构嵌入可收缩软基体构成的单层复合膜（Polymer Membrane Tensegrity, PMT），研究其从平面薄膜经内应力驱动形变为自由曲面（如穹顶、双曲面、螺旋二十四面体单元）的力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过单侧数字光图案化在弹性膜中嵌入刚性棒，产生约50%面内应变差和约2000倍模量对比，使收缩膜受拉而互不相连的棒受压，形成类张拉整体结构，可将平面膜精确形变为指定三维曲面（平均偏差为目标尺寸的1.0–2.1%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过单侧数字光图案化在弹性膜中嵌入刚性棒，产生约50%面内应变差和约2000倍模量对比，使收缩膜受拉而互不相连的棒受压，形成类张拉整体结构，可将平面膜精确形变为指定三维曲面（平均偏差为目标尺寸的1.0–2.1%）。；创新点：首次将“非均匀面内应变+空间图案化刚度”的植物形态发生原理转化为单侧光图案化制备框架，消除了双层膜方法所需的前后对准步骤，提供从平面聚合物膜到自由形态三维曲面的可扩展路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用液晶显示（LCD）光掩模进行单侧数字光图案化，将溶胀有第二单体的弹性膜选择性UV固化，随后溶剂提取未反应单体并干燥；设计上采用基于折纸（origami）的逆向设计算法计算棒状结构的布局，并通过周长曲线优化降低形变误差。

papers.title: A multi-scale study to unravel the dehydration mechanism of hydrated salts
papers.abstract: Understanding the dehydration mechanism of hydrated salts remains fundamentally important in solid state chemistry, as their behavior affect fields ranging from heat storage to heritage conservation and pharmaceutical crystallization. Combining Raman confocal microscopy, dynamic weight loss measurements, SEM, and micro CT, we show that dehydration kinetics of sodium sulfate decahydrate (mirabilite) unfold through two regimes: an initial nucleation controlled phase, where atomic rearrangement drives two dimensional lateral growth following an exponential law, and a subsequent phase boundary controlled regime, where growth advances into the crystal depth, limited by water vacancy formation at the hydrated dehydrated interface. The resulting thenardite product shows around 35 percent shrinkage and forms a porous, layered dual porosity nanocrystalline structure, with relative humidity directly governing crystal size. Extending this analysis to other sulfate hydrates reveals that crystallographic symmetry changes between hydrate and anhydrous phases dictate surface morphology, linking microstructure to mechanism. This multiscale framework uncovers dynamics hidden from bulk measurements and suggests structural indicators could predict dehydration pathways in other hydrated salt families, and opening route toward designing thermal energy storage materials without exhaustive experimental screening.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到结合Raman共聚焦显微镜、动态失重测量、SEM和micro CT等实验手段。；研究对象：水合盐的脱水机制，具体以十水硫酸钠（芒硝，mirabilite）为主要研究对象，并扩展到其他硫酸盐水合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 芒硝脱水动力学分为两个阶段：初始成核控制阶段（原子重排驱动二维横向生长，遵循指数规律）和随后的相界面控制阶段（生长向晶体深度推进，受水空位形成限制）。脱水产物无水硫酸钠（thenardite）收缩约35%，形成多孔、层状双尺度纳米晶结构，且相对湿度直接控制晶体尺寸。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：芒硝脱水动力学分为两个阶段：初始成核控制阶段（原子重排驱动二维横向生长，遵循指数规律）和随后的相界面控制阶段（生长向晶体深度推进，受水空位形成限制）。脱水产物无水硫酸钠（thenardite）收缩约35%，形成多孔、层状双尺度纳米晶结构，且相对湿度直接控制晶体尺寸。；创新点：建立了从微观原子重排到宏观晶体形貌的多尺度脱水机制框架，揭示了体相测量无法观测的动力学过程，并提出晶体学对称性变化可作为预测其他水合盐家族脱水路径的结构指标，为热储能材料设计提供无需大量实验筛选的途径。
papers.method_zh: Raman共聚焦显微镜、动态失重测量、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、微计算机断层扫描（micro CT），并结合多尺度分析框架。

papers.title: Viscoelastic interfacial structures in undersaturated calcium solutions under nanoconfinement
papers.abstract: Calcium mineralisation underpins processes ranging from biomineralisation to scalable carbon storage, yet the earliest stages of nucleation remain unresolved. Here we investigate calcium-containing solutions under nanoscopic confinement while remaining undersaturated with respect to bulk calcium carbonate precipitation. Using sensitive surface force measurements, we identify a long-range non-DLVO repulsive interaction specific to calcium solutions, which we attribute to hydrated ion networks at mineral interfaces. These interfacial networks exhibit viscoelastic behaviour distinct from the bulk solution, persist across a broad pH range, and can be disrupted by competing ions with strong surface affinity. Our findings provide experimental evidence that stable hydrated ion networks can emerge at mineral interfaces under undersaturated conditions, supporting the possibility that interfaces and confinement stabilise intermediate ion assemblies prior to nucleation. These results bridge classical and nonclassical descriptions of mineral nucleation and highlight the central role of interfaces and confinement in directing crystallisation pathways.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用灵敏的表面力测量”（sensitive surface force measurements），属于实验手段。；研究对象：纳米限域条件下、相对于块体碳酸钙沉淀仍处于欠饱和状态的含钙溶液，以及矿物界面处形成的含水离子网络结构（hydrated ion networks）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在欠饱和钙溶液中，矿物界面处可形成稳定的、具有粘弹性（viscoelastic）的长程非DLVO排斥性离子网络结构；该结构可被强表面亲和力的竞争离子破坏，表明界面与限域可在成核前稳定中间离子组装体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在欠饱和钙溶液中，矿物界面处可形成稳定的、具有粘弹性（viscoelastic）的长程非DLVO排斥性离子网络结构；该结构可被强表面亲和力的竞争离子破坏，表明界面与限域可在成核前稳定中间离子组装体。；创新点：首次在实验上证明，在欠饱和条件下矿物界面处可自发形成稳定的水合离子网络，且该网络具有区别于体相溶液的粘弹性行为，为经典与非经典成核理论之间提供了实验桥梁。摘要未突出说明更具体的创新细节。
papers.method_zh: 灵敏的表面力测量（surface force measurements），用于探测纳米限域下钙溶液与矿物界面之间的相互作用力，并结合不同pH和竞争离子条件进行对照实验。

papers.title: Coupling of two individual magnon resonators via a superconducting microwave resonator operating in the strong coupling regime
papers.abstract: We demonstrate coherent coupling of ferromagnetic resonance in two individual permalloy stripes via a superconducting coplanar waveguide resonator. The two stripes are placed on top of the resonator with an angle of 50$^{\circ}$ between their respective long axes. This alignment enables us to separately tune their ferromagnetic resonance frequency by exploiting their shape anisotropy by simply rotating the external bias magnetic field in the sample plane. Both individual ferromagnets exhibit strong coupling with the microwave resonator. This method avoids the use of local individual bias coils and facilitates the integration of similar experiments into planar device infrastructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“demonstrate”“placed on top”“rotating the external bias magnetic field”等实验操作与观测表述。；研究对象：两个独立的坡莫合金（permalloy）微米条带中的铁磁共振模式，通过超导共面波导谐振腔实现相干耦合。体系为“磁子-微波光子”混合量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两个独立的坡莫合金条带可通过同一个超导微波谐振腔实现强耦合下的相干耦合；通过旋转面内偏置磁场，利用形状各向异性可分别独立调谐两个条带的铁磁共振频率，从而避免使用局部偏置线圈。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两个独立的坡莫合金条带可通过同一个超导微波谐振腔实现强耦合下的相干耦合；通过旋转面内偏置磁场，利用形状各向异性可分别独立调谐两个条带的铁磁共振频率，从而避免使用局部偏置线圈。；创新点：通过几何排列（50°夹角）结合形状各向异性实现两个磁子谐振器的频率独立调谐，无需局部偏置线圈，简化了实验装置并有利于将此类实验集成到平面器件架构中。摘要未突出说明与以往多磁子耦合实验在耦合强度或可扩展性方面的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超导共面波导谐振腔作为耦合媒介，将两个坡莫合金条带以长轴夹角50°放置于谐振腔上方；通过旋转面内外加磁场，利用形状各向异性分别调谐两个铁磁体的共振频率；测量并表征了每个铁磁体与微波谐振腔之间的强耦合。

papers.title: Evanescent-mode Casimir-Josephson force and gate-controlled resonances in ballistic graphene Josephson junctions
papers.abstract: We develop a microscopic scattering theory of the phase-dependent equilibrium mechanical response of a ballistic superconductor-graphene-superconductor Josephson junction. The calculation is based on an energy-dependent Dirac scattering matrix embedded in a normalized Matsubara determinant, so the reported force correction contains the complete Bogoliubov-de Gennes spectrum of the stated ideal model.
