At charge neutrality the full determinant approaches a closed-form evanescent-mode result proportional to $ΔW/L^2$, reaching $2\ln 2\,ΔW/(πL^2)$ at phase difference $π$ in the zero-temperature short-junction limit. Gate doping produces propagating channels and Fabry-Pérot structure, causing large oscillations and sign reversals of the phase-dependent force correction $δF=F(φ)-F(0)$. We distinguish the interband-to-intraband Andreev crossover, controlled by $|μ|/Δ$, from the evanescent-to-propagating crossover, controlled by $|μ|L/(\hbar v_F)$. Exact real-energy subgap poles obtained from the same energy-dependent scattering matrix are used to diagnose specular/interband and retro/intraband character; these labels are not treated as separately measurable thermodynamic forces in the mixed regime. We also quantify the difference between the complete determinant result and the frozen-scattering short-junction approximation without identifying that difference with a pure continuum force. The resulting gate- and phase-dependent mechanical signal provides a Dirac-material extension of earlier superconductivity-induced mechanical-force proposals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“microscopic scattering theory”“calculation”“scattering matrix”“determinant”等理论推导与数值计算关键词。；研究对象：弹道超导体-石墨烯-超导体（S-G-S）约瑟夫森结，具体研究其相位依赖的平衡力学响应（即Casimir-Josephson力），以及门电压调控下的共振行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电荷中性点，相位依赖的力修正趋近于一个闭式衰减模结果，正比于ΔW/L²，在零温短结极限、相位差为π时达到2ln2·ΔW/(πL²)。门掺杂会引入传播通道和Fabry-Pérot结构，导致力修正δF出现大幅振荡和符号反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电荷中性点，相位依赖的力修正趋近于一个闭式衰减模结果，正比于ΔW/L²，在零温短结极限、相位差为π时达到2ln2·ΔW/(πL²)。门掺杂会引入传播通道和Fabry-Pérot结构，导致力修正δF出现大幅振荡和符号反转。；创新点：将超导诱导的力学力方案扩展到狄拉克材料体系，并明确区分了由|μ|/Δ控制的带间-带内安德烈夫交叉与由|μ|L/(ħv_F)控制的衰减-传播模式交叉。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于能量依赖的Dirac散射矩阵，嵌入归一化的Matsubara行列式，构建微观散射理论，完整包含Bogoliubov-de Gennes谱。利用同一散射矩阵的实能量亚隙极点来诊断镜面/带间与回射/带内安德烈夫过程。对比了完整行列式结果与冻结散射短结近似之间的差异。

papers.title: d'Q = TdS for Infinitesimal Irreversible Processes: On the Differential Form of the Clausius Inequality
papers.abstract: Conventionally, the differential form of the Clausius inequality is adopted for infinitesimal irreversible processes. We show that the correct first-order form for infinitesimal quasi-static irreversible processes is the equality d'Q=TdS rather than d'Q < TdS. This provides a purely thermodynamic proof that internal entropy production is second-order or higher and confirms that entropy remains a well-defined state quantity even when quasi-static irreversible processes are included, without resorting to the Boltzmann relation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic proof、differential form、Clausius inequality。；研究对象：热力学中不可逆过程的熵与热交换关系，具体为无穷小准静态不可逆过程中Clausius不等式的微分形式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于无穷小准静态不可逆过程，正确的热力学一阶关系是等式 d'Q = TdS，而非不等式 d'Q < TdS；内部熵产生至少是二阶小量，因此熵在包含准静态不可逆过程时仍是良定义的状态量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于无穷小准静态不可逆过程，正确的热力学一阶关系是等式 d'Q = TdS，而非不等式 d'Q < TdS；内部熵产生至少是二阶小量，因此熵在包含准静态不可逆过程时仍是良定义的状态量。；创新点：首次从纯热力学角度证明准静态不可逆过程中内部熵产生为二阶或更高阶小量，从而在不依赖统计力学假设的情况下确认熵作为状态量的有效性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 纯热力学推导，不借助玻尔兹曼关系，基于Clausius不等式的微分形式进行严格分析。

papers.title: Extending the Pnictide Chemical Space for Photovoltaics
papers.abstract: Developing novel and efficient materials that are beyond silicon for photovoltaic (PV) applications is required to meet the upcoming energy needs of our societies. To identify novel candidate materials that can act as PVs, we use first principles calculations to perform a systematic screening of the pnictide chemical space (i.e., nitrides and phosphides). Specifically, we explore three different ternary and quaternary pnictide classes, namely, ABCX$_2$, BB'B"X$_2$, and A$_4$BX$_2$ (A = Li, Na, or K; B, B', B" = Ca, Sr, Mg, or Zn; C = Al, Ga, or In; X = N or P), leading to a set of 104 possible pnictide compositions. Based on our evaluations of ground state structures, 0 K thermodynamic stabilities, electronic structures, carrier effective masses, dynamic stabilities, and intrinsic point defect formation energies, we arrive at three promising candidates, namely, NaCaInN$_2$, NaSrInN$_2$, and K$_4$ZnP$_2$. Notably, all the identified candidates are thermodynamically (meta)stable, exhibit direct (or nearest direct) band gaps that are optimal for PV applications, and are resistant to forming several types of point defects. We hope that our first principles driven workflow and the identified candidates will advance the development of novel PV materials and reinvigorate interest in the exploration of pnictides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first principles calculations”（第一性原理计算），并涉及结构、稳定性、电子结构等计算筛选。；研究对象：光伏应用的新型氮化物和磷化物（pnictides），具体包括三类三元/四元化合物：ABCX₂、BB'B"X₂、A₄BX₂（A = Li, Na, K；B, B', B" = Ca, Sr, Mg, Zn；C = Al, Ga, In；X = N, P），共104种可能的组分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过系统筛选，识别出三种有前景的光伏候选材料：NaCaInN₂、NaSrInN₂和K₄ZnP₂。它们均具有热力学（亚）稳定性、适合光伏的直接（或近直接）带隙，并对多种点缺陷具有抗性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过系统筛选，识别出三种有前景的光伏候选材料：NaCaInN₂、NaSrInN₂和K₄ZnP₂。它们均具有热力学（亚）稳定性、适合光伏的直接（或近直接）带隙，并对多种点缺陷具有抗性。；创新点：首次对pnictide（氮化物和磷化物）化学空间进行系统性的第一性原理高通量筛选，覆盖三类化学式共104种组分，并建立了从结构、稳定性到缺陷形成能的完整筛选流程，为拓展光伏材料体系提供了新方向。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT），具体包括：基态结构计算、0 K热力学稳定性评估、电子结构计算、载流子有效质量计算、动力学稳定性计算，以及本征点缺陷形成能计算。

papers.title: Pseudospin Dynamics of Charge Order
papers.abstract: Charge order is conventionally viewed as a static modulation of the electronic density, despite growing experimental capabilities to probe and manipulate its nonequilibrium evolution. In contrast to spin-ordered systems, a microscopic framework for charge-order dynamics and its control under external driving remains largely underdeveloped. Here, starting from an extended Hubbard model, we derive an effective pseudospin model in which the charge-ordered state maps onto staggered pseudospin order. The resulting charge-order dynamics is governed by Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert-like equations for the pseudospins, closely analogous to those of a bipartite antiferromagnet. We show that an external electric field directly controls the staggered pseudospin order and, above a threshold field, drives coherent reversal of the charge-order polarity by destabilizing collective pseudospin excitations. Our results establish the charge pseudospin as a microscopic dynamical degree of freedom for coherent switching and control of charge order, providing a charge-sector analogue of the well-established framework for spin-order dynamics in spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive an effective pseudospin model”“governed by Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert-like equations”，属于解析推导与理论建模。；研究对象：电荷有序（charge order）体系的非平衡动力学，具体从扩展Hubbard模型出发，研究电荷有序态在外加电场下的集体激发与极性反转。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电荷有序态可映射为交错赝自旋序，其动力学由类似Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert方程描述；外加电场可直接控制该赝自旋序，并在超过阈值场时通过失稳集体赝自旋激发实现电荷有序极性的相干反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电荷有序态可映射为交错赝自旋序，其动力学由类似Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert方程描述；外加电场可直接控制该赝自旋序，并在超过阈值场时通过失稳集体赝自旋激发实现电荷有序极性的相干反转。；创新点：建立了电荷有序动力学的微观赝自旋框架，将自旋电子学中成熟的自旋序动力学方法推广到电荷序通道，为电荷序的相干开关与控制提供了与自旋系统类比的理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：从扩展Hubbard模型出发，推导有效赝自旋模型；采用Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert方程框架描述赝自旋动力学；通过分析集体赝自旋激发的不稳定性确定电场阈值行为。

papers.title: Optimal Transport of an Anisotropic Tracer in Dense Active Suspensions
papers.abstract: The transport of anisotropic tracers in active fluids exhibits rich dynamical behavior arising from the interplay between particle shape, activity, and steric interactions. We employ Brownian dynamics simulations to investigate the motion of an elliptical tracer immersed in a suspension of active dumbbells. We find that both translational and rotational transport, characterized by the mean-square speed and diffusivity, are enhanced by more than an order of magnitude with increasing area fraction, $φ$, of active dumbbells. Notably, tracer motion is enhanced along the major axis relative to the minor axis, with $\mathrm{v}_{\parallel}>\mathrm{v}_{\perp}$ and $D_{\parallel}>D_{\perp}$. Remarkably, both translational and rotational transport exhibit an optimum at an intermediate packing fraction of active dumbbells, with the corresponding transport coefficients decreasing at higher densities. We show that this non-monotonic transport arises from the anisotropic accumulation and aggregation of active dumbbells around the tracer, which control the non-equilibrium force and torque fluctuations. Thus, establish a direct connection between the collective organization of active dumbbells at the tracer surface and its emergent translational and rotational transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：Brownian dynamics simulations（布朗动力学模拟）。；研究对象：致密活性悬浮液中的各向异性示踪粒子（椭圆示踪粒子）的输运行为，具体体系为活性哑铃粒子悬浮液。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 椭圆示踪粒子的平动和转动输运（均方位移速度与扩散系数）随活性哑铃面积分数φ增加而增强一个数量级以上，且在中等堆积分数下出现最优值（非单调行为）；沿长轴方向的输运强于短轴方向（v∥>v⊥，D∥>D⊥）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：椭圆示踪粒子的平动和转动输运（均方位移速度与扩散系数）随活性哑铃面积分数φ增加而增强一个数量级以上，且在中等堆积分数下出现最优值（非单调行为）；沿长轴方向的输运强于短轴方向（v∥>v⊥，D∥>D⊥）。；创新点：揭示了活性哑铃在示踪粒子表面的各向异性聚集与堆积直接控制非平衡力/力矩涨落，从而建立了活性粒子集体组织与示踪粒子涌现输运之间的直接联系，解释了输运系数随密度非单调变化（存在最优堆积分数）的微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 布朗动力学模拟（Brownian dynamics simulations），模拟椭圆示踪粒子浸入活性哑铃悬浮液中的运动，分析面积分数φ对输运系数的影响。

papers.title: Real-space overlap is not enough: ambiguity in nanobeam iterative ptychography
papers.abstract: High-resolution iterative ptychography typically relies on a well-aligned, high-convergence-angle electron probe. Here we explore whether it can instead be performed at small convergence angles, relaxing the need for probe correctors and enabling experiments at low accelerating voltages or with a de-excited objective lens, as in Lorentz mode. Through experiments and simulations, we show that once the convergence angle is small enough that no diffracted disks overlap, the resulting reconstruction is ambiguous, posing a significant challenge for robust interpretation of results. This challenge arises because of the lack of interference between Bragg disks in the recorded diffraction pattern intensity, leading to no phase information for each reflection. Reconstructions with these data lead to degenerate objects in which rigid translations of the lattice and reversals of contrast of the object produce the same error between experimental data and the ptychography forward model. Increasing the real-space overlap between probe positions does not lift this degeneracy. An amorphous substrate can supply the missing phase relationships by giving the Bragg beams support in the gaps between disks. This phasing is fragile, however, and survives only where the forward model matches the experiment. At fixed dose, either constraining the object to be a pure phase object or introducing thermal motion into the forward model is enough on its own to make the solution non-unique, highlighting why our experimental reconstructions below the overlap threshold are ambiguous despite ample dose and real-space redundancy. Most troublingly, the lattice spacing and orientation are always recovered correctly, so a non-unique reconstruction looks convincing and can be diagnosed only by repeating the reconstruction from different starting points.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Through experiments and simulations”。；研究对象：纳米束迭代叠层衍射成像（nanobeam iterative ptychography）技术本身，具体研究其在低会聚角（小会聚角）条件下的重建行为，涉及电子显微镜中的洛伦兹模式、低加速电压等实验条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当会聚角足够小以至于衍射盘之间不再重叠时，叠层重建结果存在简并性（非唯一性），表现为晶格刚性平移和衬度反转产生相同的误差；增加实空间重叠度无法消除该简并，且晶格间距和取向总能被正确恢复，使非唯一解看起来可信，只能通过不同初始条件的重复重建来诊断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当会聚角足够小以至于衍射盘之间不再重叠时，叠层重建结果存在简并性（非唯一性），表现为晶格刚性平移和衬度反转产生相同的误差；增加实空间重叠度无法消除该简并，且晶格间距和取向总能被正确恢复，使非唯一解看起来可信，只能通过不同初始条件的重复重建来诊断。；创新点：首次系统揭示了低会聚角（衍射盘不重叠）条件下叠层重建的简并性根源——缺乏Bragg盘间干涉导致各反射无相位信息，并指出实空间重叠度无法弥补这一缺陷；同时发现非晶衬底可部分提供相位关系但脆弱，且纯相位约束或热运动引入各自单独都会导致解非唯一。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用纳米束叠层衍射成像（nanobeam ptychography），在低会聚角/洛伦兹模式下进行；模拟上使用叠层前向模型（ptychography forward model）进行数值重建，并测试了纯相位物体约束、热运动引入、非晶衬底等不同条件对重建唯一性的影响。

papers.title: Holographic Representations of Topological Quantum Criticality: Emergent Symmetry Approach around the Bott Clock
papers.abstract: In this article, we apply the idea of emergent symmetries to construct holographic representations of a broad class of topological quantum critical points (tQCPs) that appear in fermionic classes in the Bott clock. We show explicitly that around the Bott clock, an emergent symmetry $U_{EM}$ exists at a tQCP between different symmetry protected gapped phases with protecting symmetry $G_p$ in $d$ spatial dimensions. This emergent symmetry can be used to construct a $(d+1)$ spatial dimensional lattice model with a properly upgraded symmetry such as $U_{EM}\times G_p$ or $U_{EM} \rtimes G_p$, etc. By doubling the degrees of freedom of the adjacent topological class in $d$-dimensions, we successfully show that the $(d+1)$-dimensional lattice models constructed in this way have the desired enlarged symmetry groups that precisely belong to the adjacent topological classes, counterclockwise around the Bott clock. Furthermore, $d$-dimensional boundaries of these $(d+1)$ dimensional lattice models of gapped topological classes are shown to exhibit identical infrared dynamics as the corresponding tQCPs in the $d$-dimensional adjacent topological phases in the Bott clock, with lower symmetries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“apply the idea of emergent symmetries”“construct holographic representations”“we show explicitly”“lattice model”等理论构造与论证关键词，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：拓扑量子临界点（tQCPs），具体为Bott时钟中费米子对称性保护拓扑相之间的临界点，以及由这些临界点构造的(d+1)维晶格模型及其d维边界。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Bott时钟中，任意d维tQCP处存在一个涌现对称性U_EM，利用该对称性可将相邻拓扑类的自由度加倍，构造出具有更大对称群（如U_EM×G_p或U_EM⋊G_p）的(d+1)维晶格模型，其对称群恰好属于Bott时钟上逆时针相邻的拓扑类；这些(d+1)维模型的d维边界在红外极限下与对应的d维tQCP具有完全相同的动力学行为，但对称性更低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Bott时钟中，任意d维tQCP处存在一个涌现对称性U_EM，利用该对称性可将相邻拓扑类的自由度加倍，构造出具有更大对称群（如U_EM×G_p或U_EM⋊G_p）的(d+1)维晶格模型，其对称群恰好属于Bott时钟上逆时针相邻的拓扑类；这些(d+1)维模型的d维边界在红外极限下与对应的d维tQCP具有完全相同的动力学行为，但对称性更低。；创新点：首次系统地将涌现对称性思想应用于Bott时钟中一大类费米子拓扑量子临界点的全息表示构造，建立了tQCP与更高维拓扑相边界之间的对应关系，并明确展示了对称性沿Bott时钟逆时针方向的升级规律。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为涌现对称性方法（emergent symmetry approach）与全息表示（holographic representation）构造，即通过将d维相邻拓扑类的自由度加倍，并适当升级对称性（直积或半直积），构建(d+1)维晶格模型，再分析其边界的红外动力学与对称性。

papers.title: Scalar Spin Chirality from Dissipative Pumping and Lamb Shift Precession
papers.abstract: Circulating currents in triangular triple quantum dots reverse repeatedly with bias even at zero magnetic flux and for a real Hamiltonian, a phenomenon whose origin has remained unclear. We show that dissipative tunneling prepares an orbital pseudospin, while virtual charge fluctuations generate a noncollinear Lamb field that rotates it toward the chiral direction. Bias changes their relative orientation and thereby reverses the current. This reservoir-induced orbital Hanle effect converts a nonchiral orbital polarization into scalar spin chirality, which an exact ground-multiplet identity links to the circulating current. Hierarchical-equations-of-motion calculations show that the low-bias reversal survives beyond the second-order weak-coupling description, while the quadratic growth of chirality after a sudden voltage switch identifies precession. More broadly, time-reversal-odd responses can emerge in open quantum systems from the interplay between dissipative state preparation and coherent precession.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：dissipative tunneling、Lamb field、hierarchical-equations-of-motion calculations、second-order weak-coupling description。；研究对象：三角三量子点（triangular triple quantum dots）中的循环电流（circulating currents）及其与标量自旋手性（scalar spin chirality）的关系，特别关注零磁通、实哈密顿量下电流随偏压反复反转的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 耗散隧穿制备轨道赝自旋，而虚电荷涨落产生非共线Lamb场使其向手性方向旋转；偏压改变二者相对取向从而反转电流。该“储库诱导轨道Hanle效应”将非手性轨道极化转化为标量自旋手性，并与循环电流通过精确基态多重态恒等式相联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：耗散隧穿制备轨道赝自旋，而虚电荷涨落产生非共线Lamb场使其向手性方向旋转；偏压改变二者相对取向从而反转电流。该“储库诱导轨道Hanle效应”将非手性轨道极化转化为标量自旋手性，并与循环电流通过精确基态多重态恒等式相联系。；创新点：首次将储库诱导的Hanle效应（通常与自旋相关）推广到轨道赝自旋，并揭示耗散态制备与相干进动的协同如何产生时间反演奇（time-reversal-odd）响应；通过精确恒等式将循环电流与标量自旋手性直接关联。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 层级运动方程（hierarchical-equations-of-motion, HEOM）计算，以及二阶弱耦合微扰描述；理论分析基于耗散泵浦（dissipative pumping）与Lamb位移进动（Lamb shift precession）的相互作用。

papers.title: Singlet-doublet transitions and Josephson currents in a superconducting ring with a quantum dot
papers.abstract: We investigate the ground state properties of a superconducting ring embedded with a quantum dot (QD) by using a variational wave-function approach. A theoretical formulation for the treatment of the finite-U Anderson impurity coupled with a superconducting ring are presented. We demonstrate singlet-doublet transitions of the ground state for this system with the QD in the mixed valence regime. It is shown that the supercurrent in the superconductor ring shows oscillations with the external enclosed magnetic flux and exhibits abrupt jumps at the singlet-doublet phase transition points.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“variational wave-function approach”（变分波函数方法）和“theoretical formulation”（理论公式化）。；研究对象：嵌入量子点（QD）的超导环体系，具体研究该混合系统的基态性质，包括有限U安德森杂质与超导环的耦合，以及超导环中的约瑟夫森电流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该体系在量子点处于混合价态区域时，基态会发生单重态-双重态（singlet-doublet）相变；超导环中的超电流随外磁通振荡，并在单重态-双重态相变点处出现突变跳变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该体系在量子点处于混合价态区域时，基态会发生单重态-双重态（singlet-doublet）相变；超导环中的超电流随外磁通振荡，并在单重态-双重态相变点处出现突变跳变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分波函数方法（variational wave-function approach），并提出了处理有限U安德森杂质与超导环耦合的理论公式。

papers.title: Covariant formula for the driving force for interface migration
papers.abstract: Interfaces of crystalline materials are strongly affected by the anisotropy of interface energy. A key quantity in this context is the interface stiffness tensor, which characterizes the response of the interface energy to changes in interface orientation and plays a role in determining the driving force for interface migration. The latter is expressible via contraction of the stiffness tensor and interface curvature tensor. Practical computations involving tensors necessarily rely on their individual components. In this work, an explicit component-wise expression is derived for the contraction of the stiffness and curvature tensors, valid in arbitrary coordinate systems. Within this formulation, to get the driving force, the curvature tensor is contracted with the pullback of a stiffness-related tensor - originally defined in three-dimensional Euclidean space - onto the interface manifold. This covariant treatment establishes a physically consistent foundation for three-dimensional computational models involving interface stiffness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中强调“推导出显式分量表达式”“协变处理”“建立物理一致的基础”，属于理论推导与形式化建模工作。；研究对象：晶体材料中界面迁移的驱动力，具体涉及界面能各向异性、界面刚度张量、界面曲率张量及其在任意坐标系下的收缩运算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 给出了界面刚度张量与曲率张量收缩的显式分量表达式，该表达式在任意坐标系下均成立；驱动力通过将三维欧氏空间中的刚度相关张量拉回到界面流形上再与曲率张量收缩获得，从而为三维计算模型提供了协变且物理自洽的表述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：给出了界面刚度张量与曲率张量收缩的显式分量表达式，该表达式在任意坐标系下均成立；驱动力通过将三维欧氏空间中的刚度相关张量拉回到界面流形上再与曲率张量收缩获得，从而为三维计算模型提供了协变且物理自洽的表述。；创新点：首次给出了该收缩在任意坐标系下的显式分量表达式，并通过协变（拉回）处理将三维空间定义的刚度张量正确投影到二维界面流形上，解决了以往计算中坐标系依赖可能导致的物理不一致性问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：采用微分几何中的协变形式（拉回映射、流形上的张量运算），在任意坐标系下对刚度张量与曲率张量的收缩进行分量级展开。

papers.title: Switchable Magnetoelectric Transport in Graphene via a Van der Waals Multiferroic
papers.abstract: Electric and magnetic control of transport properties at atomic interfaces is central to the development of next generation electronics and spintronics. Van der Waals multiferroics materials that simultaneously host dielectric and magnetic orders down to the monolayer limit offer a promising platform for such interfacial control, yet the realization of electronic functionalities that exploit the unique attributes of van der Waals multiferroics has largely remained elusive. Here, we realize a van der Waals heterostructure comprising graphene and the multiferroic CuCrP2S6, enabling gate-switchable magnetoelectric transport in graphene, mediated by the multiferroic layer. The charge-neutrality resistance peak of graphene exhibits pronounced hysteresis arising from polarization flip in the multiferroic state. Application of an in-plane magnetic field shifts this peak in a polarization-dependent manner, revealing magnetic-field-induced polarization modulation a direct signature of the magnetoelectric effect. Furthermore, cooling the device under an applied electric field enables domain control of the multiferroic order, allowing reversible switching of the interfacial magnetoelectric transport. These results provide the first demonstration of interfacial magnetoelectric transport in a vdW heterostructure, and establish a pathway for engineering two-dimensional van der Waals interfaces for functional device applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了实际器件制备（van der Waals heterostructure comprising graphene and CuCrP2S6）、输运测量（charge-neutrality resistance peak、hysteresis）、磁场施加（in-plane magnetic field）以及电场冷却（cooling the device under an applied electric field）等实验操作。；研究对象：石墨烯与多铁材料CuCrP2S6构成的范德华异质结，研究其界面磁电输运现象，特别是多铁层极化翻转对石墨烯输运的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在石墨烯/CuCrP2S6范德华异质结中实现了可通过栅压开关的磁电输运：石墨烯电荷中性点电阻峰表现出由多铁极化翻转引起的显著滞回，且该峰随面内磁场呈极化依赖的移动，直接证明了磁电效应；通过电场冷却可实现多铁畴控制，从而可逆切换界面磁电输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在石墨烯/CuCrP2S6范德华异质结中实现了可通过栅压开关的磁电输运：石墨烯电荷中性点电阻峰表现出由多铁极化翻转引起的显著滞回，且该峰随面内磁场呈极化依赖的移动，直接证明了磁电效应；通过电场冷却可实现多铁畴控制，从而可逆切换界面磁电输运。；创新点：首次在范德华异质结中演示了界面磁电输运效应，利用多铁材料CuCrP2S6的极化与磁有序耦合实现了对石墨烯输运的可切换磁电调控，为二维范德华界面的功能器件应用开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：范德华异质结器件制备（石墨烯与CuCrP2S6堆叠）、栅压调控输运测量（观测电荷中性点电阻峰及滞回）、面内磁场下的输运测量（观测极化依赖的峰移）、电场冷却过程（用于多铁畴控制）。

papers.title: Coexisting Large and Small Polarons in Photoexcited CeO$_2$
papers.abstract: Time-resolved terahertz (THz) spectroscopy is used to probe polaron formation in CeO$_2$. The ultrafast THz photoconductivity is dominated by contributions from large hole and small electron polarons. Delocalized large hole polarons are formed on a $820 \pm 50$ fs time scale and are of Fröhlich type, with optical conductivity well described by a simple Drude model and a transient hole mobility of $100$ cm$^2$/Vs. Small electron polarons form via localized coupling to Ce lattice sites, revealed by reduction in the lattice Born effective charge causing a transient phonon softening. These results establish the dual polaron nature of CeO$_2$ and provide a basis for understanding charge transfer dynamics in metal oxide photocatalysts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Time-resolved terahertz (THz) spectroscopy is used to probe”，属于时间分辨太赫兹光谱实验。；研究对象：CeO₂（二氧化铈）中光激发后的极化子形成过程，具体涉及大极化子（空穴型）与小极化子（电子型）的共存及其动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CeO₂在光激发下同时形成离域的大空穴极化子（Fröhlich型，形成时间约820 fs，瞬态空穴迁移率约100 cm²/Vs）和局域的小电子极化子（通过与Ce晶格位点的局域耦合形成，伴随晶格Born有效电荷降低和瞬态声子软化），确立了CeO₂的双极化子本质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CeO₂在光激发下同时形成离域的大空穴极化子（Fröhlich型，形成时间约820 fs，瞬态空穴迁移率约100 cm²/Vs）和局域的小电子极化子（通过与Ce晶格位点的局域耦合形成，伴随晶格Born有效电荷降低和瞬态声子软化），确立了CeO₂的双极化子本质。；创新点：首次在实验上直接观测到CeO₂中光激发下大极化子与小极化子共存的双极化子特性，并定量给出了大空穴极化子的形成时间与迁移率，为理解金属氧化物光催化剂中的电荷转移动力学提供了微观基础。（摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异，但“establish the dual polaron nature”表明这是首次确立该材料的双极化子图像。）
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨太赫兹光谱（Time-resolved THz spectroscopy），结合光学电导率分析（用Drude模型描述大极化子贡献）以及晶格Born有效电荷变化的探测（用于揭示小极化子引起的声子软化）。

papers.title: Linear stability and viscoelastic response in weakly jammed frictional granular systems
papers.abstract: Granular particles typically feature contact friction, which gives rise to various nontrivial properties of granular materials. In this work, we investigate the linear stability of static packings composed of frictional spheres, whose interactions are modeled using the discrete element method. We discuss a key difficulty in properly modeling static friction and address the problem of identifying rattlers. We also explore the spectrum of the energy matrix, which governs the linear viscoelastic response of the system. The intermediate- and high-frequency regimes of the spectrum remain qualitatively independent of both the friction coefficient and the packing fraction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用离散元方法（discrete element method）进行建模”，属于数值模拟研究。；研究对象：弱堵塞（weakly jammed）状态下的摩擦颗粒体系，具体为摩擦球体的静态堆积（static packings of frictional spheres），关注其线性稳定性与线性黏弹性响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 能量矩阵的中间频率和高频率区域对摩擦系数和堆积分数均保持定性不变，即这两个参数主要影响低频行为，而中高频响应具有普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：能量矩阵的中间频率和高频率区域对摩擦系数和堆积分数均保持定性不变，即这两个参数主要影响低频行为，而中高频响应具有普适性。；创新点：系统性地处理了摩擦颗粒体系中静态摩擦建模的难点，并首次明确揭示了能量矩阵中高频谱对摩擦系数和堆积分数的定性不敏感性。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用离散元方法（DEM）模拟摩擦球体间的相互作用，构建静态堆积；通过分析能量矩阵（energy matrix）的谱来研究系统的线性黏弹性响应；同时讨论了静态摩擦建模中的关键困难以及rattlers（悬浮颗粒）的识别问题。

papers.title: Universal tuning of Förster resonance energy transfer in gate-programmable conductor-dielectric-conductor heterostructures
papers.abstract: We develop a quantum-electrodynamical theory for universal tuning of spontaneous emission and Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) in a material-agnostic conductor-dielectric-conductor heterostructure. The platform consists of a dielectric spacer of thickness $W$ bounded by two gate-tunable two-dimensional conductors. The only microscopic input from the surrounding materials is the transverse-magnetic and transverse-electric reflection amplitudes $r_{\TM/\TE}(q_ρ,ω)$ of the two sheets. Starting from the QED photon propagator, we derive the retarded Maxwell dyadic, the vacuum/Hadamard field propagator, and the time-ordered Feynman propagator in the same geometry. The spontaneous-emission rate is controlled by the local vacuum spectral density, while FRET is controlled by the nonlocal retarded/advanced product $\obG_{\text R}(\bx_D,\bx_A;ω_D)\Im\,\balpha_A(ω_D)\obG_{\text A}(\bx_A,\bx_D;ω_D)$. In the transparent limit $r_{\TM}\to 0$, the near-field FRET rate recovers the bulk $x_ρ^{-6}$ law. In the Dirichlet/PEC branch $r_{\TM}\to -1$, the gapless transverse mode is removed and the donor-acceptor coupling acquires a Bessel-$K$ envelope, giving an exponentially screened FRET rate $Γ_{D\to A}\propto\exp(-2πx_ρ/W)$ at large lateral separation. In the opposite Neumann/PMC-like branch $r_{\TM}\to 1^{-}$, a nearly gapless transverse mode survives and produces a wide quasi-two-dimensional logarithmic propagator, enhancing the nonlocal electromagnetic coupling over a gate-programmable range $x_{ρ,*}\sim W/(1-r_{\TM})$. For graphene-Er implementations, the same retarded Green tensor also separates dissipative on-shell Er-to-graphene decay, governed by its absorptive part, from dispersive virtual-plasmon-mediated Er-Er coupling, governed by its reactive part; a plasmonic band gap can suppress the former while retaining the latter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We develop a quantum-electrodynamical theory”，并推导光子传播子、麦克斯韦并矢等解析表达式，属于理论/解析建模工作。；研究对象：导体-介电-导体（conductor-dielectric-conductor）异质结构，具体为厚度为W的介电间隔层夹在两个栅极可调二维导体之间；研究其中自发辐射和Förster共振能量转移（FRET）的调控，并以石墨烯-铒（Er）体系为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节二维导体的反射振幅r_TM（从透明极限到Dirichlet/PEC分支再到Neumann/PMC分支），可实现对FRET速率的通用调控：从体相x_ρ^{-6}幂律衰减，到指数屏蔽衰减exp(-2πx_ρ/W)，再到近无隙横模导致的宽程准二维对数型增强耦合；在石墨烯-Er体系中，等离激元带隙可抑制耗散性Er-石墨烯衰减而保留色散性Er-Er耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节二维导体的反射振幅r_TM（从透明极限到Dirichlet/PEC分支再到Neumann/PMC分支），可实现对FRET速率的通用调控：从体相x_ρ^{-6}幂律衰减，到指数屏蔽衰减exp(-2πx_ρ/W)，再到近无隙横模导致的宽程准二维对数型增强耦合；在石墨烯-Er体系中，等离激元带隙可抑制耗散性Er-石墨烯衰减而保留色散性Er-Er耦合。；创新点：提出一种材料无关（material-agnostic）的通用平台，仅需两个二维导体的反射振幅即可统一描述自发辐射和FRET的调控；揭示了从幂律到指数屏蔽再到对数增强的FRET行为转变，并展示了栅极可编程的耦合距离范围x_{ρ,*}~W/(1-r_TM)；同时区分了耗散性（吸收部分）与色散性（反应部分）的Er-石墨烯耦合机制。
papers.method_zh: 量子电动力学（QED）理论框架：从QED光子传播子出发，推导推迟麦克斯韦并矢、真空/Hadamard场传播子、时序Feynman传播子；利用二维导体的横磁/横电反射振幅r_TM/TE(q_ρ,ω)作为唯一微观输入；分别分析自发辐射（局域真空谱密度）和FRET（非局域推迟/超前格林函数乘积）的表达式，并在不同反射极限下做渐近分析。

papers.title: Superconductivity of Tellurium Polyhydride with Tc above 90K
papers.abstract: We report experimental diacovery of superconductivity (SC) in tellurium (Te) polyhydride. The compound was synthesized at high pressure and high temperature conditions using a diamond anvil cell combined with a laser heating system. Subsequent in situ transport measurements at high pressures, performed as a function of temperature and applied magnetic field, revealed a superconducting transition with a critical temperature Tc about 91 K at 263 GPa. The superconducting phase is assigned to TeH4 with characterized face shared TeH12 cage forming quasi molecular H2 units based on synchrotron x-ray diffraction experiments. Analysis of the SC behavior at magnetic fields yielded a Ginzburg Landau (GL) coherence length of approximately 54 angstroms. Tellurium polyhydride thus becomes another chalcogen polyhydride superconductor in addition to the landmark discovery of the first polyhydride high Tc SC SH3.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要明确提到“experimental discovery”，并涉及高压合成、原位输运测量和同步辐射X射线衍射实验。；研究对象：碲（Te）多氢化物，具体为TeH₄，在高压高温条件下合成，研究其超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在263 GPa压力下，碲多氢化物TeH₄表现出超导转变，临界温度Tc约为91 K，成为继SH₃之后又一硫族元素多氢化物高温超导体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在263 GPa压力下，碲多氢化物TeH₄表现出超导转变，临界温度Tc约为91 K，成为继SH₃之后又一硫族元素多氢化物高温超导体。；创新点：首次实验发现碲多氢化物的超导电性，将硫族元素多氢化物高温超导家族从硫（SH₃）拓展至碲（TeH₄），并确定了其独特的TeH₁₂笼状结构及准分子H₂单元构型。
papers.method_zh: 金刚石对顶砧（DAC）结合激光加热系统进行高压高温合成；原位输运测量（变温、变磁场）确定超导转变；同步辐射X射线衍射（XRD）确定晶体结构；基于磁场下超导行为分析提取Ginzburg-Landau相干长度。

papers.title: Attosecond Reconstruction of Strain Tensors via Electronic Fingerprints
papers.abstract: We demonstrate an attosecond transient absorption spectroscopy (ATAS) scheme for reconstructing strain tensors in two-dimensional materials. Using strained graphene as a prototype system, we show that the fishbone structures in ATAS serve as distinctive spectral fingerprints of strain, where strain-induced shifts and splittings of van Hove singularities encode the magnitude and orientation of the strain tensor, respectively. By combining density-matrix simulations with analytical modeling, we establish a direct mapping between transient absorption spectra and strain tensors, enabling accurate retrieval of lattice deformation from ultrafast electronic responses. Our work introduces an attosecond spectroscopic paradigm for ultrafast strain metrology, where electronic fingerprints replace conventional structural probes for sensing lattice deformation in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“density-matrix simulations”与“analytical modeling”，未提及实验数据采集。；研究对象：二维材料中的应变张量，以应变石墨烯为原型体系；具体物理现象为超快应变诱导的电子结构变化及其在阿秒瞬态吸收光谱中的指纹特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 应变石墨烯的ATAS中“鱼骨结构”可作为应变的独特光谱指纹：应变引起的van Hove奇点位移编码应变大小，劈裂编码应变方向，从而可从超快电子响应中精确反演晶格形变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：应变石墨烯的ATAS中“鱼骨结构”可作为应变的独特光谱指纹：应变引起的van Hove奇点位移编码应变大小，劈裂编码应变方向，从而可从超快电子响应中精确反演晶格形变。；创新点：提出一种以电子指纹替代传统结构探针的阿秒光谱学范式，用于量子材料中超快应变计量，实现从电子动力学直接重构应变张量（大小与取向）。摘要未突出说明与已有应变测量方法的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 阿秒瞬态吸收光谱（ATAS）方案的理论模拟；结合密度矩阵数值模拟与解析建模，建立瞬态吸收光谱与应变张量之间的直接映射关系。

papers.title: Two-step transient liquid phase bonding of NiTi to Ti-6Al-4V through a NbZrW barrier
papers.abstract: Dissimilar joining of NiTi to Ti-6Al-4V (Ti-64) is limited by brittle Ti2Ni formation and degradation of NiTi functionality. A two-step transient liquid phase (TLP) route was developed in which a refractory NbZrW diffusion barrier converts the incompatible couple into two independently bondable interfaces. The barrier plays a different role for each alloy: a reactive substrate for NiTi, dissolving to form a Ti-rich Ni-Ti-Nb liquid that infiltrates its own grain boundaries and is terminated by selective Ti absorption into the barrier; and an inert substrate for Ti-64, joined through contact melting of a sacrificial Cu foil. Both interfaces are fully dense and free of continuous intermetallic layers. In tension, joints spanning both interfaces began transforming at 350 MPa, exhibited a stress plateau to 2.5 global strain (consistent with stress-induced transformation of the NiTi half of the gauge) and failed beyond the plateau at 380-410 MPa. Five load-unload cycles to 460 MPa showed stable superelastic loops with minor ratcheting. These results demonstrate that a diffusion barrier enables dissimilar TLP joining of otherwise incompatible alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的连接工艺开发、界面表征（“fully dense”“free of continuous intermetallic layers”）以及力学测试（拉伸、循环加载）等实验内容。；研究对象：NiTi形状记忆合金与Ti-6Al-4V（Ti-64）钛合金的异种材料连接，具体涉及通过NbZrW难熔扩散阻挡层实现两步瞬态液相（TLP）扩散焊的界面体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过NbZrW扩散阻挡层将NiTi/Ti-64不相容连接体系拆分为两个可独立键合的界面，成功获得无连续金属间化合物层的致密接头；接头在拉伸下表现出超弹性行为（应力平台至2.5%全局应变，失效强度380–410 MPa），且循环加载下具有稳定的超弹性滞回环。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过NbZrW扩散阻挡层将NiTi/Ti-64不相容连接体系拆分为两个可独立键合的界面，成功获得无连续金属间化合物层的致密接头；接头在拉伸下表现出超弹性行为（应力平台至2.5%全局应变，失效强度380–410 MPa），且循环加载下具有稳定的超弹性滞回环。；创新点：首次提出利用难熔NbZrW扩散阻挡层将原本不相容的NiTi/Ti-64异种连接转化为两个独立可控的TLP界面，分别利用阻挡层对两侧合金的不同作用（反应性溶解与惰性接触熔化）来抑制脆性Ti₂Ni相生成并保护NiTi功能特性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 两步瞬态液相（TLP）扩散焊工艺；NbZrW扩散阻挡层设计（对NiTi侧为反应性基底，对Ti-64侧为惰性基底）；Cu箔作为Ti-64侧接触熔化中间层；拉伸力学测试（含应力-应变曲线）及多循环加载-卸载测试（5次循环至460 MPa）。

papers.title: Experimental Observation of Mesoscopic Dynamic Fluctuations in Water-Alcohol Mixtures
papers.abstract: We applied a dynamic fluctuation measurement method to liquid water-methanol mixtures over a wide range of compositions and temperatures. This method, which we developed in recent years, combines ultrasonic and inelastic X-ray scattering techniques to detect mesoscopic-level fluctuations-that is, the degree of heterogeneity-in liquids using sound waves. The results showed that the strength of dynamic fluctuations increased as the alcohol composition decreased and as the temperature decreased. This trend was also observed in water-ethanol and water-glycerol mixtures. From these results, we concluded that the origin of these fluctuations lies in the low-temperature (supercooled) region of water alone, and that mixing with alcohol eliminates the dynamic fluctuations. This conclusion-that mixing substances reduces fluctuations or heterogeneity-may seem strange at first glance, but it is actually consistent with the framework of the liquid-liquid phase transition hypothesis, which explains the thermodynamic anomalies of water. It also aligns with the results of our recent measurements of the strength of dynamic fluctuations in water across a wide range of temperature and pressure conditions. It has long been known that various thermodynamic anomalies exist in water-alcohol mixtures at low compositions, and while there have been various discussions on this topic in the past, our current findings offer a new perspective on these discussions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述“We applied a dynamic fluctuation measurement method”，并给出实验测量结果。；研究对象：水-甲醇、水-乙醇、水-甘油混合液体体系中的介观动态涨落（即液体中尺度不均匀性），以及其随组分和温度的变化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 水-醇混合物的动态涨落强度随醇组分减少和温度降低而增强；该涨落的起源在于纯水的低温（过冷）区域，混合醇类会消除这种动态涨落，这一行为与液-液相变假说框架一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：水-醇混合物的动态涨落强度随醇组分减少和温度降低而增强；该涨落的起源在于纯水的低温（过冷）区域，混合醇类会消除这种动态涨落，这一行为与液-液相变假说框架一致。；创新点：首次将动态涨落测量方法系统应用于水-醇混合物，揭示低组分区热力学反常的新视角，并将涨落起源明确归因于纯水的过冷区域行为，与液-液相变假说及近期纯水宽温压动态涨落测量结果相衔接。摘要未突出说明与传统方法或理论计算的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 动态涨落测量方法，结合超声和非弹性X射线散射技术，通过声波探测液体中介观尺度的不均匀性（即动态涨落强度）。测量覆盖宽组分范围和温度范围。

papers.title: Tunable Pathway Selection in Coupled Multistable Snap-Through Systems
papers.abstract: Multistable mechanical systems can store and release elastic energy through snap-through instabilities, but controlling transition pathways between stable states remains challenging when multiple routes are accessible. Here, we introduce a two-mass von Mises truss as a general model for studying pathway selection governed by coupled saddle-node bifurcations. The system consists of two coupled snap-through units with geometric imperfections, giving rise to four stable configurations: a fully inverted state, a fully natural state, and two intermediate mixed states. We show that the coupling stiffness reorganizes the quasi-static bifurcation structure and selects among three transition pathways under release: sequential snapping through one mixed state, direct cooperative snapping, or sequential snapping through the other mixed state. Using pseudo-arclength continuation, we track the relevant saddle-node bifurcations and identify the parameter regimes associated with each quasi-static pathway. We then demonstrate that dynamic bifurcation delay provides an additional rate-dependent mechanism for pathway selection. Even when the quasi-static bifurcation structure favours a unique sequential pathway, finite-rate loading delays snap-through beyond the corresponding static saddle-node points and can reorder the snapping sequence of the two units. A local reduction of the coupled dynamics near each saddle-node yields normal forms with coupling-dependent critical points and coefficients. The resulting theory identifies distinct rate-dependent delay laws in the inertia-dominated and overdamped regimes and predicts the critical rate at which the snapping order reverses. These results establish a general mechanics framework for tuning transition pathways in multistable systems through elastic coupling and loading-rate control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“pseudo-arclength continuation”（伪弧长延拓）、“normal forms”（规范形）等理论分析与数值计算方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：耦合多稳态弹跳系统，具体为双质量 von Mises 桁架（two-mass von Mises truss），包含两个带几何缺陷的弹跳单元，具有四个稳定构型（完全倒置态、完全自然态及两个中间混合态）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节耦合刚度可重组准静态分岔结构，从而在三种释放路径（经某一混合态的依次弹跳、直接协同弹跳、经另一混合态的依次弹跳）中选择；此外，动态分岔延迟提供了依赖加载速率的额外路径选择机制，可在有限速率下改变两个单元的弹跳顺序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节耦合刚度可重组准静态分岔结构，从而在三种释放路径（经某一混合态的依次弹跳、直接协同弹跳、经另一混合态的依次弹跳）中选择；此外，动态分岔延迟提供了依赖加载速率的额外路径选择机制，可在有限速率下改变两个单元的弹跳顺序。；创新点：建立了通过弹性耦合与加载速率控制多稳态系统转变路径的通用力学框架，特别是揭示了动态分岔延迟可超越准静态分岔结构偏好、重新排序弹跳顺序这一速率依赖机制。
papers.method_zh: 伪弧长延拓（pseudo-arclength continuation）跟踪鞍结分岔；对鞍结点附近的耦合动力学进行局部约化，推导含耦合依赖临界点与系数的规范形（normal forms）；分别分析惯性主导与过阻尼区间的速率依赖延迟律，并预测弹跳顺序反转的临界速率。

papers.title: Libron-phonon coupling and hydrogen-bond dynamics in the vacancy-ordered perovskite (NH4)2SnCl6: a temperature- and pressure-dependent Raman study
papers.abstract: Vacancy-ordered perovskites R2MX6 combine a rigid inorganic framework with a molecular A-site cation, but how the cation dynamics couples to the lattice phonons under external perturbation remains largely unexplored. The librational motion of NH4+ in (NH4)2SnCl6 is strictly Raman-silent by symmetry, which is why it has been probed almost exclusively by neutron scattering, NMR and NQR. We show that it is nevertheless accessible to Raman spectroscopy, through the renormalization it imposes on the allowed [SnCl6]2- modes. Combining single-crystal X-ray diffraction with Raman scattering between 10 and 300 K and up to 10.1 GPa, we find that the average cubic structure varies smoothly with no anomaly, while below ~100 K the [SnCl6]2- modes acquire a libron-phonon renormalization (E_eff ~ 4.7 meV) and a symmetry-selective line asymmetry, and the N-H stretch passes through a minimum near 120 K (E_eff ~ 9.3 meV); both track the classical-to-quantum crossover of the ammonium rotor. The two effective energies lie below the bare librational transition of 13.4 meV measured by neutrons, as expected for a self-energy scale. The ammonium linewidths, by contrast, are governed by pure dephasing rather than by anharmonic decay and carry no crossover signature. Under pressure the octahedral modes stiffen smoothly, whereas the cavity responds twice: the translational F2g mode of NH4+ gains Raman intensity above 1.3 GPa, and the N-H stretch inverts its pressure slope near 1.7 GPa, with no change of space group and full recovery on decompression. The rigid octahedral framework is thus essentially decoupled from a dynamically active NH4+ subsystem that carries the response to both perturbations, offering a route to tune cation-phonon coupling independently of the octahedral network.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“Raman study”“single-crystal X-ray diffraction”“Raman scattering”等实验手段，且涉及温度（10–300 K）和压力（至10.1 GPa）依赖测量。；研究对象：空位有序钙钛矿（NH₄）₂SnCl₆，具体研究其NH₄⁺阳离子的平动/转动（libration）动力学与[SnCl₆]²⁻八面体框架声子之间的耦合，以及该耦合在温度和压力下的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管NH₄⁺的平动模式在对称性上严格拉曼静默，但其动力学可通过重整化[SnCl₆]²⁻允许模式而被拉曼光谱间接探测；低温下（~100 K以下）观测到libron-phonon重整化（E_eff ~ 4.7 meV）和对称选择性线型不对称，N-H伸缩振动在~120 K附近出现能量极小（E_eff ~ 9.3 meV），两者均追踪铵转子从经典到量子的交叉。压力下八面体框架平滑硬化，而NH₄⁺子系统在1.3 GPa和1.7 GPa附近分别表现出拉曼强度增强和压力斜率反转，且无结构相变、可完全可逆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管NH₄⁺的平动模式在对称性上严格拉曼静默，但其动力学可通过重整化[SnCl₆]²⁻允许模式而被拉曼光谱间接探测；低温下（~100 K以下）观测到libron-phonon重整化（E_eff ~ 4.7 meV）和对称选择性线型不对称，N-H伸缩振动在~120 K附近出现能量极小（E_eff ~ 9.3 meV），两者均追踪铵转子从经典到量子的交叉。压力下八面体框架平滑硬化，而NH₄⁺子系统在1.3 GPa和1.7 GPa附近分别表现出拉曼强度增强和压力斜率反转，且无结构相变、可完全可逆。；创新点：首次证明对称性静默的NH₄⁺平动模式可通过其对允许八面体模式的重整化效应而被拉曼光谱间接探测，从而绕过了传统上必须依赖中子散射、NMR和NQR的限制；并揭示了阳离子-声子耦合可在不改变八面体框架的情况下被温度和压力独立调控。
papers.method_zh: 单晶X射线衍射（10–300 K）结合变温（10–300 K）和变压（至10.1 GPa）拉曼散射光谱；通过分析[SnCl₆]²⁻模式的重整化能量（E_eff）和线型不对称性，以及N-H伸缩振动和NH₄⁺平动模式的压力/温度依赖行为来提取耦合信息。

papers.title: Chemical potentials from structure factors: II. Charged multi-component mixtures
papers.abstract: The chemical potentials of charged multi-component mixtures are central to electrolyte thermodynamics, but remain difficult to compute from atomistic simulations. The S0 method enables computing chemical potentials of mixtures from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations. Here we extend the S0 method to charged mixtures by combining the composition-space framework developed in Part I: Neutral Multi-component Mixtures with a Coulombic treatment of the small-wavenumber limits of static structure factors. This approach separates thermodynamically relevant neutral composition fluctuations from forbidden macroscopic charge fluctuations, and further accounts for charge-neutrality constraints. We use the method to compute the chemical potentials of multiple-halide aqueous salt solutions, elucidating the ion-specific thermodynamic effects. We also calculate the mixing free energies of molten salt mixtures, demonstrating the importance of correctly describing long-wavelength electrostatic correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations”（平衡分子动力学模拟）、“S0 method”（S0方法）以及“static structure factors”（静态结构因子）等计算与理论关键词。；研究对象：带电多组分混合物，具体包括多卤化物水盐溶液（multiple-halide aqueous salt solutions）和熔盐混合物（molten salt mixtures）。研究聚焦于这些体系的化学势、混合自由能以及离子特异性热力学效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将S0方法扩展到带电混合物，成功计算了多卤化物水盐溶液的化学势和熔盐混合物的混合自由能，揭示了离子特异性热力学效应，并证明了正确描述长波长静电关联对混合自由能的重要性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将S0方法扩展到带电混合物，成功计算了多卤化物水盐溶液的化学势和熔盐混合物的混合自由能，揭示了离子特异性热力学效应，并证明了正确描述长波长静电关联对混合自由能的重要性。；创新点：将S0方法从中性混合物推广至带电混合物，通过库仑处理小波数结构因子极限，在组分空间框架中同时处理中性涨落与电荷中性约束，从而能够计算带电多组分体系的化学势和混合自由能。
papers.method_zh: 采用S0方法，结合第一部分（中性多组分混合物）建立的组分空间框架，对静态结构因子的小波数极限进行库仑处理。该方法将热力学相关的中性组分涨落与禁止的宏观电荷涨落分离，并考虑电荷中性约束。具体计算基于平衡分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: A unified geometric design framework for kirigami structures
papers.abstract: In recent years, kirigami metamaterials have been widely studied and applied in science and engineering. While various two- and three-dimensional kirigami design methods have been developed, most of them are only applicable to a limited class of kirigami structures. In this work, we develop a unified framework for kirigami design that encompasses a wide range of 2D-to-2D, 2D-to-3D, and 3D-to-3D shape-morphing effects, as well as additional geometric and physical properties such as compact reconfigurability and rigid deployability. In particular, by reformulating the design task as a length-based constrained optimization problem and solving it simultaneously for multiple target states of the kirigami structure, our unified design framework enables greater design flexibility and stronger theoretical support. Experimental results with a wide range of shape-morphing effects are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. We further present a rigorous theoretical analysis of several key aspects of kirigami design, covering inertia transposition, aspect-ratio law, and angle defects, thereby elucidating important design rules and limitations. Altogether, our work paves a new way for the design of shape-morphing mechanical metamaterials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+实验）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“constrained optimization problem”（理论/计算框架）与“Experimental results”（实验验证）。；研究对象：剪纸（kirigami）超材料，具体为可实现2D-to-2D、2D-to-3D、3D-to-3D形状变形的剪纸结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个统一的剪纸设计框架，通过将设计任务重构为基于长度的约束优化问题并同时求解多个目标状态，可涵盖广泛的形状变形效应，并兼具紧凑可重构性与刚性可展开性等几何物理特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个统一的剪纸设计框架，通过将设计任务重构为基于长度的约束优化问题并同时求解多个目标状态，可涵盖广泛的形状变形效应，并兼具紧凑可重构性与刚性可展开性等几何物理特性。；创新点：相较于现有仅适用于有限类别剪纸结构的设计方法，该框架统一了2D-to-2D、2D-to-3D、3D-to-3D多种变形模式，并同时纳入可重构性与可展开性等额外约束，提供了更强的设计灵活性和理论支撑。摘要未突出说明具体实验材料或制备工艺。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为长度约束优化（length-based constrained optimization），对多目标状态进行同步求解；实验部分展示了多种形状变形效应的验证结果；此外还包含针对惯性转置、长宽比定律和角缺陷的严格理论分析。

papers.title: Twist-Tunable Paramagnetic Superconductivity in $d$-wave Altermagnet/Superconductor Heterostructures
papers.abstract: The interplay between twist-angle engineering and unconventional magnetism provides a powerful new route to control quantum phenomena. We theoretically investigate a heterostructure comprising a $d$-wave superconductor proximitized by a two-dimensional $d$-wave altermagnet. We reveal that the momentum-space mismatch between the superconducting gap nodes and the altermagnetic spin-splitting nodes generates a robust, twist-tunable odd-frequency spin-triplet pairing. Consequently, the macroscopic electromagnetic response of the system can be tuned from a conventional diamagnetic Meissner state to an anomalous paramagnetic Meissner effect driven entirely by the interfacial twist angle. For a $d_{x^2-y^2}$ altermagnet, the paramagnetic response is maximized at perfect alignment ($φ=0$) and completely suppressed at a maximal twist of $φ=π/4$, while a $d_{xy}$ altermagnet exhibits the exact complementary behavior. Our results establish twisted altermagnetic heterostructures as a versatile platform for engineering odd-frequency pairing and macroscopic superconducting phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We theoretically investigate”，属于理论计算/模型研究。；研究对象：由二维 d 波交变磁体（altermagnet）与 d 波超导体构成的异质结，重点研究界面转角调控下的超导配对对称性与宏观电磁响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超导能隙节点与交变磁自旋劈裂节点在动量空间中的失配可产生稳健的、可由转角调控的奇频自旋三重态配对，从而使系统宏观电磁响应从常规抗磁Meissner态转变为反常顺磁Meissner效应。对于 d_{x²-y²} 交变磁体，顺磁响应在完美对齐（φ=0）时最大，在最大转角 φ=π/4 时完全抑制；而 d_{xy} 交变磁体表现出完全互补的行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超导能隙节点与交变磁自旋劈裂节点在动量空间中的失配可产生稳健的、可由转角调控的奇频自旋三重态配对，从而使系统宏观电磁响应从常规抗磁Meissner态转变为反常顺磁Meissner效应。对于 d_{x²-y²} 交变磁体，顺磁响应在完美对齐（φ=0）时最大，在最大转角 φ=π/4 时完全抑制；而 d_{xy} 交变磁体表现出完全互补的行为。；创新点：首次提出将转角工程与交变磁体结合，利用动量空间节点失配实现可调谐的奇频自旋三重态配对，并证明仅通过界面转角即可在抗磁与顺磁Meissner态之间连续调控宏观超导电磁响应。摘要未突出说明与已有转角超导或交变磁体研究的更具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论模型分析，具体涉及动量空间对称性分析（超导能隙节点与交变磁自旋劈裂节点的失配分析）、奇频配对机制推导，以及宏观电磁响应（Meissner效应）的计算。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如是否使用BdG、格林函数等）。

papers.title: Chiral-symmetry breaking and degeneracy in Koch fractal geometries
papers.abstract: Fractal geometries provide a distinctive platform for controlling quantum interference, topology, and localization. We investigate the Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) model constructed on the Koch curve, where a triangular geometry enables additional same-sublattice hoppings that break chiral symmetry and modify the conventional topological behavior captured by a real-space local marker. Destructive interference within the triangular units produces a highly degenerate flat level at $E=-t$. Although this level originates from the local geometry, its degeneracy and spectral weight are controlled by the self-similar connectivity of the Koch curve. The hierarchy reduces the number of independent flat states and reorganizes the spectrum into an intricate distribution of energy levels. Our results reveal complementary roles for local triangular interference and global fractal connectivity in shaping the electronic properties of geometrically modified SSH chains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“investigate”“real-space local marker”“spectrum”等理论分析与数值计算相关表述，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：基于Koch曲线的Su–Schrieffer–Heeger（SSH）模型，即一维SSH链的几何分形修饰体系，重点研究三角几何单元引入的同子格跳跃对手性对称性、拓扑行为及电子态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Koch分形几何中三角单元内的相消干涉产生位于E=-t的高度简并平带，该平带的简并度与谱权重由Koch曲线的自相似连通性控制；局域三角干涉与全局分形连通性共同塑造了修饰SSH链的电子性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Koch分形几何中三角单元内的相消干涉产生位于E=-t的高度简并平带，该平带的简并度与谱权重由Koch曲线的自相似连通性控制；局域三角干涉与全局分形连通性共同塑造了修饰SSH链的电子性质。；创新点：揭示了分形几何中局域三角干涉（破坏手性对称性）与全局自相似连通性（控制平带简并度与谱重排）的互补作用，展示了分形维度对SSH链拓扑与电子结构的非平庸调控。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值分析：构建Koch曲线上的SSH模型，引入同子格跳跃项，采用实空间局域拓扑标记（real-space local marker）表征拓扑行为，通过谱分析研究平带简并度与能级分布。

papers.title: Chemical Perspectives on Cuprate Superconductivity: Hole-Protected Spin Dimers as d Wave Cooper Pairs
papers.abstract: The observation that the coherence lengths in cuprate superconductors are extremely small motivated us to search for its real-space structure by examining the consequence of hole-doping in CuO4 units in cuprates. We analyzed aggregates of hole-doped CuO4 units that phase-separate from hole-doped CuO2 layers in terms of their segregation-pressure indices defined in this work. Our search suggests that each d-wave Cooper pair is an antiferromagnetically coupled spin dimer protected in an antiferromagnetic hole dimer (AHD), and that the antiferromagnetic chains of AHDs provide channels through which such spin dimers can move collectively without perturbation. Based on these suggestions and their implications, we examined the causes for several seemingly puzzling observations on cuprate superconductors to find that they are naturally explained by the suggestions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“motivated us to search”“We analyzed”“Our search suggests”等表述，属于理论分析与模型构建，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体（cuprate superconductors），具体聚焦于CuO4单元中空穴掺杂后的相分离行为，以及d波Cooper对的实空间结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出每个d波Cooper对本质上是一个被“反铁磁空穴二聚体”（AHD）保护的反铁磁耦合自旋二聚体；AHD的反铁磁链为这些自旋二聚体提供了无扰动的集体移动通道，从而可自然解释铜氧化物超导体中若干看似费解的实验现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出每个d波Cooper对本质上是一个被“反铁磁空穴二聚体”（AHD）保护的反铁磁耦合自旋二聚体；AHD的反铁磁链为这些自旋二聚体提供了无扰动的集体移动通道，从而可自然解释铜氧化物超导体中若干看似费解的实验现象。；创新点：将d波Cooper对与实空间中的“空穴保护自旋二聚体”结构直接对应，并提出AHD链作为集体输运通道的微观机制，为铜氧化物超导的实空间配对图像提供了新的化学视角。摘要未突出说明与已有理论（如自旋涨落、共振价键等）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：定义了“偏析压力指数”（segregation-pressure indices），用于分析空穴掺杂CuO4单元聚集体从空穴掺杂CuO2层中相分离的趋势；基于该指数对AHD结构及其动力学通道进行推理。

papers.title: Van Hove singularities at the $L$-face of the lutetium nitride phonon dispersion
papers.abstract: We report the structural and vibrational properties of the prototypical 4$f$-filled nonmagnetic member LuN of the lanthanide nitrides, \textit{Ln}N, with elastic and inelastic neutron scattering data at $4$~K. We find a peak in the generalized density of states which, through input from a DFT+$U$ computation, we ascribe to a van Hove singularity on the fourfold-degenerate $L$-face of the Brillouin zone. This work advances the understanding of phonon dynamics in \textit{Ln}N beyond the $Γ$-point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。判断依据：摘要提及“elastic and inelastic neutron scattering data”（弹性/非弹性中子散射实验）以及“DFT+$U$ computation”（DFT+U 计算）。；研究对象：镧系氮化物家族（\textit{Ln}N）中的原型非磁性成员——氮化镥（LuN），具体研究其晶格（结构）与振动（声子）性质，聚焦于布里渊区 $L$ 面上的声子色散行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 4 K 下测得的广义声子态密度中出现一个峰，通过 DFT+$U$ 计算将其归因于布里渊区四重简并 $L$ 面上的范霍夫奇点。该工作将 \textit{Ln}N 声子动力学的研究从 $Γ$ 点拓展到了 $L$ 面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 4 K 下测得的广义声子态密度中出现一个峰，通过 DFT+$U$ 计算将其归因于布里渊区四重简并 $L$ 面上的范霍夫奇点。该工作将 \textit{Ln}N 声子动力学的研究从 $Γ$ 点拓展到了 $L$ 面。；创新点：首次在 \textit{Ln}N 体系中明确将声子态密度峰与 $L$ 面上的范霍夫奇点联系起来，突破了以往仅关注 $Γ$ 点声子行为的局限。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用弹性与非弹性中子散射（4 K 低温）；理论上采用 DFT+$U$ 计算辅助解释实验数据。

papers.title: Asymmetry-controlled resonant transport in a Brownian flashing ratchet
papers.abstract: We investigate directed transport in a one-dimensional Brownian flashing ratchet with a piecewise-linear asymmetric periodic potential. Numerical solutions of the Fokker--Planck equation and Brownian dynamics simulations reveal a nonmonotonic dependence of the stationary current on the switching frequency, with a resonant maximum whose position depends on the potential asymmetry $δ$ and barrier height $Δ$. For moderate asymmetry, $|δ|<0.5$, the current obeys a scaling form that separates the dependence on the potential parameters from a common frequency dependence, resulting in a data collapse upon appropriate scaling of the current and frequency. The current amplitude varies linearly with $δ$, while the resonance frequency follows $ν(δ,Δ)=ν_0(Δ)/ [1-b_0\, δ^2]$. We interpret the resulting $(1-δ^2)^{-1}$ scaling in terms of coupled relaxation along the two branches of the asymmetric potential, which provides a physical basis for the observed dependence of the resonant frequency on the potential asymmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“Fokker--Planck方程数值解”和“布朗动力学模拟”，属于理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：一维布朗闪烁棘轮（Brownian flashing ratchet）中的定向输运现象，具体为分段线性非对称周期势场中的粒子输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 稳态电流随开关频率呈非单调变化，存在共振极大值；共振频率随势垒不对称度δ增大而按(1−δ²)⁻¹规律增大，且中等不对称度下电流满足标度律，可统一数据塌缩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：稳态电流随开关频率呈非单调变化，存在共振极大值；共振频率随势垒不对称度δ增大而按(1−δ²)⁻¹规律增大，且中等不对称度下电流满足标度律，可统一数据塌缩。；创新点：发现电流与频率的标度分离形式，并给出共振频率对不对称度的显式依赖关系ν(δ,Δ)=ν₀(Δ)/[1−b₀δ²]，从物理上以不对称势两分支的耦合弛豫机制解释了该(1−δ²)⁻¹标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 数值求解Fokker–Planck方程，并结合布朗动力学（Brownian dynamics）模拟；通过标度分析提取电流与频率的普适关系，并用势垒两分支的耦合弛豫图像进行物理解释。

papers.title: Symmetry-Enforced Topological Structures in Quantum Phase Diagrams
papers.abstract: We study the topological structure of the quantum phase diagram of gapped systems by identifying the noncontractibility of loops, so-called $S^1$-families, within the gapped phase diagram in which many-body Hamiltonians can have nontrivial ground-state degeneracy. We manifest the role of symmetries in such $S^1$-family classifications by the exotic symmetry interplay: (i) nontrivial mixed anomalies, (ii) semi-direct product relation between the spontaneously broken and the unbroken symmetries, and (iii) symmetry with noninvertible operators. We find that such structures lead to the novel $S^1$-family classifications inaccessible by earlier classifications based on ``independent'' symmetries. Furthermore, we construct lattice realizations of these $S^1$-families and explicitly demonstrate their novel algebraic structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We study the topological structure”“classifications”“construct lattice realizations”等理论推导与模型构建关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：有能隙量子多体系统的量子相图，具体关注相图中不可收缩的环路（即 \(S^1\)-族）所对应的拓扑结构，以及这些结构如何受对称性（混合反常、半直积对称性、非可逆对称算子）影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对称性之间的非平凡相互作用（混合反常、自发破缺与未破缺对称性的半直积关系、非可逆对称算子）可以产生此前基于“独立对称性”分类无法触及的新型 \(S^1\)-族拓扑分类，并可通过晶格模型实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对称性之间的非平凡相互作用（混合反常、自发破缺与未破缺对称性的半直积关系、非可逆对称算子）可以产生此前基于“独立对称性”分类无法触及的新型 \(S^1\)-族拓扑分类，并可通过晶格模型实现。；创新点：突破了以往仅考虑“独立对称性”的 \(S^1\)-族分类框架，首次系统展示了对称性之间“纠缠”（混合反常、半直积、非可逆性）如何产生全新的拓扑分类，并给出了具体的晶格实现。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为对称性保护的拓扑分类，具体涉及 \(S^1\)-族（环路）的同伦非收缩性分析、混合反常与半直积对称性代数结构分析，以及非可逆对称算子的处理；并构造了晶格模型来显式验证这些代数结构。

papers.title: Cesium Clustering and Fluoroberyllate Network Disruption in FLiBe: A Total Scattering and Molecular Dynamics Study
papers.abstract: Several next-generation fission reactor designs employ molten salts such as FLiBe (2LiF-BeF$_2$), with some concepts using fuel dissolved directly in the salt. During operation, fission products such as cesium will accumulate in the salt mixture, potentially leading to an evolution of the thermophysical properties underpinned by the atomic structure. To understand the structural perturbations in FLiBe with 5 mol% CsF, we conducted X-ray and neutron diffraction measurements, refined empirical potential structure refinement (EPSR) models against the experimental data, and compared the resulting structure with neural network molecular dynamics (NNMD) simulations. Comparisons of the EPSR and NNMD structures distinguishes features constrained by the scattering data from those that remain model dependent. The new Cs-bearing correlations account for the changes in the total structure factor and pair-distribution function, while the FLiBe correlations remain minimally altered. We find that Cs slightly disrupts the intermediate-range fluoroberyllate network, increasing the fraction of free fluorine ions, while the local coordination remains largely unchanged. The Cs ions within FLiBe cluster extensively, with BeF$_4^{2-}$ tetrahedra bridging neighboring cesium environments. In contrast to the minor structural perturbations in the liquid, the addition of 5 mol% CsF suppressed the formation of the crystalline Li2BeF4 phase at room temperature, with the phase appearing only above 180C upon heating. These experimentally constrained structural features provide a benchmark for atomistic models used to predict the behavior and properties of fission-product-containing FLiBe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：X射线/中子衍射实验、EPSR建模、神经网络分子动力学（NNMD）模拟。；研究对象：熔盐FLiBe（2LiF-BeF₂）中添加5 mol% CsF后的原子结构，重点研究铯（Cs）聚集行为、氟铍酸盐网络结构扰动，以及Cs对结晶相形成的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cs在FLiBe中显著聚集，轻微破坏中程氟铍酸盐网络并增加自由氟离子比例，但局域配位基本不变；5 mol% CsF抑制了室温下Li₂BeF₄晶相的形成，该相仅在加热至180°C以上才出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cs在FLiBe中显著聚集，轻微破坏中程氟铍酸盐网络并增加自由氟离子比例，但局域配位基本不变；5 mol% CsF抑制了室温下Li₂BeF₄晶相的形成，该相仅在加热至180°C以上才出现。；创新点：首次将总散射实验数据与NNMD模拟结合，定量表征含裂变产物Cs的FLiBe熔盐中Cs聚集及氟铍酸盐网络扰动，并发现Cs对结晶动力学（抑制Li₂BeF₄室温成相）的显著影响。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: X射线和中子衍射实验测量总结构因子与对分布函数；经验势结构精修（EPSR）对实验数据建模；神经网络分子动力学（NNMD）模拟；EPSR与NNMD结构对比以区分数据约束特征与模型依赖特征。

papers.title: Chiral superconductors and competing states across a Lifshitz transition in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene
papers.abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene hosts a distinctive low-energy electronic structure in which strong Coulomb interactions and nontrivial quantum geometry intertwine to generate exotic quantum states. Recent experiments reported signatures of chiral superconductivity in electron-doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene within the spin- and valley-polarized regime. Here we map the normal-state fermiology surrounding chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene. Quantum oscillation measurements reveal an electrically controlled Lifshitz transition between a simply-connected circular quarter-metal Fermi surface and an annular quarter-metal Fermi surface. The Lifshitz boundary itself shifts with perpendicular magnetic field, consistent with the strongly momentum-dependent orbital magnetic moment of the low-energy band. Approaching the transition from either side, the electron effective mass becomes strongly enhanced, implying the formation of a nearly dispersionless band bottom and a strongly reduced kinetic-energy scale. This singular electronic structure produces a regime of exceptionally strong instability in which chiral superconductivity competes with Wigner crystalline phases and reentrant quantum Hall states. In particular, two superconducting regions with signatures of orbital time-reversal-symmetry breaking lie on opposite sides of the Lifshitz boundary and have comparable transition temperatures, yet the annular-side state is suppressed by a substantially smaller perpendicular magnetic field. Our calculation finds comparable chiral pairing tendencies on the two parent Fermi surfaces while producing a much lower orbital-Zeeman pair-breaking scale and an additional finite-momentum pairing tendency for the annular state. These results identify Fermi-surface topology as a key control parameter for chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要包含“Quantum oscillation measurements”（量子振荡实验测量）以及“Our calculation finds...”（理论计算），属于实验与计算结合的研究。；研究对象：菱面体五层石墨烯（rhombohedral pentalayer graphene）中的手性超导电性，以及伴随的Lifshitz转变、Wigner晶体相和回旋量子霍尔态等竞争态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在菱面体五层石墨烯中，通过电场调控实现了费米面拓扑从简单连通圆形到环形的Lifshitz转变，该转变边界随垂直磁场移动；在转变两侧均出现手性超导态，但环形费米面一侧的超导态被显著更小的垂直磁场抑制，表明费米面拓扑是控制手性超导的关键参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在菱面体五层石墨烯中，通过电场调控实现了费米面拓扑从简单连通圆形到环形的Lifshitz转变，该转变边界随垂直磁场移动；在转变两侧均出现手性超导态，但环形费米面一侧的超导态被显著更小的垂直磁场抑制，表明费米面拓扑是控制手性超导的关键参数。；创新点：首次在菱面体五层石墨烯中系统绘制了手性超导附近的正常态费米学，并揭示了Lifshitz转变两侧超导态对磁场响应的显著不对称性，将费米面拓扑确立为手性超导的关键调控自由度。
papers.method_zh: 量子振荡测量（quantum oscillation measurements）用于表征正常态费米面拓扑和有效质量；理论计算用于分析手性配对倾向、轨道Zeeman对破坏效应以及有限动量配对趋势。

papers.title: Birefringent-colored optical profiling of wood presenting the 3D cellulose microfibril architecture
papers.abstract: Wood slices under a polarized optical microscope show a spectrum of interference colors, such as cyan, blue, magenta, yellow, and bluish gray because of the birefringent cellulose in the microfibrils. An optical model is established to simulate the birefringent-colored micrograph of wood. Five typical cell wall architectures, line, helix, ring, crossed helix, and twisted helix, are considered. With a retardation wave plate to distinguish fibrils of different orientations, each structure displays its unique birefringent-colored texture, presenting its underlying 3D structure with the vivid colors. Cross sections of the trunk and twig of Eucalyptus grandis presented birefringent-colored profiles. Three identification methods were compared: visible fibril trends, birefringent-colored optical textures, and the simulated look-up library. The three methods gave consistent results, proving that the birefringent-color tags are efficient and accurate. Electron and atomic force microscopy are unable to resolve cellulose microfibrils embedded in the lignin and hemicellulose matrix. Polarized optical microscopy overcomes this by selectively detecting birefringent cellulose, enabling accurate identification of complex helical structures. This method enables statistical and spatial analysis of complex biomaterial compositions. Capable of profiling dozens of cells simultaneously, this high-throughput optical method provides a potentially fully automated analysis framework for plant science, biomechanics, and bioinspired cellulose materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 建模/模拟）。判断依据关键词：optical model is established to simulate、polarized optical microscope、experimental comparison。；研究对象：木材切片中纤维素微纤丝（cellulose microfibrils）的三维排列结构，具体涉及五种典型细胞壁构型（直线、螺旋、环状、交叉螺旋、扭转螺旋），以及巨桉（Eucalyptus grandis）树干和枝条的横截面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过偏振光学显微镜结合延迟波片，木材切片中不同取向的纤维素微纤丝会呈现特征性的双折射干涉色纹理，这些颜色标签能够准确、高效地识别复杂螺旋结构的三维细胞壁构型，且与电子显微镜和原子力显微镜结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过偏振光学显微镜结合延迟波片，木材切片中不同取向的纤维素微纤丝会呈现特征性的双折射干涉色纹理，这些颜色标签能够准确、高效地识别复杂螺旋结构的三维细胞壁构型，且与电子显微镜和原子力显微镜结果一致。；创新点：利用双折射干涉色作为“颜色标签”直接可视化并识别木材细胞壁中嵌入木质素/半纤维素基质内的纤维素微纤丝三维构型，克服了电子显微镜和原子力显微镜无法分辨基质内微纤丝的局限，并实现了对复杂螺旋结构的高通量、可统计的空间分析。摘要未明确说明该光学模型的具体数值实现细节。
papers.method_zh: 偏振光学显微镜（polarized optical microscopy）结合延迟波片（retardation wave plate）进行双折射彩色成像；建立了光学模型模拟双折射彩色显微图；对比了三种识别方法（可见纤丝走向、双折射彩色纹理、模拟查找库）；并与电子显微镜和原子力显微镜进行对照验证。

papers.title: Spin-textured orbitals in altermagnetic artificial atoms
papers.abstract: Artificial atoms provide a versatile platform for engineering atomic-like orbitals, yet spin generally remains a passive degree of freedom in their orbital structure. Here, we introduce the concept of altermagnetic artificial atoms formed by confining electrons with momentum-dependent spin splitting. We show that altermagnetism reconstructs conventional confined orbitals into spin-textured orbitals, with spatially distinct distributions of opposite spin components. The resulting confined spectrum retains a twofold degeneracy protected by the combined $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ symmetry. These spin textures persist in higher-energy states, where additional radial structures combine with the characteristic angular spin pattern. Furthermore, strain resolves the degenerate orbital pairs into spin-polarized states, and continuously tunes their energy splitting. Our results establish altermagnetic artificial atoms as a route to engineering spin-dependent orbital structures in quantum-confined systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“introduce the concept”“We show that”“Our results establish”等理论推导与模型构建表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：交变磁性人工原子（altermagnetic artificial atoms），即通过将具有动量依赖自旋劈裂的电子限制在量子点/人工势阱中形成的体系，研究其轨道结构中的自旋纹理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交变磁性将传统受限轨道重构为自旋纹理轨道，使相反自旋分量在空间上分离分布；受限能谱在 $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ 联合对称性下保持二重简并，且应变可解除简并并连续调控自旋极化态的能量劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交变磁性将传统受限轨道重构为自旋纹理轨道，使相反自旋分量在空间上分离分布；受限能谱在 $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ 联合对称性下保持二重简并，且应变可解除简并并连续调控自旋极化态的能量劈裂。；创新点：首次提出“交变磁性人工原子”概念，将交变磁序与量子受限轨道工程结合，实现自旋作为主动自由度参与轨道结构设计，为在量子受限体系中工程化自旋依赖轨道结构提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论模型与对称性分析：基于动量依赖自旋劈裂的电子受限模型，利用 $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ 联合对称性分析能谱简并性，并引入应变作为可调参数研究简并解除与能级劈裂的连续调控。

papers.title: Chiral cellulose fibril organization in a plant cell wall as liquid crystal confined in a cylindrical boundary
papers.abstract: The order of cellulose microfibrils in xylem cell walls is identified using polarized optical microscopy. The line, helix, ring, crossed helix, and twisted helix organizations in a cylindrical shell are the equilibrium states of balanced elastic deformation and surface anchoring. A computational model of the five organizations is established to simulate their birefringent-colored profiles. These five textures present unique optical textures, which are clearly recognized in the cross sections of Eucalyptus grandis. The libriform fiber cell for support has a twisted helical cell wall. The vessel cell for high-speed water uptake consists of a helical layer covered by a layer of vortex array. The ray cell for radial transportation is crossed helical. The microfibril angles versus the radius of the cell wall were measured utilizing the distribution of birefringence colors. In fiber cell walls, the MFA is significantly correlated with the curvature, bending, and surface anchoring, respectively. In vessel cell walls, the vortex array includes focal conic domains of chiral order and topological defects of nematic order, suggesting that the phase transition of cellulose fibrils leads to pattern formation. Liquid crystal phases and patterns in the cell walls reveal how the cell wall thickens and how cells differentiate. Out of the frustration of long, stiff, twisting fibrils packed in slender tubes, trees generate the helical channel networks, transforming the brittle lamina into an elastic, tear-resistant, self-healing tissue.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算模拟结合）。判断依据：摘要中提及“利用偏振光学显微镜识别”（实验手段），以及“建立计算模型模拟双折射彩色剖面”（计算模拟）。；研究对象：植物细胞壁（具体为Eucalyptus grandis（巨桉）的木质部细胞）中纤维素微纤丝的手性液晶有序结构，以及其在圆柱形边界约束下的自组装组织形态（线状、螺旋、环状、交叉螺旋、扭曲螺旋等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纤维素微纤丝在圆柱形细胞壁中形成多种液晶织构（线、螺旋、环、交叉螺旋、扭曲螺旋），这些织构是弹性形变与表面锚定平衡的结果；不同细胞类型（纤维细胞、导管细胞、射线细胞）具有各自特征性的螺旋织构，且微纤丝角与细胞壁曲率、弯曲和表面锚定显著相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纤维素微纤丝在圆柱形细胞壁中形成多种液晶织构（线、螺旋、环、交叉螺旋、扭曲螺旋），这些织构是弹性形变与表面锚定平衡的结果；不同细胞类型（纤维细胞、导管细胞、射线细胞）具有各自特征性的螺旋织构，且微纤丝角与细胞壁曲率、弯曲和表面锚定显著相关。；创新点：将植物细胞壁中纤维素微纤丝的有序排列明确解释为受限在圆柱边界内的手性液晶相，并系统建立了五种液晶织构的计算模型与实验光学纹理的对应关系；揭示了涡旋阵列中的焦锥畴（手性序）和向列序拓扑缺陷，表明纤维素纤丝的相变驱动图案形成。摘要未突出说明与以往植物细胞壁结构研究相比的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 偏振光学显微镜（POM）用于识别细胞壁中微纤丝的有序结构；计算模型用于模拟五种液晶织构的双折射彩色剖面；利用双折射颜色分布测量微纤丝角随细胞壁半径的变化。

papers.title: Superheating Field of Extreme Type-II Superconductors Calculated from the Eliashberg Theory
papers.abstract: We calculate the superheating field $H_s$ of a type-II superconductor with a large Ginzburg-Landau parameter from the isotropic Eliashberg theory. It is shown that the temperature dependencies of $H_s(T)$ can be obtained from a thermodynamic approach for different scattering parameters $p=\hbar/2πτ_Nk_BT_c$ in a wide range of the nonmagnetic impurity scattering times $τ_N$ ranging from the clean $(p\ll 1)$ to the dirty $(p\gg 1)$ limits. Specific calculations were done for Nb and Nb$_3$Sn using their electron-phonon spectral functions extracted from tunneling measurements. We show that the ratio $H_s(T,p)/H_c(T)$ calculated from the Eliashberg theory exceeds that of the weak coupling BCS model, where $H_c$ is the thermodynamic magnetic field. We also show that, even though nonmagnetic impurities are pairbreakers in the current-carrying state, $H_s(0,p)$ for Nb$_3$Sn at $T=0$ has a maximum at $p\approx 0.2$ at which the ratio $H_s/H_c$ is about $6\%$ higher than that in the BCS clean limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Eliashberg理论”进行计算，属于强耦合超导理论框架下的数值计算研究。；研究对象：极端第二类超导体（大Ginzburg-Landau参数）的过热场 \(H_s\)，具体材料为Nb和Nb\(_3\)Sn，并考察非磁性杂质散射对 \(H_s\) 的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从Eliashberg理论计算的 \(H_s(T,p)/H_c(T)\) 比值高于弱耦合BCS模型的结果；对于Nb\(_3\)Sn，在 \(T=0\) 时 \(H_s(0,p)\) 在 \(p\approx 0.2\) 处出现极大值，该处 \(H_s/H_c\) 比BCS清洁极限高约6%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从Eliashberg理论计算的 \(H_s(T,p)/H_c(T)\) 比值高于弱耦合BCS模型的结果；对于Nb\(_3\)Sn，在 \(T=0\) 时 \(H_s(0,p)\) 在 \(p\approx 0.2\) 处出现极大值，该处 \(H_s/H_c\) 比BCS清洁极限高约6%。；创新点：首次在Eliashberg理论框架下系统计算了极端第二类超导体的过热场随温度和杂质散射的变化，并揭示了强耦合效应使 \(H_s/H_c\) 超过BCS预言，以及非磁性杂质在载流态下作为配对破坏者时 \(H_s(0,p)\) 存在非单调行为（在 \(p\approx 0.2\) 处有极大值）。
papers.method_zh: 基于各向同性Eliashberg理论，采用热力学方法计算不同非磁性杂质散射参数 \(p=\hbar/2\pi\tau_N k_B T_c\) 下的 \(H_s(T)\)，覆盖从清洁极限（\(p\ll 1\)）到脏极限（\(p\gg 1\)）的宽范围。具体计算使用了从隧穿测量提取的Nb和Nb\(_3\)Sn的电子-声子谱函数。

papers.title: Floquet Topological Spin-Valley-Layertronics on a Layered Dice Lattice
papers.abstract: The recent discovery of long-sought dice flat band in layered YCl electride has opened up rich possibilities of correlation and topological physics in dice lattice systems [Nature Communications 17, 2213 (2026), arXiv:2509.05958]. Here, we reveal a plethora of distinctive correlated topological phases in a generic layered dice lattice system at band filling of $ν=4$ under on-site Hubbard interactions: (i) the system is an intrinsic sublattice anti-ferromagnetic (AFM) quantum spin-valley Hall insulator; (ii) a circularly polarized light (CPL) drives the AFM spin-valley insulator into a Floquet odd-parity $f$-wave altermagnet(AM) insulator; (iii) a vertical displacement field turns the Floquet $f$-wave AM insulator into a spin-valley-layer-polarized Chern insulator, with the sign of spin, valley and Chern number all controlled by the direction of the displacement field. Our results not only establish the layered dice lattice as a versatile platform for electrically switchable magnetic and topological phases, but also provide an all-electrical scheme for integrated spin-valley-layertronics for non-volatile information storage and processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“on-site Hubbard interactions”“Floquet”“Chern insulator”等理论模型与拓扑相概念，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：层状骰子（dice）晶格体系，具体以层状YCl电子化合物中发现的dice平带为背景，研究其在带填充ν=4、在位Hubbard相互作用下的关联拓扑相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在ν=4填充的层状dice晶格中，体系可呈现三种可调控的关联拓扑相：本征亚晶格反铁磁量子自旋谷霍尔绝缘体；圆偏振光驱动的Floquet奇宇称f波交错磁（altermagnet）绝缘体；以及垂直位移场调控的自旋-谷-层极化Chern绝缘体，其自旋、谷和Chern数符号均可由位移场方向控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在ν=4填充的层状dice晶格中，体系可呈现三种可调控的关联拓扑相：本征亚晶格反铁磁量子自旋谷霍尔绝缘体；圆偏振光驱动的Floquet奇宇称f波交错磁（altermagnet）绝缘体；以及垂直位移场调控的自旋-谷-层极化Chern绝缘体，其自旋、谷和Chern数符号均可由位移场方向控制。；创新点：首次在层状dice晶格体系中提出电学可切换的磁性与拓扑相变方案，实现自旋-谷-层三重自由度耦合的集成调控，为“自旋-谷-层电子学”（spin-valley-layertronics）提供全电学非易失信息存储与处理方案。摘要未突出说明与已有dice晶格研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论模型分析：基于在位Hubbard相互作用的强关联模型，结合Floquet工程（圆偏振光驱动）和垂直位移场调控，分析不同参数下的磁序、拓扑不变量（Chern数）及自旋/谷/层极化性质。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如DFT+U、精确对角化或量子蒙特卡洛等）。

papers.title: Ballistic-to-Localized Dynamics as Signature of Quantum Phase Transition in Josephson Junction
papers.abstract: Using state-of-the-art numerical techniques, we investigate how quantum phase fluctuations and quasiparticle tunneling shape the behavior of a small-capacitance Josephson junction across Ohmic, sub-Ohmic, and super-Ohmic dissipation regimes. We show that increasing the Ohmic dissipation strength drives a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless quantum phase transition at thermodynamic equilibrium. Deviations from Ohmic behavior profoundly alter this scenario: the super-Ohmic regime exhibits no phase transition, whereas the sub-Ohmic regime displays a continuous second-order transition, consistent with the universality classes of the spin-boson model. Within the Ohmic regime, real-frequency linear-response calculations reveal that the phase particle does not undergo the commonly assumed diffusive-to-localized crossover. Instead, finite resistance progressively suppresses the singular zero-frequency response, producing a ballistic-to-localized change in the dynamics. At finite frequencies, coupling to the environment generates a long-lived excitation in the charge response, which evolves into a resonance as the subgap and shunt resistances are reduced.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Using state-of-the-art numerical techniques”（先进数值技术）以及“real-frequency linear-response calculations”（实频线性响应计算），属于数值模拟与理论分析结合的研究。；研究对象：小电容约瑟夫森结（small-capacitance Josephson junction），具体研究其在欧姆（Ohmic）、亚欧姆（sub-Ohmic）和超欧姆（super-Ohmic）三种耗散环境下的量子相变与动力学行为，涉及量子相位涨落和准粒子隧穿效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在欧姆耗散下，增大耗散强度驱动体系在热力学平衡下发生Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）量子相变；但相粒子动力学并非常见的“扩散-局域化”交叉，而是随有限电阻增大呈现“弹道-局域化”（ballistic-to-localized）转变。偏离欧姆行为时，超欧姆区无相变，亚欧姆区呈现连续二级相变，与自旋-玻色子模型的普适类一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在欧姆耗散下，增大耗散强度驱动体系在热力学平衡下发生Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）量子相变；但相粒子动力学并非常见的“扩散-局域化”交叉，而是随有限电阻增大呈现“弹道-局域化”（ballistic-to-localized）转变。偏离欧姆行为时，超欧姆区无相变，亚欧姆区呈现连续二级相变，与自旋-玻色子模型的普适类一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出两点新意：一是揭示欧姆区相粒子动力学并非传统假设的扩散-局域化交叉，而是弹道-局域化转变；二是在有限频率下发现环境耦合产生的长寿命电荷激发，并随电阻减小演化为共振峰。
papers.method_zh: 采用先进数值技术（摘要未具体说明算法名称，如DMRG或QMC等未提及）；使用实频线性响应计算分析动力学响应；通过改变耗散类型（欧姆、亚欧姆、超欧姆）和电阻参数系统研究相变与电荷响应。

papers.title: Interplay of Excitonic Charge Density Wave and Superconductivity in Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
papers.abstract: Motivated by the unique characteristics of the phase diagram of 1T-TiSe2, we investigated the complex interplay of excitonic charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity (SC) on a two-dimensional triangular lattice, each site accommodating two orbitals. In response to various tuning parameters, such as intercalation, pressure, substitution, and gating, these materials exhibit a generic and gradual waning of CDW, followed by the emergence of SC. Intriguingly, the nature of CDW changes from commensurate to incommensurate with the appearance of SC. Setting up a minimal model based on observed excitonic CDW and electron and hole pockets in the Fermi surface, and analyzing it within a simple mean-field framework, we can comprehend some salient experimental features. We also found that the qualitative phase diagram remains insensitive to details of the band structure. These results offer crucial insights into the nature of the interplay between CDW and SC in transition-metal dichalcogenides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Setting up a minimal model”“analyzing it within a simple mean-field framework”，属于模型构建与平均场理论分析。；研究对象：1T-TiSe₂ 为代表的过渡金属二硫属化物（TMDs）中激子型电荷密度波（CDW）与超导（SC）的相互作用。具体体系为二维三角晶格、每个格点含两个轨道的模型，对应具有电子和空穴费米口袋的激子CDW材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CDW逐渐减弱并伴随超导出现的调控过程中，CDW的序性质会从公度（commensurate）转变为非公度（incommensurate）；该定性相图对能带结构细节不敏感，表明CDW与SC的相互作用具有普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CDW逐渐减弱并伴随超导出现的调控过程中，CDW的序性质会从公度（commensurate）转变为非公度（incommensurate）；该定性相图对能带结构细节不敏感，表明CDW与SC的相互作用具有普适性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可指出其通过最小模型在平均场层面同时捕捉了CDW公度-非公度转变与超导出现的关联，并验证了相图对能带细节的鲁棒性，为理解TMDs中CDW与SC的相互作用提供了统一框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于观测到的激子CDW及费米面上电子/空穴口袋构建最小模型，采用平均场（mean-field）理论框架进行分析，并考察不同调控参数（插层、压力、替代掺杂、门电压）下的相图行为。

papers.title: Pseudo Entropy in Quantum Spin Chains: from Integrability to Chaos
papers.abstract: In this work, we study pseudo entropy and spectral dynamics in quantum spin chains (Heisenberg XXZ model and the mixed-field Ising model) to investigate whether they can serve as diagnostics of quantum chaos. First, we derive an exact relation between the real part of the thermal pseudo entropy and the spectral form factor. This provided evidence that pseudo entropy could exhibit the characteristic dip, logarithmic ramp, and plateau, implying the precise manner in which pseudo entropy probes chaos. We found that the imaginary part, while it does not diagnose chaos, can still provide crucial information about Fisher zeros that is not available in the real counterpart. For spatial pseudo entropy in the XXZ chain, we find that the logarithmic critical scaling persists in both integrable and chaotic regimes, and that the non-positivity conjecture holds. Finally, we derive an exact connection between pseudo entropy, relative pseudo entropy, and spectral complexity with a potential connection to holography.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“derive an exact relation”“derive an exact connection”等理论推导，以及“spectral form factor”“Fisher zeros”等理论概念，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：量子自旋链体系，具体包括可积的Heisenberg XXZ模型和混沌的混合场Ising模型；研究物理现象为赝熵（pseudo entropy）及其谱动力学，并考察其作为量子混沌诊断工具的可行性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热赝熵的实部与谱形因子存在精确关系，可呈现dip、对数斜坡和平台结构，从而以精确方式探测混沌；赝熵虚部虽不诊断混沌，但能提供Fisher零点的关键信息。空间赝熵的对数临界标度在可积与混沌区均成立，且非正性猜想成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热赝熵的实部与谱形因子存在精确关系，可呈现dip、对数斜坡和平台结构，从而以精确方式探测混沌；赝熵虚部虽不诊断混沌，但能提供Fisher零点的关键信息。空间赝熵的对数临界标度在可积与混沌区均成立，且非正性猜想成立。；创新点：首次建立了热赝熵实部与谱形因子之间的精确解析关系，将赝熵与量子混沌的谱诊断标准（dip-ramp-plateau）直接联系起来；同时揭示了赝熵虚部作为Fisher零点探测器的独特作用，并建立了赝熵与谱复杂度及全息理论的潜在联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析推导与数值计算相结合：推导热赝熵实部与谱形因子的精确关系；对XXZ链和混合场Ising模型进行谱动力学与空间赝熵分析；推导赝熵、相对赝熵与谱复杂度之间的精确联系。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如DMRG或精确对角化）。

papers.title: Branching stochastic mechanics. I. Clustering and connected correlations within a branching-process representation of the Schrödinger equation
papers.abstract: Can finite-range correlations hide in the statistics of an extended quantum state? The Schrödinger-Nagasawa transform represents the wave function by positive forward and backward diffusion fields whose product is the Born density. We promote them to branching superprocesses, \(Φ_F\) and \(Φ_B\): diffusion samples stochastic paths, whereas Bohm/Fisher-controlled branching generates genealogies of alternative continuations. With rates evaluated on the prescribed Born density, their means reproduce Schrödinger dynamics exactly. The connected sector exhibits supercritical, critical, and subcritical clustering in confinement and has critical dimension \(d_c=2\) in free space. Stationary eigenmodes remain extended; subcritical clusters acquire the reduced de~Broglie scale. We then let the branching rate respond to the fluctuating product \(Φ_FΦ_B\). In the reciprocal basis, the fields equal a smooth reference \(R\) plus centered fluctuations \(ψ_F,ψ_B\), defining the signed kernel \(C_{\rm FB}(x,y)=\mathbb E_ω[ψ_F(x)ψ_B(y)]\). On the anticorrelated branch, \(ρ_{\rm BSM}(x)=-C_{\rm FB}(x,x)\) is the positive paired density. Stationary recovery requires its diagonal to match the Born profile, while off-diagonal decay defines the correlation range. The pair equation splits into collective and relative sectors: spectral cancellation selects the Born collective mode, while suppression of the leading density fluctuation selects the anticorrelated source channel. With relative diffusivity \(D_{\rm eff}\) and positive relaxation rate \(μ_{\rm FB}\), correlations have screening length \(ξ_{\rm FB}=\sqrt{D_{\rm eff}/μ_{\rm FB}}\). Thus an extended Born density and a finite correlation range can coexist in one stochastic kernel, suggesting particle-like organization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：branching superprocesses、stochastic mechanics、Schrödinger-Nagasawa transform、theoretical framework。；研究对象：量子力学中薛定谔方程的随机表示，具体研究扩展量子态的统计性质中是否可隐藏有限程关联，以及由此产生的粒子状组织（clustering）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将薛定谔波函数表示为正向和反向分支超过程，证明扩展的Born密度与有限关联长度可以在同一个随机核中共存，关联具有屏蔽长度ξ_FB = √(D_eff/μ_FB)，从而暗示粒子状组织可以从量子态的随机统计中涌现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将薛定谔波函数表示为正向和反向分支超过程，证明扩展的Born密度与有限关联长度可以在同一个随机核中共存，关联具有屏蔽长度ξ_FB = √(D_eff/μ_FB)，从而暗示粒子状组织可以从量子态的随机统计中涌现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于将分支过程（branching processes）引入薛定谔方程的随机表示，并证明在自由空间中存在临界维度d_c=2，且关联的屏蔽长度与de Broglie尺度相关联，从而在扩展量子态中自然产生有限程关联和粒子状结构。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为薛定谔-长泽变换（Schrödinger-Nagasawa transform），将波函数分解为正反向扩散场，并推广为分支超过程（branching superprocesses）。分析中引入了Bohm/Fisher控制的branching机制，并研究了关联核C_FB(x,y)的配对方程，将其分解为集体模和相对模进行谱分析。

papers.title: Thermal Hall Signatures of Distinct Schwinger-Boson Flux Sectors on the Honeycomb Lattice
papers.abstract: Thermal transport offers a bulk probe of charge-neutral excitations in frustrated magnets. It remains challenging, however, to determine whether such transport can distinguish different parton mean-field structures of the same spin system. This question is particularly relevant on the honeycomb lattice, where distinct $0$-flux, $π$-flux, and chiral $π/2$-flux sectors have been proposed.
