In this paper, we compare self-consistent saddle-point solutions in these three sectors for a frustrated $J_1-J_2$ Heisenberg model with a next-nearest-neighbor Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and a perpendicular magnetic field. Using finite-temperature Schwinger-boson mean-field theory and the Kubo formula for bosonic Bogoliubov-de Gennes systems, we evaluate the intrinsic spinon thermal Hall conductivity. At a common parameter point where all three branches remain gapped, the $0$-flux response is positive and the $π$-flux response is negative for $D>0$ and $h>0$ under the sign conventions used in this paper, whereas the $π/2$-flux response changes sign with increasing temperature. We further show that a projective symmetry combining a sixfold rotation with time reversal forces the zero-field response of a fixed chiral $π/2$-flux domain to vanish. Within the mean-field regime examined in this paper, the sign and temperature dependence of $κ_{xy}/T$ therefore provide a flux-sensitive transport signature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“self-consistent saddle-point solutions”“finite-temperature Schwinger-boson mean-field theory”“Kubo formula”等理论计算方法，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：蜂窝晶格上受挫的J₁-J₂海森堡模型，含次近邻Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用及垂直磁场，具体研究该自旋系统中三种不同的Schwinger玻色子通量扇区（0-通量、π-通量、手性π/2-通量）的热霍尔输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三个分支均保持有能隙的共同参数点，0-通量扇区的热霍尔响应为正，π-通量扇区为负（在本文符号约定下，D>0, h>0），而π/2-通量扇区的响应随温度升高改变符号。因此κ_xy/T的符号和温度依赖可作为区分不同通量扇区的输运特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三个分支均保持有能隙的共同参数点，0-通量扇区的热霍尔响应为正，π-通量扇区为负（在本文符号约定下，D>0, h>0），而π/2-通量扇区的响应随温度升高改变符号。因此κ_xy/T的符号和温度依赖可作为区分不同通量扇区的输运特征。；创新点：首次系统比较同一自旋模型（蜂窝晶格J₁-J₂-DM-磁场）中三个不同通量扇区的热霍尔响应，证明热输运可以区分同一自旋系统的不同部分子平均场结构；并揭示了六重旋转与时间反演组合的投影对称性对手性π/2-通量扇区零场响应的强制消失。
papers.method_zh: 有限温度Schwinger-玻色子平均场理论（SBMFT），结合玻色子Bogoliubov-de Gennes系统的Kubo公式，计算内禀自旋子热霍尔电导率κ_xy；通过自洽鞍点求解比较三个通量扇区。

papers.title: Josephson-Phase Reversal of Non-Bloch Andreev Propagation
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian control is difficult in solid-state systems due to fixed dissipation. Here, we show that in a spin-orbit-coupled planar Josephson junction, changing only the Josephson phase reverses the non-Bloch propagation of a low-energy Andreev band and switches its boundary accumulation between junction edges. The phase reshapes the band's spin and electron-hole composition, causing a fixed reservoir to unequally attenuate counterpropagating modes. Weak-loss theory links this phase-controlled loss imbalance to boundary-selected complex momenta, offering an in situ route to reconfigurable non-Hermitian transport in superconducting platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We show that”“Weak-loss theory links”等理论推导性表述，未提及实验手段或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：自旋-轨道耦合的平面约瑟夫森结中的非厄米安德烈夫传播现象，具体关注低能安德烈夫能带在约瑟夫森相位调控下的非布洛赫传播行为及其边界累积效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅通过改变约瑟夫森相位即可反转低能安德烈夫带的非布洛赫传播方向，并使其边界累积在结的两个边缘之间切换；该相位调控通过重塑能带的自旋与电子-空穴组成，使固定耗散源对反向传播模式产生不等衰减，从而实现相位控制的损耗失衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅通过改变约瑟夫森相位即可反转低能安德烈夫带的非布洛赫传播方向，并使其边界累积在结的两个边缘之间切换；该相位调控通过重塑能带的自旋与电子-空穴组成，使固定耗散源对反向传播模式产生不等衰减，从而实现相位控制的损耗失衡。；创新点：首次提出在固态超导平台中仅通过约瑟夫森相位（而非改变耗散结构）实现非厄米输运的原位可重构调控，为固态体系中难以实现的非厄米控制提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 弱损耗理论（weak-loss theory）分析，结合非布洛赫能带理论（complex momenta / boundary-selected complex momenta）框架，用于建立相位控制的损耗失衡与边界选择复动量之间的关联。

papers.title: Valley-Enabled Intrinsic Dresselhaus Spin-Orbit Coupling in Silicon
papers.abstract: We develop a symmetry-based theory of spin-orbit-valley coupling in silicon that reveals an intrinsic source of Dresselhaus spin-orbit coupling independent of interfaces or external electric fields. Treating the valley degree of freedom as a symmetry-carrying quantum degree of freedom, we show that the Dresselhaus interaction is necessarily valley off-diagonal and that a bulk contribution proportional to the valley Pauli matrix $τ_1$ is symmetry allowed. Tight-binding calculations yield a bulk coupling more than an order of magnitude larger than typical interface-induced spin-orbit coupling; achieving the same energy scale through the interface-induced mechanism would require electric fields roughly 50 times larger than typical fields. We further derive the symmetry-allowed spin-valley couplings generated by magnetic-field gradients and show how they account for the valley-dependent Zeeman splitting observed in micromagnet experiments. A slight tilt of the background magnetic field out of the plane produces an additional isotropic contribution linear in $B_z$, providing an experimentally accessible signature of the corresponding coupling constant. Finally, we predict a spin-independent micromagnet-induced valley splitting in the $τ_3$ channel, which is distinct from the $τ_{1,2}$ channels generated by alloy disorder and therefore remains robust against disorder-induced cancellation. These results establish valley symmetry as a fundamental ingredient in the spin-orbit physics of silicon and provide new mechanisms for controlling and probing spin and valley degrees of freedom in silicon quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“symmetry-based theory”“symmetry allowed”“Tight-binding calculations”，属于对称性分析与紧束缚计算相结合的理论研究。；研究对象：硅（silicon）中的自旋-轨道-谷耦合物理，具体涉及Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合、谷自由度、磁场梯度诱导的自旋-谷耦合，以及微磁体（micromagnet）实验中的谷依赖塞曼劈裂和谷劈裂现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硅中天然存在一种与界面或外电场无关的体Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合，其强度比典型界面诱导的自旋轨道耦合大一个数量级以上；该耦合必然为谷间（valley off-diagonal）形式，正比于谷Pauli矩阵τ₁。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硅中天然存在一种与界面或外电场无关的体Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合，其强度比典型界面诱导的自旋轨道耦合大一个数量级以上；该耦合必然为谷间（valley off-diagonal）形式，正比于谷Pauli矩阵τ₁。；创新点：首次揭示硅中Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合可以具有纯体来源（不依赖界面或电场），并将谷对称性确立为硅自旋轨道物理的基本要素；此外预测了微磁体诱导的τ₃通道谷劈裂，该通道与合金无序产生的τ₁,₂通道不同，因此不受无序抵消影响。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性的理论分析（将谷自由度视为携带对称性的量子自由度），结合紧束缚（tight-binding）计算来定量评估耦合强度；并推导了磁场梯度下对称性允许的自旋-谷耦合形式及其对实验可观测量的影响。

papers.title: Phonon-Localization-Driven Decoupling of Dual-Channel Transport for Record-Low Intrinsic Lattice Thermal Conductivity
papers.abstract: A fundamental bottleneck in pushing the intrinsic lattice thermal conductivity of inorganic crystalline solids to its lowest limit arises from the inherent competition between the particle-like propagation (\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{P}}\)) and wave-like tunneling (\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{C}}\)) channels. Herein, we demonstrate that phonon localization provides a robust pathway to decouple the dual-channel transport, achieving record-low \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}\) in quasi-1D ternary helical crystals. Despite the structural complexity leading to densely populated phonon branches and thus inducing abundant coherent phonons, the weak interchain interactions and heavy elements compress numerous branches into highly localized, nearly dispersionless flat bands. Such strong localization simultaneously suppresses both the diagonal and off-diagonal components of the group velocity, thereby synergistically suppressing \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{P}}\) and \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{C}}\). Taking InSeI as an example, the interchain room-temperature \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{P}}\) and \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{C}}\) are 0.145 and 0.053 W/mK, respectively, yielding an ultralow total \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}\) of 0.198 W/mK. Weaker interchain interactions further drive the room-temperature \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}\) of GaSeI and AlSeI to record lows of 0.086 and 0.089 W/mK, respectively; these values even drop to 0.058 and 0.059 W/mK at 900 K. These findings provide useful insights into exploring the thermal conductivity limit in crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“demonstrate”（理论演示）、“taking InSeI as an example”给出具体数值预测，未提及任何实验测量手段，属于第一性原理计算或理论模拟类工作。；研究对象：准一维三元螺旋晶体（具体包括InSeI、GaSeI、AlSeI），以及其中的声子局域化现象与晶格热导率（κ_L）的双通道输运（粒子型传播κ_L^P与波型隧穿κ_L^C）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 声子局域化能够有效解耦晶格热导率的双通道输运，同时抑制粒子型与波型通道，从而在准一维三元螺旋晶体中实现创纪录的低本征晶格热导率（如GaSeI室温κ_L低至0.086 W/mK）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：声子局域化能够有效解耦晶格热导率的双通道输运，同时抑制粒子型与波型通道，从而在准一维三元螺旋晶体中实现创纪录的低本征晶格热导率（如GaSeI室温κ_L低至0.086 W/mK）。；创新点：提出“声子局域化”作为解耦粒子型与波型热输运通道的新机制，利用弱链间相互作用和重元素将密集声子支压缩为近无色散的平带，从而协同抑制双通道热导率，突破了以往仅单独优化某一通道的限制。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法，但根据内容推断为基于第一性原理的声子计算（如DFT结合玻尔兹曼输运方程及相干势近似等），用于分解κ_L^P和κ_L^C通道，并分析声子色散关系（平带特征）与群速度的局域化效应。摘要未给出具体软件或泛函细节。

papers.title: Representation Transitions Reveal Predictive Structure in Complex Systems: A Trajectory-Level Reconstruction in a Critical System
papers.abstract: Trajectories in complex systems often contain structure that is not captured by the population-averaged, scalar statistics traditionally used to describe them. Here we reconstruct, through independent numerical re-simulation rather than literature review, a systematic search across representational forms - from single scalar statistics, through two independent discrete multi-feature classification attempts, to a trajectory-level structural representation and a diagnostic surrogate test, to a continuous low-dimensional compression - applied to the same underlying trajectory ensemble in a critical complex system. Predictive failure is not explained by insufficient correlation: one discrete representation's own strongest individual feature correlates with the target more strongly ($r=0.588$) than the eventual successful representation's own headline statistic ($r=0.540$), yet fails to separate the ensemble's two most consequential cases - while the continuous representation succeeds, robustly, across eight independent scale-removal folds ($r=0.677$-$0.717$, all $p<0.001$). The determining factor was not correlation strength but whether the representation preserved the structure relevant to prediction. These results indicate that the choice of representation determines whether predictive structure in complex systems becomes accessible - a scientific variable in its own right, not a downstream analysis choice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数值模拟文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“independent numerical re-simulation”（独立数值重模拟），以及“eight independent scale-removal folds”（八次独立去尺度折交叉验证）等数值实验流程。；研究对象：一个临界复杂系统（critical complex system）中的轨迹系综（trajectory ensemble）。摘要未明确说明具体是何种物理体系（如自旋系统、流体、生态网络等），仅强调其“临界”属性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在复杂系统中，预测成功与否的决定性因素不是表征与目标之间的相关性强度，而是表征是否保留了与预测相关的结构信息。一个相关性更强（r=0.588）的离散表征因无法区分系综中两个最关键的案例而失败，而一个相关性稍弱（r=0.540）但结构保留正确的连续表征则在所有八次独立测试中稳健成功（r=0.677–0.717，p<0.001）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在复杂系统中，预测成功与否的决定性因素不是表征与目标之间的相关性强度，而是表征是否保留了与预测相关的结构信息。一个相关性更强（r=0.588）的离散表征因无法区分系综中两个最关键的案例而失败，而一个相关性稍弱（r=0.540）但结构保留正确的连续表征则在所有八次独立测试中稳健成功（r=0.677–0.717，p<0.001）。；创新点：将“表征选择”本身提升为影响复杂系统预测可及性的科学变量，而非下游分析选择。通过在同一轨迹系综上的系统对比，直接证明相关性强度不足以决定预测成败，结构保留才是关键——这一结论对表征学习的普适设计原则具有启示意义。
papers.method_zh: 系统性地对同一轨迹系综进行多种表征形式的对比搜索，包括：单一标量统计、两种独立的离散多特征分类、轨迹级结构表征及诊断性替代测试（surrogate test）、连续低维压缩。通过独立数值重模拟（而非文献综述）获得结果，并使用八次独立去尺度折交叉验证评估预测稳健性。

papers.title: Magnetic contacts on freestanding superconducting LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ micromembranes
papers.abstract: The superconducting two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) at the LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ (LAO-STO) interface is a promising platform for superconducting spintronics, however, integrating ferromagnetic contacts with the superconducting 2DEG remains challenging. Here, we realize superconducting LAO-STO micromembrane devices contacted by ferromagnetic nickel contacts through a side-contact geometry. Low-temperature transport measurements demonstrate that superconductivity is preserved in the presence of the ferromagnetic contacts. We show that the superconducting state is strongly influenced by the magnetic history of the nickel contacts, which generates a tunable effective magnetic field in the 2DEG. Through an effective field model, the magnetization of the contacts can be inferred from the maximum superconducting response. Our results establish ferromagnetically contacted LAO-STO as a platform for future investigations of spin injection into oxide superconductors and provide a route towards superconducting spintronic devices based on complex oxide interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Low-temperature transport measurements”（低温输运测量），属于实验手段。；研究对象：LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃（LAO-STO）界面处的超导二维电子气（2DEG），以及通过侧接触方式集成的铁磁镍（Ni）电极。研究聚焦于超导与铁磁接触共存时的物理行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁磁镍接触下，LAO-STO微米薄膜的超导性得以保持，且超导态强烈依赖于镍接触的磁历史，可通过接触磁化产生的可调有效磁场来调控超导响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁磁镍接触下，LAO-STO微米薄膜的超导性得以保持，且超导态强烈依赖于镍接触的磁历史，可通过接触磁化产生的可调有效磁场来调控超导响应。；创新点：首次在LAO-STO超导微米薄膜上实现铁磁镍侧接触，并证明超导性在铁磁接触存在下仍可保持，为氧化物超导体中的自旋注入研究提供了可行平台。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用侧接触几何结构制备铁磁镍电极与超导LAO-STO微米薄膜的器件；通过低温输运测量表征超导性质；利用有效磁场模型从最大超导响应反推接触的磁化强度。

papers.title: Localized orbitals and tunnel couplings from general confinement potentials in gate-defined quantum-dot arrays
papers.abstract: Efficient simulation of dense gate-defined multi-quantum-dot arrays requires accurate and scalable modeling methods, compatible with asymmetries and imperfections of realistic voltage-controlled confinement potentials. We present a numerical localization procedure that rotates the eigenbasis of a general one-particle effective orbital Hamiltonian into $s$-, $p$-, $d$-, $\ldots$-shells of localized orbital wavefunctions associated with individual quantum dots. The pairwise tunnel couplings between such states are computed directly as matrix elements of the Hamiltonian. We demonstrate this procedure on a 2D triangular Si-MOS triple-quantum-dot array by obtaining the voltage dependencies of the tunnel couplings and their distributions in the presence of disorder. We discuss the implications of this evaluation method on the many-body calculations, and relate it to the experimental tunnel coupling measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerical localization procedure、matrix elements、simulation。；研究对象：栅极定义的多量子点阵列，具体为二维三角形 Si-MOS 三量子点体系，关注其有效单粒子势阱中的局域轨道与隧穿耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种数值局域化方法，可将一般约束势下的单粒子本征态旋转为与各量子点关联的 s、p、d…壳层局域轨道，并直接计算这些态之间的隧穿耦合矩阵元；在无序存在下，该方法能给出隧穿耦合的电压依赖及其分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种数值局域化方法，可将一般约束势下的单粒子本征态旋转为与各量子点关联的 s、p、d…壳层局域轨道，并直接计算这些态之间的隧穿耦合矩阵元；在无序存在下，该方法能给出隧穿耦合的电压依赖及其分布。；创新点：该方法兼容真实电压控制约束势中的不对称性与缺陷，可扩展至密集多量子点阵列，并直接与实验隧穿耦合测量建立联系；摘要未突出说明与传统方法（如 Wannier 函数或 Hubbard 参数提取）的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 数值局域化方法：对一般单粒子有效轨道哈密顿量的本征基进行旋转（酉变换），得到各量子点的壳层局域轨道；隧穿耦合直接取哈密顿量在局域态间的矩阵元。演示体系为二维三角形 Si-MOS 三量子点阵列，并引入无序统计。

papers.title: Emergent Pair Density Wave and Incoherent Metallic State in a Strongly Correlated Doped System
papers.abstract: We investigate the dynamical emergence of a state driven by the interplay between antiferromagnetism (AFM) and singlet $d$-wave superconductivity (SC) within a slave-rotor mean-field framework. By decomposing the electron into charge and spin degrees of freedom, the formalism captures strong-correlation effects beyond conventional mean-field approaches. A PDW order is found to emerge dynamically in the coexistence region of AFM and SC. The AFM-SC coexistence region is significantly modified with correlation, leading to a systematic shift of the tetra-critical point. The doping and temperature evolution of the AFM, SC, and PDW order parameters, together with the rotor condensate amplitude $φ$, which characterizes charge coherence, shows a crossover from a coherent to an incoherent metal with the suppression of coherent quasi-particle spectral weight. Moreover, in the AFM + $(φ\neq 0)$ region, coherent quasi-particle bands coexist with incoherent Hubbard-like excitations, whereas only incoherent spectral features survive in the AFM + $(φ= 0)$ regime. The SC phase exhibits nodal quasi-particles consistent with $d$-wave pairing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：slave-rotor mean-field framework、decomposing the electron、theoretical framework。；研究对象：强关联掺杂体系中反铁磁（AFM）与d波超导（SC）共存及其动力学涌现的物理现象，具体关注由两者相互作用驱动的量子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在AFM与SC共存区域内，动力学涌现出配对密度波（PDW）序；随着关联效应增强，体系从相干金属演化为非相干金属，伴随准粒子谱权重被抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在AFM与SC共存区域内，动力学涌现出配对密度波（PDW）序；随着关联效应增强，体系从相干金属演化为非相干金属，伴随准粒子谱权重被抑制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于：在slave-rotor框架下自洽地揭示了AFM与SC共存区中PDW序的动力学涌现，并系统展示了关联效应对四临界点位置及金属相干-非相干演化的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用slave-rotor平均场理论框架，将电子分解为电荷和自旋自由度，从而在平均场水平上纳入超出常规方法的强关联效应。

papers.title: Active embracement enables autonomous tweezing in active star polymers
papers.abstract: The capacity for autonomous structural reconfiguration is a defining trait of living systems, yet it remains elusive in artificial active matter. Here, we report the discovery of active embracement, a non-equilibrium phenomenon where active star polymers, comprising a central core and self-propelled monomeric arms, transition from open configurations to tightly collapsed, ``hugging'' states. By combining polymer experiments using connected vibrobots with simulations, we demonstrate that internal self-propulsion fundamentally overrides the steric repulsion that keeps passive polymers dispersed. This active drive enables a suite of behaviors unattainable in equilibrium systems: individual star polymers undergo a globular-like self-collapse, multiple star polymers mutually intertwine and mutually embrace, and can spontaneously embrace and capture surrounding passive particles. Our findings reveal that active embracement is a distinct kinetic phase that allows star polymers to function as autonomous tweezers. By bridging the gap between macroscopic robotic collectives and microscopic polymer physics, this work provides a versatile blueprint for the design of smart materials capable of targeted cargo capture and self-directed assembly in complex environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combining polymer experiments using connected vibrobots with simulations”。；研究对象：活性星形聚合物（active star polymers），即由中心核和自驱动单体臂组成的聚合物体系，以及其非平衡“活性拥抱”（active embracement）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性星形聚合物在内部自驱动作用下，可自发从开放构型转变为紧密塌缩的“拥抱”态，并实现自身塌缩、相互缠绕以及捕获周围被动颗粒，从而作为自主镊子（autonomous tweezers）工作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性星形聚合物在内部自驱动作用下，可自发从开放构型转变为紧密塌缩的“拥抱”态，并实现自身塌缩、相互缠绕以及捕获周围被动颗粒，从而作为自主镊子（autonomous tweezers）工作。；创新点：首次发现并命名“活性拥抱”这一非平衡动力学相，证明内部自推进可克服被动聚合物中维持分散的位阻排斥，实现平衡体系无法达到的自发结构重构与靶向捕获功能，为智能材料设计提供新蓝图。
papers.method_zh: 宏观机器人实验（使用连接的振动机器人 vibrobots 模拟聚合物）结合数值模拟。摘要未明确说明具体模拟方法（如分子动力学或蒙特卡洛），也未给出模拟力场细节。

papers.title: Harnessing the skyrmion Hall effect for low-power skyrmion transport in a tubular synthetic antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: We show that optimal control can turn the skyrmion Hall effect from a source of typically unwanted transverse motion into a mechanism for reducing Ohmic losses in skyrmion transport. We consider a pair of antiferromagnetically coupled skyrmions confined to a tubular geometry, where their relative transverse displacement becomes a periodic internal coordinate. The skyrmion Hall effect drives this coordinate, while finite interlayer coupling makes the resulting relation between applied current and longitudinal velocity nonlinear, allowing different current protocols to produce the same prescribed average velocity. We determine which of these protocols minimizes Joule heating. Depending on the interlayer coupling and spin-transfer-torque parameters, the optimal current is either constant, with the skyrmion pair maintaining a fixed relative position, or time dependent, with the pair undergoing periodic relative motion around the tube. In either case, the additional internal degree of freedom created by the skyrmion Hall effect and interlayer coupling enables skyrmion transport at a lower power than in the uncoupled limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要使用“We show that optimal control can turn...”“We consider...”“We determine...”等理论推导与优化控制分析表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：管状几何中反铁磁耦合的斯格明子对（synthetic antiferromagnet），具体研究其输运过程中的斯格明子霍尔效应（skyrmion Hall effect）与焦耳热损耗。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过最优控制，可将斯格明子霍尔效应从通常导致横向运动的负面因素转变为降低输运欧姆损耗的机制；在层间耦合与自旋转移力矩参数的不同条件下，最优电流可为恒定或时变，但均能实现比无耦合极限更低的功耗输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过最优控制，可将斯格明子霍尔效应从通常导致横向运动的负面因素转变为降低输运欧姆损耗的机制；在层间耦合与自旋转移力矩参数的不同条件下，最优电流可为恒定或时变，但均能实现比无耦合极限更低的功耗输运。；创新点：首次提出利用斯格明子霍尔效应本身（而非抑制它）作为降低输运功耗的手段，并借助管状几何与层间耦合引入的内禀自由度实现低功率输运。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与最优控制分析。具体包括：构建管状合成反铁磁中反铁磁耦合斯格明子对的动力学模型，将相对横向位移视为周期性内坐标，分析层间耦合导致的电流-纵向速度非线性关系，并求解最小化焦耳热的最优电流协议。

papers.title: High-Field Terahertz Spin Resonance in Cr$_2$O$_3$ above the Spin-Flop Transition
papers.abstract: We report single-shot terahertz time-domain spectroscopy of Cr$_2$O$_3$ in pulsed magnetic fields up to 30 T. Well above the spin-flop field, in the 20-30 T range, the resonance frequency exhibits a nearly linear field dependence with a slope of ~22 GHz/T, smaller than the 28 GHz/T reported from low-field measurements. This reduction is insensitive to temperature and to a 15° field tilt, suggesting an intrinsic high-field property.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“单发太赫兹时域光谱”“脉冲磁场”等实验手段。；研究对象：Cr₂O₃（氧化铬）单晶材料，具体研究其在自旋翻转转变（spin-flop transition）以上的高场太赫兹自旋共振行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在20–30 T的高磁场区间（远高于自旋翻转场），Cr₂O₃的自旋共振频率随磁场近似线性增加，斜率为约22 GHz/T，明显低于低场测量报道的28 GHz/T。该斜率减小对温度和15°的磁场倾斜不敏感，表明这是材料的内在高场特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在20–30 T的高磁场区间（远高于自旋翻转场），Cr₂O₃的自旋共振频率随磁场近似线性增加，斜率为约22 GHz/T，明显低于低场测量报道的28 GHz/T。该斜率减小对温度和15°的磁场倾斜不敏感，表明这是材料的内在高场特性。；创新点：首次在远高于自旋翻转场的脉冲高磁场区间（20–30 T）直接测量Cr₂O₃的自旋共振，发现其高场斜率（~22 GHz/T）显著低于低场值（28 GHz/T），且该变化具有温度与角度不敏感性，揭示了一种内在的高场物理特性。
papers.method_zh: 单发太赫兹时域光谱（single-shot terahertz time-domain spectroscopy），配合脉冲磁场（最高30 T）进行测量。

papers.title: Phase Diagram and Critical Behaviour of the Two-Dimensional Potts Model with Long-Range Quenched Disorder
papers.abstract: We study the phase diagram and critical properties of the $q = 3$ and $q = 8$ Potts models with spatially correlated disorder governed by a power-law decay with exponent $a$. Building on the phase diagram proposed by Chippari et al. [3], where a transition from finite-disorder to infinite-disorder fixed points was identified as a function of a, we refine this picture by using wrapping probabilities of Fortuin-Kasteleyn clusters. Furthermore, using magnetic observables, we clarify the physical origin of the double-peak structure in the magnetic susceptibility and establish the validity of the hyper-scaling relation across all investigated regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we study”“phase diagram”“wrapping probabilities”“hyper-scaling relation”等，属于数值模拟与标度分析结合的理论计算研究。；研究对象：二维 $q=3$ 和 $q=8$ Potts 模型，带有以幂律指数 $a$ 描述的空间关联淬火无序。物理现象为无序诱导的相图重构与临界行为变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过 Fortuin-Kasteleyn 簇的缠绕概率，细化了 Chippari 等人提出的随 $a$ 变化的有限无序到无限无序不动点转变的相图；利用磁学观测量澄清了磁化率双峰结构的物理起源，并在所有研究参数区间内验证了超标度关系的有效性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过 Fortuin-Kasteleyn 簇的缠绕概率，细化了 Chippari 等人提出的随 $a$ 变化的有限无序到无限无序不动点转变的相图；利用磁学观测量澄清了磁化率双峰结构的物理起源，并在所有研究参数区间内验证了超标度关系的有效性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于：首次用缠绕概率这一几何判据系统刻画无序 Potts 模型的相图边界，并首次明确解释了磁化率双峰结构的物理机制（摘要未明确说明具体机制内容）。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（蒙特卡洛方法），具体采用 Fortuin-Kasteleyn 簇的缠绕概率作为序参量判据，并结合磁化率等磁学观测量进行有限尺寸标度分析，检验超标度关系。

papers.title: Magnetic Field-Tunable Repulsive Exciton-Exciton Interaction in the van der Waals Antiferromagnet NiPS$_3$
papers.abstract: Two ultra-narrow absorption peaks around 1.5 eV, which are widely believed to originate from a transition from a spin-orbital entangled triplet to a singlet state, in the two-dimensional van der Waals crystal NiPS$_3$, have attracted considerable attention because of their pronounced spin-dependent character. An interesting question is whether ultrahigh magnetic fields modify an interaction-driven hybridization between those two peaks. In this work we perform systematic magneto-optical measurements of NiPS$_3$ in pulsed magnetic fields of up to 178 T and observe a pronounced mutual repulsion between the two sharp exciton peaks accompanied by a redistribution of oscillator strength, while the band edge shows no detectable field-induced shift within our experimental resolution. We construct a minimal two-level interaction model and compare it semi-quantitatively with the experimental data. Our results reveal a magnetic-field-tunable exciton-exciton coupling as the dominant high-field response of NiPS$_3$, and clarify this material as a new experimental platform for exploring strongly correlated exciton physics in magnetic van der Waals insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“magneto-optical measurements”“pulsed magnetic fields”“experimental data”等实验关键词，并辅以理论建模对比。；研究对象：二维范德华反铁磁材料 NiPS₃，具体关注其约 1.5 eV 处两个超窄吸收峰（自旋-轨道纠缠三重态到单重态的跃迁）在超高磁场下的激子-激子相互作用行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高达 178 T 的脉冲磁场下，NiPS₃ 中两个尖锐激子峰之间出现显著的相互排斥（mutual repulsion），并伴随振子强度的重新分布，而带边在实验分辨率内无场致移动。这表明磁场可调谐的激子-激子耦合是该材料在高场下的主导响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高达 178 T 的脉冲磁场下，NiPS₃ 中两个尖锐激子峰之间出现显著的相互排斥（mutual repulsion），并伴随振子强度的重新分布，而带边在实验分辨率内无场致移动。这表明磁场可调谐的激子-激子耦合是该材料在高场下的主导响应。；创新点：首次在超高磁场（178 T）下揭示 NiPS₃ 中激子峰之间的磁场可调谐排斥性相互作用，将其确立为研究磁性范德华绝缘体中强关联激子物理的新型实验平台。摘要未突出说明与以往更低场实验的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 系统性的磁光光谱测量（magneto-optical measurements），使用脉冲磁场最高达 178 T；并构建了一个最小二能级相互作用模型（minimal two-level interaction model），与实验数据进行半定量比较。

papers.title: Competition between on-site and off-site pairing phases and surface spectra in superconducting wallpaper fermion systems
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the competition between on-site and off-site pairings in superconducting topological crystalline insulators hosting wallpaper fermions, a class of surface states protected by nonsymmorphic symmetries. In-plane nearest-neighbor pair hopping stabilizes the $\mathrm{A_{1u}}$ phase, while off-site pairing channels yield additional dominant phases with $\mathrm{B_{2u}}$ and $\mathrm{E_u}$ representations. We further show that the $\mathrm{B_{2u}}$ pairing state supports the hybridization between wallpaper-fermion spectra themselves, whereas a representative time-reversal-invariant nematic $\mathrm{E_u}$ state exhibits spectral hybridization between wallpaper fermion and double Majorana Kramers pairs, yielding twisted surface energy spectra. These results demonstrate that the twisted dispersions arising from hybridization phenomena persist in the presence of off-site pairing interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“theoretically investigate”（理论研究）、“We further show”（理论推导）等关键词，且讨论的是对称性分类与相竞争，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：超导拓扑晶体绝缘体中的壁纸费米子（wallpaper fermions）表面态，具体研究其超导配对通道（on-site 与 off-site pairing）之间的竞争，以及由此产生的表面能谱杂化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 面内最近邻配对跳跃稳定 A₁ᵤ 相，而 off-site 配对通道可产生 B₂ᵤ 和 Eᵤ 表示的优势相；其中 B₂ᵤ 相导致壁纸费米子谱之间的杂化，而时间反演不变的向列 Eᵤ 相则导致壁纸费米子与双 Majorana Kramers 对之间的谱杂化，形成扭曲的表面能谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：面内最近邻配对跳跃稳定 A₁ᵤ 相，而 off-site 配对通道可产生 B₂ᵤ 和 Eᵤ 表示的优势相；其中 B₂ᵤ 相导致壁纸费米子谱之间的杂化，而时间反演不变的向列 Eᵤ 相则导致壁纸费米子与双 Majorana Kramers 对之间的谱杂化，形成扭曲的表面能谱。；创新点：首次揭示 off-site 配对相互作用下，壁纸费米子系统中的杂化扭曲色散仍然存在，并具体区分了不同配对表示（B₂ᵤ 与 Eᵤ）导致的两种不同杂化类型（壁纸费米子-壁纸费米子 vs 壁纸费米子-双 Majorana Kramers 对）。
papers.method_zh: 理论对称性分析与配对通道分类。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如是否使用 BdG 方法、有效模型或数值对角化），仅提及基于非点式对称性保护的表面态理论框架。

papers.title: From Freezing to Terminal Packing: A Puzzle and a Paradox
papers.abstract: A density-functional theory developed for equilibrium freezing also produces a high-density endpoint close to terminal packing. We revisit the nonlinear Ramakrishnan--Yussouff bifurcation framework and distinguish the first crystalline fold, thermodynamic coexistence, and terminal marginality. At the terminal point, the grand-potential curvature vanishes along the principal finite-wavevector density mode, exactly when the nonlinear self-consistency equation loses stiffness. The construction gives exact close packing for one-dimensional hard rods, a terminal hard-disk packing fraction near 0.8407, and a hard-sphere value near 0.629, close to random close packing. These results identify a finite-wavevector thermodynamic marginality of a metastable liquid continuation, rather than equilibrium freezing or mechanical jamming, and expose a persistent puzzle: why should liquid-state correlations encode the approach to terminal disordered packing across different physical dimensions and systems?
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“density-functional theory”（密度泛函理论）、“bifurcation framework”（分岔框架）以及“self-consistency equation”（自洽方程），属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：经典液体的结晶与终端堆积（terminal packing）问题，具体体系包括一维硬杆、二维硬圆盘和三维硬球，关注从平衡冻结到无序密堆积的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该密度泛函理论在终端堆积点处，大势曲率沿有限波矢密度模式消失，同时非线性自洽方程失去刚度，表明终端堆积对应亚稳液体延续的有限波矢热力学边缘性（marginality），而非平衡结晶或力学堵塞。硬圆盘终端堆积分数约为0.8407，硬球约为0.629（接近随机密堆积）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该密度泛函理论在终端堆积点处，大势曲率沿有限波矢密度模式消失，同时非线性自洽方程失去刚度，表明终端堆积对应亚稳液体延续的有限波矢热力学边缘性（marginality），而非平衡结晶或力学堵塞。硬圆盘终端堆积分数约为0.8407，硬球约为0.629（接近随机密堆积）。；创新点：首次将终端无序堆积识别为亚稳液体延续的有限波矢热力学边缘性，而非传统意义上的平衡结晶或机械堵塞，并揭示不同维度（1D、2D、3D）下液体态关联函数均能编码接近终端无序堆积的普适性谜题。
papers.method_zh: 采用Ramakrishnan–Yussouff非线性分岔框架，重新审视平衡结晶的密度泛函理论，区分第一结晶分支、热力学共存和终端边缘性，并通过自洽方程的刚度消失条件确定终端点。

papers.title: Evaluating a 4B open-weights local LLM for agentic DFT workflows: a literature reproducibility audit
papers.abstract: Agentic workflows in materials science relying on hosted commercial models face severe reproducibility, economic, and data-privacy constraints. To explore fully local agentic science, this work evaluates an open-weights Qwen3:4B model executing an autonomous scientific pipeline across varying hardware constraints. Applied to pentagonal two-dimensional materials, the system extracts parameters from unstructured text, translates them into density functional theory (DFT) inputs, and drives simulations to convergence under a strict neurosymbolic architecture where agents propose and deterministic code disposes. The workflow is guarded by verbatim text grounding and multi-pass inference unions to counteract hardware-induced structural collapse. Evaluated against 201 expert judgements, the extractor achieves 95.7% precision (95% CI 90.3-98.1%) and 67.3% recall (59.8-74.0%), ensuring extracted parameters are strictly factual. However, precision identifying absent parameters does not exceed 47.0%, establishing that the measured omission rate constitutes a loose upper bound on true literature incompleteness. Across three hardware configurations, complete GPU residency governs extraction quality more fundamentally than weight or cache precision, raising Matthews correlation from 0.414 to 0.530 at fixed quantisation and to 0.560 with an unquantised cache. A corpus-scale audit indicates only 19 (33.3%) of the 57 studies are reproducible in principle, reporting every method parameter needed to re-initialise the calculation. Driven to convergence, the workflow reproduces published lattice constants with a mean absolute relative error of 2.3% where the relaxed structure retains its prototype, establishing that lightweight open-weights models can reliably drive autonomous agentic workflows when bounded by deterministic code gates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法学文章。关键词：agentic workflows、density functional theory (DFT) inputs、drives simulations to convergence、neurosymbolic architecture。；研究对象：五角形二维材料（pentagonal two-dimensional materials），以及从文献中提取其DFT计算参数并复现其晶格常数的自动化流程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 一个仅40亿参数的开源本地大语言模型（Qwen3:4B）在确定性代码门控的神经符号架构下，能够可靠驱动自主DFT工作流，复现文献晶格常数的平均绝对相对误差为2.3%；但文献可复现性审计显示，57项研究中仅19项（33.3%）在原则上可复现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：一个仅40亿参数的开源本地大语言模型（Qwen3:4B）在确定性代码门控的神经符号架构下，能够可靠驱动自主DFT工作流，复现文献晶格常数的平均绝对相对误差为2.3%；但文献可复现性审计显示，57项研究中仅19项（33.3%）在原则上可复现。；创新点：首次系统评估超轻量级开源本地LLM（4B参数）在完全本地化、无云端依赖的自主DFT工作流中的可靠性，并量化了硬件配置（GPU驻留、权重/缓存精度）对提取质量的影响；同时建立了文献参数缺失率的严格上界估计方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用神经符号架构：Qwen3:4B开源大语言模型作为智能体（agent）负责从非结构化文本中提取参数并生成DFT输入，确定性代码（deterministic code）负责执行模拟至收敛。工作流受逐字文本锚定（verbatim text grounding）和多遍推理并集（multi-pass inference unions）保护。评估基于201项专家判断，并在三种硬件配置下对比了量化/缓存精度的影响。

papers.title: Solid and Quasi-Solid Electrolytes for Zinc Batteries: Balancing Water Activity, Ion Transport, and Interfaces
papers.abstract: Zinc batteries offer a compelling route to safe and low-cost energy storage, yet their reliance on aqueous electrolytes promotes hydrogen evolution, corrosion, cathode dissolution, and non-uniform zinc deposition. Replacing the liquid with a solid or quasi-solid electrolyte can suppress these processes, but it also removes the medium that enables rapid Zn2+ transport and conformal electrode contact. This tension, the price of removing water, has been obscured by inconsistent use of the term solid state and by comparisons based largely on bulk ionic conductivity. Here we critically examine zinc electrolytes across a continuum from water-rich hydrogels to dry polymers, solvated crystals, and inorganic conductors. We distinguish water content from thermodynamic water activity and classify these materials according to phase state, mobile-solvent fraction, and dominant transport mechanism. We show that neither high conductivity nor nominally water-free composition reliably predicts cell performance: electrolyte thickness, Zn2+ transference, interfacial resistance, and evolving contact often determine the practical outcome. Controlled-solvation and hybrid electrolytes therefore provide the most credible near-term path, whereas genuinely solvent-free Zn2+ conductors remain a longer-term scientific target. Progress will require transparent reporting of solvent state and validation using thin electrolytes, realistic electrode loadings, limited zinc excess, and calendar-life testing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述/评论性文章（critical review），基于对已有文献的批判性分析，而非新实验或新计算。判断依据：摘要中“critically examine”“classify”“show”等表述，未提及新实验数据或计算方法。；研究对象：锌电池中的固态与准固态电解质，涵盖水凝胶、干态聚合物、溶剂化晶体、无机导体等材料体系，重点研究其水含量、水活度、相态、离子输运机制及界面行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高离子电导率或标称无水组成并不能可靠预测电池性能；电解质厚度、Zn²⁺迁移数、界面电阻和接触演化往往决定实际结果。可控溶剂化与杂化电解质是近期最可行的路径，而真正无溶剂的Zn²⁺导体仍是长期科学目标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高离子电导率或标称无水组成并不能可靠预测电池性能；电解质厚度、Zn²⁺迁移数、界面电阻和接触演化往往决定实际结果。可控溶剂化与杂化电解质是近期最可行的路径，而真正无溶剂的Zn²⁺导体仍是长期科学目标。；创新点：区分了“水含量”与“热力学水活性”两个概念，并提出按相态、溶剂分数和输运机制分类的框架，指出当前“固态”术语使用不一致及仅以体相电导率比较的误区。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验或计算手段，属于文献综述与分类框架构建，依据相态、可移动溶剂分数、主导输运机制等参数对电解质进行分类比较。

papers.title: Extreme Polarization of the Optical Gap and High-Energy Exciton Landscape in CrSBr
papers.abstract: We reveal a strongly anisotropic excitonic landscape in monolayer and bulk-like CrSBr using optical absorption spectroscopy and $GW$-Bethe-Salpeter equation $\textit{ab initio}$ calculations. The direct absorptive determination of the lowest bright optical onsets i.e. $X_0^a$ and $X_0^b$ excitons for the two in-plane polarization eigenaxes yield an in-plane optical gap anisotropy of $470 \pm 15$ meV. This is the highest observed value for any material in the near-infrared-to-visible spectral region to the best of our knowledge. Energetically above, we identify multiple strongly polarized excitons spanning $1.25$ eV to $3.1$ eV selectively aligned along the two orthogonal axes. A resonance $X^-$, located $24$ meV below the $X_0^b$ progressively transfers oscillator strength to $X_b^0$, a behavior consistent with a coupled trion (Fermi-polarion)/exciton pair. Our experiments also provide polarization-resolved broadband dielectric functions of CrSBr. These results establish CrSBr as a strongly polarization-selective excitonic system and highlight its potential for polarization-selective optoelectronics enabled with its large optical-gap anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：optical absorption spectroscopy（实验）与 $GW$-Bethe-Salpeter equation ab initio calculations（第一性原理计算）并用。；研究对象：层状磁性半导体 CrSBr（单层及类体相），具体研究其激子（exciton）的各向异性光学响应与光学带隙的极端偏振依赖性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CrSBr 面内两个正交偏振方向上的最低亮激子（$X_0^a$ 与 $X_0^b$）能量差达 $470 \pm 15$ meV，为近红外至可见波段已知材料中最大的面内光学带隙各向异性；同时在高能区（1.25–3.1 eV）存在多个强偏振选择的激子态，并观察到 trion（Fermi-polaron）/激子耦合行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CrSBr 面内两个正交偏振方向上的最低亮激子（$X_0^a$ 与 $X_0^b$）能量差达 $470 \pm 15$ meV，为近红外至可见波段已知材料中最大的面内光学带隙各向异性；同时在高能区（1.25–3.1 eV）存在多个强偏振选择的激子态，并观察到 trion（Fermi-polaron）/激子耦合行为。；创新点：首次直接通过吸收光谱定量测定 CrSBr 面内光学带隙各向异性（470 meV），并宣称该值为近红外-可见区所有材料中最高；同时提供了偏振分辨的宽带介电函数，确立了 CrSBr 作为强偏振选择性激子体系的地位。摘要未突出说明与以往 CrSBr 光学研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 偏振分辨的光学吸收光谱（实验）测量最低亮激子位置及宽带介电函数；$GW$-BSE 第一性原理计算（理论）用于解释和验证激子能级与各向异性。

papers.title: Vibrational Origin of the Barocaloric Effect in the Spin-Crossover Complex Fe(pap-5NO2)2: A Combined DFT and Mean-Field Study
papers.abstract: Despite the barocaloric performance recently reported for the spin-crossover complex Fe(pap-5NO2)2, the microscopic origin of its pressure-induced entropy change remains poorly understood. In particular, the relative contributions of vibrational, configurational, and spin degrees of freedom to the barocaloric response have not yet been quantitatively established. Here, we develop a theoretical framework that combines density functional theory (DFT) calculations with an effective mean field Hamiltonian to investigate the barocaloric effect in this spin-crossover complex. Vibrational frequencies of the low-spin (S = 0) and high-spin (S = 2) states obtained from first-principles calculations are incorporated into a thermodynamic model that explicitly accounts for configurational, spin, and lattice entropy contributions. By establishing a correspondence between the vibrational spectra of both spin states through displacement-vector overlap analysis, we identify low and mid frequency metal-ligand vibrations as the primary microscopic origin of the vibrational entropy change. The proposed model quantitatively reproduces the experimentally reported barocaloric entropy change for a pressure variation of 2 kbar, corresponding to a maximum reversible entropy change of approximately 70 J kg-1 K-1, and predicts a spin-crossover temperature of T_1/2 = 313 K under ambient pressure, in excellent agreement with the experimental value of 308 K. Analysis of the entropy components reveals that lattice entropy associated with molecular vibrations accounts for approximately 84% of the total barocaloric response, whereas configurational and spin contributions are comparatively small.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合型文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“density functional theory (DFT) calculations”和“effective mean field Hamiltonian”，属于第一性原理计算结合平均场理论建模。；研究对象：自旋交叉配合物 Fe(pap-5NO2)2 的压卡效应（barocaloric effect），具体关注其压力诱导熵变中振动、构型与自旋自由度的微观贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该配合物压卡效应的主要微观起源是低、中频金属-配体振动模式，晶格振动熵贡献约占压卡总响应的84%，而构型熵与自旋熵贡献较小；模型定量重现了2 kbar压力下的实验压卡熵变（约70 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹），并预测常压自旋交叉温度T₁/₂ = 313 K，与实验值308 K高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该配合物压卡效应的主要微观起源是低、中频金属-配体振动模式，晶格振动熵贡献约占压卡总响应的84%，而构型熵与自旋熵贡献较小；模型定量重现了2 kbar压力下的实验压卡熵变（约70 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹），并预测常压自旋交叉温度T₁/₂ = 313 K，与实验值308 K高度吻合。；创新点：首次定量区分了振动、构型与自旋自由度对自旋交叉配合物压卡效应的相对贡献，并通过振动谱对应分析明确了金属-配体振动模式是振动熵变化的主要来源，实现了对实验压卡熵变的定量复现。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算低自旋（S=0）和高自旋（S=2）态的振动频率，通过位移矢量重叠分析建立两自旋态振动谱的对应关系；将第一性原理振动数据嵌入包含构型、自旋和晶格熵贡献的有效平均场热力学模型，定量计算压卡熵变。

papers.title: PINN-Phase: A physics-informed neural network for curvature-driven multiphase-field evolution
papers.abstract: Phase-field simulation of polycrystalline microstructures becomes costly when many related cases must be evolved over long times. We introduce PINN-Phase, a physics-informed neural time integrator that advances the full multiphase field from its initial condition and enforces phase bounds and unit sum at every step; on the reported explicit multiphase-field benchmarks, post-initial-condition reference states serve only for evaluation. Without case-specific tuning, a single trained 25-grain model meets all predefined criteria in seven of eight unseen microstructures fixed before evaluation and in both stress cases, with 0.94-3.71% terminal grain-label disagreement across the ten cases. Each 12,000-step rollout takes about 5.2 min on a single GPU and reaches nearly three times the temporal horizon represented during training. A pre-registered 64-grain model reaches 6.09% disagreement, retaining all 21 reference survivors plus one additional grain; a post-evaluation continuation with a doubled training horizon and 25 additional epochs reaches 3.97% and the exact survivor set. In three dimensions, one trained 16-grain 96^3 model recovers the exact terminal active set and all three extinction identities in six of six unseen microstructures, five of which meet the complete predefined qualification. These results demonstrate structurally admissible long-horizon prediction and prospective initial-condition transfer within fixed benchmark families.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：physics-informed neural network、neural time integrator、multiphase-field evolution、benchmarks。；研究对象：多晶微结构中的曲率驱动多相场演化，具体为二维和三维多晶粒微结构（25-grain、64-grain、16-grain 96³ 模型）的长时间演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PINN-Phase 神经网络时间积分器能够在无需逐案例调参的情况下，对未见过的多晶初始条件进行长时间、结构上可接受的多相场演化预测，在二维和三维基准测试中均能准确恢复终态活性晶粒集合及灭绝晶粒身份。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PINN-Phase 神经网络时间积分器能够在无需逐案例调参的情况下，对未见过的多晶初始条件进行长时间、结构上可接受的多相场演化预测，在二维和三维基准测试中均能准确恢复终态活性晶粒集合及灭绝晶粒身份。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可归纳为：无需案例特定调参即可实现跨初始条件的迁移预测，且训练时未覆盖的时间范围（近三倍于训练时域）仍能保持结构可接受性；在三维体系中实现了精确的灭绝身份恢复。
papers.method_zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）时间积分器，在每一步强制满足相界（phase bounds）和单位总和约束；训练后直接推进完整多相场，参考态仅用于评估。训练在单个 GPU 上进行，12,000 步 rollout 约需 5.2 分钟。

papers.title: Controlling Intertwined Electronic Orders in FeSe with Exfoliation
papers.abstract: Controlling intertwined electronic orders in two-dimensional superconductors offers an effective route to answering fundamental questions and engineering new quantum devices. However, tuning the balance between competing orders typically requires complex chemistry, strain, or interface engineering. Here, we show that a pristine alternative is the dimensional reduction of the unconventional superconductor FeSe. Exfoliation suppresses the bulk electronic nematic response and switches the superconducting symmetry from bulk s-wave to d-wave-dominant. Transport, electron microscopy, and Raman spectroscopy establish the substantial weakening of nematic order in thin flakes. To probe superconductivity, we perform angle-dependent Andreev reflection spectroscopy on pristine crystal edges. As the junction's orientation is rotated, the spectra evolve from zero-energy bound states to coherence peaks. The injection angle, field, and temperature dependence, along with theoretical modeling, confirm that exfoliation switches the superconducting symmetry. Our results suggest a versatile superconducting platform for engineering quantum orders and provide fresh insights into the underlying pairing mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到 transport, electron microscopy, Raman spectroscopy, angle-dependent Andreev reflection spectroscopy 等实验手段，并辅以理论建模。；研究对象：二维超导体 FeSe（铁硒）薄片，具体研究其电子向列序（nematic order）与超导配对对称性之间的相互竞争与调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机械剥离（exfoliation）实现 FeSe 的维度降低，可显著抑制体相电子向列响应，并将超导配对对称性从体相的 s 波转变为 d 波主导。这一发现提供了一种无需化学掺杂、应变或界面工程即可调控竞争电子序的“纯净”途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机械剥离（exfoliation）实现 FeSe 的维度降低，可显著抑制体相电子向列响应，并将超导配对对称性从体相的 s 波转变为 d 波主导。这一发现提供了一种无需化学掺杂、应变或界面工程即可调控竞争电子序的“纯净”途径。；创新点：首次证明仅通过维度降低（剥离）即可在不引入外部扰动（如化学、应变、界面）的情况下，同时抑制向列序并改变超导配对对称性，为二维超导量子序调控提供了全新平台。摘要未突出说明与具体理论模型的细节差异。
papers.method_zh: 机械剥离制备薄片；输运测量（transport）；电子显微镜（electron microscopy）；拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy）；角度依赖的安德烈夫反射谱（angle-dependent Andreev reflection spectroscopy）用于探测超导配对对称性；结合注入角、磁场和温度依赖的测量以及理论建模进行验证。

papers.title: Dynamical backaction in nanoscale superfluid electromechanics
papers.abstract: Nanofluidic acoustic resonators employing superfluid $^4$He can be used to study quantized vortices from collective behavior in two-dimensional superfluid turbulence down to few individual vortices created by rotation. In order to improve sensitivity to the level needed for probing individual quantized vortices, readout mechanisms employing optomechanical or optomechanics-inspired approaches seem to be promising in this regard. In this work, we develop an electromechanical system, which couples a 4$^\mathrm{th}$ sound acoustic resonance to a superconducting LC tank circuit in a sideband-resolved regime. Using this system, we demonstrate electromechanically induced transparency (EMIT), optical spring effect and optomechanical sideband damping and amplification. Furthermore, by rotating the cryostat, we demonstrate sensitivity to quantized vortices, which can become trapped and released in avalanche-like process inside the nanofluidic volume.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述“we develop an electromechanical system”“we demonstrate”“by rotating the cryostat, we demonstrate sensitivity”，均为实验实现与测量表述。；研究对象：纳米流体超流⁴He声学谐振器与超导LC谐振回路构成的机电耦合系统；具体物理现象包括第四声声学模式与微波电路的边带分辨耦合、光力效应（光学弹簧、边带阻尼与放大），以及旋转下量子涡旋在纳米流体通道中的俘获与雪崩式释放。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在边带分辨区实现了超流⁴He纳米流体声学模式与超导LC电路的机电耦合，演示了机电诱导透明、光学弹簧效应及边带冷却/放大；并通过对低温恒温器旋转，展示了系统对量子涡旋的探测灵敏度，观察到涡旋的俘获与雪崩式释放过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在边带分辨区实现了超流⁴He纳米流体声学模式与超导LC电路的机电耦合，演示了机电诱导透明、光学弹簧效应及边带冷却/放大；并通过对低温恒温器旋转，展示了系统对量子涡旋的探测灵敏度，观察到涡旋的俘获与雪崩式释放过程。；创新点：将光机/光力学启发的读出方案应用于超流⁴He纳米流体声学系统，首次在边带分辨区实现机电诱导透明与光力效应，并将灵敏度提升至可探测单个量子涡旋俘获/释放事件的水平（摘要中未明确说明与已有工作的具体对比，但“in order to improve sensitivity…readout mechanisms employing optomechanical…approaches”表明这是新读出路径）。
papers.method_zh: 实验上构建了第四声声学谐振器与超导LC谐振腔的机电系统，工作在边带分辨区（sideband-resolved regime）；采用微波读出机制（类似光机读出的电学类比），测量透射谱以观察EMIT和光力效应；通过旋转低温恒温器引入涡旋，监测系统响应以探测涡旋动力学。

papers.title: Elastic properties of amorphous LiTaCl$_6$ solid-state electrolyte
papers.abstract: Amorphous solid-state electrolytes are attractive candidates for safe, high-energy-density all-solid-state batteries, yet their mechanical properties remain poorly understood from a computational perspective. Here, we investigate the elastic behavior of the recently discovered amorphous superionic Li-ion conductor LiTaCl$_6$ using density-functional-theory (DFT)-based methods, including unrelaxed static, relaxed static, and strain fluctuations from molecular dynamics (MD) simulations in the isobaric--isothermal (NPT) ensemble with DFT-trained machine-learning force fields (MLFFs). While the unrelaxed static method predicts a Young's modulus an order of magnitude higher than the experiment, the relaxed static method---commonly applied to crystalline electrolytes---still overestimates the modulus by more than 170%. In contrast, the MD approach using MLFFs yields a Young's modulus of $2.84 \pm 0.26$ GPa, which quantitatively agrees with the experimental value of $2.91 \pm 0.32$ GPa. Using the MLFF-MD approach, we further predict bulk modulus (4.44 GPa), shear modulus (1.02 GPa), and Poisson's ratio (0.39) for amorphous LiTaCl$_6$ and conclude that elastically it behaves like a soft polymer or gel. These results demonstrate that amorphous superionic materials possess some unique elastic properties and that, among the methods examined, only the MLFF-MD approach yields quantitative agreement with experiment, highlighting the necessity of a dynamical treatment to simulate their elastic response, consistent with recent findings for crystalline superionic conductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用 density-functional-theory (DFT) 方法、机器学习力场（MLFFs）及分子动力学（MD）模拟，无实验数据采集描述（实验值仅用于对比）。；研究对象：非晶固态电解质 LiTaCl₆（一种新发现的非晶超离子锂离子导体）的弹性性质，包括杨氏模量、体模量、剪切模量和泊松比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非晶 LiTaCl₆ 的弹性行为类似软聚合物或凝胶（杨氏模量 2.84 GPa，泊松比 0.39）；只有基于机器学习力场的分子动力学（MLFF-MD）方法能定量复现实验值，而静态方法严重高估模量（未弛豫静态法高估一个数量级，弛豫静态法高估超 170%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非晶 LiTaCl₆ 的弹性行为类似软聚合物或凝胶（杨氏模量 2.84 GPa，泊松比 0.39）；只有基于机器学习力场的分子动力学（MLFF-MD）方法能定量复现实验值，而静态方法严重高估模量（未弛豫静态法高估一个数量级，弛豫静态法高估超 170%）。；创新点：首次对非晶超离子导体 LiTaCl₆ 的弹性性质进行系统计算研究，并明确证明动态处理（MLFF-MD）是定量描述非晶超离子导体弹性响应的必要条件，而传统用于晶态电解质的静态弛豫方法在此失效。
papers.method_zh: 基于 DFT 的三种计算方法：(1) 未弛豫静态法；(2) 弛豫静态法；(3) 等压等温（NPT）系综下的分子动力学模拟，其中原子间相互作用由 DFT 训练的机器学习力场（MLFFs）描述，通过应变涨落提取弹性常数。

papers.title: "Ultra-weak" First-Order Phase Transition in Biaxial Liquid Crystals
papers.abstract: We report high-resolution Monte Carlo evidence characterizing the hierarchy of transition strengths in biaxial nematogens. By employing multiple histogram reweighting on large lattices, we demonstrate that while the isotropic-to-uniaxial ($I \to N_U$) transition is symmetry-enforced first-order, the uniaxial-to-biaxial ($N_U \to N_B$) transition in the region between the tricritical point and the triple point ($λ= 0.26$) is proximity-driven and more than an order of magnitude smaller for large system sizes. Such a class of ultra-weak first-order transitions could be a new pathway for future investigations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：Monte Carlo evidence、multiple histogram reweighting、large lattices。；研究对象：双轴液晶（biaxial nematogens）中的各向同性—单轴（I→N_U）与单轴—双轴（N_U→N_B）相变，特别是三临界点与三相点之间（λ=0.26）的相变强度层级。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: I→N_U 相变是对称性强制的弱一级相变，而 N_U→N_B 相变在特定参数区间内是邻近效应驱动的一级相变，其强度比前者小一个数量级以上，属于“超弱一级相变”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：I→N_U 相变是对称性强制的弱一级相变，而 N_U→N_B 相变在特定参数区间内是邻近效应驱动的一级相变，其强度比前者小一个数量级以上，属于“超弱一级相变”。；创新点：首次系统量化了双轴液晶中不同相变强度的层级关系，并明确提出“超弱一级相变”（ultra-weak first-order transition）这一新类别，为后续研究提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨率蒙特卡洛模拟，结合多重直方图重加权（multiple histogram reweighting）技术，在大尺寸格点上进行有限尺寸分析。

papers.title: Strain-Driven Electronic and Catalytic Modulation of g-C3N4/GeS van der Waals heterostructure for Photocatalytic Water Splitting
papers.abstract: Photocatalytic water splitting offers a viable pathway for sustainable hydrogen production. In this study, first-principles density functional theory calculations were performed to explore the strain-dependent photocatalytic behaviour of a two-dimensional g-C3N4/GeS heterostructure. The heterostructure shows type-II band alignment with an indirect band gap of 2.17 eV, smaller than those of the individual g-C3N4 (2.81 eV) and GeS (3.31 eV) monolayers. Biaxial tensile strain up to 3% effectively modulates the band gap and band edge positions, allowing suitable alignment with water redox potentials. The calculated Gibbs free energy for the hydrogen evolution reaction (ΔGHER) is 0.2 eV for the pristine heterostructure and approaches near-thermoneutral values (-/+ 0.1 eV) under +1% and +2% strain. Meanwhile, the OER overpotential decreases from 2.17 V to 0.97 V with increasing strain. AIMD simulations and optical absorption in the visible region confirm the thermodynamic stability and promising photocatalytic potential of the heterostructure for hydrogen generation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles density functional theory calculations”（第一性原理密度泛函理论计算），以及AIMD模拟。；研究对象：二维g-C3N4/GeS范德华异质结，及其在光催化水分解中的应变调控行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该异质结具有type-II能带排列和2.17 eV间接带隙，双轴拉伸应变（最高3%）可有效调控带隙和带边位置，使其与水的氧化还原电位匹配；同时应变显著降低析氧反应过电位（从2.17 V降至0.97 V），并使析氢反应的吉布斯自由能接近热中性（±0.1 eV）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该异质结具有type-II能带排列和2.17 eV间接带隙，双轴拉伸应变（最高3%）可有效调控带隙和带边位置，使其与水的氧化还原电位匹配；同时应变显著降低析氧反应过电位（从2.17 V降至0.97 V），并使析氢反应的吉布斯自由能接近热中性（±0.1 eV）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于系统研究双轴拉伸应变对g-C3N4/GeS异质结光催化水分解性能（包括带边对齐、HER和OER动力学）的协同调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算；AIMD（从头算分子动力学）模拟用于验证热力学稳定性；计算了能带结构、带边位置、吉布斯自由能（ΔGHER）和析氧过电位，以及可见光区光学吸收。

papers.title: Analogue Phase Change Computational Memory with High Precision Reads and Energy Efficient Writes
papers.abstract: Resistive memory technologies offer a compelling advantage for in-memory computing. However, realizing a device architecture that simultaneously achieves high computational precision, efficiency, and density has remained elusive due to inherent trade-offs among these performance metrics. Here, we introduce a com- pact phase-change memory device architecture that combines an ultra-confined active switching volume for enhanced electro-thermal efficiency with a non-insulating thin film that suppresses temporal conductance fluctuations. We analytically model and back-end integrate these devices into crossbar arrays. Even with conventional, undoped phase-change materials, the device architecture enables a computational precision approaching 6 bits, low conductance values below 50 μS with an adequate conductance window, and a viable pathway toward sub-100 μA programming currents under nominal operating voltages.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与器件集成混合类型。判断依据关键词：device architecture、analytically model、back-end integrate、crossbar arrays。；研究对象：相变存储（phase-change memory）器件，具体为一种具有超受限活性开关体积和非绝缘薄膜的紧凑型存储单元，用于存内计算（in-memory computing）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该器件架构在采用常规未掺杂相变材料的情况下，可实现接近6位的计算精度、低于50 μS的低电导值（且具有足够的电导窗口），并有望在标称工作电压下实现低于100 μA的编程电流，同时抑制时间电导涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该器件架构在采用常规未掺杂相变材料的情况下，可实现接近6位的计算精度、低于50 μS的低电导值（且具有足够的电导窗口），并有望在标称工作电压下实现低于100 μA的编程电流，同时抑制时间电导涨落。；创新点：通过将超受限活性开关体积（提升电热效率）与非绝缘薄膜（抑制时间电导涨落）相结合，在单一器件架构中同时缓解了计算精度、效率和密度之间的固有矛盾，且无需使用掺杂相变材料。摘要未突出说明与传统相变存储器件在具体工艺或材料选择上的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如材料沉积方法、表征技术等），但明确提及：器件架构的解析建模（analytically model）、后端集成（back-end integrate）到交叉阵列（crossbar arrays）中，以及电导涨落抑制和编程电流的电气表征。

papers.title: Collinear and noncollinear antiferromagnetic ordering in a highly frustrated decorated square kagomé lattice antiferromagnets of the nabokoite family
papers.abstract: Nabokoite family compounds ACu$_7$(TeO$_4$)(SO4)$_5$X (A=Na, K, Rb, Cs; X=Cl, Br) host frustrated 2D square kagom'{e} lattice layers decorated by additional inter-layer magnetic ions. We study magnetic order in nabokoites with multi-frequency electron spin resonance spectroscopy and thermodynamic measurement (specific heat, magnetization and dielectric permittivity). Our study reveals that the choice of the low-temperature ground state is qualitatively different in light-alkali-ion (K, Na) and heavy-alkali-ion (Rb, Cs) compounds. Heavy-alkali-ion nabokoites order in conventional collinear antiferromagnetic pattern with easy-axis anisotropy. The parameters of the ordered antiferromagnetic state are very close for all heavy-alkali-ion subfamily. Light-alkali-ion members of nabokoite family demonstrate much more complicated route to the ordered state: firstly, a ferroelectric transition at 25-90K lifts the frustration and thus pre-cooks the low-temperature ordering; secondly, an unusual noncollinear magnetic order develops via two-step phase transition with first transition temperature $T_{c1}\simeq 5-6$K and the second transition at $T_{c2}\simeq 3-4$K. Noncollinear order is evidenced by observation of characteristic non-Larmor antiferromagnetic resonance mode. Spin dynamics of light-alkali-ion nabokoites is characterized by three zero-field magnon gaps and two spin-reorientation fields, the values of magnon gaps and critical fields are quite different for different compounds. The finite-size cluster modeling of pyramidal structural block of nabokoite structure combined suggests that the critical closeness of the nabokoite exchange coupling parameters to the border-line between the different quantum ground state of pyramidal building block of nabokoite structure could be the clue to the choice of qualitatively different ordered state in light- and heavy-alkali-ion nabokoites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含部分理论建模）。判断依据：多频电子自旋共振谱、热力学测量（比热、磁化率、介电常数）等实验手段，并结合有限尺寸团簇建模分析。；研究对象：Nabokoite 家族化合物 ACu₇(TeO₄)(SO₄)₅X（A=Na, K, Rb, Cs；X=Cl, Br），具体研究其二维高度阻挫方形 kagomé 晶格中由额外层间磁性离子修饰的反铁磁有序行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 轻碱金属离子（K、Na）与重碱金属离子（Rb、Cs）的 nabokoite 化合物在低温基态选择上存在本质差异：重碱金属体系呈现常规共线反铁磁序（易轴各向异性），而轻碱金属体系先经历铁电相变解除阻挫，再通过两步相变进入非共线反铁磁序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：轻碱金属离子（K、Na）与重碱金属离子（Rb、Cs）的 nabokoite 化合物在低温基态选择上存在本质差异：重碱金属体系呈现常规共线反铁磁序（易轴各向异性），而轻碱金属体系先经历铁电相变解除阻挫，再通过两步相变进入非共线反铁磁序。；创新点：首次揭示同一家族中轻/重碱金属离子对磁基态选择的决定性影响，并发现轻碱金属体系中铁电相变与磁阻挫解除之间的关联，以及非共线磁序通过两步相变形成的独特路径。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 多频电子自旋共振谱（multi-frequency ESR）、热力学测量（比热、磁化强度、介电常数），以及有限尺寸团簇建模（finite-size cluster modeling）分析 nabokoite 结构中的金字塔形结构单元。

papers.title: Heavy-Hole--Light-Hole Mixing and Spin--Photon Coupling in Germanium Flopping-Mode Qubits
papers.abstract: Intrinsic spin--orbit interaction in germanium provides electrically active flopping-mode qubits without requiring magnetic-field gradients to generate spin--charge hybridization. We study double quantum dots (DQDs) with a multiband Luttinger--Kohn framework that retains heavy-hole (HH) and light-hole (LH) states on equal footing. Modeling vertical confinement with a finite confinement potential along the growth direction brings selected subbands into a regime of appreciable HH--LH mixing. This admixture activates electric-dipole spin-coupling through LH--LH and LH--HH transitions, complementing the conventional HH--HH pseudospin-flip resonance. For the parameter sets considered, these additional channels can produce larger spin--photon figures of merit than the HH--HH transition. HH--LH mixing thus supplies a tunable ingredient for qubit--cavity coupling in germanium hole-spin qubits and extends the operating regimes available to circuit-QED architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“multiband Luttinger–Kohn framework”（多带Luttinger–Kohn框架）以及“modeling vertical confinement”（对垂直限制进行建模），属于理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：锗（Germanium）空穴自旋量子点中的flopping-mode量子比特，具体为双量子点（DQD）体系，重点关注重空穴（HH）与轻空穴（LH）混合效应以及自旋–光子耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在锗flopping-mode量子比特中，有限垂直限制势引起的HH–LH混合可激活额外的电偶极自旋耦合通道（LH–LH和LH–HH跃迁），在部分参数下这些通道产生的自旋–光子耦合品质因子优于传统的HH–HH赝自旋翻转跃迁，从而为量子比特–腔耦合提供可调谐的新机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在锗flopping-mode量子比特中，有限垂直限制势引起的HH–LH混合可激活额外的电偶极自旋耦合通道（LH–LH和LH–HH跃迁），在部分参数下这些通道产生的自旋–光子耦合品质因子优于传统的HH–HH赝自旋翻转跃迁，从而为量子比特–腔耦合提供可调谐的新机制。；创新点：无需外加磁场梯度即可实现自旋–电荷杂化（flopping-mode），并首次系统展示了HH–LH混合作为额外自旋–光子耦合通道的可行性，扩展了锗空穴自旋量子比特在电路QED架构中的工作区间。
papers.method_zh: 采用多带Luttinger–Kohn理论框架，将重空穴（HH）和轻空穴（LH）态平等地纳入计算；沿生长方向用有限限制势模拟垂直约束，从而获得具有显著HH–LH混合的子带结构，并在此基础上计算自旋–光子耦合强度及品质因子。

papers.title: Experimental observation of decoupled spin subsystems in decorated square kagomé lattice magnets of the nabokoite family
papers.abstract: The square kagomé lattice (SKL) offers a model platform for investigating geometric frustration in 2D systems. Nabokoite-family compounds \nabok{A}{X} (A=Na, K, Cs, Rb and X=Cl, Br) extend this physics to a 3D network, where 2D SKL layers are decorated by interlayer spins. Using electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR), we demonstrate a dramatic splitting of this complex exchange network into two virtually decoupled spin subsystems: absolute calibration of the electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) absorption reveals that only a fraction of all copper spins in nabokoites is EPR-active and this fraction of the spins orders at the Néel point. Comparison of the EPR absorption and static susceptibility indicates that contribution of the EPR-silent spin subsystem to total magnetic susceptibility decreases on cooling. This direct observation of coexisting magnetic order and possible spin-liquid dynamics within a single compound challenges conventional models of unified exchange networks in decorated frustrated lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Using electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR)”，并涉及“absolute calibration of the EPR absorption”等实验测量。；研究对象：Nabokoite家族化合物（化学式A₂Cu₃X₂，其中A=Na, K, Cs, Rb；X=Cl, Br），具体研究其装饰型方形kagomé晶格（square kagomé lattice, SKL）中的磁性行为，特别是二维SKL层与层间自旋构成的三维交换网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过EPR测量发现，该复杂交换网络可分裂为两个几乎完全退耦合的自旋子系统：仅部分铜自旋具有EPR活性并在Néel点发生磁有序，而另一部分EPR沉默的自旋子系统对总磁化率的贡献随降温而减小。这一共存现象挑战了传统统一交换网络模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过EPR测量发现，该复杂交换网络可分裂为两个几乎完全退耦合的自旋子系统：仅部分铜自旋具有EPR活性并在Néel点发生磁有序，而另一部分EPR沉默的自旋子系统对总磁化率的贡献随降温而减小。这一共存现象挑战了传统统一交换网络模型。；创新点：首次在实验上直接观察到同一化合物中磁有序与可能的自旋液体动力学共存，并证明装饰型受阻晶格中自旋子系统可近乎完全退耦合，突破了以往将整个交换网络视为统一整体的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 电子顺磁共振（EPR）谱学，包括EPR吸收的绝对标定；结合静态磁化率测量进行对比分析。

papers.title: Evaluating LLM-based AI agents integrated with materials synthesis tools: the case of atomic layer deposition
papers.abstract: This work provides an overview of the different strategies that can be used to evaluate the performance of AI models and agents based on large language models (LLMs) for materials synthesis. After providing a brief overview of the key technologies behind the current generation of AI agents based on LLMs, we summarize the different approaches to evaluating these models in the context of materials science and in particular on materials synthesis, with a specific emphasis on scenarios in which the models are directly integrated with experimental tools. We discuss evaluation strategies spanning knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, tool-use benchmarks, and closed loop benchmarks involving the interaction with experimental systems or realistic virtual tools. We use atomic layer deposition (ALD) as a case study, emphasizing how existing approaches in the literature both build from general approaches used beyond materials science and can be generalized to other materials synthesis techniques. Finally, we provide a practical evaluation framework to evaluate LLMs in the context of materials synthesis
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（综述/评估类文章，涉及AI模型与实验工具集成）。判断依据关键词：overview、evaluation strategies、integrated with experimental tools。；研究对象：研究对象并非传统凝聚态材料，而是**基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI智能体在材料合成中的应用**，以**原子层沉积（ALD）** 作为具体案例体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出具体的物理或材料学结论，核心贡献在于系统梳理了LLM智能体在材料合成（特别是ALD）中的三类评估策略（知识/推理基准、工具使用基准、闭环实验基准），并提出了一个实用的评估框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出具体的物理或材料学结论，核心贡献在于系统梳理了LLM智能体在材料合成（特别是ALD）中的三类评估策略（知识/推理基准、工具使用基准、闭环实验基准），并提出了一个实用的评估框架。；创新点：将通用AI智能体评估方法（超越材料科学领域）系统性地映射到材料合成场景，以ALD为具体案例，提出了一个可推广到其他材料合成技术的实用评估框架。摘要未突出说明与传统凝聚态物理研究方法的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 本文为方法论综述，未使用具体实验或计算手段。其讨论的评估方法包括：知识/推理基准测试、工具使用基准测试、以及与实验系统或虚拟工具交互的闭环基准测试。未涉及具体DFT、DMRG等物理计算方法。

papers.title: Crystal electric field excitations and an effective-spin-$1/2$ ground doublet in the hyperkagome magnet Yb$_3$Sc$_2$Ga$_3$O$_{12}$
papers.abstract: We use inelastic neutron scattering (INS) to determine the crystal electric field (CEF) excitations of Yb$^{3+}$ in the rare-earth hyperkagome magnet Yb$_3$Sc$_2$Ga$_3$O$_{12}$. Three nearly dispersionless magnetic excitations are observed near 58, 68, and 74~meV, corresponding to transitions from the ground-state Kramers doublet to the three excited doublets of the $J=7/2$ multiplet. A Stevens-operator analysis constrained by the local $222$ ($D_2$) symmetry reproduces the excitation energies and spectral weights and yields an Ising-type ground-state $g$ tensor. The first excited doublet lies approximately 58~meV above the ground state, establishing a well-isolated effective $J_{\mathrm{eff}}=1/2$ degree of freedom over the low-temperature regime relevant to collective magnetism. Notably, the directly measured CEF spectrum substantially revises the level scheme previously inferred from bulk measurements, while preserving the essential low-energy pseudospin description. Two independent fitting protocols give consistent excitation energies, ground-doublet wave functions, and $g$ tensors, despite the nonuniqueness of the individual CEF parameters. The resulting single-ion model also reproduces the characteristic susceptibility, magnetization, and field evolution of the Schottky anomaly in specific heat. These results establish the microscopic single-ion basis needed to construct an effective exchange Hamiltonian and to interpret future measurements of low-energy collective excitations in Yb$_3$Sc$_2$Ga$_3$O$_{12}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用非弹性中子散射（inelastic neutron scattering, INS）进行测量，并结合Stevens算符分析。；研究对象：稀土超kagome磁体Yb₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂中Yb³⁺离子的晶格电场（CEF）激发，以及由此确定的有效自旋-1/2基态双重态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过INS直接测定了Yb³⁺的CEF能级，三个激发双重态分别位于约58、68和74 meV，基态为Ising型g张量的Kramers双重态，从而确立了低温下良好隔离的有效J_eff=1/2自由度。该直接测量的能级方案显著修正了此前从体测量推断的能级图，但保留了基本的低能赝自旋描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过INS直接测定了Yb³⁺的CEF能级，三个激发双重态分别位于约58、68和74 meV，基态为Ising型g张量的Kramers双重态，从而确立了低温下良好隔离的有效J_eff=1/2自由度。该直接测量的能级方案显著修正了此前从体测量推断的能级图，但保留了基本的低能赝自旋描述。；创新点：首次直接测量了该材料的CEF激发谱，修正了此前仅由体测量推断的能级方案，同时确认了低能有效自旋-1/2描述的适用性，为构建有效交换哈密顿量提供了可靠的微观单离子基础。
papers.method_zh: 非弹性中子散射（INS）测量磁激发谱；Stevens算符分析（受局域222（D₂）对称性约束）拟合激发能量和谱权重；两种独立的拟合协议交叉验证；单离子模型计算用于复现磁化率、磁化强度及比热中Schottky异常随场的变化。

papers.title: Single-pulse strain-induced precessional dynamics of magnetization in Co-doped iron garnet
papers.abstract: Ultrafast control of magnetization through lattice excitation provides a route to manipulating magnetic order on short timescales, yet the role of transient strain in driving magnetization dynamics remains poorly understood. Here, single-shot pump-probe magneto-optical microscopy is used to resolve the structural and magnetic responses of cobalt-doped yttrium iron garnet to individual 5-ps mid-infrared pulses. The excitation generates a localized strain field together with an outward-propagating elastic wave. Concurrently, the magnetic contrast decreases following excitation and subsequently reverses on a timescale of approximately 1.5-2 ns before recovering to its initial state. The structural and magnetic responses exhibit closely correlated wavelength and pulse-energy dependences, indicating a common excitation pathway. Micromagnetic simulations incorporating transient strain reproduce the precessional reorientation of the magnetization within individual domains while largely preserving the labyrinthine domain morphology. These results identify transient lattice deformation as the link between single-pulse mid-infrared excitation and reversible precessional magnetization dynamics in Co-doped yttrium iron garnet.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“single-shot pump-probe magneto-optical microscopy”（单发泵浦-探测磁光显微术）作为主要实验手段，同时包含“Micromagnetic simulations”（微磁模拟）作为辅助验证，属于实验与模拟结合的混合类型。；研究对象：钴掺杂钇铁石榴石（Co-doped yttrium iron garnet）薄膜中的磁化超快动力学，具体为单脉冲中红外激发诱导的瞬态应变场与磁化进动（precessional）重取向之间的耦合关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单脉冲中红外激发产生的瞬态晶格应变场是驱动钴掺杂钇铁石榴石中磁化可逆进动重取向的关键机制：磁化在约1.5–2 ns时间尺度上发生反转后恢复初始态，且结构响应与磁响应具有共同的激发路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单脉冲中红外激发产生的瞬态晶格应变场是驱动钴掺杂钇铁石榴石中磁化可逆进动重取向的关键机制：磁化在约1.5–2 ns时间尺度上发生反转后恢复初始态，且结构响应与磁响应具有共同的激发路径。；创新点：首次将单脉冲中红外激发下的瞬态晶格形变明确确立为驱动可逆磁化进动动力学的物理桥梁，并通过结构-磁响应的波长与脉冲能量依赖关系的一致性，以及微磁模拟对磁畴形态的保留，提供了直接的因果证据。摘要未突出说明与以往应变驱动磁化研究的具体差异点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用单发（single-shot）泵浦-探测磁光显微术，使用5皮秒中红外单脉冲激发，同时解析结构响应（应变场及向外传播的弹性波）与磁响应（磁对比度变化）；理论上采用微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations），将瞬态应变场作为输入以重现磁化进动行为。

papers.title: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Process Driven by Multiple Dichotomous Noises
papers.abstract: We study a generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process driven by a superposition of $K$ independent dichotomous noises with arbitrary fixed amplitudes and switching rates. Unlike the classical Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process driven by equilibrium Gaussian white noise, the present system is governed by bounded nonequilibrium fluctuations with finite correlation times. We obtain exact expressions for the stationary position distribution and all cumulants, and show that the stationary state possesses an unexpectedly rich structure, including compact support, algebraic branch-point singularities, edge divergences, and multiple extrema. We establish a mapping onto a heterogeneous random-flight process with bounded jumps, yielding a transparent probabilistic interpretation of the stationary measure. We further analyze several limiting regimes, including the crossover to Gaussian statistics for large numbers of noise sources. For ensembles with exponentially-distributed quenched amplitudes, we derive exact disorder-averaged stationary distributions and show that disorder fundamentally alters the stationary state, producing exponential tails decorated by algebraic prefactors with non-trivial exponents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We obtain exact expressions”“We establish a mapping”“We derive”等理论推导表述，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程，具体为受K个独立二值（dichotomous）噪声叠加驱动的随机动力学系统。该体系属于非平衡统计物理中的随机过程，而非特定凝聚态材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该非平衡系统在稳态下具有丰富的结构，包括紧支撑、代数支点奇异性、边界发散和多极值；且当噪声源数目增大时，系统交叉到高斯统计。对于淬火无序振幅服从指数分布的系综，无序会根本性地改变稳态，产生带有非平凡代数前因子的指数尾巴。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该非平衡系统在稳态下具有丰富的结构，包括紧支撑、代数支点奇异性、边界发散和多极值；且当噪声源数目增大时，系统交叉到高斯统计。对于淬火无序振幅服从指数分布的系综，无序会根本性地改变稳态，产生带有非平凡代数前因子的指数尾巴。；创新点：首次对多个任意固定振幅和切换率的二值噪声叠加驱动的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程给出精确稳态解，揭示了远超经典高斯白噪声驱动情形的丰富稳态结构（紧支撑、边界发散、多极值等），并通过随机飞行映射提供了透明概率解释；同时首次展示了淬火无序对稳态统计的定性改变（指数尾巴+代数前因子）。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论方法：精确求解广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的稳态位置分布与所有累积量；建立到异质随机飞行（random-flight）过程的映射以获得概率论解释；分析多个极限情形（如大噪声源数目的高斯交叉）；对淬火无序系综进行精确的无序平均稳态分布推导。

papers.title: Quantitative Disentanglement of Terahertz Spin and Orbital Pumping in 3d Ferromagnetic Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Spin and orbital pumping - the injection of spin and orbital angular momentum from a driven ferromagnet into an adjacent nonmagnetic layer - are fundamental processes underlying angular-momentum generation and transport in magnetic heterostructures. Femtosecond optical excitation extends these phenomena into the ultrafast regime, where spintronic terahertz emission spectroscopy (STES) detects picosecond angular-momentum currents in a contact-free manner through spin-to-charge and orbital-to-charge conversion. Microscopic theory predicts that orbital-pumping efficiency increases from Fe to Ni across the 3d series, yet whether these predictions hold under ultrafast excitation remains unclear. A central challenge is that spin and orbital currents are generated simultaneously and contribute additively to the same terahertz emission, preventing their quantitative separation. Here, we overcome this limitation by combining STES with wedge-sample thickness control in heterostructures whose nonmagnetic layers (Ta, W, and Nb) have spin Hall and orbital Hall angles of opposite signs. The two angular-momentum channels therefore exhibit distinct emission polarities and thickness dependences, enabling their quantitative decomposition. Systematic measurements on Fe, Co, and Ni heterostructures reveal that the orbital-pumping contribution increases progressively toward Ni, reaching several tens of percent of the spin-current contribution - far exceeding theoretical predictions. Even Fe generates a non-negligible orbital current that becomes essential in the thin-nonmagnetic-layer regime. The extracted orbital diffusion lengths are consistently shorter than spin diffusion lengths and increase with decreasing spin-orbit coupling strength of the nonmagnetic layer. These results establish a quantitative framework for ultrafast spin and orbital pumping in magnetic heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“systematic measurements”“STES”“wedge-sample thickness control”等实验手段。；研究对象：3d铁磁金属（Fe、Co、Ni）与非磁层（Ta、W、Nb）构成的异质结构，具体研究超快太赫兹自旋泵浦与轨道泵浦现象及其定量分离。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Fe、Co、Ni异质结构中，轨道泵浦贡献随元素从Fe到Ni逐渐增大，最高可达自旋电流贡献的百分之几十，远超理论预言；即使Fe也产生不可忽略的轨道电流，且轨道扩散长度普遍短于自旋扩散长度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Fe、Co、Ni异质结构中，轨道泵浦贡献随元素从Fe到Ni逐渐增大，最高可达自旋电流贡献的百分之几十，远超理论预言；即使Fe也产生不可忽略的轨道电流，且轨道扩散长度普遍短于自旋扩散长度。；创新点：首次实现了超快激发条件下自旋泵浦与轨道泵浦电流的定量分离，克服了二者同时产生且对同一太赫兹发射信号相加贡献的难题，建立了超快自旋/轨道泵浦的定量分析框架。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹自旋发射谱（STES）结合楔形样品厚度控制；利用非磁层（Ta、W、Nb）自旋霍尔角与轨道霍尔角符号相反的特性，通过发射极性与厚度依赖关系定量分解自旋和轨道电流贡献。

papers.title: Topological pair density waves in kagome superconductors
papers.abstract: The pair density wave (PDW) is an unconventional superconducting state exhibiting periodic pairing modulations due to pairing with finite momentum Q. In two dimensions, multiple Q components of the PDW can have a non-trivial relative phase, breaking time-reversal symmetry and resulting in a topological electronic structure. Here we review progress on exploring such topological PDWs (TPDWs) and discuss their potential realization in kagome superconductors. We first introduce the concept of a TPDW starting from the Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) state and examine the challenges toward its realization. We then discuss the possibility of a TPDW in the kagome lattice, which intertwines with chiral superconductivity and loop currents, thus connecting to models describing the quantum anomalous Hall effect. Furthermore, we review the experimental signatures of a TPDW in AV3Sb5 (A = Cs, Rb, K) superconductors and highlight related quantum effects, including switchable chiral pairing modulations, Bogoliubov Fermi states, the superconducting diode effect, and the anomalous thermal Hall effect. Finally, we project the future research opportunities of this correlated topological quantum phase and discuss its broad implications for finite-momentum pairing, topological matter, and chiral superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“review”“discuss”“introduce the concept”“project future research opportunities”等表述，属于理论综述性质，未涉及具体实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：Kagome超导体中的拓扑配对密度波（TPDW），具体材料体系为AV₃Sb₅（A = Cs, Rb, K）超导体，以及相关的有限动量配对、手性超导、环形电流和量子反常霍尔效应等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维体系中，配对密度波（PDW）的多个动量分量之间可具有非平凡相对相位，从而打破时间反演对称性并产生拓扑电子结构；这种拓扑PDW（TPDW）可能在kagome超导体中实现，并与手性超导和环形电流相互交织，产生可切换的手性配对调制、Bogoliubov费米态、超导二极管效应和反常热霍尔效应等量子现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维体系中，配对密度波（PDW）的多个动量分量之间可具有非平凡相对相位，从而打破时间反演对称性并产生拓扑电子结构；这种拓扑PDW（TPDW）可能在kagome超导体中实现，并与手性超导和环形电流相互交织，产生可切换的手性配对调制、Bogoliubov费米态、超导二极管效应和反常热霍尔效应等量子现象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作作为综述，系统性地将拓扑配对密度波的概念与kagome超导体联系起来，整合了有限动量配对、拓扑物质和手性超导三个方向的交叉研究，并展望了该相关拓扑量子相的未来研究方向。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段或计算方法。文中采用的概念框架包括：从Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov（FFLO）态出发引入TPDW概念，结合kagome晶格模型讨论其与手性超导和环形电流的关联，并回顾了AV₃Sb₅体系中的实验证据。具体实验技术（如ARPES、STM等）摘要未提及。

papers.title: Evolving charge order in the CDW state of AV$_3$Sb$_5$ metals
papers.abstract: AV$_3$Sb$_5$ kagome metals are characterized by intertwined electronic and structural orders, which motivated extensive studies in recent years. Yet the details of the electronic state preceding the superconducting phase remain poorly understood. Here we extend our previous investigation [Phys. Rev. Research 7, L032046 (2025)] of RbV$_3$Sb$_5$ using avoided level crossing (ALC) muon-spin spectroscopy to the $A$ = Cs and K systems. Consistent with our previous study, we identify a second transition whose origin cannot be attributed solely to an internal magnetic field, indicating the involvement of an additional electronic mechanism that subtly modifies the charge distribution within the V plane. In particular, the ALC results point towards an additional charge modulation taking place within the charge density wave (CDW) phase and occurring at $T^{*}<T_{CDW}$ for $A$ = Cs and Rb, or in the vicinity of $T_{CDW}$ for $A$ = K.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到使用 muon-spin spectroscopy（μ子自旋谱学）进行测量，并对比了不同元素（Cs、K）的体系。；研究对象：AV₃Sb₅ 笼目金属（A = Cs、Rb、K），具体研究其电荷密度波（CDW）态内部的电子有序演化，以及进入超导相之前的电子态细节。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 AV₃Sb₅ 的 CDW 相内部存在第二个转变，该转变不能仅由内磁场解释，而是涉及额外的电子机制，导致 V 面内电荷分布发生细微修改。该额外电荷调制发生在 T* < T_CDW（A = Cs、Rb）或接近 T_CDW（A = K）处。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 AV₃Sb₅ 的 CDW 相内部存在第二个转变，该转变不能仅由内磁场解释，而是涉及额外的电子机制，导致 V 面内电荷分布发生细微修改。该额外电荷调制发生在 T* < T_CDW（A = Cs、Rb）或接近 T_CDW（A = K）处。；创新点：将此前仅针对 RbV₃Sb₅ 的 ALC-μSR 研究扩展到 Cs 和 K 体系，揭示 CDW 相内部存在一个普遍的、与磁场无关的额外电荷调制转变，表明该现象是 AV₃Sb₅ 家族的共性特征。
papers.method_zh: 避免能级交叉（ALC）μ子自旋谱学（avoided level crossing muon-spin spectroscopy），并扩展至 Cs 和 K 体系，与之前对 RbV₃Sb₅ 的研究进行对比。

papers.title: Directional commensurability stabilizes structural superlubricity in patterned mesoscale interfaces
papers.abstract: Structural superlubricity, arising from lattice incommensurability, offers a promising route to eliminate friction and associated energy losses in mechanical systems. In real-world systems, roughness and wear currently pose severe limitations on its robustness and especially the contact size. Here, we consider patterned surfaces as a possible route to overcome some of these limitations. We show that the simplest choice of patterning, contacts made up of two incommensurate triangular-triangular patterns, fails at elevated loads because of the small number of load-bearing contacts, causing the maximum local contact pressure to exceed the strength of the superlubric coating. We introduce a square-triangular patterned interface that increases the number of load-bearing contacts and organizes them into continuous contact lines. When sliding along specific directions relative to these lines, superlubricity is maintained at significantly higher loads by reducing pressure-induced coating failure while also remaining somewhat tolerant to surface imperfections. These findings establish a mechanism for stabilizing structural superlubricity against coating failure and a design principle for engineering low-friction interfaces with enhanced load-bearing capacity and defect tolerance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we consider”“we show”“we introduce”等表述，且未提及实验手段，属于理论建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：结构超润滑（structural superlubricity）体系中的图案化介观尺度接触界面，具体包括三角-三角（triangular-triangular）和方-三角（square-triangular）两种图案化接触构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三角-三角图案化接触在高载荷下因承载接触点数量少、局部接触压力超过超润滑涂层强度而失效；方-三角图案化界面可增加承载接触点数量并将其组织为连续接触线，沿特定方向滑动时能在显著更高的载荷下维持超润滑，同时容忍一定表面缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三角-三角图案化接触在高载荷下因承载接触点数量少、局部接触压力超过超润滑涂层强度而失效；方-三角图案化界面可增加承载接触点数量并将其组织为连续接触线，沿特定方向滑动时能在显著更高的载荷下维持超润滑，同时容忍一定表面缺陷。；创新点：提出了一种通过图案化设计（方-三角构型）稳定结构超润滑的新机制，即利用连续接触线组织承载接触点，在提高承载能力的同时保持低摩擦，并增强对表面缺陷的容忍度，为高承载、缺陷容忍的低摩擦界面提供了设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算手段（如分子动力学、有限元或解析模型），仅提及对图案化界面的接触压力分布、滑动方向依赖性和缺陷容忍度进行分析。具体方法需参考原文。

papers.title: A route to the thermodynamics of colloid-polymer mixtures from structural information
papers.abstract: Liquid-state theory provides a fundamental connection between microscopic structure and macroscopic thermodynamic behaviour. Here, we develop a framework for predicting thermodynamics and phase behaviour directly from structural correlations, using either radial distribution functions or static structure factors as input. The approach constructs a free-energy functional from structural information obtained at a single thermodynamic state point, without requiring explicit knowledge of the underlying interaction potentials. This circumvents a central difficulty in modelling complex fluids, for which effective interactions are often unknown or rely on approximations. We demonstrate the framework for a range of model fluids, including colloidal and colloid--polymer systems, with predictions in good agreement with molecular simulation data. The results show that structural information at a single state point can provide sufficient information to predict the broader thermodynamic response of a system. This establishes a route toward inferring phase behaviour directly from experimentally measured structure, even when the microscopic interactions are not known a priori.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“Liquid-state theory”“free-energy functional”“molecular simulation data”等关键词，核心为理论框架构建与模拟验证。；研究对象：胶体与胶体-聚合物混合体系（colloid–polymer mixtures）等模型流体，关注其热力学性质与相行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅凭单一热力学状态点的结构信息（径向分布函数或静态结构因子）即可构建自由能泛函，从而预测体系更广泛的热力学响应与相行为，且与分子模拟结果吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅凭单一热力学状态点的结构信息（径向分布函数或静态结构因子）即可构建自由能泛函，从而预测体系更广泛的热力学响应与相行为，且与分子模拟结果吻合良好。；创新点：绕过对有效相互作用势的显式依赖，直接从实验可测的结构信息推断热力学与相行为，为未知微观相互作用的复杂流体提供了新的预测路径。
papers.method_zh: 基于液态理论的自由能泛函构建方法，以径向分布函数或静态结构因子作为输入，无需已知相互作用势；通过分子模拟数据对模型流体进行验证。

papers.title: Light-induced nonconservative static forces in many-body systems
papers.abstract: In a quantum many-body system, a periodic drive can often generate effective static forces on the slow collective degrees of freedom. We study the static forces generated by light on electronic order parameters in solid-state systems. We show that the forces can have nonconservative components that originate from dissipation, i.e., optical absorption. This effect is demonstrated in two nontrivial examples. In excitonic insulators, via interband excitations, the light field generates a nonconservative force on the phase of the excitonic order parameter. This force leads to an acceleration of the phase, which manifests as a shift of the photon emission peak from an exciton condensate. In materials with an incommensurate charge density wave, a propagating light field generates a nonconservative force on the phase of its order parameter. It drives the charge density wave into sliding motion, leading to a DC electric current via topological Thouless pumping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”“We show”“This effect is demonstrated”等理论推导与模型分析表述，未提及实验手段或数值计算细节。；研究对象：量子多体系统中的光致静态力，具体聚焦于固态材料中的电子有序参量（激子绝缘体的激子有序参量相位，以及非公度电荷密度波的相位），涉及光与物质相互作用下的非保守力效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光场在耗散（光吸收）存在时，可对电子有序参量产生非保守静态力。在激子绝缘体中，该力加速激子相位，导致激子凝聚体光子发射峰移动；在非公度电荷密度波材料中，传播光场驱动有序参量相位滑动，通过拓扑Thouless泵浦产生直流电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光场在耗散（光吸收）存在时，可对电子有序参量产生非保守静态力。在激子绝缘体中，该力加速激子相位，导致激子凝聚体光子发射峰移动；在非公度电荷密度波材料中，传播光场驱动有序参量相位滑动，通过拓扑Thouless泵浦产生直流电流。；创新点：首次揭示光致静态力可具有非保守分量，其来源为光学吸收（耗散），并给出两个具体物理实现（激子绝缘体与电荷密度波），将光驱动力与拓扑泵浦电流联系起来。摘要未突出说明与以往光致力研究的其他区别。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于周期性驱动量子多体系统中慢集体自由度的有效静态力理论，结合具体模型（激子绝缘体的带间激发、非公度电荷密度波的传播光场）进行解析推导。摘要未提及具体数值方法或第一性原理计算。
