papers.title: Electronic phase separation and emergence of a nondimerized insulating phase in VO$_2$ $(110)_{\mathit{R}}$ ultrathin films
papers.abstract: Using in situ photoemission spectroscopy and x-ray absorption spectroscopy, we investigated the thickness dependence of the electronic structure and V-V dimerization in VO$_2$/TiO$_2$ (110) ultrathin films, in which the one-dimensional V-V chains along the $c_{\mathit{R}}$ axis lie in the film plane. In VO$_2$ $(110)_{\mathit{R}}$ films, the reduction in dimensionality along the surface-normal direction is not expected to impose a geometric constraint on V-V dimerization, unlike in VO$_2$ $(001)_{\mathit{R}}$ films. Nevertheless, the characteristic spectral changes associated with the temperature-driven metal-insulator transition observed in thick films persist down to 1.5 nm, whereas at 1 nm an insulating electronic phase is observed without V-V dimerization. This behavior is highly similar to that reported for VO$_2$ $(001)_{\mathit{R}}$, suggesting that the enhancement of Mott instability resulting from reduced dimensionality is a common and essential driving force for the emergence of the nondimerized insulating phase in VO$_2$ ultrathin films. Meanwhile, unlike in VO$_2$ $(001)_{\mathit{R}}$, the nondimerized insulating phase in VO$_2$ $(110)_{\mathit{R}}$ coexists with the phase exhibiting the temperature-driven metal-insulator transition. Its fraction increases exponentially with decreasing thickness and becomes dominant at 1 nm. The corresponding effective critical thickness is estimated to be 2.2 nm. These results imply that the geometric orientation of the V-V chains dictates the spatial evolution of electronic phase separation via strain-mediated phase competition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到使用原位光电子能谱（in situ photoemission spectroscopy）和X射线吸收谱（x-ray absorption spectroscopy）进行测量。；研究对象：VO₂/TiO₂ (110) 超薄膜，具体研究其电子结构、V-V二聚化以及厚度依赖的金属-绝缘体转变（MIT）行为，特别是电子相分离和非二聚化绝缘相的出现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在VO₂ (110)_R超薄膜中，非二聚化绝缘相的出现源于维度降低增强的Mott不稳定性，且该相与具有温度驱动MIT的相发生电子相分离，其比例随厚度减小呈指数增长，有效临界厚度约为2.2 nm。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在VO₂ (110)_R超薄膜中，非二聚化绝缘相的出现源于维度降低增强的Mott不稳定性，且该相与具有温度驱动MIT的相发生电子相分离，其比例随厚度减小呈指数增长，有效临界厚度约为2.2 nm。；创新点：揭示了在V-V链位于膜面内（(110)_R取向）的VO₂超薄膜中，维度降低同样能诱导非二聚化绝缘相，且该相与MIT相共存并发生电子相分离，表明V-V链的几何取向通过应变介导的相竞争决定了电子相分离的空间演化。这一发现将此前仅在(001)_R取向观察到的行为推广到(110)_R取向，并强调了Mott不稳定性增强的普适性。
papers.method_zh: 原位光电子能谱（PES）和X射线吸收谱（XAS），用于表征不同厚度薄膜的电子结构和V-V二聚化程度。

papers.title: Doping-driven evolution of pairing symmetry in pressurized La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$
papers.abstract: We investigate the superconducting pairing symmetry and its doping evolution in pressurized La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. For the undoped compound, the most favorable pairing state is found to be $s_{\pm}$-wave, characterized by sign reversal of the gap functions between the Fermi pockets. A detailed analysis of the pairing interactions reveals that this unconventional state originates from repulsive interactions mediated by the magnetic odd modes of the bilayer nickelate. Upon hole doping, the $γ$ Fermi pocket expands, which amplifies the intrapocket repulsions on this pocket. These repulsions, driven by the magnetic even modes, gradually dominates the pairing interactions and ultimately drive a transition in pairing symmetry from $s_{\pm}$-wave to $d_{xy}$-wave in the heavily hole-doped regime. In stark contrast, the $s_{\pm}$-wave pairing persists under electron doping, even deep into the heavily electron-doped regime where a Lifshitz transition occurs. This finding suggests that the $γ$ Fermi pocket is not essential for the emergence of superconductivity in bilayer nickelates. In fact, the $s_{\pm}$-wave pairing becomes more robust in the absence of the $γ$ pocket, as spin fluctuations are strongly enhanced by the favorable nesting between the $α$ and $β$ pockets --- a condition guaranteed by Luttinger's theorem and the Fermi surface topology. We believe that exploring the doping evolution of superconducting pairing will open a new realm for testing the pairing mechanism in pressurized La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“investigate”“analysis of the pairing interactions”“reveals”“suggests”等理论分析词汇，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：加压双层镍氧化物La₃Ni₂O₇（ pressurized La₃Ni₂O₇）的超导配对对称性及其随掺杂（空穴掺杂与电子掺杂）的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 未掺杂的加压La₃Ni₂O₇最有利的配对态为s±波（费米口袋间能隙符号反转）；空穴掺杂会驱动配对对称性从s±波转变为dxy波，而电子掺杂（即使发生Lifshitz转变）下s±波配对持续存在，且γ费米口袋并非超导出现所必需。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：未掺杂的加压La₃Ni₂O₇最有利的配对态为s±波（费米口袋间能隙符号反转）；空穴掺杂会驱动配对对称性从s±波转变为dxy波，而电子掺杂（即使发生Lifshitz转变）下s±波配对持续存在，且γ费米口袋并非超导出现所必需。；创新点：首次系统揭示加压La₃Ni₂O₇中配对对称性随掺杂的演化路径（s±→dxy），并提出γ费米口袋缺失反而增强s±配对鲁棒性的反直觉结论，为实验检验配对机制提供了新方向。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于配对相互作用的详细分析，结合磁性模式（磁奇模与磁偶模）介导的排斥相互作用、费米面拓扑与Luttinger定理讨论自旋涨落增强机制。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如DFT+U、FLEX等）。

papers.title: Real-space manifestation of ferroic multipoles in altermagnetic MnF$_2$
papers.abstract: Altermagnets are unconventional spin split magnets arising from the zero spin-orbit coupled limit. They host a magnetic multipolar order parameter yet direct real-space observation of these multipoles has remained elusive. Here we use polarized-neutron diffraction to reconstruct the three-dimensional magnetization density of the prototypical altermagnet MnF$_2$. By exploiting symmetry-selective magnetic reflections, we separate the dominant spherical Mn$^{2+}$ contribution from the much weaker anisotropic Mn magnetization and the covalent spin polarization of the fluorine ligands. The reconstructed spin density reveals a finite fluorine ion moment together with an anisotropic Mn magnetization consistent with the symmetry-allowed altermagnetic rank-5 magnetic multipole $O_{52}$(magnetic triacontadipole). These results provide direct real-space evidence of ferroic multipolar order in an altermagnet and establish polarized-neutron diffraction as a powerful probe of hidden magnetic multipoles in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用极化中子衍射”（polarized-neutron diffraction）进行测量与重构。；研究对象：典型交错磁体（altermagnet）MnF₂，具体研究其三维磁化密度分布、Mn²⁺离子各向异性磁矩、氟配体共价自旋极化，以及磁性多极（rank-5磁三十二极子）的实空间表现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过极化中子衍射重构出MnF₂的自旋密度，直接观察到有限的氟离子磁矩和与对称性允许的交错磁rank-5磁多极O₅₂（磁三十二极子）一致的各向异性Mn磁化，首次在实空间证实了交错磁体中铁性多极序的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过极化中子衍射重构出MnF₂的自旋密度，直接观察到有限的氟离子磁矩和与对称性允许的交错磁rank-5磁多极O₅₂（磁三十二极子）一致的各向异性Mn磁化，首次在实空间证实了交错磁体中铁性多极序的存在。；创新点：首次在实空间直接观测到交错磁体中的磁性多极序（铁性多极），并证明极化中子衍射是探测量子材料中隐藏磁多极的有力工具。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 极化中子衍射（polarized-neutron diffraction），结合对称选择性磁反射（symmetry-selective magnetic reflections）来分离球形Mn²⁺贡献、各向异性Mn磁化与氟配体共价自旋极化，进而三维重构磁化密度。

papers.title: Duality Between Twist-Angle Disorder and Non-Hermitian Disorder
papers.abstract: We propose and study a model of moire heterobilayer systems where the twist angle remains uniform and well defined only within a finite range, but deforms randomly at larger distances. The local twist angle is then subject to a certain probability distribution that penalizes large fluctuations around its mean value. Within the framework of the replica trick, we show that disorder averaging produces a nontrivial correlation with alternating sign between replicas, maximized only close the boundary of each local domain and along certain directions. We show that for the low-energy moire bands, exactly the same correlation can be generated in a dual model where fermions are coupled to non-Hermitian disorder, which can evade Anderson localization dynamically. This duality provides a new perspective to investigate twist-angle disorder in moire systems, and unveils some of the essential differences between twist-angle disorder and conventional disorder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose and study a model、replica trick、duality。；研究对象：莫尔异质双层体系中的扭转角无序（twist-angle disorder），即局部扭转角在有限范围内均匀、在更大尺度上随机变形的物理系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扭转角无序在低能莫尔带中产生的复制品间交变符号关联，可以等价地由费米子耦合非厄米无序的双重模型产生，且后者能动态规避安德森局域化。该对偶揭示了扭转角无序与传统无序的本质区别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扭转角无序在低能莫尔带中产生的复制品间交变符号关联，可以等价地由费米子耦合非厄米无序的双重模型产生，且后者能动态规避安德森局域化。该对偶揭示了扭转角无序与传统无序的本质区别。；创新点：首次提出扭转角无序与非厄米无序之间的对偶关系，为研究莫尔系统中的扭转角无序提供了全新视角，并明确区分了扭转角无序与传统无序的物理后果。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析计算：构建扭转角随机分布模型，利用复制技巧（replica trick）进行无序平均，分析复制品间关联函数，并建立与非厄米无序模型的映射。

papers.title: Enhanced Diffusion from Twist-Angle Disorder
papers.abstract: We consider the effect of twist-angle disorder on the single-particle properties of twisted bilayer systems. These materials are a natural playground for studying how tiny, uncontrolled spatial variations may become unusually consequential; a local change in the twist geometry can give rise to spatially-correlated alterations of the parent Hamiltonian, which in turn affect the coarse-grained properties of the substrate such as transport and ordering tendencies. In analogy to electrodynamics, where the magnetic field is given by the curl of the vector potential, we model the twist angle as the curl of the relative displacement between the two bilayers. We find that geometric scattering constraints imposed here by the twist structure substantially suppress momentum relaxation relative to mean-rate-matched white noise. We quantify these effects and show that the problem can be mapped onto a non-linear sigma model (NLSM).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We consider”“We model”“We find”“can be mapped onto”等理论推导与建模表述，未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：扭转双层体系（twisted bilayer systems）中由扭转角无序（twist-angle disorder）引起的单粒子性质变化，特别是其对动量弛豫、输运和有序化倾向等粗粒化性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扭转角无序导致的几何散射约束会显著抑制动量弛豫（相对于平均速率匹配的白噪声情况），且该问题可映射为一个非线性sigma模型（NLSM）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扭转角无序导致的几何散射约束会显著抑制动量弛豫（相对于平均速率匹配的白噪声情况），且该问题可映射为一个非线性sigma模型（NLSM）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：将扭转角类比为电磁学中的磁场（即相对位移的旋度），建立扭转角无序的几何描述；通过对比白噪声情况分析动量弛豫的抑制效应；最终将问题映射到非线性sigma模型（NLSM）框架。

papers.title: Probing spin order via magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional material platforms now host a remarkable array of exotic correlated phases, from unconventional superconductivity to fractional Chern insulators. Probing magnetic order in these systems is essential for understanding their underlying physics, yet dilute spin densities render conventional magnetic probes ineffective. Spin waves, or magnons, in quantum Hall ferromagnets (QHFM) have proven effective for probing the magnetic order in various symmetry-broken quantum Hall (QH) phases in graphene systems, but previous works have been limited to homojunction configurations within a single material. Here, we demonstrate magnon transmission across a monolayer-bilayer graphene quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunction - the first magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions, using one material as a magnon source to probe magnetic order in a distinct material. Generating magnons in monolayer graphene (MLG) at $ν$ = 1, we detect their transmission through bilayer graphene (BLG) via nonlocal voltage measurements, revealing spin order in BLG symmetry-broken quantum Hall states. The transmission exhibits hallmark magnon signatures: a sharp onset at the Zeeman energy and systematic variation with Landau level filling, including suppression at $ν$ = 4 and 8 where spin polarization vanishes. Our findings establish heterojunction magnon transmission as a powerful, modular probe of magnetic order, opening new avenues for investigating exotic quantum states across the rapidly expanding family of two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“nonlocal voltage measurements”（非局域电压测量）等实验手段，并描述了实际观测到的输运信号特征。；研究对象：单层-双层石墨烯（MLG-BLG）量子霍尔铁磁异质结中的自旋波（磁振子）输运，以及双层石墨烯对称性破缺量子霍尔态中的磁有序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次实现了磁振子跨量子霍尔铁磁异质结的传输：在单层石墨烯ν=1态产生磁振子，可在双层石墨烯中通过非局域电压探测到其透射信号，从而揭示双层石墨烯对称性破缺量子霍尔态的自旋序。透射信号在塞曼能量处出现陡峭起始，并在ν=4和8（自旋极化消失处）被抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次实现了磁振子跨量子霍尔铁磁异质结的传输：在单层石墨烯ν=1态产生磁振子，可在双层石墨烯中通过非局域电压探测到其透射信号，从而揭示双层石墨烯对称性破缺量子霍尔态的自旋序。透射信号在塞曼能量处出现陡峭起始，并在ν=4和8（自旋极化消失处）被抑制。；创新点：将磁振子探测磁有序的方法从单一材料内的同质结拓展到不同材料之间的异质结，实现了“一种材料作为磁振子源探测另一种材料磁有序”的模块化探测方案。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 非局域电压测量（nonlocal voltage measurement）：在单层石墨烯中于ν=1量子霍尔铁磁态产生磁振子，通过测量双层石墨烯中的非局域电压来检测磁振子透射；通过改变朗道能级填充因子ν系统研究透射信号的变化。

papers.title: Fractional Impurity Entropy from Potential Scattering in a Free Electron Gas
papers.abstract: Fractional changes in entropy are often associated with strong electron correlations or non-Abelian anyons in topological systems. We show that neither condition is necessary -- a system of free electrons on a ring scattering off a repulsive point-like impurity undergoes a $k_B\ln\sqrt 2$ entropy change as the impurity strength is increased. This effect arises from a shift of allowed single-particle momenta from integer quantization to half-integer quantization, induced by the impurity. We show that this fractional entropy change is universal across a broad class of single-particle dispersions, demonstrating that such signatures can arise without strong correlations or topological order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“free electrons on a ring”“single-particle dispersions”等理论模型语言，且无实验或数值计算关键词。；研究对象：一维环上自由电子气体中，一个排斥性点状杂质（potential scatterer）对体系熵的影响。具体物理现象为杂质强度增大时体系熵的分数变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自由电子气中仅通过点状杂质势散射，即可在杂质强度增大时产生 \( k_B\ln\sqrt{2} \) 的熵变，该分数熵变不依赖于强电子关联或非阿贝尔任意子，且对多种单粒子色散关系具有普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自由电子气中仅通过点状杂质势散射，即可在杂质强度增大时产生 \( k_B\ln\sqrt{2} \) 的熵变，该分数熵变不依赖于强电子关联或非阿贝尔任意子，且对多种单粒子色散关系具有普适性。；创新点：打破了“分数熵变必然源于强关联或拓扑序”的普遍认知，证明仅由势散射引起的单粒子边界条件改变（整数到半整数动量量子化）即可产生分数熵变，且该效应在多种色散关系下具有普适性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于一维环上自由电子的单粒子量子力学模型，通过引入点状杂质势，分析允许的单粒子动量从整数量子化到半整数量子化的转变，并计算相应的熵变化。摘要未提及具体数值方法或数值模拟。

papers.title: Can a Spin Liquid State Persist as the Ground State in the Presence of Competing Interactions and Disorder?
papers.abstract: In this report, we have shown that, in an otherwise geometrically frustrated lattice, the underlying interactions compete to stabilize different magnetic phases. In conjunction with fluctuations, these interactions may lead to the formation of unusual ordered phases, providing a pathway for understanding the fluctuation-driven order-by-disorder phenomenon. This competition is further modified by the presence of inherent structural disorder in a frustrated two-dimensional lattice. Furthermore, due to the local nature of the additional structural disorder, the majority of the samples evolve toward glassy dynamics, which can not only mimic spin-liquid-like behavior but also make it difficult to identify genuine spin-liquid candidates experimentally.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：geometrically frustrated lattice、fluctuations、order-by-disorder phenomenon、structural disorder、glassy dynamics）。摘要未提及具体实验手段，侧重于理论机制分析。；研究对象：二维几何阻挫晶格中的磁性系统，具体关注自旋液体态在竞争相互作用与结构无序共同作用下的稳定性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在几何阻挫晶格中，相互竞争的相互作用会稳定不同的磁相，并可能通过涨落诱导出“序由无序”（order-by-disorder）现象；而局域结构无序的引入会使大多数样品演化为玻璃态动力学，这种玻璃态行为可以模拟自旋液体特征，从而在实验上干扰对真实自旋液体候选材料的识别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在几何阻挫晶格中，相互竞争的相互作用会稳定不同的磁相，并可能通过涨落诱导出“序由无序”（order-by-disorder）现象；而局域结构无序的引入会使大多数样品演化为玻璃态动力学，这种玻璃态行为可以模拟自旋液体特征，从而在实验上干扰对真实自旋液体候选材料的识别。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但核心新意在于指出：局域结构无序导致的玻璃态动力学可能“伪装”成自旋液体行为，这为实验上甄别真实自旋液体候选材料提出了新的挑战。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或计算方法（如蒙特卡洛、张量网络、自旋波理论等），仅提及“fluctuations”和“order-by-disorder”机制，属于一般性理论分析。

papers.title: Orbital occupation selects structural dimensionality in binary transition-metal oxides
papers.abstract: Orbital-lattice coupling in transition-metal oxides is usually discussed within a given bonding framework, where orbital occupation is intertwined with local coordination, strain, or symmetry breaking. Here, we show that orbital occupation can also select the bonding framework itself, thereby determining structural dimensionality. Using first-principles calculations, we identify CrO as a prototype in which the single active $3d\,e_g$ electron of high-spin Cr$^{2+}$ gives rise to two competing orbital-structure states. The $d_{x^2-y^2}$ occupation favors a three-dimensionally connected covalent phase, whereas the $d_{z^2}$ occupation stabilizes a weakly coupled layered phase. Constrained-occupation calculations show that increasing the $d_{z^2}$ filling continuously contracts the in-plane lattice while expanding the structure along the layer normal. The two phases exhibit distinct magnetic ground states and ferroelastic responses. Moreover, the layered phase is robust against exchange-correlation functional and on-site ($U$) variations, remains dynamically stable down to the monolayer limit, and has a low exfoliation energy of 46 meV/Angstrom^2. Extending the analysis across related $3d$ binary oxides reveals a filling-dependence relation between accessible orbital filling and the preference for 2D or 3D connected bonding motifs, providing a microscopic basis for exploring low-dimensional oxide materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）和“constrained-occupation calculations”（约束占据计算）。；研究对象：二元过渡金属氧化物CrO，以及相关的3d过渡金属二元氧化物体系。具体物理现象是轨道占据如何决定晶体结构维度（三维共价相 vs 二维层状相）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CrO中高自旋Cr²⁺的单个活性3d e_g电子，其轨道占据方式（d_{x²-y²} vs d_{z²}）直接决定了结构维度：前者稳定三维连通共价相，后者稳定弱耦合层状相。层状相具有低剥离能（46 meV/Å²），且可稳定至单层极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CrO中高自旋Cr²⁺的单个活性3d e_g电子，其轨道占据方式（d_{x²-y²} vs d_{z²}）直接决定了结构维度：前者稳定三维连通共价相，后者稳定弱耦合层状相。层状相具有低剥离能（46 meV/Å²），且可稳定至单层极限。；创新点：以往研究通常在既定成键框架内讨论轨道-晶格耦合，本文首次展示轨道占据本身可以选择成键框架（即决定结构维度），并建立了3d二元氧化物中轨道填充与2D/3D成键偏好之间的普适填充依赖关系，为低维氧化物材料设计提供了微观基础。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT），包括约束占据计算（constrained-occupation calculations）以模拟不同轨道填充；测试了不同交换关联泛函和Hubbard U值的影响；计算了剥离能、磁性基态和铁弹响应。

papers.title: Electronic state of vortices at twin boundaries in a nematic superconductor
papers.abstract: Local electronic states of vortices in an s $\pm$ d wave nematic superconductor are studied both in the absence and presence of twin boundaries. The Bogoliubov-de Gennes theory for a tight-binding model is used with its nematicity represented by the anisotropy in the transfer integrals and attractive interactions between the nearest-neighbor sites. We evaluate s and d wave components of the pair potentials and the local density of states, and analyze the effects of nematicity on the vortex core structures with/without twin boundaries. We find that a single vortex trapped at the twin boundary is composed of a bound pair of fractional vortices accompanied by weakly-induced s $\pm$ id wave components, despite that such s $\pm$ id wave components do not appear in a zero magnetic field. The calculated spatial structures of the local electronic states are compared with the vortex image measured by STM experiments in an iron-based superconductor FeSe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 理论对紧束缚模型进行计算，属于数值理论工作。；研究对象：s±d 波向列超导体中的涡旋，具体关注孪晶界处涡旋的局域电子态，并与铁基超导体 FeSe 的 STM 实验图像对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在孪晶界处俘获的单个涡旋由一对分数涡旋束缚对组成，并伴随弱诱导的 s±id 波分量；尽管零磁场下并不出现该 s±id 波分量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在孪晶界处俘获的单个涡旋由一对分数涡旋束缚对组成，并伴随弱诱导的 s±id 波分量；尽管零磁场下并不出现该 s±id 波分量。；创新点：首次在向列超导体孪晶界涡旋体系中揭示分数涡旋束缚对及其伴随的场致 s±id 波分量，并将计算结果与 FeSe 的 STM 涡旋图像进行直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于紧束缚模型的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）理论；向列性通过转移积分的各向异性及最近邻位点间的吸引相互作用来表征；计算了 s 波和 d 波配对势分量及局域态密度（LDOS）。

papers.title: Surface-mediated frequency aging beyond quality-factor saturation in an AlScN-on-silicon resonator
papers.abstract: Vacuum package integrity in micro- and nanoelectromechanical resonators is commonly assessed through the quality factor Q, although Q probes residual-gas damping rather than the surface-state evolution that can govern frequency aging. Here, we disentangle the pressure responses of Q and the resonance frequency f0 in a 64.21 MHz Al0.7Sc0.3N-on-silicon cross-sectional Lamé-mode resonator between 0.01 to 760 Torr. Measurements at 25 °C and at the 68.8°C frequency turnover, where first-order thermal sensitivity is suppressed, reveal widely separated equilibration timescales. Following each pressure step, Q reaches a reversible, history-independent steady value on the pressure-control timescale and approaches a fitted pressure-independent ceiling of 8.5e4 below approximately 1 Torr. By contrast, f0 responds measurably down to 1e-5 Torr and remains history-dependent, relaxing for hours at fixed pressure. The transients follow stretched-exponential kinetics, consistent with a broad distribution of surface relaxation rates, and individual pressure steps produce fractional frequency shifts as large as 1.9 ppm. Ten-hour phase-locked measurements show a common short-term time-deviation floor near 1e-10 s from 0.01 to 100 Torr, whereas residual deterministic relaxation dominates at long averaging times; at 760 Torr, gas damping degrades short-term tracking through the reduced Q. These results establish gas-damping equilibrium and frequency equilibrium as distinct states. Quality-factor saturation alone is therefore insufficient to qualify vacuum packaging for precision mechanical frequency references; package specifications must also constrain surface-mediated frequency aging.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体测量（压力响应、Q值、频率f0、相位锁定测量），并给出实验条件（25°C、68.8°C频率转折点、0.01–760 Torr压力范围）。；研究对象：Al0.7Sc0.3N-on-silicon（氮化铝钪/硅）截面Lamé模式谐振器，具体研究其品质因数Q与谐振频率f0对气压的响应，以及表面介导的频率老化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Q值饱和（约8.5e4，低于约1 Torr）并不代表频率稳定性的饱和——f0在低至1e-5 Torr仍对压力有可测响应，且呈现持续数小时的历史依赖弛豫（拉伸指数动力学）。气体阻尼平衡与频率平衡是两个不同的物理状态，仅凭Q值饱和不足以判定真空封装质量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Q值饱和（约8.5e4，低于约1 Torr）并不代表频率稳定性的饱和——f0在低至1e-5 Torr仍对压力有可测响应，且呈现持续数小时的历史依赖弛豫（拉伸指数动力学）。气体阻尼平衡与频率平衡是两个不同的物理状态，仅凭Q值饱和不足以判定真空封装质量。；创新点：首次将Q值饱和与频率老化解耦，明确区分气体阻尼平衡与表面介导频率平衡两个独立状态，并提出真空封装规范必须同时约束表面介导频率老化，而非仅依赖Q值饱和判据。
papers.method_zh: 在0.01–760 Torr压力范围内对64.21 MHz谐振器进行Q与f0的同步测量；利用68.8°C频率转折点抑制一阶热灵敏度；采用逐步加压方式观察瞬态弛豫；使用拉伸指数函数拟合频率瞬态；进行10小时相位锁定测量以评估短期时间偏差（time deviation）。

papers.title: Symmetry-Preserving Phase Transitions in $AM_2$Al$_9$ Materials under Pressure
papers.abstract: External parameters such as temperature, pressure, and chemical doping can induce structural phase transitions in materials. Although such transitions usually involve a change in symmetry, an uncommon exception is the isostructural phase transition, which is first order yet preserves the symmetry of the parent structure. Using first-principles calculations, we show that $AM_2$Al$_9$ compounds ($A$ = Ba, Ca, Sr, or Eu; $M$ = Fe, Co, or Ni) undergo pressure-induced isostructural phase transitions. At the transition pressure, these systems exhibit a pronounced volume collapse while retaining the same crystal symmetry and space group ($P6/mmm$). Bonding analysis based on the integrated crystal orbital Hamilton population (ICOHP) shows that the transition is driven by a redistribution of bonding character between intralayer and interlayer atomic bonds. Because isostructural transitions are rare in single crystals, $AM_2$Al$_9$ provides a promising platform for investigating critical phenomena under pressure and for deepening our understanding of symmetry-preserving structural transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用第一性原理计算”（first-principles calculations）。；研究对象：$AM_2$Al$_9$ 化合物（$A$ = Ba, Ca, Sr, Eu；$M$ = Fe, Co, Ni），具体研究其在压力下的等结构相变（isostructural phase transition）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: $AM_2$Al$_9$ 化合物在压力下发生一级等结构相变：在相变压力处体积显著塌缩，但晶体对称性和空间群（$P6/mmm$）保持不变。该相变由层内与层间原子键之间成键特征的重新分配所驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：$AM_2$Al$_9$ 化合物在压力下发生一级等结构相变：在相变压力处体积显著塌缩，但晶体对称性和空间群（$P6/mmm$）保持不变。该相变由层内与层间原子键之间成键特征的重新分配所驱动。；创新点：等结构相变在单晶材料中极为罕见，$AM_2$Al$_9$ 体系为研究压力下的临界现象以及对称性保持的结构相变提供了新的平台。摘要未突出说明该方法或体系在计算技术上的其他新意。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT）；成键分析采用晶体轨道哈密顿布居积分（ICOHP，integrated crystal orbital Hamilton population）。

papers.title: Coherent phononic frequency combs in ferroelectric CMOS oxides
papers.abstract: Modern electronic systems require tens of clock and carrier frequencies, each synthesized by a dedicated phase-locked loop from a shared reference, imposing routing, power and synchronization burdens that grow with every domain. Optical frequency combs solved this problem in photonics, whereas electronics has lacked an equivalent source in its native radiofrequency domain. Here we report broadband phononic frequency combs in ferroelectric hafnia-zirconia nanoelectromechanical resonators built from complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) oxides. Lithographically defined detuning of a 2:1 internal resonance selects the generation mechanism: two-tone-seeded wave mixing yields more than 170 lines distributed over two octaves, with mutual coherence verified for representative pump and generated lines, whereas an autonomous Hopf route yields hierarchical combs of more than 200 lines through torus and period-doubling dynamics, in agreement with slow-flow bifurcation theory. Geometric scaling extends comb generation across 0.44 GHz to 2.1 GHz. Heterodyne measurements, analyzed using the modified Allan deviation (MDEV), establish a two-timescale law. The mechanism governs short-term stability: seeded combs inherit the white-phase-noise scaling of their pumps, whereas autonomous combs acquire the phase diffusion of a free-running oscillator, with the one-second MDEV increasing from 1e-11 to 1e-8. The material governs long-term stability: in air and without active thermal control, the temperature-compensated stack suppresses the random-walk drift that dominates uncompensated resonators. These results establish mechanism- and material-level design rules for operating a single resonator as chip-scale frequency infrastructure, from multi-clock generation to radiofrequency parallel processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了实际器件制备（“lithographically defined”）、测量（“Heterodyne measurements”）以及实验现象观测（“more than 170 lines”等），属于实验研究，并辅以理论对比（“in agreement with slow-flow bifurcation theory”）。；研究对象：铁电氧化铪锆（hafnia-zirconia）纳米机电谐振器，基于CMOS兼容氧化物构建，研究其中的相干声子频率梳（phononic frequency combs）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁电CMOS氧化物纳米机电谐振器中实现了宽带声子频率梳，通过2:1内共振的失谐调控可选择两种梳齿产生机制（双音注入波混频或自治Hopf分岔），分别产生超过170条和200条的相干梳齿线，并建立了由机制（短期稳定性）和材料（长期稳定性）共同决定的双时间尺度稳定性规律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁电CMOS氧化物纳米机电谐振器中实现了宽带声子频率梳，通过2:1内共振的失谐调控可选择两种梳齿产生机制（双音注入波混频或自治Hopf分岔），分别产生超过170条和200条的相干梳齿线，并建立了由机制（短期稳定性）和材料（长期稳定性）共同决定的双时间尺度稳定性规律。；创新点：首次在CMOS兼容的铁电氧化物纳米机电谐振器中实现宽带声子频率梳，将光学频率梳的概念拓展到射频/声子领域；通过几何缩放实现0.44–2.1 GHz的梳齿频率调谐；揭示了机制层面（种子注入 vs. 自治振荡）与材料层面（温度补偿）对频率稳定性的独立控制规律，为单谐振器作为芯片级频率基础设施提供了设计规则。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：微纳加工制备（光刻定义谐振器几何结构）、电学驱动与检测（双音注入波混频、自治振荡）、外差测量（heterodyne measurements）结合修正Allan方差（MDEV）分析频率稳定性；理论框架为慢流分岔理论（slow-flow bifurcation theory）用于解释自治梳齿的动力学路径（torus与周期倍增）。

papers.title: Giant staggered Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya vectors emerged in synthetic antiferromagnets with spatially alternating stress
papers.abstract: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction is a source of chiral magnetic physics, and it manifests microstructural symmetry which could link to exotic magnetic and electronic properties such as altermagnetism. For a new paradigm in magnetism and spintronics, it is crucial to have control on the DM interaction as well as ordering of the DM vectors which characterize the DM interaction. Here, we report on a strong interlayer DM interaction emerged in Co/Ru magnetic superlattices whose structural symmetry is unambiguously broken by alternating mechanical strains developed using the peculiar technique of our stress mechanism. Moreover, theoretical analyses reveal that our magnetic superlattices host a staggered order of the DM vectors. Our results indicate that the spatially varying strains with our breakthrough technique are quite effective in breaking the symmetry of the system and prove that it can control the DM interaction strength as well as the DM vector order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论分析）。判断依据：摘要提及“we report on”“developed using the peculiar technique of our stress mechanism”“theoretical analyses reveal”。；研究对象：Co/Ru 磁性超晶格（人造合成反铁磁体），重点研究其中由空间交替应力诱导产生的层间 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用及其 DM 矢量序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Co/Ru 磁性超晶格中，通过空间交替机械应变打破结构对称性，实现了强层间 DM 相互作用，并发现 DM 矢量呈交错（staggered）有序排列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Co/Ru 磁性超晶格中，通过空间交替机械应变打破结构对称性，实现了强层间 DM 相互作用，并发现 DM 矢量呈交错（staggered）有序排列。；创新点：首次在合成反铁磁 Co/Ru 超晶格中利用空间变化的应变（而非传统界面工程）有效打破结构对称性，实现对 DM 相互作用强度及其矢量序（交错序）的调控，为 DM 矢量序与交错磁（altermagnetism）等新奇物性的关联提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用作者自行发展的“应力机制”（stress mechanism）技术，对 Co/Ru 超晶格施加空间交替的机械应变；理论上通过分析揭示 DM 矢量的交错序。摘要未明确说明具体表征手段（如磁光克尔效应、布里渊光散射等）或理论计算方法（如第一性原理计算）。

papers.title: Chiral Tubular Magnonic Crystals with Periodic Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya Interaction
papers.abstract: We introduce a chiral tubular magnonic crystal formed by a ferromagnetic nanotube with a periodically modulated interfacial Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (DMI). Using a plane-wave formalism adapted to the cylindrical geometry, we calculate the spin-wave band structure including exchange, nonlocal dipolar coupling, and interfacial DMI. We show that the tubular geometry qualitatively modifies the role of periodic DMI compared with planar chiral magnonic crystals. Besides producing the usual nonreciprocal frequency shift, curvature converts part of the interfacial DMI into an effective anisotropy-like internal field. This creates a sign-dependent frequency landscape along the tube, so that DMI-covered regions can act either as potential wells or barriers for the lowest-frequency modes. As a result, flat and weakly dispersive bands appear in both Damon--Eshbach-like and backward-volume-like configurations, with the latter having no direct counterpart in planar systems. Our results identify periodically engineered DMI in nanotubes as a route for controlling nonreciprocal spin waves, localized modes, and flat magnonic bands in curved architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据：摘要提到“使用平面波形式”“计算自旋波能带结构”，属于理论建模与数值计算。；研究对象：具有周期性界面Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用（DMI）调制的铁磁纳米管，即手性管状磁子晶体。研究其自旋波能带、非互易传播、局域模及平带行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 管状几何会定性改变周期性DMI的作用：曲率将部分界面DMI转化为类似各向异性的有效内场，使DMI覆盖区域对低频模式表现为势阱或势垒，从而在Damon–Eshbach型和backward-volume型构型中均出现平带和弱色散带，后者在平面体系中无直接对应物。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：管状几何会定性改变周期性DMI的作用：曲率将部分界面DMI转化为类似各向异性的有效内场，使DMI覆盖区域对低频模式表现为势阱或势垒，从而在Damon–Eshbach型和backward-volume型构型中均出现平带和弱色散带，后者在平面体系中无直接对应物。；创新点：首次提出并研究具有周期性DMI的铁磁纳米管作为手性管状磁子晶体，揭示曲率诱导的DMI有效各向异性场及其对模式局域化和平带形成的独特作用，特别是backward-volume型平带在平面体系中不存在对应。
papers.method_zh: 采用适用于圆柱几何的平面波形式方法，计算包含交换作用、非局域偶极耦合和界面DMI的自旋波能带结构。

papers.title: Energy landscape and dissipation of sliding magnetic rotor arrays
papers.abstract: Magnetically coupled damped rotational degrees of freedom can give rise to tribological loss when excited by a relative sliding motion, linking friction to the dynamics of magnetic moments. We analytically investigate such magnetic friction by studying a recently introduced simplified model for a rigid magnetic rotor array sliding over a commensurate magnetic substrate. Here, the array rotors can rotate about an axis perpendicular to the sliding direction and are damped by microscopic shaft friction, while the substrate magnets have a fixed in-plane orientation. The simplified model reduces the collective rotor dynamics of this setup to a set of coupled nonlinear differential equations, which can be studied by the corresponding energy landscape in the quasi-static regime. We find that the parameter plane spanned by layer separation and time can be divided into distinct chambers, in which the structure of the energy landscape remains invariant. Using these chambers, we identify the layer separation intervals corresponding to different dynamical states and recover the emergence of a regime where the moment alignment alternates globally while exhibiting peak dissipation. Additionally, we derive the leading nontrivial orders of the collective magnetic friction in the regimes of small and large gaps between the array and the substrate. For the alternating regime, we find that friction can be computed by tracking energy jumps from unstable to stable critical points at the chamber boundaries. These results provide an analytical foundation for the observed dynamics and dissipation in sliding rotor arrays. Because the simplified model is scale-free, our conclusions transfer across a broad range of microscopic and macroscopic length scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“analytically investigate”“simplified model”“coupled nonlinear differential equations”“energy landscape”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：刚性磁转子阵列在共度磁性基底上滑动时的磁摩擦现象。具体体系为：转子可绕垂直于滑动方向的轴旋转，受微观轴摩擦阻尼；基底磁矩具有固定面内取向。研究聚焦于层间距与时间构成的参数平面内的动力学状态与耗散。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 层间距与时间参数平面可划分为若干“腔室”，每个腔室内能量景观结构不变；据此识别出不同动力学状态对应的层间距区间，并发现一种全局磁矩交替排列且耗散达到峰值的特殊状态。在小间距和大间距极限下，推导了集体磁摩擦的前导非平凡阶；在交替状态下，摩擦可通过追踪腔室边界处从不稳定到稳定临界点的能量跳跃来计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：层间距与时间参数平面可划分为若干“腔室”，每个腔室内能量景观结构不变；据此识别出不同动力学状态对应的层间距区间，并发现一种全局磁矩交替排列且耗散达到峰值的特殊状态。在小间距和大间距极限下，推导了集体磁摩擦的前导非平凡阶；在交替状态下，摩擦可通过追踪腔室边界处从不稳定到稳定临界点的能量跳跃来计算。；创新点：首次对滑动磁转子阵列的摩擦行为给出解析层面的系统描述，特别是通过能量景观的腔室结构统一解释了不同动力学状态及其转变，并建立了交替状态下摩擦与能量跳跃之间的定量联系。由于模型无特征尺度，结论可跨微观至宏观尺度迁移。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析理论框架：将刚性磁转子阵列的集体动力学约化为耦合非线性微分方程组，在准静态极限下通过能量景观分析研究其结构；利用腔室划分确定动力学状态；在大小间距极限下做微扰展开推导摩擦的解析表达式。

papers.title: Design and Modeling of the Charge Readout of a SiMOS Quantum Dot with a Single Electron Transistor and CryoCMOS
papers.abstract: Single electron spin qubits trapped in SiMOS quantum dots are a promising technology for scaling to thousand- or million-qubit systems due to their compatibility with mature CMOS manufacturing processes. A readout system that combines a single electron transistor with a custom cryogenic CMOS amplification and digitization chain offers key advantages by avoiding the use of bulky RF components or room-temperature interconnects. We present design techniques and simulation results for an optimized qubit-SET cryoCMOS interface, culminating in the design of the QNDR1 ASIC, the first cryogenic readout ASIC designed under the Quandarum project, which targets the development of a many-channel spin qubit based detector for use in high energy physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：工程设计/仿真类文章（关键词：design techniques, simulation results, ASIC design）。属于应用型工程研究，非纯实验或纯理论。；研究对象：SiMOS量子点中的单电子自旋量子比特，及其与单电子晶体管（SET）和低温CMOS（cryoCMOS）放大/数字化链路的集成读出系统。具体物理对象是量子点电荷态读出接口。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过优化量子比特-SET-cryoCMOS接口设计，成功实现了QNDR1 ASIC——Quandarum项目下首款低温读出专用集成电路，面向多通道自旋量子比特探测器（用于高能物理）的电荷读出需求。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过优化量子比特-SET-cryoCMOS接口设计，成功实现了QNDR1 ASIC——Quandarum项目下首款低温读出专用集成电路，面向多通道自旋量子比特探测器（用于高能物理）的电荷读出需求。；创新点：首次在Quandarum项目框架下设计出低温读出ASIC（QNDR1），避免了传统方案中笨重的射频元件和室温互连，实现了与CMOS工艺兼容的紧凑型多通道电荷读出方案。摘要未突出说明与现有SET读出方案相比的具体性能改进指标。
papers.method_zh: 电路设计技术与仿真模拟。具体包括：量子点-SET耦合接口的电路级优化设计，低温CMOS放大与数字化链路的仿真验证，以及ASIC（QNDR1）的完整设计流程。摘要未提及具体仿真工具或工艺节点。

papers.title: Revealing low-energy surfaces of multinary compounds by controlling surface coordination environments
papers.abstract: When modeling surfaces of multinary compounds, conventional cleavage planes often cut through strongly bonded polyhedra, resulting in unphysical surface energies. Here, we introduce SALAMI (Symmetric Atomic Layers for Arbitrary Multinary Interfaces), a Python package that generates symmetric, charge-neutral, dipole-free, and low-energy slab models for multinary compounds. SALAMI performs combinatorial searches to selectively remove surface atoms and generate corrugated terminations that preserve optimal coordination environments. We applied this workflow to all symmetrically inequivalent crystallographic orientations with Miller indices up to 2 for two prototypical structures: the solid-state electrolyte Li3PS4 and the transparent conducting oxide ZnSb2O6. Density functional theory calculations reveal that Li3PS4 must preserve all PS4 units to achieve the minimum surface energy. For ZnSb2O6, low-energy surfaces are achieved by partial undercoordination of surface Sb atoms to SbO5 or SbO4 from the bulk SbO6, depending on the surface orientations. Compared to surface models generated with unconstrained coordination, applying constraints to achieve optimal local coordination environments significantly lowers surface energies, shrinking the volume of the predicted Wulff shape by approximately 20%. Our results demonstrate that meticulous control of local coordination environments is necessary for accurately predicting the surface energetics of multinary compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Density functional theory calculations”（密度泛函理论计算），并开发了Python包（SALAMI）用于生成表面模型，属于计算材料学工作。；研究对象：多组分化合物（multinary compounds）的低能表面，具体以固态电解质Li₃PS₄和透明导电氧化物ZnSb₂O₆为原型体系，研究其不同晶体学取向的表面稳定性与表面配位环境的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过控制表面原子的局部配位环境（保留最优配位多面体），可以显著降低多组分化合物的表面能；对Li₃PS₄必须完整保留所有PS₄四面体单元，而对ZnSb₂O₆则允许表面Sb原子部分欠配位（形成SbO₅或SbO₄）以实现最低表面能。施加配位约束后，预测的Wulff形状体积缩小约20%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过控制表面原子的局部配位环境（保留最优配位多面体），可以显著降低多组分化合物的表面能；对Li₃PS₄必须完整保留所有PS₄四面体单元，而对ZnSb₂O₆则允许表面Sb原子部分欠配位（形成SbO₅或SbO₄）以实现最低表面能。施加配位约束后，预测的Wulff形状体积缩小约20%。；创新点：提出了一种系统生成多组分化合物低能表面模型的自动化方法（SALAMI），首次将“局部配位环境优化”作为显式约束引入表面建模流程，解决了传统解理面切断强键合多面体导致非物理表面能的问题。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 开发了Python包SALAMI（Symmetric Atomic Layers for Arbitrary Multinary Interfaces），通过组合搜索选择性移除表面原子，生成对称、电荷中性、无偶极矩且具有波纹状（corrugated）终止面的slab模型；结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算表面能，并对Miller指数≤2的所有对称不等价晶面进行系统搜索。

papers.title: Phase stability, charge ordering, and charge-liquid formation in the Falicov-Kimball model on triangular and kagome lattices
papers.abstract: We present a systematic investigation of the stability of the phase diagram of the spinless Falicov-Kimball model on two-dimensional non-bipartite lattices, the triangular and kagome lattices, using Markov-chain Monte Carlo simulations. Three filling or chemical potential conditions are examined: fixed chemical potentials ($μ_f = μ_c = U/2$), "generalized" half-filling ($\bar{n}_f = 1/3$, $\bar{n}_c = 2/3$), and conventional half-filling ($\bar{n}_f = \bar{n}_c = 1/2$). For each condition, the effects of a perturbatively small next-nearest-neighbor hopping are studied. On the triangular lattice, Anderson insulator, Mott insulator, and charge-density wave (CDW) phases are found in all cases, with the CDW driven by Coulomb-interaction-mediated nesting. Evidence for a charge-liquid regime is found in the region between the weakly correlated regime and the CDW, characterized by competing charge-ordering wavevectors and the absence of universal scaling behavior, whose extent shrinks progressively from the grand-canonical to the conventional half-filling condition. On the kagome lattice, the CDW phase is completely absent; instead, an insulating ground state, plausibly of the Mott type, is found, with signatures of a possible quantum phase transition at zero temperature. Our results establish the crucial role of lattice geometry and particle-hole symmetry breaking in shaping the phase diagram of correlated electron systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用Markov-chain Monte Carlo模拟进行系统性研究。；研究对象：二维非二分格点（三角格与kagome格）上的无自旋Falicov-Kimball模型，重点关注相稳定性、电荷有序及电荷液体形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三角格上，所有填充条件下均出现Anderson绝缘体、Mott绝缘体和电荷密度波（CDW）相，并在弱关联区与CDW之间发现电荷液体区域的证据；在kagome格上CDW完全缺失，取而代之的是可能的Mott型绝缘基态，并存在零温量子相变的迹象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三角格上，所有填充条件下均出现Anderson绝缘体、Mott绝缘体和电荷密度波（CDW）相，并在弱关联区与CDW之间发现电荷液体区域的证据；在kagome格上CDW完全缺失，取而代之的是可能的Mott型绝缘基态，并存在零温量子相变的迹象。；创新点：系统揭示了晶格几何（三角 vs. kagome）和粒子-空穴对称性破缺对关联电子体系相图的决定性作用，特别是在非二分格点上发现电荷液体区域及其随填充条件的演化，以及kagome格上CDW的完全缺失——这些结果突出了非二分格点体系中几何阻挫对电荷有序的抑制效应。
papers.method_zh: 采用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（Markov-chain Monte Carlo）模拟，考察三种填充/化学势条件（固定化学势μ_f=μ_c=U/2、广义半填充n̄_f=1/3, n̄_c=2/3、常规半填充n̄_f=n̄_c=1/2），并研究微扰性次近邻跳跃的影响。

papers.title: Regularization of Vortex Core Size in Photon BECs due to Harmonic Trap: An Analytical Approach
papers.abstract: Quantized vortices are a hallmark of superfluidity. However, in a photon Bose--Einstein condensate, the photon-photon interaction is so weak that in a homogeneous system the healing length exceeds the experimentally achievable size of the condensate itself. Here we show that a harmonic confinement regularizes the vortex size to experimentally achievable scales. Moreover, such an external confinement closely resembles the standard experimental setup of a pumped dye-filled microcavity. We model the condensate via a complex Gross--Pitaevskii equation and obtain an approximate dynamical single-vortex solution by applying the recently proposed projection optimization method. The latter generalizes the variational approach of closed systems to open-dissipative systems without assuming a specific form for the condensate phase. The radial photon flow, which is characteristic for driven-dissipative systems, yields a definition of the vortex core size based on the competition of gain and loss. However, this condition reproduces the heuristic closed system definition now based on physical grounds. A subsequent linear stability analysis shows that interaction, as well as pumping and loss can drive the system to an unstable regime. In this way one can fundamentally distinguish between closed and open-dissipative systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical approach、complex Gross–Pitaevskii equation、projection optimization method、linear stability analysis。；研究对象：光子玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体（photon BEC）中的量子化涡旋，特别是谐波囚禁势下涡旋核心尺寸的调控，以及开放耗散（驱动–耗散）体系中的涡旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 谐波囚禁势可将光子BEC中原本超过体系尺寸的涡旋愈合长度（核心尺寸）正则化到实验可观测的尺度；基于增益与损耗竞争可定义涡旋核心尺寸，且该定义在物理上复现了闭系统启发式定义。线性稳定性分析表明，相互作用、泵浦和损耗均可驱动系统进入不稳定区，从而在原则上区分闭系统与开放耗散系统。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：谐波囚禁势可将光子BEC中原本超过体系尺寸的涡旋愈合长度（核心尺寸）正则化到实验可观测的尺度；基于增益与损耗竞争可定义涡旋核心尺寸，且该定义在物理上复现了闭系统启发式定义。线性稳定性分析表明，相互作用、泵浦和损耗均可驱动系统进入不稳定区，从而在原则上区分闭系统与开放耗散系统。；创新点：将投影优化方法首次应用于光子BEC涡旋问题，无需假设相位形式即可处理开放耗散系统中的涡旋解；从增益–损耗竞争出发给出了涡旋核心尺寸的物理解释，并揭示了开放耗散系统与闭系统在稳定性行为上的本质区别。
papers.method_zh: 采用复Gross–Pitaevskii方程描述凝聚体，应用近期提出的投影优化方法（projection optimization method）获得近似的动力学单涡旋解；该方法将闭系统的变分方法推广到开放耗散系统，且无需预先假定凝聚体相位形式；随后进行线性稳定性分析。

papers.title: Engineering Excitons through Polymorphism and Dimensional Confinement in Low-Dimensional Tellurium
papers.abstract: The interplay between dimensionality, band-edge electronic structure, and electron-hole interactions governs the optical response of low-dimensional tellurium, yet the microscopic origin of its excitonic behavior remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the quasiparticle, excitonic, and optical properties of two-dimensional tellurium polymorphs and one-dimensional helical nanowires using many-body GW and the Bethe--Salpeter equation. Our results reveal a strong dependence of the excitonic response on band-edge dispersion, crystal symmetry, and dimensional confinement. $α$-tellurene exhibits comparatively weak and spatially extended electron-hole correlations, whereas the SOC-induced quasi-flat band-edge states of $β$-tellurene give rise to a strongly bound and anisotropic near-infrared exciton. Momentum-resolved BSE eigenvectors and real-space exciton wave functions directly reveal the contrasting localization and anisotropy of these excitonic states. Remarkably, hydrogen-passivated hexagonal tellurene, previously identified as a quantum spin Hall phase with $Z_2=1$, supports an even larger direct exciton binding energy of 0.51 eV together with a compact and nearly isotropic in-plane excitonic distribution. This demonstrates that strong electron-hole correlations are fully compatible with nontrivial band topology, while the binding strength and spatial character of the exciton remain strongly dependent on the underlying band-edge electronic structure and crystal symmetry. The one-dimensional helical nanowire represents the strong-confinement limit, exhibiting a direct high exciton binding energy and a pronounced shift of the optical response toward the ultraviolet.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到使用“many-body GW and the Bethe–Salpeter equation”（多体GW方法及Bethe–Salpeter方程）进行第一性原理计算。；研究对象：低维碲（tellurium）体系，包括二维碲的多晶型（α-tellurene、β-tellurene、氢钝化六方碲烯）以及一维螺旋纳米线，重点研究其激子（exciton）行为与光响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低维碲的激子性质强烈依赖于能带边缘色散、晶体对称性和维度限制：α-tellurene中电子-空穴关联较弱且空间延展，β-tellurene中自旋-轨道耦合诱导的准平带边缘态产生强束缚且各向异性的近红外激子，而氢钝化六方碲烯（量子自旋霍尔相，Z₂=1）具有高达0.51 eV的直接激子结合能且空间分布紧凑近各向同性，一维螺旋纳米线则呈现强束缚激子并将光响应显著移至紫外区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低维碲的激子性质强烈依赖于能带边缘色散、晶体对称性和维度限制：α-tellurene中电子-空穴关联较弱且空间延展，β-tellurene中自旋-轨道耦合诱导的准平带边缘态产生强束缚且各向异性的近红外激子，而氢钝化六方碲烯（量子自旋霍尔相，Z₂=1）具有高达0.51 eV的直接激子结合能且空间分布紧凑近各向同性，一维螺旋纳米线则呈现强束缚激子并将光响应显著移至紫外区。；创新点：首次系统揭示了低维碲不同晶型与维度下激子行为与能带拓扑、晶体对称性及维度限制之间的微观关联，特别是证明了强电子-空穴关联与非平庸能带拓扑（量子自旋霍尔相）可以共存，且激子结合强度与空间特征仍由能带边缘电子结构决定。
papers.method_zh: 基于多体微扰理论的第一性原理计算：GW近似（用于准粒子能带结构）结合Bethe–Salpeter方程（用于激子与光学性质），并利用动量分辨的BSE本征矢和实空间激子波函数分析激子局域化与各向异性。

papers.title: Superconductivity and Magnetism in Bi-Ni System: From Bulk to Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Unconventional superconductivity with ingredients of magnetism such as time reversal breaking, triplet pairing and proximity effects has been a long time pursued topic in physics and material science as a new source of innovative phenomena and effects to drive further scientific advances and technologies. The Bi-Ni system has emerged as a convenient candidate for the investigation of such phenomenology. Strictly speaking, the term Bi-Ni system refers to two different schemes, first to the NiBi$_{3}$ intermetallic compound, a 4 K superconductor in which a complex magnetism seems to govern electrical properties in the normal phase, but without implication in the superconducting properties. The second Bi-Ni system is not quite a material but a heterostructure formed by a bilayer of Bi and Ni. Here the superconducting phase has to steal the spotlight by showing strong evidence of time-reversal breaking and triplet pairing featuring a complex unconventional state. The ease of preparing the samples, compared to other candidates for such unconventionality, usually Uranium-based compounds, has accelerated the research in this system. Here, we went through a detailed review of the main results about the electronic properties of these two systems as well as a discussion of the main open questions to be solved in order to reach the complete understanding in this topic.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。判断依据：摘要中明确出现“we went through a detailed review of the main results”。；研究对象：Bi-Ni 体系中的超导电性与磁性，具体包括两种方案：(1) NiBi₃ 金属间化合物（4 K 超导体，正常态存在复杂磁性）；(2) Bi/Ni 双层异质结构（表现出时间反演对称性破缺和自旋三重态配对迹象）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Bi-Ni 体系为研究非常规超导电性（含磁性成分、时间反演破缺、三重态配对及邻近效应）提供了便捷平台：NiBi₃ 中磁性仅影响正常态电输运而不参与超导；Bi/Ni 异质结则呈现强时间反演破缺与三重态配对的复杂非常规超导态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Bi-Ni 体系为研究非常规超导电性（含磁性成分、时间反演破缺、三重态配对及邻近效应）提供了便捷平台：NiBi₃ 中磁性仅影响正常态电输运而不参与超导；Bi/Ni 异质结则呈现强时间反演破缺与三重态配对的复杂非常规超导态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其价值在于系统梳理 Bi-Ni 体系（块材与异质结）的非常规超导证据，并指出该体系相比铀基化合物更易制备，从而加速了相关研究进程。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验或计算手段，仅提及“样品制备简便”（相对于铀基化合物），并指出该综述涵盖电子性质的主要结果及待解决的关键问题。具体方法（如输运测量、极化中子反射、点接触谱等）摘要未给出。

papers.title: Direct Evidence of Unconventional Superconductivity in Doped Kagome system RV$_3$Sb$_5$
papers.abstract: The superconducting pairing symmetry of kagome metals remains a central unresolved question largely because phase-sensitive experiments capable of distinguishing between different possible order parameters have been difficult to implement. The spatial and energetic characteristics of impurity bound states measured by spectroscopic-imaging scanning tunneling microscopy encode information on the superconducting order parameter. Here, we use impurity-bound state spectroscopy to investigate optimally doped RbV$_3$Sb$_{5}$ where the charge-density wave instability is fully suppressed. We find that the superconducting state is fully gapped and exhibits two distinct energy scales, consistent with a multiband order parameter. Atomic-scale spectroscopy around nonmagnetic defects reveals pronounced particle-hole asymmetric bound states. Comparison with theoretical calculations demonstrates that these bound states are incompatible with conventional $s$-wave and sign-changing $s^{\pm}$ pairing. Our calculations also show that the data are fully consistent with a chiral order parameter. Our results establish impurity-bound-state spectroscopy as a powerful phase-sensitive probe of superconductivity in kagome materials and provide strong evidence that optimally doped RbV$_3$Sb$_{5}$ realizes a fully gapped chiral superconducting state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“spectroscopic-imaging scanning tunneling microscopy”（光谱成像扫描隧道显微镜）进行测量，属于实验手段。；研究对象：掺杂Kagome体系RbV₃Sb₅（最优掺杂，电荷密度波被完全抑制），具体研究其超导配对对称性及杂质束缚态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最优掺杂RbV₃Sb₅的超导态为全能隙（fully gapped）且具有两个不同能量尺度，对应多带序参量；非磁缺陷周围出现粒子-空穴不对称的束缚态，与常规s波和符号反转s±配对不相容，但与手性（chiral）序参量完全一致，表明该体系实现全能隙手性超导态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最优掺杂RbV₃Sb₅的超导态为全能隙（fully gapped）且具有两个不同能量尺度，对应多带序参量；非磁缺陷周围出现粒子-空穴不对称的束缚态，与常规s波和符号反转s±配对不相容，但与手性（chiral）序参量完全一致，表明该体系实现全能隙手性超导态。；创新点：首次将杂质束缚态光谱确立为Kagome超导体中具有相位敏感性的探测手段，并直接排除了常规s波和s±配对，为手性超导态提供了强实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 光谱成像扫描隧道显微镜（spectroscopic-imaging STM）测量杂质束缚态的空间与能量特征，并结合理论计算进行对比分析。

papers.title: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy of graphene nanogaps
papers.abstract: Graphene nanogaps represent an emerging platform for nanoscale electrochemical and sensing devices, with potential applications in next-generation biomolecular sequencing. However, their interfacial behavior in aqueous environments remains poorly characterized, particularly with respect to frequency-dependent impedance and charge transport mechanisms at the graphene edge. We fabricate graphene nanogaps by controlled electrical breakdown in an inert atmosphere and study their electrochemical response. Upon exposure to ambient conditions, a surface contamination layer supports electrochemical activity within an adsorbed ultrathin conductive film between the graphene edges. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy reveals distinct frequency-dependent responses consistent with a Warburg element associated with diffusion in this confined interfacial film. The impedance evolves systematically with liquid $\mathrm{p}H$, reflecting changes in electrochemical reaction-diffusion processes at the graphene edges. A quantitative equivalent-circuit model captures these effects and enables extraction of an effective nanogap length scale from impedance spectra, providing information complementary to that obtained from tunneling measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We fabricate...”“Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy reveals...”“A quantitative equivalent-circuit model captures...”，涉及器件制备、实验测量与等效电路建模。；研究对象：石墨烯纳米间隙（graphene nanogaps）在水环境中的界面电化学行为，特别是石墨烯边缘处的频率相关阻抗与电荷传输机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 石墨烯纳米间隙在暴露于环境后，其边缘间会形成一层吸附的超薄导电污染膜，该膜内的扩散过程主导了电化学阻抗的频率响应（表现为Warburg元件特征），且阻抗随液体pH值系统演化，反映了边缘处电化学反应-扩散过程的改变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：石墨烯纳米间隙在暴露于环境后，其边缘间会形成一层吸附的超薄导电污染膜，该膜内的扩散过程主导了电化学阻抗的频率响应（表现为Warburg元件特征），且阻抗随液体pH值系统演化，反映了边缘处电化学反应-扩散过程的改变。；创新点：首次对石墨烯纳米间隙在水环境中的频率相关电化学阻抗进行系统表征，并利用Warburg扩散元件定量描述受限界面膜内的传输过程，实现了从阻抗谱中提取纳米间隙几何信息，与隧穿测量形成互补。
papers.method_zh: 在惰性气氛中通过受控电击穿（controlled electrical breakdown）制备石墨烯纳米间隙；使用电化学阻抗谱（EIS）测量频率相关响应；结合定量等效电路模型（equivalent-circuit model）拟合阻抗谱，提取有效纳米间隙长度尺度。

papers.title: Domain walls with alternating magnetic order in a model with dipolar coupling
papers.abstract: A model for a one-dimensional chain of elongated nano-scale magnetic islands with dipole interactions is analyzed here for the properties of its static domain walls with site-by-site alternating order. The anisotropic magnetic islands on a nonmagnetic substrate have their longer axes oriented transverse ($y$-direction) to the chain direction ($x$-direction), in a transverse applied magnetic field. The islands' magnetic dipoles $\vecμ_n$ are represented as macrospins of fixed length $μ$. The nearest-neighbor (NN) dipole interactions drive transverse alternating order, allowing for doubly-degenerate, uniform, static, $y$-alternating states, where the dipoles alternately point transverse to the chain direction, as in $\vecμ_n = \pm(-1)^n μ\hat{y}$. Assuming only NN interactions, the domain walls connecting these two alternating states are found with numerical relaxation simulations and analyzed in a two-sublattice continuum theory. As the uniaxial anisotropy constant $K_1$ descends from larger values until it closely approaches the NN dipolar coupling constant $D$, the domain wall width grows indefinitely, and the large-$x$ continuum solutions closely approach the lattice numerical solutions. The applied field produces a very slight canting of the dipoles towards the field, maximum in the center of the domain wall. The dipoles on the two sublattices are found to rotate in {\em opposite senses} as one scans along the lattice, resulting in a large longitudinal magnetic moment of the domain wall. A much smaller transverse magnetic moment has a topological contribution that depends on whether the chain length is odd or even.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analyzed here for the properties”（理论分析）、“found with numerical relaxation simulations”（数值弛豫模拟）以及“analyzed in a two-sublattice continuum theory”（双子格连续统理论）。；研究对象：一维链状排列的纳米尺度细长磁性岛屿（elongated nano-scale magnetic islands）体系，其磁偶极子（macrospins）在横向（y方向）外加磁场下，通过最近邻偶极相互作用形成横向交替磁序。具体研究的物理现象是连接两种简并交替磁序的静态畴壁（domain walls）的性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在仅考虑最近邻偶极相互作用时，连接两种简并交替磁序的畴壁宽度会随着单轴各向异性常数 $K_1$ 趋近于最近邻偶极耦合常数 $D$ 而无限增大；畴壁中心处偶极子沿外场方向有轻微倾斜，且两个子格的偶极子在沿链扫描时旋转方向相反，导致畴壁具有较大的纵向磁矩，而较小的横向磁矩则包含一个依赖于链长奇偶性的拓扑贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在仅考虑最近邻偶极相互作用时，连接两种简并交替磁序的畴壁宽度会随着单轴各向异性常数 $K_1$ 趋近于最近邻偶极耦合常数 $D$ 而无限增大；畴壁中心处偶极子沿外场方向有轻微倾斜，且两个子格的偶极子在沿链扫描时旋转方向相反，导致畴壁具有较大的纵向磁矩，而较小的横向磁矩则包含一个依赖于链长奇偶性的拓扑贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其新意在于：针对具有偶极相互作用的交替磁序体系，系统研究了畴壁宽度发散行为及其与各向异性常数的关系，并揭示了畴壁中两个子格反向旋转导致的纵向磁矩以及横向磁矩的拓扑奇偶效应。
papers.method_zh: 数值弛豫模拟（numerical relaxation simulations）用于求解晶格模型；双子格连续统理论（two-sublattice continuum theory）用于解析分析大尺度行为；两种方法的结果进行了对比验证。

papers.title: Benchtop Momentum-Resolved Phonon Spectroscopy: Unlocking Lattice Dynamics via X-ray Diffuse Scattering
papers.abstract: Momentum-resolved phonon spectroscopy is essential for understanding the thermal, electronic, and structural properties of materials, yet it traditionally necessitates access to large-scale synchrotron or neutron facilities. We report a paradigm shift by demonstrating the accurate measurement and quantitative analysis of Thermal Diffuse Scattering (TDS) patterns using a commercially available benchtop Small/Wide-Angle X-ray Scattering (SAXS/WAXS) instrument. By utilizing a low-energy (8 keV) X-ray source and a custom-integrated vacuum geometry, we acquired characteristic TDS patterns in silicon (111) and (100) slabs. We demonstrate that these benchtop images contain sufficient information to extract interatomic force constants (IFCs) through global optimization algorithms, achieving a fitting accuracy comparable to those obtained from simulated data with statistical noise. Crucially, this capability provides access to phonon information across the entire Brillouin Zone, a critical component of lattice dynamics unavailable via standard laboratory techniques like first-order Raman spectroscopy. This low-barrier approach makes synchrotron-level lattice dynamics characterization accessible to virtually any research laboratory, enabling new avenues for the study of intrinsic strain and anisotropic lattice dynamics in emerging material systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了使用商用台式SAXS/WAXS仪器进行实际测量，并强调“demonstrating the accurate measurement and quantitative analysis”。；研究对象：硅（Si）单晶的（111）和（100）晶面，具体物理现象为热漫散射（TDS）所反映的晶格动力学（声子色散）信息。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用低能X射线源的台式SAXS/WAXS仪器即可准确测量并定量分析热漫散射图样，从中提取的原子间力常数（IFCs）精度可与含统计噪声的模拟数据相当，从而在无需同步辐射或中子源的情况下获得全布里渊区的声子信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用低能X射线源的台式SAXS/WAXS仪器即可准确测量并定量分析热漫散射图样，从中提取的原子间力常数（IFCs）精度可与含统计噪声的模拟数据相当，从而在无需同步辐射或中子源的情况下获得全布里渊区的声子信息。；创新点：首次证明台式（非同步辐射）X射线散射仪器即可实现动量分辨的声子谱学测量，将原本依赖大科学装置的晶格动力学表征能力普及到常规实验室，并覆盖整个布里渊区（这是普通实验室一阶拉曼光谱无法实现的）。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用商用台式小角/广角X射线散射（SAXS/WAXS）仪器，使用8 keV低能X射线源，并定制集成真空几何构型；数据分析上通过全局优化算法从TDS图样中提取原子间力常数（IFCs）。

papers.title: Floquet engineering of competing antiferromagnetism and $d$-wave superconductivity on the square lattice
papers.abstract: We propose a driven Lieb--Hubbard quantum simulator whose prethermal dynamics realize a square-lattice spin-1/2 fermion model with independently tunable repulsive on-site and attractive bond interactions. Periodically modulating the charge-transfer offset between the site ($d$) and bond ($p$) orbitals of the Lieb lattice brings a $p$-orbital doublon energetically close to a pair in the $d$ manifold while keeping all $p$-orbital singlons off resonance, thereby creating a synthetic ``negative-$U$'' center on a Lieb-lattice bond site. Two controlled eliminations then generate a compact bond attraction in the reduced $d$-only model on the square lattice, despite the microscopic repulsion in the $p$ orbital. The resulting interaction $J$ is tunable independently of the Hubbard repulsion $U_d$ on the $d$ orbitals, while interference between photon-assisted paths provides access to an intermediate-coupling regime in which $J$ and $U_d$ are both comparable to the effective hopping. At half filling, a mean-field calculation in this regime finds adjacent antiferromagnetic and $d$-wave superconducting phases, as well as narrow coexistence regions, suggesting close competition between these orders. We discuss the branch-preparation, prethermal, and higher-band conditions required to translate the formal construction into an optical-lattice protocol. More broadly, our work identifies a structural similarity between Floquet systems and electron-phonon problems that may guide the design of novel quantum-simulation protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We propose”“a mean-field calculation”等表述，属于理论建模与解析/数值计算研究，未涉及实验数据。；研究对象：Lieb-Hubbard量子模拟器中的二维正方格子自旋-1/2费米子模型，具体研究该体系中反铁磁序与d波超导序之间的竞争关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过周期驱动Lieb晶格，可在正方格子上实现可独立调控的排斥型Hubbard相互作用与吸引型键相互作用，在半填充下平均场计算发现相邻的反铁磁相和d波超导相，以及窄的共存区域，表明两种序之间存在密切竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过周期驱动Lieb晶格，可在正方格子上实现可独立调控的排斥型Hubbard相互作用与吸引型键相互作用，在半填充下平均场计算发现相邻的反铁磁相和d波超导相，以及窄的共存区域，表明两种序之间存在密切竞争。；创新点：首次提出在Lieb-Hubbard量子模拟器中通过Floquet驱动实现“负U”中心，从而在正方格子上产生可独立于Hubbard排斥U_d调控的紧凑键吸引相互作用；并指出Floquet系统与电子-声子问题之间存在结构性相似性，可能指导新型量子模拟协议的设计。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为Floquet工程（周期驱动）结合两次受控消除（controlled eliminations）的微扰论方法，用于推导约化d轨道有效模型；在半填充下采用平均场计算（mean-field calculation）求解相图。摘要未提及具体数值算法细节。

papers.title: Determinant Quantum-Quantum Monte Carlo: Coherent Auxiliary-Field Sampling
papers.abstract: We introduce determinant quantum-quantum Monte Carlo (DQ$^2$MC), a quantum algorithm that lifts the auxiliary-field sampling and averaging at the operational core of determinant quantum Monte Carlo onto a quantum computer. A determinant oracle synthesizes the DQMC amplitudes directly from a block encoding of the single-particle action matrix via quantum singular value transformations, so that the exponentially many Hubbard-Stratonovich weights are never enumerated, precomputed, or stored. Since the fermions are free for fixed auxiliary fields, the construction operates entirely at the single-particle level, requiring $O(\log N_{\mathrm{st}})$ system qubits and no Jordan-Wigner or Bravyi-Kitaev encoding, where $N_{\mathrm{st}}$ is the space-time volume. A full-quantum protocol makes observables interference amplitudes, eliminating the Markov chain and its autocorrelation time altogether; a hybrid quantum-classical protocol retains a constant-size active block of qubits and replaces the Metropolis-Hastings acceptance step with an exact heat-bath draw, so that cluster updates of any size are rejection-free, and passes only classical information between updates, admitting parallel tempering and distributed execution across quantum processors. The circuit-depth scales more favorably with spatial volume than classical DQMC, at the price of a post-selection overhead determined exactly by the largest target probability --- polynomial for smooth distributions, exponential for sharply peaked ones. Finally, the reweighting estimator underlying the fermion sign problem maps exactly onto a quantum weak value, placing the exponential cost of sign-problematic DQMC in precise correspondence with the post-selection overhead of weak-value extraction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/算法文章。关键词：quantum algorithm、quantum singular value transformations、protocol、circuit-depth。；研究对象：量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）算法在量子计算机上的实现，具体针对行列式量子蒙特卡洛（DQMC）中的辅助场采样与平均过程，以及费米符号问题（fermion sign problem）的映射。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种名为行列式量子-量子蒙特卡洛（DQ$^2$MC）的量子算法，将DQMC的辅助场采样与平均过程提升到量子计算机上执行，完全避免枚举指数多个Hubbard-Stratonovich权重，并消除马尔可夫链及其自相关时间。同时证明费米符号问题的重加权估计子精确映射为量子弱值（quantum weak value），其指数代价与弱值提取的后选择开销精确对应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种名为行列式量子-量子蒙特卡洛（DQ$^2$MC）的量子算法，将DQMC的辅助场采样与平均过程提升到量子计算机上执行，完全避免枚举指数多个Hubbard-Stratonovich权重，并消除马尔可夫链及其自相关时间。同时证明费米符号问题的重加权估计子精确映射为量子弱值（quantum weak value），其指数代价与弱值提取的后选择开销精确对应。；创新点：首次将DQMC的辅助场采样与平均过程整体映射到量子计算机上，无需Jordan-Wigner或Bravyi-Kitaev编码，仅需$O(\log N_{\mathrm{st}})$个系统量子比特（$N_{\mathrm{st}}$为时空体积）；并首次将费米符号问题的指数代价与量子弱值提取的后选择开销建立精确对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 量子算法设计：利用量子奇异值变换（quantum singular value transformations）从单粒子作用量矩阵的块编码（block encoding）中直接合成DQMC振幅（行列式预言机）。提出全量子协议（观测量为干涉振幅，无马尔可夫链）和混合量子-经典协议（保留常数大小活跃量子比特块，用精确热浴抽取替代Metropolis-Hastings接受步骤，实现无拒绝簇更新，支持并行回火与分布式执行）。电路深度随空间体积的标度优于经典DQMC，代价是后选择开销（由最大目标概率决定：光滑分布为多项式，尖锐峰值为指数）。

papers.title: Fractal Confinement and Magnetic Self-sabotage of Current Flow: Electrons Near the Metal-insulator Crossover in a 2D $δ$-layer
papers.abstract: We study low-$T$ transport and itinerant magnetism in 2D $δ$-doped semiconductors. Large-scale Hartree-Fock calculations with random hoppings and repulsion $U_0$ reveal two transport regimes near a critical density. The conductivity $σ(T)$ initially increases as $T$ drops below $U_0 / 10$. However, at $T \sim U_0/100$, a tiny density of magnetic moments forms, driving an insulating downturn. Fractal wavefunctions locally amplify magnetic interactions, initially concentrating currents into branched filaments, but ultimately choking them off via dynamic SU(2) symmetry breaking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Large-scale Hartree-Fock calculations with random hoppings and repulsion \(U_0\)”，属于数值计算方法。；研究对象：二维δ掺杂半导体中的低温柔性输运与巡游磁性，重点研究金属-绝缘体临界点附近的电子行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界密度附近存在两个输运区域：低温下电导率先随温度降低而增大，但当温度降至 \(U_0/100\) 量级时，极低密度的磁矩形成并导致绝缘性电导下降。分形波函数局域放大磁相互作用，使电流先汇聚为分支状细丝，最终通过动态SU(2)对称性破缺完全阻断电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界密度附近存在两个输运区域：低温下电导率先随温度降低而增大，但当温度降至 \(U_0/100\) 量级时，极低密度的磁矩形成并导致绝缘性电导下降。分形波函数局域放大磁相互作用，使电流先汇聚为分支状细丝，最终通过动态SU(2)对称性破缺完全阻断电流。；创新点：揭示了分形波函数对磁相互作用的局域放大效应，以及电流从分支细丝传导到完全阻断的演化机制，并将这一过程与动态SU(2)对称性破缺联系起来。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 大规模Hartree-Fock计算，包含随机跳跃（random hoppings）和库仑排斥项 \(U_0\)，研究二维δ掺杂体系中的输运和磁性。

papers.title: Statistical Properties of a Fluctuation-Driven Nanomechanical Duffing Resonator
papers.abstract: We investigate the fluctuating nonlinear dynamics of multiple modes of a nanomechanical doubly clamped beam resonator. Each mode is driven by Gaussian force noise centered around the resonance; the mode response is monitored while the force magnitude is increased, inducing a transition from harmonic to the nonlinear Duffing regime. To characterize the dynamics, we introduce an effective temperature based on the mode fluctuation amplitude. As the nonlinearity becomes prominent at large amplitudes, we observe a reduction in the effective thermal energy and a crossover in response statistics from Gaussian to platykurtic, consistent with the dynamics expected in a Duffing potential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了对纳米机械谐振器的实际测量（“monitored while the force magnitude is increased”），涉及驱动、响应监测和统计测量。；研究对象：双钳位纳米机械梁谐振器的多个振动模式，在随机力噪声驱动下的非线性（Duffing）动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着驱动力增大，系统从谐波响应过渡到非线性Duffing区，有效热能量降低，响应统计从高斯分布转变为尖峰态（platykurtic）分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着驱动力增大，系统从谐波响应过渡到非线性Duffing区，有效热能量降低，响应统计从高斯分布转变为尖峰态（platykurtic）分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于将“有效温度”概念用于描述噪声驱动的非线性纳米机械谐振器，并首次观察到统计分布从高斯到尖峰态的交叉行为（摘要未明确说明是否为首个观测，故保守表述）。
papers.method_zh: 实验上对每个模式施加中心频率附近的Gaussian力噪声驱动，逐步增大驱动力幅度，同时监测模式响应；引入基于模式涨落幅度的有效温度来表征动力学。

papers.title: Emergent hydrodynamic response and dynamical backreaction: Magnon bound-state propagation in a Bose-Hubbard fluid
papers.abstract: We study the nonequilibrium response of a one-dimensional Bose-Hubbard medium to a two-magnon bound state propagating along an attractive XXZ chain. A Holstein-type displacement coupling makes the magnon density act both as a local chemical-potential perturbation and as a source of bosons. We derive a long-wavelength hydrodynamic description of the density and phase fluctuations and test it against matrix-product-state simulations of the full coupled dynamics. The theory predicts a comoving near-field deformation together with retarded density waves confined to a sound cone. In the Mott regime, the deformation remains localized around the moving pair. In the compressible regime, two counterpropagating fronts detach and approach the semiclassical sound velocity, recovered from the equilibrium density with no fitted parameters. The coupling also induces a dynamical backreaction that slows the bound state and broadens its magnon-density profile. The comparison delimits where hydrodynamics stays quantitative once the probe reacts back on the medium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：hydrodynamic description（流体力学描述）、matrix-product-state simulations（矩阵乘积态模拟）、derived、predicts。；研究对象：一维Bose-Hubbard介质中沿吸引性XXZ链传播的双磁振子束缚态的非平衡响应，涉及Holstein型位移耦合导致的磁振子密度与玻色子之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该耦合体系在长波长下表现出流体力学响应：束缚态周围形成共动近场形变，并伴随限制在声锥内的延迟密度波。在可压缩区，两个反向传播的前沿以无拟合参数恢复的半经典声速运动；同时动力学反作用会减慢束缚态并展宽其磁振子密度分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该耦合体系在长波长下表现出流体力学响应：束缚态周围形成共动近场形变，并伴随限制在声锥内的延迟密度波。在可压缩区，两个反向传播的前沿以无拟合参数恢复的半经典声速运动；同时动力学反作用会减慢束缚态并展宽其磁振子密度分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但明确展示了流体力学描述在探针（束缚态）对介质产生反作用时仍能保持定量有效的适用范围。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导长波长流体力学描述（密度与相位涨落），并用矩阵乘积态（MPS）模拟对完整耦合动力学进行数值验证。

papers.title: Charge-State Dependence of Electronic Excitations in keV Ions Transmitted Through Solids Probed by Ion-Photon Coincidence Measurements
papers.abstract: Investigating the electronic excitations caused by light keV ions in matter contributes to a better understanding of materials modification such as space weathering or plasma-wall interactions in fusion reactors as well as improved materials analysis methods such as low or medium energy ion scattering. This study investigates the dependence of specific excitations in keV He projectiles, the most common projectile employed in these analytical methods, on the kinetic energy of the ion. We report on photon emission at energies >10eV emitted by projectiles excited upon transmission through different sample systems. We separate exit charge states and report on measurements of ion-photon pairs in coincidence, i.e. we can link a photon to the specific ion emitting it. From these measurements we extracted charge state resolved photon yields and obtained a deep insight into the electronic excitation occurring. Our results show that the electronic excitation of the helium projectile is largely material independent and rising strongly with the kinetic energy of the projectile. The photon yields are in good agreement with a common excitation model initially developed for beam foil spectroscopy. We hence extend the validity of this model to higher photon energies and different sample materials. We further provide a detailed analysis of the employed coincidence approach and necessary corrections to the raw data, as the methodology has a broad applicability in fundamental research and materials analysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“ion-photon coincidence measurements”（离子-光子符合测量）、“photon emission”等实验手段。；研究对象：keV能量范围内氦（He）离子在穿过不同固体样品时引发的电子激发过程，具体关注激发态He离子发射能量>10 eV的光子行为，以及出射电荷态与光子发射的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: He弹丸的电子激发在很大程度上与材料无关，且随弹丸动能增加而显著增强；测得的光子产额与最初为束箔光谱学发展的通用激发模型高度吻合，将该模型的适用性扩展至更高光子能量和不同样品材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：He弹丸的电子激发在很大程度上与材料无关，且随弹丸动能增加而显著增强；测得的光子产额与最初为束箔光谱学发展的通用激发模型高度吻合，将该模型的适用性扩展至更高光子能量和不同样品材料。；创新点：首次在keV He离子穿透固体的实验中，通过离子-光子符合测量实现电荷态分辨的光子产额提取，并将束箔光谱学激发模型的适用范围从传统低能光子区域扩展至更高光子能量（>10 eV）及多种样品材料。此外，对符合测量方法学及其数据修正给出了系统分析，该方法具有广泛适用性。
papers.method_zh: 离子-光子符合测量（ion-photon coincidence measurements）：将出射离子的电荷态与特定离子发射的光子进行关联测量，提取电荷态分辨的光子产额；并对符合方法本身及原始数据修正进行了详细分析。

papers.title: Closed-form hard-sphere thermodynamics under nanoscale confinement: from equations of state to unmixing forces
papers.abstract: Equations of state accurately describe hard-sphere thermodynamics but are generally considered to fail under nanoscale confinement. We show that this failure is geometric rather than thermodynamic: a closed-form, parameter-free mapping from apparent to effective packing fraction restores the accuracy of the Carnahan-Starling equation of state and, with it, the entire analytical thermodynamic framework, including free energies, wall pressures, chemical potentials, and the large-cavity surface response. Applied to overlapping anchored hard-sphere droplets, a geometry inherent to biomolecular force generation, it yields unmixing free energies and full distance-dependent force profiles in quantitative agreement with simulations from the dilute regime to above the bulk freezing transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要强调“closed-form, parameter-free mapping”“analytical thermodynamic framework”，并与“simulations”对比验证。；研究对象：硬球体系在纳米尺度受限下的热力学性质，以及重叠锚定硬球液滴（overlapping anchored hard-sphere droplets）这一用于模拟生物分子力产生的几何构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硬球状态方程在纳米受限下看似失效，其根源是几何效应而非热力学问题；通过一个无参数的闭合形式映射，将表观堆积分数转换为有效堆积分数，即可恢复Carnahan-Starling状态方程及其整套解析热力学框架的准确性，并能定量重现从稀溶液到高于体相冻结转变的模拟结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硬球状态方程在纳米受限下看似失效，其根源是几何效应而非热力学问题；通过一个无参数的闭合形式映射，将表观堆积分数转换为有效堆积分数，即可恢复Carnahan-Starling状态方程及其整套解析热力学框架的准确性，并能定量重现从稀溶液到高于体相冻结转变的模拟结果。；创新点：首次指出硬球状态方程在纳米受限下的失效是几何效应而非热力学失效，并给出无需拟合参数的解析映射，使整个经典热力学框架可直接推广至受限体系；同时将该方法应用于生物分子力产生的几何模型，获得与模拟定量一致的力曲线。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：提出从表观堆积分数到有效堆积分数的闭合形式、无参数映射；基于Carnahan-Starling状态方程重建自由能、壁压、化学势及大空腔表面响应；对重叠锚定硬球液滴体系计算去混合自由能和距离依赖的力曲线，并与模拟结果定量对比。

papers.title: Carrier-Resolved Attosecond Valley Polarimetry of Monolayer MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: In recent years, all-optical writing and switching of valley polarization in two-dimensional semiconductors has been demonstrated on femtosecond timescales. Reading this polarization out on the same timescale, carrier by carrier, has so far remained out of reach. Employing semiconductor Bloch equation simulations of monolayer MoS$_2$, we show that attosecond transient absorption closes this gap by turning the Mo $4p$ semicore edge into a quantitative valley polarimeter. We find that pump-enabled core-to-valence absorption probes the holes while core-to-conduction bleaching probes the electrons, so that a single spectrum identifies each carrier by its photoabsorption energy. The hole channel, Pauli-blocked in equilibrium, emerges background-free. Its circular dichroism reverses sign with the pump helicity, and its normalized magnitude is proportional to the valley polarization. Finally, we show that scanning the probe delay clocks the few-femtosecond write in real time. Thus, attosecond core-level dichroism is a carrier-sensitive, quantitative probe of the creation and evolution of valley polarization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Employing semiconductor Bloch equation simulations”（采用半导体布洛赫方程模拟）。；研究对象：单层二硫化钼（monolayer MoS₂）中的谷极化（valley polarization）超快动力学，具体关注价带空穴与导带电子的载流子分辨超快光谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用阿秒瞬态吸收谱可将Mo 4p半芯能级转变为定量谷极化测量计：芯-价带吸收通道探测空穴，芯-导带漂白通道探测电子，单个光谱即可按光吸收能量区分两类载流子；该方法的圆二色信号随泵浦光手性反转符号，其归一化强度正比于谷极化度，并能实时记录数飞秒尺度的谷极化写入过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用阿秒瞬态吸收谱可将Mo 4p半芯能级转变为定量谷极化测量计：芯-价带吸收通道探测空穴，芯-导带漂白通道探测电子，单个光谱即可按光吸收能量区分两类载流子；该方法的圆二色信号随泵浦光手性反转符号，其归一化强度正比于谷极化度，并能实时记录数飞秒尺度的谷极化写入过程。；创新点：首次提出在飞秒时间尺度上实现“逐载流子”（carrier-by-carrier）读取谷极化，将阿秒瞬态吸收与芯能级圆二色相结合，使空穴通道在平衡态下因泡利阻塞而呈现无背景信号，从而实现对谷极化的定量、载流子分辨探测。摘要未突出说明与其他谷极化探测方案（如时间分辨ARPES或二次谐波）的系统性对比。
papers.method_zh: 半导体布洛赫方程（Semiconductor Bloch Equations, SBE）数值模拟，模拟单层MoS₂的阿秒瞬态吸收光谱（attosecond transient absorption），分析芯-价带与芯-导带跃迁通道的圆二色信号。

papers.title: Superfluid memory effect
papers.abstract: We identify a memory effect produced by phonon scattering in a superfluid: a localized scattering event generates a far-field pressure pulse with vanishing time integral but a nonzero first temporal moment, corresponding to a permanent shift in a prepotential for the far-field velocity. The effect is controlled by the soft factor for phonon emission, including corrections from nonlinear dispersion. In superfluid $^4$He, scattering macroscopic phonon wave packets produces a signal whose estimated magnitude may lie within experimental reach, thereby providing a laboratory analogue of electromagnetic and gravitational memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要使用“We identify”“corresponding to”“thereby providing”等理论推导与概念提出用语，未提及实验数据或数值模拟。；研究对象：超流体中的声子散射现象，具体涉及超流⁴He中宏观声子波包的散射，以及由此产生的远场压力脉冲与速度预势的永久位移（即“超流记忆效应”）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超流体中局域散射事件会产生一个时间积分为零但一阶时间矩非零的远场压力脉冲，对应远场速度预势的永久性偏移；该效应由声子发射的软因子控制，并包含非线性色散的修正。在超流⁴He中，该信号强度可能达到实验可探测范围，可作为电磁记忆与引力记忆的实验室类比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超流体中局域散射事件会产生一个时间积分为零但一阶时间矩非零的远场压力脉冲，对应远场速度预势的永久性偏移；该效应由声子发射的软因子控制，并包含非线性色散的修正。在超流⁴He中，该信号强度可能达到实验可探测范围，可作为电磁记忆与引力记忆的实验室类比。；创新点：首次提出“超流记忆效应”这一概念，将电磁与引力记忆效应类比拓展至超流体声子系统，并指出其在超流⁴He中具有实验可测的可行性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于声子发射的软因子（soft factor）展开，并纳入非线性色散修正；对超流⁴He中宏观声子波包散射的信号幅度进行了估算（摘要未明确说明具体计算技术，如是否使用有效场论或微扰展开）。

papers.title: Efficient search for excitable zero-modes in constrained systems
papers.abstract: Kinetically constrained systems, such as those representing Rydberg atom arrays in the blockade regime, have gathered considerable attention due to the presence of atypical eigenstates in their spectrum. The latter manifests itself through the presence of quantum many-body scars as well as unusually large zero-mode (ZM) subspaces which contain analytically tractable eigenstates with various entanglement scalings. In particular, some of the latter are excitable zero-modes (EZMs), meaning that they can be promoted to a non-zero energy for open boundary conditions. In this work, I present an efficient protocol for finding analytical expressions for translation-invariant EZMs in constrained systems, based on the eigendecomposition of the local unconstrained Hamiltonian. I demonstrate the power of this method on a decorated Rydberg chain. In that model, my protocol directly produces a continuous matrix-product-state manifold located entirely in the zero-energy eigenspace for periodic boundary conditions. The span of that manifold grows exponentially with the system, and for odd system sizes it covers the entire zero-momentum eigenspace with zero energy. I then show how the physical structure of the manifold, which is tied to the local eigenbasis, also allows one to derive analytical expressions for ZMs at non-zero momentum and for a polynomial number of exact scars at $E=\pm\sqrt{3}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical expressions、eigendecomposition、protocol。；研究对象：动力学约束系统（kinetically constrained systems），具体以 blockade 机制下的 Rydberg 原子阵列（Rydberg atom arrays）为代表，并在一维 decorated Rydberg chain 上演示方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种高效协议，可系统构造约束系统中平移不变的可激发零模（excitable zero-modes, EZMs）的解析表达式；在 decorated Rydberg chain 中，该协议直接产生一个完全位于零能本征空间的连续矩阵乘积态（MPS）流形，其跨度随系统尺寸指数增长，且在奇数尺寸下覆盖整个零动量零能本征空间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种高效协议，可系统构造约束系统中平移不变的可激发零模（excitable zero-modes, EZMs）的解析表达式；在 decorated Rydberg chain 中，该协议直接产生一个完全位于零能本征空间的连续矩阵乘积态（MPS）流形，其跨度随系统尺寸指数增长，且在奇数尺寸下覆盖整个零动量零能本征空间。；创新点：提出了一种通用的、基于局域本征分解的高效解析构造协议，可直接生成完整的零能 MPS 流形，并揭示其与局域本征基的关联，从而同时获得非零动量零模和精确疤痕的解析形式。摘要未突出说明与以往构造方法的对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 基于局域无约束哈密顿量的本征分解（eigendecomposition of the local unconstrained Hamiltonian），结合平移不变性约束，构造零模的解析形式；并利用流形与局域本征基的物理结构，进一步推导非零动量零模及精确量子疤痕（scars）的解析表达式。

papers.title: Engineering multi-photon dissipation with a dc-voltage-biased Josephson junction
papers.abstract: Multi-photon dissipation -- a key resource for bosonic qubits -- is usually realized by parametrically pumping a Josephson coupler at the cost of spurious nonlinear terms. Here we instead engineer it using a dc-voltage-biased SQUID, such that these parasitic terms average out. We activate the conversion of one, two, or four photons of a high-Q mode into a single photon of a lossy mode. We characterize the two-photon dissipation by Wigner tomography, establishing dc-biased junctions as a resource for reservoir engineering and a viable route to cat-qubit stabilization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：**实验文章**。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We characterize the two-photon dissipation by Wigner tomography”（通过Wigner断层扫描表征双光子耗散），这是具体的实验表征手段。；研究对象：**超导量子电路中的玻色子模**，具体为利用直流电压偏置的SQUID（超导量子干涉器）在高质量因子（high-Q）微波腔模与有损模之间实现多光子耗散工程。该体系面向玻色子量子比特（特别是猫量子比特）的稳定化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: **通过直流电压偏置的SQUID，可以激活高Q模中一个、两个或四个光子向有损模中单个光子的转换，从而工程化多光子耗散过程，且避免了参数泵浦方案中固有的杂散非线性项。** 实验上通过Wigner断层扫描验证了双光子耗散的有效性，表明该方案是可行的储层工程资源，为猫量子比特稳定化提供了新途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：**通过直流电压偏置的SQUID，可以激活高Q模中一个、两个或四个光子向有损模中单个光子的转换，从而工程化多光子耗散过程，且避免了参数泵浦方案中固有的杂散非线性项。** 实验上通过Wigner断层扫描验证了双光子耗散的有效性，表明该方案是可行的储层工程资源，为猫量子比特稳定化提供了新途径。；创新点：**利用直流电压偏置替代参数泵浦来驱动多光子耗散，使得寄生非线性项在时间平均下抵消，从而简化了系统哈密顿量并避免了泵浦引入的杂散效应。** 这是首次将直流偏置约瑟夫森结确立为储层工程的实用资源，并展示了其在猫量子比特稳定化中的可行性。
papers.method_zh: **实验方法**：使用直流电压偏置的SQUID作为非线性耦合元件，替代传统的参数泵浦方案；通过Wigner断层扫描（量子态层析成像）对双光子耗散过程进行表征。摘要未提及具体材料体系或制备工艺细节。

papers.title: The large $N$ vector model with angular velocity
papers.abstract: We study the free energy of the critical $O(N)$ vector model at large $N$ on $S^{1}\times S^{2}$ with an angular velocity $\hatμ$ without the singlet constraint. The leading high-temperature behaviour is determined analytically both as an expansion about $\hatμr=0$ and $\hatμ^{2}r^{2}=1$ where $r$ is the radius of the sphere. We supplement the analytic results with a numerical analysis that agrees with both the analytical expansions in their respective regimes and smoothly interpolates between them. The leading high-temperature contribution to the free energy develops a pole at $\hatμ^{2}r^{2}=1$, in agreement with expectations from the thermal effective field theory. Its residue coincides with that of the massless free theory. Sub-leading terms, however, exhibit non-analytic dependence on the angular velocity and distinguish the critical fixed-point result from the free theory answer. The residue at the pole can also be obtained by placing the $O(N)$ model on the pp-wave geometry. We show that the residue agrees with that obtained from the direct computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“We study the free energy”“determined analytically”“numerical analysis”，属于解析与数值计算结合的理论研究。；研究对象：临界O(N)矢量模型在S¹×S²几何上、带角速度（化学势）且不施加单态约束时的大N极限自由能行为。属于量子场论/统计场论中的临界现象研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高温极限下自由能的主导项在角速度满足μ̂²r²=1处出现极点，其留数与无质量自由理论一致；但次主导项对角速度具有非解析依赖，从而区分了临界不动点结果与自由理论结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高温极限下自由能的主导项在角速度满足μ̂²r²=1处出现极点，其留数与无质量自由理论一致；但次主导项对角速度具有非解析依赖，从而区分了临界不动点结果与自由理论结果。；创新点：首次在带角速度且无单态约束的S¹×S²上系统研究临界O(N)矢量模型的高温自由能，揭示了极点留数与自由理论的一致性以及次主导项的非解析行为，并通过pp-wave几何交叉验证了极点留数。
papers.method_zh: 大N展开（解析方法），分别围绕μ̂r=0和μ̂²r²=1两个极限做高温展开；辅以数值分析验证解析结果并平滑插值；另用pp-wave几何计算极点留数并与直接计算对比。

papers.title: Colorful Exponential Random Graph Models
papers.abstract: In this paper, we initiate the study of colored exponential random graph models (ERGMs), a class of exponential-family models for networks with multiple types of edge relations. Using the framework of probability graphons, we first derive a variational representation for the limiting free energy, whose maximizers determine the asymptotic structure of typical samples from the model. Then we identify several general families of colored ERGMs exhibiting replica symmetry, where the variational problem has constant maximizers and the model asymptotically concentrates on product colorings with independent edges. For general colored ERGMs, we derive Euler-Lagrange fixed-point equations for the variational maximizers, which in turn yield a general high-temperature uniqueness criterion.
