In the complementary zero-temperature regime, we establish a two-level selection principle: the leading energy term determines the ground states, while the lower-order energy terms, combined with entropy, act as a tie-breaker to determine the asymptotic zero-temperature structure of the model. We illustrate this principle through the induced wedge and rainbow triangle ERGMs. Both models have natural interpretations in multitype networks, and their zero-temperature limits exhibit interesting structures that connect to well-known results in extremal combinatorics. We further establish finite-temperature symmetry breaking for both these models and complement the rigorous results with numerical experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：variational representation、Euler-Lagrange fixed-point equations、replica symmetry、zero-temperature regime。；研究对象：彩色指数随机图模型（colored ERGMs），即具有多种边关系类型的网络系综，属于统计物理与网络科学交叉领域，而非具体凝聚态材料或量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该文建立了彩色ERGMs的变分自由能表示，证明在一般条件下模型渐近集中于独立边的乘积染色结构；在零温极限下，能量主导项决定基态，低阶能量项与熵共同作为“破平局”机制决定渐近结构，并通过诱导楔形与彩虹三角形模型展示了与极值组合学已知结果的联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该文建立了彩色ERGMs的变分自由能表示，证明在一般条件下模型渐近集中于独立边的乘积染色结构；在零温极限下，能量主导项决定基态，低阶能量项与熵共同作为“破平局”机制决定渐近结构，并通过诱导楔形与彩虹三角形模型展示了与极值组合学已知结果的联系。；创新点：首次系统研究彩色ERGMs的渐近结构，提出零温下“能量主导+熵破平局”的两级选择原理，并将极值组合学中的经典结果（如诱导楔形、彩虹三角形）与网络统计模型建立联系。摘要未突出说明与已有单色ERGM理论的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用概率图限（probability graphons）框架推导自由能的变分表示；利用复制对称性（replica symmetry）分析常值最大化子；推导Euler-Lagrange不动点方程以建立高温唯一性判据；在零温区建立两级选择原理，并辅以数值实验验证有限温对称破缺。

papers.title: Boundary Quantum Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov Equations and Integrability of Quantum Field Theories with Time-Dependent Bulk and Boundary Coupling Strengths
papers.abstract: The generalized Bethe ansatz framework formulated in [P. R. Pasnoori, Phys. Rev. B 112, L060409 (2025)] provides a unified framework to find exact solutions to quantum many-body systems with time-dependent coupling strengths with periodic boundary conditions. In this work we extend this framework to the case of open boundary conditions where in addition to the time-dependent interactions in the bulk, the boundary conditions are explicitly time-dependent. We show that for integrable time-dependent bulk coupling strengths, the generalized Bethe ansatz framework provides the time-dependent boundary conditions compatible with integrability and reduces the time-dependent Schrodinger equation to a set of matrix difference equations called the boundary quantum Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov (BqKZ) equations. The solution to the BqKZ equations provides the explicit form of the exact wavefunction. We further show that the RG invariants of the corresponding static model identify with the dynamical invariants in the time-dependent model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“广义Bethe ansatz框架”“量子Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov方程”“可积性”等理论构造与数学推导，未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：具有时间依赖的体态与边界耦合强度的量子多体系统，特别是开放边界条件下的可积量子场论模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作将广义Bethe ansatz框架从周期边界条件推广到开放边界条件，证明在时间依赖的体态耦合强度下，该框架能给出与可积性相容的时间依赖边界条件，并将含时薛定谔方程约化为边界量子Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov（BqKZ）矩阵差分方程；其解给出精确波函数的显式形式。此外，静态模型的RG不变量与时间依赖模型中的动力学不变量一一对应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作将广义Bethe ansatz框架从周期边界条件推广到开放边界条件，证明在时间依赖的体态耦合强度下，该框架能给出与可积性相容的时间依赖边界条件，并将含时薛定谔方程约化为边界量子Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov（BqKZ）矩阵差分方程；其解给出精确波函数的显式形式。此外，静态模型的RG不变量与时间依赖模型中的动力学不变量一一对应。；创新点：首次将广义Bethe ansatz框架推广至同时具有时间依赖体态相互作用和显式时间依赖边界条件的开放边界系统，并建立了BqKZ方程与精确可解性之间的联系。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 广义Bethe ansatz框架（由Pasnoori于2025年提出），结合边界量子Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov方程求解，以及RG不变量与动力学不变量的对应分析。摘要未提及具体数值或实验手段。

papers.title: Work Extraction Across a Thermodynamic Hierarchy in Quantum Many-Body Systems
papers.abstract: Thermodynamics is operational in the sense that the very concept of thermal equilibrium depends crucially on the choice of observables, while the amount of extractable work is defined relative to the allowed operations. Here we show that isolated quantum many-body states admit a thermodynamic hierarchical structure of observables and allowed operations, where the same state can be thermal at one level of the hierarchy and athermal at another. Enlarging the set of allowed operations therefore renders such hidden athermality a potential resource for work extraction; the resulting work gain is bounded in terms of the difference between the entropy densities of the two levels. This entropy difference takes the form of the mutual-information density. We establish the bounds for three extensions of operational access: increased spatial resolution, increased duration of control, and nonlocal connectivity, which provide access to position-state Holevo information, correlations between neighboring regions and spatially nonlocal correlations, respectively. Thus the difference between entropies at different levels of the thermodynamic hierarchy governs the bound on the work gain associated with moving to a less restricted level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamics is operational、we show、establish the bounds（理论推导与概念分析）。；研究对象：孤立量子多体系统中的热力学层级结构，以及不同层级下可提取功（work extraction）的资源理论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 同一量子多体态可以在某一热力学层级上表现为热态，而在另一层级上表现为非热态；扩大允许操作集合可将这种“隐藏的非热性”转化为可提取功的资源，功增益的上限由两个层级的熵密度之差（即互信息密度）决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：同一量子多体态可以在某一热力学层级上表现为热态，而在另一层级上表现为非热态；扩大允许操作集合可将这种“隐藏的非热性”转化为可提取功的资源，功增益的上限由两个层级的熵密度之差（即互信息密度）决定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但核心新意在于将“热平衡依赖于可观测量选择”这一操作性观点系统化为多体量子态中的层级结构，并证明层级间熵密度差（互信息密度）直接约束功提取增益，建立了从“隐藏非热性”到可用功的定量桥梁。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于可观测量与允许操作集合定义的热力学层级（thermodynamic hierarchy），推导功提取上界；具体分析了三种操作扩展——提高空间分辨率（对应位置态Holevo信息）、延长控制时间（对应相邻区域间的关联）、非局域连通性（对应空间非局域关联），并分别建立功增益界限。

papers.title: Quantum Dot Colloidosomes as Triggerable Microlasers
papers.abstract: Quantum dot (QD) supraparticle lasers are promising platforms for microscale light sources and photonic labeling, yet their optical properties are set during assembly. Here we introduce QD colloidosomes, liquid-core/solid-shell supraparticles that combine whispering-gallery-mode optical feedback with stimulus-triggered structural collapse. Intact QD colloidosomes show cavity-defined lasing with fluence thresholds of ~2.8 mJ/cm2 and linewidths of 2.2-3.7 nm, demonstrating efficient light trapping without a solid core. We identify shell continuity as a critical determinant for whispering-gallery feedback and lasing by exploring a morphological continuum of suprastructures comprising solid supraparticles, colloidosomes, and microporous hollow shells. Intact colloidosomes support narrow cavity modes, whereas porous shells remain broadband even at high pump fluence. We show that colloidosomes can be driven to rupture and release payload through well-defined pathways, including meniscus-driven capillary failure, uniform heating, and localized near-infrared activation, thereby reconfiguring their optical response from cavity-defined lasing to broadband emission. These results establish QD colloidosomes as reconfigurable microlasers that couple optical-state switching and triggered release within a single self-assembled platform.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了实验观测（如“fluence thresholds”“linewidths”）、结构表征（“morphological continuum”）以及触发机制实验（“meniscus-driven capillary failure”“near-infrared activation”）。；研究对象：量子点胶体囊（QD colloidosomes），即液核/固壳超粒子结构，结合回音壁模式光学反馈与刺激响应性结构塌缩，用于可触发微激光器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 完整的量子点胶体囊可实现腔模定义的激光发射（阈值约2.8 mJ/cm²，线宽2.2–3.7 nm），而壳层连续性对回音壁反馈至关重要；通过可控破裂，其光学响应可从腔模激光切换为宽带发射，实现可重构微激光器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：完整的量子点胶体囊可实现腔模定义的激光发射（阈值约2.8 mJ/cm²，线宽2.2–3.7 nm），而壳层连续性对回音壁反馈至关重要；通过可控破裂，其光学响应可从腔模激光切换为宽带发射，实现可重构微激光器。；创新点：首次将量子点胶体囊作为可触发微激光器，在同一自组装平台中耦合光学态切换（腔模激光→宽带发射）与受控释放功能，且无需固体核心即可实现高效光限制。摘要未突出说明与已有QD超粒子激光器在材料或制备工艺上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：自组装制备不同形态的超结构（实心超粒子、胶体囊、微孔空心壳）；光学表征（激光阈值、线宽、泵浦强度依赖的发射谱）；触发破裂实验（毛细力驱动、均匀加热、近红外局部激活）并监测光学响应变化。

papers.title: A Truncated Majorana
papers.abstract: We investigate the quantum field dynamics of truncating a Majorana wave packet via a time-dependent channel shutter. Modeling truncation as a controlled modification of chiral propagation rather than a literal spatial cut, we analyze a $1+1$D massless Majorana field subjected to a time-dependent rotation between its chiral components. We demonstrate that this protocol manifests two complementary physical limits. Globally, a mismatch between early- and late-time channel identifications induces a fermionic Bogoliubov transformation. We prove this asymptotic change universally generates an infrared soft-mode memory, $β(ω, ν) \propto (ω+ν)^{-1}$, leading to a logarithmic divergence in the Hilbert--Schmidt norm. This orthogonality-catastrophe-like obstruction persists even under infinitely smooth switching in the massless limit. Conversely, in the number-conserving regime where pair production vanishes, the shutter acts as a purely causal filter. We establish exact local field identities showing that, restricted to the even local observable algebra, the retained sector is exactly equivalent to a single-particle state while the discarded sector reduces to the vacuum. Ultimately, we show that global infrared memory and local causal truncation are complementary diagnostics of the same dynamical operation. These results provide a rigorous field-theoretic foundation for time-dependent control in topological platforms, cleanly separating effective operational benchmarks from microscopic boundary dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum field dynamics、modeling、analyze、prove、establish exact local field identities。；研究对象：1+1维无质量Majorana场在时间依赖通道快门（channel shutter）作用下的量子场动力学，即通过时间依赖旋转手征分量来实现对Majorana波包的截断。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该截断协议表现出两种互补的物理极限：全局上，早期与晚期通道识别的不匹配诱导费米子Bogoliubov变换，产生红外软模记忆β(ω,ν)∝(ω+ν)^{-1}，导致Hilbert–Schmidt范数对数发散（正交性灾难型阻碍），即使在无限光滑切换下依然存在；局域上，在粒子数守恒（无对产生）区域，快门作为纯因果滤波器，保留扇区精确等价于单粒子态，丢弃扇区约化为真空。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该截断协议表现出两种互补的物理极限：全局上，早期与晚期通道识别的不匹配诱导费米子Bogoliubov变换，产生红外软模记忆β(ω,ν)∝(ω+ν)^{-1}，导致Hilbert–Schmidt范数对数发散（正交性灾难型阻碍），即使在无限光滑切换下依然存在；局域上，在粒子数守恒（无对产生）区域，快门作为纯因果滤波器，保留扇区精确等价于单粒子态，丢弃扇区约化为真空。；创新点：将时间依赖控制下的Majorana波包截断严格纳入场论框架，证明全局红外记忆与局域因果截断是同一动力学操作的互补诊断，为拓扑平台中的时间依赖控制提供了清晰的场论基础，并区分了有效操作基准与微观边界动力学。摘要未突出说明与具体拓扑平台或实验方案的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为1+1维无质量Majorana场的量子场论分析，采用时间依赖的手征分量旋转来建模截断，推导Bogoliubov变换、红外软模记忆函数、Hilbert–Schmidt范数，并建立局域场恒等式以分析局域可观测代数上的等价性。

papers.title: Towards an effective medium theory for in-vivo Magnetic Resonance: Characterizing Admissible Magnetization Dynamics
papers.abstract: The classical Bloch equation forms the foundation of magnetic resonance theory but may be insufficient to capture the complex effective dynamics observed in heterogeneous materials such as biological tissue. Here an effective-medium strategy is proposed to describe magnetic resonance dynamics from observations at macro-scale (order 1 mm$^3$). In this framework, the classical Larmor torque is retained while the relaxation term is replaced by a general nonlinear field (i.e. the effective medium term). This field is required to preserve key physical properties, including rotational symmetry, global stability of thermal equilibrium, and dissipativity. These requirements lead to a complete characterization of admissible relaxation fields and provide a constructive framework for generating nonlinear relaxation models. The resulting theory recovers classical Bloch dynamics as a special case and provides a principled foundation for effective-medium descriptions of magnetic resonance phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“effective-medium strategy is proposed”“complete characterization”“constructive framework”等理论构建性表述，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：生物组织等异质材料中的磁共振（Magnetic Resonance）有效动力学，具体为宏观尺度（约1 mm³）下磁化强度矢量的弛豫行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过要求弛豫项满足旋转对称性、热平衡全局稳定性与耗散性，完整刻画了所有允许的有效介质弛豫场形式，并证明经典Bloch方程是该理论的一个特例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过要求弛豫项满足旋转对称性、热平衡全局稳定性与耗散性，完整刻画了所有允许的有效介质弛豫场形式，并证明经典Bloch方程是该理论的一个特例。；创新点：首次为体内磁共振的宏观有效动力学提供了系统化的理论构建方案，将经验性的非线性弛豫模型纳入统一的理论框架，并严格证明了经典Bloch方程的适用范围边界。
papers.method_zh: 有效介质理论框架：保留经典Larmor进动项，将Bloch方程中的线性弛豫项替换为一般非线性场（有效介质项），并基于物理约束（旋转对称、全局稳定、耗散性）进行数学分类与构造。

papers.title: Coexisting chaos and order in micro-textured elastic flows
authors: Ricardo Arturo Lopez de la Cruz
papers.abstract: Viscoelastic fluid flows over micro-textured surfaces - densely covered by slender protrusions like cilia lining the body airways or villi covering the intestinal epithelium - underpin essential biological processes including transport, mixing, and absorption. Despite their ubiquity, the dynamics generated by the interplay between fluid elasticity and these complex geometries remain largely unexplored. Here we combine fully resolved numerical simulations with microfluidic experiments to reveal the flow dynamics established above dense arrays of microscopic pillars (canopies) immersed in the low-Reynolds-number flow of a viscoelastic liquid. We observe that the flow above the canopy tips spontaneously develops elastic turbulence. Remarkably, the chaotic state coexists with elastic waves emerging from the coupling between fluid elasticity and the heterogeneous shear induced by the canopy geometry. These ordered fluid motions persist across a broad range of flow conditions and canopy configurations. Our results demonstrate that coherent wave propagation and elastic turbulence are complementary manifestations of viscoelastic fluid flow. Beyond their fundamental significance, these mechanisms have broad implications for transport in biological and engineered environments, and reveal how structured geometries can harness the spontaneous dynamics of viscoelastic liquids to manipulate complex flows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“fully resolved numerical simulations”和“microfluidic experiments”。；研究对象：微纹理表面（密集排列的微观柱状阵列，即“canopies”）上方的粘弹性流体流动，具体为低雷诺数粘弹性液体在微观柱阵列上方形成的流动动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在微柱阵列上方，粘弹性流体自发产生弹性湍流（混沌态），同时该混沌态与由流体弹性与柱几何诱导的非均匀剪切耦合产生的弹性波（有序态）共存。相干波传播与弹性湍流是粘弹性流动的互补表现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在微柱阵列上方，粘弹性流体自发产生弹性湍流（混沌态），同时该混沌态与由流体弹性与柱几何诱导的非均匀剪切耦合产生的弹性波（有序态）共存。相干波传播与弹性湍流是粘弹性流动的互补表现。；创新点：首次揭示在微纹理几何上方，弹性湍流与弹性波有序态可以共存，表明相干波传播与弹性湍流并非互斥，而是粘弹性流动的互补表现；并展示了结构化几何可利用粘弹性液体的自发动力学来操控复杂流动。
papers.method_zh: 全分辨数值模拟（fully resolved numerical simulations）结合微流控实验（microfluidic experiments），研究低雷诺数粘弹性液体在微观柱阵列（canopies）上方的流动。

papers.title: Local connectivity balance shapes population dynamics in random recurrent networks
papers.abstract: Disordered dynamical systems comprising many interacting units, from ecological communities to neural circuits, are ubiquitous, and understanding how connectivity shapes their collective behavior is a central theoretical challenge. One long-recognized feature of neural circuits is local connectivity balance, in which the excitatory and inhibitory weights converging onto each unit approximately cancel. Although local connectivity balance has been proposed to serve functions such as gating incoming signals, its effect on collective network dynamics remains unclear. Here we analytically study randomly connected recurrent networks with varying degrees of local connectivity balance. We show that this balance leaves the connectivity spectrum unchanged yet drastically reshapes the dynamics in a manner that depends critically on the single-unit nonlinearity. Local balance suppresses unbounded growth of the network state and stabilizes network dynamics when the activation function scales linearly or faster, whereas it drives the network into chaos when the activation function is sub-linear or saturating. Importantly, these effects vanish for odd activation functions, which are commonly assumed in previous work. We further find that, for saturating nonlinearities, the effective dimension of the dynamics varies nonmonotonically with the degree of balance. We show that all these phenomena arise from a unifying mechanism: the suppression of a self-generated feedback input by local connectivity balance. Our results identify local connectivity balance as a previously overlooked control parameter for collective dynamics in realistic disordered networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“analytically study”（解析研究）随机连接的循环网络，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：随机循环神经网络（random recurrent networks），重点关注局部连接平衡（local connectivity balance）——即每个单元上汇聚的兴奋性与抑制性权重近似抵消——对群体动力学的影响。该体系可类比生态群落或神经回路等无序多体动力学系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局部连接平衡不改变连接谱，但会显著重塑网络动力学，其效果取决于单单元非线性函数的形式：当激活函数线性或超线性时，平衡抑制状态发散并稳定动力学；当激活函数次线性或饱和时，平衡反而驱动网络进入混沌。这些效应在奇函数激活下消失，且对饱和非线性，动力学有效维度随平衡程度呈非单调变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局部连接平衡不改变连接谱，但会显著重塑网络动力学，其效果取决于单单元非线性函数的形式：当激活函数线性或超线性时，平衡抑制状态发散并稳定动力学；当激活函数次线性或饱和时，平衡反而驱动网络进入混沌。这些效应在奇函数激活下消失，且对饱和非线性，动力学有效维度随平衡程度呈非单调变化。；创新点：首次将局部连接平衡识别为无序网络集体动力学的一个此前被忽视的控制参数，并揭示其作用强烈依赖于单单元非线性类型，尤其指出以往工作中常用的奇函数激活会掩盖这些效应。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论分析：对随机连接循环网络进行平均场或谱理论分析，考察连接谱、动力学稳定性、混沌转变及有效维度，并引入“自生成反馈输入被局部平衡抑制”的统一机制解释所有现象。

papers.title: Symmetric Mass Generation for Domain-Wall Fermions
papers.abstract: We report the first numerical examination of symmetric mass generation (SMG) for domain-wall fermions. Our simulation on a two-dimensional Euclidean lattice computes the path-integral of the Fidkowski-Kitaev Majorana chain with two boundaries, corresponding to the two (physical and mirror) walls. We demonstrate by evaluating the lattice Dirac operator eigenvalue spectrum that the local four-Fermi interaction selectively gaps the edge fermions on the mirror wall while leaving the physical wall intact. We further identify a characteristic signature of SMG in the path-integral: the gap of the Dirac operator opens along the imaginary axis of the complex spectrum, in contrast to the standard mass shift in the real direction. The conventional hybrid Monte Carlo algorithm remains practical with reweighting the complex phase of the Pfaffian, which is found to be remarkably small throughout the simulation. These results provide a practical nonperturbative framework for interaction-induced mirror-fermion decoupling of lattice domain-wall fermions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“numerical examination”“simulation on a two-dimensional Euclidean lattice”“computes the path-integral”，属于数值模拟研究。；研究对象：二维欧几里得格点上的畴壁费米子（domain-wall fermions），具体为具有两个边界（物理壁和镜像壁）的Fidkowski-Kitaev Majorana链，研究其对称质量生成（SMG）机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域四费米相互作用可选择性地在镜像壁上打开能隙（使镜像壁费米子退耦），而物理壁保持无隙；SMG在路径积分中的特征表现为狄拉克算符能隙沿复谱的虚轴打开，而非标准质量项沿实轴方向移动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域四费米相互作用可选择性地在镜像壁上打开能隙（使镜像壁费米子退耦），而物理壁保持无隙；SMG在路径积分中的特征表现为狄拉克算符能隙沿复谱的虚轴打开，而非标准质量项沿实轴方向移动。；创新点：首次对畴壁费米子的对称质量生成进行数值检验，并识别出SMG在路径积分中沿虚轴打开能隙的特征性谱学信号；同时证明HMC算法配合小复相位reweighting在该问题中仍然实用。
papers.method_zh: 二维欧几里得格点蒙特卡罗模拟，计算路径积分；通过评估格点狄拉克算符本征值谱来表征能隙；使用混合蒙特卡罗（HMC）算法，并对Pfaffian的复相位进行reweighting处理。

papers.title: Equilibrium fluctuations of the weakly asymmetric inclusion process
papers.abstract: We prove that the stationary density fluctuation field of the one-dimensional weakly asymmetric simple inclusion process converges to the energy solution of the stochastic Burgers equation. The key technical ingredient is a second-order Boltzmann-Gibbs principle tailored to the microscopic current. As a consequence, we also obtain Ornstein-Uhlenbeck fluctuations for the symmetric inclusion process in a weakly condensing regime, a result of independent interest.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“prove”（证明）、“converges”（收敛性证明）、“Boltzmann-Gibbs principle”（玻尔兹曼-吉布斯原理）等数学严格性术语。；研究对象：一维弱不对称简单包含过程（weakly asymmetric simple inclusion process）的平衡态密度涨落，以及对称包含过程（symmetric inclusion process）在弱凝聚（weakly condensing）区间的涨落行为。属于非平衡统计物理与随机多体系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了该过程在平衡态下的密度涨落场在标度极限下收敛到随机Burgers方程的能量解；作为推论，对称包含过程在弱凝聚区间表现出Ornstein-Uhlenbeck型涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了该过程在平衡态下的密度涨落场在标度极限下收敛到随机Burgers方程的能量解；作为推论，对称包含过程在弱凝聚区间表现出Ornstein-Uhlenbeck型涨落。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异，但明确指出二阶Boltzmann-Gibbs原理是针对微观流的新技术要素，且弱凝聚区间的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck涨落结果具有独立价值。
papers.method_zh: 采用概率论与随机分析框架，核心工具是专门针对微观流构造的二阶Boltzmann-Gibbs原理（second-order Boltzmann-Gibbs principle），用于控制非线性项的涨落并建立极限过程的唯一性。

papers.title: Exact Entanglement Swapping through Single-Occupancy Measurements in Gaussian Fermion States
papers.abstract: We determine the exact entanglement structure of the conditional state obtained by measuring $m$ corresponding rungs ($m\leq N/2$) in two identical copies of an arbitrary half-filled free fermion Gaussian state and post-selecting the same normalized single-fermion state ($|ψ\rangle = u|10\rangle+v|01\rangle$, where 0 and 1 denote the fermion occupancy on each sites) on each rung. For $m<N/2$, the conditional wavefunction generally depends on the initial state. Nevertheless, whenever the selected outcome has nonzero probability, the state on the unmeasured sites remains Gaussian and factorizes exactly into $N-m$ different orthogonal modes including $m$ inter-copy entangling modes and $N-2m$ spectator modes localized in one copy. Consequently, the entanglement entropy between the unmeasured parts of the two copies is $S=m h_2(|v|^2)$, independent of the initial state, where $h_2(x)=-x\ln x-(1-x)\ln(1-x)$. The success probability is given by $P_m=\det C_L\det(I_m-C_L)=\det(C_{LR}C_{RL})$, determined solely by the initial correlations and independent of ($u$,$v$). Equal-weight Bell post-selection serves as a special case that achieves the maximal entanglement swapping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“exact entanglement structure”“conditional wavefunction”“entanglement entropy”等理论推导，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：自由费米子高斯态（half-filled free fermion Gaussian state）中的纠缠交换（entanglement swapping）现象，具体为通过单占据测量实现两拷贝间的纠缠转移。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对任意半填充自由费米子高斯态的两个相同拷贝，在m个对应“横档”（rungs）上测量并后选择相同的单费米子态后，未测量部分的态仍为高斯态，且精确分解为m个纠缠模和N-2m个旁观模；两拷贝未测量部分间的纠缠熵为S = m h₂(|v|²)，与初始态无关，仅由测量选择态的参数决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对任意半填充自由费米子高斯态的两个相同拷贝，在m个对应“横档”（rungs）上测量并后选择相同的单费米子态后，未测量部分的态仍为高斯态，且精确分解为m个纠缠模和N-2m个旁观模；两拷贝未测量部分间的纠缠熵为S = m h₂(|v|²)，与初始态无关，仅由测量选择态的参数决定。；创新点：首次给出任意半填充自由费米子高斯态在单占据测量后条件态的精确纠缠结构，证明纠缠交换量仅由测量参数决定而与初始态无关，并指出等权重Bell后选择是实现最大纠缠交换的特例。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论推导。基于高斯态的性质，分析m个对应位置上的单费米子投影测量（post-selection）后的条件态结构，利用行列式（det C_L、det(I_m−C_L)、det(C_LR C_RL)）计算成功概率，并推导纠缠熵的精确表达式。

papers.title: Local Density Approximation and Other Limit Regimes for a Homogeneous Bose Gas with Repulsive Three-Body Interactions in Low-Dimensional Space
papers.abstract: In the whole space of low spatial dimensions, namely $d \leq 2$, we study the minimizers of an energy functional with an attractive cubic nonlinearity and a repulsive quintic nonlinearity, which describes a quantum Bose gas with a two-body attraction and a three-body repulsion. We prove the existence of minimizers at fixed effective statistics parameter. In the limit of a large effective statistics parameter of the mass-critical nonlinearity (with respect to the kinetic energy), we derive an effective Thomas-Fermi-like model for the homogeneous Bose gas. We also consider other limit regimes depending on the mass-critical nonlinearity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：energy functional、minimizers、limit regimes、model。；研究对象：低维空间（d ≤ 2）中具有排斥性三体相互作用的均匀玻色气体，具体涉及两体吸引（三次非线性）与三体排斥（五次非线性）竞争下的量子基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在固定有效统计参数下证明了能量泛函极小值（基态）的存在性；在大有效统计参数极限下，推导出均匀玻色气体的有效Thomas-Fermi型模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在固定有效统计参数下证明了能量泛函极小值（基态）的存在性；在大有效统计参数极限下，推导出均匀玻色气体的有效Thomas-Fermi型模型。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其创新在于针对低维（d ≤ 2）均匀玻色气体，在质量临界非线性（相对动能）的大参数极限下建立了有效的Thomas-Fermi描述，并系统考察了其他极限区域。
papers.method_zh: 变分法（能量泛函极小化）、非线性分析（质量临界非线性项的极限分析），以及Thomas-Fermi近似推导。

papers.title: Homogeneous attractive Bose-Einstein condensates with repulsive three-body interactions: the two-dimensional case
papers.abstract: We consider a homogeneous Bose gas composed of $N$ identical bosons occupying an infinite two-dimensional space. This gas exhibits both an attractive two-body interaction and a repulsive three-body interaction. Via the intermediate Hartree theory, we rigorously derive the homogeneous cubic-quintic nonlinear Schroedinger functional as the mean-field limit of the model. Our investigation focuses on the system's behavior in relation to the two-body interaction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“rigorously derive”“mean-field limit”“Hartree theory”等数学物理推导关键词。；研究对象：二维无限空间中的均匀玻色气体，体系同时具有吸引性两体相互作用和排斥性三体相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过中间哈特里（Hartree）理论，严格推导出该模型的平均场极限为均匀三次-五次非线性薛定谔泛函，并系统研究了体系行为随两体相互作用强度的变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过中间哈特里（Hartree）理论，严格推导出该模型的平均场极限为均匀三次-五次非线性薛定谔泛函，并系统研究了体系行为随两体相互作用强度的变化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其创新在于对二维情形下同时含吸引两体和排斥三体相互作用的均匀玻色气体，给出了严格的平均场极限推导，并专门关注两体相互作用对体系行为的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用中间哈特里（intermediate Hartree）理论框架，对N个全同玻色子的多体模型进行严格的平均场极限推导，得到cubic-quintic非线性薛定谔泛函。

papers.title: Homogeneous attractive Bose-Einstein condensates with repulsive three-body interactions: the one-dimensional case
papers.abstract: We investigate the behavior of a homogeneous one-dimensional Bose gas composed of $N$ identical bosons experiencing attractive two-body and repulsive three-body interactions. Utilizing intermediate Hartree theory, we rigorously derive the homogeneous cubic-quintic nonlinear Schrödinger functional as the mean-field limit of the many-body Hamiltonian. Particular attention is given to the impact of the repulsive three-body term on ground state energy estimates and mass concentration properties
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“rigorously derive”（严格推导）、“mean-field limit”（平均场极限）等理论分析关键词。；研究对象：一维均匀玻色气体，由N个全同玻色子组成，具有吸引性两体相互作用和排斥性三体相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过中间Hartree理论，严格推导出该多体哈密顿量的平均场极限为均匀三次-五次非线性薛定谔泛函；并重点分析了排斥性三体项对基态能量估计和质量集中性质的影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过中间Hartree理论，严格推导出该多体哈密顿量的平均场极限为均匀三次-五次非线性薛定谔泛函；并重点分析了排斥性三体项对基态能量估计和质量集中性质的影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于将排斥性三体相互作用引入一维吸引性玻色气体，并给出严格的平均场极限推导及对基态性质的影响分析。
papers.method_zh: 中间Hartree理论（intermediate Hartree theory），用于从多体哈密顿量严格推导平均场极限泛函；涉及基态能量估计与质量集中性质的数学分析。

papers.title: Controlling the Coupling Strengths in Nanophotonic Networks using Modified Yagi-Uda Nanoplasmonic Antennas
papers.abstract: On-chip communication in optical neural networks is commonly done via waveguides which results in large system footprints. A compact alternative is to broadcast light signals between nano-optoelectronic components in free space and tailor the light field distribution using sub-wavelength nanophotonics. We propose and simulate nanoplasmonic metal structures in combination with III-V nanowire emitters and receivers to create an optical network in which the shape and position of these nanostructures create varying weights between the nano-optoelectronic nodes. Using Finite Difference Time Domain modelling, we investigate systems of experimentally verified nanowire optoelectronics combined with nanoplasmonic structures that can be made in the same fabrication step as electrical contacts powering the nanowires. We investigate both individual nanowire/antenna devices as well as networks corresponding to two layers in a neural network. We show that directed communication from a nanowire node can be significantly altered using Yagi-Uda antennas. Modifying the antenna with an asymmetric director component enables the directing of light several different angular directions simultaneously. We find that highly variable complex weight distribution between the connections in two seven node layers can be achieved depending on the combined geometry of the antenna components. The possible weight distributions in compact layers of nanowire nodes could be used for creating a variety of neural networks with complex connectivity. The concepts can be generalized to other types of nanoscale emitter/receiver systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“We propose and simulate”“Using Finite Difference Time Domain modelling”。；研究对象：纳米光子网络中的纳米等离子体金属结构（改进型Yagi-Uda天线）与III-V族纳米线发射器/接收器组成的复合体系，用于自由空间光信号广播与神经形态计算中的光互连。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变Yagi-Uda纳米等离子体天线的几何形状（尤其是非对称引向器结构），可以显著调控纳米线节点间的定向光通信，并在两层各含七个节点的网络中实现高度可变的复数权重分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变Yagi-Uda纳米等离子体天线的几何形状（尤其是非对称引向器结构），可以显著调控纳米线节点间的定向光通信，并在两层各含七个节点的网络中实现高度可变的复数权重分布。；创新点：提出利用Yagi-Uda天线的非对称引向器设计，使单个纳米线节点能同时向多个不同角度方向定向发射光，从而在紧凑的纳米线节点层间实现复杂可调的连接权重矩阵，替代传统波导方案以缩小系统尺寸。摘要还指出该概念可推广至其他纳米尺度发射/接收系统。
papers.method_zh: 时域有限差分（FDTD）数值模拟。研究对象基于实验已验证的纳米线光电子器件，纳米等离子体结构可与纳米线供电的金属电极在同一制备步骤中加工。

papers.title: Localization in microcavities revealed by phase-space non-Hermitian skin effect
papers.abstract: Contrary to the semiclassical expectation for fully chaotic systems, localization of resonances is found to be a common feature in open microcavities. In spiral-shaped dielectric microcavities, a substantial fraction of resonances localize on polygonal patterns in real space, are chiral, and their momentum distributions accumulate near the critical line for total internal reflection. Despite the extensive investigation, the physical mechanism responsible for their remarkable abundance has remained a long-standing question. Addressing this, we reveal a physical correspondence between an inhomogeneous-loss Hatano-Nelson model and the dielectric phase space of a spiral microcavity. We show that the combination of geometry-induced momentum drift and refractive escape yields a generalized non-Hermitian skin effect in the phase space momentum. We identify this mechanism as the origin of the critical-line localization of resonances in open chaotic spiral microcavities, extending the skin-effect concept beyond nonreciprocal lattices to phase space and to open chaotic wave systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“揭示物理对应”“提出广义非厄米趋肤效应机制”，属于理论建模与分析，未提及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：开放螺旋形介电微腔中的共振局域化现象，具体为实空间多边形手性局域模式及其在相空间动量中的临界线局域化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 螺旋微腔中几何诱导的动量漂移与折射逃逸共同产生相空间动量中的广义非厄米趋肤效应，该效应是开放混沌螺旋微腔中临界线局域化的物理根源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：螺旋微腔中几何诱导的动量漂移与折射逃逸共同产生相空间动量中的广义非厄米趋肤效应，该效应是开放混沌螺旋微腔中临界线局域化的物理根源。；创新点：将非厄米趋肤效应的概念从非互易晶格推广到相空间，并首次将其应用于开放混沌波系统，解释了长期未明的螺旋微腔中临界线局域共振丰度问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论对应方法：将非均匀损耗的Hatano-Nelson模型与螺旋微腔的介电相空间建立映射，通过非厄米趋肤效应的推广框架分析相空间动量动力学。

papers.title: Parametric amplification in a Kerr Oscillator based on Ne FIB Nanobridges
papers.abstract: Superconducting circuits play a crucial role in the advancement of quantum computing and quantum sensing. Typically such circuits require the presence of a non-linear element, where the engineered anharmonicity (Kerr factor) and resonant linewidth determine the potential applications of the circuit. In this work we have fabricated Nb-based CPW resonators embedded with a DC SQUID incorporating Nb nanobridges as the weak links. We use two-tone spectroscopy to study the non-linear behaviour of the device at 15 mK up to a field of 2.48 mT. Under the application of a blue-detuned pump, the device shows a decrease in the resonant frequency which is used to estimate the Kerr factor. We further apply a red-detuned pump to go beyond the bifurcation threshold and observe the appearance of an additional idler mode with net gain. The gain of the device was maximized by further decreasing the pump frequency, showing a maximum amplification of 15 dB. Finally, we show agreement between the Kerr non-linear oscillator model and the measured transmission spectrum, and highlight further design modifications to improve the gain and bandwidth of such devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了器件制备（fabricated）、测量（two-tone spectroscopy, at 15 mK, up to a field of 2.48 mT）以及实验观测（gain, transmission spectrum）。；研究对象：基于Nb纳米桥（Nb nanobridges）作为弱连接的DC SQUID嵌入Nb基共面波导（CPW）谐振器构成的超导非线性器件（Kerr振荡器）。研究其非线性行为、参量放大效应及Kerr非线性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在蓝失谐泵浦下器件谐振频率降低，可用于估算Kerr因子；在红失谐泵浦下越过分岔阈值后出现具有净增益的额外idler模式，通过进一步降低泵浦频率获得最大15 dB的放大增益。实验透射谱与Kerr非线性振荡器模型吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在蓝失谐泵浦下器件谐振频率降低，可用于估算Kerr因子；在红失谐泵浦下越过分岔阈值后出现具有净增益的额外idler模式，通过进一步降低泵浦频率获得最大15 dB的放大增益。实验透射谱与Kerr非线性振荡器模型吻合。；创新点：利用聚焦离子束（FIB）制备的Nb纳米桥作为弱连接构建DC SQUID嵌入谐振器，在超导电路中实现参量放大，并系统表征了Kerr非线性及放大性能；摘要未突出说明与已有器件的具体性能对比优势，但指出了进一步设计改进方向（增益和带宽）。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：Nb基CPW谐振器嵌入含Nb纳米桥的DC SQUID；双音谱（two-tone spectroscopy）测量；在15 mK温度、最高2.48 mT磁场下进行；施加蓝失谐泵浦（估算Kerr因子）和红失谐泵浦（实现参量放大）；测量透射谱并与Kerr非线性振荡器模型对比。

papers.title: Quantum optomechanics with arbitrary mirror displacement: nonlinear Langevin equation with non-Markovian back-action noises
papers.abstract: Quantum optomechanics (QOM) explores the interaction between a quantum field, often confined in a cavity, and the quantum motion of mirrors, membranes or material media, usually assumed slow enough with negligible particle production, which is the central concern of dynamical Casimir effects, and a drive laser field for effective control. This rapidly developing field has a wide range of applications, from quantum sensing to the detection of gravitational waves. Because the opto-mechanical coupling is nonlinear, most theoretical investigations assume that the amplitude of mirror motion $x$ remains small. Recent years saw several papers treating $x^2, x^3$ orders in the mirror displacement. In our work we take a different route, deploying the functional perturbative method presented in [1] and enriched in [2], applicable for sufficiently weak opto-mechanical couplings. With this we can treat arbitrary displacement of the mirror, not just at a higher order in a power series expansion in $x$. We first derive the influence action of the quantum field and its non-Markovian noises back-reacting on the moving mirror with self-consistency. From it we derive a nonlinear Langevin equation driven by these back-action noises from the quantum field. We then show how results from our general modeling and treatment can be linked with the models and the Langevin equations presented in the literature, starting with the popular radiation pressure $Nx$ coupling, with $N$ the photon number, up to the recent $x^3$ order results. We hope this new approach and the results presented here can provide useful theoretical support for high precision QOM experimentation in the future.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：functional perturbative method、derive、theoretical support。；研究对象：量子光力学（QOM）系统，具体为腔中量子场与可任意位移的移动镜面之间的相互作用，涉及非马尔可夫反作用噪声和非线性朗之万方程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过泛函微扰方法，在弱光-机耦合条件下，可处理镜面任意位移（而非仅在小位移或x²、x³阶展开），并自洽地导出由量子场反作用噪声驱动的非线性朗之万方程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过泛函微扰方法，在弱光-机耦合条件下，可处理镜面任意位移（而非仅在小位移或x²、x³阶展开），并自洽地导出由量子场反作用噪声驱动的非线性朗之万方程。；创新点：不同于以往仅在小位移或高阶幂级数展开（x²、x³）中处理镜面运动，本工作可在弱耦合条件下处理任意大小的镜面位移，并建立了与文献中多种朗之万方程模型的统一联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用文献[1]提出、文献[2]扩展的泛函微扰方法，推导量子场的影响作用（influence action）及其非马尔可夫噪声，进而得到非线性朗之万方程，并与文献中已有的辐射压Nx耦合及x³阶结果进行对比。

papers.title: Algorithmic threshold for high-dimensional projection pursuit I: general theory
papers.abstract: We study a null model of high-dimensional projection pursuit: we are given $M$ points sampled i.i.d. from a standard gaussian in $N$ dimensions, where $M,N\to\infty$ with $M/N\toα\in(0,\infty)$. Our goal is to characterize the possible empirical distributions of these points' projections along a data-dependent direction $x$, which ranges over either the sphere $S_N=\sqrt{N}\mathbb{S}^{N-1}$ or cube $Σ_N=\{-1,+1\}^N$. We consider this problem in an algorithmic setting, where $x$ must be the output of an algorithm with dimension-free Lipschitz dependence on the input; this class of algorithms includes general gradient-based methods such as Langevin dynamics and approximate message passing (AMP). Our main result exactly characterizes the set of empirical distributions attainable by this class in terms of a one-dimensional stochastic control problem. As a consequence of our main result, we obtain exact algorithmic thresholds for optimizing the Hamiltonian of a spherical or Ising perceptron model with general bounded continuous activation. For the spherical problem, independent work of Montanari and Zhou (2024) characterized the empirical distributions attainable by a related two-stage AMP algorithm, also in terms of stochastic control. Our proof of hardness builds on the branching overlap gap property introduced in earlier work by the first two authors. Our main innovation is to develop stochastic control theory within the branching OGP framework, significantly expanding the settings in which it locates an exact algorithmic threshold. Notably, our methods apply even though the non-algorithmic problem of characterizing all feasible projections remains a major outstanding challenge. For the matching algorithmic result, we construct a new incremental AMP algorithm that acts on a Brownian-bridge revelation of the gaussian disorder and simulates the same family of controlled SDEs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确讨论“null model”“algorithmic setting”“stochastic control problem”“proof of hardness”等，属于数学与统计物理交叉的理论分析，无实验或数值模拟描述。；研究对象：高维投影寻踪的零模型：在N维标准高斯分布中独立采样M个点（M/N→α），研究其沿数据依赖方向x（球面或超立方体）投影的经验分布。物理上对应球形或Ising感知器模型的哈密顿量优化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 精确刻画了具有无维Lipschitz依赖性的算法类（含梯度方法、Langevin动力学、AMP）所能达到的投影经验分布集合，并由此得到球形/Ising感知器模型哈密顿量优化的精确算法阈值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：精确刻画了具有无维Lipschitz依赖性的算法类（含梯度方法、Langevin动力学、AMP）所能达到的投影经验分布集合，并由此得到球形/Ising感知器模型哈密顿量优化的精确算法阈值。；创新点：将随机控制理论引入分支OGP框架，显著扩展了该框架能定位精确算法阈值的适用范围；且即便非算法问题（刻画所有可行投影）仍未解决，方法依然适用。摘要未突出说明与Montanari-Zhou（2024）工作的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：一维随机控制问题；分支重叠间隙性质（branching OGP）；构造增量AMP算法，作用于高斯无序的布朗桥揭示过程，模拟受控SDE族。

papers.title: Quantum work extraction from partial information and with finite resources
papers.abstract: Information can be converted into work, but in quantum mechanics information about a state is not freely available: it must be inferred statistically from measurements on a finite number of copies. We study work extraction in this finite-resource setting by introducing a partial-information and finite-resources (PIFR) quantum Maxwell's demon. Given $N$ identical copies of a state with known Hamiltonian, the demon measures $M$ copies to estimate the state and the corresponding ergotropic unitary, which is then applied to the remaining $N-M$ copies. This protocol induces a trade-off between information acquisition, reconstruction accuracy, and thermodynamic yield, making the total extracted work normalized to the ideal ergotropic benchmark the relevant figure of merit. As our central result, we derive a universal closed-form trade-off bound that places this ergotropic efficiency between a Carnot-type ceiling $1-M/N$ and a floor controlled by a reconstruction precision rooted in finite-sample quantum estimation theory; optimizing the copy allocation yields $M^*\propto N^{2/3}$ and an $N^{-1/3}$ approach to the ideal limit, set by a conservative, worst-case reconstruction precision. By considering standard quantum state tomography, we numerically verify the presence of an optimal resource distribution, which also depends on the purity of the state under consideration. Our results identify finite-copy work extraction as a genuinely task-dependent inference problem, in which estimation strategies should be judged by thermodynamic performance rather than reconstruction fidelity alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“我们研究”“我们推导”“数值验证”等理论推导与数值模拟表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：量子热力学中的信息-功转换问题，具体为有限资源（有限拷贝数）条件下，基于部分信息提取量子功的麦克斯韦妖协议。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出一个普适的闭式权衡界，将“ergotropic效率”限制在Carnot型上限1−M/N与由有限样本量子估计理论决定的重构精度下限之间；最优拷贝分配满足M*∝N^(2/3)，且理想极限的逼近速度为N^(−1/3)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出一个普适的闭式权衡界，将“ergotropic效率”限制在Carnot型上限1−M/N与由有限样本量子估计理论决定的重构精度下限之间；最优拷贝分配满足M*∝N^(2/3)，且理想极限的逼近速度为N^(−1/3)。；创新点：将有限拷贝条件下的功提取问题明确刻画为任务依赖的统计推断问题，提出以热力学性能（ergotropic效率）而非单纯重构保真度作为估计策略的评判标准，并给出普适的闭式权衡界。摘要未突出说明与已有具体工作的对比差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为量子信息论与量子热力学结合，具体包括：部分信息与有限资源（PIFR）麦克斯韦妖协议设计、ergotropic幺正操作、有限样本量子估计理论（用于重构精度分析）、标准量子态层析（数值验证），以及优化拷贝分配（M*∝N^(2/3)）的解析推导。

papers.title: Convex conservation of von Neumann entropy implies unitarity or antiunitarity
papers.abstract: On the space of density matrices $D(H)$, Kadison's theorem establishes that all invertible convex transformations $K:D(H)\to D(H)$ are unitarity or antiunitary. For a finite Hilbert space, we propose a similar theorem which replaces the invertibility requirement with that of entropy conservation. Thus, we argue, the supposition of reversibility in quantum mechanics may be replaced with a principle of entropy conservation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论数学定理（Kadison定理）及理论证明，无实验或计算关键词。；研究对象：量子力学中密度矩阵空间上的凸变换，具体为有限维希尔伯特空间上的密度矩阵集合 D(H)，关注其可逆性与熵守恒的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限维希尔伯特空间上，若将 Kadison 定理中的“可逆性”条件替换为“冯·诺依曼熵守恒”，则所有凸变换仍只能是幺正或反幺正变换。由此提出量子力学中的可逆性假设可被熵守恒原理替代。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限维希尔伯特空间上，若将 Kadison 定理中的“可逆性”条件替换为“冯·诺依曼熵守恒”，则所有凸变换仍只能是幺正或反幺正变换。由此提出量子力学中的可逆性假设可被熵守恒原理替代。；创新点：将 Kadison 定理的适用条件从“可逆性”放宽为“熵守恒”，从而在更弱的物理假设下得到相同的幺正/反幺正结论，为量子力学基本公设提供了新的替代表述。摘要未突出其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 数学证明方法，基于 Kadison 定理的推广，利用凸变换与熵守恒条件在密度矩阵空间上的约束推导结论。摘要未给出具体证明技巧。

papers.title: Anomalous Frequency Shift in Low-Loss Superconducting Granular Aluminum Resonators
papers.abstract: Superconducting high-kinetic inductance materials like granular aluminum (grAl) are a versatile part of the circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED) toolbox, provided their losses at microwave frequencies are low enough. To further advance the use of grAl in quantum devices, it is indispensable to identify the dominant loss mechanisms. The standard approach pairs electromagnetic simulations of resonator geometry with measured temperature and power dependence of resonance frequency and loss rate. Most materials follow the phenomenological theory of two-level systems (TLSs) at low temperatures, resulting in an initial decrease of the resonance frequency with increasing temperature. In our work, we observe an opposite behavior at the lowest temperatures: The resonance frequency initially increases with both temperature and readout power, contradicting the standard TLS model predictions. We are able to explain a part of the data by an alternative mechanism associated with the effect of superconducting quasiparticles in a granular system with spatially-nonuniform gap. Yet, the observed change in the resonance frequency with temperature is not matched by a proportional change in the loss rate. We also observe anomalous positive frequency responses following high-energy events, characterized by several time scales. While anomalous behavior has been reported previously in grAl, the disagreement with standard models is particularly visible in our devices thanks to their exceptionally low loss rates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了对超导谐振器的测量（温度、功率依赖关系），并对比了电磁模拟与实验数据。；研究对象：低损耗超导颗粒铝（granular aluminum, grAl）微波谐振器，具体研究其谐振频率与损耗率在低温下的温度及功率依赖行为，以及高频能量事件后的反常频率响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在最低温度下，grAl谐振器的谐振频率随温度或读出功率升高而**增加**，与标准二能级系统（TLS）模型预测的初始下降相反；该反常频率变化与损耗率的变化不成比例，且高频能量事件后出现多时间尺度的正频率响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在最低温度下，grAl谐振器的谐振频率随温度或读出功率升高而**增加**，与标准二能级系统（TLS）模型预测的初始下降相反；该反常频率变化与损耗率的变化不成比例，且高频能量事件后出现多时间尺度的正频率响应。；创新点：在极低损耗的grAl器件中清晰展示了与标准TLS模型相矛盾的反常频率位移，并指出准粒子非均匀能隙机制可部分解释该现象；摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 电磁仿真结合谐振器几何结构，测量谐振频率和损耗率随温度与功率的变化；利用超导准粒子在空间非均匀能隙颗粒系统中的效应解释部分数据；观测高能事件后的瞬态频率响应。

papers.title: Probabilistic generation of two-mode binomial cat states using cross-Kerr interactions
papers.abstract: Superpositions of macroscopically distinct coherent states, or cat states, are a key resource for quantum technologies. In particular, two-mode binomial cat states can give rise to exact quantum error correction in continuous-variable quantum computing. However, their preparation typically requires non-Gaussian initial states, such as Fock or NOON states, which are challenging to realize experimentally. Here, we propose a protocol to generate two-mode binomial cat states where the only requirements are Gaussian initial states in combination with heralded heterodyne measurements. Our approach utilizes cross-Kerr interactions between bosonic modes commonly realizable in superconducting circuit architectures. We show that by adjusting the input state parameters, our protocol remains robust to dissipation under realistic experimental conditions. Our work provides a practical route to realizing multinomial cat states in current experimental platforms without requiring non-Gaussian initial resources, overcoming a key limitation of existing preparation schemes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/方案提出文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we propose a protocol”“our approach utilizes”“our protocol remains robust”等表述，属于理论方案设计与分析，未提及实验数据或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：连续变量量子光学体系中的双模二项式猫态（two-mode binomial cat states），具体涉及玻色模之间的cross-Kerr相互作用，以及超导电路架构中的量子态制备。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种仅需高斯初始态和 heralded heterodyne 测量即可制备双模二项式猫态的方案，避免了以往方案中对非高斯初始态（如Fock态或NOON态）的需求；在现实耗散条件下，通过调节输入态参数，该方案仍保持鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种仅需高斯初始态和 heralded heterodyne 测量即可制备双模二项式猫态的方案，避免了以往方案中对非高斯初始态（如Fock态或NOON态）的需求；在现实耗散条件下，通过调节输入态参数，该方案仍保持鲁棒性。；创新点：首次提出仅用高斯初始态即可制备双模二项式猫态的方案，绕过了现有方案中对非高斯初始资源的依赖，为当前超导电路平台提供了更易实现的制备路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论协议设计：利用cross-Kerr相互作用（玻色模间非线性耦合），结合 heralded heterodyne 测量（条件测量）进行态制备；考虑了耗散影响下的鲁棒性分析。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如主方程模拟或解析计算）。

papers.title: Exact Haar Statistics of Planar $k$-Purity in Multipartite Quantum Systems
papers.abstract: Planar $k$-uniform states have maximally mixed reductions on every $k$-site interval of a ring. We introduce planar $k$-purity---the mean purity of those intervals---as a faithful cost function for this simultaneous constraint. For a Haar-random pure state of $n$ parties with local dimension $p$, the joint purity of two intervals depends only on their overlap. An exhaustive four-replica calculation therefore yields the complete cyclic covariance kernel and a closed variance for every $1\le k\le\lfloor n/2\rfloor$. In the balanced qubit case, $k=\lfloor n/2\rfloor$ and $N=2^n$, the variance is asymptotic to $20/(3nN^2)$ for even $n$ and $6/(nN^2)$ for odd $n$. A site-factorized permutation representation gives all raw moments and permits exact finite-sum evaluation of the skewness. Fixed-seed simulations validate nonbalanced qubit and qutrit cases, while balanced-qubit simulations through $n=10$ validate the parity formulas and finite-size skewness. Balanced planar and absolute balanced purity have the same Haar mean but different fluctuations; the planar variance is approximately $2.83$ times larger at $n=10$. Thus subsystem incidence, although invisible to every one-cut marginal distribution, controls the collective fluctuations of geometrically related cuts. Together with universal attainability and a linear number of interval constraints at balance, this provides a geometry-aware benchmark for multipartite entanglement beyond AME existence regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“Haar-random pure state”“four-replica calculation”“permutation representation”等理论推导与统计计算关键词，无实验或数值模拟为主的研究手段。；研究对象：多体量子系统中的平面k-均匀态（planar k-uniform states）及其纠缠结构，具体为环上多体纯态的平面k-纯度（planar k-purity）统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于Haar随机多体纯态，平面k-纯度（即环上所有k位区间约化态纯度的平均值）的方差具有精确的闭式表达式；在平衡量子比特情形下，方差渐近行为为偶数n时20/(3nN²)、奇数n时6/(nN²)。平面纯度与绝对平衡纯度具有相同的Haar均值但不同的涨落，平面方差在n=10时约为后者的2.83倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于Haar随机多体纯态，平面k-纯度（即环上所有k位区间约化态纯度的平均值）的方差具有精确的闭式表达式；在平衡量子比特情形下，方差渐近行为为偶数n时20/(3nN²)、奇数n时6/(nN²)。平面纯度与绝对平衡纯度具有相同的Haar均值但不同的涨落，平面方差在n=10时约为后者的2.83倍。；创新点：首次引入平面k-纯度作为同时满足环上所有k位区间最大混合约束的忠实代价函数，并给出其完整的Haar统计（方差、所有原始矩及偏度）。揭示了子系统几何位置（incidence）虽不改变单切口边际分布，却控制着几何相关切口的集体涨落，为超越AME（绝对最大纠缠）存在区域的纠缠提供几何敏感的基准。
papers.method_zh: 采用四副本（four-replica）计算方法推导两个区间纯度的联合分布，得到完整的循环协方差核；利用位点因子化的置换表示（site-factorized permutation representation）计算所有原始矩，并精确求有限和得到偏度（skewness）。数值验证采用固定随机种子模拟，覆盖非平衡量子比特、qutrit以及n≤10的平衡量子比特情形。

papers.title: Active wetting transition in cell aggregates
papers.abstract: During many biological processes, cell aggregates spread on substrates in a process of active wetting. The existing models of tissue spreading, however, do not explicitly capture the state of partial wetting, in which the cell aggregate reaches a non-zero contact angle. Here, modeling cell aggregates as active polar liquid droplets, we predict a transition between partial and complete wetting. This transition emerges from the competition between tissue surface tension and active traction forces, which is captured in an active Young-Dupré equation. The active wetting transition is discontinuous, and it features a region of parameters in which both partial and complete wetting are possible. Unlike in passive wetting, the transition depends on dynamical parameters such as the tissue viscosity and substrate friction. Finally, adding contractile intercellular active stresses leads to higher contact angles and even full dewetting. Overall, our work predicts an active wetting transition for tissues and it captures the partial wetting states often seen in experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：modeling、predict、theoretical framework（active polar liquid droplets模型）。；研究对象：细胞团聚体在基底上的主动润湿（active wetting）行为，具体关注部分润湿（非零接触角）与完全润湿之间的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细胞团聚体作为活性极性液滴，存在从部分润湿到完全润湿的主动润湿转变，该转变是不连续的（一级相变），且存在双稳态参数区间；细胞间收缩性主动应力会增大接触角甚至导致完全去润湿。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细胞团聚体作为活性极性液滴，存在从部分润湿到完全润湿的主动润湿转变，该转变是不连续的（一级相变），且存在双稳态参数区间；细胞间收缩性主动应力会增大接触角甚至导致完全去润湿。；创新点：首次在组织铺展模型中显式捕捉部分润湿状态，并预测了主动润湿转变的存在及其不连续特性；与被动润湿不同，该转变依赖于动力学参数（组织黏度、基底摩擦），且存在部分润湿与完全润湿共存的参数区间。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：将细胞团聚体视为活性极性液滴，推导了主动Young-Dupré方程，分析组织表面张力与主动牵引力之间的竞争，并引入细胞间收缩性主动应力进行扩展。

papers.title: Spin-spin effects from non-relativistic limit of Dirac-Pauli-Maxwell Lagrangian
papers.abstract: It is natural to expect that the electromagnetic spin-spin interaction has roots in a more fundamental theory: quantum electrodynamics in this case. To show this, we take the non-relativistic limit of the Dirac-Maxwell Lagrangian, using the Foldy-Wouthuysen transformation and derive the Breit interaction by an alternative approach. By adding the Pauli term (i.e., a higher-order interaction between spin and the electromagnetic field), we calculate the correction terms to electromagnetic spin-spin interactions in the non-relativistic limit. Finally, we study some of the physical effects of these terms regarding spin-spin interactions and spin-spin entanglements. Accordingly, we provide theoretical estimates that are not yet accessible with current experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：non-relativistic limit、Foldy-Wouthuysen transformation、theoretical estimates。；研究对象：电磁自旋-自旋相互作用及其相对论修正项，具体涉及Dirac-Pauli-Maxwell拉氏量的非相对论极限，以及由此产生的自旋-自旋纠缠效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Foldy-Wouthuysen变换从Dirac-Maxwell拉氏量出发可推导出Breit相互作用，加入Pauli项后得到电磁自旋-自旋相互作用的修正项，并给出目前实验尚无法探测的理论预言。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Foldy-Wouthuysen变换从Dirac-Maxwell拉氏量出发可推导出Breit相互作用，加入Pauli项后得到电磁自旋-自旋相互作用的修正项，并给出目前实验尚无法探测的理论预言。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：采用Foldy-Wouthuysen变换对Dirac-Maxwell拉氏量取非相对论极限，并加入Pauli项（自旋与电磁场的高阶相互作用）计算修正项。

papers.title: Strongly coupled quark matter in neutron stars and their mergers
papers.abstract: The discovery of the strongly-coupled quark-gluon plasma (sQGP) in high-energy heavy-ion collisions has revealed remarkable properties of matter at high temperature, with transport coefficients close to conjectured bounds from quantum field theory at strong coupling. The high sQGP collision rates imply very large energy uncertainties and the melting of quasiparticle structures. Deploying quantum many-body theory based on the self-consistent $T$-matrix approach for the sQGP at high temperature, we investigate its manifestation at high baryon density and low temperature, as present in neutron stars and their mergers. We constrain the chemical-potential dependence of the quark interaction kernel using first-principles information from Quantum Chromodynamics on baryon-number susceptibilities. Very large collisional widths persist at large density and are found to relegate superconducting phases to rather small temperatures. Instead, a strongly coupled diquark liquid prevails in the thermodynamics under the conditions relevant to neutron-star mergers. At lower densities, the diquarks take over from the single-quark contributions, suggesting a pathway toward hadronization. Our results are consistent with observational constraints on the equation of state of neutron stars, corroborating the presence of strongly coupled quark matter in the interior of these objects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：quantum many-body theory、self-consistent T-matrix approach、first-principles information from QCD。；研究对象：中子星及其并合过程中的强耦合夸克物质（strongly coupled quark matter），具体涉及高重子密度、低温度下的夸克物质热力学性质，以及强耦合夸克-胶子等离子体（sQGP）在该极端条件下的表现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中子星及其并合相关的高密度低温度条件下，夸克物质保持强耦合，且非常大的碰撞宽度抑制了超导相，使其仅存在于极低温度；取而代之的是强耦合双夸克（diquark）液体主导热力学，并在较低密度下向单夸克贡献过渡，暗示强子化路径。结果与中子星状态方程的观测约束一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中子星及其并合相关的高密度低温度条件下，夸克物质保持强耦合，且非常大的碰撞宽度抑制了超导相，使其仅存在于极低温度；取而代之的是强耦合双夸克（diquark）液体主导热力学，并在较低密度下向单夸克贡献过渡，暗示强子化路径。结果与中子星状态方程的观测约束一致。；创新点：将高温sQGP中验证的自洽T矩阵框架系统应用于中子星内部的高密度低温度区域，并用QCD第一性原理约束相互作用核，从而揭示强耦合双夸克液体而非超导相在该环境中的主导地位。摘要未突出说明与具体中子星观测数据的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于自洽T矩阵方法（self-consistent T-matrix approach）的量子多体理论，用于高温sQGP并推广至高密度低温度条件；利用QCD第一性原理给出的重子数磁化率（baryon-number susceptibilities）来约束夸克相互作用核的化学势依赖。

papers.title: Dissipation across the ultrastrong-coupling regime of nanomechanical quantum Rabi systems
papers.abstract: Mechanical resonators ultrastrongly coupled to quantum two-level systems provide a promising route towards mechanical qubits by introducing significant anharmonicity to the mechanical modes, particularly in the slow-oscillator regime. Although the resulting hybrid system is well described by the quantum Rabi model, a consistent treatment of dissipation remains challenging across the broad parameter space routinely probed in current nanotube electromechanical devices. Here, we investigate dissipation in the open quantum Rabi model using a Born-Markov framework based on the slowly varying bath spectrum approximation, yielding a Lindblad master equation applicable far beyond conventional descriptions while recovering them in their respective limits. Using this framework, we analyze experimentally accessible observables across this parameter space. As the secular approximation breaks down, phonon blockade progressively washes out. Our approach remains valid in this regime, enabling a quantitative description of the continuous evolution of phonon blockade with coupling strength and dissipation. At finite temperature, we find a suppression of the temperature-induced increase of coherence decay rate for weak anharmonicity. Under driving, our approach remains applicable to substantially stronger perturbations than conventional dressed-state master equations and shows that an apparently classical observable can coexist with Wigner negativity. We further capture the weakly anharmonic regime arising from finite detuning in the double-quantum dot. These results establish a unified description of dissipation from weakly anharmonic operating regimes to the strongly anharmonic mechanical-qubit regime and provide experimentally relevant predictions for ultrastrong electromechanical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Born-Markov framework”“Lindblad master equation”等理论方法，且未提及实验数据或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：纳米管机电系统中机械谐振子与量子二能级系统超强耦合形成的量子Rabi系统，重点研究其耗散行为及声子阻塞效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了一个适用于超强耦合宽参数空间的开放量子Rabi模型耗散描述，揭示了声子阻塞随耦合强度和耗散的连续演化，并发现弱非谐性下温度引起的相干衰减率增加被抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了一个适用于超强耦合宽参数空间的开放量子Rabi模型耗散描述，揭示了声子阻塞随耦合强度和耗散的连续演化，并发现弱非谐性下温度引起的相干衰减率增加被抑制。；创新点：提供了一个从弱非谐工作区到强非谐机械量子比特区的统一耗散描述，且在世俗近似失效（声子阻塞逐渐消失）的区间仍保持定量有效；此外，该方法可处理比常规缀饰态主方程更强的驱动扰动，并揭示了经典可观测量与Wigner负性共存的非经典特征。
papers.method_zh: 基于慢变库谱近似的Born-Markov框架，推导出超越常规描述的Lindblad主方程；在常规极限下可恢复已有结果。同时分析了驱动场下的响应，并与常规缀饰态主方程进行了对比。

papers.title: Quantum synchronization of spin-1 system: Enhanced synchronization due to additive Lindblad operators
papers.abstract: We experimentally investigate quantum synchronization for one of the simplest possible quantum systems, namely an externally driven few-level system with equally spaced energy levels effectively acting as a spin-1 system. Coupling to excited auxiliary states, we realize additive effective Lindblad operators that are associated with non-conventional dissipative pathways, which are shown to enhance, in certain parameter regimes, quantum synchronization. The experimental set-up, which utilizes cold $^{87}$Rb atoms in a MOT, and associated synchronization extraction protocol are benchmarked carefully through dedicated simulations. Convincing agreement is found between experiment and simulations. The dissipation engineering approach established in our work can be readily extended to systems with more energy levels, such as effective spin-$3/2$ or spin-$2$ systems, and has implications for quantum synchronization studies in higher-spin systems as well as for a wide range of quantum science studies and technology applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合仿真模拟验证）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimentally investigate”“experimental set-up”“dedicated simulations”“agreement between experiment and simulations”。；研究对象：自旋-1量子系统的量子同步现象。具体体系为冷⁸⁷Rb原子在磁光阱（MOT）中构成的外驱动少能级系统，能级等间距，有效等效为自旋-1系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过耦合激发辅助态，实现了与非常规耗散通道相关的附加Lindblad算符（加性Lindblad算符），在特定参数区间内可增强量子同步。实验与仿真结果吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过耦合激发辅助态，实现了与非常规耗散通道相关的附加Lindblad算符（加性Lindblad算符），在特定参数区间内可增强量子同步。实验与仿真结果吻合良好。；创新点：首次在实验上实现并验证了通过附加Lindblad算符（非常规耗散路径）增强自旋-1系统量子同步的方案；该耗散工程方法可推广至更高自旋（如自旋-3/2或自旋-2）系统，为高自旋量子同步研究提供新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用冷⁸⁷Rb原子磁光阱（MOT）装置，驱动少能级系统实现有效自旋-1；通过耦合激发辅助态工程化耗散通道（附加Lindblad算符）；同步提取协议通过专门仿真进行基准测试。

papers.title: Analysis of the Principal Components of Correlation Matrices of S&P 500 Financial Data from an Econophysics Perspective
papers.abstract: This thesis analyzes the collective dynamics of the S&P 500 from an econophysics perspective, treating the financial market as a complex system. Using daily logarithmic returns of 430 companies, time-dependent Pearson correlation matrices are constructed over sliding windows and their spectral structure is studied through the leading eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Market States (MS) are identified by applying k-Means clustering to several spectral quantities: the largest eigenvalue (interpreted as the State of the Market), the squared entries of the dominant eigenvector (read as a relative participation of each stock), and truncated matrix reconstructions C^l built from the l largest eigenpairs and normalized to retain a correlation-matrix interpretation. The stability of the resulting clusters is assessed, transition matrices and their stationary vectors are computed, and the inverse participation ratio is used to quantify how participation spreads across assets. The COVID-19 episode emerges as an atypical state in the full correlation matrices; reconstructing it requires more than one principal component, and the C^2 and C^3 constructions reproduce it, particularly for window length q=40 and k=5. During crisis periods the relative participation distributes over a larger number of assets, while the 2017-2018 interval contributes to the dynamics without appearing as an isolated regime. The analysis is descriptive rather than predictive, and provides conceptual and methodological tools relevant to portfolio design and trading strategies, with natural extensions to other international exchanges.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（数据分析/计算研究）。判断依据：使用统计物理与随机矩阵方法分析金融数据，属于计算与理论建模结合，非实验文章。；研究对象：标普500指数中430家公司的日对数收益率，作为复杂系统研究其集体动力学；具体物理现象为相关矩阵的谱结构、市场状态聚类及危机期间的参与度分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: COVID-19期间表现为非典型市场状态，需多个主成分才能重构；在窗口长度q=40、聚类数k=5时，C²和C³截断重构可复现该状态。危机期间相对参与度分散到更多资产上，而2017-2018区间仅贡献动态而不形成独立状态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：COVID-19期间表现为非典型市场状态，需多个主成分才能重构；在窗口长度q=40、聚类数k=5时，C²和C³截断重构可复现该状态。危机期间相对参与度分散到更多资产上，而2017-2018区间仅贡献动态而不形成独立状态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的明确对比，但将主成分分析、聚类与逆参与率结合用于市场状态识别，并系统评估了不同截断阶数（C²、C³）对危机状态的重构能力，属于方法整合层面的新意。
papers.method_zh: - 滑动窗口构建时间依赖的Pearson相关矩阵

papers.title: Propensity Straight-Through Gradients for Discrete Stochastic Systems
papers.abstract: Continuous-time Markov chains (CTMCs) provide the backbone for modeling discrete stochastic dynamics across applied, physical, and biological sciences. Their integration with modern gradient-based machine learning, however, is limited by the hard categorical event selection intrinsic to Gillespie-type simulation algorithms. We exploit the affine state update to obtain the exact one-step conditional-mean sensitivity by differentiating normalized reaction propensities. We pair this backward rule with exact forward trajectories to define the propensity straight-through (PST) estimator. At the trajectory level, we show that one-step sensitivities composed across events can depart from the exact multistep sensitivity. We derive the resulting per-step discrepancy in closed form and prove that it vanishes identically for affine downstream dependence. PST matches the accuracy of Gumbel-Softmax straight-through across all benchmarks: reversible dimerization (0.06% error), a genetic oscillator (1.7% error), a 50-task repressilator suite (0.17% median error), and patch-clamp ion-channel recordings ($R^2$ = 0.988). Under matched settings, PST converges 3.0-fold faster on the oscillator and 2.1-fold faster on the ion channel. At deep-learning scale, PST trains a 203,796-parameter stochastic reaction network with hard sampling, reaching 98.22% MNIST digit classification accuracy. By differentiating an exact conditional mean rather than a relaxed sample, PST offers a temperature- and Gumbel-free path to scalable gradient-based learning through exact stochastic trajectories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：gradient-based machine learning、estimator、backward rule、closed form、benchmarks。；研究对象：离散随机系统，具体为连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）描述的随机化学动力学，包括可逆二聚化、遗传振荡器、repressilator套件、离子通道记录，以及一个大规模随机反应网络（用于MNIST分类）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为“倾向直通（PST）”的梯度估计器，通过精确微分归一化反应倾向获得单步条件均值灵敏度，在多个基准上达到与Gumbel-Softmax直通相当的精度，同时训练速度更快，并能扩展到具有硬采样的深层随机反应网络。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为“倾向直通（PST）”的梯度估计器，通过精确微分归一化反应倾向获得单步条件均值灵敏度，在多个基准上达到与Gumbel-Softmax直通相当的精度，同时训练速度更快，并能扩展到具有硬采样的深层随机反应网络。；创新点：提出了一种无需温度参数和Gumbel噪声的梯度估计方法（PST），通过精确条件均值而非松弛样本进行微分，在保持精度的同时显著加速收敛，并首次将硬采样的随机反应网络扩展到深度学习规模（20万参数级）。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟结合。推导了单步条件均值灵敏度的精确反向规则，并在轨迹层面证明了多步灵敏度与单步灵敏度组合之间的偏差，给出了闭合形式的每步偏差表达式，并证明对仿射下游依赖该偏差恒为零。基准测试包括可逆二聚化、遗传振荡器、50任务repressilator套件、离子通道记录，以及一个203,796参数的随机反应网络用于MNIST分类。

papers.title: Interaction corrections to topological density three-point functions in two-dimensional Fermi liquids: a coadjoint orbit perspective
papers.abstract: Density three-point correlations are known to probe the topology of the Fermi sea in two-dimensional noninteracting systems. Here, we study how these correlations are modified by interactions using the coadjoint-orbit effective field theory. A key advantage of the coadjoint-orbit formulation is that it provides a systematic way to incorporate generalized Landau interactions in terms of bosonized degrees of freedom, mapping fermionic loop contributions onto simpler tree-level diagrams. We show that, for a general isotropic dispersion $ε(p)$, even at linear order in the generalized Landau interaction, $\mathcal{O}(\mathcal{F}^{(2,0)})$, there exists a contribution proportional to the band curvature $ε''(p_F)$ that changes the nonanalytic structure of the free density three-point correlation function. This contribution introduces a distinct nonanalytic structure beyond that found in either the noninteracting case or an interacting Galilean-invariant system, showing that interaction effects can modify the topology-detecting density three-point correlation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“有效场论”“玻色化”“树级图”等理论工具，属于凝聚态理论/场论研究。；研究对象：二维费米液体中的密度三点关联函数，重点研究其非解析结构如何受相互作用修正，以及该修正与费米海拓扑探测的联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在一般各向同性色散 ε(p) 下，即使仅考虑广义朗道相互作用的线性阶 O(𝒪(𝒻^(2,0)))，也会出现正比于能带曲率 ε''(p_F) 的贡献，改变自由费米子密度三点关联函数的非解析结构。该结构既不同于无相互作用情形，也不同于伽利略不变相互作用体系，表明相互作用可以修正用于探测拓扑的密度三点关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在一般各向同性色散 ε(p) 下，即使仅考虑广义朗道相互作用的线性阶 O(𝒪(𝒻^(2,0)))，也会出现正比于能带曲率 ε''(p_F) 的贡献，改变自由费米子密度三点关联函数的非解析结构。该结构既不同于无相互作用情形，也不同于伽利略不变相互作用体系，表明相互作用可以修正用于探测拓扑的密度三点关联。；创新点：首次在余伴随轨道框架下系统研究相互作用对密度三点关联函数（拓扑探测工具）的修正，并发现能带曲率项在朗道相互作用线性阶即可引入新的非解析结构，突破了此前仅关注无相互作用或伽利略不变情形的局限。
papers.method_zh: 采用余伴随轨道（coadjoint orbit）有效场论框架，将广义朗道相互作用系统地纳入玻色化自由度，将费米子圈图贡献映射为更简单的树级图，从而计算密度三点关联函数的相互作用修正。

papers.title: Layer-Controlled Intermolecular Coupling and Many-Body Effects in C$_{60}$ Films
papers.abstract: Crystalline C$_{60}$ is a molecular solid whose electronic properties emerge from the interplay of intermolecular hopping, electron correlations, and electron-vibration coupling. Unlike moir$\rm\acute{e}$ van der Waals heterostructures, where interaction strength is commonly tuned by twist angle, molecular materials offer a complementary route in which layer number, molecular orientation, and substrate registry provide experimentally accessible control parameters. Here we present a systematic thickness-dependent angle-resolved photoemission study of C$_{60}$ films, spanning the monolayer to the bulk limit. The HOMO-derived band exhibits a non-monotonic evolution: the intermediate-thickness film shows larger bandwidth, reduced effective mass, and pronounced gap-like and sub-band features. The experimental trends, together with Holstein-model simulations, point to strengthened effective intermolecular electronic coupling and enhanced electron-phonon-induced spectral renormalization in the intermediate-thickness regime. These results identify a dimensional crossover in C$_{60}$ films and establish layer number as an effective knob for engineering electronic structure and many-body interactions in molecular thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论模拟）。判断依据：关键词为“角度分辨光电子能谱研究（angle-resolved photoemission study）”、“实验趋势（experimental trends）”，并辅以“Holstein模型模拟（Holstein-model simulations）”。；研究对象：C₆₀（富勒烯）分子晶体薄膜，具体研究其从单层到体相极限的厚度依赖电子结构，以及层数调控的分子间耦合与多体效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: C₆₀薄膜的HOMO衍生能带随厚度呈非单调演化：中等厚度薄膜表现出更大的带宽、更小的有效质量，以及明显的类能隙和子带特征，表明该厚度区间存在增强的有效分子间电子耦合和电子-声子耦合引起的光谱重整化，即维度交叉行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：C₆₀薄膜的HOMO衍生能带随厚度呈非单调演化：中等厚度薄膜表现出更大的带宽、更小的有效质量，以及明显的类能隙和子带特征，表明该厚度区间存在增强的有效分子间电子耦合和电子-声子耦合引起的光谱重整化，即维度交叉行为。；创新点：不同于通过扭转角调控相互作用的莫尔异质结，该工作提出并验证了在分子材料中以“层数”作为有效调控旋钮，实现对电子结构和多体相互作用的工程化调控，并首次系统揭示了C₆₀薄膜中的维度交叉现象。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用厚度依赖的角度分辨光电子能谱（ARPES），覆盖从单层到体相极限的薄膜；理论上使用Holstein模型进行数值模拟，以解释实验光谱趋势。

papers.title: Solvable relaxation in discrete unitary systems: Ruelle-Pollicott resonances and CMV matrices
papers.abstract: Leading eigenvalues of the truncated propagator, known as Ruelle-Pollicott (RP) resonances, are an elegant way of addressing the dynamics of unitary many-body systems. We study unitary propagators in their canonical form, known in the mathematical literature as the CMV matrices, and obtain a number of exact results for RP resonances and the associated norm-diverging eigenvectors. For the simplest CMV class describing a unilateral shift with an impurity, motivated by operator dynamics in dual-unitary circuits, we obtain closed-form results and in particular show that the three independent ways of obtaining RP resonances -- the truncated propagator, analytic continuation of the resolvent, and the rigged Hilbert space approach -- all give the same results. In more realistic CMV matrices, in which shift-like operator dynamics characteristic of chaotic systems is only asymptotic, we rely on the rich theory of orthogonal polynomials on the unit circle and identify two phases. In the first phase, relaxation occurs due to local operators effectively evolving into increasingly nonlocal ones with negligible backflow. Especially interesting is the second phase, which, surprisingly, exhibits faster relaxation because of contributions from the backflow of large operators. Additionally, in the second phase, RP resonances are not equal to the eigenvalues of the truncated propagator, instead, they are ``hidden'' within a ring of ill-conditioned eigenvalues.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“exact results”“analytic continuation”“rigged Hilbert space approach”等纯理论推导关键词，无实验或数值模拟描述。；研究对象：离散幺正系统中的弛豫动力学，具体为CMV矩阵（幺正传播子的正则形式）及其对应的Ruelle-Pollicott（RP）共振。物理背景包括dual-unitary电路中的算符动力学，以及单位圆上正交多项式理论描述的混沌系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于最简单的CMV类（带杂质的单侧移位），三种独立方法（截断传播子、解析延拓、rigged Hilbert空间）得到的RP共振完全一致；对于更现实的CMV矩阵，存在两个弛豫相：第一相弛豫源于局域算符演化为非局域算符且回流可忽略，第二相因大算符回流反而弛豫更快，且此时RP共振不等于截断传播子本征值，而是“隐藏”在病态本征值环中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于最简单的CMV类（带杂质的单侧移位），三种独立方法（截断传播子、解析延拓、rigged Hilbert空间）得到的RP共振完全一致；对于更现实的CMV矩阵，存在两个弛豫相：第一相弛豫源于局域算符演化为非局域算符且回流可忽略，第二相因大算符回流反而弛豫更快，且此时RP共振不等于截断传播子本征值，而是“隐藏”在病态本征值环中。；创新点：首次在CMV矩阵框架下系统证明三种独立RP共振提取方法的一致性，并发现第二相中RP共振与截断传播子本征值的偏离及其“隐藏”机制，揭示了回流对弛豫速率的非直觉加速效应。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：CMV矩阵的幺正传播子形式、Ruelle-Pollicott共振分析、截断传播子本征值方法、预解式解析延拓、rigged Hilbert空间方法，以及单位圆上正交多项式理论。

papers.title: Super-resolution Control of Two-dimensional Quantum Emitters
papers.abstract: Localized interlayer excitons in semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers are quantum emitters with a static electric dipole moment, making them excellent nanoscale charge sensors to probe correlated quantum phases in a proximal layer. These emitters are electrically tunable and inherit spin-valley selection rules, yet their deterministic spatial control remains challenging due to subwavelength confinement. Here, we present a platform that combines cryogenic optical spectroscopy with scanning probe microscopy to investigate trapped interlayer excitons in WSe$_2$/MoSe$_2$ bilayers. By exploiting AFM-based local Stark shift, we achieve super-resolution localization of emitters separated by only a few tens of nanometers and demonstrate deterministic control of individual charge states, including trion formation, opening a path towards coherent inter-dot coupling. Time-resolved measurements reveal tip-induced modification of the electromagnetic vacuum around individual emitters, thus controlling their radiative emission. Our multi-point charge sensing platform with optical readout is particularly well-suited to study fractionalization and anyon dynamics in semiconducting FCIs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“cryogenic optical spectroscopy”“scanning probe microscopy”“AFM-based local Stark shift”“Time-resolved measurements”等实验手段。；研究对象：WSe₂/MoSe₂ 异质双层中的局域层间激子（量子发射体），以及其作为纳米尺度电荷传感器探测近邻层关联量子相（如分数量子霍尔态）的潜力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过AFM针尖诱导的局域斯塔克位移，实现了对相距仅数十纳米的量子发射体的超分辨定位，并能确定性调控单个发射体的电荷态（包括三子形成），同时针尖可改变单个发射体周围的电磁真空从而调控其辐射发射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过AFM针尖诱导的局域斯塔克位移，实现了对相距仅数十纳米的量子发射体的超分辨定位，并能确定性调控单个发射体的电荷态（包括三子形成），同时针尖可改变单个发射体周围的电磁真空从而调控其辐射发射。；创新点：将扫描探针的局域电场调控与低温光学读出结合，实现了对亚波长尺度量子发射体的确定性空间定位和电荷态操控，并展示了针尖对辐射衰变速率（Purcell效应）的调控，为研究半导体分数量子霍尔态中的分数化与任意子动力学提供了多触点电荷传感平台。
papers.method_zh: 低温光学光谱与扫描探针显微镜联用平台；基于AFM的局域斯塔克位移实现超分辨定位；时间分辨光学测量研究针尖对电磁真空的修饰。

papers.title: A Three-Fluid Model of Dissipation at Surfaces in Superconducting Radiofrequency Cavities
papers.abstract: Experiments on superconducting cavities have found that under large RF fields the quality factor can improve with increasing field amplitude, a so-called ``anti-Q slope.'' We numerically solve the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations at a superconducting surface in a parallel magnetic field, finding at large fields there are surface quasiparticle states with energies below the bulk superconducting gap that emerge and disappear as the field cycles. Modifying the standard two-fluid model, we introduce a ``three''-fluid model where we partition the normal fluid to consider continuum and surface quasiparticle states separately. We compute dissipation in a semi-classical theory of conductivity, where we provide physical estimates of elastic scattering times of Bogoliubov quasiparticles with point-like impurities having potential strengths informed from complementary \textit{ab initio} calculations of impurities in bulk niobium. We show, in this simple yet effective framework, how the relative scattering rates of surface and continuum quasiparticle states can play a role in producing an anti-Q slope while demonstrating how this model naturally includes a mechanism for turning the anti-Q slope on and off.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“numerically solve the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations”“semi-classical theory of conductivity”“ab initio calculations”，属于数值求解与理论建模相结合的工作。；研究对象：超导射频腔（SRF cavities）表面在强射频磁场下的耗散行为，具体涉及超导铌（niobium）表面的准粒子态，以及“反Q斜率”（anti-Q slope）现象——即品质因子随场幅增大而改善的异常行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强平行磁场下，超导表面会出现能量低于体超导能隙的表面准粒子态，这些态随场周期性地出现和消失；通过将正常流体进一步划分为连续态和表面准粒子态（三流体模型），发现两者的相对弹性散射率差异可以产生反Q斜率，且该模型天然包含反Q斜率开启与关闭的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强平行磁场下，超导表面会出现能量低于体超导能隙的表面准粒子态，这些态随场周期性地出现和消失；通过将正常流体进一步划分为连续态和表面准粒子态（三流体模型），发现两者的相对弹性散射率差异可以产生反Q斜率，且该模型天然包含反Q斜率开启与关闭的机制。；创新点：在标准二流体模型基础上引入“三流体”划分，将正常流体区分为连续态和表面准粒子态，并首次在该框架内将表面态与连续态的散射率差异与反Q斜率现象直接联系起来，同时提供了该效应的开关机制。
papers.method_zh: 数值求解 Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）方程，模拟超导表面在平行磁场中的准粒子谱；采用半经典电导理论计算耗散；弹性散射时间通过点状杂质模型估算，杂质势强度参考铌体材料中杂质的从头计算（ab initio）结果。

papers.title: Machine learned designs of functional colloidal foldamers
papers.abstract: A protein's function follows from the structure it adopts, and which structure that is depends on the pathway taken. In programmable matter the target is fixed before assembly, and whatever else forms is treated as error. Here we show that pathways themselves form a design space. Using reinforcement learning, we fold model DNA-coated droplet chains into rigid two-dimensional geometries, uncovering two classes of pathways: downhill, in which bonds are only added, and detour, in which bonds are broken and remade before the target is reached: for some the only route that exists. Coarse-graining pathways by interactions gives experimentally realizable protocols. Some produce one geometry, others several: structures sharing a detour route can be cycled between, while those that coexist assemble into superstructures inaccessible to a uniform product. Function emerges from the pathways rather than being designed. Designing the process instead of the components could give colloidal materials that reconfigure and repair themselves on demand.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“using reinforcement learning”（使用强化学习）、“fold model DNA-coated droplet chains”（折叠模型DNA包被液滴链），属于计算模拟研究。；研究对象：DNA包被的液滴链（DNA-coated droplet chains）作为胶体折叠体（colloidal foldamers），研究其折叠路径（pathways）作为设计空间，以及由此产生的可重构、自修复胶体材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 折叠路径本身构成一个设计空间，可分为“下坡路径”（只添加键）和“绕行路径”（先断键再成键）两类；某些目标几何结构只有绕行路径才能实现。通过粗粒化路径可获得实验可实现的协议，且不同结构若共享绕行路径可在其间循环切换，共存结构可组装成均匀产物无法形成的超结构——功能源于路径而非预先设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：折叠路径本身构成一个设计空间，可分为“下坡路径”（只添加键）和“绕行路径”（先断键再成键）两类；某些目标几何结构只有绕行路径才能实现。通过粗粒化路径可获得实验可实现的协议，且不同结构若共享绕行路径可在其间循环切换，共存结构可组装成均匀产物无法形成的超结构——功能源于路径而非预先设计。；创新点：将设计对象从“目标结构”转变为“折叠路径本身”，提出路径作为设计空间的新范式，使材料具备按需重构和自修复能力。摘要未突出说明与已有折叠体设计工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 强化学习（reinforcement learning）用于折叠模型DNA包被液滴链；通过相互作用对路径进行粗粒化（coarse-graining）以获得实验可实现的协议。

papers.title: Switchable chiral antiferromagnetism through nonlinear magnetic susceptibility
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnets (AFM) have attracted considerable attention in recent years because a number of nontrivial, technologically relevant properties associated with time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking are discovered in many materials. However, time-reversal (TR) partners of AFM states are generally challenging to be selected deterministically except in a few cases with nonzero net magnetization. Recently, it has been shown that the TR partners of the kagome spin ice ground state in HoAgGe with strictly zero net magnetization can be selected through a nonlinear magnetic susceptibility $χ^{(1)}$. In this work, we generalize this scenario to a broad class of chiral AFM with zero net magnetization but field-switchable ground states through $χ^{(1)}$. After a general discussion of $χ^{(1)}$ and its symmetry constraints, we first present a first-principles formalism for calculating it including both mean-field and self-consistent corrections, and then apply the approach to the noncollinear AFM family Mn$_3X$N ($X=$ Ni, Ag, Ga, Zn, Sn) in the $Γ_{5g}$ phase. An intuitive picture of the origin of $χ^{(1)}$ in similar noncollinear AFM is illustrated using 3-sublattice toy model. The model also predicts a nontrivial temperature dependence of $χ^{(1)}$ due to competitions between the longitudinal and transverse single-spin susceptibilities. Our work shows that nonlinear susceptibility can serve as a general protocol for accessing and switching TR partners in fully compensated AFM.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“first-principles formalism”“mean-field and self-consistent corrections”“toy model”等关键词，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：具有零净磁化强度但可通过非线性磁化率χ^(1)实现场切换的手性反铁磁体。具体材料为Mn₃X N（X = Ni, Ag, Ga, Zn, Sn）家族中的Γ₅g相非共线反铁磁结构，以及用于概念说明的3-子格玩具模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性磁化率χ^(1)可作为通用协议，在完全补偿（零净磁化）反铁磁体中实现时间反演伙伴态的选择与切换，推广了此前仅在HoAgGe kagome自旋冰中展示的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性磁化率χ^(1)可作为通用协议，在完全补偿（零净磁化）反铁磁体中实现时间反演伙伴态的选择与切换，推广了此前仅在HoAgGe kagome自旋冰中展示的机制。；创新点：将非线性磁化率切换时间反演伙伴态的机制从特定材料（HoAgGe）推广到一类广泛的手性反铁磁体，并建立了第一性原理计算χ^(1)的完整形式化方法；玩具模型揭示了纵向与横向单自旋磁化率竞争导致的χ^(1)非平凡温度依赖。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算框架（包含平均场与自洽修正）用于计算χ^(1)；结合3-子格玩具模型给出χ^(1)起源的直观图像，并分析其温度依赖行为。

papers.title: Hierarchical organization governs nonlinear mechanical reversibility in $ι$-carrageenan gels
papers.abstract: Carrageenan gels are thermoreversible polysaccharide networks whose mechanical properties emerge from ion-mediated helix association, yet how their molecular organization controls nonlinear deformation remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the temperature-dependent rheology of $ι$-carrageenan gels formed in KCl solutions using linear and nonlinear oscillatory rheology combined with normal-force measurements. $ι$-carrageenan forms homogeneous and mechanically reversible gels whose elastic modulus increases continuously with quench depth. Deep quenches generate pronounced strain stiffening before yielding, associated with the development of internal stresses revealed by negative normal forces. Remarkably, large deformations preserve the small-strain elastic modulus while progressively suppressing strain stiffening, demonstrating a partial mechanical reversibility of the network. We interpret these observations using a hierarchical network picture in which a persistent intermolecular network controls linear elasticity, while a more fragile mesoscale organization enables cooperative alignment and stress amplification under deformation. Our results highlight that nonlinear mechanics of thermoreversible polysaccharide gels are governed not only by molecular connectivity, but also by the reversible formation and eventually destruction of mechanically adaptive hierarchical structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“rheology”“normal-force measurements”“oscillatory rheology”等实验手段。；研究对象：ι-卡拉胶（ι-carrageenan）在KCl溶液中形成的热可逆多糖凝胶，重点研究其层级分子组织对非线性力学响应（应变硬化、屈服、内应力）的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ι-卡拉胶凝胶的弹性模量随淬火深度增加而连续增大，深淬火产生显著应变硬化并伴随负法向力（内应力）；大变形后小应变弹性模量保持，但应变硬化被抑制，表明网络具有部分力学可逆性。非线性力学由持久分子间网络（控制线性弹性）和脆弱介观组织（控制协同排列与应力放大）共同决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ι-卡拉胶凝胶的弹性模量随淬火深度增加而连续增大，深淬火产生显著应变硬化并伴随负法向力（内应力）；大变形后小应变弹性模量保持，但应变硬化被抑制，表明网络具有部分力学可逆性。非线性力学由持久分子间网络（控制线性弹性）和脆弱介观组织（控制协同排列与应力放大）共同决定。；创新点：提出层级网络图像：持久分子间网络与可逆形成的介观组织分别主导线性与非线性力学响应，揭示热可逆多糖凝胶的非线性力学不仅由分子连接性决定，还受力学自适应层级结构的可逆形成与破坏调控。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 线性与非线性振荡流变学（oscillatory rheology）结合法向力测量（normal-force measurements），研究温度依赖的流变行为。

papers.title: Modifying van der Waals Materials via Cavity Vacuum Fluctuations
papers.abstract: In the field of cavity quantum materials, vacuum fluctuations of optical cavities are used for modifying ground-state properties of quantum materials without external driving. Here, one example is the van der Waals (vdW)/dispersion interaction in layered 2D vdW materials, where non-additive long-range correlations can dominate the interlayer binding. While cavity-induced changes of such interactions have been predicted and described using ab initio methods for molecular systems, no efficient description exists yet for extended materials. In this Letter, we close this gap by introducing a periodic formulation of the photon many-body dispersion (pMBD) functional within quantum electrodynamical density-functional theory (QEDFT).
