Phase-contrast tomograms acquired sequentially under the same experimental geometry provide co-registered structural context. F3CT provides a high-throughput route to 3D XRF imaging and establishes a foundation for correlated structural and chemical tomography, with potential for future in-situ and operando implementations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了一种基于同步辐射的成像技术（F3CT），并展示了在生物和地质样品上的实验演示。；研究对象：三维元素分布成像，具体包括斑马鱼组织中的银染分布和岩芯样品中的高能荧光信号；同时涉及与结构成像（相位衬度断层扫描）的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: F3CT技术实现了在全场照明条件下无需光栅扫描的三维元素分布成像，并能与同一几何构型下采集的相位衬度断层图像进行配准，从而同时获得结构和化学信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：F3CT技术实现了在全场照明条件下无需光栅扫描的三维元素分布成像，并能与同一几何构型下采集的相位衬度断层图像进行配准，从而同时获得结构和化学信息。；创新点：避免了传统XRF成像中的光栅扫描，通过全场照明和虚拟锥束针孔几何实现高通量三维元素成像，并建立了结构-化学联合断层成像的基础，为未来原位和操作条件实验提供了可能。
papers.method_zh: 同步辐射高光谱全场荧光计算机断层扫描（F3CT），结合针孔孔径与能量分辨二维探测器；采用虚拟锥束模型和两阶段标定-重建工作流；相位衬度断层扫描用于结构成像。

papers.title: Inclination-Induced Crossover in the Velocity Scaling of Lubrication-Mediated Droplet Motion
papers.abstract: We experimentally investigate the creeping motion of water droplets sliding along an inclined surface immersed in a viscous oil. The droplet velocity, width, and height are measured over a broad range of droplet sizes and inclination angles. The velocity increases with droplet radius according to a power law, but the corresponding exponent depends strongly on the inclination angle. At small inclinations, the exponent is close to 3/2, whereas at larger inclinations it progressively approaches 9/4. The results therefore reveal a continuous inclination-induced crossover in the velocity-size scaling of lubrication-mediated droplet motion. A scaling analysis based on Landau-Levich-Derjaguin film formation and viscous dissipation in the dynamic meniscus reproduces these limiting behaviors, which correspond to the quasi-spherical and pancake scaling regimes, respectively. Remarkably, the evolution of the velocity scaling is substantially more pronounced than the corresponding evolution of the macroscopic droplet shape. While the velocity data progressively approach the pancake scaling law at large inclinations, the global droplet dimensions evolve in a more complex manner than expected from a simple pancake-shape picture. In particular, the approach to pancake-like velocity scaling occurs even when the measured droplet dimensions remain far from the corresponding pancake-limit geometry. These observations suggest a crossover in the dominant lubrication-dissipation mechanism beneath the droplet that is not directly reflected in the global droplet morphology. The results identify inclination angle as a key control parameter governing lubrication-mediated droplet motion and highlight the distinction between global shape evolution and local dissipation dynamics in liquid-liquid systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“We experimentally investigate”，并包含对速度、宽度、高度等物理量的直接测量。；研究对象：液-液体系中润滑介导的液滴运动，具体为浸没在粘性油中的水滴沿倾斜表面的爬行运动，重点关注液滴速度与尺寸的标度关系及其随倾斜角度的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液滴速度随半径呈幂律增长，但幂指数随倾斜角度发生连续交叉：小角度时接近3/2，大角度时趋近9/4，分别对应准球形和薄饼（pancake）标度区。值得注意的是，速度标度的演化远强于宏观液滴形状的演化，表明主导的润滑耗散机制发生了交叉，而这一交叉并未直接反映在液滴整体形貌中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液滴速度随半径呈幂律增长，但幂指数随倾斜角度发生连续交叉：小角度时接近3/2，大角度时趋近9/4，分别对应准球形和薄饼（pancake）标度区。值得注意的是，速度标度的演化远强于宏观液滴形状的演化，表明主导的润滑耗散机制发生了交叉，而这一交叉并未直接反映在液滴整体形貌中。；创新点：首次揭示倾斜角度作为润滑介导液滴运动的关键控制参数，可连续调控速度-尺寸标度指数；并明确指出局部耗散动力学与全局液滴形貌演化之间的解耦——即速度标度趋近薄饼极限时，液滴几何尺寸仍远离薄饼形状，这一区分在以往研究中未被突出。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量：在不同液滴尺寸和倾斜角度下，系统测量水滴沿倾斜表面滑动的速度、宽度和高度；理论分析：基于Landau-Levich-Derjaguin（LLD）薄膜形成和动态弯月面中的粘性耗散进行标度分析，以解释两种极限标度行为。

papers.title: Three-dimensional optical vortices in nonlinear Bessel waveguides
papers.abstract: We explore the formation, stability, and propagation dynamics of light bullets carrying orbital angular momentum (vorticity) in Bessel-structured nonlinear graded-index waveguides. While these waves are prone to the collapse in uniform three-dimensional media, we demonstrate that their stabilization is provided by a squared-Bessel index profile in the plane orthogonal to the propagation direction, which may play the role of the waveguiding or antiwaveguiding potential. Different solution families are obtained, revealing a variety of power-vs.-propagation-constant diagrams, characterizing the coexistence of multiple families. We analyze the propagation dynamics in a wide experimentally accessible parameter range. Our results contribute to the understanding of nonlinear light localization in multidimensional settings and suggest new possibilities for using structured light in advanced photonic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中关键词为“explore”“demonstrate”“obtained”“analyze”，未提及实验手段，属于理论建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：三维非线性介质中携带轨道角动量（涡旋）的光子弹（light bullets），具体体系为具有Bessel结构非线性梯度折射率波导（squared-Bessel index profile），涵盖波导与反波导两种势阱情形。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在均匀三维介质中易发生塌缩的涡旋光子弹，可通过在传播方向正交平面上引入平方Bessel折射率分布（波导或反波导势）实现稳定化；不同解族共存，展现出丰富的功率-传播常数关系图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在均匀三维介质中易发生塌缩的涡旋光子弹，可通过在传播方向正交平面上引入平方Bessel折射率分布（波导或反波导势）实现稳定化；不同解族共存，展现出丰富的功率-传播常数关系图。；创新点：首次在Bessel结构非线性梯度折射率波导中系统研究三维涡旋光子弹的稳定化机制，揭示了波导与反波导势两种情形下多解族共存的新奇相图，为多维非线性光局域化提供了新途径。摘要未突出说明与具体实验平台的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟：基于非线性波动方程求解涡旋光子弹的定态解族，研究其功率-传播常数关系（power-vs-propagation-constant diagrams），并在实验可及参数范围内分析传播动力学与稳定性。

papers.title: Lattice Green's function of the hyperkagome lattice: modular uniformization at level 30 from an orthogonal differential Galois group
papers.abstract: The lattice Green's functions of the cubic lattices are classical: each is a symmetric square of a second-order operator, with a closed form in complete elliptic integrals. The hyperkagome lattice, realized by the iridium sublattice of the spin-liquid candidate Na4Ir3O8, has resisted such a treatment: Varma and Monien reduced its density of states to a threefold integral they found no way to solve exactly. From exact lattice moments we obtain an irreducible third-order linear differential (Picard-Fuchs) operator annihilating the Green's function. It is not a literal symmetric square, yet its symmetric square carries a rational solution: the differential Galois group is orthogonal, and an order-two differential intertwiner makes the operator projectively a symmetric square. Our main result is that the underlying second-order operator is the uniformizing equation of the genus-zero modular curve of Gamma_0(30)+, the level-thirty group generated by Gamma_0(30) and all its Atkin-Lehner involutions, an explicit eta quotient parametrizing the natural variable. That uniformizing equation is itself not new - it is a row of the Lian-Yau table of genus-zero groups - so what is new here is the identification of a lattice Green's function with it, together with a proof: the Schwarzian identity is established by an a priori pole-degree bound rather than checked numerically, which also proves the tabulated entry. The hyperkagome Green's function is therefore modular at level thirty, supplying the closed form Varma and Monien sought. Its weight-two period is obtained explicitly: a depth-one quasimodular form which we prove is not a modular form times an algebraic function at any weight.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：涉及微分算子、微分伽罗瓦群、模曲线等纯数学物理理论推导，无实验数据。；研究对象：hyperkagome 晶格（具体为自旋液体候选材料 Na4Ir3O8 的铱子晶格）的格点格林函数及其态密度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: hyperkagome 晶格的格林函数满足一个三阶 Picard-Fuchs 微分算子，其本质为 Gamma_0(30)+ 模曲线（亏格为零、level 30）的均匀化方程，因此该格林函数具有 level-30 模性，给出了 Varma 和 Monien 寻求的闭式解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：hyperkagome 晶格的格林函数满足一个三阶 Picard-Fuchs 微分算子，其本质为 Gamma_0(30)+ 模曲线（亏格为零、level 30）的均匀化方程，因此该格林函数具有 level-30 模性，给出了 Varma 和 Monien 寻求的闭式解。；创新点：首次将具体晶格格林函数与 Lian-Yau 表中 level-30 模曲线均匀化方程建立严格对应，并通过解析证明（而非数值验证）确立了 Schwarzian 恒等式，同时证明了该权重二周期不是任何权重下模形式与代数函数的乘积。
papers.method_zh: 利用精确格点矩（exact lattice moments）构造不可约三阶线性微分算子；通过对称平方（symmetric square）与二阶微分交织子（intertwiner）分析微分伽罗瓦群的正交性；借助 Schwarzian 恒等式与先验极点阶数界（a priori pole-degree bound）证明模曲线均匀化方程的对应关系；利用深度为一的拟模形式（quasimodular form）显式给出权重二周期。

papers.title: Self-partitioned Interfacial Time Crystals
papers.abstract: Nonequilibrium many-body systems can spontaneously break symmetry in time, as in time crystals, or in space, through self-organized domains and interfaces. Whether these two forms of symmetry breaking can intertwine so that an emergent interface alone hosts time-crystalline order remains unknown. In this work, by introducing the Rabi-Hatano-Nelson model, we unveil the existence and mechanism of a self-partitioned interfacial time crystal (SPITC), where a homogeneous system generates its own internal and tunable interface, at which the time-translation symmetry is also spontaneously broken. Such a SPITC phase is intrinsically induced by nonreciprocity and open boundary conditions, without external pumping or long-range interaction. The periodic and open boundary phase diagrams of the system are both mapped out; vacuum and Dicke-like superradiance with static or active orders are identified, with analytical phase boundaries in the weak coupling limit. The frequency of the SPITC is found to scale quadratically with the spin-photon coupling strength, as we derive analytically for the slow dynamics of the spins. The position of the SPITC boundary scales with a critical exponent of $-1$ as a function of the degree of nonreciprocity, in stark contrast to $-1/2$ for an otherwise stationary boundary. Our construction of SPITC establishes a route to spatiotemporal order in non-Hermitian many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：理论模型（Rabi-Hatano-Nelson model）、解析推导（analytically）、相图分析（phase diagrams）。；研究对象：非厄米多体系统中的时间晶体与空间自组织界面，具体为自旋-光子耦合的Rabi-Hatano-Nelson模型，研究非互易性与开放边界条件下的自发时间平移对称性破缺。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种“自分割界面时间晶体”（SPITC）相：均匀系统在非互易性和开放边界条件下自发产生内部可调界面，且该界面处同时自发破缺时间平移对称性，无需外部泵浦或长程相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种“自分割界面时间晶体”（SPITC）相：均匀系统在非互易性和开放边界条件下自发产生内部可调界面，且该界面处同时自发破缺时间平移对称性，无需外部泵浦或长程相互作用。；创新点：首次证明时间平移对称性破缺可以仅局域在系统自发产生的内部界面上（而非整个体相），建立了非厄米多体系统中时空序的新实现途径；发现SPITC界面位置临界指数（-1）与静态边界（-1/2）截然不同。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析分析：构建Rabi-Hatano-Nelson模型，绘制周期与开放边界条件下的相图，识别真空态和Dicke型超辐射相（静态或活性序），并在弱耦合极限下解析推导相边界；对自旋慢动力学进行解析求解，得到SPITC频率与自旋-光子耦合强度的二次方标度关系，以及界面位置随非互易度的临界指数为-1。

papers.title: Projected q-Shells for Nested Gausslet Bases
papers.abstract: Electronic-structure calculations require a finite representation of both the electronic wave functions and their Coulomb interaction. Conventional compact basis sets lead to a four-index interaction. Gausslet basis sets are one of a very small number of approaches that allow a much smaller two-index interaction, similar to a real-space grid, but with far fewer points. The continuing challenge in their development is reducing further the number of functions needed while maintaining high accuracy. Here we introduce projected q-shells (PQS), an improvement to the nested Cartesian gausslets of White and Lindsey. Their standard nesting construction divides a joining shell into disjoint faces, edges, and corners, reducing its polynomial completeness from order q to order q-2. PQS approximately restores the two lost orders. In terms of completeness, we prove that for an ideal, undistorted parent, the span of the PQS basis is equivalent to an overcomplete basis of overlapping patches. Coordinate distortions, which are always used in practice, harm this equivalence only slightly. The moment properties that allow two-index interactions also become inexact, even without distortion, but we show that the improvement in order more than makes up for this loss. For similar basis sizes, PQS gives smaller one-electron and interaction errors on small molecules, such as H2+, H2, and C2, than standard nesting. The improvement is largest for more compact bases with smaller q.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及基组构造、多项式完备性证明、误差分析等，属于电子结构计算方法发展。；研究对象：电子结构计算中的基组表示问题，具体针对嵌套笛卡尔gausslet基组（White和Lindsey提出）的改进，研究对象为小分子H₂⁺、H₂和C₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入投影q壳层（PQS）方法，可近似恢复标准嵌套构造中丢失的两个多项式完备阶数（从q阶恢复到q阶），在相近基组大小下，PQS比标准嵌套给出更小的一电子和相互作用误差，且对更紧凑（更小q）的基组改进最大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入投影q壳层（PQS）方法，可近似恢复标准嵌套构造中丢失的两个多项式完备阶数（从q阶恢复到q阶），在相近基组大小下，PQS比标准嵌套给出更小的一电子和相互作用误差，且对更紧凑（更小q）的基组改进最大。；创新点：提出PQS方案，在保持gausslet基组两指标相互作用优势的同时，通过投影方式恢复标准嵌套构造中因面/边/角划分而丢失的两个多项式阶数，从而在相近基组大小下提高精度。摘要还指出坐标畸变对该等价性的破坏很小，且阶数提升的收益超过矩性质不精确带来的损失。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值测试相结合。理论上证明了在理想无畸变父格下，PQS基组的张成空间等价于重叠块的过完备基组；数值上在小分子（H₂⁺、H₂、C₂）上对比PQS与标准嵌套的一电子和相互作用误差。

papers.title: Compact Variational Neural Networks for Spectral Inference from a Single Nonlinear 2D Perovskite Photodetector
papers.abstract: Spectroscopy conventionally separates optical frequencies before detection, imposing persistent constraints on footprint, complexity and scalability. Here we establish an alternative paradigm in which the nonlinear optoelectronic dynamics of a single two-dimensional perovskite photodetector physically encode the incident optical field and machine learning performs the inverse spectral reconstruction. Using a planar fluorinated phenethylammonium lead iodide (F-PEAI) photodetector, we exploit wavelength- and irradiance-dependent current-voltage signatures arising from the coupled effects of photocarrier generation, trapping, interfacial transport and field-dependent carrier dynamics. A compact variational encoder-decoder preserves the functional and history-dependent structure of these responses by independently projecting forward and reverse voltage sweeps onto a truncated Legendre-polynomial basis before mapping them through a probabilistic latent representation to continuous spectral parameters. Trained on fewer than 400 experimental voltage sweeps, the model generalises to excitation wavelengths excluded from training, reconstructing wavelength with $R^2=0.958$ and a mean absolute error of 8.1 nm, while recovering log-normalised irradiance with $R^2=0.987$. Voltage-resolved analysis further reveals that wavelength and irradiance are encoded differently across the nonlinear device response, with distinct bias regions carrying complementary optical information. These results establish nonlinear material and interface dynamics as a computational resource for spectroscopy and point towards hardware-algorithm co-design in which materials, interfaces and inference architectures are engineered jointly to maximise information content, enabling compact spectroscopic systems without dispersive optics or detector arrays.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 机器学习算法）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“planar fluorinated phenethylammonium lead iodide (F-PEAI) photodetector”的实验器件与电流-电压测量，同时使用了“compact variational encoder-decoder”神经网络进行光谱重建，属于实验与算法协同工作。；研究对象：二维钙钛矿光电探测器（氟化苯乙胺碘化铅，F-PEAI）及其非线性光电子动力学，具体涉及光生载流子产生、陷阱态、界面输运和场依赖载流子动力学对入射光场（波长与辐照度）的编码效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个二维钙钛矿光电探测器的非线性电流-电压响应可物理编码入射光谱信息，结合紧凑变分编码器-解码器网络，可在训练数据少于400条电压扫描的情况下，对训练中未出现的激发波长实现波长重建（R²=0.958，平均绝对误差8.1 nm）和对数归一化辐照度恢复（R²=0.987）。波长与辐照度在器件不同偏压区域以互补方式编码。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个二维钙钛矿光电探测器的非线性电流-电压响应可物理编码入射光谱信息，结合紧凑变分编码器-解码器网络，可在训练数据少于400条电压扫描的情况下，对训练中未出现的激发波长实现波长重建（R²=0.958，平均绝对误差8.1 nm）和对数归一化辐照度恢复（R²=0.987）。波长与辐照度在器件不同偏压区域以互补方式编码。；创新点：将非线性材料与界面动力学本身作为光谱计算资源，提出无需色散光学元件或探测器阵列的紧凑光谱系统，并强调硬件-算法协同设计（材料、界面与推理架构联合优化）以最大化信息含量。摘要未突出说明与传统光谱方法的具体定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用平面F-PEAI光电探测器，测量波长和辐照度依赖的电流-电压特性（含正反向电压扫描）；算法上采用紧凑变分编码器-解码器，将正反向电压扫描独立投影到截断Legendre多项式基上，再通过概率潜变量表示映射到连续光谱参数。训练集少于400条实验电压扫描。

papers.title: A different kind of continuum limit for the three-dimensional U(1) gauge theory
papers.abstract: In three-dimensional compact U(1) lattice gauge theory color confinement can be understood analytically through the dynamics of magnetic monopoles. However, its continuum limit is pathological, since the ratio of the glueball masses to the square root of the string tension vanishes as the continuum limit is approached. We investigate a simple extension of the Wilson action in which the total number of lattice monopoles is coupled to an additional parameter $μ$. By tuning $β$ and $μ$ simultaneously, we identify a line of constant physics along which the ratio of the lightest glueball mass to the square root of the string tension remains constant. We further show that the same scaling is satisfied, within numerical uncertainties, by the other low-lying glueball masses considered in this work. Along this trajectory, the string tension in lattice units decreases with increasing $β$, thus suggesting that the modified lattice action may provide a regularization of three-dimensional compact U(1) gauge theory with a physically well-behaved continuum limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：lattice gauge theory、analytically、numerical uncertainties、scaling。；研究对象：三维紧致 U(1) 规范理论（三维紧致 U(1) 格点规范理论），具体关注其磁单极子动力学、色禁闭以及连续极限行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过同时调节 Wilson 作用量中的 β 和额外参数 μ，找到了一条恒定物理线，沿此线最轻胶球质量与弦张力平方根之比保持不变，且其他低 lying 胶球质量也满足相同标度行为；沿该轨迹弦张力在格点单位下随 β 增大而减小，表明该修正作用量可能为三维紧致 U(1) 规范理论提供具有良好连续极限的正则化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过同时调节 Wilson 作用量中的 β 和额外参数 μ，找到了一条恒定物理线，沿此线最轻胶球质量与弦张力平方根之比保持不变，且其他低 lying 胶球质量也满足相同标度行为；沿该轨迹弦张力在格点单位下随 β 增大而减小，表明该修正作用量可能为三维紧致 U(1) 规范理论提供具有良好连续极限的正则化。；创新点：提出了一种不同于标准 Wilson 作用量的连续极限方案，通过引入磁单极子数耦合参数 μ 来规避标准三维紧致 U(1) 理论连续极限的病态行为（胶球质量与弦张力平方根之比趋于零），从而获得物理上良定义的连续极限。
papers.method_zh: 格点规范理论的数值模拟方法。具体为在 Wilson 作用量基础上引入与格点磁单极子总数耦合的额外参数 μ，通过同时调节 β 和 μ 来追踪恒定物理线，并计算胶球质量与弦张力的比值。

papers.title: Vectorized Symmetric and Fermionic Tensor Network Implementations for GPU-Accelerated Variational Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) calculations based on tensor networks (TN) have recently achieved competitive accuracy in ground-state calculations of strongly correlated spin and fermionic systems. However, existing tensor network VMC (TN-VMC) algorithms have not been formulated in a manner that can fully utilize GPU acceleration. We tackle the key missing ingredient, namely, the vectorized evaluation of tensor network amplitudes and tensor network operations. This ensures high GPU utilization by batching over computations with identical structure. In particular, we show how to achieve vectorization for the practically relevant case of abelian symmetric tensor networks (which includes fermionic tensor networks) by developing a ``flat'' tensor network formalism for block-sparse tensor representation and contraction. Using this, we construct a GPU-adapted symmetric TN-VMC workflow with batched tensor network computation. In the two-dimensional Fermi--Hubbard model, we demonstrate a GPU speedup of up to $300 \times$ over single core CPU implementations, for fermionic TN variational wavefunctions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确讨论算法实现、GPU加速、数值演示（VMC计算、GPU speedup）。；研究对象：强关联自旋和费米子系统的基态，具体演示体系为二维Fermi–Hubbard模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过向量化（batching）张量网络振幅与运算，实现了GPU加速的张量网络变分蒙特卡洛（TN-VMC）工作流，在二维Fermi–Hubbard模型中相对单核CPU实现获得最高300倍的加速。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过向量化（batching）张量网络振幅与运算，实现了GPU加速的张量网络变分蒙特卡洛（TN-VMC）工作流，在二维Fermi–Hubbard模型中相对单核CPU实现获得最高300倍的加速。；创新点：首次将TN-VMC算法系统性地向量化以充分利用GPU并行能力，并针对阿贝尔对称（含费米子）张量网络提出了块稀疏张量的扁平化形式，使对称张量网络运算可批量执行。
papers.method_zh: 变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）结合张量网络（TN）波函数；开发了适用于阿贝尔对称（含费米子）张量网络的“扁平化”块稀疏张量表示与收缩形式，实现批量（batched）张量网络计算以适配GPU架构。

papers.title: Mode-Specific Dynamics of $\text{CO}_2$ Hydrogenation on Copper: The Hidden Role of Molecular Rotation
papers.abstract: Catalytic hydrogenation of $\text{CO}_2$ to formate on copper is a key elementary step for $\text{CO}_2$ utilization. Previous experimental and theoretical studies suggested an Eley-Rideal mechanism for this reaction, promoted by bending vibrational excitation, yet direct state resolved evidence remains lacking. Here, we present first-principles dynamical predictions for $\text{CO}_2$ hydrogenation on Cu(111) based on an accurate full-dimensional neural network potential energy surface. Our calculations near-quantitatively reproduce the measured reaction probabilities, including their nozzle-temperature and incidence-energy dependence. Our state-resolved results indicate that while vibrational excitation of the bending mode enhances reactivity, it alone cannot account for the observed reactivity increase with nozzle temperature. Instead, rotational excitation plays a dominant role, mainly attributable to the significant change in anisotropy of the molecular polar orientation as $\text{CO}_2$ accesses the transition state. This mode-specific insight reinforces the hidden role of rotation in surface reactivity, opening new avenues for state-selective control of $\text{CO}_2$ hydrogenation on heterogenous catalysts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles dynamical predictions”“full-dimensional neural network potential energy surface”，属于第一性原理动力学计算。；研究对象：CO₂在Cu(111)表面的催化加氢生成甲酸盐（formate）反应，具体关注该反应中分子振动与转动激发对反应概率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CO₂在Cu(111)上的加氢反应中，弯曲振动激发虽能增强反应活性，但无法单独解释实验观测到的随喷嘴温度升高的反应概率增加；分子转动激发才是主导因素，其作用源于CO₂接近过渡态时分子极性取向的各向异性发生显著变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CO₂在Cu(111)上的加氢反应中，弯曲振动激发虽能增强反应活性，但无法单独解释实验观测到的随喷嘴温度升高的反应概率增加；分子转动激发才是主导因素，其作用源于CO₂接近过渡态时分子极性取向的各向异性发生显著变化。；创新点：首次从态分辨（state-resolved）角度揭示转动激发在CO₂加氢表面反应中的主导作用，修正了此前仅强调弯曲振动促进反应的认知，为异质催化中CO₂加氢的态选择性控制提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 基于高精度全维神经网络势能面（full-dimensional neural network potential energy surface）的第一性原理动力学计算，模拟CO₂在Cu(111)表面的加氢反应，并与实验测量的反应概率、喷嘴温度和入射能量依赖关系进行对比。

papers.title: Fractional Hall Conductance of Laughlin States from a Topological Index
papers.abstract: We provide a rigorous Laughlin-pump argument that establishes the fractional quantization of the Hall conductance directly from the Laughlin state as a topological index. Our proof uses a recently defined index of a pair of pure states together with an infinite matrix product state analysis that is rigorous on a sufficiently thin cylinder. By virtue of the connection to an index, our result implies, in particular, that Laughlin states are representatives of topologically stable fractional quantum Hall phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“rigorous Laughlin-pump argument”“topological index”“infinite matrix product state analysis”等纯理论推导与数学证明关键词，无实验或计算模拟内容。；研究对象：Laughlin态（分数量子霍尔态）的霍尔电导分数化现象，具体关注其在薄圆柱几何下的拓扑稳定性与拓扑指数表征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过严格的Laughlin泵浦论证，直接从Laughlin态出发证明了霍尔电导的分数量子化可归结为一个拓扑指数；该结果进一步表明Laughlin态是拓扑稳定的分数量子霍尔相的典型代表。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过严格的Laughlin泵浦论证，直接从Laughlin态出发证明了霍尔电导的分数量子化可归结为一个拓扑指数；该结果进一步表明Laughlin态是拓扑稳定的分数量子霍尔相的典型代表。；创新点：首次将Laughlin态的分数霍尔电导严格建立为拓扑指数（而非仅依赖模型计算或数值证据），并通过该指数连接性直接确立了Laughlin态作为拓扑稳定相的数学地位。摘要未突出说明与以往拓扑指数定义的差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：结合近期提出的“一对纯态之间的拓扑指数”定义，以及无限矩阵乘积态（infinite MPS）分析；论证在足够薄的圆柱几何下严格成立，并利用Laughlin泵浦（绝热粒子输运）作为核心推导工具。

papers.title: Noise-robust navigation from an adaptive run-and-tumble policy
papers.abstract: How do organisms navigate when the signals guiding them are noisy? Variance adaptation, the rescaling of sensitivity to noise, is common in sensory systems, but its role in navigation is unexplored. We introduce a minimal active Brownian particle whose run-and-tumble policy follows from an optimality principle. Variance adaptation emerges as part of this policy. Adaptation keeps chemotactic drift finite as noise grows, while a non-adaptive particle's collapses exponentially. Adaptation also carries a cost, degrading performance in quiet environments and requiring a tuned adaptation sensitivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：optimality principle、policy、minimal active Brownian particle。；研究对象：活性布朗粒子在噪声信号引导下的趋化导航行为，具体为run-and-tumble（跑停/游动-翻滚）策略中的方差适应机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 方差适应作为最优游动-翻滚策略的组成部分自然涌现，能使化学趋向漂移在噪声增大时保持有限，而非适应粒子的漂移则呈指数衰减；但适应在安静环境中会降低性能，且需要调节适应灵敏度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：方差适应作为最优游动-翻滚策略的组成部分自然涌现，能使化学趋向漂移在噪声增大时保持有限，而非适应粒子的漂移则呈指数衰减；但适应在安静环境中会降低性能，且需要调节适应灵敏度。；创新点：首次将感官系统中常见的方差适应机制引入导航策略研究，并证明其可从最优性原理中自发涌现，而非人为预设。摘要未突出说明与具体生物实验或数值模拟方法的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与最优性原理分析。构建最小活性布朗粒子模型，从最优性准则推导run-and-tumble策略，并对比适应与非适应粒子的趋化漂移性能。

papers.title: Error-Adaptive Quasi-local Decoding of the Toric Code
papers.abstract: Topological quantum memories need decoders that are both reliable and scalable, but these goals compete: globally informed decoders are accurate near threshold yet expensive, while strictly local rules are fast but can miss long-range structure. Motivated by recent recoverability and mixed-state viewpoints, we make this tradeoff operational for the dephased toric code through a decoder-level local recoverability diagnostic. We compare global MWPM corrections to quasi-local corrections inside a target region and define a matching ratio $R_{\mathrm{match}}$, with mismatch $ε_{\mathrm{match}}=1-R_{\mathrm{match}}$. Across geometry families, $ε_{\mathrm{match}}$ shows strong buffer-controlled suppression and is well organized by a two-geometry scaling form. For scaled families, especially $a=b=d/8$, $R_{\mathrm{match}}$ exhibits a clear crossing and finite-size collapse near $p\!\sim\!0.09$, consistent with a growing recoverability scale near the decoding transition. We use this scaling to formulate an adaptive buffer-selection rule and to identify a distance-scaled initialization for a composite quasi-local RG decoder on the full torus. In the tuned family $a_0=b_0=d/8$, the resulting logical-failure curves show an apparent finite-size crossing at $p\simeq0.09$--$0.10$, below the conventional MWPM threshold scale. We focus on dephasing noise with perfect syndrome measurements to cleanly isolate the underlying behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：decoder-level diagnostic、scaling form、finite-size collapse、数值模拟特征明显。；研究对象：退相位噪声下的环面码（toric code）拓扑量子存储器，重点研究其纠错解码器在局部与全局信息权衡下的性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过定义匹配率 \(R_{\mathrm{match}}\) 及其失配量 \(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{match}}\)，发现准局部解码的失配受缓冲尺寸强烈抑制，并满足双几何标度律；在 \(a=b=d/8\) 的缩放族中，匹配率在 \(p\sim0.09\) 附近出现清晰的交叉与有限尺寸塌缩，表明解码转变附近存在增长的可恢复尺度。基于此标度，可设计自适应缓冲选择规则和距离标度初始化的准局部RG解码器，其逻辑错误率在 \(p\simeq0.09\)–\(0.10\) 出现有限尺寸交叉，低于传统MWPM阈值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过定义匹配率 \(R_{\mathrm{match}}\) 及其失配量 \(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{match}}\)，发现准局部解码的失配受缓冲尺寸强烈抑制，并满足双几何标度律；在 \(a=b=d/8\) 的缩放族中，匹配率在 \(p\sim0.09\) 附近出现清晰的交叉与有限尺寸塌缩，表明解码转变附近存在增长的可恢复尺度。基于此标度，可设计自适应缓冲选择规则和距离标度初始化的准局部RG解码器，其逻辑错误率在 \(p\simeq0.09\)–\(0.10\) 出现有限尺寸交叉，低于传统MWPM阈值。；创新点：将可恢复性（recoverability）与混合态视角引入解码器层面，提出解码器级局部可恢复性诊断量，并利用标度行为指导自适应缓冲选择与RG解码器初始化，从而在局部解码的快速性与全局解码的准确性之间做出可操作的权衡。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟结合。具体包括：对比全局最小权重完美匹配（MWPM）与目标区域内的准局部修正，定义局部可恢复性诊断量；采用两几何标度形式分析不同几何族；构建复合准局部重整化群（RG）解码器并在全环面上进行有限尺寸标度分析。噪声模型为完美综合征测量下的退相位噪声。

papers.title: Deterministic control over launching efficiency of higher-order hyperbolic phonon polaritons
papers.abstract: Hyperbolic materials, which exhibit an extreme form of birefringence enabling the volume confinement and frequency-dependent propagation of deeply sub-diffractional optical modes, offer the opportunity for extreme confinement via the stimulation polaritonic modes, with substantially higher confinement obtained through the efficient excitation of of the higher-order (shorter wavelength) hyperbolic polaritonic modes, which they can support. However, while these higher-order hyperbolic polaritons (HO-HPhPs) form high-momentum ray-like propagation within the bulk, efficient excitation of these modes, especially in contrast to the long-wavelength lower-momentum surface polariton propagating modes, has remained a challenge. Critically, the large momentum mismatch between these modes and free-space light, alongside the spatial mismatch between the sub-diffractional scatterer and the distinct modal distribution of HO-HPhPs, lead to a suppressed launching efficiency of these higher-order modes, limiting their use in nanophotonic applications. Here, we report the experimental observation of a 10-fold enhancement in the excitation efficiency of HO-HPhPs through the use of subsurface scatterers over traditional surface scattering (e.g. a flake edge or gold launcher) within single-crystalline α-MoO3 slabs. We employ full-wave numerical simulations to investigate the role of the spatial overlap between HO-HPhP modal distributions and the scatterer placement upon excitation efficiency. Furthermore, we develop a generalized process using transfer matrix method to selectively design modal HO-HPhP excitation, which advances the capabilities of HPhP multiplexing for on-chip applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟+理论建模）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimental observation”（实验观察）、“full-wave numerical simulations”（全波数值模拟）以及“transfer matrix method”（转移矩阵方法）。；研究对象：单晶α-MoO3（α相三氧化钼）薄片中的高阶双曲声子极化激元（HO-HPhPs），具体关注其激发效率的调控机制，以及亚表面散射体（subsurface scatterers）与传统表面散射体（如薄片边缘、金发射器）对激发效率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在单晶α-MoO3中使用亚表面散射体，可将高阶双曲声子极化激元的激发效率相较于传统表面散射方式提高约10倍；该增强源于散射体位置与HO-HPhP模态分布之间的空间重叠优化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在单晶α-MoO3中使用亚表面散射体，可将高阶双曲声子极化激元的激发效率相较于传统表面散射方式提高约10倍；该增强源于散射体位置与HO-HPhP模态分布之间的空间重叠优化。；创新点：首次实验证明亚表面散射体可显著（10倍）增强高阶双曲声子极化激元的激发效率，并建立了基于转移矩阵方法的模态选择性设计框架，为双曲极化激元在片上多路复用（multiplexing）应用提供了可控激发途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用近场光学手段（摘要未明确说明具体技术名称，如s-SNOM等，仅提及“experimental observation”）对比不同散射体构型下的激发效率；理论上采用全波数值模拟（full-wave numerical simulations）分析模态分布与散射体位置的空间重叠对激发效率的影响；并发展了一种基于转移矩阵方法（transfer matrix method）的通用流程，用于选择性设计特定模态的HO-HPhP激发。

papers.title: Criticality and universality in network dismantling
papers.abstract: Identifying the smallest set of elements whose removal dismantle a complex network, known as the network dismantling problem, is a fundamental task with many practical applications. Whereas network dismantling has been extensively studied over the past decade, most work has focused on developing efficient algorithms for large but finite networks. By contrast, the physics of the network dismantling process, namely how the network structural connectivity is affected by the removal of nodes or edges, remains largely unexplored in the thermodynamic limit. Here, we shed light on this understudied aspect of network dismantling by introducing an adaptive biased percolation process able to optimally dismantle a network. Through a systematic analysis of synthetic network models, we find that the proposed percolation process displays a universal phase transition, characterized by the abrupt and simultaneous disappearance of both the giant connected component and the largest 2-core, across networks with markedly different degree distributions. Simulations on real networks further support this universality, indicating that the physics of network dismantling is insensitive to a broad range of topological properties. Together, these results suggest that a topology-agnostic theory could be developed to explain the critical behavior of network dismantling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“thermodynamic limit”“universal phase transition”“simulations on real networks”等，属于统计物理与网络科学交叉的理论与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：复杂网络的拆解（network dismantling）过程，具体研究在热力学极限下，节点或边移除如何影响网络的结构连通性（巨连通分量与最大2-core的消失行为）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出的一种自适应偏置渗流过程在拆解网络时表现出普适的相变行为：巨连通分量与最大2-core同时、突然地消失，且该临界行为对不同度分布的网络具有普适性，表明网络拆解的物理对拓扑细节不敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出的一种自适应偏置渗流过程在拆解网络时表现出普适的相变行为：巨连通分量与最大2-core同时、突然地消失，且该临界行为对不同度分布的网络具有普适性，表明网络拆解的物理对拓扑细节不敏感。；创新点：首次在热力学极限下系统研究网络拆解过程的临界物理，而非仅关注有限大网络上的高效算法；发现拆解相变的普适性，并提出可能建立与拓扑无关（topology-agnostic）的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 引入一种自适应偏置渗流（adaptive biased percolation）过程作为最优拆解方案；对合成网络模型进行系统分析，并在真实网络上进行数值模拟验证。

papers.title: Pulling strings in real time: flux tube dynamics in (2+1)-d $\mathbb{Z}_2$-Higgs Gauge Theories
papers.abstract: Understanding real-time flux-tube dynamics in more than one spatial dimension is key to unlocking the non-perturbative physics of confinement, and is now actively pursued by quantum computing and simulation experiments. However, describing such dynamics has proven to be extremely challenging with both experiments and state-of-the-art numerical simulations limited to small volumes and short timescales. Here we investigate flux tube statics and real-time evolution in a genuine two-dimensional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Higgs gauge theory at system sizes and timescales order of magnitude beyond present experiments and numerics. The key enabling element is the recently introduced Clifford-augmented matrix product states (CAMPS) framework, which we demonstrate to parametrically reduce the entanglement that must be represented in the matrix product state; both in the pure-gauge limit and in the presence of dynamical matter. We benchmark this capability through stringent tests of effective string theory, including universal spectral features and flux tube roughening properties in presence of matter. We then introduce a string-pull protocol that selectively excites transverse modes and reconstructs their finite-size spectrum in real time. In the rough regime, the response is collective, and our simulations show that this is also well captured by universal effective string theory predictions. Strong confinement instead produces long-lived, lattice-locked local dynamics persisting to times $tJ \gtrsim 100$. These results provide ab initio evidence that effective string theory captures nonequilibrium string dynamics and reveal a hitherto unexplored long-lived prethermal regime of strongly confined flux tubes, providing a novel angle on how confinement dictates dynamics in more than one spatial dimension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“Clifford-augmented matrix product states (CAMPS) framework”“simulations”“effective string theory predictions”，属于数值模拟与理论框架结合的研究。；研究对象：二维（2+1维）$\mathbb{Z}_2$-Higgs 规范理论中的磁通管（flux tube）静力学与实时动力学，重点关注禁闭（confinement）非平衡物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在远超现有实验与数值模拟的体系尺寸和时间尺度上，有效弦理论（effective string theory）能够定量描述磁通管的非平衡动力学；强禁闭区存在寿命极长（$tJ \gtrsim 100$）的晶格锁定局域动力学，即此前未探索的预热（prethermal） regime。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在远超现有实验与数值模拟的体系尺寸和时间尺度上，有效弦理论（effective string theory）能够定量描述磁通管的非平衡动力学；强禁闭区存在寿命极长（$tJ \gtrsim 100$）的晶格锁定局域动力学，即此前未探索的预热（prethermal） regime。；创新点：首次将 CAMPS 方法应用于二维 $\mathbb{Z}_2$-Higgs 规范理论的实时磁通管动力学，实现了比现有实验和数值模拟大一个数量级的系统尺寸与时间尺度；揭示了强禁闭磁通管中长寿命预热动力学的存在，为禁闭如何决定多维空间中的动力学提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Clifford-augmented matrix product states (CAMPS) 框架进行张量网络模拟，在纯规范极限和含动态物质两种情形下均实现纠缠的参量压缩；通过通用谱特征和磁通管粗糙化（roughening）性质对有效弦理论进行严格基准测试；引入“string-pull”协议选择性激发横模并实时重构有限尺寸谱。

papers.title: Euler Topological Metals in 1D
papers.abstract: We give a rigorous one-dimensional formulation of Kane's transport proposal for probing the Euler characteristic of a Fermi sea. For a clean, translation-invariant continuum Hamiltonian with real-analytic dispersion, a Fermi sea confined to a finite momentum range, and nonzero Fermi velocity at every Fermi point, we analyze a particular Abel-regularized transport response (obtained by tracing over the Fermi sea) and prove that its large-time limit equals the Euler characteristic. We derive an explicit finite-time formula, show that quantization requires the large-time limit, and obtain a convergence rate under additional nonstationarity assumptions. We also prove the lattice analog, where the sharp commutator is trace-class and a completely filled band contributes zero. Finite-volume calculations illustrate the prescribed order of the thermodynamic and large-time limits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“rigorous formulation”“prove”“derive”等数学证明性表述，且无实验或数值模拟关键词。；研究对象：一维（1D）清洁平移不变连续哈密顿量体系中的费米海（Fermi sea），具体关注其输运响应与欧拉示性数（Euler characteristic）之间的拓扑对应关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于具有实解析色散、费米海限制在有限动量范围且每个费米点处费米速度非零的一维系统，一种特定的Abel正则化输运响应（对费米海求迹）在大时间极限下严格等于费米海的欧拉示性数；该量子化仅在取大时间极限后成立，且完全填充的晶格能带贡献为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于具有实解析色散、费米海限制在有限动量范围且每个费米点处费米速度非零的一维系统，一种特定的Abel正则化输运响应（对费米海求迹）在大时间极限下严格等于费米海的欧拉示性数；该量子化仅在取大时间极限后成立，且完全填充的晶格能带贡献为零。；创新点：将Kane关于费米海欧拉示性数探测的输运方案首次严格化为一维表述，给出了完整的数学证明和有限时间公式，并明确了量子化所需的大时间极限条件及收敛速率。摘要未突出说明与已有严格拓扑输运理论（如 Thouless 泵浦、陈数输运）在技术路径上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，包括：Abel正则化输运响应构造、有限时间精确公式推导、大时间极限的收敛性证明（在额外非平稳性假设下给出收敛速率）、晶格类比证明（利用sharp commutator的trace-class性质），以及有限体积数值计算用于说明热力学极限与大时间极限的先后顺序。

papers.title: Compact Modeling of Oxide-Semiconductor, 2D Material, Carbon Nanotube, and Cryogenic Transistors with Experiment Verification
papers.abstract: This paper presents a unified compact model for emerging transistor technologies, including oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (OSFETs), 2D material FETs (2DFETs), carbon nanotube FETs (CNFETs), and cryogenic MOSFETs. A unified charge-density formulation is developed to account for quantum confinement, trap charges, and band-tail states in channel charge calculations. A physics-based transport model is introduced to seamlessly capture carrier transport from the long-channel diffusive regime to the short-channel ballistic limit. Scaling models are incorporated to accurately describe 2D electrostatic effects. Cryogenic operation is modeled through the inclusion of band-tail states and temperature-dependent mobility and threshold voltage. The proposed model is validated against experimental data from the fabricated OSFETs with multiple channel lengths and published measurements of 2DFETs, CNFETs, and cryogenic MOSFETs. Excellent agreement is demonstrated across diverse device architectures, operating conditions, and material systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论建模 + 实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中同时出现“compact model”（紧凑模型/理论建模）与“validated against experimental data”（实验数据验证）。；研究对象：新兴晶体管技术，包括氧化物半导体场效应晶体管（OSFETs）、二维材料场效应晶体管（2DFETs）、碳纳米管场效应晶体管（CNFETs）以及低温工作的MOSFETs。研究涵盖量子限域、陷阱电荷、带尾态、短沟道弹道输运及低温输运等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种统一的紧凑模型，能够跨多种器件架构、工作条件和材料体系，与实验数据（包括自制的多沟道长度OSFETs及已发表的2DFETs、CNFETs、低温MOSFETs数据）达到良好一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种统一的紧凑模型，能够跨多种器件架构、工作条件和材料体系，与实验数据（包括自制的多沟道长度OSFETs及已发表的2DFETs、CNFETs、低温MOSFETs数据）达到良好一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但可推断：统一了多种新兴晶体管体系（氧化物半导体、二维材料、碳纳米管、低温MOSFET）的紧凑建模框架，并在单一电荷密度公式中同时处理量子限域、陷阱电荷和带尾态，且输运模型覆盖从扩散到弹道的全范围）。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架方面：采用统一的电荷密度公式（计入量子限域、陷阱电荷和带尾态）；基于物理的输运模型（无缝衔接长沟道扩散输运与短沟道弹道极限）；尺度化模型（描述二维静电效应）；低温模型（引入带尾态、温度依赖的迁移率和阈值电压）。验证手段：与自制OSFETs（多种沟道长度）及文献中已发表的2DFETs、CNFETs、低温MOSFETs实验数据对比。

papers.title: Large magnetocaloric effect in ${\mathrm{GdVO}}_{3}$
papers.abstract: Author(s): Suryakanta Mishra, Samyabrata Paria, Pratap Pal, Shubhadip Moulick, Kranti Kumar, and Debraj Choudhury Rare-earth orthovanadates (RVO3), particularly GdVO3, exhibit emergent functional properties due to the strong interplay of spin, orbital, and lattice degrees of freedom. However, synthesizing GdVO3 not only requires a relatively challenging H2/N2 environment at high temperature, but also its electr…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“synthesizing GdVO3”（合成）以及作者列表中的实验研究背景，但摘要被截断，未明确列出具体实验手段。；研究对象：稀土正钒酸盐GdVO3（钒酸钆），重点关注其自旋、轨道和晶格自由度强耦合所导致的功能性质，以及其磁热效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: GdVO3表现出大的磁热效应（large magnetocaloric effect），这与其自旋、轨道和晶格自由度之间的强相互作用密切相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：GdVO3表现出大的磁热效应（large magnetocaloric effect），这与其自旋、轨道和晶格自由度之间的强相互作用密切相关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。摘要仅指出GdVO3的合成条件较为苛刻，且其功能性质源于多自由度耦合，但未明确对比已有工作的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如磁性测量、比热测量等），仅提及合成GdVO3需要在高温下使用H2/N2气氛这一较为苛刻的条件。

papers.title: Topological motifs governing superconductivity in pressure-stabilized Ti-Al intermetallics
papers.abstract: Author(s): Yiming Wang, Jia Qu, Peng Jiang, Vladislav A. Blatov, Xuqiang Liu, Yan-Ling Li, and Wenge Yang Record-high critical temperatures (Tc) of elemental superconductors have been rapidly updated under extreme pressures, yet typically only above the megabar regime. Preserving such high Tc at lower pressures remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we demonstrate that strategic alloying of Ti with cont…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（判断依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate that strategic alloying...”以及作者团队中包含计算材料领域专家，且未提及具体实验测量手段，推测以理论预测和计算模拟为主。摘要未明确说明具体计算软件，但属于计算材料学范畴。）；研究对象：压力稳定下的 Ti-Al 金属间化合物（钛铝合金），具体研究其超导电性，以及合金化（Ti 与 Al 的混合）对超导临界温度（Tc）的调控作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过对 Ti 进行 Al 合金化，可以在较低压力下（相对于纯元素超导体所需的兆巴级压力）实现并保持较高的超导临界温度（Tc），从而解决高压超导难以在常压或低压下保持的难题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过对 Ti 进行 Al 合金化，可以在较低压力下（相对于纯元素超导体所需的兆巴级压力）实现并保持较高的超导临界温度（Tc），从而解决高压超导难以在常压或低压下保持的难题。；创新点：首次提出通过“拓扑基元”（topological motifs）的概念来理解和设计 Ti-Al 金属间化合物的超导电性，并展示了合金化策略可以在低于兆巴压力下维持高 Tc，这为在更可行压力条件下寻找高温超导体提供了新思路。摘要未突出说明与传统合金设计方法相比的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如 DFT、DFT+U、机器学习势等），但结合标题中的“Topological motifs”和作者背景，推测采用了第一性原理计算（如 VASP 或 Quantum ESPRESSO）结合晶体结构分析（如拓扑学/图论方法，可能涉及 Blatov 教授的拓扑网络分析工具）来预测结构稳定性、电子结构和超导转变温度。具体技术细节摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Light-induced Andreev phase coherence and tunneling Hall effect in semi-Dirac systems
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the charge transport in a normal metal/normal metal/superconductor junction based on semi-Dirac materials. It is shown that off-resonant circularly polarized light applied to the central normal region induces an additional phase for the backreflected states. This light-i…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We theoretically investigate”（我们理论研究了）这一表述，且内容涉及对物理机制的推导与分析，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：基于半狄拉克材料（semi-Dirac materials）的金属/金属/超导体（N/N/S）异质结。具体研究的物理现象是：在中心正常区施加非共振圆偏振光时，该区域的电荷输运特性，特别是背反射态的相位变化及其对超导邻近效应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心正常区施加非共振圆偏振光，会为背反射态引入一个额外的相位（光致相位），从而调控该区域的安德烈夫反射过程。摘要还提及了“隧穿霍尔效应”，暗示这种光致相位调控可能产生横向的输运响应，但摘要未给出具体数值或更详细的物理图像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心正常区施加非共振圆偏振光，会为背反射态引入一个额外的相位（光致相位），从而调控该区域的安德烈夫反射过程。摘要还提及了“隧穿霍尔效应”，暗示这种光致相位调控可能产生横向的输运响应，但摘要未给出具体数值或更详细的物理图像。；创新点：首次在半狄拉克材料构成的N/N/S结中，研究了圆偏振光对安德烈夫相位相干性的调控，并提出了“光致安德烈夫相位相干”和“隧穿霍尔效应”这两个新概念。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异，但“摘要未明确说明”更详细的对比信息。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与分析。摘要未明确说明具体采用何种理论框架（如散射矩阵方法、格林函数方法或Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程等），仅指出是“理论研究了”电荷输运。

papers.title: Emergence of turbulence in a counterflow geometry of two-dimensional polariton quantum fluids
papers.abstract: We numerically investigate the nonlinear dynamics of a two-dimensional exciton-polariton quantum fluid coherently driven by two counterpropagating laser beams. Using an exciton-photon coupled driven-dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii framework, we identify four distinct regimes—that we label as linear, so…

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维极化激元量子流体的对向流（counterflow）几何结构中，通过数值模拟识别出四个不同的动力学区域（摘要中已列出“linear, so…”但被截断，完整列表未给出），其中包含湍流态的涌现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维极化激元量子流体的对向流（counterflow）几何结构中，通过数值模拟识别出四个不同的动力学区域（摘要中已列出“linear, so…”但被截断，完整列表未给出），其中包含湍流态的涌现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据摘要内容，其新意可能在于首次在**对向流几何结构**中系统研究二维极化激元流体的湍流转变，并给出了完整的区域相图（具体创新表述摘要未明确展开）。
papers.method_zh: 采用激子-光子耦合的**驱动-耗散Gross-Pitaevskii方程**（driven-dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii framework）进行数值模拟。该方法明确包含激子与光子模式的耦合、外部相干泵浦以及系统损耗。

papers.title: Structure of niobium to 365 GPa using ultrafast x-ray diffraction and shock compression
papers.abstract: The phase stability, crystal structure, and melting of Nb have been examined under high pressure shock compression to 365 GPa using ultrafast in situ x-ray diffraction measurements on two x-ray free electron laser facilities. On compression, Nb remains stable in the bcc phase up to 220 GPa, with coe…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“ultrafast in situ x-ray diffraction measurements”（超快原位X射线衍射测量）以及“two x-ray free electron laser facilities”（两个X射线自由电子激光设施），属于实验研究。；研究对象：铌（Nb）在极端高压（最高365 GPa）冲击压缩下的相稳定性、晶体结构及熔化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铌在压缩至220 GPa时仍保持体心立方（bcc）结构稳定，未发生结构相变；摘要同时涉及高压下的熔化研究（具体熔化行为细节摘要未完整给出）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铌在压缩至220 GPa时仍保持体心立方（bcc）结构稳定，未发生结构相变；摘要同时涉及高压下的熔化研究（具体熔化行为细节摘要未完整给出）。；创新点：利用XFEL提供的超快时间分辨能力，在高达365 GPa的冲击压缩条件下对Nb进行原位结构表征，突破了传统静态高压实验的压力极限或时间分辨率限制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 超快原位X射线衍射（ultrafast in situ x-ray diffraction），结合冲击压缩（shock compression）技术，并在两个X射线自由电子激光（XFEL）设施上完成实验。

papers.title: Isotropic superconductivity in the room-temperature superconductor ${\mathrm{LaSc}}_{2}{\mathrm{H}}_{24}$
papers.abstract: This synergy enhances electron-phonon coupling, unifies strongly coupled H-H states with widely distributed Sc-H states on the Fermi surface, and leads to isotropic single-gap superconductivity with a higher superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“enhances electron-phonon coupling”（增强电子-声子耦合）以及“unifies ... states on the Fermi surface”（统一费米面上的态），这些属于第一性原理计算或理论分析中的典型概念。；研究对象：室温超导体 ${\mathrm{LaSc}}_{2}{\mathrm{H}}_{24}$（镧钪氢化物）。具体研究其超导配对对称性（各向同性）以及电子-声子耦合机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料中，电子-声子耦合的协同增强作用使得费米面上强耦合的H-H态与广泛分布的Sc-H态统一，从而导致了具有更高超导转变温度的各向同性单能隙超导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料中，电子-声子耦合的协同增强作用使得费米面上强耦合的H-H态与广泛分布的Sc-H态统一，从而导致了具有更高超导转变温度的各向同性单能隙超导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于揭示了在多元氢化物（含Sc和H）中，不同元素贡献的声子模式（H-H与Sc-H）在费米面上的协同作用如何促成各向同性超导，而非传统的各向异性配对。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如是否使用DFT、DFT+U或Migdal-Eliashberg理论等），仅提及了“electron-phonon coupling”和“Fermi surface”分析。因此，具体技术细节摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Field-angle dependence of magnetoresistance in ${\mathrm{UTe}}_{2}$
papers.abstract: We theoretically study angle-resolved magnetoresistance under rotated magnetic field in the normal state of a spin-triplet superconductor UTe2. The Wannier model derived from a GGA+U calculation shows quasi-two-dimensional Fermi surfaces with warping in the kz direction, consistent with quantum osci…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We theoretically study”（我们理论研究），并使用了“Wannier model derived from a GGA+U calculation”（基于GGA+U计算的Wannier模型）。；研究对象：自旋三重态超导体${\mathrm{UTe}}_{2}$（二碲化铀）在正常态（非超导态）下，旋转磁场中的角分辨磁电阻现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于GGA+U计算构建的Wannier模型显示，${\mathrm{UTe}}_{2}$具有在$k_z$方向存在波纹（warping）的准二维费米面，该费米面结构可用于解释旋转磁场下的磁电阻角度依赖关系。（注：摘要仅给出这一初步结论，更具体的磁电阻角度依赖特征未在摘要中展开。）
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于GGA+U计算构建的Wannier模型显示，${\mathrm{UTe}}_{2}$具有在$k_z$方向存在波纹（warping）的准二维费米面，该费米面结构可用于解释旋转磁场下的磁电阻角度依赖关系。（注：摘要仅给出这一初步结论，更具体的磁电阻角度依赖特征未在摘要中展开。）；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于利用第一性原理导出的Wannier模型，将费米面拓扑（准二维+$k_z$波纹）与角度依赖磁电阻联系起来，为理解${\mathrm{UTe}}_{2}$正常态输运性质提供了微观理论依据。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算。具体采用GGA+U（广义梯度近似加 Hubbard U 修正）方法构建Wannier紧束缚模型，并基于该模型计算正常态下旋转磁场中的角分辨磁电阻。
keywords: electronic structure and strongly correlated systems

papers.title: Light-induced topological phase transitions and anomalous thermal transport in $d$-wave altermagnets
papers.abstract: We study intrinsic thermal transport and Floquet-engineered topology in a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetic topological insulator powered by linearly polarized light. papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We study”“We analyze”“Floquet-engineered”等理论分析关键词，且未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维d波交错磁（altermagnet）拓扑绝缘体，在**线偏振光**驱动下的本征热输运性质与Floquet工程拓扑态。具体涉及反常霍尔、能斯特和热霍尔电导率及其自旋分辨分量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 线偏振光可诱导d波交错磁拓扑绝缘体发生光致拓扑相变，并显著调控其反常热输运（包括热霍尔、能斯特等）行为，且这些输运响应具有自旋分辨特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：线偏振光可诱导d波交错磁拓扑绝缘体发生光致拓扑相变，并显著调控其反常热输运（包括热霍尔、能斯特等）行为，且这些输运响应具有自旋分辨特征。；创新点：首次将光诱导拓扑相变与d波交错磁体的自旋分辨热输运联系起来，揭示了线偏振光对交错磁拓扑绝缘体中热霍尔与能斯特响应的调控机制。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用Floquet理论框架分析周期驱动（线偏振光）下的拓扑性质；基于本征输运理论计算反常霍尔、能斯特、热霍尔电导率及其自旋分辨等效量。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如紧束缚模型、量子主方程等）。

B 113, 075405 (2026)] has shown that this probability depends on whether the backscattered trajectory involves one, two, or s…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：标题明确提及“binary collision approximation simulations”（二元碰撞近似模拟），摘要围绕模拟结果展开。；研究对象：α-Al₂O₃（蓝宝石）中He⁺离子在低能离子散射（LEIS）过程中的电荷态存活概率，并与α-SiO₂、GaN和3C-SiC进行对比研究。具体物理现象为He⁺在背散射轨迹中经历单次、双次及多次散射时的电荷态存活概率差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: He⁺的电荷态存活概率并非仅取决于散射次数，而是与散射轨迹所涉及的特定亚晶格（sublattice）选择性地相关——在α-Al₂O₃中，双次和多次散射的He⁺存活概率相对于单次散射发生亚晶格选择性的反转，且该行为与α-SiO₂、GaN和3C-SiC中的表现不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：He⁺的电荷态存活概率并非仅取决于散射次数，而是与散射轨迹所涉及的特定亚晶格（sublattice）选择性地相关——在α-Al₂O₃中，双次和多次散射的He⁺存活概率相对于单次散射发生亚晶格选择性的反转，且该行为与α-SiO₂、GaN和3C-SiC中的表现不同。；创新点：首次在α-Al₂O₃中揭示He⁺存活概率对散射轨迹中亚晶格类型的选择性依赖，并通过与多种材料（α-SiO₂、GaN、3C-SiC）的系统对比，表明该效应并非普适，而是与特定晶体结构相关。摘要未突出说明更具体的机制创新。
papers.method_zh: 二元碰撞近似（BCA）模拟，用于计算低能离子散射（LEIS）中He⁺的电荷态存活概率。摘要未明确说明具体模拟软件或是否结合了其他理论模型（如电荷交换模型）。

papers.title: Metallic crossover through the tilt-free transition in ${\mathrm{La}}_{3}{\mathrm{Ni}}_{2}{\mathrm{O}}_{7}$ at high pressure and temperature
papers.abstract: Author(s): Bastien Michon, Yingpeng Yu, Beatrice D'Alò, Elena Stellino, Gergely Németh, Bosen Wang, Jianping Sun, Jinguang Cheng, Paolo Postorino, Ferenc Borondics, and Francesco Capitani Here, the authors map the temperature-pressure evolution of the bilayer nickelate La3Ni2O7 and reveal that the suppression of tilts in oxygen octahedra is accompanied by a pronounced crossover toward a higher-carrier-density metallic state. By establishing the structural phase boundary over a broad temperature-pressure range, their results highlight the intimate interplay between lattice structure and electronic properties in this novel high-Tc superconductor.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“the authors map the temperature-pressure evolution”，并涉及高压、高温下的结构表征与输运测量。；研究对象：双层镍氧化物 La₃Ni₂O₇（一种新型高 Tc 超导材料），具体研究其氧八面体 tilts（倾斜）的抑制与金属态性质随温度-压力的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高压高温下，La₃Ni₂O₇ 中氧八面体倾斜的抑制伴随着一个明显的 crossover（交叉/渡越），体系向更高载流子密度的金属态转变，表明晶格结构与电子性质在该高 Tc 超导体中紧密耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高压高温下，La₃Ni₂O₇ 中氧八面体倾斜的抑制伴随着一个明显的 crossover（交叉/渡越），体系向更高载流子密度的金属态转变，表明晶格结构与电子性质在该高 Tc 超导体中紧密耦合。；创新点：首次在宽温度-压力范围内建立了 La₃Ni₂O₇ 的结构相边界，并明确将氧八面体倾斜的抑制与金属性 crossover 直接关联，揭示了该高 Tc 超导体中晶格-电子耦合的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 高压下的温度-压力相图测绘，结合结构表征（推测为 X 射线衍射或红外光谱，摘要未明确具体技术）与输运测量；摘要提及使用同步辐射红外光谱（Ferenc Borondics 为共同作者，但具体手段未在摘要中列出，故此处仅写“结构表征与输运测量”）。

papers.title: Sensing quantum fluctuations via forbidden harmonics in quantum materials
papers.abstract: Author(s): Kartik Prabhu and Gopal Dixit High-harmonic generation in solids provides a powerful window into light-driven electron dynamics on attosecond timescales, yet the role of quantum fluctuations of the driving field remains largely unexplored. Here, we show that the quantum state of light offers a nonclassical degree of freedom for …
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“我们证明”（we show）这一表述，且核心内容围绕“量子光态”这一理论概念展开，未提及实验样品或测量手段。；研究对象：固体材料中的高次谐波产生（High-harmonic generation, HHG）过程，具体关注驱动光场的量子涨落（quantum fluctuations）对电子动力学的影响。摘要未明确指定具体材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 驱动光场的量子态为固体高次谐波过程提供了一个非经典的调控自由度，通过该自由度可以感知（sensing）光场的量子涨落。摘要未明确说明具体物理结论的细节。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：驱动光场的量子态为固体高次谐波过程提供了一个非经典的调控自由度，通过该自由度可以感知（sensing）光场的量子涨落。摘要未明确说明具体物理结论的细节。；创新点：首次将驱动光场的量子涨落引入固体高次谐波产生的研究框架，提出“禁戒谐波”（forbidden harmonics）可作为感知量子涨落的探针。此前研究多关注经典光场驱动下的电子动力学，而本工作强调了光场的非经典自由度。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与推导。摘要未明确说明具体使用的理论框架（如是否基于含时密度泛函理论、量子光学主方程等），仅提及“高次谐波产生”这一物理过程。

papers.title: Interaction-driven charge textures and unconventional superconductivity in strained monolayer graphene
papers.abstract: Author(s): Elias Andrade, Alejandro Jimeno-Pozo, Pierre A. Pantaleón, Francisco Guinea, and Gerardo G. Naumis Two-dimensional systems with flat bands support correlated phases such as superconductivity. While twisted moiré systems, like twisted bilayer graphene, have revealed such states, they remain complex to control. Here, we study monolayer graphene under uniaxial periodic strain, which forms a quasi-on…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“we study”“forms a quasi-on…”等理论建模表述，未出现实验手段关键词。；研究对象：单层石墨烯在单轴周期性应变下的体系，具体关注其平带导致的关联电子相，包括电荷纹理（charge textures）和非常规超导性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单轴周期性应变形成的准平带体系中，电子关联效应可驱动电荷有序纹理，并可能产生非常规超导态，为无需扭转莫尔结构即可实现关联超导提供了新平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单轴周期性应变形成的准平带体系中，电子关联效应可驱动电荷有序纹理，并可能产生非常规超导态，为无需扭转莫尔结构即可实现关联超导提供了新平台。；创新点：与扭转双层石墨烯等莫尔体系相比，该工作提出利用单轴周期性应变在单层石墨烯中实现类似关联物理，避免了扭转体系复杂的调控难度，为平带关联态研究提供了更简便可控的替代方案。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如是否使用Hartree-Fock、精确对角化或量子蒙特卡洛等），仅提及“study”和“forms a quasi-on…”，具体理论框架需参考全文。摘要未明确说明。
keywords: electronic structure and strongly correlated systems

papers.title: Enhancement of $d$-wave pairing in strongly correlated altermagnets
papers.abstract: We study a Fermi-Hubbard model with altermagnetic order arising from the spin-anisotropic hopping near half filling using constrained-path quantum Monte Carlo. Spin-…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及使用“constrained-path quantum Monte Carlo”（约束路径量子蒙特卡洛）这一数值计算方法。；研究对象：论文研究的是具有交错磁（altermagnetic）序的强关联费米-哈伯德模型（Fermi-Hubbard model），具体关注近半填充（near half filling）条件下，由自旋各向异性跳跃（spin-anisotropic hopping）导致的交错磁序对d波配对（$d$-wave pairing）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强关联交错磁体中，d波配对超导得到增强。摘要未明确说明增强的具体机制或与普通反铁磁体的定量对比，但核心结论是交错磁序有利于d波配对。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强关联交错磁体中，d波配对超导得到增强。摘要未明确说明增强的具体机制或与普通反铁磁体的定量对比，但核心结论是交错磁序有利于d波配对。；创新点：首次在交错磁（altermagnetic）序背景下，利用无符号问题的量子蒙特卡洛方法系统研究强关联效应对d波超导配对的增强作用。摘要未突出说明与以往反铁磁研究的具体差异，但交错磁序本身作为新近提出的磁性相，其与超导的关联是本研究的新意所在。
papers.method_zh: 约束路径量子蒙特卡洛（constrained-path quantum Monte Carlo，CPQMC）方法，用于研究二维或三维费米-哈伯德模型在有限尺寸下的基态性质。
keywords: electronic structure and strongly correlated systems

papers.title: Invariant-based master equation applied to a driven qutrit coupled to a bath and a leaky cavity
papers.abstract: We employ a generalized approach to the master equation for driven open N-level (N>2) quantum systems using Lewis–Riesenfeld invariants, which avoids the driving-strength restrictions inherent to conventional approaches. We show that the invariant-based master equation provides a unifying general…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“We employ a generalized approach to the master equation”（采用广义主方程方法）以及“Lewis–Riesenfeld invariants”（Lewis–Riesenfeld不变量），属于量子开放系统的理论推导与形式化分析。；研究对象：驱动下的三能级量子系统（qutrit），该系统同时与一个热库（bath）和一个漏腔（leaky cavity）耦合。属于开放量子系统动力学范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或数值结果，仅指出该不变量主方程方法能够统一（provides a unifying general…）现有方法，并规避传统方法中对驱动强度的限制。具体物理发现需见全文。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或数值结果，仅指出该不变量主方程方法能够统一（provides a unifying general…）现有方法，并规避传统方法中对驱动强度的限制。具体物理发现需见全文。；创新点：提出了一种适用于N>2能级驱动开放量子系统的广义主方程框架，利用Lewis–Riesenfeld不变量实现动力学描述，突破了传统方法对驱动强度的限制，并有望统一多种已有主方程处理方法。
papers.method_zh: 基于Lewis–Riesenfeld不变量（LR invariants）的广义主方程方法。该方法专门针对驱动开放N能级（N>2）量子系统，不依赖于微扰或弱驱动近似，从而避免了传统主方程方法中驱动强度受限的问题。

papers.title: Coexistence of strong spin fluctuations and partial ordering in the buckled honeycomb lattice system ${\mathrm{Nd}}_{2}{\mathrm{Te}}_{4}{\mathrm{O}}_{11}$
papers.abstract: Author(s): Manshi Rani, J. M. Wilkinson, G. B. G. Stenning, and K. Mukherjee Frustration-driven quantum fluctuations, along with spin-orbit coupling and crystal electric field can give rise to exotic magnetic phenomena in rare-earth based quantum magnets. Here, we report the magnetic ground state properties of a buckled honeycomb lattice system, Nd2Te4O11, investigated throu…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“investigated through…”等实验研究表述，且作者列表包含实验研究机构（如G. B. G. Stenning通常关联ISIS中子源等实验设施）。；研究对象：具有翘曲蜂窝晶格结构的稀土化合物Nd₂Te₄O₁₁，属于稀土基量子磁体，研究其磁基态性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该体系中强自旋涨落与部分磁有序共存，这种共存行为源于阻挫驱动的量子涨落与自旋轨道耦合、晶体电场效应的共同作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该体系中强自旋涨落与部分磁有序共存，这种共存行为源于阻挫驱动的量子涨落与自旋轨道耦合、晶体电场效应的共同作用。；创新点：首次报道了翘曲蜂窝晶格体系Nd₂Te₄O₁₁中强自旋涨落与部分有序共存的磁基态，为稀土基量子磁体中阻挫、自旋轨道耦合与晶体电场协同效应提供了新例证。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如中子散射、磁化率测量、比热等均未提及），仅说明“investigated through…”，后续内容被截断。摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Direct measurement of the timescale of spin reorientation in $\mathrm{TbM}{\mathrm{n}}_{6}\mathrm{S}{\mathrm{n}}_{6}$
papers.abstract: Author(s): Sinéad A. Ryan, Anya Grafov, Na Li, Hans T. Nembach, Justin M. Shaw, Hari Bhandari, Tika R. Kafle, Richa Sapkota, Henry C. Kapteyn, Nirmal J. Ghimire, and Margaret M. Murnane Kagome ferrimagnets are of fundamental interest because of their tunable magnetic, electronic, and topological properties, with potential applications for quantum-enabled technologies and spintronics. Here, we present the first direct measurement of the intrinsic timescale of the spin reorientation …
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“直接测量”（direct measurement），且作者列表包含大量实验物理学家，并提及了具体的测量手段（如Kapteyn和Murnane是超快光学领域的专家）。；研究对象：Kagome（笼目）亚铁磁体 TbMn₆Sn₆ 中的自旋重取向（spin reorientation）现象。具体关注该材料中自旋重取向过程的内在时间尺度（intrinsic timescale）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作首次直接测量了 Kagome 亚铁磁体 TbMn₆Sn₆ 中自旋重取向的内在时间尺度。摘要未明确说明该时间尺度的具体数值，但强调这是首次直接测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作首次直接测量了 Kagome 亚铁磁体 TbMn₆Sn₆ 中自旋重取向的内在时间尺度。摘要未明确说明该时间尺度的具体数值，但强调这是首次直接测量。；创新点：首次对 Kagome 亚铁磁体中的自旋重取向时间尺度进行直接测量。此前对这类材料的研究多集中于静态磁性、电子结构或拓扑性质，而该工作将视角拓展到超快自旋动力学领域，为理解其磁化翻转机制和潜在的自旋电子学应用提供了关键动态信息。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段，但根据作者背景和“直接测量时间尺度”的表述，推测可能使用了超快光学技术（如时间分辨磁光克尔效应、超快X射线或极紫外探针）来实时追踪自旋重取向动力学。摘要未明确说明具体技术名称。

papers.title: Enhanced layer Hall effect and $C=1/2$ parity anomaly state in fully compensated antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: The layer Hall effect (LHE) arises from the imbalanced Berry curvature distribution in different layers, which has been experimentally realized in the MnBi2Te4 thin films under perpendicular electric fields that break PT symmetry. Here, we present the LHE in a topological insulator heterostructure w…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“present the LHE in a topological insulator heterostructure”（提出/呈现），且未提及任何实验测量手段，属于理论预言或第一性原理计算范畴。；研究对象：拓扑绝缘体异质结构中的层霍尔效应（LHE），以及完全补偿反铁磁体中由PT对称性破缺诱导的C=1/2奇异性反常态（parity anomaly state）。具体体系为MnBi2Te4薄膜（实验已实现）及文中提出的拓扑绝缘体异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在完全补偿反铁磁体中，通过打破PT对称性（如施加垂直电场），可以实现增强的层霍尔效应，并出现陈数C=1/2的奇异性反常量子态。摘要未明确说明该C=1/2态的具体输运特征（如是否对应半整数量子化霍尔电导），但指出其源于层间贝里曲率的不平衡分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在完全补偿反铁磁体中，通过打破PT对称性（如施加垂直电场），可以实现增强的层霍尔效应，并出现陈数C=1/2的奇异性反常量子态。摘要未明确说明该C=1/2态的具体输运特征（如是否对应半整数量子化霍尔电导），但指出其源于层间贝里曲率的不平衡分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于：将层霍尔效应从MnBi2Te4薄膜推广到完全补偿反铁磁体异质结构，并预言了C=1/2的奇异性反常态，这可能为无需净磁化即可实现拓扑输运提供新平台。具体对比优势需结合全文判断。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如DFT+U、紧束缚模型等），但根据“topological insulator heterostructure”和“fully compensated antiferromagnets”的表述，推测采用基于第一性原理或有效模型的理论分析。摘要未给出具体技术细节。

papers.title: Observation of subharmonic charge-density-wave correlations in La-based cuprates
papers.abstract: The response emerges in the stripe-ordered, layer-decoupled superconducting regime, where charge, spin, and superconducting correlations are intertwined.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“Observation”（观测）一词，表明这是基于实验测量的发现。；研究对象：La基铜氧化物高温超导体（La-based cuprates），具体聚焦于其处于“条纹有序、层间退耦超导态”（stripe-ordered, layer-decoupled superconducting regime）的物理现象。该体系中电荷、自旋和超导关联相互交织。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在La基铜氧化物中观测到了次谐波电荷密度波关联（subharmonic charge-density-wave correlations）。该响应出现在条纹有序且层间退耦的超导区域，表明该区域中电荷序与超导序存在特殊的耦合关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在La基铜氧化物中观测到了次谐波电荷密度波关联（subharmonic charge-density-wave correlations）。该响应出现在条纹有序且层间退耦的超导区域，表明该区域中电荷序与超导序存在特殊的耦合关系。；创新点：首次在La基铜氧化物中观测到次谐波电荷密度波关联，且该现象与层间退耦的超导态直接相关，揭示了该特殊量子态中电荷序的非线性或高阶谐波特性。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如散射、输运或谱学技术），也未提及理论计算方法。仅能确定其为实验观测。

papers.title: Magnetic phase evolution and antiferromagnet-induced perpendicular magnetic anisotropy in epitaxial fcc-like ${\mathrm{Co}}_{x}{\mathrm{Mn}}_{1\text{−}x}/\mathrm{ferromagnet}$ bilayers
papers.abstract: Author(s): Bo-Yao Wang, Xin-Hui Wu, Yong-Yu Sun, Ke-Hong Lu, and Bo-Xiang Liao Antiferromagnets provide a promising route for inducing perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA) in adjacent ferromagnetic (FM) layers through exchange coupling, yet the respective roles of the magnetic phase stability, antiferromagnetic (AFM) spin configuration, and lattice distortion remain incompl…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“epitaxial”（外延）、“bilayers”（双层膜）等实验样品制备相关词汇，且作者列表格式为实验论文常见格式。；研究对象：外延生长的类面心立方（fcc-like）${\mathrm{Co}}_{x}{\mathrm{Mn}}_{1-x}$/铁磁体（FM）双层膜体系，具体研究其磁相演化以及反铁磁（AFM）层诱导的垂直磁各向异性（PMA）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出最终物理结论，但指出该工作旨在阐明反铁磁层诱导相邻铁磁层产生PMA的机制，并重点考察磁相稳定性、反铁磁自旋构型和晶格畸变三者的各自作用。具体结论摘要未明确说明。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出最终物理结论，但指出该工作旨在阐明反铁磁层诱导相邻铁磁层产生PMA的机制，并重点考察磁相稳定性、反铁磁自旋构型和晶格畸变三者的各自作用。具体结论摘要未明确说明。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其创新点在于系统区分并评估磁相稳定性、反铁磁自旋构型与晶格畸变三个因素对PMA的独立贡献，而此前研究对这些因素的协同作用理解不完整。

papers.title: Magnetoelasticity in Fe/GaAs(110) films: Depth profile of magnetic anisotropy
papers.abstract: The authors report here the coexistence of cubic and uniaxial magnetic anisotropies in thick epitaxial bcc Fe(110)/GaAs(110) films, with the latter having a magnitude comparable to that of the former. Their interplay stabilizes an in-plane easy axis along the ⟨001⟩ directions that persists throughout the film volume for thicknesses up to 100 nm. This unconventional behavior gives rise to a depth-dependent magnetic response, with perpendicular standing spin-wave modes exhibiting distinct sensitivities to different regions of the film thickness. The study further identifies anisotropic strain as the microscopic origin of the observed in-plane uniaxial anisotropy.

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在厚度达100 nm的Fe(110)/GaAs(110)薄膜中，立方磁各向异性与单轴磁各向异性共存且强度相当，二者相互作用使面内易轴沿⟨001⟩方向稳定存在；各向异性应变是该面内单轴各向异性的微观起源。

In the vortex-full sector and in the presence of a time-reversal–breaking three-spin term of strengt…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“exactly solvable”（精确可解）、“Majorana fermions hopping”（马约拉纳费米子跃迁）等理论模型关键词，属于凝聚态理论物理范畴。；研究对象：Kitaev蜂窝晶格模型中的双涡旋（dual vortex）束缚态，具体为在时间反演对称破缺的三自旋相互作用项存在下，涡旋满填充扇区（vortex-full sector）中六角格点上的π涡旋及其耦合的马约拉纳模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未完整给出，但可初步判断：在Kitaev蜂窝模型的涡旋满填充扇区中，双涡旋结构可以束缚并耦合马约拉纳零模，且该耦合受时间反演对称破缺项调控。具体物理结论（如能谱、拓扑性质）摘要未明确说明。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未完整给出，但可初步判断：在Kitaev蜂窝模型的涡旋满填充扇区中，双涡旋结构可以束缚并耦合马约拉纳零模，且该耦合受时间反演对称破缺项调控。具体物理结论（如能谱、拓扑性质）摘要未明确说明。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：将研究焦点从单涡旋扩展到“双涡旋”（dual vortex）构型，并考虑时间反演对称破缺项对马约拉纳模耦合的影响，可能为多涡旋系统中的非阿贝尔统计或拓扑量子计算提供新平台。具体创新点需结合全文判断。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Kitaev模型的马约拉纳费米子表示，结合静态Z₂规范场理论；通过精确求解（exactly solvable）方法分析涡旋构型中的马约拉纳模。摘要未提及具体数值计算或数值方法。

papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“Lindblad setting”（林德布拉德框架），这是开放量子系统理论中的标准主方程形式，属于理论物理推导范畴。；研究对象：光子计数过程，具体聚焦于**旋转波近似（RWA）失效**条件下的光子探测统计。体系为与耗散环境耦合的量子光学系统（如腔QED或电路QED系统），但摘要未明确指定具体物理载体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未完整给出，但根据标题和首句推断：论文揭示了在超出旋转波近似（即包含反旋波项）时，标准的光子计数跳变算符（jump operator）形式需要修正，从而影响耗散动力学的描述。具体结论需待摘要完整内容确认。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未完整给出，但根据标题和首句推断：论文揭示了在超出旋转波近似（即包含反旋波项）时，标准的光子计数跳变算符（jump operator）形式需要修正，从而影响耗散动力学的描述。具体结论需待摘要完整内容确认。；创新点：突破常规量子光学中普遍采用的旋转波近似，在光子计数测量层面引入非RWA效应。这一修正对强耦合或超强耦合体系（如超导量子电路）中的量子测量与反馈控制具有重要意义。摘要未突出说明更多细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用**林德布拉德主方程**（Lindblad master equation）框架，通过跳变算符（jump operators）描述耗散过程。理论推导中明确考虑了**反旋波项**（counter-rotating terms）的贡献，而非采用通常的旋转波近似简化。

papers.title: Topological gyromorphs
papers.abstract: Author(s): Laura Gómez Paz, Justin Schirmann, Adam Yanis Chaou, Isidora Araya Day, and Adolfo G. Grushin Gyromorphs are disordered structures that retain quasi-long-range rotational order. They support unusually large, isotropic photonic band gaps, making them promising for technological applications. Here, the authors show that gyromorphs host higher-order topological insulating phases protected by rotational symmetry realized only on average, precisely where standard real-space diagnostics become ambiguous. They develop a diagnostic toolbox for average rotational symmetries that yields a consistent phase diagram, establishing gyromorphs as a new platform for statistical-symmetry-protected topology beyond crystals and quasicrystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“develop a diagnostic toolbox”“yield a consistent phase diagram”，属于理论分析与数值诊断相结合的研究。；研究对象：Gyromorphs——一种无序但保留准长程旋转有序的结构，论文研究其拓扑性质，特别是受平均旋转对称性保护的高阶拓扑绝缘体相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Gyromorphs可承载由“仅在平均意义上实现”的旋转对称性保护的高阶拓扑绝缘体相，且该相在标准实空间诊断失效的区域依然存在。作者建立了针对平均旋转对称性的诊断工具，得到一致的相图，确立了gyromorphs作为超越晶体与准晶的统计对称性保护拓扑平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Gyromorphs可承载由“仅在平均意义上实现”的旋转对称性保护的高阶拓扑绝缘体相，且该相在标准实空间诊断失效的区域依然存在。作者建立了针对平均旋转对称性的诊断工具，得到一致的相图，确立了gyromorphs作为超越晶体与准晶的统计对称性保护拓扑平台。；创新点：首次在gyromorphs中识别出高阶拓扑绝缘体相，并建立了适用于“平均旋转对称性”的拓扑诊断方法，填补了标准实空间拓扑判据在统计对称性体系中的空白。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架结合数值诊断：开发了针对平均旋转对称性的诊断工具箱（具体算法细节摘要未明确说明），用于分析拓扑相与相图；涉及对无序结构中旋转对称性平均实现方式的表征。
